inputs.description: The base filename for the saved images, which can include formatting for dynamic naming based on other parameters.

inputs.name: path
inputs.description: The directory path where the images will be saved.

inputs.name: extension
inputs.description: The file format extension for the saved images, supporting formats like PNG, JPEG, and WEBP.

inputs.name: steps
inputs.description: The number of steps involved in the image generation process, potentially included in the metadata.

inputs.name: cfg
inputs.description: The CFG (classifier-free guidance) scale used during image generation, optionally included in the metadata.

inputs.name: modelname
inputs.description: The name of the model used for generating the images, which can be included in the metadata.

inputs.name: sampler_name
inputs.description: The name of the sampling method used in the generation process, optionally included in the metadata.

inputs.name: scheduler
inputs.description: The scheduler used during the image generation, which can be included in the metadata.

inputs.name: positive
inputs.description: Positive prompts or keywords that influenced the image generation, optionally included in the metadata.

inputs.name: negative
inputs.description: Negative prompts or keywords that were avoided during the image generation, optionally included in the metadata.

inputs.name: seed_value
inputs.description: The seed value used for random number generation during image creation, optionally included in the metadata.

inputs.name: width
inputs.description: The width of the generated images.

inputs.name: height
inputs.description: The height of the generated images.

inputs.name: lossless_webp
inputs.description: A flag indicating whether to save images in a lossless format when using WEBP.

inputs.name: quality_jpeg_or_webp
inputs.description: The quality setting for JPEG or WEBP images, affecting file size and image clarity.

inputs.name: counter
inputs.description: A counter that can be used for naming or ordering images, potentially included in the metadata.

inputs.name: time_format
inputs.description: The format for timestamps that can be included in the filename or metadata, providing temporal context for the image generation.

Scheduler Selector.description: The Scheduler Selector node is designed to facilitate the selection of a scheduler from a predefined list of schedulers available within the Comfy samplers. It abstracts the complexity of scheduler selection, providing a streamlined interface for users to choose the most suitable scheduler for their image generation or modification tasks.

inputs.name: scheduler
inputs.description: Specifies the scheduler to be selected. This parameter allows users to choose from a list of available schedulers, impacting the image generation process by determining the scheduling algorithm used.

outputs.name: scheduler
outputs.description: Returns the selected scheduler's name. This output is crucial for further processing steps that require a specific scheduler to be identified and used.

Seed Generator.description: The Seed Generator node is designed to provide a deterministic or randomized seed value for various operations within the image saving process. It ensures that operations can be repeatable with a fixed seed or varied with a random seed, supporting both consistency and diversity in output.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.description: The seed parameter allows users to specify a seed value for generating deterministic outputs. If not provided, a default value is used, ensuring repeatability or randomness in operations.

outputs.name: int
outputs.description: Outputs an integer representing the seed value, which can be used to initialize random number generators or other processes requiring a seed.

String Literal.description: The String Literal node is designed to encapsulate and manage string values within the node network. It serves as a fundamental utility for handling literal string inputs, enabling the seamless integration and manipulation of text data across various nodes and processes.

inputs.name: string
inputs.description: This parameter allows users to input a literal string value, which the node then processes or passes on as needed. It acts as the primary means for introducing text data into the node's workflow, emphasizing the node's role in text management and manipulation.

outputs.name: string
outputs.description: Outputs the literal string value that was input, facilitating the transfer of text data to subsequent nodes or processes within the network.

Width_Height Literal.description: The Width/Height Literal node is designed to provide a straightforward way to specify and pass fixed width and height values as parameters within a node-based processing pipeline. This node simplifies the configuration of dimensions for various operations, ensuring that downstream nodes receive consistent and accurate size specifications.

inputs.name: int
inputs.description: unknown

outputs.name: int
outputs.description: unknown

CM_BoolBinaryOperation.description: This node performs binary operations on boolean values, allowing for the combination and manipulation of boolean logic.

inputs.name: op
inputs.description: Specifies the binary operation to perform on the boolean inputs, such as 'And', 'Or', 'Xor', etc. This choice determines how the two boolean inputs will be combined.

inputs.name: a
inputs.description: The first boolean input for the binary operation.

inputs.name: b
inputs.description: The second boolean input for the binary operation.

outputs.name: bool
outputs.description: The result of the specified binary operation on the two boolean inputs.

CM_BoolToInt.description: This node performs a type conversion from a boolean value to an integer. It abstracts the process of interpreting boolean logic in a numerical context, enabling the translation of true/false values into binary (0 or 1) form.

inputs.name: a
inputs.description: The boolean input to be converted to an integer. This parameter is crucial as it directly influences the output by determining whether the result will be 0 (False) or 1 (True).

outputs.name: int
outputs.description: The integer representation of the input boolean value, where True becomes 1 and False becomes 0.

CM_BoolUnaryOperation.description: This node performs unary boolean operations on a given boolean value. It supports operations like logical NOT, allowing for the manipulation of boolean logic in a mathematical or logical context.

inputs.name: op
inputs.description: Specifies the unary boolean operation to be performed, such as 'Not'. This choice determines how the input boolean value is manipulated.

inputs.name: a
inputs.description: The boolean value to be operated on. This is the primary input for the unary operation.

outputs.name: bool
outputs.description: The result of the unary boolean operation performed on the input value.

CM_BreakoutVec2.description: The CM_BreakoutVec2 node is designed for decomposing a 2-dimensional vector into its individual components, facilitating operations that require access to the separate x and y values.

inputs.name: a
inputs.description: The 'a' parameter represents the 2-dimensional vector to be decomposed. It allows for operations on vectors by breaking them down into their individual x and y components.

outputs.name: float
outputs.description: The output consists of two float values, representing the x and y components of the input vector, respectively.

CM_BreakoutVec3.description: The node is designed to decompose a 3-dimensional vector into its individual components, facilitating operations that require access to the separate dimensions of a vector.

inputs.name: a
inputs.description: This parameter represents the 3-dimensional vector to be decomposed. It allows for operations on individual vector components by breaking down the vector into its x, y, and z components.

outputs.name: float
outputs.description: Each output represents one of the three components of the input vector, allowing for individual manipulation or analysis of the vector's dimensions.

CM_BreakoutVec4.description: The node is designed to decompose a four-dimensional vector into its individual components, facilitating operations that require access to the separate elements of a Vec4.

inputs.name: a
inputs.description: This parameter represents the four-dimensional vector to be decomposed. It is crucial for the operation as it provides the vector whose components are to be extracted.

outputs.name: float
outputs.description: Each output represents one of the four components of the input Vec4, allowing for individual manipulation or analysis.

CM_ComposeVec2.description: The CM_ComposeVec2 node is designed to construct a 2-dimensional vector from individual scalar components, facilitating the conversion of separate scalar values into a structured vector format.

inputs.name: x
inputs.description: The 'x' parameter represents the x-coordinate of the 2-dimensional vector. It plays a crucial role in defining the vector's horizontal component.

inputs.name: y
inputs.description: The 'y' parameter represents the y-coordinate of the 2-dimensional vector. It is essential for defining the vector's vertical component.

outputs.name: vec2
outputs.description: Outputs a 2-dimensional vector constructed from the input scalar values, encapsulating both the horizontal and vertical components.

CM_ComposeVec3.description: The `CM_ComposeVec3` node is designed for creating a 3-dimensional vector (Vec3) from individual float values for each of its dimensions (x, y, z). This node facilitates the conversion of separate scalar values into a structured vector format, making it essential for mathematical operations and transformations that require vector inputs.

inputs.name: x
inputs.description: The 'x' parameter represents the x-coordinate of the Vec3. It is crucial for defining the vector's position along the x-axis.

inputs.name: y
inputs.description: The 'y' parameter represents the y-coordinate of the Vec3. It plays a key role in specifying the vector's position along the y-axis.

inputs.name: z
inputs.description: The 'z' parameter signifies the z-coordinate of the Vec3. It is essential for determining the vector's position along the z-axis.

outputs.name: vec3
outputs.description: The output is a 3-dimensional vector (Vec3) composed of the input float values for x, y, and z. This vector can be used for further mathematical or graphical operations.

CM_ComposeVec4.description: The `CM_ComposeVec4` node is designed for the mathematical conversion of individual float values into a four-dimensional vector (Vec4). This operation is fundamental in various mathematical and graphical computations where a Vec4 representation is required.

inputs.name: x
inputs.description: Represents the first component of the Vec4, influencing its spatial or graphical representation.

inputs.name: y
inputs.description: Denotes the second component of the Vec4, contributing to its spatial or graphical characteristics.

inputs.name: z
inputs.description: Defines the third component of the Vec4, affecting its spatial or graphical attributes.

inputs.name: w
inputs.description: Indicates the fourth component of the Vec4, impacting its spatial or graphical representation.

outputs.name: vec4
outputs.description: Outputs a four-dimensional vector (Vec4) constructed from the input float values.

CM_FloatBinaryCondition.description: This node evaluates binary conditions between two floating-point numbers based on a specified operation. It abstracts the complexity of various floating-point comparisons into a simple interface, allowing users to perform mathematical comparisons like equality, inequality, greater than, and less than operations.

inputs.name: op
inputs.description: Specifies the operation to perform on the two floating-point numbers. It determines the type of comparison (e.g., equal, not equal, greater than) to be executed.

inputs.name: a
inputs.description: The first floating-point number to be compared.

inputs.name: b
inputs.description: The second floating-point number to be compared.

outputs.name: bool
outputs.description: The result of the binary condition operation, indicating whether the specified condition between the two floating-point numbers is true or false.

CM_FloatBinaryOperation.description: This node performs binary operations on two float inputs, such as addition, subtraction, multiplication, or division, based on the operation specified. It abstracts the complexity of float arithmetic operations, providing a straightforward way to execute binary mathematical operations on float values.

inputs.name: op
inputs.description: Specifies the binary operation to be performed on the float inputs. This parameter determines the mathematical operation (e.g., addition, subtraction) that will be applied.

inputs.name: a
inputs.description: The first float input for the binary operation. Acts as one of the operands in the mathematical operation.

inputs.name: b
inputs.description: The second float input for the binary operation. Serves as the other operand in the mathematical operation.

outputs.name: float
outputs.description: The result of the binary operation performed on the two float inputs. It is a single float value representing the outcome of the specified operation.

CM_FloatToInt.description: The CM_FloatToInt node is designed for mathematical conversion operations, specifically converting floating-point numbers to integers. It abstracts the process of type conversion in mathematical computations, facilitating the transition between different numerical types.

inputs.name: a
inputs.description: The floating-point number to be converted into an integer. This parameter is crucial as it directly influences the outcome of the conversion process.

outputs.name: int
outputs.description: The integer result obtained from converting the input floating-point number.

CM_FloatToNumber.description: This node is designed for converting floating-point values to a more general number type, facilitating operations across different numeric types by standardizing them to a common format.

inputs.name: a
inputs.description: The floating-point value to be converted into a general number type. This conversion enables seamless integration and manipulation within a broader range of mathematical operations.

outputs.name: number
outputs.description: The result of converting the input floating-point value to a general number type, allowing for its use in a wide array of numerical computations and operations.

CM_FloatUnaryCondition.description: This node performs unary operations on floating-point numbers based on a specified condition. It evaluates a single float input against a predefined condition, such as checking if the number is zero, positive, negative, or NaN, among others.

inputs.name: op
inputs.description: Specifies the unary operation to be performed on the float input. The operation is chosen from a predefined list of conditions like 'IsZero', 'IsPositive', etc., which determine the nature of the evaluation.

inputs.name: a
inputs.description: The floating-point number to be evaluated against the specified unary condition.

outputs.name: bool
outputs.description: The result of the unary condition evaluation, indicating whether the condition holds true for the input float.

CM_FloatUnaryOperation.description: This node performs unary operations on floating-point numbers, allowing for the application of a variety of mathematical functions to a single float input.

inputs.name: op
inputs.description: Specifies the unary operation to be performed on the input float. The choice of operation directly influences the outcome.

inputs.name: a
inputs.description: The floating-point number to be operated on. It serves as the input to the unary operation specified.

outputs.name: float
outputs.description: The result of applying the specified unary operation on the input float.

CM_IntBinaryCondition.description: This node performs binary conditional operations on integer inputs, evaluating the relationship between two integers based on a specified operation (e.g., equality, inequality, greater than, less than). It abstracts the complexity of conditional checks into a simple interface, allowing for easy integration into mathematical and logical workflows.

inputs.name: op
inputs.description: Specifies the binary conditional operation to perform on the integers, such as equality or greater than, and directly influences the outcome of the node's evaluation.

inputs.name: a
inputs.description: The first integer operand in the binary conditional operation, serving as one of the two values to be compared.

inputs.name: b
inputs.description: The second integer operand in the binary conditional operation, serving as the other value to be compared with the first operand.

outputs.name: bool
outputs.description: The result of the binary conditional operation, indicating whether the specified condition holds true between the two integer operands.

CM_IntBinaryOperation.description: The node `CM_IntBinaryOperation` performs binary operations on integer inputs, such as addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division, based on a specified operation. It abstracts the complexity of these operations into a simple interface, allowing for the dynamic execution of various mathematical operations on integers.

inputs.name: op
inputs.description: Specifies the binary operation to be performed on the integer inputs. This affects the node's execution by determining the mathematical operation applied.

inputs.name: a
inputs.description: Represents the first integer input for the binary operation. It is one of the operands on which the specified operation is performed.

inputs.name: b
inputs.description: Represents the second integer input for the binary operation. It serves as the other operand in the operation alongside `a`.

outputs.name: int
outputs.description: The result of the specified binary operation performed on the integer inputs `a` and `b`.

CM_IntToBool.description: The node transforms an integer input into a boolean output, effectively converting numerical values into binary conditions based on their equivalence to zero.

inputs.name: a
inputs.description: The integer input to be converted into a boolean. If the input is non-zero, the output is True; otherwise, it is False.

outputs.name: bool
outputs.description: The boolean result of the conversion, indicating whether the input integer was non-zero.

CM_IntToFloat.description: The CM_IntToFloat node is designed for mathematical conversion operations, specifically converting an integer value to a floating-point number. This node facilitates the seamless transition between different numerical types, enhancing flexibility in mathematical computations.

inputs.name: a
inputs.description: The integer value to be converted into a floating-point number. This parameter is crucial for specifying the exact integer that needs to be transformed, thereby enabling precise numerical conversions.

outputs.name: float
outputs.description: The resulting floating-point number after the conversion of the input integer. This output is significant for further mathematical operations that require floating-point precision.

CM_IntToNumber.description: This node is designed for converting integer values to a more general number format, facilitating operations across different numeric types within mathematical computations.

inputs.name: a
inputs.description: The integer value to be converted into a general number format. This conversion enables seamless integration and operation with other numeric types.

outputs.name: number
outputs.description: The converted general number format value, allowing for versatile mathematical operations.

CM_IntUnaryCondition.description: This node performs unary operations on integers based on a specified operation. It abstracts the complexity of various unary operations into a simple interface, allowing for the evaluation of conditions or transformations on single integer values.

inputs.name: op
inputs.description: Specifies the unary operation to be performed on the integer. This operation determines how the integer is evaluated or transformed, impacting the node's output.

inputs.name: a
inputs.description: The integer value to be operated on. This is the primary input for the unary operation, which will be evaluated or transformed according to the specified operation.

outputs.name: bool
outputs.description: The result of the unary operation on the integer, typically a boolean value indicating the outcome of a condition.

CM_IntUnaryOperation.description: Performs unary operations on integers, applying a specified operation to a single integer input and producing an integer result. This node abstracts mathematical operations that modify the value or state of an integer based on predefined unary operations.

inputs.name: op
inputs.description: Specifies the unary operation to be applied to the integer. This determines how the integer's value will be modified.

inputs.name: a
inputs.description: The integer to which the unary operation will be applied. This is the input integer that will be modified by the specified operation.

outputs.name: int
outputs.description: The result of applying the unary operation to the input integer.

CM_NearestSDXLResolution.description: This node is designed to find the nearest supported SDXL resolution to the input image's resolution. It calculates the aspect ratio of the input image and compares it with a list of supported SDXL resolutions to select the closest match, ensuring optimal resizing without significant distortion.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The input image for which the nearest SDXL resolution is to be found. The image's aspect ratio is used to determine the closest supported resolution.

outputs.name: width
outputs.description: The width component of the nearest SDXL resolution.

outputs.name: height
outputs.description: The height component of the nearest SDXL resolution.

CM_NumberBinaryCondition.description: This node performs binary conditional operations on numbers, evaluating the relationship between two numeric inputs based on a specified condition.

inputs.name: op
inputs.description: Specifies the binary conditional operation to be performed, determining how the two numbers are compared.

inputs.name: a
inputs.description: The first number to be compared in the conditional operation.

inputs.name: b
inputs.description: The second number to be compared in the conditional operation.

outputs.name: bool
outputs.description: The result of the binary conditional operation, indicating whether the specified condition holds true between the two numbers.

CM_NumberBinaryOperation.description: This node performs binary operations on numbers, such as addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division, based on a specified operation. It abstracts the complexity of handling different types of number operations, providing a straightforward way to execute binary mathematical operations between two numbers.

inputs.name: op
inputs.description: Specifies the binary operation to be performed on the two numbers. It determines the mathematical action (e.g., addition, subtraction) that will be executed.

inputs.name: a
inputs.description: The first operand in the binary operation, representing one of the numbers involved in the calculation.

inputs.name: b
inputs.description: The second operand in the binary operation, representing the other number involved in the calculation.

outputs.name: number
outputs.description: The result of the binary operation performed on the two input numbers.

CM_NumberToFloat.description: The CM_NumberToFloat node is designed for converting numerical values from a generic number type, which can be an integer or a float, into a floating-point representation. This conversion facilitates operations that require floating-point precision and is essential in mathematical computations where such precision is necessary.

inputs.name: a
inputs.description: The input 'a' represents the numerical value to be converted into a floating-point number. This parameter is crucial for the conversion process, affecting the node's execution by determining the output's precision and value.

outputs.name: float
outputs.description: The output is a floating-point representation of the input numerical value, providing the necessary precision for further mathematical operations.

CM_NumberToInt.description: The CM_NumberToInt node is designed for converting numerical values from a generic number type to an integer type. This node facilitates the type casting process within mathematical or computational operations, ensuring compatibility and precision in scenarios where integer-specific operations are required.

inputs.name: a
inputs.description: The input 'a' represents the numerical value to be converted to an integer. This parameter is crucial for the conversion process, determining the resultant integer value.

outputs.name: int
outputs.description: The output is the integer representation of the input numerical value, achieved through type conversion.

CM_NumberUnaryCondition.description: This node performs unary operations on numbers based on predefined conditions, allowing for the evaluation of mathematical conditions involving a single numeric input. It abstracts the complexity of various unary mathematical operations into a simple interface.

inputs.name: op
inputs.description: Specifies the unary operation to be performed, chosen from a predefined set of conditions. This determines how the input number is evaluated.

inputs.name: a
inputs.description: The numeric input on which the unary operation is to be performed. This is the subject of the mathematical condition being evaluated.

outputs.name: bool
outputs.description: The result of the unary operation, indicating whether the condition is met (True) or not (False).

CM_NumberUnaryOperation.description: This node performs unary operations on numbers, allowing for the manipulation of a single numerical input through predefined operations.

inputs.name: op
inputs.description: Specifies the unary operation to be performed on the input number. The choice of operation affects the outcome of the node's computation.

inputs.name: a
inputs.description: The numerical input on which the unary operation will be performed. This input is central to the node's functionality.

outputs.name: number
outputs.description: The result of applying the specified unary operation on the input number.

CM_SDXLResolution.description: This node is designed to convert a string representation of a resolution into its numerical width and height components. It serves as a utility within the math/graphics category, facilitating the manipulation and analysis of image resolutions by breaking down their string format into distinct numerical values.

inputs.name: resolution
inputs.description: The 'resolution' parameter takes a string input representing an image resolution in the format 'widthxheight'. It is crucial for determining the output numerical values of width and height, effectively translating textual resolution data into a form that can be directly utilized in image processing tasks.

outputs.name: width
outputs.description: The 'width' output represents the numerical width component of the input resolution string.

outputs.name: height
outputs.description: The 'height' output represents the numerical height component of the input resolution string.

CM_Vec2BinaryCondition.description: This node performs a binary condition operation between two 2-dimensional vectors, evaluating to a boolean result based on the specified operation.

inputs.name: op
inputs.description: Specifies the binary condition operation to be applied between the two vectors, determining the nature of the comparison.

inputs.name: a
inputs.description: The first 2-dimensional vector involved in the binary condition operation.

inputs.name: b
inputs.description: The second 2-dimensional vector involved in the binary condition operation.

outputs.name: bool
outputs.description: The boolean result of the binary condition operation between the two vectors.

CM_Vec2BinaryOperation.description: The node performs binary operations on two-dimensional vectors, producing a new vector as a result. It abstracts mathematical operations that combine two vectors into one, based on a specified operation.

inputs.name: op
inputs.description: Specifies the binary operation to be performed on the vectors. It determines how the two input vectors will be combined.

inputs.name: a
inputs.description: The first two-dimensional vector involved in the binary operation.

inputs.name: b
inputs.description: The second two-dimensional vector involved in the binary operation.

outputs.name: vec2
outputs.description: The resulting two-dimensional vector after applying the specified binary operation on the input vectors.

CM_Vec2ScalarOperation.description: This node performs a scalar operation on a 2-dimensional vector, applying a specified operation (such as multiplication or division) between the vector and a scalar value. It abstracts complex vector arithmetic into simple, reusable logic.

inputs.name: op
inputs.description: Specifies the scalar operation to perform on the vector, such as multiplication or division, affecting the overall transformation of the vector.

inputs.name: a
inputs.description: The 2-dimensional vector to be operated on, serving as the primary operand in the scalar operation.

inputs.name: b
inputs.description: The scalar value to be used in the operation, acting as the secondary operand that modifies the vector.

outputs.name: vec2
outputs.description: The resulting 2-dimensional vector after applying the specified scalar operation.

CM_Vec2ToScalarBinaryOperation.description: This node performs a binary operation between two 2-dimensional vectors, resulting in a scalar value. It abstracts mathematical operations that take two vectors as input and produce a single scalar output, such as dot product or distance calculation.

inputs.name: op
inputs.description: Specifies the binary operation to be performed on the vectors. It affects the nature of the scalar result obtained from the operation.

inputs.name: a
inputs.description: The first 2-dimensional vector involved in the binary operation.

inputs.name: b
inputs.description: The second 2-dimensional vector involved in the binary operation.

outputs.name: float
outputs.description: The scalar result of the binary operation performed on the two vectors.

CM_Vec2ToScalarUnaryOperation.description: This node performs a unary operation that transforms a 2-dimensional vector into a scalar value, based on a specified operation. It abstracts complex mathematical operations into a simple interface, allowing for the transformation of vector data into a single numerical outcome.

inputs.name: op
inputs.description: Specifies the unary operation to be performed on the vector, determining the nature of the transformation from a 2D vector to a scalar value.

inputs.name: a
inputs.description: The 2-dimensional vector to be transformed into a scalar value through the specified operation.

outputs.name: float
outputs.description: The scalar result of the unary operation performed on the input 2-dimensional vector.

CM_Vec2UnaryCondition.description: This node performs unary condition operations on 2-dimensional vectors, evaluating a specified condition for a given vector.

inputs.name: op
inputs.description: Specifies the unary condition operation to be performed on the vector. The choice of operation affects the outcome of the condition evaluation.

inputs.name: a
inputs.description: The 2-dimensional vector on which the unary condition operation is to be performed.

outputs.name: bool
outputs.description: The result of the unary condition operation, indicating whether the specified condition holds true for the given vector.

CM_Vec2UnaryOperation.description: The node performs unary operations on 2-dimensional vectors, transforming a single vector based on a specified operation.

inputs.name: op
inputs.description: Specifies the unary operation to be performed on the vector, affecting the transformation result.

inputs.name: a
inputs.description: The 2-dimensional vector to be transformed by the unary operation.

outputs.name: vec2
outputs.description: The transformed 2-dimensional vector resulting from the specified unary operation.

CM_Vec3BinaryCondition.description: This node performs a binary condition operation on two 3-dimensional vectors (Vec3), evaluating the condition specified by the operation and returning a boolean result. It abstracts complex vector comparison logic into a simple interface, allowing for easy integration of vector-based conditions into larger computational workflows.

inputs.name: op
inputs.description: Specifies the binary condition operation to be performed on the vectors. The choice of operation determines how the two vectors are compared.

inputs.name: a
inputs.description: The first 3-dimensional vector (Vec3) to be compared.

inputs.name: b
inputs.description: The second 3-dimensional vector (Vec3) to be compared.

outputs.name: bool
outputs.description: The result of the binary condition operation, indicating whether the specified condition holds true for the given vectors.

CM_Vec3BinaryOperation.description: Performs binary operations on two 3-dimensional vectors, resulting in a new 3-dimensional vector. This node abstracts complex vector arithmetic into simple, high-level operations.

inputs.name: op
inputs.description: Specifies the binary operation to perform on the vectors, such as addition or subtraction, influencing the result of the operation.

inputs.name: a
inputs.description: The first 3-dimensional vector operand in the binary operation.

inputs.name: b
inputs.description: The second 3-dimensional vector operand in the binary operation.

outputs.name: vec3
outputs.description: The resulting 3-dimensional vector after performing the specified binary operation on the input vectors.

CM_Vec3ScalarOperation.description: Performs scalar operations on 3-dimensional vectors, allowing for mathematical manipulations such as scaling and division by a scalar value.

inputs.name: op
inputs.description: Specifies the scalar operation to be performed on the vector, such as multiplication or division, influencing the resulting vector's magnitude or direction.

inputs.name: a
inputs.description: The 3-dimensional vector to be operated on, serving as the primary operand for the scalar operation.

inputs.name: b
inputs.description: The scalar value to be used in the operation, affecting the vector's magnitude or direction based on the specified operation.

outputs.name: vec3
outputs.description: The resulting 3-dimensional vector after applying the specified scalar operation, reflecting changes in magnitude or direction.

CM_Vec3ToScalarBinaryOperation.description: This node performs a binary operation between two 3-dimensional vectors (Vec3) and returns a scalar value as a result. It supports a variety of operations such as dot product and distance calculation, abstracting complex mathematical operations into a simple interface.

inputs.name: op
inputs.description: Specifies the binary operation to be performed on the two Vec3 inputs, such as dot product or distance calculation. This choice determines how the vectors are mathematically combined.

inputs.name: a
inputs.description: The first 3-dimensional vector (Vec3) input for the binary operation.

inputs.name: b
inputs.description: The second 3-dimensional vector (Vec3) input for the binary operation.

outputs.name: float
outputs.description: The scalar result of the binary operation performed on the two Vec3 inputs.

CM_Vec3ToScalarUnaryOperation.description: This node performs a unary operation that transforms a 3-dimensional vector into a scalar value, based on a specified operation. It abstracts complex mathematical operations into a simple interface, allowing for the transformation of vector data into scalar form.

inputs.name: op
inputs.description: Specifies the unary operation to be performed on the 3-dimensional vector. This operation determines how the vector is transformed into a scalar value.

inputs.name: a
inputs.description: The 3-dimensional vector to be transformed into a scalar value through the specified unary operation.

outputs.name: float
outputs.description: The scalar result of applying the specified unary operation on the input 3-dimensional vector.

CM_Vec3UnaryCondition.description: The CM_Vec3UnaryCondition node is designed to evaluate unary conditions on 3-dimensional vectors, providing a boolean result based on the specified operation and vector input.

inputs.name: op
inputs.description: Specifies the unary operation to be performed on the vector. The choice of operation determines the condition being evaluated. The operations are limited to a predefined set of unary conditions applicable to 3-dimensional vectors.

inputs.name: a
inputs.description: The 3-dimensional vector on which the unary condition is evaluated.

outputs.name: bool
outputs.description: The result of the unary condition evaluation, indicating whether the condition holds true for the given vector.

CM_Vec3UnaryOperation.description: The CM_Vec3UnaryOperation node performs unary operations on 3-dimensional vectors, applying a specified operation to a single vector and producing a modified vector as a result. This node abstracts the complexity of vector manipulation, enabling efficient and straightforward vector transformations.

inputs.name: op
inputs.description: Specifies the unary operation to be performed on the vector. The choice of operation directly influences the outcome of the transformation.

inputs.name: a
inputs.description: The 3-dimensional vector to be transformed. It serves as the input for the unary operation, determining the base vector for the transformation.

outputs.name: vec3
outputs.description: The result of applying the specified unary operation to the input vector, represented as a 3-dimensional vector.

CM_Vec4BinaryCondition.description: This node performs binary conditional operations on two 4-dimensional vectors (Vec4), evaluating to a boolean result based on the specified operation. It abstracts complex vector comparisons into simple, reusable logic.

inputs.name: op
inputs.description: Specifies the binary conditional operation to be performed on the vectors, determining the nature of the comparison.

inputs.name: a
inputs.description: The first 4-dimensional vector (Vec4) to be compared.

inputs.name: b
inputs.description: The second 4-dimensional vector (Vec4) to be compared.

outputs.name: bool
outputs.description: The boolean result of the binary conditional operation between the two Vec4 inputs.

CM_Vec4BinaryOperation.description: The node CM_Vec4BinaryOperation performs binary operations on two 4-dimensional vectors (Vec4), resulting in a new Vec4 that represents the outcome of the operation. It abstracts complex vector arithmetic into simple, high-level operations, facilitating mathematical manipulations in vector space.

inputs.name: op
inputs.description: Specifies the binary operation to be performed on the vectors. It determines how the two Vec4 inputs will be combined to produce the output Vec4.

inputs.name: a
inputs.description: The first 4-dimensional vector (Vec4) input for the binary operation. Acts as one of the operands in the vector arithmetic.

inputs.name: b
inputs.description: The second 4-dimensional vector (Vec4) input for the binary operation. Acts as the other operand in the vector arithmetic.

outputs.name: vec4
outputs.description: The result of the binary operation on the two Vec4 inputs, returned as a new Vec4.

CM_Vec4ScalarOperation.description: Performs scalar operations on 4-dimensional vectors, allowing for the manipulation of vector components with a scalar value. This node abstracts mathematical operations such as multiplication or division, facilitating vector transformations in a 4D space.

inputs.name: op
inputs.description: Specifies the scalar operation to be performed on the vector, such as multiplication or division, influencing the resulting vector transformation.

inputs.name: a
inputs.description: The 4-dimensional vector to be transformed, serving as the primary operand in the scalar operation.

inputs.name: b
inputs.description: The scalar value to be applied to the vector, acting as the secondary operand in the operation.

outputs.name: vec4
outputs.description: The transformed 4-dimensional vector resulting from the specified scalar operation.

CM_Vec4ToScalarBinaryOperation.description: This node performs a binary operation between two Vec4 vectors, resulting in a scalar value. It supports operations like dot product and distance calculation, transforming vector relationships into a single numerical outcome.

inputs.name: op
inputs.description: Specifies the binary operation to be performed, such as dot product or distance, affecting the scalar result.

inputs.name: a
inputs.description: The first Vec4 vector operand in the binary operation.

inputs.name: b
inputs.description: The second Vec4 vector operand in the binary operation.

outputs.name: float
outputs.description: The scalar result of the binary operation between the two Vec4 vectors.

CM_Vec4ToScalarUnaryOperation.description: This node performs unary operations on a 4-dimensional vector (Vec4) to produce a scalar value. It supports a variety of operations that can transform a Vec4 into a single floating-point number, emphasizing the node's ability to abstract and reduce vectorial data into a simpler form.

inputs.name: op
inputs.description: Specifies the unary operation to be performed on the Vec4. The choice of operation determines how the vector is transformed into a scalar value.

inputs.name: a
inputs.description: The Vec4 on which the unary operation is to be performed. This vector serves as the input for the transformation process.

outputs.name: float
outputs.description: The resulting scalar value obtained from applying the specified unary operation on the Vec4 input.

CM_Vec4UnaryCondition.description: This node performs unary operations on 4-dimensional vectors based on predefined conditions, evaluating to a boolean result. It abstracts complex vector operations into simple, condition-based checks.

inputs.name: op
inputs.description: Specifies the unary operation to be performed on the vector, chosen from a predefined set of conditions. This determines how the vector is evaluated.

inputs.name: a
inputs.description: The 4-dimensional vector to be operated on. It serves as the input for the unary operation.

outputs.name: bool
outputs.description: The boolean result of the unary operation performed on the 4-dimensional vector.

CM_Vec4UnaryOperation.description: This node performs unary operations on 4-dimensional vectors, applying a specified operation to a single Vec4 input and producing a Vec4 output. It abstracts complex vector manipulations into simple, callable operations, facilitating mathematical computations on 4D vectors.

inputs.name: op
inputs.description: Specifies the unary operation to be performed on the Vec4 input. The choice of operation directly influences the result, enabling a variety of mathematical manipulations.

inputs.name: a
inputs.description: The Vec4 input on which the unary operation is to be performed. This vector serves as the primary data for the operation, determining the nature of the computation.

outputs.name: vec4
outputs.description: The result of applying the specified unary operation on the Vec4 input, returned as a Vec4. This output encapsulates the transformed vector, reflecting the mathematical computation performed.

ACN_AdvancedControlNetApply.description: This node applies advanced control net transformations to conditioning data, enhancing image generation with more nuanced control and customization options. It leverages advanced features of control nets to modify and fine-tune the conditioning process, allowing for sophisticated manipulation of image attributes.

inputs.name: positive
inputs.description: Positive conditioning data that will be enhanced through the application of control net transformations, contributing to the generation of desired image attributes.

inputs.name: negative
inputs.description: Negative conditioning data that will be modified by control net transformations to avoid certain image attributes, ensuring the generated image aligns with specified preferences.

inputs.name: control_net
inputs.description: The advanced control net model used to apply transformations to the conditioning data, enabling the customization and fine-tuning of image attributes.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The input image to which the control net transformations are applied, serving as a canvas for the enhanced conditioning effects.

inputs.name: strength
inputs.description: A scalar value determining the intensity of the control net transformations applied to the conditioning data, allowing for fine-tuning of the effect's strength.

inputs.name: start_percent
inputs.description: Defines the starting percentage of the effect's application, allowing for gradual introduction of the control net transformations over the image.

inputs.name: end_percent
inputs.description: Specifies the ending percentage for the application of control net transformations, enabling a controlled and gradual effect on the image.

inputs.name: mask_optional
inputs.description: An optional mask that can be applied to selectively target areas for control net transformations, enhancing precision in image manipulation.

inputs.name: timestep_kf
inputs.description: Optional keyframe for timestep control, allowing for dynamic adjustment of transformation application over time.

inputs.name: latent_kf_override
inputs.description: Optional override for latent keyframes, providing advanced control over the conditioning process through specific latent manipulations.

inputs.name: weights_override
inputs.description: Optional weights override for the control net, offering further customization of the transformation effects based on specific weight adjustments.

inputs.name: model_optional
inputs.description: An optional model parameter that can be used in conjunction with the control net for enhanced conditioning effects.

inputs.name: vae_optional
inputs.description: An optional VAE parameter that can be utilized for additional conditioning manipulations, enriching the image generation process.

inputs.name: autosize
inputs.description: Optional autosizing parameter that automatically adjusts the image size for optimal processing, enhancing the efficiency of transformation application.

outputs.name: positive
outputs.description: The enhanced positive conditioning data after the application of advanced control net transformations.

outputs.name: negative
outputs.description: The modified negative conditioning data following the application of control net transformations, tailored to avoid specific attributes.

outputs.name: model_opt
outputs.description: An optional output model that has been adjusted through the control net application process, reflecting changes in conditioning effects.

ACN_ControlNet++InputNode.description: This node is designed to serve as the entry point for input data into the ControlNet++ architecture, facilitating the preprocessing and preparation of data for further processing within the advanced ControlNet++ framework. It abstracts the complexities of data formatting and ensures compatibility with the ControlNet++ model's requirements.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: Specifies the image data to be processed and manipulated by the ControlNet++ model, serving as the foundational input for the architecture.

inputs.name: control_type
inputs.description: Determines the type of control to be applied by the ControlNet++ model, influencing how the input image is processed.

inputs.name: prev_plus_input
inputs.description: An optional parameter that allows for the chaining of ControlNet++ processing steps by using the output of a previous ControlNet++ node as input.

inputs.name: autosize
inputs.description: An optional parameter that automatically adjusts the size of the input image to meet the requirements of the ControlNet++ model, ensuring optimal processing.

outputs.name: plus_input
outputs.description: The processed input data ready for further manipulation or analysis within the ControlNet++ framework.

ACN_ControlNet++LoaderAdvanced.description: This node is designed to load multiple ControlNet++ models, facilitating advanced model management and usage within the ComfyUI framework. It supports loading various configurations of ControlNet++ models, enabling flexible and dynamic application of these models in different scenarios.

inputs.name: plus_input
inputs.description: Specifies the PlusPlusInputGroup to be used with the ControlNet++ model, enabling advanced control and customization of the model's behavior.

inputs.name: name
inputs.description: Specifies the name of the ControlNet++ model to be loaded, allowing for dynamic selection from available models.

outputs.name: control_net
outputs.description: Returns the loaded ControlNet++ model, ready for application in the specified context.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: Provides an image wrapper around the PlusPlusInputGroup, facilitating its use with the loaded ControlNet++ model.

ACN_ControlNet++LoaderSingle.description: This node is designed to load a single instance of the ControlNet++ model, facilitating the integration of advanced control mechanisms into the generation process. It abstracts the complexities of model loading, ensuring seamless access to ControlNet++ functionalities for enhanced content creation.

inputs.name: name
inputs.description: Specifies the name of the ControlNet++ model to be loaded, serving as a key identifier for selecting the appropriate model instance.

inputs.name: control_type
inputs.description: Determines the type of control mechanism to be applied using the ControlNet++ model, influencing how the model will be utilized in the generation process.

outputs.name: control_net
outputs.description: The loaded ControlNet++ model instance, ready for integration and use in content generation workflows.

ACN_DefaultUniversalWeights.description: This node specializes in loading and configuring default universal weights for the Advanced ControlNet system, facilitating the customization and optimization of weight parameters for enhanced control in text-to-image adaptation processes.

inputs.name: cn_extras
inputs.description: Allows for the inclusion of additional, custom weight parameters, offering extended customization capabilities for the control network.

inputs.name: autosize
inputs.description: Configures automatic sizing for the control network, optimizing its structure and parameters for improved performance.

outputs.name: CN_WEIGHTS
outputs.description: Outputs the configured control net weights, ready for use in the Advanced ControlNet system.

outputs.name: TK_SHORTCUT
outputs.description: Provides a shortcut to timestep keyframe configurations, facilitating efficient integration and application within the system.

ACN_ReferenceControlNet.description: The ACN_ReferenceControlNet node is designed to load and apply a Reference ControlNet configuration for advanced control in generative models. It allows for the customization of reference types, style fidelity, and reference weight to fine-tune the influence of the control net on the generative process.

inputs.name: reference_type
inputs.description: Specifies the type of reference to be used, affecting how the control net interprets and applies style and content guidance.

inputs.name: style_fidelity
inputs.description: Determines the fidelity of the style to be applied by the control net, influencing the balance between style and content in the generated output.

inputs.name: ref_weight
inputs.description: Controls the weight of the reference in the control net's decision-making process, adjusting the overall impact of the reference on the output.

outputs.name: control_net
outputs.description: The configured Reference ControlNet, ready to be applied to the generative model for influencing its output.

ACN_ReferenceControlNetFinetune.description: This node specializes in refining the application of reference-based control mechanisms within a neural network, focusing on enhancing the integration of attention and adaptive instance normalization (AdaIN) techniques for improved style fidelity and reference weighting. It aims to fine-tune the control network's response to reference inputs, ensuring a more precise and effective adaptation to the provided references.

inputs.name: attn_style_fidelity
inputs.description: Specifies the fidelity of the style to be maintained when applying attention mechanisms, influencing the network's ability to preserve the stylistic aspects of the reference.

inputs.name: attn_ref_weight
inputs.description: Determines the weight of the reference input in the attention mechanism, affecting how strongly the reference influences the output.

inputs.name: attn_strength
inputs.description: Controls the overall strength of the attention mechanism, adjusting the impact of the reference on the network's output.

inputs.name: adain_style_fidelity
inputs.description: Defines the fidelity of the style to be maintained when applying adaptive instance normalization (AdaIN), influencing the preservation of stylistic elements from the reference.

inputs.name: adain_ref_weight
inputs.description: Sets the weight of the reference input in the AdaIN mechanism, modifying the extent to which the reference affects the output.

inputs.name: adain_strength
inputs.description: Adjusts the strength of the AdaIN mechanism, determining the influence of the reference on the final output.

outputs.name: control_net
outputs.description: The refined control network, enhanced for better integration and application of reference-based control mechanisms like attention and AdaIN.

ACN_ReferencePreprocessor.description: The ACN_ReferencePreprocessor node is designed to preprocess reference inputs for the Advanced ControlNet, transforming them into a format suitable for further manipulation and application within the network. It emphasizes the importance of preparing reference data in a way that aligns with the network's requirements for optimal performance.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The image parameter is the visual data to be processed, serving as a foundational input for the preprocessing operation. It is essential for aligning the input image with the network's requirements.

inputs.name: vae
inputs.description: The vae parameter represents the variational autoencoder used in the preprocessing step. It is crucial for encoding the image into a latent space representation, facilitating its compatibility with the network.

inputs.name: latent_size
inputs.description: The latent_size parameter specifies the dimensions of the latent space into which the image is encoded. It plays a key role in ensuring that the processed image matches the expected input size for the network.

outputs.name: proc_IMAGE
outputs.description: This output is a specialized latent representation, not a typical image, intended for direct use with an Apply Advanced ControlNet node. It underscores the unique handling of reference data within the system.

ACN_SparseCtrlIndexMethodNode.description: This node is designed to generate a sparse control method based on specified indexes. It abstracts the complexity of selecting specific indexes for sparse control in advanced control networks, facilitating targeted manipulation or analysis of data points within a given dataset.

inputs.name: indexes
inputs.description: Specifies the indexes to be used for the sparse control method. This parameter allows for targeted selection within the dataset, enabling precise control over which data points are manipulated or analyzed.

outputs.name: sparse_method
outputs.description: Returns a sparse method object configured with the specified indexes. This object is used to apply sparse control techniques within advanced control networks.

ACN_SparseCtrlLoaderAdvanced.description: This node is designed for loading and initializing the Sparse ControlNet models, facilitating the integration of sparse control mechanisms into the advanced control network architecture. It abstracts the complexities of model loading, ensuring that the Sparse ControlNet models are properly set up for subsequent operations.

inputs.name: sparsectrl_name
inputs.description: Specifies the name of the Sparse ControlNet model to be loaded, crucial for identifying the correct model file.

inputs.name: use_motion
inputs.description: A boolean flag that determines whether motion-based control mechanisms should be applied, influencing the dynamic aspects of the control.

inputs.name: motion_strength
inputs.description: Defines the intensity of the motion effect, adjusting how strongly motion influences the control mechanism.

inputs.name: motion_scale
inputs.description: Sets the scale of motion effects, modifying the extent to which motion is factored into the control process.

inputs.name: sparse_method
inputs.description: Selects the method for sparse control, impacting the strategy for sparse adjustments within the network.

inputs.name: tk_optional
inputs.description: Optional timestep keyframe input for more granular control over animation or motion effects.

inputs.name: context_aware
inputs.description: Enables context-aware adjustments, allowing the model to adapt its control strategy based on contextual information.

inputs.name: sparse_hint_mult
inputs.description: Multiplier for hints in sparse control, affecting how hint-based adjustments are scaled.

inputs.name: sparse_nonhint_mult
inputs.description: Multiplier for non-hint adjustments, influencing the strength of control without explicit hints.

inputs.name: sparse_mask_mult
inputs.description: Multiplier for mask-based adjustments in sparse control, determining the influence of mask inputs on the control strategy.

outputs.name: control_net
outputs.description: The loaded Sparse ControlNet model, ready for integration and use within the advanced control network.

ACN_SparseCtrlMergedLoaderAdvanced.description: This node is designed for advanced loading of merged Sparse Control Networks, integrating both standard control networks and sparse control mechanisms with enhanced settings for motion. It facilitates the combination of these networks to leverage the strengths of each, providing a more versatile and dynamic control network for applications requiring nuanced control over motion and other attributes.

inputs.name: sparsectrl_name
inputs.description: Specifies the name of the sparse control network to be loaded. This name is used to locate the network within a predefined directory structure.

inputs.name: control_net_name
inputs.description: Specifies the name of the standard control network to be merged with the sparse control network. This name is used to identify and load the corresponding standard control network.

inputs.name: use_motion
inputs.description: A boolean flag indicating whether motion settings should be applied to the sparse control network, enhancing its dynamic capabilities.

inputs.name: motion_strength
inputs.description: Defines the strength of the motion effect to be applied, allowing for fine-tuning of how motion influences the control network's behavior.

inputs.name: motion_scale
inputs.description: Sets the scale of motion effects, providing control over the magnitude of motion adjustments within the network.

inputs.name: sparse_method
inputs.description: Determines the method used for sparse control within the network, affecting how control signals are generated and applied.

inputs.name: tk_optional
inputs.description: Optional timestep keyframe group to be used for temporal control, offering additional flexibility in how motion and other dynamics are handled.

outputs.name: control_net
outputs.description: The merged and enhanced control network, incorporating both standard and sparse control mechanisms with motion settings applied.

ACN_SparseCtrlRGBPreprocessor.description: The ACN_SparseCtrlRGBPreprocessor node is designed for preprocessing images for use with Sparse ControlNet models. It transforms input images into a format suitable for these models, specifically by encoding the images into a latent space that mimics the appearance of an image. This preprocessing step is crucial for the subsequent application of Sparse ControlNet techniques, ensuring compatibility and optimizing performance.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The input image to be preprocessed. This image is transformed to match the latent size requirements of the Sparse ControlNet model.

inputs.name: vae
inputs.description: The Variational Autoencoder (VAE) model used for encoding the input image into a latent representation.

inputs.name: latent_size
inputs.description: Specifies the size of the latent representation to which the input image should be resized and encoded.

inputs.name: autosize
inputs.description: An optional parameter that allows for automatic resizing of the input image, with an option to specify padding.

outputs.name: proc_IMAGE
outputs.description: The processed image, now encoded in a latent space that simulates the appearance of an image, ready for use with Sparse ControlNet models.

ACN_SparseCtrlSpreadMethodNode.description: This node is designed to generate a SparseSpreadMethod instance based on a specified spread strategy. It abstracts the complexity of creating spread patterns for sparse control in advanced control networks, facilitating the customization of spread behaviors for enhanced control and manipulation of network outputs.

inputs.name: spread
inputs.description: Defines the spread strategy to be used for generating the SparseSpreadMethod. This parameter is crucial for determining the pattern and distribution of control points within the network, affecting the overall behavior and output of the control network.

outputs.name: sparse_method
outputs.description: Returns an instance of SparseSpreadMethod configured according to the specified spread strategy. This output is essential for integrating custom spread behaviors into advanced control networks.

ACN_SparseCtrlWeightExtras.description: This node is designed to create and manage additional weight parameters for Sparse Control Networks, enabling fine-tuned control over the network's behavior by adjusting hint, non-hint, and mask multipliers.

inputs.name: cn_extras
inputs.description: A dictionary to store extra weight parameters, allowing for the customization and fine-tuning of the Sparse Control Network's behavior.

inputs.name: sparse_hint_mult
inputs.description: Multiplier for sparse hints, influencing how strongly hints affect the network's output.

inputs.name: sparse_nonhint_mult
inputs.description: Multiplier for non-hints, adjusting the influence of non-hint areas on the network's output.

inputs.name: sparse_mask_mult
inputs.description: Multiplier for the mask, determining the impact of the mask on the network's behavior.

inputs.name: autosize
inputs.description: An optional parameter to adjust the size of the network's components, providing flexibility in network configuration and optimization.

outputs.name: cn_extras
outputs.description: Updated dictionary of extra weight parameters, reflecting the adjustments made for hint, non-hint, and mask multipliers.

ACN_TimestepKeyframeFromStrengthList.description: This node is designed to generate a sequence of timestep keyframes based on a list of strength values. It facilitates the creation of dynamic animations or effects within a control network by interpolating between specified strength levels over a series of timesteps, allowing for precise control over the animation's progression.

inputs.name: float_strengths
inputs.description: Specifies the strength values for each keyframe. This input allows for the dynamic generation of keyframes based on varying strength levels, enabling the creation of nuanced animations or effects.

inputs.name: start_percent
inputs.description: Defines the starting percentage for the keyframe sequence, allowing for the customization of when the animation effects begin within the control network.

inputs.name: end_percent
inputs.description: Sets the ending percentage for the keyframe sequence, determining when the animation effects conclude within the control network.

inputs.name: prev_timestep_kf
inputs.description: An optional input representing the previous state of timestep keyframes, enabling the continuation or modification of an existing sequence.

inputs.name: cn_weights
inputs.description: Optional control network weights that can be applied to the keyframes, offering additional customization for the animation's behavior.

inputs.name: latent_keyframe
inputs.description: Optional latent keyframes that can be integrated into the timestep keyframes for enhanced control over the animation's characteristics.

inputs.name: null_latent_kf_strength
inputs.description: Defines the strength of a null latent keyframe, allowing for the adjustment of the animation's intensity.

inputs.name: inherit_missing
inputs.description: A boolean flag indicating whether missing keyframe attributes should be inherited from previous keyframes, ensuring continuity in the animation.

inputs.name: mask_optional
inputs.description: An optional mask that can be applied to the keyframes, providing further customization of the animation's appearance.

inputs.name: print_keyframes
inputs.description: A boolean flag that, when set to true, enables logging of the generated keyframes for debugging or informational purposes.

inputs.name: autosize
inputs.description: Specifies the autosizing options for the control network, facilitating the automatic adjustment of the network's dimensions based on the provided parameters.

outputs.name: TIMESTEP_KF
outputs.description: The output is a sequence of timestep keyframes, which are generated based on the provided strength values and other parameters. This sequence can be used to control animations or effects within a control network.

ACN_TimestepKeyframeInterpolation.description: This node specializes in interpolating keyframes over timesteps within an advanced control network, enabling the creation of smooth transitions and animations by adjusting parameters such as strength and percentage over specified intervals. It leverages linear or custom interpolation methods to generate a sequence of keyframes that guide the animation or transformation process, ensuring a seamless progression from one state to another.

inputs.name: start_percent
inputs.description: Specifies the starting percentage for the interpolation, marking the initial point of the transition within the animation or transformation process. It plays a crucial role in determining the beginning of the keyframe sequence and sets the initial context for the interpolation, directly influencing the starting point of the generated keyframe sequence.

inputs.name: end_percent
inputs.description: Defines the ending percentage for the interpolation, indicating the final point of the transition within the animation or transformation process. It is essential for establishing the conclusion of the keyframe sequence and determines the endpoint for the interpolation, ensuring that the transition smoothly concludes at the desired state.

inputs.name: strength_start
inputs.description: Sets the starting strength for the interpolation, influencing the initial intensity or impact of the transition on the animation or transformation. It affects the beginning of the keyframe sequence's effectiveness and establishes the initial intensity level for the transition, providing a baseline for the interpolation's impact.

inputs.name: strength_end
inputs.description: Determines the ending strength for the interpolation, affecting the final intensity or impact of the transition on the animation or transformation. It is vital for defining the end of the keyframe sequence's effectiveness and sets the final intensity level, ensuring a targeted impact by the conclusion of the transition.

inputs.name: interpolation
inputs.description: Defines the method of interpolation used for transitioning between keyframes, such as linear or custom easing functions. It significantly impacts the smoothness and dynamics of the animation or transformation, determining the character and flow of the transition between keyframes.

inputs.name: intervals
inputs.description: Specifies the number of intervals or steps in the interpolation process, dictating the granularity and smoothness of the transition. It directly influences the number of keyframes generated and their distribution over the transition, impacting the overall smoothness and detail of the interpolated sequence.

inputs.name: prev_timestep_kf
inputs.description: Specifies the previous timestep keyframe group to be considered in the interpolation process, ensuring continuity and leveraging existing keyframe data for the new sequence. This input provides a foundation for the new interpolation, utilizing prior keyframe data to inform and enhance the current transition.

inputs.name: cn_weights
inputs.description: Specifies the control network weights for the interpolation, influencing how different aspects are weighted during the transition. It enables precise control over the dynamics and balance of the transition, affecting how various elements are emphasized throughout the interpolation process.

inputs.name: latent_keyframe
inputs.description: Determines the latent keyframes to be included in the interpolation, allowing for the integration of specific transformation states into the sequence. It enriches the transition with predefined keyframe data, adding depth and complexity to the interpolation by incorporating existing keyframe information.

inputs.name: null_latent_kf_strength
inputs.description: Sets the strength for null latent keyframes, providing a means to adjust the influence of keyframes that do not directly contribute to the visible transformation. It allows for fine-tuning the overall effect of the interpolation, offering control over the presence and impact of latent elements in the transition.

inputs.name: inherit_missing
inputs.description: Indicates whether to inherit missing parameters from previous keyframes, ensuring continuity and consistency across the interpolation sequence. It helps maintain the integrity of the transition, ensuring that any gaps or missing data are seamlessly integrated for a cohesive interpolation experience.

inputs.name: mask_optional
inputs.description: Provides an optional mask hint for the interpolation, enabling targeted adjustments to specific regions or aspects of the animation or transformation. It offers additional control over the transition effects, allowing for localized modifications that can enhance or focus the interpolation's impact on certain areas.

inputs.name: print_keyframes
inputs.description: Enables logging of keyframe information for debugging or analysis purposes, offering insights into the interpolation process and the generated keyframe sequence. This feature aids in the evaluation and refinement of the interpolation, providing valuable feedback on the generated keyframes and their alignment with the intended transition.

inputs.name: autosize
inputs.description: Specifies the autosize configuration, adjusting the size of the control network's output to fit certain dimensions, which can be crucial for ensuring the proper scaling of animations or transformations. This parameter impacts the final output's dimensions, ensuring that the interpolated keyframes are appropriately scaled to match the desired output size.

outputs.name: TIMESTEP_KF
outputs.description: Returns the interpolated timestep keyframe group, encapsulating the sequence of generated keyframes over the specified intervals. This output is crucial for integrating the smooth transitions into the control network's animation or transformation process.

ControlNetLoaderAdvanced.description: This node is designed to load advanced control networks, enabling the customization and enhancement of generative models through specified control net configurations. It supports loading control nets by name and optionally applying timestep keyframe adjustments for fine-tuned control.

inputs.name: control_net_name
inputs.description: Specifies the name of the control net to load, serving as a key identifier for retrieving the appropriate control net configuration.

inputs.name: tk_optional
inputs.description: An optional parameter for specifying timestep keyframe adjustments, enhancing the control net's application with temporal fine-tuning.

outputs.name: control_net
outputs.description: Returns the loaded control net, ready for application in generative model customization.

CustomControlNetWeights.description: This node is designed to dynamically load and apply custom control net weights for advanced manipulation of neural network behavior. It allows for fine-tuning the influence of various control parameters on the network's output, enabling more precise and tailored generation of content.

inputs.name: weight_i
inputs.description: Specifies a weight in the control net, contributing to the nuanced adjustment of network behavior. The index 'i' ranges from 00 to 03, allowing for detailed control over the network's processing and output.

inputs.name: flip_weights
inputs.description: A boolean flag that, when set, reverses the order of weight application, potentially altering the network's behavior in significant ways.

inputs.name: uncond_multiplier
inputs.description: Adjusts the unconditional multiplier for the control weights, offering an additional layer of fine-tuning over the network's output.

inputs.name: cn_extras
inputs.description: Provides a mechanism to include extra control weight parameters, further expanding the customization capabilities for network behavior.

inputs.name: autosize
inputs.description: Configures the autosizing feature, which automatically adjusts the size of control weights based on specified parameters, enhancing the adaptability of network behavior.

outputs.name: CN_WEIGHTS
outputs.description: The customized control net weights, tailored according to the input parameters.

outputs.name: TK_SHORTCUT
outputs.description: A shortcut to timestep keyframe data, facilitating easier manipulation and application of control net weights over time.

CustomT2IAdapterWeights.description: This node is designed to adapt and load custom weights for text-to-image (T2I) generation within the Advanced ControlNet framework. It allows for precise control over the influence of various weights on the image generation process, accommodating adjustments and enhancements to the control mechanism.

inputs.name: weight_i
inputs.description: Specifies a weight in the sequence, setting the foundational influence for the T2I generation process. The index 'i' ranges from 00 to 03, each adjusting the influence on the generation process.

inputs.name: flip_weights
inputs.description: A boolean flag to reverse the order of weights, accommodating recent changes in ComfyUI.

inputs.name: uncond_multiplier
inputs.description: A multiplier for unconditional weights, offering additional control over the generation process.

inputs.name: cn_extras
inputs.description: A dictionary for extra control net weights, allowing for extended customization.

inputs.name: autosize
inputs.description: Specifies the padding size for automatic sizing, enhancing layout adaptability.

outputs.name: CN_WEIGHTS
outputs.description: The customized control net weights adapted for T2I generation.

outputs.name: TK_SHORTCUT
outputs.description: A timestep keyframe shortcut, encapsulating the control weights for efficient processing.

DiffControlNetLoaderAdvanced.description: The DiffControlNetLoaderAdvanced node is designed for loading advanced control net models with the capability to handle different models and optional timestep keyframe groups. It extends the functionality of control net loading by incorporating model-specific adjustments and optional parameters for enhanced control net application.

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: Specifies the model for which the control net is being loaded, enabling model-specific control net adjustments.

inputs.name: control_net_name
inputs.description: The name of the control net to be loaded, used to locate and load the specific control net file.

inputs.name: tk_optional
inputs.description: An optional timestep keyframe group to be applied to the control net, providing additional control over the animation or transformation process.

inputs.name: autosize
inputs.description: An optional parameter that allows for automatic resizing of the control net with a specified padding, enhancing flexibility in control net application.

outputs.name: control_net
outputs.description: The loaded advanced control net, ready for application within the system.

LatentKeyframe.description: The LatentKeyframe node is designed for creating and managing individual keyframes within a latent space. It focuses on the manipulation of specific points in the latent space, allowing for the adjustment of their strength or influence, and supports operations such as adding, replacing, and sorting keyframes based on their batch index. This node plays a crucial role in controlling the evolution of generated content by defining key moments or states within the generation process.

inputs.name: batch_index
inputs.description: Specifies the index of the keyframe within a batch. It is used to identify and manage the position of the keyframe in the sequence, enabling precise control over the timing and order of content generation.

inputs.name: strength
inputs.description: Determines the influence or intensity of the keyframe within the latent space. Adjusting the strength allows for fine-tuning the impact of the keyframe on the generated content, enabling more nuanced control over the generation process.

inputs.name: prev_latent_kf
inputs.description: An optional parameter that allows for the inclusion of previous latent keyframes, enabling the chaining or blending of keyframes for more complex generation patterns.

inputs.name: autosize
inputs.description: Configures the automatic sizing feature for the node, which adjusts the size of the input or output to fit specified requirements, enhancing flexibility in handling various data dimensions.

outputs.name: LATENT_KF
outputs.description: Represents the output latent keyframe or keyframe group, encapsulating the modifications applied to the latent space through the node's operations.

LatentKeyframeBatchedGroup.description: This node is designed to manage and manipulate batches of latent keyframes for advanced control in generative models. It allows for the creation, modification, and interpolation of keyframes based on specified strengths and batch indices, facilitating dynamic adjustments to the generative process.

inputs.name: float_strengths
