inputs.description: Defines the strengths for a batch of keyframes, enabling the creation or modification of multiple keyframes simultaneously. This parameter can accept either a single float value or an iterable of float values, allowing for flexible keyframe strength specification.

inputs.name: prev_latent_kf
inputs.description: An optional parameter that allows for the inclusion of previously defined latent keyframes, enabling their modification or extension with new keyframe data.

inputs.name: print_keyframes
inputs.description: A flag that, when enabled, triggers logging of keyframe details for debugging or informational purposes.

inputs.name: autosize
inputs.description: An optional parameter that adjusts the size of the generated keyframes, providing flexibility in their presentation or storage.

outputs.name: LATENT_KF
outputs.description: The modified or newly created batch of latent keyframes, ready for use in further generative processes.

LatentKeyframeGroup.description: The LatentKeyframeGroup class manages a collection of keyframes, allowing for the addition, retrieval, and cloning of keyframe objects based on their batch index. It supports sorting keyframes by their batch index, ensuring an organized sequence for operations that depend on the temporal order of keyframes.

inputs.name: index_strengths
inputs.description: A multiline string input specifying the indices and strengths for keyframes to be loaded or manipulated, enabling dynamic keyframe management based on user-defined criteria.

inputs.name: prev_latent_kf
inputs.description: An optional input representing a previous LatentKeyframeGroup object, allowing for the continuation or modification of an existing sequence of keyframes.

inputs.name: latent_optional
inputs.description: An optional latent input for operations that may require additional latent information not provided by the default keyframe parameters.

inputs.name: print_keyframes
inputs.description: A boolean flag to enable or disable printing of keyframe information, useful for debugging or informational purposes.

inputs.name: autosize
inputs.description: An optional parameter to automatically adjust the size of the keyframe group, with a specified padding for flexibility in keyframe management.

outputs.name: LATENT_KF
outputs.description: The output is a LatentKeyframeGroup object, representing the updated collection of keyframes after the operation.

LatentKeyframeTiming.description: This node is designed to manage the timing and sequencing of latent keyframes within a generative model's control network. It focuses on interpolating and scheduling keyframes based on specified timing parameters, ensuring smooth transitions and accurate timing for the generation process.

inputs.name: batch_index_from
inputs.description: Specifies the starting index for the batch of keyframes to be processed, serving as the initial point for timing and sequencing operations.

inputs.name: batch_index_to_excl
inputs.description: Defines the exclusive end index for the batch of keyframes, marking the boundary for the sequence of keyframes to be interpolated or scheduled.

inputs.name: strength_from
inputs.description: Indicates the starting strength value for the interpolation of keyframes, setting the initial intensity or effect level.

inputs.name: strength_to
inputs.description: Specifies the ending strength value for the interpolation, determining the final intensity or effect level for the sequence of keyframes.

inputs.name: interpolation
inputs.description: Defines the method of interpolation to be used for transitioning between keyframes, such as linear or ease-in/out, to ensure smooth changes in strength or effects.

inputs.name: prev_latent_kf
inputs.description: Optional parameter for providing a previous set of latent keyframes to be considered or integrated into the current timing and sequencing operation.

inputs.name: print_keyframes
inputs.description: A flag to enable logging of keyframe details for debugging or informational purposes.

inputs.name: autosize
inputs.description: unknown

outputs.name: LATENT_KF
outputs.description: The output is a modified or newly created set of latent keyframes, reflecting the applied timing and sequencing operations.

LoadImagesFromDirectory.description: This node is designed for loading and processing a batch of images from a specified directory, including their associated masks if available. It supports filtering and limiting the number of images loaded based on provided criteria, and prepares the images and masks for further processing or analysis.

inputs.name: directory
inputs.description: Specifies the directory path from which images are to be loaded. It is crucial for locating and accessing the image files for processing.

inputs.name: image_load_cap
inputs.description: Determines the maximum number of images to load from the directory. If set to 0, there is no limit on the number of images to load.

inputs.name: start_index
inputs.description: Specifies the index from which to start loading images within the directory, allowing for partial loading of images.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: A tensor containing the loaded images, concatenated along the first dimension.

outputs.name: mask
outputs.description: A tensor containing the masks associated with the loaded images, stacked along the first dimension.

outputs.name: int
outputs.description: The total number of images successfully loaded and processed.

ScaledSoftControlNetWeights.description: The ScaledSoftControlNetWeights node is designed to dynamically adjust the influence of control weights within a neural network based on a set of parameters. It allows for the customization of weight scaling, enabling fine-tuned control over the network's behavior in response to specific conditions or inputs.

inputs.name: base_multiplier
inputs.description: Defines the base scaling factor for the control weights, serving as the foundational adjustment level before any conditional modifications are applied.

inputs.name: flip_weights
inputs.description: A boolean flag that, when true, reverses the effect of the control weights, allowing for inverse scaling effects.

inputs.name: uncond_multiplier
inputs.description: Specifies an unconditional scaling multiplier that is applied regardless of other conditions, offering an additional layer of weight adjustment.

inputs.name: cn_extras
inputs.description: A dictionary of extra parameters for further customization of the control weights, providing extended flexibility in their application.

inputs.name: autosize
inputs.description: Configures automatic sizing for the control weights, including padding adjustments to accommodate various network configurations.

outputs.name: CN_WEIGHTS
outputs.description: Represents the adjusted control net weights after applying the scaling factors.

outputs.name: TK_SHORTCUT
outputs.description: A shortcut to timestep keyframe data, encapsulating the effects of the adjusted weights on the network's temporal dynamics.

ScaledSoftMaskedUniversalWeights.description: The ScaledSoftMaskedUniversalWeights node is designed to dynamically adjust the influence of control weights within a neural network based on a set of input parameters. It allows for the customization of weight scaling and flipping, enabling fine-tuned control over the network's behavior in response to conditional inputs or specific task requirements.

inputs.name: mask
inputs.description: Specifies the tensor mask that determines the spatial application of base multipliers across the control weights, enabling differentiated scaling.

inputs.name: min_base_multiplier
inputs.description: Sets the minimum scaling factor for the control weights, defining the lower bound of weight influence.

inputs.name: max_base_multiplier
inputs.description: Sets the maximum scaling factor for the control weights, defining the upper bound of weight influence.

inputs.name: uncond_multiplier
inputs.description: Specifies an unconditional scaling factor applied to the control weights, offering an additional layer of adjustment independent of other conditions.

inputs.name: cn_extras
inputs.description: A dictionary of extra parameters for further customization of the control weights, providing a mechanism for incorporating additional, specific adjustments.

inputs.name: autosize
inputs.description: Configures automatic sizing for the control weights, including padding adjustments, to ensure optimal fit within the network's architecture.

outputs.name: CN_WEIGHTS
outputs.description: The control net weights adjusted according to the input parameters, ready for use in the network.

outputs.name: TK_SHORTCUT
outputs.description: A timestep keyframe shortcut that encapsulates the adjusted control weights for temporal application within the network.

SoftControlNetWeights.description: This node is designed to dynamically adjust the weights for control networks in a soft, nuanced manner, allowing for more refined and flexible control over the generation process. It focuses on providing a customizable approach to weight manipulation, enabling users to fine-tune the influence of various control parameters based on specific needs or desired outcomes.

inputs.name: weight_i
inputs.description: Specifies a weight in the control network, serving as an adjustable factor for nuanced control. The index 'i' ranges from 0 to 3, allowing for multiple levels of refinement in control adjustments.

inputs.name: flip_weights
inputs.description: A boolean flag that determines whether the control weights should be inverted, offering an alternative perspective on the control influence.

inputs.name: uncond_multiplier
inputs.description: Defines an unconditional multiplier that applies universally across all control weights, allowing for a global adjustment to their influence.

inputs.name: cn_extras
inputs.description: Allows for the inclusion of additional, custom-defined control weight parameters, providing a mechanism for extending and customizing the control influence beyond the standard set.

inputs.name: autosize
inputs.description: Configures automatic sizing parameters for the control network, facilitating adaptive adjustments to the network's dimensions based on specific requirements.

outputs.name: CN_WEIGHTS
outputs.description: The computed control network weights after applying the specified adjustments.

outputs.name: TK_SHORTCUT
outputs.description: A shortcut to the timestep keyframe, encapsulating the adjusted control weights.

SoftT2IAdapterWeights.description: This node is designed to adapt text-to-image (T2I) control weights for a softer blending or transition effect in generated images. It manipulates a set of weights to achieve a desired balance between different control aspects, enhancing the flexibility and precision of image generation processes.

inputs.name: weight_i
inputs.description: Specifies the weight for a control aspect, influencing the blending or transition effect in the generated images. The index 'i' ranges from 0 to 3, each representing a different aspect of control.

inputs.name: flip_weights
inputs.description: When enabled, reverses the order of weights, offering an alternative approach to control the blending or transition effects.

inputs.name: uncond_multiplier
inputs.description: Adjusts the unconditional aspect of the weights, providing an additional layer of control over the image generation.

inputs.name: cn_extras
inputs.description: Includes extra control net weights for extended customization and fine-tuning capabilities in the image generation process.

inputs.name: autosize
inputs.description: Configures automatic sizing parameters, affecting how control net weights are applied and adjusted.

outputs.name: CN_WEIGHTS
outputs.description: The computed control net weights after processing input parameters.

outputs.name: TK_SHORTCUT
outputs.description: A shortcut representation for timestep keyframes, facilitating easier manipulation and application in the control net process.

TimestepKeyframe.description: The TimestepKeyframe node is designed to encapsulate the concept of a keyframe within a timeline, specifying the moment and intensity of an effect, along with associated control weights, latent keyframes, and other properties. It serves as a foundational element for defining and manipulating animation or effect progressions over time.

inputs.name: start_percent
inputs.description: Specifies the starting point of the keyframe as a percentage of the total animation or effect duration, influencing when the keyframe's effect begins.

inputs.name: prev_timestep_kf
inputs.description: References a previous timestep keyframe group, allowing for the continuation or modification of existing keyframe sequences.

inputs.name: strength
inputs.description: Determines the intensity or magnitude of the keyframe's effect, affecting how strongly it influences the animation or effect.

inputs.name: cn_weights
inputs.description: Associates specific control net weights with the keyframe, dictating the influence of various control parameters on the keyframe's effect.

inputs.name: latent_keyframe
inputs.description: unknown

inputs.name: null_latent_kf_strength
inputs.description: Defines the strength of a null or default latent keyframe, providing a baseline effect intensity.

inputs.name: inherit_missing
inputs.description: Indicates whether missing properties from the parent or previous keyframes should be inherited by this keyframe.

inputs.name: guarantee_steps
inputs.description: Specifies the minimum number of steps for which the keyframe's effect is guaranteed to be applied, ensuring a minimum duration.

inputs.name: mask_optional
inputs.description: Optionally includes a mask hint, which can guide the application of the keyframe's effect based on spatial criteria.

inputs.name: autosize
inputs.description: Configures automatic sizing for the keyframe, adjusting its dimensions based on specified parameters.

outputs.name: TIMESTEP_KF
outputs.description: Outputs a modified or newly created timestep keyframe group, incorporating the defined keyframe settings.

ADE_AdjustPEFullStretch.description: This node is designed to adjust the positional encoding (PE) within a model by stretching it to a new length, optionally printing the adjustment process. It allows for dynamic modification of the PE to accommodate different sequence lengths or to apply specific transformations for animation or other advanced modeling purposes.

inputs.name: pe_stretch
inputs.description: Specifies the amount by which the positional encoding should be stretched. A positive integer increases the PE length, enabling the model to handle longer sequences or apply specific transformations.

inputs.name: print_adjustment
inputs.description: A boolean flag that, when set to True, enables the printing of the adjustment process for debugging or informational purposes.

inputs.name: prev_pe_adjust
inputs.description: An optional parameter that allows for the chaining of positional encoding adjustments by taking a previous adjustment group as input.

outputs.name: pe_adjust
outputs.description: Returns an updated adjustment group that includes the new positional encoding stretch, ready for further processing or application.

ADE_AdjustPEManual.description: The ADE_AdjustPEManual node allows for manual adjustments to the positional encoding (PE) parameters within the AnimateDiff framework. It provides fine-grained control over the PE adjustments, enabling users to tailor the animation process to specific needs.

inputs.name: cap_initial_pe_length
inputs.description: Specifies the maximum initial length of the positional encoding to be used, allowing for the capping of PE at the beginning of the process. This can be crucial for controlling the animation's starting point.

inputs.name: interpolate_pe_to_length
inputs.description: Determines the length to which the positional encoding should be interpolated, enabling the adjustment of PE length to match specific animation requirements.

inputs.name: initial_pe_idx_offset
inputs.description: Sets the starting index offset for the positional encoding, allowing for the adjustment of the animation's initial phase.

inputs.name: final_pe_idx_offset
inputs.description: Defines the ending index offset for the positional encoding, facilitating the control over the animation's final phase.

inputs.name: print_adjustment
inputs.description: Enables the printing of adjustment information, useful for debugging and understanding the impact of the applied adjustments.

inputs.name: prev_pe_adjust
inputs.description: Allows for the inclusion of previous positional encoding adjustments, enabling cumulative adjustments over multiple steps.

outputs.name: pe_adjust
outputs.description: Returns an adjusted positional encoding object, reflecting the manual adjustments made to the PE settings.

ADE_AdjustPESweetspotStretch.description: This node is designed to adjust the position encoding (PE) sweetspot stretch in the AnimateDiff framework, allowing for dynamic modification of the PE stretch based on input parameters. It facilitates the fine-tuning of animation effects by modifying how the position encoding adapts over the course of an animation.

inputs.name: sweetspot
inputs.description: Defines the initial position encoding length, serving as a baseline for adjustments.

inputs.name: new_sweetspot
inputs.description: Specifies the target position encoding length to adjust towards, enabling the stretch or compression of the encoding.

inputs.name: print_adjustment
inputs.description: A flag to control the logging of adjustment details, aiding in debugging and fine-tuning.

inputs.name: prev_pe_adjust
inputs.description: Allows for the incorporation of previous position encoding adjustments, enabling cumulative modifications.

outputs.name: pe_adjust
outputs.description: Returns the updated position encoding adjustment, encapsulating the modifications applied.

ADE_AdjustWeightAllAdd.description: The ADE_AdjustWeightAllAdd node is designed to adjust the weights of various components in an animation diffusion model by adding specified values. This adjustment process is crucial for fine-tuning the animation generation process, allowing for more precise control over the animation's appearance and behavior.

inputs.name: all_ADD
inputs.description: Specifies the value to be added to all weight components, enabling a uniform adjustment across the model. This parameter allows for a broad modification of the model's behavior.

inputs.name: print_adjustment
inputs.description: A boolean flag that, when set to true, enables the printing of the adjustment details for debugging or informational purposes.

inputs.name: prev_weight_adjust
inputs.description: An optional parameter that allows for the chaining of weight adjustments by providing a previous AdjustGroup object. This facilitates cumulative adjustments over multiple steps.

outputs.name: weight_adjust
outputs.description: Returns an updated AdjustGroup object that encapsulates the new weight adjustments, reflecting the changes made to the model's weights.

ADE_AdjustWeightAllMult.description: The ADE_AdjustWeightAllMult node is designed for adjusting the weights of various components in an animation diffusion model by applying a multiplication factor to all weights simultaneously. This node facilitates the fine-tuning of animation generation by allowing for global adjustments to the model's behavior, enhancing or diminishing the influence of all weights based on the provided multiplier.

inputs.name: all_MULT
inputs.description: Specifies the multiplication factor to be applied to all weights, enabling global adjustment of the model's behavior. This parameter allows for the scaling of weights to either amplify or reduce their influence in the animation generation process.

inputs.name: print_adjustment
inputs.description: A boolean flag that, when set to True, enables the printing of the adjustment details for debugging or informational purposes.

inputs.name: prev_weight_adjust
inputs.description: An optional parameter that allows for the continuation of weight adjustments from a previous state, facilitating sequential adjustments within a workflow.

outputs.name: weight_adjust
outputs.description: Returns an updated weight adjustment object, encapsulating the applied global multiplication adjustments to all weights.

ADE_AdjustWeightIndivAdd.description: This node is designed to adjust individual attention and positional encoding weights by addition, allowing for fine-tuned control over the animation diffusion process. It facilitates the customization of the animation generation by modifying the weights associated with different components of the attention mechanism.

inputs.name: pe_ADD
inputs.description: Specifies the addition value for positional encoding weights, influencing the spatial aspect of generated animations.

inputs.name: attn_ADD
inputs.description: Determines the addition value for the overall attention weights, affecting the focus and relevance of elements within the animation.

inputs.name: other_ADD
inputs.description: Applies an addition adjustment to other unspecified weights, offering a generic mechanism for weight modification.

inputs.name: print_adjustment
inputs.description: Controls whether the adjustments made are printed out, aiding in debugging and fine-tuning processes.

inputs.name: prev_weight_adjust
inputs.description: Allows for the chaining of weight adjustments by taking a previous adjustment group as input, enabling cumulative adjustments.

outputs.name: weight_adjust
outputs.description: Returns an updated weight adjustment group, encapsulating all the specified additions to the weights.

ADE_AdjustWeightIndivAttnAdd.description: This node is designed to adjust the weights of individual attention components in an animation differential setting by adding specified values. It allows for fine-tuning of the attention mechanism's parameters to achieve desired animation effects.

inputs.name: pe_ADD
inputs.description: Specifies the amount to be added to the positional encoding weights, influencing the animation's spatial transformations.

inputs.name: attn_ADD
inputs.description: Determines the addition to the overall attention weights, affecting how the model's attention mechanism prioritizes different parts of the input.

inputs.name: attn_q_ADD
inputs.description: Adjusts the query weights in the attention mechanism by adding the specified value, impacting the calculation of attention scores.

inputs.name: attn_k_ADD
inputs.description: Modifies the key weights in the attention mechanism through addition, influencing how keys and queries interact.

inputs.name: attn_v_ADD
inputs.description: Alters the value weights in the attention mechanism by addition, affecting the output of the attention calculation.

inputs.name: attn_out_weight_ADD
inputs.description: Specifies the addition to the attention output weights, impacting the final attention output before it's passed to subsequent layers.

inputs.name: attn_out_bias_ADD
inputs.description: Adjusts the bias added to the attention output, fine-tuning the attention mechanism's output.

inputs.name: other_ADD
inputs.description: Specifies the amount to be added to other unspecified weights, allowing for general adjustments outside the main attention components.

inputs.name: print_adjustment
inputs.description: Controls whether the adjustments made are printed out, aiding in debugging and fine-tuning processes.

inputs.name: prev_weight_adjust
inputs.description: Allows for the chaining of weight adjustments by taking a previous adjustment group as input, enabling cumulative adjustments.

outputs.name: weight_adjust
outputs.description: Returns an updated weight adjustment group, incorporating the specified individual attention and other adjustments.

ADE_AdjustWeightIndivAttnMult.description: This node is designed to adjust the weights of individual attention components in a model by applying multiplication factors. It allows for fine-tuning of the attention mechanism's parameters, such as query, key, value, and output weights and biases, to potentially enhance model performance or adapt it to specific tasks.

inputs.name: pe_MULT
inputs.description: Specifies the multiplication factor for positional encoding weights, influencing how much the positional information contributes to the model's attention mechanism.

inputs.name: attn_MULT
inputs.description: Determines the overall multiplication factor for the attention weights, affecting the model's focus on different parts of the input.

inputs.name: attn_q_MULT
inputs.description: Applies a multiplication factor to the query weights of the attention mechanism, adjusting its querying capabilities.

inputs.name: attn_k_MULT
inputs.description: Sets the multiplication factor for the key weights, influencing the model's ability to match queries to relevant information.

inputs.name: attn_v_MULT
inputs.description: Controls the multiplication factor for the value weights, affecting how input information is summarized.

inputs.name: attn_out_weight_MULT
inputs.description: Adjusts the output weights of the attention mechanism through a multiplication factor, impacting the final attention output.

inputs.name: attn_out_bias_MULT
inputs.description: Modifies the bias of the attention output with a multiplication factor, potentially altering the attention mechanism's output bias.

inputs.name: other_MULT
inputs.description: Applies a multiplication factor to other unspecified model weights, offering a generic way to adjust model parameters.

inputs.name: print_adjustment
inputs.description: A flag to enable or disable printing of the adjustment details, useful for debugging or monitoring the adjustment process.

inputs.name: prev_weight_adjust
inputs.description: Allows for chaining adjustments by taking a previous weight adjustment group as input, enabling cumulative adjustments.

outputs.name: weight_adjust
outputs.description: Returns an updated weight adjustment group, incorporating the specified multiplicative adjustments to the model's attention mechanism and potentially other weights.

ADE_AdjustWeightIndivMult.description: This node is designed to adjust the weights of individual components in a model multiplicatively, based on specified multipliers for each component. It allows for fine-tuning of model behavior by scaling the influence of different parts of the model, such as attention mechanisms and other parameters, to achieve desired outcomes.

inputs.name: pe_MULT
inputs.description: Specifies the multiplier for positional encoding weights, influencing how much the positional encodings are scaled during the adjustment process.

inputs.name: attn_MULT
inputs.description: Determines the multiplier for the overall attention weights, affecting the scaling of attention mechanisms within the model.

inputs.name: other_MULT
inputs.description: Specifies a general multiplier for other model weights not explicitly covered by other parameters, allowing for broad adjustment.

inputs.name: print_adjustment
inputs.description: A flag indicating whether the adjustments made by this node should be printed for verification or debugging purposes.

inputs.name: prev_weight_adjust
inputs.description: An optional parameter allowing for the input of previous weight adjustments, enabling cumulative adjustments over multiple iterations.

outputs.name: weight_adjust
outputs.description: Returns the updated weight adjustments, incorporating the multiplicative changes specified by the input parameters.

ADE_AnimateDiffCombine.description: This node is designed for combining multiple animation sequences or frames into a single, cohesive animation. It focuses on integrating various elements of animation to create a unified and seamless experience.

inputs.name: images
inputs.description: The images input consists of a sequence of frames that are to be combined into a single animation. It plays a crucial role in determining the content and visual flow of the final animation output.

inputs.name: frame_rate
inputs.description: Specifies the playback speed of the combined animation in frames per second. This parameter influences the temporal aspect of the animation, affecting how smoothly it plays.

inputs.name: loop_count
inputs.description: Determines the number of times the animation will loop. This affects the duration and replayability of the final animation.

inputs.name: filename_prefix
inputs.description: A prefix for the filename under which the animation will be saved. It aids in organizing and identifying the output files.

inputs.name: format
inputs.description: Defines the file format of the output animation. This choice impacts compatibility and quality.

inputs.name: pingpong
inputs.description: A boolean indicating whether the animation should play forwards and then backwards, creating a seamless loop effect.

inputs.name: save_image
inputs.description: Controls whether the final animation is saved to disk. This parameter is essential for persisting the output for later use.

inputs.name: deprecation_warning
inputs.description: Provides a warning that this node is deprecated and suggests using an alternative node for similar functionality.

outputs.name: gif
outputs.description: The output is a GIF animation combining the input frames according to the specified parameters.

ADE_AnimateDiffKeyframe.description: This node is designed to facilitate the creation and manipulation of keyframes within the AnimateDiff framework. It allows for the dynamic adjustment of animation parameters such as scale, effect intensity, and camera control at specific points in the animation timeline, enhancing the customization and precision of animation effects.

inputs.name: start_percent
inputs.description: Specifies the percentage point along the animation timeline at which the keyframe is to be applied, enabling precise control over when animation adjustments occur.

inputs.name: prev_ad_keyframes
inputs.description: An optional list of previously defined keyframes that the current keyframe will be added to, allowing for the accumulation and sequencing of animation effects.

inputs.name: scale_multival
inputs.description: Determines the scaling factor to be applied at the keyframe, affecting the size of animated elements.

inputs.name: effect_multival
inputs.description: Controls the intensity of visual effects applied at the keyframe, such as brightness or contrast adjustments.

inputs.name: inherit_missing
inputs.description: A boolean flag indicating whether the keyframe should inherit unspecified parameters from preceding keyframes, ensuring continuity in animation effects.

inputs.name: guarantee_steps
inputs.description: Specifies the minimum number of steps for which the keyframe's effects are guaranteed to be applied, ensuring consistent animation outcomes.

outputs.name: ad_keyframes
outputs.description: Returns an updated list of keyframes, including the newly added keyframe, facilitating the sequential application of animation effects.

ADE_AnimateDiffLoaderGen1.description: The ADE_AnimateDiffLoaderGen1 node is designed to load and initialize the first generation of AnimateDiff models, setting the stage for subsequent animation or image manipulation tasks. It encapsulates the complexities of model loading and configuration, providing a streamlined interface for the generation of dynamic content.

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: This input specifies the AnimateDiff model to be loaded, central to initializing the animation or image manipulation process.

inputs.name: model_name
inputs.description: The model_name parameter allows for the selection of a specific AnimateDiff model by name, facilitating a more targeted initialization.

inputs.name: beta_schedule
inputs.description: The beta_schedule parameter determines the scheduling of beta values used in the diffusion process, impacting the quality and characteristics of the generated content.

inputs.name: context_options
inputs.description: Optional settings that provide additional context or preferences for the model loading process, allowing for customized initialization.

inputs.name: motion_lora
inputs.description: Specifies the LoRA parameters for motion models, enabling fine-tuned control over the animation dynamics.

inputs.name: ad_settings
inputs.description: Animation and diffusion settings that customize the behavior of the AnimateDiff model during the loading process.

inputs.name: ad_keyframes
inputs.description: Defines keyframes for animation, guiding the model in generating dynamic content over specified intervals.

inputs.name: sample_settings
inputs.description: Settings that influence the sampling process, such as temperature and top-k filtering, to refine the generated output.

inputs.name: scale_multival
inputs.description: Multipliers for scaling the effects in the generated content, allowing for varied intensities of certain features.

inputs.name: effect_multival
inputs.description: Multipliers for adjusting the intensity of specific effects within the generated content, providing creative control over the output.

outputs.name: model
outputs.description: This output is the loaded AnimateDiff model, ready for use in animation or image manipulation tasks.

ADE_AnimateDiffLoaderV1Advanced.description: This node is designed for advanced loading of AnimateDiff models, offering enhanced configuration options and optimizations for deprecated model versions. It aims to provide a more flexible and efficient way to work with older AnimateDiff models, ensuring compatibility and performance.

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: Specifies the AnimateDiff model to be loaded, allowing for advanced configuration and optimization of deprecated models.

inputs.name: latents
inputs.description: Defines the latent variables associated with the AnimateDiff model, crucial for its operation and performance.

inputs.name: model_name
inputs.description: Identifies the specific AnimateDiff model to be loaded, enabling precise selection and configuration.

inputs.name: unlimited_area_hack
inputs.description: A boolean flag that, when enabled, allows for bypassing certain limitations, enhancing the model's flexibility.

inputs.name: context_length
inputs.description: unknown

inputs.name: context_stride
inputs.description: unknown

inputs.name: context_overlap
inputs.description: unknown

inputs.name: context_schedule
inputs.description: unknown

inputs.name: closed_loop
inputs.description: unknown

inputs.name: beta_schedule
inputs.description: Determines the beta schedule used during the model's operation, affecting its performance and outcomes.

inputs.name: deprecation_warning
inputs.description: Provides a warning about the deprecated status of the model, advising on its experimental or limited use.

outputs.name: model
outputs.description: Outputs the loaded AnimateDiff model, configured and optimized for use.

outputs.name: latent
outputs.description: unknown

ADE_AnimateDiffLoaderWithContext.description: This node is designed to load the AnimateDiff model along with a specific context, facilitating the integration of additional information or settings that influence the animation process. It serves as a bridge between the legacy AnimateDiff model and newer, context-aware functionalities, ensuring compatibility and enhanced control over the animation generation.

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: Specifies the AnimateDiff model to be loaded, serving as the core component for the animation process.

inputs.name: model_name
inputs.description: Identifies the specific AnimateDiff model by name, allowing for precise selection within the available options.

inputs.name: beta_schedule
inputs.description: Adjusts the beta schedule for the animation, influencing the diffusion process.

inputs.name: context_options
inputs.description: Provides context-specific options that modify how the AnimateDiff model processes animations, allowing for customized animation behaviors.

inputs.name: motion_lora
inputs.description: Specifies the LoRA parameters for motion, enhancing the model's ability to generate dynamic animations.

inputs.name: ad_settings
inputs.description: Defines the settings for AnimateDiff, tailoring the animation process to specific requirements.

inputs.name: sample_settings
inputs.description: Determines the sampling settings for the animation, affecting the quality and characteristics of the generated animation.

inputs.name: motion_scale
inputs.description: Controls the scale of motion in the animation, allowing for finer adjustment of movement intensity.

inputs.name: apply_v2_models_properly
inputs.description: Ensures that version 2 models are applied correctly, optimizing compatibility and performance.

inputs.name: ad_keyframes
inputs.description: Specifies keyframes for the animation, guiding the AnimateDiff model in generating targeted animation sequences.

outputs.name: model
outputs.description: The loaded AnimateDiff model, ready for animation generation with the specified context and settings.

ADE_AnimateDiffLoRALoader.description: The ADE_AnimateDiffLoRALoader node is designed to load motion LoRA (Locally Recurrent Architecture) configurations for use in animation processes. It facilitates the selection and application of specific motion LoRA settings, enhancing the control and customization of animation dynamics.

inputs.name: lora_name
inputs.description: Specifies the name of the motion LoRA to be loaded. It is crucial for identifying the specific LoRA configuration to apply.

inputs.name: strength
inputs.description: Determines the strength of the motion LoRA effect. This parameter allows for fine-tuning the intensity of the motion applied, affecting the animation's overall dynamics.

inputs.name: prev_motion_lora
inputs.description: Optional. Represents the previous motion LoRA configuration. If provided, it enables the chaining or layering of motion LoRA effects for more complex animations.

outputs.name: motion_lora
outputs.description: Returns the updated motion LoRA configuration, incorporating the selected LoRA settings and strength. This output is essential for subsequent animation steps.

ADE_AnimateDiffModelSettings.description: This node is designed to configure motion model settings for the AnimateDiff process, allowing users to adjust motion scale parameters and apply optional mask motion scaling to fine-tune the animation effects.

inputs.name: pe_strength
inputs.description: Determines the strength of positional encoding adjustments, influencing the overall animation dynamics.

inputs.name: attn_strength
inputs.description: Controls the strength of attention adjustments, affecting how motion influences are applied across the animation.

inputs.name: other_strength
inputs.description: Adjusts the strength of other model parameters not explicitly categorized, offering additional fine-tuning of the animation.

inputs.name: motion_pe_stretch
inputs.description: Specifies the amount by which positional encoding is stretched, altering the motion's perceived speed and extent.

inputs.name: cap_initial_pe_length
inputs.description: Caps the initial positional encoding length, potentially limiting the range of motion.

inputs.name: interpolate_pe_to_length
inputs.description: Defines the length to which positional encoding is interpolated, affecting the smoothness and range of motion.

inputs.name: initial_pe_idx_offset
inputs.description: Sets the initial positional encoding index offset, adjusting the starting point of the motion.

inputs.name: final_pe_idx_offset
inputs.description: Determines the final positional encoding index offset, adjusting the endpoint of the motion.

inputs.name: mask_motion_scale
inputs.description: An optional mask to scale motion selectively across different parts of the image, enabling more detailed control over the animation.

inputs.name: min_motion_scale
inputs.description: Specifies the minimum scale for motion, influencing the subtlety of the animation. Lower values result in more subtle motion effects.

inputs.name: max_motion_scale
inputs.description: Defines the maximum scale for motion, affecting the intensity of the animation. Higher values lead to more pronounced motion effects.

outputs.name: ad_settings
outputs.description: Outputs the configured motion model settings, encapsulating adjustments to motion scale and optional mask motion scaling.

ADE_AnimateDiffModelSettingsAdvancedAttn.description: This node is designed to fine-tune the attention strengths within the AnimateDiff model, allowing for advanced customization of the model's attention mechanisms. It provides the capability to adjust the multipliers for various components of the attention mechanism, including query, key, value, output weights, and biases, thereby offering a granular control over the model's focus and processing of input features.

inputs.name: pe_strength
inputs.description: Specifies the multiplier for positional encoding adjustments, influencing how the model perceives the position of elements within the input.

inputs.name: attn_strength
inputs.description: Defines the overall multiplier for the attention mechanism, affecting the model's ability to focus on relevant parts of the input.

inputs.name: attn_q_strength
inputs.description: Adjusts the multiplier for the query component of the attention mechanism, impacting how queries are generated from the input.

inputs.name: attn_k_strength
inputs.description: Sets the multiplier for the key component, influencing the matching process between queries and keys.

inputs.name: attn_v_strength
inputs.description: Modifies the multiplier for the value component, affecting the information retrieved based on query-key matching.

inputs.name: attn_out_weight_strength
inputs.description: Controls the multiplier for the attention output weights, adjusting the influence of attention outputs on the final result.

inputs.name: attn_out_bias_strength
inputs.description: Determines the multiplier for the attention output biases, fine-tuning the bias applied to the attention outputs.

inputs.name: other_strength
inputs.description: Specifies the multiplier for other model components not explicitly covered by the other parameters, offering a catch-all adjustment mechanism.

inputs.name: motion_pe_stretch
inputs.description: Specifies the stretch factor for positional encoding in motion, adjusting how motion influences positional encoding.

inputs.name: cap_initial_pe_length
inputs.description: Caps the initial length of positional encoding, limiting the extent of positional encoding adjustments.

inputs.name: interpolate_pe_to_length
inputs.description: Determines the length to which positional encoding is interpolated, affecting the granularity of positional adjustments.

inputs.name: initial_pe_idx_offset
inputs.description: Sets the initial index offset for positional encoding, adjusting the starting point of positional encoding.

inputs.name: final_pe_idx_offset
inputs.description: Defines the final index offset for positional encoding, adjusting the endpoint of positional encoding adjustments.

inputs.name: mask_motion_scale
inputs.description: Specifies a tensor for scaling the attention mask based on motion, allowing for dynamic adjustment of attention based on motion.

inputs.name: min_motion_scale
inputs.description: Sets the minimum scale for motion-based attention adjustments, ensuring a baseline level of motion influence.

inputs.name: max_motion_scale
inputs.description: Defines the maximum scale for motion-based attention adjustments, capping the influence of motion on attention.

outputs.name: ad_settings
outputs.description: Returns an updated AnimateDiffSettings object that incorporates the specified attention and motion-related adjustments, enabling subsequent customization steps.

ADE_AnimateDiffModelSettingsSimple.description: This node is designed to configure motion model settings for AnimateDiff, focusing on simplifying the process by adjusting the stretch of motion path encoding (PE) and scaling motion effects. It's tailored for scenarios requiring basic motion adjustments without the complexity of full model configuration.

inputs.name: motion_pe_stretch
inputs.description: Specifies the stretch factor for the motion path encoding, directly influencing the motion's perceived length and intensity.

inputs.name: mask_motion_scale
inputs.description: Optional tensor to scale motion effects selectively across different regions of the image.

inputs.name: min_motion_scale
inputs.description: Sets the minimum scale for motion effects, providing a baseline for motion intensity.

inputs.name: max_motion_scale
inputs.description: Defines the maximum scale for motion effects, capping the intensity of motion adjustments.

outputs.name: ad_settings
outputs.description: Outputs the configured motion model settings, encapsulating the adjustments made to motion path encoding and motion effect scaling.

ADE_AnimateDiffModelSettings_Release.description: This node is designed to configure motion model settings for the AnimateDiff process, allowing users to adjust motion scale parameters to fine-tune the animation effects.

inputs.name: min_motion_scale
inputs.description: Specifies the minimum scale for motion in the animation, serving as a baseline for how subtle or pronounced the motion effects should be.

inputs.name: max_motion_scale
inputs.description: Defines the maximum scale for motion, setting an upper limit on the intensity of the animation effects.

inputs.name: mask_motion_scale
inputs.description: An optional mask tensor to apply scale adjustments selectively across different parts of the image, enhancing the control over motion effects.

outputs.name: ad_settings
outputs.description: Returns the configured motion model settings, encapsulating the adjustments made to motion scales.

ADE_AnimateDiffSamplingSettings.description: This node is designed to configure and manage the sampling settings for the AnimateDiff process, allowing for detailed customization of the animation generation process. It enables users to specify various parameters such as batch offsets, noise types, seed generation methods, and more, to finely tune the animation output according to specific requirements.

inputs.name: batch_offset
inputs.description: Specifies the offset for the batch processing, allowing for control over the starting point of animation generation.

inputs.name: noise_type
inputs.description: Defines the type of noise to be applied during the sampling process, influencing the visual texture and quality of the generated animation.

inputs.name: seed_gen
inputs.description: Determines the method for generating seeds used in the animation process, impacting the randomness and variation of the output.

inputs.name: seed_offset
inputs.description: Sets the offset for seed generation, providing additional control over the randomness of the animation.

inputs.name: noise_layers
inputs.description: Optional parameter that allows for the specification of custom noise layers, offering further customization of the animation's visual effects.

inputs.name: iteration_opts
inputs.description: Provides options for iteration control during the sampling process, enabling adjustments to the animation's progression and detail.

inputs.name: seed_override
inputs.description: Allows for a specific seed value to be used, overriding the default or generated seed for precise control over the animation outcome.

inputs.name: adapt_denoise_steps
inputs.description: Enables or disables the adaptation of denoise steps based on specific conditions, affecting the smoothness and quality of the animation.

inputs.name: custom_cfg
inputs.description: Permits the inclusion of custom configuration settings for keyframes, enhancing the animation's narrative and visual coherence.

inputs.name: sigma_schedule
inputs.description: Specifies a sigma schedule to control the variance of noise throughout the animation, impacting the overall visual dynamics.

inputs.name: image_inject
inputs.description: Allows for the injection of specific images into the animation, adding complexity and detail to the visual output.

outputs.name: settings
outputs.description: Returns the configured sampling settings, encapsulating all specified parameters and adjustments for the animation process.

ADE_AnimateDiffSettings.description: This node is designed to configure settings for the animation difference process, allowing users to adjust parameters related to positional encoding and weight adjustments. It serves as a foundational element in customizing the behavior and output of animation difference operations.

inputs.name: pe_adjust
inputs.description: Specifies the adjustments to be made to the positional encoding, influencing how animation frames are generated and interpolated.

inputs.name: weight_adjust
inputs.description: Defines the adjustments to the weights, affecting the influence of different components in the animation difference calculation.

outputs.name: ad_settings
outputs.description: The configured animation difference settings, ready to be applied in subsequent animation difference processes.

ADE_AnimateDiffUniformContextOptions.description: This node is designed to provide uniform context options for the AnimateDiff process, facilitating the generation of animations with consistent context across frames. It is marked as legacy, indicating that it may have been superseded by newer methods or nodes for managing context in animation generation.

inputs.name: context_length
inputs.description: Defines the length of the context used in the animation process, influencing the amount of information considered for generating each frame.

inputs.name: context_stride
inputs.description: Determines the stride between contexts in the animation, affecting the transition and flow between frames.

inputs.name: context_overlap
inputs.description: Specifies the degree of overlap between contexts of consecutive frames, affecting the smoothness and continuity of the animation.

inputs.name: context_schedule
inputs.description: Specifies the scheduling method for context application, influencing the timing and sequence of animation frames.

inputs.name: closed_loop
inputs.description: Indicates whether the animation should loop back to the beginning after completing, creating a continuous loop effect.

inputs.name: fuse_method
inputs.description: Determines the method used to fuse multiple contexts together, impacting the overall coherence and flow of the generated animation.

inputs.name: use_on_equal_length
inputs.description: A boolean flag indicating whether the context options should be applied uniformly across frames of equal length, ensuring consistent animation characteristics.

inputs.name: start_percent
inputs.description: Indicates the starting point of the animation as a percentage, allowing for precise control over the animation's initiation within the context.

inputs.name: guarantee_steps
inputs.description: Guarantees a minimum number of steps in the animation, ensuring that the animation reaches a certain length regardless of other parameters.

inputs.name: prev_context
inputs.description: The previous context options group, which can be used as a basis for generating the new context options, facilitating continuity across animations.

inputs.name: view_opts
inputs.description: View options that specify additional parameters for rendering the animation, further customizing the output.

inputs.name: deprecation_warning
inputs.description: A notice that this node is considered legacy and may be replaced by newer methods or nodes in future updates.

outputs.name: CONTEXT_OPTS
outputs.description: The generated context options, ready to be utilized in the AnimateDiff process for creating uniform animations.

ADE_AnimateDiffUnload.description: This node is designed to unload or release resources associated with the AnimateDiff model from memory, ensuring efficient resource management and freeing up memory for subsequent tasks.

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: Specifies the AnimateDiff model to be unloaded, allowing for the release of its resources from memory.

outputs.name: model
outputs.description: Confirms the successful unloading of the specified AnimateDiff model, ensuring its resources are freed.

ADE_ApplyAnimateDiffModel.description: The ADE_ApplyAnimateDiffModel node is designed to apply advanced AnimateDiff model configurations to generate motion in images. It leverages a comprehensive set of parameters to fine-tune the animation process, accommodating a wide range of motion effects and styles.

inputs.name: motion_model
inputs.description: Specifies the motion model to be used for animation. It is crucial for defining the animation's behavior and characteristics.

inputs.name: start_percent
inputs.description: Defines the starting percentage of the animation effect, marking the beginning of the motion's application.

inputs.name: end_percent
inputs.description: Specifies the ending percentage of the animation effect, determining the point at which the motion ceases.

inputs.name: motion_lora
inputs.description: Optional parameter that allows for the adjustment of motion using LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation) techniques, enhancing the animation's quality.

inputs.name: scale_multival
inputs.description: Optional parameter that influences the scale of the animation effect, allowing for fine-tuning of the animation's intensity.

inputs.name: effect_multival
inputs.description: Optional parameter that adjusts the overall effect of the animation, enabling customization of the visual outcome.

inputs.name: ad_keyframes
inputs.description: Optional parameter that specifies keyframes for the animation, allowing for precise control over the motion's timing and sequence.

inputs.name: prev_m_models
inputs.description: Optional parameter that includes previous motion models to be considered in the current animation process, allowing for cumulative effects.

outputs.name: m_models
outputs.description: Outputs the motion models used in the animation process, encapsulating all adjustments and configurations made.

ADE_ApplyAnimateDiffModelSimple.description: This node is designed to apply a motion model to animate images or sequences, offering a simplified interface for integrating motion effects. It abstracts the complexities involved in the animation process, making it accessible for users to apply predefined motion models to their content.

inputs.name: motion_model
inputs.description: Specifies the motion model to be applied. It is crucial for defining the animation behavior and effects on the target content.

inputs.name: motion_lora
inputs.description: Optional parameter for incorporating motion Lora adjustments, enhancing the animation with additional motion effects.

inputs.name: scale_multival
inputs.description: Optional parameter for scaling effects, providing flexibility in the intensity of the applied motion.

inputs.name: effect_multival
inputs.description: Optional parameter for effect adjustments, enabling customization of the visual impact of the motion.

inputs.name: ad_keyframes
inputs.description: Optional parameter for specifying keyframes, allowing for more controlled and precise animation effects.

outputs.name: m_models
outputs.description: Outputs the modified motion models after applying the specified motion effects, keyframes, and adjustments.

ADE_ApplyAnimateDiffModelWithCameraCtrl.description: This node applies the AnimateDiff model with camera control, integrating motion model adjustments and camera control parameters to generate animated sequences. It leverages camera control poses and other animation parameters to enhance the AnimateDiff model's output, providing a more dynamic and customizable animation experience.

inputs.name: motion_model
inputs.description: The motion model to be animated, incorporating both the AnimateDiff model's capabilities and camera control features for enhanced animation.

inputs.name: cameractrl_poses
inputs.description: A list of camera control poses, each defining a specific camera position and orientation to be applied during the animation process.

inputs.name: start_percent
inputs.description: The starting point of the animation as a percentage of the total animation length, allowing for partial animations.

inputs.name: end_percent
inputs.description: The ending point of the animation as a percentage of the total animation length, enabling customization of the animation's duration.

inputs.name: motion_lora
inputs.description: Optional parameter for specifying motion LoRA settings to further customize the animation.

inputs.name: scale_multival
inputs.description: Optional parameter for applying scale multipliers to the animation, affecting the overall size of animated elements.

inputs.name: effect_multival
inputs.description: Optional parameter for applying effect multipliers, allowing for additional visual effects in the animation.

inputs.name: cameractrl_multival
inputs.description: Optional parameter for applying multiple camera control values, enhancing the dynamic camera movements within the animation.

inputs.name: ad_keyframes
inputs.description: Optional parameter for defining keyframes within the animation, enabling precise control over animation sequences.

inputs.name: prev_m_models
inputs.description: Optional parameter for incorporating previously generated motion models, facilitating sequential or layered animations.

outputs.name: m_models
outputs.description: The resulting motion models after applying the AnimateDiff model with camera control, including any specified animations and effects.

ADE_ApplyAnimateDiffModelWithPIA.description: This node is designed to apply a PIA (Pose Interpolation and Animation) model within the AnimateDiff framework, enabling the animation of images by interpolating between poses. It integrates motion models with specific PIA enhancements to enrich the animation process, ensuring compatibility and leveraging PIA's capabilities for more dynamic and detailed animations.

inputs.name: motion_model
inputs.description: Specifies the motion model to be applied, which must be compatible with PIA. It is crucial for the animation process, dictating how the image is animated between poses.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The input image to be animated. This image serves as the basis for the animation process, with the motion model applying transformations to it.

inputs.name: vae
inputs.description: The VAE model used for encoding and decoding images during the animation process. It plays a key role in processing the images for animation.

inputs.name: start_percent
inputs.description: Defines the starting percentage of the animation, allowing for control over when the animation effect begins.

inputs.name: end_percent
inputs.description: Specifies the ending percentage of the animation, enabling control over when the animation effect concludes.

inputs.name: pia_input
inputs.description: Optional PIA-specific input parameters that influence the animation effect. Allows for customization of the animation process.

inputs.name: motion_lora
inputs.description: A list of motion Lora settings that can be applied to the motion model for enhanced animation effects.

inputs.name: scale_multival
inputs.description: A multivalued parameter for scaling effects, providing additional customization for the animation.

inputs.name: effect_multival
inputs.description: A multivalued parameter for effect intensity, offering further customization options for the animation.

inputs.name: ad_keyframes
inputs.description: Specifies the keyframes for the animation, dictating the sequence and timing of animated poses.

inputs.name: prev_m_models
inputs.description: A list of previously applied motion models, allowing for sequential animation effects to be layered or combined.

outputs.name: m_models
outputs.description: The updated list of motion models after applying the PIA model, with the most recent model added first.

ADE_ApplyAnimateLCMI2VModel.description: This node is designed to apply the AnimateLCM-I2V model to animate images using latent code motion inference with I2V (Image-to-Video) capabilities. It integrates motion models and keyframe groups to generate dynamic, animated visuals from static images, enhancing them with motion and effects based on specified parameters.

inputs.name: motion_model
inputs.description: The motion model parameter is crucial for defining the motion characteristics and dynamics that will be applied to the static image. It affects the node's execution by determining the type of animation and movement effects that will be introduced.

inputs.name: ref_latent
inputs.description: This parameter holds the reference latent representation of the image to be animated. It is essential for maintaining the image's original characteristics while applying motion effects.

inputs.name: ref_drift
inputs.description: Specifies the degree of drift or deviation from the original image's characteristics when applying motion, allowing for subtle or significant changes in the animated output.

inputs.name: apply_ref_when_disabled
inputs.description: Determines whether the reference characteristics (e.g., drift) should be applied even when the motion model is disabled, ensuring continuity in the animation process.

inputs.name: start_percent
inputs.description: Defines the starting point of the animation within the motion model's timeline, allowing for precise control over when the animation effects begin.

inputs.name: end_percent
inputs.description: Sets the endpoint of the animation within the motion model's timeline, enabling customization of the animation's duration and conclusion.

inputs.name: motion_lora
inputs.description: A list of motion-specific LoRA settings that can be applied to further customize the animation effects and dynamics.

inputs.name: scale_multival
inputs.description: Multipliers for scaling effects, providing additional control over the size and proportion of animated elements.

inputs.name: effect_multival
inputs.description: Multipliers for various effects, offering further customization of the visual appearance and dynamics of the animation.

inputs.name: ad_keyframes
inputs.description: Specifies a group of keyframes for advanced animation control, allowing for detailed customization of motion and effects over time.

inputs.name: prev_m_models
inputs.description: A group of previously applied motion models, enabling the node to build upon or modify existing animations for enhanced or varied effects.

outputs.name: m_models
outputs.description: The updated list of motion models, including the most recently applied model with its configured animation and effects.

ADE_AttachLoraHookToCLIP.description: This node is designed to attach a LoRA hook to a CLIP model, enhancing its functionality by integrating additional computational layers or modifications. It serves as a customization point for the CLIP model, allowing for tailored adjustments that can influence the model's behavior or outputs.

inputs.name: clip
inputs.description: The CLIP model to which the LoRA hook will be attached. This parameter is crucial as it determines the base model that will be modified.

inputs.name: lora_hook
inputs.description: The LoRA hook to be attached to the CLIP model. This hook represents the modifications or enhancements to be applied, playing a key role in customizing the model's functionality.

outputs.name: hook_CLIP
outputs.description: The modified CLIP model with the LoRA hook attached, representing the enhanced version of the original model.

ADE_AttachLoraHookToConditioning.description: This node is designed to attach LoRA hooks to conditioning data, enabling the dynamic modification of model behavior based on specified LoRA hooks. It plays a crucial role in customizing and controlling the conditioning process in generative models, particularly in the context of animation and differential rendering.

inputs.name: conditioning
inputs.description: The conditioning data to which the LoRA hook will be attached. This data dictates the model's behavior and output, and attaching a LoRA hook allows for dynamic adjustments.

inputs.name: lora_hook
inputs.description: The LoRA hook to be attached to the conditioning data. This hook enables the modification of model parameters at runtime, allowing for enhanced control and customization of the generative process.

outputs.name: conditioning
outputs.description: The modified conditioning data with the LoRA hook attached, enabling dynamic adjustments to the model's behavior.

ADE_BatchedContextOptions.description: This node is designed to create and manage batched context options for Animate Diff operations. It allows for the customization of context length, start percentage, and guaranteed steps, with the option to inherit and modify previous context settings. This facilitates the efficient handling of context in batched processing scenarios, optimizing the animation and diffing processes by adjusting context parameters dynamically.

inputs.name: context_length
inputs.description: Specifies the length of the context to be used in the batched processing. This parameter is crucial for defining the scope of the context over which the animation and diff operations are applied, directly influencing the granularity and precision of the process.

inputs.name: start_percent
inputs.description: Determines the starting point of the context as a percentage of the total length. This allows for fine-tuning the initial position of the context window, enabling more precise control over the animation and diffing operations.

inputs.name: guarantee_steps
inputs.description: Defines the minimum number of steps guaranteed within the context. This parameter ensures that a certain level of detail and smoothness is maintained in the animation and diffing processes, regardless of the context length or start position.

inputs.name: prev_context
inputs.description: Allows for the inheritance and modification of previously defined context options. This facilitates the reuse and adaptation of context settings, promoting efficiency and consistency across batched processing tasks.

outputs.name: CONTEXT_OPTS
outputs.description: The modified or newly created batched context options, ready to be utilized in subsequent Animate Diff operations. This encapsulates all the specified parameters, providing a tailored context setup for optimized batch processing.

ADE_CameraCtrlAnimateDiffKeyframe.description: This node is designed to generate and manage keyframes for animations that incorporate camera control, enabling the creation of dynamic and complex camera movements within the AnimateDiff framework. It allows for the specification of start percentages for animations, the application of multiple values for scaling, effects, and camera control, and the inheritance of missing values to ensure continuity across keyframes.

inputs.name: start_percent
inputs.description: Specifies the starting point of the animation as a percentage, allowing for precise control over the timing of camera movements and effects within the animation.

inputs.name: prev_ad_keyframes
inputs.description: Optional. Allows for the inclusion of previously defined AnimateDiff keyframes, enabling the chaining and layering of animations for more complex sequences.

inputs.name: scale_multival
inputs.description: Optional. Applies a scaling factor to the animation, enabling adjustments to the size of animated elements.

inputs.name: effect_multival
inputs.description: Optional. Applies various effects to the animation, enabling the addition of visual enhancements or modifications.

inputs.name: cameractrl_multival
inputs.description: Optional. Specifies multiple values for camera control, allowing for the creation of intricate camera movements within the animation.

inputs.name: inherit_missing
inputs.description: Determines whether missing values in the current keyframe should be inherited from previous keyframes, ensuring continuity in the animation.

inputs.name: guarantee_steps
inputs.description: Specifies the minimum number of steps to be guaranteed in the animation, ensuring a certain level of smoothness and continuity.

outputs.name: ad_keyframes
outputs.description: Produces a sequence of AnimateDiff keyframes, enabling the creation of animations with complex camera movements.

ADE_CameraManualPoseAppend.description: The ADE_CameraManualPoseAppend node is designed for manually appending camera control poses, enabling the customization and extension of camera movements within animations. This node facilitates the integration of user-defined camera poses, enhancing the dynamic visual storytelling capabilities in animation projects.

inputs.name: poses_first
inputs.description: Specifies the initial set of camera control poses to be appended. It plays a crucial role in determining the starting point of the camera's movement.

inputs.name: poses_last
inputs.description: Defines the final set of camera control poses to be appended. It determines the ending point of the camera's movement, allowing for a seamless transition between camera states.

outputs.name: cameractrl_poses
outputs.description: Outputs the combined set of camera control poses, representing the seamless integration of the initial and final poses for dynamic camera movement in animations.

ADE_CameraPoseAdvanced.description: The ADE_CameraPoseAdvanced node is designed for creating advanced camera control poses for animations. It allows for the combination of multiple motion types and strengths to generate complex camera movements, enhancing the dynamic visual storytelling in animated sequences.

inputs.name: motion_type1
inputs.description: Specifies the first type of camera motion to apply, influencing the overall camera movement and its visual impact on the animation.

inputs.name: strength1
inputs.description: Specifies the strength multiplier for the first motion type, adjusting the intensity of the camera's movement.

inputs.name: motion_type2
inputs.description: Defines the second type of camera motion, contributing to the complexity and depth of the camera's path.

inputs.name: strength2
inputs.description: Defines the strength multiplier for the second motion type, modifying the impact of the camera's path.

inputs.name: motion_type3
inputs.description: Indicates the third type of camera motion, adding another layer of movement to the camera's trajectory.

inputs.name: strength3
inputs.description: Indicates the strength multiplier for the third motion type, altering the camera's movement intensity.

inputs.name: motion_type4
inputs.description: Specifies the fourth type of camera motion, further enriching the camera's movement and its effect on the scene.

inputs.name: strength4
inputs.description: Specifies the strength multiplier for the fourth motion type, affecting the depth of the camera's trajectory.

inputs.name: motion_type5
inputs.description: Defines the fifth type of camera motion, enhancing the animation with additional movement nuances.

inputs.name: strength5
inputs.description: Defines the strength multiplier for the fifth motion type, influencing the nuance of the camera's movement.

inputs.name: motion_type6
inputs.description: Indicates the sixth type of camera motion, completing the set of movements for sophisticated camera control.

inputs.name: strength6
inputs.description: Indicates the strength multiplier for the sixth motion type, fine-tuning the complexity of the camera's control.

inputs.name: speed
inputs.description: Controls the speed of the camera movement, affecting how quickly or slowly the camera transitions between poses.

inputs.name: frame_length
inputs.description: Determines the number of frames over which the camera movement is applied, defining the duration of the motion.

inputs.name: prev_poses
inputs.description: Optional. Previous camera poses that can be combined with the new motion for seamless transitions in animations.

outputs.name: cameractrl_poses
outputs.description: The resulting camera control poses, representing the combined effect of the specified motions and parameters on the camera's path through the animation.

ADE_CameraPoseBasic.description: This node is designed to create basic camera control poses based on specified motion types, speed, and frame length. It allows for the generation of camera poses that can be used to control the camera's movement and orientation in a 3D environment, facilitating dynamic and customizable animations.

inputs.name: motion_type
inputs.description: Specifies the type of motion to apply to the camera, influencing the direction and nature of the camera's movement.

inputs.name: speed
inputs.description: Determines the speed at which the camera moves, allowing for control over the pace of the animation.

inputs.name: frame_length
inputs.description: Defines the number of frames over which the camera motion is applied, setting the duration of the camera's movement.

inputs.name: prev_poses
inputs.description: Optional. Provides previous camera poses to be combined with the newly generated ones, enabling seamless transitions between animations.

outputs.name: cameractrl_poses
outputs.description: Outputs the generated camera control poses, ready for use in animations.

ADE_CameraPoseCombo.description: The ADE_CameraPoseCombo node is designed to create complex camera control poses by combining multiple motion types and their respective strengths. It allows for the customization of camera movements in animation sequences, enabling the generation of dynamic and nuanced camera behaviors.

inputs.name: motion_type1
inputs.description: Specifies the first type of camera motion to be included in the combination. Each motion type contributes to the overall camera movement pattern.

inputs.name: motion_type2
inputs.description: Specifies the second type of camera motion to be included in the combination, adding to the complexity of the camera movement.

inputs.name: motion_type3
inputs.description: Specifies the third type of camera motion, further enriching the camera movement pattern.

inputs.name: motion_type4
inputs.description: Specifies the fourth type of camera motion, contributing to the diversity of the camera movement.

inputs.name: motion_type5
inputs.description: Specifies the fifth type of camera motion, adding another layer to the camera movement complexity.

inputs.name: motion_type6
inputs.description: Specifies the sixth type of camera motion, completing the set of movements for a comprehensive camera control.

inputs.name: speed
inputs.description: Controls the speed of the camera movement, affecting how quickly or slowly the camera transitions between poses.

inputs.name: frame_length
inputs.description: Determines the number of frames over which the camera movement occurs, defining the duration of the animation.

inputs.name: prev_poses
inputs.description: Optional. Previous camera poses that can be combined with the new motion for seamless transitions in animations. This input is crucial for creating fluid and continuous camera movements, especially in scenarios where maintaining a narrative or visual continuity is essential.

outputs.name: cameractrl_poses
outputs.description: The resulting camera control poses after combining the specified motions and strengths, ready for use in animations.

ADE_CombineLoraHooks.description: This node is designed to aggregate multiple LoRA Hook Groups into a single, unified LoRA Hook Group. It facilitates the combination of various LoRA hooks, allowing for more complex and nuanced model conditioning by integrating different modifications or enhancements provided by each individual hook.

inputs.name: lora_hook_A
inputs.description: Represents the first LoRA Hook Group to be combined. It plays a crucial role in the aggregation process, contributing its modifications or enhancements to the resulting unified LoRA Hook Group.

inputs.name: lora_hook_B
inputs.description: Represents the second LoRA Hook Group to be combined. It contributes its unique modifications or enhancements to the unified LoRA Hook Group, enriching the overall conditioning effect.

outputs.name: lora_hook
outputs.description: The output is a unified LoRA Hook Group that combines the modifications or enhancements of the input LoRA Hook Groups. This aggregated hook facilitates more complex model conditioning.

ADE_CombineLoraHooksEight.description: This node is designed to combine up to eight LoRA hooks into a single, unified LoRA hook group. It facilitates the integration of multiple LoRA hook modifications, allowing for more complex and nuanced adjustments to model behavior in generative tasks.

inputs.name: lora_hook_A
inputs.description: Represents the first LoRA hook group to be combined. It plays a foundational role in the aggregation process, setting the initial conditions for the combined LoRA hook group.

inputs.name: lora_hook_B
inputs.description: Serves as the second LoRA hook group to be combined. Its inclusion allows for the expansion of the combined LoRA hook group's capabilities and modifications.

inputs.name: lora_hook_C
inputs.description: Acts as the third LoRA hook group in the combination process. It contributes additional modifications, further enriching the combined LoRA hook group's functionality.

inputs.name: lora_hook_D
inputs.description: Represents the fourth LoRA hook group to be combined. It adds to the diversity of modifications within the combined LoRA hook group.

inputs.name: lora_hook_E
inputs.description: Serves as the fifth LoRA hook group in the combination. It enhances the combined LoRA hook group by introducing more nuanced adjustments.

inputs.name: lora_hook_F
inputs.description: Acts as the sixth LoRA hook group to be combined. Its inclusion broadens the scope of modifications available in the combined LoRA hook group.

inputs.name: lora_hook_G
inputs.description: Represents the seventh LoRA hook group in the combination process. It adds further complexity and depth to the combined LoRA hook group's adjustments.

inputs.name: lora_hook_H
inputs.description: Serves as the eighth and final LoRA hook group to be combined. It completes the aggregation, maximizing the potential modifications and adjustments within the combined LoRA hook group.

outputs.name: lora_hook
outputs.description: The result of combining up to eight LoRA hooks into a single, unified LoRA hook group. This combined group is capable of applying a comprehensive set of modifications to model behavior.

ADE_CombineLoraHooksFour.description: This node is designed to aggregate and combine up to four LoRA hooks into a single, unified LoRA hook group. It facilitates the integration of multiple LoRA hook modifications, allowing for more complex and nuanced adjustments to model behavior within the Animate Diff framework.

inputs.name: lora_hook_A
inputs.description: Represents the first LoRA hook group to be combined. It plays a crucial role in the aggregation process, contributing to the overall modifications applied.

inputs.name: lora_hook_B
inputs.description: Serves as the second LoRA hook group for combination. Its inclusion allows for the layering of modifications, enhancing the model's adaptability.

inputs.name: lora_hook_C
inputs.description: The third LoRA hook group in the combination process. It adds another layer of customization, further refining the model's behavior.
