inputs.name: lora_hook_D
inputs.description: Represents the fourth and final LoRA hook group to be combined. It completes the set of modifications, enabling a comprehensive adjustment to the model.

outputs.name: lora_hook
outputs.description: The result of combining up to four LoRA hooks into a single, unified group. This consolidated hook group allows for enhanced and more complex model conditioning.

ADE_ConditioningSetMask.description: This node is designed to apply a mask to conditioning data, adjusting the area and strength of the conditioning based on specified parameters. It enables the dynamic modification of conditioning inputs to better align with desired outcomes, such as focusing on or excluding specific areas within the data.

inputs.name: cond_ADD
inputs.description: The conditioning data to be added or modified. This parameter is essential for introducing new contexts or content into the existing conditioning framework.

inputs.name: strength
inputs.description: Defines the intensity of the mask's effect on the conditioning data, allowing for fine-tuned control over the modification's impact.

inputs.name: set_cond_area
inputs.description: Determines whether the mask's effect is applied to the default area or the bounds of the mask, providing flexibility in targeting specific regions.

inputs.name: opt_mask
inputs.description: An optional mask that specifies the areas of the conditioning data to be modified, offering additional control over which parts of the conditioning are affected.

inputs.name: opt_lora_hook
inputs.description: An optional parameter that allows for the application of Lora hooks to the conditioning, further customizing the conditioning process.

inputs.name: opt_timesteps
inputs.description: Optional timesteps conditioning, enabling temporal adjustments to the conditioning data.

outputs.name: conditioning
outputs.description: The modified conditioning data, reflecting the applied mask and adjustments, including any additional conditioning data added.

ADE_ConditioningSetMaskAndCombine.description: This node specializes in the advanced manipulation of conditioning data for generative models, specifically focusing on the application of masks, the combination of multiple conditioning inputs, and the adjustment of their influence through strength parameters. It enables the dynamic alteration and enhancement of conditioning inputs to tailor the generative process more precisely to desired outcomes.

inputs.name: cond
inputs.description: The original conditioning data to be modified or enhanced.

inputs.name: cond_ADD
inputs.description: Additional conditioning data to be combined with the original conditioning, allowing for the introduction of new elements or modifications.

inputs.name: strength
inputs.description: A scalar value that determines the intensity of the applied modifications or enhancements on the conditioning data.

inputs.name: set_cond_area
inputs.description: Specifies the area within the conditioning data that the modifications, such as masking or strength adjustments, should be applied to.

inputs.name: opt_mask
inputs.description: An optional mask that can be applied to the conditioning data to selectively modify or enhance specific regions.

inputs.name: opt_lora_hook
inputs.description: An optional hook for applying LoRA adjustments to the conditioning data, enabling more fine-grained control over the modifications.

inputs.name: opt_timesteps
inputs.description: Optional timesteps conditioning that allows for temporal adjustments to the conditioning data, useful in sequential generative processes.

outputs.name: conditioning
outputs.description: The resulting conditioning data after applying the specified modifications, combinations, and enhancements.

ADE_ConditioningSetUnmaskedAndCombine.description: This node specializes in the advanced manipulation of conditioning data for generative models, specifically focusing on unmasking and combining different sets of conditioning inputs. It enables the enhancement or modification of generative processes by applying sophisticated conditioning transformations.

inputs.name: cond
inputs.description: The primary conditioning input that serves as the base for transformations. It plays a crucial role in determining the initial state or context for the generative process.

inputs.name: cond_DEFAULT
inputs.description: An additional conditioning input intended to be combined with the primary conditioning input. This input typically represents default or supplementary information that modifies or enhances the base conditioning.

inputs.name: opt_lora_hook
inputs.description: An optional parameter that allows for the application of Lora hooks to the conditioning inputs, providing a mechanism for further customization and control over the conditioning process.

outputs.name: conditioning
outputs.description: The result of combining and unmasking the provided conditioning inputs, representing a modified or enhanced conditioning state for use in generative models.

ADE_CustomCFG.description: This node is designed for creating custom configuration settings for animation diffusion processes, allowing users to specify multiple values for configuration settings that influence the generation process.

inputs.name: cfg_multival
inputs.description: Specifies the multiple values for configuration settings, enabling fine-tuned control over the animation diffusion process.

outputs.name: custom_cfg
outputs.description: Outputs a custom configuration group, encapsulating the specified configuration settings for use in animation diffusion.

ADE_CustomCFGKeyframe.description: The ADE_CustomCFGKeyframe node is designed for creating and managing custom configuration keyframes within the Animate Diff framework. It allows for the specification of various animation parameters at different points in the animation timeline, enabling precise control over the animation's behavior and appearance.

inputs.name: cfg_multival
inputs.description: Defines the configuration value(s) for the keyframe, which can influence various aspects of the animation process. It's crucial for tailoring the animation's characteristics at specific timeline segments.

inputs.name: start_percent
inputs.description: Specifies the starting point of the keyframe within the animation timeline as a percentage, allowing for precise timing control.

inputs.name: guarantee_steps
inputs.description: Determines the minimum number of steps for which the keyframe's configuration will be applied, ensuring a certain duration of effect.

inputs.name: prev_custom_cfg
inputs.description: Allows for the chaining of custom configuration keyframes by specifying a previous custom configuration group, enabling complex animation sequences.

outputs.name: custom_cfg
outputs.description: Outputs a custom configuration object that encapsulates the defined keyframe, ready for integration into the animation pipeline.

ADE_EmptyLatentImageLarge.description: The ADE_EmptyLatentImageLarge node is designed to initialize a large latent image tensor with zeros. This tensor serves as a blank canvas for further generative processes, allowing for the creation and manipulation of images at a latent level.

inputs.name: width
inputs.description: Specifies the width of the latent image to be generated. It determines the horizontal dimension of the resulting tensor.

inputs.name: height
inputs.description: Determines the height of the latent image. It affects the vertical dimension of the resulting tensor.

inputs.name: batch_size
inputs.description: Controls the number of latent images to generate in a single batch. It influences the first dimension of the resulting tensor, allowing for batch processing of multiple images.

outputs.name: latent
outputs.description: The output is a tensor representing a batch of blank latent images. Each image is initialized with zeros, ready for subsequent generative modifications.

ADE_InjectI2VIntoAnimateDiffModel.description: This node is designed to inject an Image-to-Video (I2V) model into an existing AnimateDiff model, enhancing its capabilities with I2V features. It focuses on integrating specific I2V components into the AnimateDiff framework to enable or improve motion-based animations.

inputs.name: model_name
inputs.description: Specifies the name of the model to be loaded and modified. It is crucial for identifying the correct AnimateDiff model to which the I2V features will be added.

inputs.name: motion_model
inputs.description: Represents the motion model patcher object that will be modified to include I2V features. It is essential for applying the I2V enhancements to the specified AnimateDiff model.

inputs.name: ad_settings
inputs.description: Optional settings for the AnimateDiff model that can be adjusted during the I2V injection process. These settings allow for customization and fine-tuning of the model's behavior.

inputs.name: deprecation_warning
inputs.description: Provides a warning message about the experimental status of this node, indicating that it may not function as expected. This parameter allows for communication of potential risks to the user.

outputs.name: MOTION_MODEL
outputs.description: The modified AnimateDiff model with I2V features injected. This output represents the enhanced model ready for use in motion-based animations.

ADE_InjectPIAIntoAnimateDiffModel.description: This node is designed to integrate PIA (Pose Independent Animation) capabilities into an existing AnimateDiff model. By injecting PIA-specific convolutional inputs into the model, it enhances the model's ability to handle motion and animation with greater flexibility and precision, particularly in scenarios where pose independence is crucial.

inputs.name: model_name
inputs.description: Specifies the name of the motion model to be used. It is crucial for identifying the correct model within the available options, ensuring the node operates with the intended motion dynamics.

inputs.name: motion_model
inputs.description: Represents the motion model to be patched with PIA capabilities. This parameter is essential for the node to apply the necessary modifications to enable PIA features within the model.

inputs.name: ad_settings
inputs.description: Optional settings for AnimateDiff that can be applied during the PIA injection process. These settings allow for customization and fine-tuning of the animation and motion effects.

inputs.name: deprecation_warning
inputs.description: Provides a warning about the experimental status of the node, indicating that it may not function as expected.

outputs.name: MOTION_MODEL
outputs.description: The modified motion model with PIA capabilities injected. This output enables enhanced animation and motion handling, especially for pose-independent animations.

ADE_InputPIA_Multival.description: The node is designed to handle multiple values for PIA (Perceptual Image Annotation) inputs, allowing for the customization and fine-tuning of animation effects in the AnimateDiff framework. It facilitates the integration of varied intensity levels or parameters to influence the animation outcome.

inputs.name: multival
inputs.description: Specifies the intensity level or parameter value for the PIA input, affecting the animation's visual effects.

outputs.name: pia_input
outputs.description: Produces a PIA input object configured with the specified multival parameter, ready for use in animation processing.

ADE_InputPIA_PaperPresets.description: This node is designed to generate input parameters for the AnimateDiff-PIA model based on predefined paper presets. It allows users to select a preset configuration, which is then used to configure the AnimateDiff-PIA model for animation generation, providing a simplified way to apply complex animation effects.

inputs.name: preset
inputs.description: Specifies the preset configuration to use for the AnimateDiff-PIA model. Each preset corresponds to a predefined set of parameters that define specific animation effects.

inputs.name: batch_index
inputs.description: Determines the index of the batch for which the input is being generated. This is used to manage multiple animation inputs within a batch processing context.

inputs.name: mult_multival
inputs.description: An optional multiplier that can be applied to multiple values within the preset, allowing for further customization of the animation effect.

inputs.name: print_values
inputs.description: When set to True, the selected preset's parameters are logged, providing insight into the specific configuration being applied.

outputs.name: pia_input
outputs.description: Generates a configured input for the AnimateDiff-PIA model based on the selected paper preset.

ADE_IterationOptsDefault.description: This node provides the default iteration options for the AnimateDiff process, allowing users to configure the iteration parameters for their animation generation tasks.

inputs.name: iterations
inputs.description: Specifies the number of iterations to perform, affecting the depth of the animation generation process.

inputs.name: iter_batch_offset
inputs.description: Determines the starting offset for batch processing within the iterations, enabling fine-tuned control over the animation generation sequence.

inputs.name: iter_seed_offset
inputs.description: Sets the seed offset for iterations, offering a way to influence the randomness and variation in the generated animations.

outputs.name: iteration_opts
outputs.description: Outputs the configured iteration options, encapsulating the settings for the animation generation process.

ADE_IterationOptsFreeInit.description: This node is designed to create iteration options for the AnimateDiff process, allowing users to customize the iteration behavior through various settings such as iteration count, batch offset, and seed offset. It encapsulates the functionality to generate and configure iteration options dynamically, facilitating the customization of the animation diffusion process.

inputs.name: iterations
inputs.description: Specifies the number of iterations for the AnimateDiff process, directly influencing the depth and detail of the animation generation.

inputs.name: filter
inputs.description: Defines a filter to be applied during the iteration process, affecting the selection or modification of data.

inputs.name: d_s
inputs.description: Specifies the spatial distance parameter, influencing the spatial aspects of the animation.

inputs.name: d_t
inputs.description: Specifies the temporal distance parameter, affecting the temporal progression of the animation.

inputs.name: n_butterworth
inputs.description: Determines the order of the Butterworth filter applied in the process, impacting the smoothness of the animation.

inputs.name: sigma_step
inputs.description: Sets the step size for sigma adjustments, influencing the detail and quality of the animation.

inputs.name: apply_to_ist_iter
inputs.description: unknown

inputs.name: init_type
inputs.description: Specifies the initialization type for the iteration process, influencing the starting conditions of the animation.

inputs.name: iter_batch_offset
inputs.description: Determines the starting batch offset for iterations, enabling control over the batch processing sequence in the animation generation.

inputs.name: iter_seed_offset
inputs.description: Sets the seed offset for iterations, allowing for varied randomness in the animation generation process.

outputs.name: iteration_opts
outputs.description: The generated iteration options, encapsulating settings such as iteration count, batch offset, and seed offset for the AnimateDiff process.

ADE_LoadAnimateDiffModel.description: This node is designed to load the AnimateDiff model, facilitating the integration and application of motion models for animation purposes within the AnimateDiff framework. It serves as a foundational component in the animation pipeline, enabling users to leverage advanced animation techniques.

inputs.name: model_name
inputs.description: Specifies the name of the motion model to be loaded. This is a critical input as it determines which motion model will be utilized for animation within the AnimateDiff framework.

inputs.name: ad_settings
inputs.description: Optional parameter that allows for the inclusion of specific animation settings, providing additional customization and control over the animation process.

outputs.name: MOTION_MODEL
outputs.description: Outputs the loaded motion model, ready for further processing and application within the animation pipeline.

ADE_LoadAnimateDiffModelWithCameraCtrl.description: This node is designed to load an AnimateDiff model with integrated camera control capabilities, enabling the application of camera movements and adjustments directly within the AnimateDiff framework. It facilitates the incorporation of dynamic camera control parameters into the AnimateDiff model, enhancing the animation process with more sophisticated visual effects.

inputs.name: model_name
inputs.description: Specifies the name of the motion model to be loaded. It is crucial for identifying the specific AnimateDiff model to which camera control features will be added.

inputs.name: camera_ctrl
inputs.description: Defines the camera control parameters to be injected into the AnimateDiff model. This input is essential for customizing the camera movements and effects within the animation.

inputs.name: ad_settings
inputs.description: Optional settings for the AnimateDiff model that allow for further customization of the animation process.

outputs.name: MOTION_MODEL
outputs.description: The modified AnimateDiff model with integrated camera control capabilities, ready for animation tasks.

ADE_LoadAnimateLCMI2VModel.description: The ADE_LoadAnimateLCMI2VModel node is designed to load and prepare AnimateLCM-I2V motion models for animation processes. It ensures that the selected motion model is compatible with the AnimateLCM-I2V format and has an image encoder, facilitating the integration of motion models into the animation workflow.

inputs.name: model_name
inputs.description: Specifies the name of the motion model to be loaded, ensuring that the model is available and compatible with the AnimateLCM-I2V format.

inputs.name: ad_settings
inputs.description: Optional settings for the Animate Diff process that can be applied to the motion model, allowing for customization of the animation.

outputs.name: MOTION_MODEL
outputs.description: The loaded motion model, ready for use in animation processes.

outputs.name: encoder_only
outputs.description: A version of the motion model that only includes the encoder, useful for specific animation tasks.

ADE_LoadCameraPoses.description: The `ADE_LoadCameraPoses` node is designed to load camera control poses from a specified file, facilitating the manipulation and animation of camera positions within the Animate Diff framework. It serves as a foundational element in creating dynamic and complex camera movements for animation sequences.

inputs.name: pose_filename
inputs.description: Specifies the filename from which camera control poses are to be loaded. This filename should correspond to a file containing the desired camera poses, enabling the node to retrieve and utilize these poses for animation purposes.

outputs.name: cameractrl_poses
outputs.description: Outputs a list of camera control poses, which are structured as lists of floats representing the camera's position, orientation, and other relevant parameters in the animation context.

ADE_LoopedUniformContextOptions.description: This node is designed to generate looped uniform context options for animation difference (AnimateDiff) processes. It facilitates the creation of context configurations that enable seamless looping and uniform distribution of context frames, enhancing the continuity and uniformity of animations.

inputs.name: context_length
inputs.description: Specifies the total length of the context to be generated. It determines the number of frames or steps that will be included in the context, directly impacting the scope of the animation's continuity.

inputs.name: context_stride
inputs.description: Defines the stride or step size between each context frame in the looped uniform context. It affects how densely the frames are sampled, influencing the smoothness and granularity of the animation.

inputs.name: context_overlap
inputs.description: Determines the overlap between consecutive context frames in the looped uniform setup. This parameter helps in creating smoother transitions between frames by allowing them to share common elements.

inputs.name: closed_loop
inputs.description: A boolean flag indicating whether the context should form a closed loop, ensuring that the animation seamlessly loops back to the beginning.

inputs.name: fuse_method
inputs.description: Specifies the method used to fuse multiple context frames together, affecting the blending and transition between frames in the animation.

inputs.name: use_on_equal_length
inputs.description: A boolean flag that, when true, allows the context configuration to be applied even when the number of frames equals the context length, ensuring uniformity across all scenarios.

inputs.name: start_percent
inputs.description: Indicates the starting point of the animation as a percentage of the total length, allowing for precise control over the animation's initial frame.

inputs.name: guarantee_steps
inputs.description: Specifies the minimum number of steps or frames guaranteed to be included in the context, ensuring a baseline level of detail and continuity in the animation.

inputs.name: prev_context
inputs.description: An optional parameter that allows for the inclusion of previously defined context options, enabling the chaining and layering of context configurations for complex animations.

inputs.name: view_opts
inputs.description: Allows for the inclusion of view-specific options, further customizing the context configuration based on specific viewing parameters.

outputs.name: CONTEXT_OPTS
outputs.description: The generated looped uniform context options, ready to be applied to AnimateDiff processes for enhanced animation continuity and uniformity.

ADE_LoopedUniformViewOptions.description: This node is designed to create view options for generating looped uniform context options in the Animate Diff framework. It configures the parameters for view length, stride, overlap, and whether the loop is closed, alongside the method for fusing context and an option to use on equal length, to tailor the generation process.

inputs.name: view_length
inputs.description: Specifies the length of the view. It determines how many frames or units are considered in a single view, affecting the granularity of the animation.

inputs.name: view_stride
inputs.description: Defines the stride or step size between views. It affects how smoothly or rapidly the animation transitions between frames.

inputs.name: view_overlap
inputs.description: Sets the overlap between consecutive views, influencing the continuity and smoothness of the animation.

inputs.name: closed_loop
inputs.description: Indicates whether the animation should loop back to the beginning, creating a seamless loop effect.

inputs.name: fuse_method
inputs.description: Determines the method used to fuse multiple views or contexts together, impacting the overall animation style.

inputs.name: use_on_equal_length
inputs.description: A flag to specify if the view options should be applied even when the animation length matches the view length, affecting the animation's versatility.

outputs.name: view_opts
outputs.description: Produces the configured view options necessary for generating looped uniform context options within the Animate Diff framework.

ADE_LoraHookKeyframe.description: This node is designed to create a LoRA hook keyframe, which is a mechanism for adjusting the influence of LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation) hooks at specific points within an animation sequence. It allows for the dynamic scheduling of LoRA hooks' strength, enabling precise control over their effects throughout the animation process.

inputs.name: strength_model
inputs.description: Specifies the strength of the LoRA hook at the keyframe, influencing how strongly the hook will affect the model's behavior at this point in the animation.

inputs.name: start_percent
inputs.description: Determines the starting point of the keyframe's effect as a percentage of the total animation length, allowing for the timing of the LoRA hook's influence to be precisely controlled.

inputs.name: guarantee_steps
inputs.description: Guarantees a minimum number of steps for which the keyframe's effect will be applied, ensuring that the LoRA hook's influence is maintained for at least this duration.

inputs.name: prev_hook_kf
inputs.description: An optional previous LoRA hook keyframe group to which the new keyframe will be added, enabling the chaining of multiple keyframes for complex animation effects.

outputs.name: HOOK_KF
outputs.description: Returns a group of LoRA hook keyframes, including the newly created keyframe, facilitating the management and application of multiple keyframes within an animation.

ADE_LoraHookKeyframeFromStrengthList.description: This node is designed to create a sequence of LoRA hook keyframes based on a list of strengths, facilitating the dynamic adjustment of model behavior over a series of steps. It allows for the customization of keyframe properties such as strength and start percentage, enabling precise control over the animation or transformation process.

inputs.name: strengths_float
inputs.description: Specifies the strengths for each keyframe in the sequence. This parameter can accept either a single float value or a list of float values, allowing for flexibility in defining the intensity of each keyframe.

inputs.name: start_percent
inputs.description: Defines the starting percentage for the keyframe sequence, setting the initial point of the animation or transformation.

inputs.name: end_percent
inputs.description: Sets the ending percentage for the keyframe sequence, marking the final point of the animation or transformation.

inputs.name: print_keyframes
inputs.description: A boolean flag that, when enabled, prints the details of each keyframe to the log, aiding in debugging and visualization of the keyframe sequence.

inputs.name: prev_hook_kf
inputs.description: An optional parameter that allows for the continuation from a previous sequence of LoRA hook keyframes, enabling seamless transitions between sequences.

outputs.name: HOOK_KF
outputs.description: Returns a group of LoRA hook keyframes, representing the sequence of adjustments to be applied to the model.

ADE_LoraHookKeyframeInterpolation.description: This node is designed to create interpolated LoRA hook keyframes for animation conditioning, allowing for the dynamic adjustment of model behavior over a sequence of frames. It leverages interpolation techniques to generate a series of keyframes based on specified start and end percentages, strengths, and intervals, facilitating smooth transitions and precise control over the animation process.

inputs.name: start_percent
inputs.description: Defines the starting percentage of the animation sequence where the first keyframe is to be applied, influencing the initial point of model behavior adjustment.

inputs.name: end_percent
inputs.description: Specifies the ending percentage of the animation sequence, marking where the last keyframe's effect concludes, thus delineating the span of the interpolation.

inputs.name: strength_start
inputs.description: Sets the initial strength value for the first keyframe, determining the starting intensity of the model's behavior modification.

inputs.name: strength_end
inputs.description: Determines the final strength value for the last keyframe, defining the ending intensity of the model's behavior adjustment.

inputs.name: interpolation
inputs.description: Chooses the method of interpolation for generating intermediate strength values between keyframes, affecting the smoothness and progression of the animation.

inputs.name: intervals
inputs.description: Specifies the number of intervals (or keyframes) to generate between the start and end points, impacting the granularity of the animation conditioning.

inputs.name: print_keyframes
inputs.description: A flag to enable or disable printing of the generated keyframes for debugging or verification purposes.

inputs.name: prev_hook_kf
inputs.description: An optional parameter allowing for the inclusion of previously defined LoRA hook keyframes, enabling the extension or modification of an existing keyframe sequence.

outputs.name: HOOK_KF
outputs.description: The resulting sequence of interpolated LoRA hook keyframes, ready for use in animation conditioning.

ADE_MultivalConvertToMask.description: The ADE_MultivalConvertToMask node is designed to transform multivalued inputs into mask format, accommodating both single float values and tensors. This conversion facilitates the use of multivalued data as masks in various processing pipelines, ensuring compatibility and extending the utility of input data by converting it into a standardized mask format.

inputs.name: multival
inputs.description: The 'multival' input accepts either a single float value or a tensor, representing the multivalued data to be converted into a mask. This flexibility allows for a wide range of data types to be seamlessly integrated into mask-based workflows.

outputs.name: mask
outputs.description: The output is a mask, either directly utilizing the input tensor if already in an appropriate format, or creating a new mask with the specified value if a float is provided. This ensures that the output is always in a mask format, ready for further processing.

ADE_MultivalDynamic.description: The ADE_MultivalDynamic node is designed to dynamically handle multiple values within the AnimateDiff framework, enabling the flexible manipulation and application of various parameters across different aspects of the animation and diffusion process.

inputs.name: float_val
inputs.description: This parameter accepts a single float or a list of floats, representing the dynamic values to be manipulated within the AnimateDiff framework. It is crucial for defining the intensity or magnitude of effects applied in the animation process.

inputs.name: mask_optional
inputs.description: An optional mask input that allows for targeted application of effects, enabling precise control over which areas of the animation are affected by the specified dynamic values.

outputs.name: multival
outputs.description: This output is a dynamic representation of multiple values, tailored to influence various aspects of the animation and diffusion process within the AnimateDiff framework.

ADE_MultivalDynamicFloatInput.description: This node specializes in dynamically generating multivalued outputs based on floating-point inputs, optionally incorporating a mask. It is designed to facilitate the creation of nuanced, variable outputs in animation and differential processing contexts, where the precise control and modulation of values can significantly impact the resulting animations or transformations.

inputs.name: float_val
inputs.description: A primary floating-point value or a list of such values, serving as the core input for generating multivalued outputs. This parameter allows for fine-grained control over the output generation process, enabling customization and variability.

inputs.name: mask_optional
inputs.description: An optional mask input that can be used to modulate or restrict the application of the float_val across different areas, providing an additional layer of control and customization. It should be a tensor of a specific shape and data type, typically related to image processing masks.

outputs.name: multival
outputs.description: The output is a dynamically generated multivalued entity, tailored according to the provided floating-point values and optional mask, suitable for varied applications in animation and differential processing.

ADE_MultivalScaledMask.description: The ADE_MultivalScaledMask node is designed to dynamically adjust and scale the values of a mask based on specified minimum and maximum float values. It supports both absolute and relative scaling modes, allowing for flexible manipulation of mask values to fit various animation or image processing needs.

inputs.name: min_float_val
inputs.description: Specifies the minimum value (or a list of minimum values) to which the mask's values will be scaled. This parameter sets the lower bound of the scaling operation.

inputs.name: max_float_val
inputs.description: Defines the maximum value (or a list of maximum values) to which the mask's values will be scaled. It sets the upper bound for the scaling, ensuring the mask's values are adjusted within a specific range.

inputs.name: mask
inputs.description: The mask input represents the initial mask to be scaled. It is crucial for determining the base structure and values that will be adjusted according to the scaling parameters.

inputs.name: scaling
inputs.description: Determines the type of scaling to be applied: absolute or relative. This choice affects how the mask values are adjusted, either by directly setting new minimum and maximum values or by normalizing them within a range.

outputs.name: multival
outputs.description: The output is a dynamically adjusted version of the input mask, with its values scaled according to the specified minimum and maximum float values and the chosen scaling mode.

ADE_NoisedImageInjection.description: This node is designed to facilitate the injection of noised images into a generative model's sampling process. It enables the dynamic alteration of images by applying noise and other transformations based on specified parameters, thereby enhancing the diversity and creativity of the generated outputs. The node's functionality is pivotal for scenarios requiring the integration of pre-existing imagery with new generative elements, offering a blend of precision and artistic freedom in the creation process.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The original image to be injected with noise and potentially other transformations. It serves as the base for the injection process, influencing the final output by providing the initial visual context.

inputs.name: vae
inputs.description: A variational autoencoder used for encoding and decoding images during the injection process. It plays a crucial role in ensuring that the injected images are compatible with the model's latent space, facilitating seamless integration.

inputs.name: mask_opt
inputs.description: An optional mask that specifies areas of the image to be affected by the injection process. It allows for targeted alterations, enhancing the precision of the injection.

inputs.name: invert_mask
inputs.description: A boolean flag that, when true, inverts the mask's effect, targeting the injection process to areas outside the mask.

inputs.name: resize_image
inputs.description: A boolean flag indicating whether the image should be resized as part of the injection process. This can be crucial for matching the dimensions expected by the model.

inputs.name: start_percent
inputs.description: Specifies the starting point of the injection process as a percentage of the total steps, allowing for timed or phased injections.

inputs.name: guarantee_steps
inputs.description: The minimum number of steps for which the injection will be applied, ensuring a certain level of impact from the injection.

inputs.name: img_inject_opts
inputs.description: Options for fine-tuning the injection process, such as positioning of the injected image.

inputs.name: strength_multival
inputs.description: A multiplier for the injection strength, allowing for adjustments in the intensity of the applied noise or transformations.

inputs.name: prev_image_inject
inputs.description: The previous group of injected images, enabling sequential and cumulative injections over multiple steps.

outputs.name: image_inject
outputs.description: The updated group of injected images, including the newly injected image. This output facilitates sequential image injections, allowing for cumulative alterations over multiple steps.

ADE_NoisedImageInjectOptions.description: This node is designed to create and configure options for injecting noised images into an animation sequence. It allows for the specification of positional adjustments for the injected images, enabling precise control over their placement within the animation frames.

inputs.name: composite_x
inputs.description: Specifies the horizontal position offset for the image injection. This allows for fine-tuning the placement of the injected image within the frame.

inputs.name: composite_y
inputs.description: Specifies the vertical position offset for the image injection. This enables precise vertical alignment of the injected image within the animation frame.

outputs.name: IMG_INJECT_OPTS
outputs.description: Returns an instance of NoisedImageInjectOptions configured with the specified positional adjustments. This object is used to control the placement of noised images in the animation sequence.

ADE_NoiseLayerAdd.description: The `ADE_NoiseLayerAdd` node is designed to integrate an additive noise layer into a given noise structure, enhancing the variability and complexity of the noise pattern. This node facilitates the dynamic adjustment of noise characteristics in generative models, allowing for more nuanced and controlled modifications to the generated outputs.

inputs.name: batch_offset
inputs.description: Specifies the offset for batch processing, affecting how noise is applied across different batches, thereby enabling more precise control over the noise application process.

inputs.name: noise_type
inputs.description: Defines the type of noise to be added, determining the characteristics and behavior of the noise layer within the generative process.

inputs.name: seed_gen_override
inputs.description: Allows for the override of the default seed generation mechanism, enabling custom seed generation strategies for noise creation.

inputs.name: seed_offset
inputs.description: Provides an additional offset to the seed value, further customizing the noise generation process for enhanced variability.

inputs.name: noise_weight
inputs.description: Determines the weight of the added noise, influencing the intensity and impact of the noise on the final output.

inputs.name: prev_noise_layers
inputs.description: Optional parameter to specify previous noise layers, enabling the stacking and combination of multiple noise layers for complex noise structures.

inputs.name: mask_optional
inputs.description: An optional mask to selectively apply noise, allowing for targeted noise application in specific areas of interest.

inputs.name: seed_override
inputs.description: Optionally overrides the seed used for noise generation, providing direct control over the randomness of the noise.

outputs.name: noise_layers
outputs.description: Returns the updated noise layer group, including the newly added additive noise layer, facilitating the construction of layered noise structures.

ADE_NoiseLayerAddWeighted.description: The ADE_NoiseLayerAddWeighted node specializes in enhancing the noise layering process by applying a weighted addition of noise to an existing noise layer. It leverages a balance multiplier to fine-tune the impact of new noise on the existing noise structure, aiming to achieve a more controlled and nuanced noise integration.

inputs.name: batch_offset
inputs.description: Specifies the offset for batch processing, affecting how noise is applied across different batches.

inputs.name: noise_type
inputs.description: Defines the type of noise to be added, influencing the characteristics of the noise applied.

inputs.name: seed_gen_override
inputs.description: Allows for overriding the default seed generation mechanism, enabling custom noise generation patterns.

inputs.name: seed_offset
inputs.description: Determines the offset applied to the seed value, facilitating varied noise generation outcomes.

inputs.name: noise_weight
inputs.description: Controls the weight of the new noise being added, allowing for adjustment of the noise's influence on the existing layer.

inputs.name: balance_multiplier
inputs.description: Adjusts the balance between the old and new noise, fine-tuning the overall effect of noise addition.

inputs.name: prev_noise_layers
inputs.description: Represents the previous state of noise layers, enabling sequential layering of noise for complex effects.

inputs.name: mask_optional
inputs.description: An optional mask that can be applied to selectively influence the noise addition process, providing further control over the noise characteristics.

inputs.name: seed_override
inputs.description: Provides an option to override the seed value used for noise generation, offering control over the randomness aspect.

outputs.name: noise_layers
outputs.description: Outputs the updated noise layer group after the addition of the weighted noise layer, reflecting the new state of noise layering.

ADE_NoiseLayerReplace.description: This node is designed to replace specific noise layers within an animation or image generation process, allowing for the customization of noise patterns by overlaying new noise on top of existing noise based on a mask. It facilitates the creation of varied visual textures and effects by selectively modifying the noise characteristics.

inputs.name: batch_offset
inputs.description: Determines the offset for batch processing, affecting how noise patterns are applied across different items in a batch.

inputs.name: noise_type
inputs.description: Specifies the type of noise to be used in the replacement process, influencing the visual texture and characteristics of the output.

inputs.name: seed_gen_override
inputs.description: Overrides the default seed generator, allowing for custom seed generation strategies that can affect the randomness and distribution of the noise.

inputs.name: seed_offset
inputs.description: Applies an additional offset to the seed value, further customizing the randomness of the noise generation.

inputs.name: prev_noise_layers
inputs.description: Specifies the previous configuration of noise layers to be modified, allowing for the integration of the new noise layer into the existing sequence.

inputs.name: mask_optional
inputs.description: Defines a mask to control where the noise is replaced, enabling selective application of new noise patterns on specific areas.

inputs.name: seed_override
inputs.description: Directly specifies a seed value, overriding any automatic seed generation for precise control over the noise pattern.

outputs.name: noise_layers
outputs.description: Returns the modified noise layer configuration, incorporating the newly replaced noise layer for subsequent processing.

ADE_PairedConditioningSetMask.description: The ADE_PairedConditioningSetMask node is designed to apply masking and conditioning adjustments to a pair of conditioning inputs. It utilizes additional parameters such as strength, set condition area, and optional elements like masks, Lora hooks, and timestep conditions to fine-tune the conditioning process, aiming to enhance or modify the generated content's attributes according to the specified adjustments.

inputs.name: positive_ADD
inputs.description: Specifies the positive conditioning input to be adjusted. It plays a crucial role in defining the attributes or features to be enhanced or modified in the generated content.

inputs.name: negative_ADD
inputs.description: Specifies the negative conditioning input to be adjusted. It is essential for defining the attributes or features to be diminished or altered in the opposite manner to the positive conditioning.

inputs.name: strength
inputs.description: Determines the intensity of the conditioning adjustment. A higher value indicates a stronger effect on the conditioning inputs.

inputs.name: set_cond_area
inputs.description: Defines the area of the conditioning inputs to be affected by the adjustments. It allows for targeted modifications within the conditioning inputs.

inputs.name: opt_mask
inputs.description: An optional mask that can be applied to the conditioning inputs for more precise adjustments.

inputs.name: opt_lora_hook
inputs.description: An optional Lora hook that can be applied for additional conditioning transformations.

inputs.name: opt_timesteps
inputs.description: Optional timesteps condition that allows for temporal adjustments to the conditioning inputs.

outputs.name: positive
outputs.description: The adjusted positive conditioning output after applying the specified adjustments.

outputs.name: negative
outputs.description: The adjusted negative conditioning output after applying the specified adjustments.

ADE_PairedConditioningSetMaskAndCombine.description: This node specializes in the advanced manipulation of paired conditioning data for generative models, focusing on the application and combination of masks and additional conditioning layers. It enables the enhancement or modification of existing conditioning through the application of masks, strength adjustments, and the integration of new conditioning elements, thereby facilitating more precise control over the generative process.

inputs.name: positive
inputs.description: The original positive conditioning data to be enhanced or modified.

inputs.name: negative
inputs.description: The original negative conditioning data to be enhanced or modified.

inputs.name: positive_ADD
inputs.description: The additional positive conditioning data to be combined with the original.

inputs.name: negative_ADD
inputs.description: The additional negative conditioning data to be combined with the original.

inputs.name: strength
inputs.description: A parameter defining the intensity of the mask or conditioning modification.

inputs.name: set_cond_area
inputs.description: Specifies the area of conditioning to which the mask or modifications are applied.

inputs.name: opt_mask
inputs.description: An optional mask to apply to the conditioning data for selective modification.

inputs.name: opt_lora_hook
inputs.description: An optional parameter allowing the application of Lora hooks to the conditioning data, providing an additional layer of transformation or control.

inputs.name: opt_timesteps
inputs.description: Optional timesteps for conditioning, allowing for temporal adjustments.

outputs.name: positive
outputs.description: The enhanced or modified positive conditioning data after applying masks, strength adjustments, and combining with additional conditioning.

outputs.name: negative
outputs.description: The enhanced or modified negative conditioning data after applying masks, strength adjustments, and combining with additional conditioning.

ADE_PairedConditioningSetUnmaskedAndComb.description: This node is designed to process and combine pairs of conditioning inputs, applying unmasking and optional transformations through LoRA hooks. It focuses on integrating default or baseline conditionings with current ones to prepare them for further processing or generation tasks, enhancing the flexibility and control over the conditioning process.

inputs.name: positive
inputs.description: The current positive conditioning input to be combined with its default counterpart.

inputs.name: negative
inputs.description: The current negative conditioning input to be combined with its default counterpart.

inputs.name: positive_DEFAULT
inputs.description: The default positive conditioning input to be combined with the current positive conditioning.

inputs.name: negative_DEFAULT
inputs.description: The default negative conditioning input to be combined with the current negative conditioning.

inputs.name: opt_lora_hook
inputs.description: An optional LoRA hook to apply transformations to the conditioning inputs before combining them.

outputs.name: positive
outputs.description: The combined positive conditioning output after integrating the current and default inputs.

outputs.name: negative
outputs.description: The combined negative conditioning output after integrating the current and default inputs.

ADE_PIA_AnimateDiffKeyframe.description: This node is designed for creating and managing keyframes within the AnimateDiff-PIA framework, specifically tailored for PIA (Pose Interpolation Animation) inputs. It facilitates the dynamic adjustment of animation parameters over time, enabling users to define specific animation behaviors at different points in the animation sequence.

inputs.name: start_percent
inputs.description: Specifies the starting point of the keyframe as a percentage of the total animation duration, allowing for precise timing control within the animation sequence.

inputs.name: prev_ad_keyframes
inputs.description: An optional list of previous ADKeyframes to be considered in the animation sequence, enabling the chaining and layering of animation effects.

inputs.name: scale_multival
inputs.description: A multiplier for scaling effects, applicable to the keyframe. It can be a single value or vary over time if provided as a tensor. This input directly influences the visual scale of animated elements, affecting the node's execution by adjusting the size of elements within the keyframe.

inputs.name: effect_multival
inputs.description: A multiplier for effect intensities, applicable to the keyframe. It can be a single value or vary over time if provided as a tensor. This input modifies the intensity of specified effects in the animation, impacting the node's execution by altering how pronounced these effects are within the keyframe.

inputs.name: pia_input
inputs.description: Specifies the PIA input settings for the keyframe, allowing for detailed control over the animation's pose interpolation aspects.

inputs.name: inherit_missing
inputs.description: Determines whether missing values for scale, effect, and camera control effects should be inherited from previous keyframes, ensuring continuity in the animation.

inputs.name: guarantee_steps
inputs.description: The minimum number of steps to guarantee for the keyframe, ensuring that certain animation effects are applied for at least a specified duration.

outputs.name: ad_keyframes
outputs.description: Outputs a sequence of ADKeyframes, incorporating the newly created or modified keyframe into the animation sequence.

ADE_RawSigmaSchedule.description: This node is designed to generate a sigma schedule based on a given beta schedule. It translates the beta schedule into a sigma schedule, which is essential for controlling the noise levels in diffusion models, particularly in the context of animation and image synthesis.

inputs.name: raw_beta_schedule
inputs.description: Specifies the beta schedule to be converted into a sigma schedule. This parameter is crucial for determining the progression and intensity of noise levels throughout the diffusion process.

inputs.name: linear_start
inputs.description: Defines the starting point of the linear interpolation used in the sigma schedule generation. It affects the initial noise level in the diffusion process.

inputs.name: linear_end
inputs.description: Sets the endpoint for the linear interpolation in the sigma schedule, influencing the final noise level in the diffusion process.

inputs.name: sampling
inputs.description: Determines the sampling method to be used in the sigma schedule, affecting how the noise levels are interpolated and applied. The type 'ModelSamplingType' should be understood as a placeholder for the actual sampling method chosen.

inputs.name: lcm_original_timesteps
inputs.description: Specifies the number of original timesteps to be considered when using LCM sampling, impacting the granularity of the sigma schedule.

inputs.name: lcm_zsnr
inputs.description: A boolean flag indicating whether to apply Zero-SNR (zSNR) adjustments to the sigma schedule, enhancing the schedule's compatibility with certain diffusion processes.

outputs.name: sigma_schedule
outputs.description: The generated sigma schedule, which outlines the specific noise levels to be applied at each step of the diffusion process.

ADE_RegisterLoraHook.description: This node is designed to register LoRA hooks within the AnimateDiff framework, enabling the dynamic modification of model behavior for enhanced animation and image manipulation capabilities.

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: The model to which LoRA hooks will be applied, serving as the foundation for dynamic behavior modification.

inputs.name: clip
inputs.description: The CLIP model that may be optionally modified alongside the primary model, allowing for synchronized adjustments.

inputs.name: lora_name
inputs.description: The identifier for the specific LoRA hook to be applied, determining the nature of the behavior modification.

inputs.name: strength_model
inputs.description: Defines the intensity of the LoRA hook's effect on the model, allowing for fine-tuned control over behavior modification.

inputs.name: strength_clip
inputs.description: Specifies the intensity of the LoRA hook's effect on the CLIP model, enabling precise adjustments to its behavior.

outputs.name: model
outputs.description: The model with the LoRA hook applied, ready for enhanced animation and image manipulation tasks.

outputs.name: clip
outputs.description: The optionally modified CLIP model, adjusted in tandem with the primary model for synchronized enhancements.

outputs.name: lora_hook
outputs.description: The registered LoRA hook, encapsulating the specified modifications for application to the model.

ADE_RegisterLoraHookModelOnly.description: This node is designed to register a model as a LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation) hook, focusing exclusively on the model without involving any CLIP models. It enables the modification and enhancement of a model's behavior through LoRA techniques, providing a streamlined approach for integrating LoRA hooks into models for advanced customization and performance tuning.

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: The model to be registered with the LoRA hook. It is the primary target for the LoRA adaptation, determining the scope and impact of the applied modifications.

inputs.name: lora_name
inputs.description: The name of the LoRA configuration to apply. This specifies the particular LoRA adaptation settings and parameters to be used, guiding the customization process.

inputs.name: strength_model
inputs.description: A floating-point value indicating the strength of the LoRA adaptation on the model. This parameter controls the intensity of the applied LoRA modifications, allowing for fine-tuned adjustments to the model's behavior.

outputs.name: model
outputs.description: The model after being registered with the LoRA hook. This output reflects the modified state of the model, showcasing the effects of the LoRA adaptation.

outputs.name: lora_hook
outputs.description: The LoRA hook that has been registered with the model. This output represents the LoRA adaptation mechanism applied, facilitating further customization and performance tuning.

ADE_RegisterModelAsLoraHook.description: This node is designed to register a model as a LoRA hook within the AnimateDiff framework, enabling dynamic modification and control of model behavior during the generation process. It facilitates the integration of LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation) techniques with models, allowing for enhanced customization and fine-tuning of model outputs based on specific conditions or inputs.

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: The model parameter represents the target model to which the LoRA hook will be applied. It is crucial for defining the scope and context of the LoRA adaptation, affecting how the model's behavior is modified during the generation process.

inputs.name: clip
inputs.description: The clip parameter specifies the CLIP model involved in the process, if any, providing context for where LoRA adaptations may be applied alongside the primary model.

inputs.name: ckpt_name
inputs.description: The ckpt_name parameter indicates the checkpoint name for loading the model's state, essential for initializing the model with specific pre-trained weights or configurations.

inputs.name: strength_model
inputs.description: This parameter controls the intensity of the LoRA modifications applied to the model. It allows for fine-tuning the impact of LoRA on the model's behavior, enabling precise adjustments to the generation process.

inputs.name: strength_clip
inputs.description: Similar to strength_model, this parameter adjusts the intensity of LoRA modifications but specifically for the CLIP model involved in the process. It enables separate control over the adaptation strength for different components of the generation framework.

outputs.name: model
outputs.description: The model with LoRA hooks applied, reflecting the dynamic adaptations specified through the input parameters.

outputs.name: clip
outputs.description: The CLIP model with LoRA hooks applied, if a CLIP model was involved in the process. It indicates the application of LoRA modifications to the CLIP component.

outputs.name: lora_hook
outputs.description: The LoRA hook that has been registered and applied to the model and/or CLIP, encapsulating the specific adaptations made.

ADE_RegisterModelAsLoraHookModelOnly.description: This node specializes in registering a model as a LoRA hook with a focus on model-only modifications. It enables the integration of LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation) techniques into a specific model, enhancing its adaptability and performance for specific tasks without affecting other components.

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: The model to be adapted using LoRA techniques. It serves as the primary target for the application of low-rank adaptations, aiming to enhance its performance or adaptability for specific tasks.

inputs.name: ckpt_name
inputs.description: The name of the checkpoint to apply LoRA configurations from. This parameter specifies which set of LoRA adaptations to use, guiding the customization of the model's behavior.

inputs.name: strength_model
inputs.description: A floating-point value that determines the intensity of the LoRA adaptation on the model. It modulates how significantly the LoRA parameters influence the model's behavior.

outputs.name: model
outputs.description: The model after applying the specified LoRA adaptations. This output reflects the enhanced or customized version of the model, tailored through the LoRA technique.

outputs.name: lora_hook
outputs.description: A reference to the LoRA hook that has been integrated into the model. This output provides access to the LoRA adaptations applied, facilitating further manipulations or analyses.

ADE_ReplaceCameraParameters.description: The node is designed to modify camera control parameters within an animation or image processing pipeline, allowing for the adjustment of camera poses based on predefined or dynamically generated criteria. This functionality is crucial for achieving desired visual effects, perspectives, or animations that require specific camera orientations or movements.

inputs.name: poses
inputs.description: This parameter represents the camera poses to be modified. It plays a crucial role in determining the final output by specifying the initial camera positions and orientations that are subject to adjustment.

inputs.name: fx
inputs.description: The focal length of the camera in the x-axis. Adjusting this parameter affects the camera's field of view along the x-axis, influencing the perspective and scale of the rendered scene.

inputs.name: fy
inputs.description: The focal length of the camera in the y-axis. Similar to 'fx', this parameter modifies the field of view but along the y-axis, impacting how the scene's depth and height are perceived.

inputs.name: cx
inputs.description: The x-coordinate of the camera's optical center. Altering this value shifts the scene's center point horizontally, which can be used to correct or achieve certain visual effects.

inputs.name: cy
inputs.description: The y-coordinate of the camera's optical center. This parameter shifts the scene's center vertically, enabling adjustments to the vertical alignment or to simulate camera tilt effects.

outputs.name: cameractrl_poses
outputs.description: The modified camera poses after applying the new camera parameters. This output is essential for downstream processes that rely on updated camera orientations for rendering or further processing.

ADE_ReplaceOriginalPoseAspectRatio.description: This node is designed to adjust the aspect ratio of original poses within the AnimateDiff framework, specifically for camera control applications. It modifies the dimensions of poses to match a new aspect ratio, ensuring that animations and visual effects are accurately rendered according to the desired spatial dimensions.

inputs.name: poses
inputs.description: The list of poses to be adjusted. Each pose is a list of floats representing the spatial and rotational parameters of a camera control point.

inputs.name: orig_pose_width
inputs.description: The original width of the pose, which will be used to calculate the new aspect ratio.

inputs.name: orig_pose_height
inputs.description: The original height of the pose, which will be used to calculate the new aspect ratio.

outputs.name: cameractrl_poses
outputs.description: The adjusted poses with the new aspect ratio applied, ready for further processing or animation within the AnimateDiff framework.

ADE_SetLoraHookKeyframe.description: This node is designed to assign a set of LoRA hook keyframes to a specific LoRA hook group. It enables the customization and dynamic adjustment of LoRA hook behaviors over the animation timeline, facilitating precise control over the model's response at different stages of the animation process.

inputs.name: lora_hook
inputs.description: The LoRA hook group to which the keyframes will be applied. This parameter is crucial for identifying the target group of hooks that will receive the new keyframe settings.

inputs.name: hook_kf
inputs.description: The set of LoRA hook keyframes to be assigned to the specified LoRA hook group. This parameter defines the timing, strength, and other characteristics of the LoRA hooks over the animation timeline.

outputs.name: lora_hook
outputs.description: The updated LoRA hook group with the new set of keyframes applied. This output reflects the changes made to the LoRA hooks, incorporating the specified keyframe settings.

ADE_SigmaSchedule.description: The ADE_SigmaSchedule node is designed to generate a sigma schedule based on a given beta schedule. It abstracts the complexity of sigma schedule creation, offering a straightforward way to obtain a sigma schedule tailored to specific model sampling types and configurations.

inputs.name: beta_schedule
inputs.description: Specifies the beta schedule to be used for generating the sigma schedule. This parameter is crucial as it determines the base configuration from which the sigma schedule will be derived.

outputs.name: sigma_schedule
outputs.description: Outputs a sigma schedule object, which is essential for defining the progression of noise levels in diffusion-based generative models.

ADE_SigmaScheduleSplitAndCombine.description: This node is designed to manipulate sigma schedules by splitting and combining them based on specified weights and interpolation methods. It enables the creation of new sigma schedules that are hybrids of two input schedules, allowing for customized progression of sigma values over time.

inputs.name: schedule_Start
inputs.description: The starting sigma schedule for the split and combination process, determining the initial segment of the new sigma schedule.

inputs.name: schedule_End
inputs.description: The ending sigma schedule for the split and combination process, influencing the latter segment of the new sigma schedule.

inputs.name: idx_split_percent
inputs.description: The percentage at which the initial sigma schedule is split, dictating the point of transition between the two schedules.

outputs.name: sigma_schedule
outputs.description: The resulting sigma schedule, a hybrid of the starting and ending input schedules modified according to the specified split percentage.

ADE_SigmaScheduleWeightedAverage.description: This node is designed to create a new sigma schedule by calculating a weighted average of two provided sigma schedules. It allows for the blending of characteristics from both schedules into a single, new schedule based on a specified weighting factor.

inputs.name: schedule_A
inputs.description: The first sigma schedule to be blended. It serves as one of the bases for the weighted average calculation.

inputs.name: schedule_B
inputs.description: The second sigma schedule to be blended with the first. It contributes to the weighted average calculation, complementing the first schedule.

inputs.name: weight_A
inputs.description: The weighting factor for the first sigma schedule. This determines the proportion of the first schedule's characteristics in the final blended schedule.

outputs.name: sigma_schedule
outputs.description: The resulting sigma schedule after blending the two input schedules based on the specified weighting factor.

ADE_SigmaScheduleWeightedAverageInterp.description: This node is designed to create a new sigma schedule by interpolating between two given sigma schedules based on a specified weight range and interpolation method. It effectively blends the characteristics of both input schedules into a single, new schedule, allowing for dynamic adjustments in the diffusion process.

inputs.name: schedule_A
inputs.description: The first sigma schedule to be interpolated.

inputs.name: schedule_B
inputs.description: The second sigma schedule to be interpolated.

inputs.name: weight_A_Start
inputs.description: The starting weight for the first sigma schedule in the interpolation.

inputs.name: weight_A_End
inputs.description: The ending weight for the first sigma schedule in the interpolation.

inputs.name: interpolation
inputs.description: The method of interpolation to be used for blending the sigma schedules.

outputs.name: sigma_schedule
outputs.description: The resulting sigma schedule after interpolation.

ADE_StandardStaticContextOptions.description: This node is designed to generate a set of static context options for the Animate Diff process, providing a standardized configuration for animation generation.

inputs.name: context_length
inputs.description: Specifies the length of the context to be used in the animation, determining how many frames or steps are considered for each segment of the animation.

inputs.name: context_overlap
inputs.description: Defines the overlap between consecutive contexts in the animation, affecting the smoothness and continuity between frames.

inputs.name: fuse_method
inputs.description: Determines the method used to fuse multiple contexts together, influencing the final animation's fluidity and coherence.

inputs.name: use_on_equal_length
inputs.description: A boolean flag that specifies whether to use the fuse method when contexts are of equal length, affecting the animation's uniformity.

inputs.name: start_percent
inputs.description: Defines the starting point of the animation as a percentage, allowing for customization of where the animation begins within the provided context.

inputs.name: guarantee_steps
inputs.description: Ensures a minimum number of steps or frames in the animation, providing a baseline for animation smoothness and continuity.

inputs.name: prev_context
inputs.description: Allows for the integration of previously defined context options, enabling the chaining or layering of context configurations for complex animations.

inputs.name: view_opts
inputs.description: Specifies view options for the animation, offering additional customization for how the animation is rendered and displayed.

outputs.name: CONTEXT_OPTS
outputs.description: Outputs a configured set of context options tailored for static animation scenarios, ready for use in the Animate Diff process.

ADE_StandardStaticViewOptions.description: This node is designed to create static view options for the Animate Diff process, allowing for the customization of view length and overlap with optional fuse method adjustments.

inputs.name: view_length
inputs.description: Specifies the length of the view, affecting the granularity of the animation frames.

inputs.name: view_overlap
inputs.description: Determines the overlap between consecutive views, influencing the smoothness of the animation transition.

inputs.name: fuse_method
inputs.description: Optional parameter that defines the method for fusing context, offering flexibility in the animation's visual continuity.

outputs.name: view_opts
outputs.description: Outputs the configured view options, ready to be utilized in the Animate Diff process.

ADE_StandardUniformContextOptions.description: This node is designed to create a uniform set of context options for animation difference processing, allowing for the customization of context length, start percentage, and guaranteed steps within the animation sequence. It supports the integration of previous context configurations to build upon existing settings.

inputs.name: context_length
inputs.description: Specifies the length of the context for the animation difference processing, influencing the granularity and scope of the animation sequence.

inputs.name: context_stride
inputs.description: Determines the stride between each context in the sequence, affecting the overlap and transition smoothness between animation frames.

inputs.name: context_overlap
inputs.description: Defines the amount of overlap between contexts, which can influence the continuity and smoothness of the animation.

inputs.name: fuse_method
inputs.description: Specifies the method used to fuse multiple contexts together, impacting the final animation's visual coherence.

inputs.name: use_on_equal_length
inputs.description: Indicates whether the context options should be applied uniformly across animations of equal length, affecting consistency in animation processing.

inputs.name: start_percent
inputs.description: Determines the starting point of the animation as a percentage, allowing for precise control over the initiation of the animation sequence.

inputs.name: guarantee_steps
inputs.description: Defines the minimum number of steps guaranteed within the animation, ensuring a certain level of detail and smoothness in the animation sequence.

inputs.name: prev_context
inputs.description: Allows for the inclusion of previous context configurations, enabling the accumulation and refinement of context settings over time.

inputs.name: view_opts
inputs.description: Allows for the specification of view options, further customizing the context configuration for animation processing.

outputs.name: CONTEXT_OPTS
outputs.description: Produces a set of context options tailored for uniform animation difference processing, encapsulating the specified configurations.

ADE_StandardUniformViewOptions.description: This node is designed to create and configure view options for generating animations with uniform distribution. It allows for the customization of view length, stride, and overlap, along with the method of fusing context, to tailor the animation generation process.

inputs.name: view_length
inputs.description: Specifies the length of the view, affecting the granularity and extent of the animation frames generated.

inputs.name: view_stride
inputs.description: Determines the stride between views, influencing the smoothness and speed of the animation.

inputs.name: view_overlap
inputs.description: Sets the overlap between views, which can help in creating smoother transitions between animation frames.

inputs.name: fuse_method
inputs.description: Defines the method used to fuse multiple contexts together, impacting the continuity and coherence of the animation.

outputs.name: view_opts
outputs.description: Produces the configured view options, ready to be utilized in the animation generation process.

ADE_TimestepsConditioning.description: The node focuses on adjusting the timing for applying specific conditions within the animation or diffusion process, allowing for precise control over when certain effects or modifications are introduced based on the progression of the animation. This enables a more dynamic and nuanced application of conditions, enhancing the overall quality and flexibility of the generated content.

inputs.name: start_percent
inputs.description: Specifies the starting point (as a percentage of the total animation length) for applying the given conditions, allowing for precise timing control.

inputs.name: end_percent
inputs.description: Defines the ending point (as a percentage of the total animation length) for the application of conditions, enabling the tailoring of effects to specific phases of the animation.

outputs.name: timesteps_cond
outputs.description: The timing adjustments for conditions, encapsulated as a specific type that represents the scheduling of conditions throughout the animation or diffusion process.

ADE_UpscaleAndVAEEncode.description: The ADE_UpscaleAndVAEEncode node is designed for processing images by first upscaling them to a higher resolution and then encoding them into a latent representation using a Variational Autoencoder (VAE). This node is part of the AnimateDiff suite, specifically tailored for enhancing image quality before applying further generative or transformational processes.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The 'image' parameter represents the input image to be upscaled and encoded. It plays a crucial role in determining the quality and resolution of the final latent representation.

inputs.name: vae
inputs.description: The 'vae' parameter specifies the Variational Autoencoder model used for encoding the upscaled image into its latent representation. It affects the encoding efficiency and the quality of the generated latent space.

inputs.name: latent_size
inputs.description: The 'latent_size' parameter indicates the size of the latent representation to be generated. It determines the dimensions of the output latent space.

inputs.name: scale_method
inputs.description: The 'scale_method' parameter defines the method used for upscaling the image. It influences the quality of the upscaled image.

inputs.name: crop
inputs.description: The 'crop' parameter specifies the cropping method applied after upscaling, affecting the final image composition.

outputs.name: latent
outputs.description: The output is a latent representation of the input image, encoded by the VAE after upscaling. It captures the essential features of the image in a compressed form, suitable for further generative tasks.

ADE_UseEvolvedSampling.description: The ADE_UseEvolvedSampling node integrates advanced sampling techniques into the animation diffusion process, leveraging evolved model sampling configurations to enhance the quality and efficiency of generated animations. It adapts the sampling process based on model configurations and dynamic conditions, aiming to optimize the animation output with respect to visual fidelity and computational performance.

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: Specifies the model to be used in the animation diffusion process, affecting the overall quality and characteristics of the generated animations.

inputs.name: beta_schedule
inputs.description: Determines the beta schedule to be applied during the sampling process, influencing the smoothness and quality of the animation transitions.

inputs.name: m_models
inputs.description: Optional. Provides additional models for consideration in the animation process, potentially enhancing the diversity and richness of the output.

inputs.name: context_options
inputs.description: Optional. Defines context-specific options that can modify the behavior of the sampling process, tailoring it to specific requirements or preferences.

inputs.name: sample_settings
inputs.description: Optional. Specifies settings related to the sampling process, such as resolution and temporal adjustments, directly impacting the animation's visual quality.

outputs.name: model
outputs.description: The enhanced model instance, equipped with evolved sampling configurations for improved animation diffusion.

ADE_ViewsOnlyContextOptions.description: This node is designed to create context options specifically tailored for viewing animations, incorporating parameters such as start percentage and guarantee steps to customize the animation's initiation and progression.

inputs.name: view_opts_req
inputs.description: Specifies the required view options to tailor the context for viewing animations, ensuring the animation's parameters are set according to the provided view options.

inputs.name: start_percent
inputs.description: Determines the starting point of the animation as a percentage, allowing for precise control over where the animation begins.

inputs.name: guarantee_steps
inputs.description: Specifies the minimum number of steps guaranteed in the animation, ensuring a certain length and progression.

inputs.name: prev_context
inputs.description: Allows for the inclusion of previous context options, enabling the chaining or layering of context configurations for complex animations.

outputs.name: CONTEXT_OPTS
outputs.description: Provides the modified context options group, enriched with the newly created context options for viewing animations.

AnimateDiffLoaderV1.description: This node is responsible for loading the AnimateDiff model version 1, facilitating the initialization and setup of the model for animation and image manipulation tasks. It is marked as deprecated, indicating that newer versions or methods are recommended for use. The node is deprecated, suggesting a transition to more current methodologies or versions for optimal performance.

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: Specifies the model to be loaded for animation and image manipulation tasks, central to the node's operation.

inputs.name: latents
inputs.description: Defines the latent space parameters for the model, crucial for initializing the model's state.

inputs.name: model_name
inputs.description: Determines the specific AnimateDiff model version 1 to be loaded, affecting the animation and image manipulation capabilities.

inputs.name: unlimited_area_hack
inputs.description: A boolean flag to enable or disable the unlimited area hack, altering the model's behavior in processing images.

inputs.name: beta_schedule
inputs.description: Specifies the beta schedule for the model, impacting the model's training or inference behavior.

inputs.name: deprecation_warning
inputs.description: Provides a deprecation warning, indicating that this node is outdated and newer versions are recommended.

outputs.name: model
outputs.description: The loaded AnimateDiff model, ready for animation and image manipulation tasks.

outputs.name: latent
outputs.description: The initialized latent space parameters of the loaded model, essential for the model's operation.

CheckpointLoaderSimpleWithNoiseSelect.description: This node specializes in loading model checkpoints with an emphasis on noise selection, allowing for more nuanced control over the initialization and behavior of models in generative tasks.
