It extends the functionality of standard checkpoint loading by incorporating beta schedule adjustments and optional scaling factors for noise, catering to advanced customization needs.

inputs.name: ckpt_name
inputs.description: Specifies the name of the checkpoint to be loaded. This parameter is crucial for identifying the specific model checkpoint file from a predefined list of available checkpoints.

inputs.name: beta_schedule
inputs.description: Determines the beta schedule to be applied to the model. This parameter allows for the adjustment of the model's sampling behavior, enhancing flexibility in model performance.

inputs.name: use_custom_scale_factor
inputs.description: A boolean flag indicating whether to apply a custom scale factor to the noise. When set to true, it enables fine-tuning of the noise's impact on the model's output.

inputs.name: scale_factor
inputs.description: Defines the magnitude of the noise scale factor, provided 'use_custom_scale_factor' is true. This allows for precise control over the noise level applied to the model.

outputs.name: model
outputs.description: The loaded model, configured according to the specified beta schedule and noise scaling options.

outputs.name: clip
outputs.description: The CLIP model associated with the loaded checkpoint, if applicable.

outputs.name: vae
outputs.description: The VAE model associated with the loaded checkpoint, if applicable.

AspectRatioSelector.description: The AspectRatioSelector node is designed to select and adjust the aspect ratio of images based on predefined options. It simplifies the process of resizing images to fit specific dimensions, ensuring that the output matches the desired aspect ratio.

inputs.name: aspect_ratio
inputs.description: Specifies the desired aspect ratio for the image, chosen from a predefined list of common ratios. This selection determines the dimensions to which the image will be resized, impacting the final appearance and layout of the image.

outputs.name: ratio
outputs.description: Returns the selected aspect ratio as a string, indicating the proportion between width and height of the image.

outputs.name: width
outputs.description: The calculated width of the image after resizing to the selected aspect ratio.

outputs.name: height
outputs.description: The calculated height of the image after resizing to the selected aspect ratio.

AV_AwsBedrockClaudeApi.description: This node is designed to facilitate the integration with AWS Bedrock Claude API, providing a streamlined way to access Claude's language model capabilities through AWS. It abstracts the complexity of authentication and API communication, enabling users to easily leverage Claude's AI for various applications.

inputs.name: aws_access_key_id
inputs.description: The AWS access key ID for authentication with AWS services. It's crucial for establishing a secure connection to AWS.

inputs.name: aws_secret_access_key
inputs.description: The AWS secret access key for authentication. Together with the access key ID, it forms the credentials needed for accessing AWS resources securely.

inputs.name: aws_session_token
inputs.description: An optional session token for temporary credentials that grant access to AWS services. It's used in conjunction with temporary access keys.

inputs.name: region
inputs.description: The AWS region where the Bedrock Claude API is hosted. It determines the geographical location of the API endpoint being accessed.

inputs.name: version
inputs.description: Specifies the version of the Bedrock Claude API to be used. It ensures that the API's features and capabilities are compatible with the user's requirements.

outputs.name: llm_api
outputs.description: The initialized Claude API object, ready for making requests to the Claude language model.

AV_AwsBedrockMistralApi.description: This node is designed to facilitate the creation of an API connection to AWS Bedrock Mistral, leveraging AWS credentials to authenticate and configure the API for use in language model applications.

inputs.name: aws_access_key_id
inputs.description: The AWS access key ID is essential for authenticating the user's AWS account, enabling secure access to AWS services.

inputs.name: aws_secret_access_key
inputs.description: The AWS secret access key works alongside the access key ID to authenticate and secure the user's AWS account access.

inputs.name: aws_session_token
inputs.description: The AWS session token provides temporary access credentials for using AWS services, enhancing security for short-term access.

inputs.name: region
inputs.description: Specifies the AWS region for the API connection, determining the geographical location of the resources accessed.

outputs.name: llm_api
outputs.description: Represents the configured API connection to AWS Bedrock Mistral, ready for use in language model applications.

AV_CheckpointLoader.description: The AV_CheckpointLoader node is designed for loading model checkpoints with optional overrides for specific components such as the checkpoint itself, VAE, or LoRA models. It extends the functionality of a standard checkpoint loader by allowing users to specify alternative sources for model components, enhancing flexibility in model configuration and experimentation.

inputs.name: ckpt_name
inputs.description: Specifies the name of the checkpoint to load. This parameter can be overridden to load a different checkpoint if desired, providing flexibility in model experimentation.

inputs.name: vae_name
inputs.description: Specifies the name of the VAE model to load. This parameter can be overridden to load a different VAE model if desired, allowing for experimentation with different VAE configurations.

inputs.name: clip_skip
inputs.description: Indicates whether to skip loading the CLIP model. This parameter allows for selective loading of model components based on requirements.

inputs.name: lora_name
inputs.description: Specifies the name of the LoRA model to load. This parameter can be overridden to load a different LoRA model if desired, enabling customization of the LoRA component.

inputs.name: lora_model_strength
inputs.description: unknown

inputs.name: lora_clip_strength
inputs.description: unknown

inputs.name: positive
inputs.description: unknown

inputs.name: negative
inputs.description: unknown

inputs.name: token_normalization
inputs.description: unknown

inputs.name: weight_interpretation
inputs.description: unknown

inputs.name: empty_latent_width
inputs.description: unknown

inputs.name: empty_latent_height
inputs.description: unknown

inputs.name: batch_size
inputs.description: unknown

inputs.name: lora_stack
inputs.description: unknown

inputs.name: cnet_stack
inputs.description: unknown

inputs.name: ckpt_override
inputs.description: unknown

inputs.name: vae_override
inputs.description: unknown

inputs.name: lora_override
inputs.description: unknown

outputs.name: MODEL
outputs.description: The loaded model instance.

outputs.name: CONDITIONING+
outputs.description: Positive conditioning components loaded or configured during the checkpoint loading process.

outputs.name: CONDITIONING-
outputs.description: Negative conditioning components loaded or configured during the checkpoint loading process.

outputs.name: LATENT
outputs.description: Latent representations or configurations loaded or derived from the checkpoint.

outputs.name: VAE
outputs.description: The VAE model loaded as part of the checkpoint, if applicable.

outputs.name: CLIP
outputs.description: The CLIP model loaded as part of the checkpoint, if applicable.

outputs.name: DEPENDENCIES
outputs.description: Any additional dependencies or components loaded alongside the main model components.

AV_CheckpointMerge.description: The AV_CheckpointMerge node is designed for merging model checkpoints within the Art Venture framework. It abstracts the complexities of combining different model states into a unified checkpoint, facilitating the integration or experimentation with various model configurations in a streamlined manner.

inputs.name: model1
inputs.description: The first model to be merged, contributing to the creation of a new, unified model checkpoint.

inputs.name: model2
inputs.description: The second model to be merged, which combines with the first model to form a new, unified model checkpoint.

inputs.name: model1_weight
inputs.description: A weight factor for the first model, influencing the degree to which it impacts the merged model checkpoint.

inputs.name: model2_weight
inputs.description: A weight factor for the second model, influencing the degree to which it impacts the merged model checkpoint.

outputs.name: model
outputs.description: The resulting merged model checkpoint, incorporating elements from both input models.

AV_CheckpointModelsToParametersPipe.description: This node is designed to convert model checkpoint names and various model component names into a structured pipeline configuration. It facilitates the organization and management of model components such as VAEs, upscalers, and LoRA layers by mapping their names to a pipeline dictionary, streamlining the process of configuring and utilizing these components in AI art generation workflows.

inputs.name: ckpt_name
inputs.description: The name of the primary model checkpoint. It is crucial for identifying the main model to be used in the pipeline.

inputs.name: pipe
inputs.description: A dictionary that may already contain some pipeline configuration, which this node will update or expand based on the provided model component names.

inputs.name: secondary_ckpt_name
inputs.description: The name of the secondary model checkpoint, allowing for the integration of additional models into the pipeline.

inputs.name: vae_name
inputs.description: Specifies the name of the VAE (Variational Autoencoder) model to be included in the pipeline, enhancing the model's capabilities.

inputs.name: upscaler_name
inputs.description: The name of the upscaling model to be used for enhancing image resolution within the pipeline.

inputs.name: secondary_upscaler_name
inputs.description: The name of an additional upscaling model, offering flexibility in choosing resolution enhancement methods.

inputs.name: lora_i_name
inputs.description: The name of a LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation) layer, enabling fine-tuning of the model's behavior. The index 'i' can range from 1 to 3, allowing for the specification of up to three different LoRA layers.

outputs.name: pipe
outputs.description: A dictionary mapping model component names to their respective identifiers, organizing the pipeline configuration for easy access and modification.

AV_CheckpointSave.description: The AV_CheckpointSave node extends the functionality of a base checkpoint saving mechanism to include the option of specifying the data type for saving model states, particularly catering to precision requirements in model merging scenarios within the Art Venture project.

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: The model to be saved. This is a core component of the checkpoint, encapsulating the model's state.

inputs.name: clip
inputs.description: The CLIP model associated with the checkpoint. This parameter is crucial for ensuring that the saved state includes necessary components for model functionality.

inputs.name: vae
inputs.description: The VAE model to be included in the checkpoint. This is essential for capturing the full scope of the model's capabilities, especially in generative tasks.

inputs.name: filename_prefix
inputs.description: The prefix for the saved filename. This allows for organized storage and easy retrieval of saved models.

inputs.name: dtype
inputs.description: Specifies the data type for the model state to be saved in, allowing for a choice between 'float16' and 'float32'. This option enables control over the precision and size of the saved model, impacting both storage efficiency and computational demand.

AV_ClaudeApi.description: The AV_ClaudeApi node is designed to facilitate interaction with Claude's API, enabling the creation of API instances for further operations with Claude's language models. It abstracts the complexities of API key management and endpoint configuration, providing a streamlined way to access Claude's advanced language processing capabilities.

inputs.name: claude_api_key
inputs.description: The API key for Claude, essential for authenticating requests to the API. It's a critical component for enabling access to Claude's language models.

inputs.name: endpoint
inputs.description: The URL of the Claude API endpoint. This parameter allows for specifying the API's location, with a default value pointing to Anthropic's API.

inputs.name: version
inputs.description: The version of the Claude API to be used, allowing for control over which features and improvements are accessible.

outputs.name: llm_api
outputs.description: The created instance of ClaudeApi, ready for making requests to Claude's language model API.

AV_ControlNetEfficientLoader.description: This node specializes in efficiently loading ControlNet configurations, optimizing the process for enhanced performance and resource utilization. It extends the capabilities of a standard ControlNet loader by incorporating advanced techniques to streamline the loading operation, making it suitable for scenarios requiring high efficiency.

inputs.name: control_net_name
inputs.description: Specifies the name of the ControlNet configuration to be loaded. This parameter is crucial for identifying which configuration file to access and load, directly influencing the node's operation by determining the specific ControlNet to be utilized.

inputs.name: conditioning
inputs.description: The conditioning data to be applied in conjunction with the ControlNet, influencing the final output by adjusting the model's behavior based on specified conditions.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The image input that the ControlNet will process, serving as a basis for the application of the ControlNet's effects or transformations.

inputs.name: strength
inputs.description: Determines the intensity of the ControlNet's application on the image, allowing for fine-tuned control over the effect's strength.

inputs.name: preprocessor
inputs.description: Specifies the preprocessor to be used on the image before applying the ControlNet, affecting the input image's condition and potentially its compatibility with the ControlNet.

inputs.name: control_net_override
inputs.description: Allows for the dynamic overriding of the specified ControlNet configuration. This flexibility is key for scenarios where conditional or runtime decisions may dictate the use of an alternative configuration, thereby affecting the outcome of the loading process.

inputs.name: timestep_keyframe
inputs.description: Defines a specific timestep or keyframe within the ControlNet configuration to be loaded. This parameter enables precise control over the loading process, allowing for targeted access to specific portions of the ControlNet, which can be critical for temporal or sequential applications.

inputs.name: resolution
inputs.description: The resolution at which the image should be processed, impacting the quality and detail of the ControlNet's application.

inputs.name: enabled
inputs.description: A flag to enable or disable the ControlNet loading and application process, providing a mechanism to conditionally bypass this node's operation.

outputs.name: conditioning
outputs.description: Returns the conditioning data after the application of the ControlNet, reflecting any modifications or enhancements made during the process.

AV_ControlNetEfficientLoaderAdvanced.description: This node represents an advanced version of the ControlNet loader, designed to efficiently load and apply ControlNet configurations for enhanced image manipulation and generation tasks. It extends the capabilities of its base loader with additional functionalities, aiming to provide more sophisticated control and optimization options for processing and applying ControlNet models.

inputs.name: control_net_name
inputs.description: Specifies the name of the ControlNet to be loaded. This parameter is crucial for identifying which ControlNet model to apply, directly influencing the outcome of the image manipulation or generation process.

inputs.name: positive
inputs.description: The positive conditioning input for the ControlNet, representing the desired attributes or features to enhance or maintain in the image.

inputs.name: negative
inputs.description: The negative conditioning input for the ControlNet, representing the attributes or features to diminish or remove from the image.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The image to be processed by the ControlNet, serving as the basis for the application of the conditioning effects.

inputs.name: strength
inputs.description: Determines the intensity of the ControlNet's effect on the image, allowing for fine-tuned control over the manipulation.

inputs.name: start_percent
inputs.description: Specifies the starting percentage of the effect's application, enabling phased or gradual application of the ControlNet.

inputs.name: end_percent
inputs.description: Specifies the ending percentage of the effect's application, allowing for a controlled conclusion to the ControlNet's influence.

inputs.name: preprocessor
inputs.description: Selects the preprocessor to be used on the image before applying the ControlNet, affecting the final outcome.

inputs.name: control_net_override
inputs.description: Allows for the override of the selected ControlNet model. This parameter offers flexibility in dynamically choosing different ControlNet models, potentially enhancing the adaptability of the node to various scenarios.

inputs.name: timestep_keyframe
inputs.description: Defines a specific timestep or keyframe for the ControlNet application. This parameter enables precise control over the timing of the ControlNet's effects, allowing for more targeted and effective image manipulations.

inputs.name: resolution
inputs.description: Defines the resolution of the image to be processed, impacting the detail and quality of the ControlNet's application.

inputs.name: enabled
inputs.description: Enables or disables the application of the ControlNet, providing a mechanism to bypass processing when necessary.

outputs.name: positive
outputs.description: The modified positive conditioning after the ControlNet application, reflecting the enhanced or maintained attributes.

outputs.name: negative
outputs.description: The modified negative conditioning after the ControlNet application, reflecting the diminished or removed attributes.

AV_ControlNetEfficientStacker.description: The AV_ControlNetEfficientStacker node is designed to streamline the process of integrating and managing control networks within an image processing pipeline. It facilitates the efficient stacking of control networks by allowing for dynamic selection based on predefined criteria, application of preprocessing steps, and adjustment of control network strength and resolution, thereby enhancing the flexibility and effectiveness of image manipulation tasks.

inputs.name: control_net_name
inputs.description: Specifies the name of the control network to be used, including options for automatic selection based on the model version. This parameter is crucial for determining the appropriate control network and preprocessing requirements for the image.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The input image to be processed. This parameter is essential as it serves as the base for applying the control network transformations.

inputs.name: strength
inputs.description: Defines the intensity of the control network's effect on the image, allowing for fine-tuned manipulation of the image's attributes.

inputs.name: start_percent
inputs.description: Specifies the starting percentage of the control network's effect, allowing for gradual application over the image.

inputs.name: end_percent
inputs.description: Specifies the ending percentage of the control network's effect, enabling precise control over how the network's influence fades.

inputs.name: preprocessor
inputs.description: Specifies the preprocessing method to be applied to the image before the control network is applied, ensuring the image is in the optimal format for manipulation.

inputs.name: cnet_stack
inputs.description: An optional stack of control networks to be applied. This allows for the layering of multiple control networks for complex image transformations.

inputs.name: control_net_override
inputs.description: Allows for the manual override of the selected control network, providing flexibility in the choice of control networks.

inputs.name: timestep_keyframe
inputs.description: Optionally specifies a keyframe for the control network, enabling temporal control over the image manipulation process.

inputs.name: resolution
inputs.description: Sets the resolution for the image processing, allowing for control over the detail level of the output image.

inputs.name: enabled
inputs.description: A flag to enable or disable the control network processing, offering a straightforward way to bypass the control network application.

outputs.name: CNET_STACK
outputs.description: unknown

AV_ControlNetEfficientStackerSimple.description: This node is designed to streamline the process of stacking control networks for image manipulation, enabling the application of multiple control net transformations to an image based on specified parameters. It simplifies the integration of control nets into the image processing pipeline, focusing on efficiency and ease of use.

inputs.name: control_net_name
inputs.description: Specifies the control net to be applied. It includes options for automatic selection based on the model version or a custom selection from available control nets, influencing the control net's behavior and output.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The input image to be processed by the control net stack. It serves as the base for subsequent control net applications, determining the initial state of the image manipulation process.

inputs.name: strength
inputs.description: Defines the intensity of the control net's effect on the image, allowing for fine-tuned adjustments to the impact of the control net application.

inputs.name: preprocessor
inputs.description: Selects a preprocessor to be applied before the control net, affecting the image's preparation and potentially its compatibility with the control net.

inputs.name: cnet_stack
inputs.description: An optional stack of control nets to be applied sequentially. This allows for the layering of multiple control net effects on the image.

inputs.name: control_net_override
inputs.description: Overrides the selected control net with a specified one, offering flexibility in experimenting with different control nets.

inputs.name: timestep_keyframe
inputs.description: Specifies keyframes for the control net application, enabling dynamic control over the effect's application over time.

inputs.name: resolution
inputs.description: Sets the resolution for the image processing, impacting the detail level of the control net application.

inputs.name: enabled
inputs.description: Toggles the control net stacker's operation, allowing it to be enabled or disabled as needed.

outputs.name: CNET_STACK
outputs.description: The resulting stack of control nets after processing. This output encapsulates the sequence of control net applications performed on the image, reflecting the cumulative effect of the specified transformations.

AV_ControlNetLoader.description: The AV_ControlNetLoader node is designed to load control net configurations for use in art and design applications. It supports loading specific control net models by name, with optional overrides and timestep keyframe adjustments, facilitating dynamic and flexible control net application within creative workflows.

inputs.name: control_net_name
inputs.description: Specifies the name of the control net to be loaded. This parameter is essential for identifying which control net configuration to apply, enabling the customization of art generation processes.

inputs.name: control_net_override
inputs.description: Allows for the specification of an alternative control net to be used instead of the one named in 'control_net_name', providing flexibility in control net selection.

inputs.name: timestep_keyframe
inputs.description: Optional parameter to specify a particular timestep keyframe for the control net, enabling fine-tuned adjustments to how the control net is applied.

outputs.name: control_net
outputs.description: Returns the loaded control net configuration, ready for application in art generation processes.

AV_ControlNetPreprocessor.description: The AV_ControlNetPreprocessor node is designed for preparing images for further processing or analysis within the Art Venture framework, specifically by applying various preprocessing techniques to enhance or modify the images based on the selected preprocessor and resolution settings. It supports a range of preprocessing options, including segmentation, edge detection, and artistic style adjustments, tailored to the requirements of subsequent control net detection and application.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The input image to be preprocessed. This is the primary data upon which preprocessing operations are performed, setting the stage for enhanced image analysis or manipulation.

inputs.name: preprocessor
inputs.description: Specifies the preprocessing technique to be applied to the input image. This selection determines how the image will be modified or enhanced, impacting the effectiveness of subsequent control net detection.

inputs.name: sd_version
inputs.description: Indicates the version of the Stable Diffusion model to be used, affecting the compatibility and performance of the preprocessing and control net detection processes.

inputs.name: resolution
inputs.description: The target resolution for the preprocessed image. Adjusting this parameter can influence the detail level and quality of the preprocessing output.

inputs.name: preprocessor_override
inputs.description: Allows for overriding the default preprocessor choice, providing flexibility in experimenting with different preprocessing techniques.

outputs.name: IMAGE
outputs.description: The preprocessed image, ready for further analysis or processing within the Art Venture framework.

outputs.name: CNET_NAME
outputs.description: The name of the detected control net, indicating the specific preprocessing technique applied to the input image.

AV_IPAdapter.description: The AV_IPAdapter node is designed to integrate and apply image processing adapters to models, enhancing their capabilities with additional image processing techniques. It allows for the dynamic application of IP adapters and clip vision models to modify and improve the input model's performance on image data, based on specified weights, noise levels, and optional configurations.

inputs.name: ip_adapter_name
inputs.description: Specifies the name of the IP adapter to be used. It is crucial for determining which IP adapter model to load and apply.

inputs.name: clip_name
inputs.description: Defines the name of the clip vision model to be used alongside the IP adapter. This parameter is essential for selecting the appropriate clip vision model to complement the IP adapter's functionality.

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: The model to which the IP adapter and clip vision modifications will be applied. This parameter is central to the node's operation, serving as the base for enhancements.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The image data to be processed by the IP adapter and clip vision models. This input is key to the adaptation and enhancement process.

inputs.name: weight
inputs.description: Affects the intensity of the IP adapter's application on the image/model. It allows for fine-tuning the strength of the modifications.

inputs.name: noise
inputs.description: Introduces a level of noise to the adaptation process, offering a means to adjust the effect of the IP adapter on the image/model.

inputs.name: ip_adapter_opt
inputs.description: Optional configurations for the IP adapter, providing flexibility in customizing its application.

inputs.name: clip_vision_opt
inputs.description: Optional configurations for the clip vision model, enabling further customization of the clip vision's application.

inputs.name: attn_mask
inputs.description: unknown

inputs.name: start_at
inputs.description: unknown

inputs.name: end_at
inputs.description: unknown

inputs.name: weight_type
inputs.description: unknown

inputs.name: enabled
inputs.description: Controls whether the IP adapter and clip vision modifications are applied, allowing for conditional processing.

outputs.name: model
outputs.description: The enhanced model after applying the IP adapter and clip vision modifications.

outputs.name: pipeline
outputs.description: A dictionary detailing the applied IP adapter and clip vision models, offering insight into the modifications made.

outputs.name: clip_vision
outputs.description: The specific clip vision model applied during the process, providing context for the enhancements.

AV_IPAdapterPipe.description: The AV_IPAdapterPipe node is designed to facilitate the integration of IP adapter and clip vision models into a unified pipeline for enhancing image processing tasks. It abstracts the complexity of loading and applying these models, providing a streamlined interface for incorporating advanced vision capabilities into applications.

inputs.name: ip_adapter_name
inputs.description: Specifies the name of the IP adapter model to be loaded. It is crucial for identifying which IP adapter model to use in the pipeline, affecting the overall image processing outcome.

inputs.name: clip_name
inputs.description: Determines the specific clip vision model to be loaded. This selection influences the vision processing capabilities of the pipeline, impacting the final image enhancement results.

outputs.name: p
outputs.description: Outputs a pipeline dictionary containing the loaded IP adapter and clip vision models, ready for application in image processing tasks.

AV_LLMApiConfig.description: The AV_LLMApiConfig node is designed to generate configuration settings for various large language models (LLMs) by specifying model type, maximum token count, and temperature. This configuration is essential for tailoring the behavior of LLMs to specific tasks or preferences, providing a foundation for further interactions with these models.

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: Specifies the model to be used for the LLM configuration. This parameter supports a wide range of models, including GPT, Claude, and Bedrock variants, allowing for flexible model selection based on the task at hand.

inputs.name: max_token
inputs.description: Defines the maximum number of tokens the LLM can generate or process in a single request. This parameter helps control the length of the output, ensuring it meets specific requirements or limitations.

inputs.name: temperature
inputs.description: Controls the creativity or randomness of the LLM's responses. A higher temperature leads to more varied outputs, while a lower temperature results in more deterministic and predictable text.

outputs.name: llm_config
outputs.description: The output is a configuration object tailored for LLM interactions, encapsulating the specified model, token limit, and temperature settings.

AV_LLMChat.description: The LLMChat node facilitates conversation with language models by processing and forwarding messages, configurations, and optional seed information to an API for generating responses. It abstracts the complexities of interacting with different language model APIs, providing a unified interface for initiating chat sessions.

inputs.name: messages
inputs.description: A list of messages that include both user and system messages, which are processed and formatted for the API call. This parameter is crucial for determining the flow and context of the conversation.

inputs.name: api
inputs.description: The API object that specifies the language model to be used for the chat session. It plays a key role in directing the request to the appropriate language model API.

inputs.name: config
inputs.description: Configuration settings for the language model, including model selection and parameters like max tokens and temperature, which influence the generation's verbosity and creativity.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.description: An optional seed for deterministic output, enhancing reproducibility of the chat responses.

outputs.name: response
outputs.description: The generated text response from the language model, encapsulating the model's reply to the input messages.

AV_LLMCompletion.description: The AV_LLMCompletion node facilitates generating text completions using a language model. It processes a given text prompt through a specified API and configuration, optionally incorporating a seed for deterministic outputs.

inputs.name: prompt
inputs.description: The text prompt to be completed by the language model. It is a crucial input as it guides the generation process.

inputs.name: api
inputs.description: The API used to interact with the language model, determining the specific model and its capabilities.

inputs.name: config
inputs.description: Configuration settings for the language model, including parameters like model type and generation settings.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.description: An optional seed value for generating deterministic outputs, ensuring reproducibility of results.

outputs.name: response
outputs.description: The generated text completion from the language model.

AV_LLMMessage.description: The AV_LLMMessage node is designed for creating and managing messages within a language model chat interface. It supports the inclusion of text and optionally images, facilitating rich, interactive dialogues between users and the system or assistant. This node plays a crucial role in structuring conversations, ensuring messages are correctly formatted and adhere to specified roles.

inputs.name: role
inputs.description: Specifies the role of the message, such as 'system', 'user', or 'assistant', influencing how the message is processed and presented within the chat flow.

inputs.name: text
inputs.description: The main content of the message, which can be a user query, system response, or assistant's reply. Supports multiline text, allowing for detailed and comprehensive messages.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: An optional image to accompany the text message, enhancing the interaction with visual content. The image is expected to be in Tensor format and converted to base64 for inclusion.

inputs.name: messages
inputs.description: A list of existing messages to which the new message will be added. This allows for the accumulation and management of conversation history.

outputs.name: messages
outputs.description: Returns a list of messages, including the newly created message, facilitating the continuation and tracking of the conversation flow.

AV_LoraListLoader.description: The AVLoraListLoader node is designed for loading and stacking lists of LoRA models based on provided data and configurations. It facilitates the dynamic enhancement of models and clips by applying multiple LoRA adjustments in sequence, allowing for complex model behavior modifications through LoRA parameters.

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: The 'model' parameter represents the initial model to which LoRA adjustments will be applied. It is crucial for defining the starting point of the LoRA stacking process.

inputs.name: clip
inputs.description: The 'clip' parameter signifies the initial clip model that will be modified alongside the main model through the LoRA adjustments. It plays a key role in the stacking process by being subject to modifications.

inputs.name: data
inputs.description: The 'data' parameter contains the list of LoRA models to be loaded and applied, in JSON format. It is essential for specifying which LoRA models and their corresponding strengths will influence the model and clip.

inputs.name: base_url
inputs.description: The 'base_url' parameter provides the base URL for fetching LoRA models not found locally. It aids in dynamically loading LoRA models from external sources.

outputs.name: model
outputs.description: Returns the modified model after applying the specified LoRA adjustments.

outputs.name: clip
outputs.description: Returns the modified clip model after the LoRA adjustments have been applied.

AV_LoraListStacker.description: The AV_LoraListStacker node is designed to manage and stack configurations for Lora models, facilitating the dynamic integration and application of multiple Lora models into a processing pipeline. It abstracts the complexity of handling Lora model parameters and ensures that the models are applied in a sequence that respects the intended layering and strength adjustments.

inputs.name: data
inputs.description: The 'data' input contains the list of Lora models and their configurations in JSON format, dictating how each Lora model should be applied to the base model.

inputs.name: base_url
inputs.description: The 'base_url' optional input provides a default URL prefix for fetching Lora models not locally available, facilitating remote model retrieval.

inputs.name: lora_stack
inputs.description: The 'lora_stack' input allows for the inclusion of an existing stack of Lora models to be further processed or integrated with new Lora configurations.

outputs.name: lora_stack
outputs.description: Returns the updated stack of Lora models after integrating the specified Lora model adjustments.

AV_LoraLoader.description: The AV_LoraLoader node is designed to load and apply LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation) models to given models and CLIP instances, optionally overriding the default LoRA model with a specified one and enabling or disabling the loading process. This functionality enhances model customization and flexibility in processing, allowing for dynamic adjustments and optimizations based on specific requirements or preferences.

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: The model parameter represents the neural network model to which the LoRA adjustments will be applied, serving as the base for modifications.

inputs.name: clip
inputs.description: The clip parameter signifies the CLIP model that will be adjusted alongside the main model, allowing for synchronized enhancements in processing capabilities.

inputs.name: lora_name
inputs.description: Specifies the name of the LoRA model to be loaded and applied, enabling targeted modifications to the base model and CLIP instance.

inputs.name: strength_model
inputs.description: Specifies the strength of the LoRA adjustment to be applied to the model, allowing for fine-tuned control over the adaptation process.

inputs.name: strength_clip
inputs.description: Specifies the strength of the LoRA adjustment to be applied to the CLIP model, enabling precise customization of the enhancement.

inputs.name: lora_override
inputs.description: Allows for the specification of an alternative LoRA model to override the default, providing flexibility in model customization.

inputs.name: enabled
inputs.description: A boolean flag that determines whether the LoRA loading and application process should be executed, offering control over the modification workflow.

outputs.name: model
outputs.description: Returns the modified neural network model with applied LoRA adjustments, reflecting the enhancements or customizations made.

outputs.name: clip
outputs.description: Returns the modified CLIP model with applied LoRA adjustments, showcasing the enhancements or customizations made to processing capabilities.

AV_OpenAIApi.description: The AV_OpenAIApi node facilitates the creation of an API client for interacting with OpenAI's services, enabling the integration of OpenAI's language model capabilities within the ArtVenture ecosystem. It abstracts the authentication and setup process, making it easier to leverage OpenAI's API for various language processing tasks.

inputs.name: openai_api_key
inputs.description: The API key for authenticating requests to OpenAI's services. It is essential for enabling secure communication with OpenAI's API.

inputs.name: endpoint
inputs.description: The URL endpoint for OpenAI's API. It defaults to OpenAI's official API endpoint but can be customized if needed.

outputs.name: llm_api
outputs.description: Returns an instance of the OpenAIApi, configured and ready to interact with OpenAI's language models.

AV_ParametersPipeToCheckpointModels.description: This node is designed to transform a set of parameters encapsulated within a pipe structure into specific model checkpoint names and configurations. It serves as a bridge between abstract parameter definitions and concrete model instantiation, facilitating the dynamic selection and configuration of models based on provided parameters.

inputs.name: pipe
inputs.description: The pipe parameter acts as a container for model-related parameters, including checkpoint names, VAE names, and upscaler names. It plays a crucial role in determining the specific models and configurations to be instantiated based on the encapsulated parameters.

outputs.name: pipe
outputs.description: Returns the updated pipe structure, now including the resolved names and configurations for model checkpoints, VAEs, and upscalers, based on the input parameters.

outputs.name: ckpt_name
outputs.description: The primary checkpoint model name derived from the input parameters.

outputs.name: secondary_ckpt_name
outputs.description: The secondary checkpoint model name derived from the input parameters.

outputs.name: vae_name
outputs.description: The name of the VAE model derived from the input parameters.

outputs.name: upscaler_name
outputs.description: The name of the primary upscaler model derived from the input parameters.

outputs.name: secondary_upscaler_name
outputs.description: The name of the secondary upscaler model derived from the input parameters.

outputs.name: lora_1_name
outputs.description: The name of the first Lora model derived from the input parameters.

outputs.name: lora_2_name
outputs.description: The name of the second Lora model derived from the input parameters.

outputs.name: lora_3_name
outputs.description: The name of the third Lora model derived from the input parameters.

AV_ParametersPipeToPrompts.description: The AV_ParametersPipeToPrompts node is designed to transform a parameters pipe into specific prompt outputs, facilitating the generation of positive, negative, image, and mask outputs based on the input parameters pipe. This node plays a crucial role in the art creation pipeline by enabling the conversion of abstract parameter sets into concrete, actionable prompts and visual elements.

inputs.name: pipe
inputs.description: The 'pipe' input is a dictionary that serves as a container for various parameters, acting as the source from which the node extracts specific values to generate the prompts and visual outputs. It is central to the node's operation, dictating the content of the generated outputs.

outputs.name: pipe
outputs.description: Returns the original input parameters pipe, allowing for further processing or utilization in subsequent nodes.

outputs.name: positive
outputs.description: Generates a positive prompt text based on the input parameters.

outputs.name: negative
outputs.description: Generates a negative prompt text based on the input parameters.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: Produces an image output if specified in the input parameters.

outputs.name: mask
outputs.description: Produces a mask output if specified in the input parameters.

AV_PromptsToParametersPipe.description: This node is designed to convert textual prompts into a structured parameters pipe, facilitating the integration of user-defined positive and negative prompts into a broader pipeline for art generation or modification. It allows for the dynamic customization of content by incorporating these prompts into the processing flow, alongside optional image and mask inputs for further refinement.

inputs.name: positive
inputs.description: The positive prompt represents the desired attributes or elements to include in the art generation process, serving as a guide for the output creation.

inputs.name: negative
inputs.description: The negative prompt specifies the attributes or elements to exclude from the art generation process, helping to refine the output by avoiding undesired features.

inputs.name: pipe
inputs.description: A structured data pipeline that can be optionally provided to include existing parameters for further processing or modification.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: An optional image input that can be used to influence the art generation process, providing a visual context or basis for modification.

inputs.name: mask
inputs.description: An optional mask input that can be used to specify areas of interest or exclusion in the provided image, aiding in targeted modifications or enhancements.

outputs.name: pipe
outputs.description: The output is a structured parameters pipe enriched with the provided positive and negative prompts, and optionally, image and mask data for tailored art generation.

AV_SAMLoader.description: The AV_SAMLoader node is designed for loading SAM models specific to the Art Venture project. It facilitates the retrieval and initialization of SAM models from a predefined directory, ensuring that the models are ready for use in segmentation tasks.

inputs.name: model_name
inputs.description: Specifies the name of the SAM model to load. This parameter is crucial for identifying and retrieving the correct model file from the available SAM models directory.

outputs.name: sam_model
outputs.description: Returns the loaded SAM model, ready for use in segmentation tasks.

AV_StyleApply.description: The AV_StyleApply node is designed to apply specific styles to given data, utilizing a model and a preset. It can optionally use a mask to refine the style application process and includes a toggle to enable or disable the styling function. This node is integral for customizing and enhancing visual content through the application of artistic or thematic styles.

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: The model parameter specifies the style model to be used for applying styles to the input data. It plays a crucial role in determining the final appearance of the styled content.

inputs.name: preset
inputs.description: The preset parameter defines the specific style to be applied. It acts as a key to select among various predefined styles within the model, influencing the styling outcome.

inputs.name: data
inputs.description: The data parameter represents the input content to which the style will be applied. This could be an image or any form of visual data that is compatible with the model.

inputs.name: weight
inputs.description: The weight parameter adjusts the intensity of the style applied to the input data, allowing for finer control over the styling effect.

inputs.name: weight_type
inputs.description: The weight_type parameter specifies the method of weighting the style application, affecting how the style intensity is calculated and applied.

inputs.name: start_at
inputs.description: The start_at parameter determines the starting point of style application in a sequence, enabling temporal control over the styling process in video or animated content.

inputs.name: end_at
inputs.description: The end_at parameter sets the endpoint for style application in a sequence, allowing for precise control over the duration and timing of styling effects.

inputs.name: mask
inputs.description: The mask parameter allows for selective application of the style to specific areas of the input data, enhancing the precision of the styling process.

inputs.name: enabled
inputs.description: The enabled parameter toggles the style application process on or off, providing control over whether the styling should be applied.

outputs.name: model
outputs.description: The model output represents the styled model after the application of the specified style and adjustments.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The image output is the visual representation of the input data after the style has been applied, reflecting the chosen presets and adjustments.

AV_VAELoader.description: The AV_VAELoader node is designed to load VAE models with an optional override feature, allowing users to specify an alternative VAE model for loading. This functionality enhances flexibility in model selection and usage within the Art Venture framework.

inputs.name: vae_name
inputs.description: The name of the VAE model to be loaded. This serves as the default model to load unless an override is specified.

inputs.name: vae_override
inputs.description: Allows specifying an alternative VAE model to load. If the specified model is not found, the default or intended VAE model is loaded instead, providing a flexible approach to model selection.

outputs.name: vae
outputs.description: The loaded VAE model, ready for use within the system. This output enables further operations or transformations using the model.

BLIPCaption.description: The `BLIPCaption` node is designed to generate textual captions for images using the BLIP model. It leverages deep learning techniques to analyze visual content and produce descriptive, human-like text based on the image's elements and context. This node can be customized with prefixes and suffixes to the generated captions, and it supports adjusting the length of the output text to fit specific requirements.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The input image to be captioned. This is the primary data the node processes to generate a textual description.

inputs.name: min_length
inputs.description: Specifies the minimum length of the generated caption. This parameter helps in ensuring that the captions are not too brief and convey sufficient detail.

inputs.name: max_length
inputs.description: Sets the maximum length of the caption. This constraint ensures that the generated text is concise and to the point, avoiding overly verbose descriptions.

inputs.name: device_mode
inputs.description: Determines the device (CPU or GPU) on which the BLIP model will run, optimizing performance based on the available hardware.

inputs.name: prefix
inputs.description: An optional text to prepend to the generated caption, allowing for additional context or information to be included.

inputs.name: suffix
inputs.description: An optional text to append to the generated caption, useful for adding extra details or clarifications.

inputs.name: enabled
inputs.description: A flag to enable or disable the caption generation feature. When disabled, it returns a default caption structure.

inputs.name: blip_model
inputs.description: An optional pre-loaded BLIP model to be used for caption generation. If not provided, the node will load a model based on available checkpoints.

outputs.name: caption
outputs.description: The generated captions for the input images, enriched with optional prefixes and suffixes. These captions provide a textual representation of the visual content.

BLIPLoader.description: The BLIPLoader node is designed to load and initialize the BLIP model for image processing tasks. It encapsulates the complexities of setting up the BLIP model, including loading the pre-trained weights, configuring the model for inference, and ensuring it is ready to process images.

inputs.name: model_name
inputs.description: Specifies the name of the BLIP model to load. This parameter determines which pre-trained model weights are loaded, affecting the node's performance and the quality of image processing.

outputs.name: blip_model
outputs.description: Returns an instance of the BLIP model, fully configured and ready for image processing tasks. This model can then be used to perform various image understanding and manipulation tasks.

BooleanPrimitive.description: The BooleanPrimitive node is designed to manipulate boolean values, offering functionality to either pass through the input boolean value as is or reverse it. This node serves as a fundamental utility within the broader system, enabling conditional logic flows and binary decision-making processes.

inputs.name: value
inputs.description: Specifies the boolean value to be manipulated. This parameter is central to the node's operation, determining the base value that may be reversed based on the 'reverse' parameter.

inputs.name: reverse
inputs.description: Determines whether the input boolean value should be reversed. When set to True, the output will be the logical negation of the input, enabling dynamic control over boolean logic flows.

outputs.name: boolean
outputs.description: The resulting boolean value after applying the 'reverse' logic to the input. This output reflects either the original or negated value, based on the 'reverse' parameter.

outputs.name: string
outputs.description: A string representation of the resulting boolean value, providing a textual output that mirrors the boolean outcome.

CheckpointNameSelector.description: The CheckpointNameSelector node is designed to facilitate the selection of checkpoint names from a predefined list, streamlining the process of identifying and utilizing specific checkpoints within a workflow. It abstracts the complexity of navigating through checkpoint directories, offering a user-friendly interface for selecting the desired checkpoint name.

inputs.name: ckpt_name
inputs.description: The 'ckpt_name' parameter allows users to specify the name of the checkpoint they wish to select. This selection is crucial as it determines which checkpoint will be utilized for subsequent operations, directly influencing the workflow's outcome.

outputs.name: ckpt_name
outputs.description: Returns the selected checkpoint name, enabling further processing or utilization within the workflow.

outputs.name: ckpt_name_str
outputs.description: Provides the selected checkpoint name as a string, facilitating its use in scenarios where a string representation is required.

ColorCorrect.description: The ColorCorrect node is designed to adjust and enhance the color properties of an image, including temperature, hue, brightness, contrast, saturation, and gamma. It utilizes advanced image processing techniques to fine-tune these attributes, improving the overall visual quality of the image.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The input image tensor to be color corrected. It serves as the base for applying various color adjustments.

inputs.name: temperature
inputs.description: Adjusts the color temperature of the image, making it warmer or cooler.

inputs.name: hue
inputs.description: Modifies the hue of the image, shifting the colors along the color spectrum.

inputs.name: brightness
inputs.description: Controls the brightness level of the image, making it lighter or darker.

inputs.name: contrast
inputs.description: Alters the contrast of the image, enhancing the difference between light and dark areas.

inputs.name: saturation
inputs.description: Adjusts the saturation level, affecting the intensity of the colors in the image.

inputs.name: gamma
inputs.description: Applies gamma correction to the image, adjusting the luminance or brightness.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The color-corrected image tensor, reflecting the applied adjustments.

DeepDanbooruCaption.description: The DeepDanbooruCaption node is designed to generate captions for images using the DeepDanbooru model. It processes images to identify and describe their content with tags, optionally applying a prefix and suffix to each caption, and can be configured to filter tags, adjust thresholds, and sort tags alphabetically.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The image to be captioned. It is the primary input for generating captions.

inputs.name: threshold
inputs.description: The confidence threshold for including tags in the caption. Tags with confidence below this threshold are excluded.

inputs.name: sort_alpha
inputs.description: Determines whether the tags should be sorted alphabetically in the caption.

inputs.name: use_spaces
inputs.description: Controls whether spaces should be used between tags in the caption.

inputs.name: escape
inputs.description: Indicates whether special characters in tags should be escaped.

inputs.name: filter_tags
inputs.description: A list of tags to be excluded from the captions.

inputs.name: device_mode
inputs.description: Specifies the device mode (e.g., CPU, GPU, AUTO) for running the DeepDanbooru model.

inputs.name: prefix
inputs.description: A prefix to be added before each caption.

inputs.name: suffix
inputs.description: A suffix to be added after each caption.

inputs.name: enabled
inputs.description: Enables or disables the captioning functionality.

outputs.name: caption
outputs.description: The generated captions for the input image, potentially modified by prefix and suffix.

DependenciesEdit.description: The `DependenciesEdit` node is designed to modify and update the dependencies required for art generation processes. It allows for the customization of various components such as VAE models, checkpoints, CLIP models, and more, based on the provided inputs. This node plays a crucial role in tailoring the art generation pipeline to specific needs by adjusting the underlying dependencies.

inputs.name: dependencies
inputs.description: A tuple containing the current set of dependencies, which this node will modify based on the other input parameters. It's the core input that determines the starting point for any modifications.

inputs.name: ckpt_name
inputs.description: Determines the checkpoint name for the model, enabling the selection from available checkpoints or specifying custom ones.

inputs.name: vae_name
inputs.description: Specifies the name of the VAE model to be used, allowing for the selection from predefined options or custom models.

inputs.name: clip
inputs.description: Defines the CLIP model to be utilized, offering flexibility in choosing the appropriate model for the task.

inputs.name: clip_skip
inputs.description: Sets the number of layers to skip in the CLIP model, optimizing performance or accuracy as needed.

inputs.name: positive
inputs.description: A positive prompt to influence the generation process, enhancing the creative output.

inputs.name: negative
inputs.description: A negative prompt to steer away the generation from undesired directions, refining the results.

inputs.name: lora_stack
inputs.description: Specifies the LoRA stack to be applied, allowing for advanced model adaptation and fine-tuning.

inputs.name: cnet_stack
inputs.description: Determines the ControlNet stack to be used, enabling precise control over the generation process.

outputs.name: dependencies
outputs.description: The modified set of dependencies, reflecting the updates made based on the input parameters.

Fooocus_KSampler.description: The Fooocus_KSampler node enhances the sampling process in art generation by introducing an adjustable sharpness parameter to the traditional KSampler functionality. This allows for more precise control over the sharpness of generated images, catering to the specific needs of art ventures.

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: Specifies the model to be used for the sampling process, serving as the foundation for generating images.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.description: Determines the initial seed for randomness in the sampling process, ensuring reproducibility of results.

inputs.name: steps
inputs.description: Defines the number of steps to be taken in the sampling process, affecting the detail and quality of the generated images.

inputs.name: cfg
inputs.description: Controls the conditioning-free guidance scale, influencing the adherence to specified conditions.

inputs.name: sampler_name
inputs.description: Selects the specific sampler algorithm to be used, impacting the sampling behavior and output quality.

inputs.name: scheduler
inputs.description: Chooses the scheduler for controlling the sampling process, affecting the progression of image generation.

inputs.name: positive
inputs.description: Sets positive conditioning to guide the sampling towards desired attributes.

inputs.name: negative
inputs.description: Applies negative conditioning to steer the sampling away from undesired attributes.

inputs.name: latent_image
inputs.description: Provides an initial latent image to be refined or altered through the sampling process.

inputs.name: denoise
inputs.description: Adjusts the level of denoising applied to the generated images, affecting clarity and detail.

inputs.name: sharpness
inputs.description: The sharpness parameter allows users to adjust the sharpness level of the generated images, providing a means to fine-tune the visual output according to artistic preferences.

outputs.name: latent
outputs.description: The output latent representation of the generated image, ready for further processing or conversion to a visual format.

Fooocus_KSamplerAdvanced.description: The `Fooocus_KSamplerAdvanced` node enhances the sampling process in art generation by incorporating a sharpness parameter, allowing for more precise control over the texture and detail in the generated artwork. This node builds upon the advanced sampling capabilities, integrating sharpness adjustments directly into the sampling workflow to refine the visual output.

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: Specifies the model used for the sampling process, serving as the core component for generating artwork.

inputs.name: add_noise
inputs.description: Determines whether noise is added to the sampling process, affecting the texture and detail of the generated artwork.

inputs.name: noise_seed
inputs.description: Sets the seed for noise generation, ensuring reproducibility in the artwork's texture and detail.

inputs.name: steps
inputs.description: Defines the number of steps in the sampling process, impacting the refinement and detail of the generated artwork.

inputs.name: cfg
inputs.description: Controls the configuration for the sampling process, influencing the balance between the model's guidance and the generated detail.

inputs.name: sampler_name
inputs.description: Selects the specific sampler to use, affecting the method of traversing the model's latent space.

inputs.name: scheduler
inputs.description: Chooses the scheduler for the sampling process, determining the progression of steps.

inputs.name: positive
inputs.description: Provides positive conditioning to guide the sampling towards desired attributes.

inputs.name: negative
inputs.description: Provides negative conditioning to steer the sampling away from undesired attributes.

inputs.name: latent_image
inputs.description: Inputs an initial latent image for the sampling process, serving as a starting point.

inputs.name: start_at_step
inputs.description: Specifies the starting step for the sampling process, allowing for mid-process intervention.

inputs.name: end_at_step
inputs.description: Defines the ending step for the sampling process, determining its completion point.

inputs.name: return_with_leftover_noise
inputs.description: Controls whether the output includes leftover noise, affecting the final texture.

inputs.name: sharpness
inputs.description: The `sharpness` parameter allows users to adjust the level of detail and texture in the generated artwork, offering a means to fine-tune the visual output for more precise artistic control.

outputs.name: latent
outputs.description: The output latent representation of the sampled artwork, reflecting the combined effects of all input parameters.

Fooocus_KSamplerEfficient.description: The Fooocus_KSamplerEfficient node enhances the sampling process in art generation by incorporating a sharpness parameter, allowing for more precise control over the texture and detail level of generated images. This node builds upon the foundational sampling capabilities to offer an advanced, efficiency-focused approach to art creation.

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: Specifies the model used for the sampling process, integral to determining the art generation's foundational style and characteristics.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.description: The seed parameter ensures reproducibility in the art generation process by initializing the random number generator to a specific state.

inputs.name: steps
inputs.description: Defines the number of steps in the sampling process, affecting the detail and quality of the generated art.

inputs.name: cfg
inputs.description: Configures the conditioning factor for the sampling process, influencing the generation's creativity and coherence.

inputs.name: sampler_name
inputs.description: Identifies the specific sampler algorithm to be used, affecting the texture and detail of the generated art.

inputs.name: scheduler
inputs.description: Specifies the scheduler for controlling the sampling process, impacting the progression and quality of art generation.

inputs.name: positive
inputs.description: Defines positive conditioning to guide the art generation towards desired attributes.

inputs.name: negative
inputs.description: Sets negative conditioning to avoid certain attributes in the generated art.

inputs.name: latent_image
inputs.description: Provides the initial latent image to be transformed by the sampling process.

inputs.name: denoise
inputs.description: Adjusts the level of denoising applied to the generated art, affecting clarity and detail.

inputs.name: preview_method
inputs.description: unknown

inputs.name: vae_decode
inputs.description: unknown

inputs.name: optional_vae
inputs.description: unknown

inputs.name: script
inputs.description: unknown

inputs.name: sharpness
inputs.description: The sharpness parameter allows users to adjust the level of detail and texture in the generated art, providing a means to fine-tune the visual output for more precise artistic control.

outputs.name: MODEL
outputs.description: unknown

outputs.name: CONDITIONING+
outputs.description: unknown

outputs.name: CONDITIONING-
outputs.description: unknown

outputs.name: LATENT
outputs.description: The output latent image represents the final generated art, encapsulating the visual characteristics specified through the input parameters.

outputs.name: VAE
outputs.description: unknown

outputs.name: IMAGE
outputs.description: unknown

Fooocus_KSamplerEfficientAdvanced.description: This node enhances the sampling process with an added sharpness parameter, tailored for efficient advanced sampling in art creation. It leverages the underlying advanced KSampler's capabilities, integrating sharpness adjustments to refine the sampling output, aiming for higher precision and detail in generated art.

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: Specifies the model to be used for sampling, serving as the foundation for generating art.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.description: Determines the random seed for sampling, ensuring reproducibility of results.

inputs.name: steps
inputs.description: Defines the number of steps to be taken in the sampling process, affecting the detail and quality of the output.

inputs.name: cfg
inputs.description: Controls the conditioning factor, influencing the guidance and coherence of the generated art.

inputs.name: sampler_name
inputs.description: Selects the specific sampler algorithm to use, impacting the texture and characteristics of the generated art.

inputs.name: scheduler
inputs.description: Chooses the scheduler for controlling the sampling process, affecting the progression and variation of the output.

inputs.name: positive
inputs.description: Sets the positive conditioning to guide the sampling towards desired attributes.

inputs.name: negative
inputs.description: Sets the negative conditioning to steer the sampling away from undesired attributes.

inputs.name: latent_image
inputs.description: Provides an initial latent image to start the sampling from, offering a basis for further modifications.

inputs.name: denoise
inputs.description: Adjusts the level of denoising applied to the sampling output, refining the clarity and sharpness.

inputs.name: preview_method
inputs.description: Specifies the method for previewing the sampling results, enhancing the user's ability to assess and adjust the process.

inputs.name: vae_decode
inputs.description: Determines whether to decode the latent representation using a VAE model, affecting the final image quality.

inputs.name: optional_vae
inputs.description: Optionally specifies a VAE model to be used for decoding, providing flexibility in the choice of model.

inputs.name: script
inputs.description: Allows for the execution of custom scripts during the sampling process, offering extended customization and control.

inputs.name: sharpness
inputs.description: The sharpness parameter allows for fine-tuning the sharpness level of the sampling output, enhancing detail and clarity in the generated art. It plays a crucial role in achieving the desired level of detail and texture in the artwork.

outputs.name: MODEL
outputs.description: The model used for the sampling process, encapsulating the computational framework.

outputs.name: CONDITIONING+
outputs.description: The positive conditioning applied during sampling, guiding the generation towards desired attributes.

outputs.name: CONDITIONING-
outputs.description: The negative conditioning applied during sampling, steering the generation away from undesired attributes.

outputs.name: LATENT
outputs.description: The final latent representation of the sampled art, encapsulating the visual content and style.

outputs.name: VAE
outputs.description: The VAE model used for decoding the latent representation, if applicable, influencing the final image quality.

outputs.name: IMAGE
outputs.description: The final image output of the sampling process, representing the generated art.

GetBoolFromJson.description: This node is designed to extract a boolean value from a JSON object based on a specified key. It simplifies the process of retrieving boolean data from complex JSON structures, making it easier to use such data in decision-making processes or conditional flows within an application.

inputs.name: json
inputs.description: The JSON object from which a boolean value is to be extracted. This parameter is crucial for specifying the source of the data.

inputs.name: key
inputs.description: The key corresponding to the boolean value within the JSON object. This parameter allows for targeted extraction of data, making the operation more efficient.

outputs.name: boolean
outputs.description: The boolean value retrieved from the JSON object based on the specified key. This output is essential for further logical or conditional operations.

GetFloatFromJson.description: Extracts a float value from a JSON object based on a specified key. This node is designed to facilitate the retrieval of numeric data from structured JSON content, enhancing data processing and manipulation within the Art Venture utility suite.

inputs.name: json
inputs.description: The JSON object from which a float value is to be extracted. This parameter is crucial for specifying the source of the data.

inputs.name: key
inputs.description: The key corresponding to the desired float value within the JSON object. This parameter determines the specific piece of data to be retrieved.

outputs.name: float
outputs.description: The extracted float value from the JSON object. This output is significant for further numerical analysis or operations.

GetIntFromJson.description: This node is designed to extract an integer value from a JSON object based on a specified key. It simplifies the process of retrieving numeric data from structured JSON, making it accessible for further processing or decision-making tasks.

inputs.name: json
inputs.description: The JSON object from which the integer value is to be extracted. This parameter is crucial for specifying the source of the data.

inputs.name: key
inputs.description: The key corresponding to the integer value within the JSON object. This parameter determines which piece of data is retrieved, making it essential for targeted data extraction.

outputs.name: int
outputs.description: The integer value retrieved from the JSON object based on the provided key. This output is significant for downstream tasks that require numeric input.

GetObjectFromJson.description: The `GetObjectFromJson` node is designed to extract a specific object from a JSON structure based on a given key. It simplifies the process of navigating complex JSON data by allowing users to directly access elements of interest.

inputs.name: json
inputs.description: The JSON input from which an object is to be retrieved. This parameter is crucial for specifying the source JSON structure.

inputs.name: key
inputs.description: The key corresponding to the value or object to be extracted from the JSON input. This parameter determines which part of the JSON structure is accessed.

outputs.name: json
outputs.description: The extracted object from the JSON input, corresponding to the specified key. This output facilitates direct access to specific elements within a JSON structure.

GetSAMEmbedding.description: The GetSAMEmbedding node is designed to extract semantic embeddings from images using a specific SAM model. It facilitates the transformation of visual content into a format that can be further processed or analyzed, emphasizing the extraction of meaningful features that represent the underlying content of the images.

inputs.name: sam_model
inputs.description: The SAM model used for generating embeddings from images. It plays a crucial role in determining the quality and relevance of the extracted features.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The input image from which embeddings are to be extracted. This image is processed by the SAM model to generate a semantic representation.

inputs.name: device_mode
inputs.description: Specifies the computational device (AUTO, Prefer GPU, CPU) for model inference, affecting performance and resource utilization.

outputs.name: sam_embedding
outputs.description: The semantic embedding generated from the input image, representing its meaningful features in a condensed form.

GetTextFromJson.description: This node is designed to extract a string value from a JSON object based on a specified key. It simplifies the process of retrieving textual information from structured JSON data, making it a valuable utility in data processing and manipulation tasks within the Art Venture/Utils category.

inputs.name: json
inputs.description: The JSON object from which a string value is to be extracted. This parameter is crucial for specifying the source data.

inputs.name: key
inputs.description: The key corresponding to the value to be retrieved from the JSON object. This parameter allows for targeted extraction of data, enhancing the node's flexibility and utility.

outputs.name: string
outputs.description: The string value retrieved from the JSON object. This output is significant for downstream processing or display purposes.

ImageAlphaComposite.description: The ImageAlphaComposite node is designed for blending two images together based on their alpha values to create a single composited image. This process involves combining the visual elements of both input images into one, taking into account transparency and layering effects.

inputs.name: image_i
inputs.description: The second image to be composited. It acts as the other base layer in the alpha compositing process, layered together with the first image.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The resulting image after alpha compositing, blending the input images based on their alpha values.

ImageApplyChannel.description: The ImageApplyChannel node is designed to modify specific color channels (Red, Green, Blue, Alpha) of a collection of images by applying given channel data to them. This functionality allows for precise control over the color composition and transparency of images, enabling customized image processing and manipulation.

inputs.name: images
inputs.description: The collection of images to be modified. This parameter is crucial as it determines the base images that will undergo channel modification.

inputs.name: channel_data
inputs.description: The data to be applied to the specified channel of each image. This parameter directly influences the outcome by altering the specified channel's values across all images.

inputs.name: channel
inputs.description: Specifies which color channel (Red, Green, Blue, Alpha) to modify in the images. This choice dictates the aspect of the images that will be altered.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The modified images with the specified channel data applied. This output reflects the changes made to the original images' specified channels.

ImageExtractChannel.description: This node is designed to extract a specific channel (Red, Green, Blue, or Alpha) from a given set of images. It allows for the manipulation and analysis of individual color channels, which can be crucial for various image processing tasks, such as creating masks or isolating color components.

inputs.name: images
inputs.description: The images from which a specific channel will be extracted. This input is crucial for determining the source images to be processed.

inputs.name: channel
inputs.description: Specifies the color channel (Red, Green, Blue, or Alpha) to be extracted from the images. This choice directly affects the output by isolating the desired channel.

outputs.name: channel_data
outputs.description: The extracted channel data from the input images, provided as a mask. This output is useful for further image processing or analysis tasks.

ImageGaussianBlur.description: The `ImageGaussianBlur` node applies a Gaussian blur filter to a collection of images, effectively smoothing them by a specified radius. This operation is commonly used in image processing to reduce noise and detail, or to create a visual effect.

inputs.name: images
inputs.description: The collection of images to be blurred. This input is crucial for defining the set of images that will undergo the Gaussian blur transformation.

inputs.name: radius
inputs.description: Specifies the radius of the Gaussian blur. A larger radius results in a more pronounced blurring effect.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The blurred images, returned as a single tensor by concatenating the individually blurred images along the batch dimension.

ImageMuxer.description: The ImageMuxer node is designed to select and output one image from a set of up to four input images based on a given selector index. This functionality is essential for scenarios where dynamic image selection is required, such as in image processing pipelines or conditional image rendering tasks.

inputs.name: image_i
inputs.description: Represents one of the up to four image inputs for selection, acting as potential outputs based on the selector index. This generalization covers all image inputs, allowing for dynamic selection from multiple sources.

inputs.name: input_selector
inputs.description: An integer index that determines which of the input images is selected for output. This selector drives the dynamic selection process.

outputs.name: image
