FromBasicPipe.description: The FromBasicPipe node is designed to decompose a basic pipe structure into its constituent components, facilitating access to individual elements such as models, clips, and VAEs for further processing or analysis.

inputs.name: basic_pipe
inputs.description: Represents the basic pipe structure encapsulating a model, clip, VAE, and positive and negative conditioning elements. It serves as the input for decomposition into its constituent components.

outputs.name: model
outputs.description: The model component extracted from the basic pipe.

outputs.name: clip
outputs.description: The clip component extracted from the basic pipe.

outputs.name: vae
outputs.description: The VAE component extracted from the basic pipe.

outputs.name: positive
outputs.description: The positive conditioning element extracted from the basic pipe.

outputs.name: negative
outputs.description: The negative conditioning element extracted from the basic pipe.

FromBasicPipe_v2.description: The `FromBasicPipe_v2` node is designed to decompose a basic pipeline into its constituent components, facilitating access to individual elements such as models, clips, and conditioning parameters for further processing or analysis.

inputs.name: basic_pipe
inputs.description: Represents the basic pipeline to be decomposed into its individual components, enabling detailed examination and manipulation of each element.

outputs.name: basic_pipe
outputs.description: Returns the original basic pipeline as received in the input, allowing for its reuse or further manipulation.

outputs.name: model
outputs.description: Extracts the model component from the basic pipeline for independent use or analysis.

outputs.name: clip
outputs.description: Retrieves the CLIP model from the basic pipeline, making it available for separate operations.

outputs.name: vae
outputs.description: Isolates the VAE model from the basic pipeline for individual application or study.

outputs.name: positive
outputs.description: Separates the positive conditioning parameter from the basic pipeline, providing it for distinct processing or examination.

outputs.name: negative
outputs.description: Separates the negative conditioning parameter from the basic pipeline, offering it for individual utilization or analysis.

FromDetailerPipe.description: The FromDetailerPipe node is designed to extract and return various components from a given detailer pipe, including models, clips, VAEs, conditioning information, bounding box detectors, SAM models, segmentation detectors, and detailer hooks. This node facilitates the decomposition of a complex detailer pipe into its constituent elements for further processing or analysis.

inputs.name: detailer_pipe
inputs.description: Represents the detailer pipe from which various components are extracted. It is crucial for the operation as it contains all the elements that need to be decomposed and returned individually.

outputs.name: model
outputs.description: Returns the model component extracted from the detailer pipe, essential for further processing or analysis.

outputs.name: clip
outputs.description: Returns the clip component extracted from the detailer pipe, essential for further processing or analysis.

outputs.name: vae
outputs.description: Returns the VAE component extracted from the detailer pipe, essential for further processing or analysis.

outputs.name: positive
outputs.description: Returns the positive conditioning information extracted from the detailer pipe, essential for further processing or analysis.

outputs.name: negative
outputs.description: Returns the negative conditioning information extracted from the detailer pipe, essential for further processing or analysis.

outputs.name: bbox_detector
outputs.description: Returns the bounding box detector component extracted from the detailer pipe, essential for further processing or analysis.

outputs.name: sam_model_opt
outputs.description: Returns the SAM model component extracted from the detailer pipe, essential for further processing or analysis.

outputs.name: segm_detector_opt
outputs.description: Returns the segmentation detector component extracted from the detailer pipe, essential for further processing or analysis.

outputs.name: detailer_hook
outputs.description: Returns the detailer hook component extracted from the detailer pipe, essential for further processing or analysis.

FromDetailerPipeSDXL.description: The FromDetailerPipeSDXL node is designed to extract and return various components from a detailer pipe, including models, clips, VAEs, conditioning elements, bounding box detectors, SAM models, segmentation detectors, and detailer hooks. It serves as a mechanism to decompose a complex detailer pipe into its constituent parts for further processing or analysis.

inputs.name: detailer_pipe
inputs.description: Represents the detailer pipe from which components are to be extracted. It is crucial for specifying the source of the data to be decomposed.

outputs.name: detailer_pipe
outputs.description: Returns the entire detailer pipe as received, allowing for further manipulation or analysis.

outputs.name: model
outputs.description: Returns the model component extracted from the detailer pipe.

outputs.name: clip
outputs.description: Returns the clip component extracted from the detailer pipe.

outputs.name: vae
outputs.description: Returns the VAE component extracted from the detailer pipe.

outputs.name: positive
outputs.description: Returns the positive conditioning element extracted from the detailer pipe.

outputs.name: negative
outputs.description: Returns the negative conditioning element extracted from the detailer pipe.

outputs.name: bbox_detector
outputs.description: Returns the bounding box detector component extracted from the detailer pipe.

outputs.name: sam_model_opt
outputs.description: Returns the SAM model component extracted from the detailer pipe, if available.

outputs.name: segm_detector_opt
outputs.description: Returns the segmentation detector component extracted from the detailer pipe, if available.
