IterativeImageUpscale.description: The IterativeImageUpscale node is designed to enhance the resolution of images through a process that iteratively applies image upscaling techniques. This node aims to improve image quality and detail, making it suitable for applications requiring high-resolution images from lower-resolution sources.

inputs.name: pixels
inputs.description: The 'pixels' parameter represents the input image data in pixel format, serving as the foundation for the upscaling process.

inputs.name: upscale_factor
inputs.description: The 'upscale_factor' parameter specifies the multiplier for increasing the resolution of the image, directly impacting the upscaling intensity.

inputs.name: steps
inputs.description: The 'steps' parameter determines the number of iterations or steps the upscaling process will undergo, affecting the gradual improvement in image quality.

inputs.name: temp_prefix
inputs.description: The 'temp_prefix' parameter is used for specifying a temporary file prefix for intermediate results, aiding in debugging or intermediate analysis.

inputs.name: upscaler

inputs.name: vae

inputs.name: step_mode

IterativeLatentUpscale.description: The IterativeLatentUpscale node is designed to progressively upscale latent images through a series of steps, either geometrically or linearly, to achieve a desired magnification factor. This node leverages various upscaling methods and models to refine the quality of the upscaled images at each iteration, ensuring enhanced detail and resolution.

inputs.name: steps
inputs.description: The number of iterative steps to perform during the upscaling process. This parameter controls the granularity of the upscaling, affecting the intermediate sizes and quality.

inputs.name: temp_prefix

inputs.name: step_mode

outputs.name: latent

inputs.name: sampler_name

inputs.name: scheduler

LatentPixelScale.description: The LatentPixelScale node is designed to upscale latent representations of images using various methods, including nearest-exact, bilinear, lanczos, and area. It can operate on both individual samples and tiled representations, optionally utilizing a specific upscaling model for enhanced results. This node facilitates the enhancement of image quality or resolution in the latent space before decoding back to pixel space, making it a crucial component in workflows that require high-quality image generation or manipulation.

inputs.name: samples
inputs.description: The latent representation of images to be upscaled. This is the core input that determines the quality and characteristics of the output images.

inputs.name: scale_method
inputs.description: Specifies the method used for upscaling. The choice of method can significantly affect the quality and characteristics of the upscaled images.

inputs.name: scale_factor
inputs.description: The factor by which the latent images are to be upscaled. A higher scale factor results in a larger output image, affecting the level of detail and resolution.

inputs.name: vae
inputs.description: The variational autoencoder used for decoding and encoding the latent representations. This parameter is crucial for ensuring that the upscaled images remain compatible with the specific characteristics of the VAE model.

inputs.name: use_tiled_vae
inputs.description: Determines whether the VAE operations should be performed on tiled representations of the images. This can affect performance and quality, especially for large images.

inputs.name: upscale_model_opt
inputs.description: An optional upscaling model that can be used for enhanced upscaling results. When provided, this model is used instead of the standard methods specified by scale_method.

outputs.name: latent

LatentSender.description: LatentSender is designed for handling and transmitting latent representations of images. It encapsulates the functionality to prepare a preview of the latent image, save the latent tensor along with metadata and a preview image to a file, and send the latent image information to a specified destination. This node facilitates the sharing and manipulation of latent image representations by providing a structured way to save and communicate these representations.

MaskDetailerPipe.description: The MaskDetailerPipe node is designed to enhance and refine the details of masks within images, leveraging advanced image processing techniques to improve the visual quality and accuracy of the masks. outputs.description: The output is a batch of masks, either as a single 3D mask if the input list contains one mask, or a concatenated batch of 3D masks if the input list contains multiple masks. This facilitates batch processing in image manipulation tasks.

MasksToMaskList.description: The MasksToMaskList node is designed to transform a collection of individual masks into a list of masks, applying a 3D mask transformation to each mask in the process. This operation is essential for preparing mask data for further processing or analysis within a pipeline that requires masks in a standardized format.

inputs.name: masks
inputs.description: The 'masks' parameter represents the collection of masks to be transformed. It is crucial for the node's operation as it provides the raw data that will be processed into a standardized list format.

outputs.name: mask
outputs.description: The output is a list of masks, each transformed into a 3D format, ready for further processing or analysis.

MaskToSEGS.description: The MaskToSEGS node is designed to transform a given mask into a structured edge graphic signal (SEGS) format, optionally incorporating various preprocessing steps such as combining, cropping, bounding box filling, size filtering, and contour filling. This node is part of the ImpactPack's operation category, facilitating the manipulation and analysis of mask data for further processing or visualization.

inputs.name: mask
inputs.description: The mask input is the primary data that the node transforms into the SEGS format. It represents the area of interest within an image for further processing or analysis.

inputs.name: combined
inputs.description: Indicates whether to combine the input mask with other processing steps or keep it separate, affecting the final SEGS output.

inputs.name: crop_factor
inputs.description: Determines the factor by which the mask is cropped, influencing the size and focus area of the resulting SEGS.

inputs.name: bbox_fill
inputs.description: Controls whether bounding boxes are filled, impacting the visual representation of the SEGS.

inputs.name: drop_size
inputs.description: Specifies the minimum size of areas to be included in the SEGS, filtering out smaller regions.

inputs.name: contour_fill
inputs.description: Determines whether contours within the mask are filled, affecting the detail level of the SEGS.

outputs.name: segs
outputs.description: unknown

MaskToSEGS_for_AnimateDiff.description: This node is designed to convert masks into SEGS format specifically tailored for animations with differential impact, accommodating both 2D and 3D masks. It leverages contour filling options and advanced mask processing techniques to ensure the generated SEGS are optimized for animation sequences, handling batch masks with specialized transformations when necessary.

inputs.name: mask
inputs.description: The input mask to be converted into SEGS. This mask can be either 2D or 3D, and it is the primary input for generating SEGS tailored for animations.

inputs.name: combined
inputs.description: A boolean flag indicating whether the mask and the resulting SEGS should be combined, affecting the processing logic of the node.

inputs.name: crop_factor
inputs.description: A factor determining the extent of cropping applied to the mask before conversion, influencing the size and detail of the resulting SEGS.

inputs.name: bbox_fill
inputs.description: A boolean flag that determines whether bounding boxes should be filled, impacting the visual representation of the resulting SEGS.

inputs.name: drop_size
inputs.description: Specifies the minimum size of features to retain in the SEGS, filtering out smaller elements based on this threshold.

inputs.name: contour_fill
inputs.description: A boolean flag indicating whether contours within the mask should be filled, enhancing the detail and completeness of the resulting SEGS.

outputs.name: segs
outputs.description: The output SEGS generated from the input mask, optimized for animations with differential impact. These SEGS are suitable for further processing or visualization in animation workflows.

MediaPipeFaceMeshToSEGS.description: The MediaPipeFaceMeshToSEGS node transforms facial landmarks detected by MediaPipe's FaceMesh into a structured format suitable for SEGS (Segmentation and Geometry Schema), enabling further manipulation and analysis of facial features within the SEGS framework.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The input image on which facial landmark detection is performed. It serves as the basis for generating the SEGS representation of facial features.

inputs.name: crop_factor
inputs.description: Determines the extent to which the detected facial region is cropped. A higher value results in a tighter crop around the facial landmarks, affecting the final SEGS output.

inputs.name: bbox_fill
inputs.description: Specifies how the bounding box around detected facial landmarks is filled, influencing the appearance and structure of the resulting SEGS.

inputs.name: crop_min_size
inputs.description: Sets the minimum size for the cropped facial region, ensuring that the output SEGS does not fall below a certain spatial resolution.

inputs.name: drop_size
inputs.description: Defines the threshold below which detected facial regions are disregarded, preventing the generation of SEGS for insignificantly small facial features.

inputs.name: dilation
inputs.description: Applies a dilation operation to the facial landmarks' bounding box, expanding its size and potentially including additional context in the SEGS output.

inputs.name: face
inputs.description: Indicates whether the face region should be included in the SEGS output, allowing for specific facial feature analysis.

inputs.name: mouth
inputs.description: Determines whether the mouth region is included in the SEGS, enabling detailed examination and manipulation of this specific area.

inputs.name: left_eyebrow
inputs.description: Specifies the inclusion of the left eyebrow in the SEGS output, facilitating focused analysis on this facial feature.

inputs.name: left_eye
inputs.description: Controls the inclusion of the left eye in the SEGS, allowing for targeted manipulation and study of eye-related aspects.

inputs.name: left_pupil
inputs.description: Determines the inclusion of the left pupil in the SEGS, enabling precise analysis and adjustments to this specific part of the eye.

inputs.name: right_eyebrow
inputs.description: Specifies the inclusion of the right eyebrow in the SEGS output, facilitating focused analysis on this facial feature.

inputs.name: right_eye
inputs.description: Controls the inclusion of the right eye in the SEGS, allowing for targeted manipulation and study of eye-related aspects.

inputs.name: right_pupil
inputs.description: Determines the inclusion of the right pupil in the SEGS, enabling precise analysis and adjustments to this specific part of the eye.

outputs.name: segs
outputs.description: The output is a structured SEGS representation of the detected facial landmarks, ready for further processing and analysis within the SEGS framework.

NoiseInjectionDetailerHookProvider.description: This node is designed to inject noise into the detailer process, allowing for enhanced control over the noise characteristics throughout the cycle. It leverages schedules and strength parameters to dynamically adjust the noise injection based on the cycle's progress.

inputs.name: schedule_for_cycle
inputs.description: Specifies the schedule to be used for the noise injection cycle, influencing how noise characteristics are adjusted over time.

inputs.name: source
inputs.description: unknown

inputs.name: seed
inputs.description: A seed value for noise generation, ensuring reproducibility of the noise characteristics.

inputs.name: start_strength
inputs.description: The initial strength of the noise to be injected at the beginning of the cycle.

inputs.name: end_strength
inputs.description: The final strength of the noise to be injected by the end of the cycle, allowing for dynamic adjustment.

outputs.name: detailer_hook
outputs.description: Produces a detailer hook configured for noise injection, ready to be integrated into the detailer process.

NoiseInjectionHookProvider.description: The NoiseInjectionHookProvider node is designed to inject noise into a given input based on a specified schedule, source, and strength parameters. It aims to enhance or alter the characteristics of the input by applying noise, which can be useful in various image and signal processing tasks to simulate real-world conditions or to introduce variability.

inputs.name: schedule_for_iteration
inputs.description: Specifies the schedule to be used for noise injection, affecting how noise is applied over iterations. It plays a crucial role in determining the pattern and intensity of noise injection throughout the process.

inputs.name: source
inputs.description: Indicates the source of the noise to be injected, which can be either CPU or GPU generated noise, affecting the characteristics of the noise.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.description: A seed value for random number generation, ensuring reproducibility of the noise pattern when the same seed is used.

inputs.name: start_strength
inputs.description: The initial strength of the noise to be injected, influencing the intensity of the noise at the beginning of the process.

inputs.name: end_strength
inputs.description: The final strength of the noise to be injected, determining the intensity of the noise at the end of the process.

outputs.name: pk_hook
outputs.description: The output is a hook that conditions the input by injecting noise according to the specified parameters.

ONNXDetectorProvider.description: The ONNXDetectorProvider node is designed to load and provide access to ONNX models for object detection. It serves as a bridge between the ONNX model files and the detection functionality, enabling the use of pre-trained ONNX models for detecting objects within images.

inputs.name: model_name
inputs.description: Specifies the name of the ONNX model to be loaded. This parameter is crucial for identifying and accessing the correct model file for object detection.

outputs.name: bbox_detector
outputs.description: Provides an object detector initialized with the specified ONNX model. This detector is capable of identifying bounding boxes around objects within images.

ONNXDetectorSEGS.description: This node is designed to utilize an ONNX model for detecting and segmenting objects within images. It leverages deep learning techniques to analyze image data and output segmented regions, making it suitable for applications requiring precise object localization and segmentation.

inputs.name: bbox_detector
inputs.description: The bounding box detector model used for detection. It plays a critical role in identifying regions of interest within the image, which are then processed for segmentation.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The input image to be processed. This image is analyzed by the detector model to identify and segment objects within it.

inputs.name: threshold
inputs.description: A threshold value for detection confidence. Objects with confidence scores above this threshold are considered detected and segmented.

inputs.name: dilation
inputs.description: Specifies the dilation factor for the segmented regions. This can be used to expand or contract the segmented areas, affecting the final segmentation output.

inputs.name: crop_factor
inputs.description: A factor that determines how much to crop around the detected objects. It affects the size of the output segmented regions by defining the margin around detected objects.

inputs.name: drop_size
inputs.description: The minimum size of objects to be considered in the segmentation. Objects smaller than this size are ignored, affecting the granularity of the segmentation.

inputs.name: labels
inputs.description: Optional labels to filter the detected objects. Only objects with these labels will be included in the segmentation output.

inputs.name: detailer_hook
inputs.description: An optional hook for custom post-processing of the detected objects. It allows for additional customization of the segmentation process.

outputs.name: segs
outputs.description: The output segmented regions of the image. These regions are the result of the detector model's detection and segmentation process, providing detailed localization of objects within the image.

PixelKSampleHookCombine.description: This node is designed to combine two PixelKSampleHook instances into a single hook, enabling the sequential application of their functionalities in image processing tasks. It serves as a mechanism to extend or modify the behavior of image processing pipelines by chaining multiple hooks together.

inputs.name: hook1
inputs.description: The first PixelKSampleHook instance to be combined. It acts as the initial step in the combined hook's processing sequence.

inputs.name: hook2
inputs.description: The second PixelKSampleHook instance to be combined. It follows the first hook in the processing sequence, allowing for layered modifications or enhancements to the image processing task.

outputs.name: pk_hook
outputs.description: The combined PixelKSampleHook instance, capable of executing the functionalities of both input hooks in sequence during image processing tasks.

PixelKSampleUpscalerProvider.description: This node specializes in upscaling images through a K-sample strategy, leveraging advanced sampling techniques to enhance pixel quality. It simplifies the application of sophisticated upscaling algorithms, aiming to produce higher resolution images with greater detail and clarity.

inputs.name: scale_method
inputs.description: Specifies the method used for upscaling, allowing selection from predefined algorithms to tailor the upscaling process to specific needs.

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: Identifies the model used for upscaling, enabling the application of specific models tailored to enhance image quality.

inputs.name: vae
inputs.description: Specifies the variational autoencoder used in the upscaling process, contributing to the generation of high-quality images.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.description: Sets the seed for random number generation, ensuring reproducibility of the upscaling process.

inputs.name: steps
inputs.description: Defines the number of steps in the upscaling process, allowing control over the refinement level of the upscaled image.

inputs.name: cfg
inputs.description: Configures the conditioning factor, influencing the upscaling process by adjusting the balance between the input image and the generated details.

inputs.name: sampler_name
inputs.description: Specifies the sampler used in the upscaling process, affecting the sampling strategy and ultimately the quality of the upscaled image.

inputs.name: scheduler
inputs.description: Determines the scheduler for the upscaling process, managing the progression of steps to optimize image quality.

inputs.name: positive
inputs.description: Represents positive conditioning data that guides the upscaling towards desired outcomes, emphasizing certain visual features.

inputs.name: negative
inputs.description: Represents negative conditioning data that the upscaling process should minimize, steering the algorithm away from undesired features.

inputs.name: denoise
inputs.description: Controls the level of denoising applied during upscaling, affecting the clarity and detail of the upscaled image.

inputs.name: use_tiled_vae
inputs.description: Indicates whether a tiled VAE is used, affecting the handling of large images by breaking them into manageable tiles for processing.

inputs.name: tile_size
inputs.description: Specifies the size of tiles when using a tiled VAE, impacting the processing of large images by dividing them into smaller, manageable sections.

inputs.name: upscale_model_opt
inputs.description: Optionally specifies an upscale model to be used, allowing for customization of the upscaling process with specific models.

inputs.name: pk_hook_opt
inputs.description: Optionally specifies a post-processing hook, enabling custom post-upscaling adjustments.

inputs.name: scheduler_func_opt
inputs.description: Optionally specifies a scheduler function, allowing for advanced control over the scheduling of upscaling steps.

outputs.name: upscaler
outputs.description: Produces the upscaled image, showcasing the enhanced resolution and detail achieved through the upscaling process.

PixelKSampleUpscalerProviderPipe.description: This node is designed to provide an upscaling service by leveraging the PixelKSample upscaling technique within a pipeline structure. It extends the capabilities of the PixelKSampleUpscalerProvider by adapting its functionality for use in a more complex, pipelined environment, allowing for seamless integration and enhanced scalability in image processing workflows.

inputs.name: scale_method
inputs.description: Specifies the method used for upscaling, allowing selection from predefined methods such as 'nearest-exact', 'bilinear', 'lanczos', and 'area'. This choice directly influences the quality and characteristics of the upscaled image.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.description: Determines the random seed for generating consistent results across upscaling sessions, ensuring reproducibility.

inputs.name: steps
inputs.description: Defines the number of steps to be used in the upscaling process, affecting the detail and quality of the output image.

inputs.name: cfg
inputs.description: Specifies the configuration for the upscaling process, influencing the balance between fidelity to the original image and the introduction of new details.

inputs.name: sampler_name
inputs.description: Selects the sampler to be used in the upscaling process, influencing the initial phase of image generation.

inputs.name: scheduler
inputs.description: Chooses the scheduling strategy for sampling during the upscaling process, affecting the distribution and application of samples.

inputs.name: denoise
inputs.description: Sets the denoising level to be applied during the upscaling process, potentially improving image clarity at the expense of some detail.

inputs.name: use_tiled_vae
inputs.description: A boolean parameter that enables or disables the use of tiled VAEs, impacting the upscaling process by potentially enhancing detail at the cost of increased computational requirements.

inputs.name: basic_pipe
inputs.description: Integrates the node within a basic pipeline structure, facilitating its combination with other processing steps.

inputs.name: tile_size
inputs.description: Defines the size of the tiles used in tiled VAE upscaling, affecting the granularity of the upscaling process.

inputs.name: upscale_model_opt
inputs.description: Optional parameter for selecting a specific upscale model, providing flexibility in choosing the algorithm for upscaling.

inputs.name: pk_hook_opt
inputs.description: Optional parameter for specifying post-processing hooks, which can modify the upscaling results or apply additional effects.

inputs.name: scheduler_func_opt
inputs.description: Optional parameter for specifying a custom scheduling function, offering additional control over the sampling process.

inputs.name: tile_cnet_opt
inputs.description: Optional parameter for specifying a control network option, which can influence the upscaling process by adjusting the content in a targeted manner.

inputs.name: tile_cnet_strength
inputs.description: Determines the strength of the control network's effect on the upscaling process, allowing for fine-tuning of the output.

outputs.name: upscaler
outputs.description: Produces an upscaled version of the input image, utilizing the specified upscaling method and other parameters to enhance image resolution and detail.

PixelTiledKSampleUpscalerProvider.description: This node provides a mechanism for upscaling images using a tiled K-sample approach, leveraging multiple samples per tile to enhance image quality and detail. It integrates with external sampling extensions to facilitate the tiling process, optimizing performance and output quality for high-resolution image generation.

inputs.name: scale_method
inputs.description: Specifies the method used for scaling the image, affecting the overall upscaling process and the quality of the output image.

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: Defines the model used for generating the samples, directly influencing the style and characteristics of the upscaled image.

inputs.name: vae
inputs.description: The variational autoencoder used in conjunction with the model to improve image quality through latent space manipulation.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.description: Determines the random seed for sample generation, ensuring reproducibility of the results.

inputs.name: steps
inputs.description: The number of steps to perform in the sampling process, impacting the detail and quality of the final image.

inputs.name: cfg
inputs.description: Controls the conditioning factor, adjusting the influence of the guidance on the sampling process.

inputs.name: sampler_name
inputs.description: Identifies the specific sampler to be used, affecting the sampling strategy and final image characteristics.

inputs.name: scheduler
inputs.description: Specifies the scheduler for controlling the sampling process, optimizing the balance between quality and performance.

inputs.name: positive
inputs.description: A positive text prompt to guide the image generation towards desired attributes.

inputs.name: negative
inputs.description: A negative text prompt to steer the image generation away from undesired attributes.

inputs.name: denoise
inputs.description: The level of denoising applied to the samples, refining the clarity and quality of the upscaled image.

inputs.name: tile_width
inputs.description: The width of each tile in the tiling strategy, determining the granularity of the upscaling process.

inputs.name: tile_height
inputs.description: The height of each tile, which, along with tile width, defines the tiling pattern and affects the upscaling precision.

inputs.name: tiling_strategy
inputs.description: Describes the strategy for laying out tiles during the upscaling process, influencing the overall efficiency and quality of the output.

inputs.name: upscale_model_opt
inputs.description: Optional upscale model to enhance the upscaling process with a specific algorithm or technique.

inputs.name: pk_hook_opt
inputs.description: Optional post-processing hook to apply custom operations or adjustments after the upscaling process.

inputs.name: tile_cnet_opt
inputs.description: Optional control network to influence the tiling process, potentially improving the coherence and quality of the upscaled image.

inputs.name: tile_cnet_strength
inputs.description: Determines the strength of the control network's influence on the tiling and upscaling process, allowing for fine-tuning of the output.

outputs.name: upscaler
outputs.description: The result of the upscaling process, encapsulating the enhanced image data ready for further processing or display.

PixelTiledKSampleUpscalerProviderPipe.description: This node provides a pipeline for upscaling images using a tiled K-sample upscaling method. It integrates various components such as model selection, VAE, seed, steps, configuration, sampler name, scheduler, denoising, and tiling strategy to perform image upscaling. The node is designed to work with specific upscale models and supports customization through options like upscale model optimization, post-kernel hooks, and tile convolution network options.

inputs.name: scale_method
inputs.description: Specifies the method used for scaling the image, affecting the overall upscaling process.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.description: Determines the random seed used for generating samples, influencing the upscaling's randomness and reproducibility.

inputs.name: steps
inputs.description: Defines the number of steps to perform in the upscaling process, impacting the detail and quality of the output.

inputs.name: cfg
inputs.description: Configuration parameter that influences the sampling behavior and the quality of the generated image.

inputs.name: sampler_name
inputs.description: The name of the sampler used in the upscaling process, affecting the sampling strategy and output quality.

inputs.name: scheduler
inputs.description: Scheduler used to adjust the sampling process over the steps, influencing the progression of detail enhancement.

inputs.name: denoise
inputs.description: Indicates whether denoising is applied during the upscaling process, affecting the clarity and quality of the output image.

inputs.name: tile_width
inputs.description: The width of the tiles used in the tiling strategy, affecting the granularity of processing and potentially the output quality.

inputs.name: tile_height
inputs.description: The height of the tiles used in the tiling strategy, similar to tile width, it affects the granularity of processing.

inputs.name: tiling_strategy
inputs.description: The strategy used for tiling the image during upscaling, influencing how the image is divided and processed.

inputs.name: basic_pipe
inputs.description: A pipeline of basic components required for the upscaling process, including model, VAE, and other essential elements.

inputs.name: upscale_model_opt
inputs.description: Optional parameter for optimizing the upscale model, allowing for customization of the upscaling process.

inputs.name: pk_hook_opt
inputs.description: Optional parameter for post-kernel hooks, enabling further customization of the upscaling process.

inputs.name: tile_cnet_opt
inputs.description: Optional parameter for tile convolution network options, allowing for adjustments in how tiles are processed.

inputs.name: tile_cnet_strength
inputs.description: Strength of the tile convolution network, affecting the intensity of processing on each tile.

outputs.name: upscaler
outputs.description: The upscaler object configured with the provided parameters, ready to perform image upscaling.

PreviewBridge.description: The PreviewBridge node serves as an intermediary for processing and caching images for preview purposes. It manages the refresh logic based on unique identifiers and cached states, loads images from cache or generates new previews as needed, and updates the cache with the new or existing image data.

inputs.name: images
inputs.description: A collection of images to be processed or cached for preview. This parameter is central to determining whether a refresh is needed based on the cache state.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: A single image to be either loaded from cache or to be used in generating a new preview. This parameter plays a key role in the refresh logic and subsequent processing.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The processed or cached image ready for preview. This output is crucial for accessing the updated or existing previews.

outputs.name: mask
outputs.description: The mask associated with the processed or cached image, indicating areas of interest or modification.

PreviewBridgeLatent.description: This node is designed to bridge the gap between various latent representations and their visual previews, adapting to different preview methods and ensuring compatibility with specific latent formats. It plays a crucial role in visualizing latent spaces by converting them into interpretable images, accommodating various generative models and preview techniques.

inputs.name: latent
inputs.description: The latent representation to be visualized. It is crucial for determining the visual output and ensuring it aligns with the selected preview method.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The image data that may be used or modified in the visualization process, depending on the preview method and the presence of a mask.

inputs.name: preview_method
inputs.description: Specifies the method used for visualizing the latent representation. It affects the conversion process and the compatibility with the latent format.

inputs.name: vae_opt
inputs.description: An optional parameter that allows for the specification of a variational autoencoder option, further customizing the visualization process.

outputs.name: latent
outputs.description: The processed latent representation, potentially modified or enhanced through the visualization process.

outputs.name: mask
outputs.description: An optional mask applied to the latent visualization, indicating areas of interest or modification.

PreviewDetailerHookProvider.description: This node provides a mechanism to enhance and detail previews by applying a specific quality setting to images. It utilizes a unique identifier to manage and track the processing of images, ensuring that each image is enhanced according to the specified quality level.

inputs.name: quality
inputs.description: Specifies the quality level for image processing, affecting the clarity and detail of the output image.

outputs.name: detailer_hook
outputs.description: Represents a hook that enhances image previews by applying a specified quality setting.

outputs.name: upscaler_hook
outputs.description: Represents a hook that can be used for upscaling images, although in this context it returns the same hook as for detailing.

ReencodeLatent.description: The ReencodeLatent node is designed for the re-encoding of latent representations. It allows for the transformation of samples through a specified input and output variational autoencoder (VAE), optionally applying tiling strategies during the decode and encode phases to manage large images or patterns.

inputs.name: samples
inputs.description: Specifies the latent samples to be re-encoded. This parameter is crucial as it determines the input data that will undergo the re-encoding process.

inputs.name: tile_mode
inputs.description: Determines the tiling strategy for decoding and encoding, allowing for optimization based on the specific needs of the input and output. It affects how the latent samples are processed, especially in handling large images.

inputs.name: input_vae
inputs.description: The variational autoencoder used for decoding the input samples. It plays a key role in the initial phase of the re-encoding process.

inputs.name: output_vae
inputs.description: The variational autoencoder used for encoding the processed samples into new latent representations. It finalizes the re-encoding process.

inputs.name: tile_size
inputs.description: Specifies the size of the tiles when tiling is applied. This parameter influences the granularity of the processing, especially in large images or patterns.

outputs.name: latent
outputs.description: The re-encoded latent representations of the input samples. This output is the result of the transformation process applied by the node.

ReencodeLatentPipe.description: This node is designed to re-encode latent representations by transforming them through a specified input and output basic pipe. It facilitates the modification of latent spaces, enabling the transition of samples from one latent representation to another, potentially enhancing or altering their characteristics.

inputs.name: samples
inputs.description: The latent samples to be re-encoded. These samples are the starting point for the transformation process.

inputs.name: tile_mode
inputs.description: Specifies the mode of tiling to be used during the re-encoding process, affecting how the samples are decoded and encoded.

inputs.name: input_basic_pipe
inputs.description: The basic pipe through which the samples are initially passed for decoding or transformation.

inputs.name: output_basic_pipe
inputs.description: The basic pipe used for the final encoding or transformation of the samples, determining their new latent representation.

outputs.name: latent
outputs.description: The re-encoded latent samples, representing the transformed latent space.

RegionalPrompt.description: The RegionalPrompt node is designed to generate regional prompts based on specified masks and advanced samplers. It allows for the creation of customized prompts that can be applied to specific regions of an image, enabling targeted modifications or enhancements. This functionality is particularly useful in scenarios where different areas of an image require distinct treatments or effects, facilitating a more granular control over the generation process.

inputs.name: mask
inputs.description: Specifies the region mask to apply the prompt to, defining the area of the image that will be affected by the generated prompt.

inputs.name: advanced_sampler
inputs.description: Determines the advanced sampling technique to be used for the specified region, influencing how the prompt is applied and the resulting modifications.

inputs.name: variation_seed
inputs.description: Controls the seed for variations in the prompt generation, allowing for reproducibility or diversity in the outputs.

inputs.name: variation_strength
inputs.description: Adjusts the strength of variations applied to the prompt, enabling fine-tuning of the prompt's impact on the region.

inputs.name: variation_method
inputs.description: Selects the method for applying variations to the prompt, such as linear or spherical linear interpolation (slerp), affecting the nature of the prompt modifications.

outputs.name: regional_prompts
outputs.description: Generates regional prompts that can be utilized in the RegionalSampler, tailored to the specified regions with the applied variations.

RegionalSampler.description: The RegionalSampler node is designed to selectively apply different sampling strategies across various regions of an input, enhancing the denoising process by adjusting the sampling technique based on regional characteristics. This approach aims to improve the overall harmony and quality of the generated output by compensating for areas that may not be adequately denoised using standard methods.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.description: Random seed to use for generating CPU noise for sampling, influencing the randomness of the sampling process.

inputs.name: seed_ind
inputs.description: unknown

inputs.name: seed_ind_mode
inputs.description: unknown

inputs.name: steps
inputs.description: Total number of sampling steps to be performed, determining the depth of the sampling process.

inputs.name: base_only_steps
inputs.description: unknown

inputs.name: denoise
inputs.description: The amount of noise to remove during the sampling process, affecting the clarity of the generated output.

inputs.name: samples
inputs.description: Input latent image to be processed through the sampling strategy.

inputs.name: base_sampler
inputs.description: The sampler applied outside the area set by the regional_prompt, defining the default sampling strategy.

inputs.name: regional_prompts
inputs.description: The prompt applied to each region, guiding the regional sampling process.

inputs.name: overlap_factor
inputs.description: To smooth the seams of the region boundaries, expand the mask set in regional_prompts by the overlap_factor amount to overlap with other regions.

inputs.name: restore_latent
inputs.description: At each step, restore the noise outside the mask area to its original state, as per the principle of inpainting. This option is provided for backward compatibility, and it is recommended to always set it to true.

inputs.name: additional_mode
inputs.description: Specifies the mode of operation for additional denoising in regions not properly denoised by the primary sampler. It determines whether to disable the feature, increase the total denoise amount, or divide the denoise amount between the primary and recovery samplers.

inputs.name: additional_sampler
inputs.description: Defines the recovery sampler to be used for additional denoising. It can be set automatically based on the primary sampler or manually chosen to best suit the specific needs of the region.

inputs.name: additional_sigma_ratio
inputs.description: Controls the multiplier for the noise schedule applied in the additional denoising step, according to the selected additional_mode.

outputs.name: latent
outputs.description: The output latent image after processing through the regional sampling strategies.

RegionalSamplerAdvanced.description: The RegionalSamplerAdvanced node is designed to enhance image generation processes by applying region-specific sampling techniques. It allows for more precise control over the denoising and detail enhancement in different areas of an image, potentially leading to higher quality and more detailed outputs.

inputs.name: add_noise
inputs.description: Determines whether noise should be added to the sampling process, affecting the initial state of the latent image.

inputs.name: noise_seed
inputs.description: Specifies the random seed for generating noise, ensuring reproducibility in the sampling process.

inputs.name: steps
inputs.description: Defines the total number of sampling steps to be executed, impacting the depth of the denoising process.

inputs.name: start_at_step
inputs.description: Indicates the starting step for applying the sampling, allowing for staged or delayed sampling interventions.

inputs.name: end_at_step
inputs.description: Marks the final step where sampling is applied, controlling the extent of the sampling process.

inputs.name: overlap_factor
inputs.description: Adjusts the overlap between regions to smooth the transitions, enhancing the coherence of the sampled image.

inputs.name: restore_latent
inputs.description: Controls whether to restore the noise outside the mask area to its original state, affecting the fidelity of the inpainting.

inputs.name: return_with_leftover_noise
inputs.description: Decides whether to return the latent image with remaining noise, influencing the final image's texture.

inputs.name: latent_image
inputs.description: The input latent image to be processed, serving as the base for the sampling operations.

inputs.name: base_sampler
inputs.description: The sampler used outside the region specified by the regional prompts, affecting the overall image quality.

inputs.name: regional_prompts
inputs.description: Prompts applied to each specified region, directing the sampling process in those areas.

inputs.name: additional_mode
inputs.description: Specifies the operational mode for additional denoising in specific regions, offering options to either disable the feature, increase the total denoising amount, or balance the denoising between the primary and recovery samplers.

inputs.name: additional_sampler
inputs.description: Determines the recovery sampler to be used for additional denoising in specific regions, with options for automatic selection based on the primary sampler or manual selection for more customized control.

inputs.name: additional_sigma_ratio
inputs.description: Defines the multiplier for the noise schedule in the additional denoising process, affecting how much additional denoising is applied based on the selected mode.

outputs.name: latent
outputs.description: The processed latent image after applying region-specific sampling and denoising techniques.

RemoveImageFromSEGS.description: The `RemoveImageFromSEGS` node is designed to process a collection of segmented images (SEGS) and remove the image data from each segment, effectively leaving the segments with their metadata and masks intact. This operation is useful for scenarios where the image data is no longer needed or desired, and only the segmentation information is of interest.

inputs.name: segs
inputs.description: The `segs` parameter represents the collection of segmented images (SEGS) to be processed. It is crucial for specifying the input segments from which the image data will be removed, maintaining the segmentation's other attributes.

outputs.name: segs
outputs.description: The output is a modified version of the input SEGS, where the image data has been removed from each segment, leaving only the segmentation metadata and masks.

RemoveNoiseMask.description: The RemoveNoiseMask node is designed to process and modify latent representations by removing or altering the noise mask associated with them. This operation is crucial for refining the quality of generated images or for preparing the latent representations for further processing steps that require a specific noise configuration.

inputs.name: samples
inputs.description: The 'samples' parameter represents the latent representations that are to be processed. It plays a crucial role in determining the outcome of the noise mask removal or alteration, affecting the quality and characteristics of the resulting images.

outputs.name: latent
outputs.description: The 'latent' output represents the modified latent representations after the noise mask has been removed or altered. This output is essential for subsequent image generation or processing steps, as it provides a refined basis for further manipulations.

SAMDetectorCombined.description: The SAMDetectorCombined node is designed for generating segmentation masks by leveraging a SAM model. It combines various inputs, including image data and segmentation hints, to produce detailed masks that highlight specific areas of interest within the image. This process is crucial for tasks that require precise image analysis and manipulation, such as object detection and image editing.

inputs.name: sam_model
inputs.description: Specifies the SAM model to be used for mask generation. It plays a crucial role in determining the accuracy and quality of the output masks.

inputs.name: segs
inputs.description: Represents the segmentation data that will be refined by the SAM model to produce the final mask. It's essential for guiding the mask generation process.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The input image on which the mask generation is performed. It serves as the primary data source for the detection process.

inputs.name: detection_hint
inputs.description: Provides hints to the model about the expected location and shape of the object to be masked, enhancing the precision of the detection.

inputs.name: dilation
inputs.description: Adjusts the thickness of the edges in the generated mask, allowing for finer control over the mask's appearance.

inputs.name: threshold
inputs.description: Sets the confidence threshold for mask generation, determining which areas are included in the final mask.

inputs.name: bbox_expansion
inputs.description: Controls the expansion of bounding boxes around detected objects, affecting the mask's coverage area.

inputs.name: mask_hint_threshold
inputs.description: Determines the threshold for applying mask hints, influencing how hints are used to refine the mask.

inputs.name: mask_hint_use_negative
inputs.description: Indicates whether negative hints are used, which can exclude certain areas from the mask, providing more control over the mask's content.

outputs.name: mask
outputs.description: The output is a detailed mask that highlights specific areas of interest within the image, based on the provided inputs and model predictions.

SAMDetectorSegmented.description: The SAMDetectorSegmented node is designed for generating segmented masks based on the SAM model. It processes an image along with segmentation hints and other parameters to produce a detailed mask that highlights specific areas of interest within the image.

inputs.name: sam_model
inputs.description: The SAM model used for generating the mask. It plays a crucial role in determining the areas of interest within the image based on the provided segmentation hints.

inputs.name: segs
inputs.description: Segmentation details that guide the mask generation process, enhancing the precision of the areas to be highlighted.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The input image to be processed. It serves as the base for mask generation, with the SAM model and segmentation hints refining the output.

inputs.name: detection_hint
inputs.description: Hints that guide the detection process, allowing for more focused and accurate mask generation.

inputs.name: dilation
inputs.description: The dilation parameter adjusts the thickness of the mask's edges, allowing for finer control over the mask's boundary.

inputs.name: threshold
inputs.description: A threshold value that determines the sensitivity of mask generation, influencing the areas that will be highlighted.

inputs.name: bbox_expansion
inputs.description: Controls the expansion of bounding boxes, which can affect the overall size and coverage of the generated mask.

inputs.name: mask_hint_threshold
inputs.description: Sets the threshold for mask hints, influencing how hints are interpreted and applied during mask generation.

inputs.name: mask_hint_use_negative
inputs.description: Determines whether negative hints are used, affecting the exclusion of certain areas from the mask.

outputs.name: combined_mask
outputs.description: The combined mask output represents the aggregated result of the segmented mask generation, highlighting areas of interest across the entire image.

outputs.name: batch_masks
outputs.description: The batch masks output provides individual segmented masks for each segment processed, offering detailed insights into specific areas of interest.

SAMLoader.description: The SAMLoader node is designed to dynamically load and manage different types of SAM (Spatial Attention Model) models, including ESAM (Efficient SAM) and various Vision Transformer (ViT) models. It handles model initialization, device allocation (CPU or GPU), and ensures the necessary dependencies and extensions are installed for specific model types.

inputs.name: model_name
inputs.description: Specifies the name of the SAM model to be loaded. This can include 'ESAM' for Efficient SAM models or names indicating different Vision Transformer models like 'vit_h', 'vit_l', 'vit_b'.

inputs.name: device_mode
inputs.description: Determines the device (CPU or GPU) on which the model will be loaded and run, with support for automatic device selection based on the model's requirements and system capabilities.

outputs.name: sam_model
outputs.description: Returns the loaded SAM model, ready for further operations such as inference. The model is wrapped in a SAMWrapper or ESAMWrapper, depending on the model type, to facilitate device management and prediction.

SegmDetectorCombined_v2.description: The SegmDetectorCombined_v2 node is designed for image segmentation tasks, combining detection and segmentation processes to output a mask representing the segmented areas of the input image. It abstracts the complexity of underlying segmentation models and detection algorithms, providing a streamlined interface for generating segmentation masks.

inputs.name: segm_detector
inputs.description: The segmentation detector model used for detecting and segmenting objects within the image. It plays a crucial role in the overall segmentation process.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The input image to be processed for segmentation. The image is analyzed to identify and segment relevant objects or areas.

inputs.name: threshold
inputs.description: A threshold value used to determine the sensitivity of the segmentation detection. It influences the segmentation outcome by filtering out detections below this threshold.

inputs.name: dilation
inputs.description: Specifies the dilation level applied to the segmentation masks, affecting the mask's boundary smoothness and size.

outputs.name: mask
outputs.description: The output segmentation mask, indicating the segmented areas of the input image.

SegmDetectorSEGS.description: This node is designed to process images through segmentation models to detect and segment objects within the images. It applies various operations such as thresholding and dilation to refine the segmentation masks, and optionally crops the images based on the detected segments. The node aims to facilitate detailed object analysis within images by providing segmented regions along with their corresponding metadata.

inputs.name: segm_detector
inputs.description: Specifies the segmentation detector to be used for detecting and segmenting objects within the image. It is crucial for defining the detection capabilities and accuracy of the node.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The input image to be processed. This image is analyzed by the segmentation model to identify and segment objects.

inputs.name: threshold
inputs.description: A threshold value used to determine the sensitivity of object detection. Higher values result in fewer detections with higher confidence.

inputs.name: dilation
inputs.description: An integer value specifying the amount of dilation to apply to the segmentation masks, enhancing the visibility and separation of detected objects.

inputs.name: crop_factor
inputs.description: Determines the extent to which the image is cropped around the detected segments, allowing for focused analysis on specific objects.

inputs.name: drop_size
inputs.description: Specifies the minimum size for detected objects to be considered valid. Objects smaller than this size are dropped from the results.

inputs.name: labels
inputs.description: A list of labels to filter the detected segments. Only segments with matching labels are included in the results.

inputs.name: detailer_hook
inputs.description: An optional hook for custom post-processing of the detected segments. It allows for further refinement of the segmentation results.

outputs.name: segs
outputs.description: Provides detailed segmentation results, including the shape of the original image and a list of segmented objects with their respective masks, confidence levels, and bounding boxes.

SEGSDetailer.description: The SEGSDetailer node is designed to enhance and refine segmentation details within images, focusing on improving the quality and precision of segmentation results. It employs advanced processing techniques to adjust and optimize segmentation data, ensuring higher fidelity and utility for subsequent analysis or applications.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The input image to be detailed or refined. It serves as the foundation for the segmentation detailing process, directly influencing the enhancements applied to the segmentation results.

inputs.name: segs
inputs.description: The segmentation data to be enhanced or refined. This input is crucial for the node's operation as it represents the target of the detailing process, affecting the quality and precision of the output.

inputs.name: guide_size
inputs.description: Specifies the target size for guiding the detailing process. It plays a significant role in determining the scale and detail level of the output segmentation.

inputs.name: guide_size_for
inputs.description: Determines the context or specific elements within the image for which the guide size is applicable, influencing the focus and precision of the detailing process.

inputs.name: max_size
inputs.description: Defines the maximum size limit for the detailing process. It ensures that the output segmentation does not exceed this size, affecting the balance between detail and computational efficiency.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.description: A seed value for random number generation, ensuring reproducibility of the detailing process. It influences the variability and consistency of the output.

inputs.name: steps
inputs.description: The number of steps to execute in the detailing process, affecting the depth of refinement and the quality of the output segmentation.

inputs.name: cfg
inputs.description: Configuration settings for the detailing process, guiding the algorithm's behavior and affecting the outcome's quality.

inputs.name: sampler_name
inputs.description: Specifies the sampling method to be used in the detailing process, influencing the texture and quality of the detailed segments.

inputs.name: scheduler
inputs.description: The scheduler algorithm used to manage the detailing process, affecting the efficiency and outcome of the segmentation refinement.

inputs.name: denoise
inputs.description: Indicates whether denoising techniques are applied during the detailing process, improving the clarity and quality of the output segmentation.

inputs.name: noise_mask
inputs.description: A mask applied to specify areas for noise reduction, focusing the denoising effect and enhancing the detailing precision.

inputs.name: force_inpaint
inputs.description: Forces the use of inpainting in areas lacking detail, improving the completeness and quality of the segmentation.

inputs.name: basic_pipe
inputs.description: The basic processing pipeline configurations used for the detailing process, setting the foundation for the enhancement techniques applied.

inputs.name: refiner_ratio
inputs.description: The ratio of refinement applied to the segmentation, adjusting the intensity of detailing and affecting the final output's precision.

inputs.name: batch_size
inputs.description: The size of the batch processed in a single detailing operation, affecting the throughput and efficiency of the node.

inputs.name: cycle
inputs.description: The number of cycles the detailing process is repeated, influencing the depth of refinement and the quality of the output segmentation.

inputs.name: refiner_basic_pipe_opt
inputs.description: Optional configurations for the refinement pipeline, allowing for customization of the detailing process to achieve specific outcomes.

inputs.name: inpaint_model
inputs.description: Indicates whether an inpainting model is used during the detailing process, enabling the filling of missing or incomplete segments for a more complete output.

inputs.name: noise_mask_feather
inputs.description: The feathering applied to the noise mask, smoothing the transition between treated and untreated areas, and enhancing the visual quality of the detailed segmentation.

inputs.name: scheduler_func_opt
inputs.description: Optional configurations for the scheduler function, allowing for further customization of the detailing process to optimize performance and results.

outputs.name: segs
outputs.description: Outputs the enhanced or refined segmentation data, reflecting the improvements made by the node.

outputs.name: cnet_images
outputs.description: Provides a list of images processed through the control net, useful for visualizing the effects of the detailing process on the segmentation.

SEGSDetailerForAnimateDiff.description: This node specializes in enhancing the detail and quality of segmentation maps specifically for animated differences, utilizing a detailed processing pipeline to refine and adjust segmentation outputs for improved animation effects. It operates by taking in image frames and segmentation maps, applying a series of refinements, and outputting enhanced segmentation maps along with corresponding control net images.

inputs.name: image_frames
inputs.description: The sequence of image frames to be processed. It plays a crucial role in guiding the detail enhancement process by providing the visual context necessary for refining the segmentation maps.

inputs.name: segs
inputs.description: The initial segmentation maps that are to be enhanced. These maps are crucial for the node's operation as they serve as the base upon which refinements are applied to improve the animation effect.

inputs.name: guide_size
inputs.description: Specifies the target size for guiding the detail enhancement process. It affects the scaling of the input segmentation maps and image frames, impacting the precision and quality of the output.

inputs.name: guide_size_for
inputs.description: Indicates the specific purpose or target for the guide size, affecting how the detail enhancement process is tailored to different animation requirements.

inputs.name: max_size
inputs.description: The maximum allowable size for the processed outputs, ensuring that the enhanced segmentation maps and control net images do not exceed this limit, which helps in managing resource utilization.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.description: A seed value for ensuring reproducibility in the detail enhancement process. It influences the randomness in the process, allowing for consistent results across runs.

inputs.name: steps
inputs.description: The number of steps to execute in the detail enhancement process, affecting the depth of refinement applied to the segmentation maps and the overall quality of the output.

inputs.name: cfg
inputs.description: Configuration settings for the detail enhancement process, providing flexibility in adjusting the parameters and algorithms used for refining the segmentation maps.

inputs.name: sampler_name
inputs.description: Specifies the sampling method to be used in the detail enhancement process, influencing the approach to refining the segmentation maps and control net images.

inputs.name: scheduler
inputs.description: The scheduler to be used in the detail enhancement process, coordinating the execution of steps and the application of refinements to the segmentation maps.

inputs.name: denoise
inputs.description: A flag indicating whether denoising should be applied during the detail enhancement process, which can help in improving the clarity and quality of the output segmentation maps.

inputs.name: basic_pipe
inputs.description: Specifies the basic processing pipeline to be used for the initial stages of the detail enhancement process, setting the foundation for further refinements.

inputs.name: refiner_ratio
inputs.description: The ratio of refinement to be applied, determining the extent of detail enhancement in relation to the initial processing. It allows for fine-tuning the balance between refinement and original detail.

inputs.name: refiner_basic_pipe_opt
inputs.description: Optional configurations for the basic processing pipeline during the refinement stage, offering additional customization for the detail enhancement process.

inputs.name: noise_mask_feather
inputs.description: The feathering value for noise masks, affecting the smoothness of transitions and blending in the enhanced segmentation maps.

inputs.name: scheduler_func_opt
inputs.description: Optional configurations for the scheduler function, providing further customization for the coordination and execution of the detail enhancement process.

outputs.name: segs
outputs.description: The enhanced segmentation maps, which have been refined and adjusted for improved animation effects, showcasing the effectiveness of the detail enhancement process.

outputs.name: cnet_images
outputs.description: The control net images corresponding to the enhanced segmentation maps, which are used to guide further processing and refinement for animation purposes.

SEGSLabelFilterDetailerHookProvider.description: The SEGSLabelFilterDetailerHookProvider node is designed to create and configure a detailer hook that filters segments based on specified labels. It allows for the customization of segment filtering through user-defined labels, enabling the targeting of specific segment types for processing or exclusion.

inputs.name: segs
inputs.description: The 'segs' parameter represents the segments to be filtered. It is crucial for determining which segments are subject to the filtering process.

inputs.name: preset
inputs.description: The 'preset' parameter allows for the selection of a predefined set of labels or the inclusion of all detection labels. This flexibility aids in quickly configuring the filter based on common use cases or custom requirements.

inputs.name: labels
inputs.description: The 'labels' parameter specifies the types of segments to be allowed, separated by commas. It directly influences the filtering outcome by defining which segment labels are considered valid for inclusion.

outputs.name: detailer_hook
outputs.description: This output represents the configured detailer hook, ready to be applied for segment filtering based on the specified labels.

SEGSOrderedFilterDetailerHookProvider.description: The SEGSOrderedFilterDetailerHookProvider node is designed to create a detailer hook that filters and orders segmentation results based on specified criteria. It allows for the customization of the ordering and filtering process, enabling the selection and prioritization of segmentation results according to user-defined parameters.

inputs.name: target
inputs.description: Specifies the target attribute of the segmentation results to be filtered and ordered. This could be attributes like area, width, height, or coordinates, which determine the basis for filtering and ordering.

inputs.name: order
inputs.description: Determines the order in which the segmentation results are sorted. A boolean value where True indicates descending order and False indicates ascending order.

inputs.name: take_start
inputs.description: Defines the starting index from which to take the filtered and ordered segmentation results, allowing for pagination or skipping initial results.

inputs.name: take_count
inputs.description: Specifies the number of segmentation results to take after applying the filter and order, enabling control over the quantity of results returned.

outputs.name: detailer_hook
outputs.description: Returns a detailer hook configured to filter and order segmentation results based on the provided criteria.

SEGSPaste.description: This node specializes in blending and manipulating image segments, leveraging latent space representations to achieve seamless integration of visual elements. It focuses on the precise control over the placement and blending of image segments within a given scene, enhancing the overall composition through advanced conditioning techniques.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: A string path or identifier for an image that is to be blended or manipulated within the scene. It serves as a secondary input for visual reference or direct integration.

inputs.name: segs
inputs.description: Represents the segments to be manipulated or blended, providing the primary elements for visual composition within the node.

inputs.name: feather
inputs.description: Defines the feathering amount for the edges of the segments, allowing for smoother integration into the target scene.

inputs.name: alpha
inputs.description: Specifies the opacity level of the segments, enabling fine-tuned control over their visibility and blending with the background.

inputs.name: ref_image_opt
inputs.description: Optional. A reference image that can be used for additional context or alignment purposes during the manipulation process.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: Outputs the modified image after the blending and manipulation processes, incorporating the segments seamlessly into the scene.

SEGSPreview.description: The SEGSPreview node is designed to generate previews of segmentation images, specifically focusing on the control network aspect of these images. It processes a batch of segmentation data, extracting and saving control network images for each segment, and returns a list of these images along with their metadata.

inputs.name: segs
inputs.description: The 'segs' parameter represents the segmentation data to be processed. It is crucial for generating the control network images and their previews, as it contains the necessary information for each segment.

inputs.name: alpha_mode
inputs.description: This parameter determines the mode of alpha blending used in the preview generation, affecting the transparency and overlay of images.

inputs.name: min_alpha
inputs.description: Specifies the minimum alpha value for transparency in the preview images, controlling the visibility of underlying layers.

inputs.name: fallback_image_opt
inputs.description: An optional fallback image to use when segmentation data is incomplete or missing, ensuring a default visual is available.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The 'image' output type represents the final image or images generated by the node, encapsulating the visual result of the processing.

SEGSPreviewCNet.description: SEGSPreviewCNet is designed to generate previews of segmentation results, specifically focusing on the control networks associated with each segmentation. It saves these previews as images, facilitating a visual inspection of how control networks influence the segmentation process.

inputs.name: segs
inputs.description: The 'segs' parameter represents the segmentation results to be previewed. It is crucial for generating the control network-based previews, as it contains the segmentation data along with associated control network information.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: unknown

SEGSRangeFilterDetailerHookProvider.description: The SEGSRangeFilterDetailerHookProvider node is designed to create and configure a detailer hook that filters segments based on a range criteria. It allows for the dynamic filtering of segments within specified minimum and maximum values, tailored to various segment properties such as area, width, height, and coordinates. This node is instrumental in refining segment selection for further processing or analysis, enhancing the precision and relevance of the output.

inputs.name: target
inputs.description: Specifies the segment property to be filtered on, such as area, width, height, or coordinates. This parameter determines the basis for the range filtering operation.

inputs.name: mode
inputs.description: Determines the filtering mode, either including segments within the specified range ('inside') or excluding them ('outside'). This affects how the range criteria are applied to the segment selection.

inputs.name: min_value
inputs.description: Sets the minimum value of the range for the specified segment property. Segments with values below this threshold can be either included or excluded based on the mode.

inputs.name: max_value
inputs.description: Defines the maximum value of the range for the specified segment property. Segments with values above this threshold can be either included or excluded based on the mode.

outputs.name: detailer_hook
outputs.description: Produces a configured detailer hook capable of filtering segments based on the specified range criteria. This hook can be applied to segment data to refine the selection process.

SEGSSwitch.description: The SEGSSwitch node dynamically selects between multiple segmentation (SEGS) inputs based on a specified index. It facilitates conditional processing paths within a pipeline, allowing for the flexible use of different segmentation data.

inputs.name: select
inputs.description: Specifies the index of the segmentation input to select. This index determines which segmentation data is used for processing, enabling dynamic choice based on conditions or preferences.

inputs.name: sel_mode
inputs.description: unknown

inputs.name: input1
inputs.description: unknown

outputs.name: selected_value
outputs.description: unknown

outputs.name: selected_label
outputs.description: unknown

outputs.name: selected_index
outputs.description: unknown

SegsToCombinedMask.description: This node is designed to transform a collection of segmented objects (segs) into a single, combined mask. It effectively merges individual segment masks into a unified mask representation, facilitating operations that require a holistic view of all segments within an image.

inputs.name: segs
inputs.description: The 'segs' parameter represents a collection of segmented objects. It is crucial for defining the segments to be combined into a single mask, affecting the overall composition and appearance of the resulting mask.

outputs.name: mask
outputs.description: The output is a tensor representation of the combined mask, where the individual segment masks have been merged into a unified mask. This mask is suitable for further processing or analysis.

SEGSToImageList.description: The SEGSToImageList node is designed to convert segmentation data into a list of images. It optionally adjusts the scale of segmentation data to match a fallback image and extracts cropped images from the segmentation data, providing a flexible way to handle segmentation outputs for further processing or visualization.

inputs.name: segs
inputs.description: The primary input containing segmentation data. It is essential for the operation as it holds the segments to be converted into images.

inputs.name: fallback_image_opt
inputs.description: An optional image used to match the scale of segmentation data. If provided, it ensures that the segmentation data is appropriately scaled to align with the fallback image's dimensions.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: A list of images extracted from the segmentation data. Each image corresponds to a cropped area from the original segmentation, potentially adjusted for scale.

SEGSUpscaler.description: The SEGSUpscaler node is designed to upscale images by segmenting them into smaller sections, enhancing each segment individually using a combination of models and techniques, and then reassembling the enhanced segments back into a single, upscaled image. This process allows for more detailed and controlled upscaling, leveraging the power of segmentation to address specific areas of an image for improvement.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The original image to be upscaled. It serves as the base for segmentation and subsequent upscaling processes.

inputs.name: segs
inputs.description: A collection of image segments, each representing a portion of the original image to be individually upscaled and enhanced.

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: The primary model used for processing and enhancing the image segments.

inputs.name: clip
inputs.description: The CLIP model used for guiding the enhancement process based on textual descriptions.

inputs.name: vae
inputs.description: The VAE model used for encoding and decoding image segments during the upscaling process.

inputs.name: rescale_factor
inputs.description: The factor by which the image will be rescaled as part of the upscaling process.

inputs.name: resampling_method
inputs.description: The method used for resampling the image during the upscaling process, affecting the quality and characteristics of the upscaled image.

inputs.name: supersample
inputs.description: Indicates whether supersampling is applied to the image for enhanced upscaling quality.

inputs.name: rounding_modulus
inputs.description: A value used to adjust the dimensions of the upscaled image, ensuring they are multiples of a specific number.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.description: A seed value for random number generation, ensuring reproducibility of the upscaling process across segments.

inputs.name: steps
inputs.description: The number of steps to perform in the image enhancement process for each segment.

inputs.name: cfg
inputs.description: Configuration settings for the image enhancement process, guiding the behavior of the models used.

inputs.name: sampler_name
inputs.description: The name of the sampling method used in the image enhancement process, affecting the generation of enhanced segments.

inputs.name: scheduler
inputs.description: The scheduler used to control the progression of steps in the image enhancement process.

inputs.name: positive
inputs.description: Positive text prompts used to guide the image enhancement process.

inputs.name: negative
inputs.description: Negative text prompts used to counterbalance the positive prompts, refining the enhancement process.

inputs.name: denoise
inputs.description: A parameter controlling the level of denoising applied to each image segment during enhancement.

inputs.name: feather
inputs.description: The feathering value applied to the edges of image segments, smoothing transitions between enhanced segments and the rest of the image.

inputs.name: inpaint_model
inputs.description: The model used for inpainting, filling in areas of the image that may be missing or require correction after segmentation.

inputs.name: noise_mask_feather
inputs.description: The feathering value applied to the noise mask, smoothing the application of noise adjustments across image segments.

inputs.name: upscale_model_opt
inputs.description: An optional model specifically designed for upscaling, providing an alternative or supplementary method to the main upscaling process.

inputs.name: upscaler_hook_opt
inputs.description: An optional hook allowing for custom post-processing steps after each segment is upscaled and reassembled into the final image.

inputs.name: scheduler_func_opt
inputs.description: An optional scheduler function providing additional control over the scheduling of enhancement steps for each segment.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The final, upscaled image, composed of individually enhanced and reassembled image segments.

SEGSUpscalerPipe.description: The SEGSUpscalerPipe node is designed for upscaling images using segmentation maps as guidance. It integrates with a basic pipeline to enhance image resolution while considering the segmentation details, ensuring that the upscale process respects the original image's segmented regions.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The original image to be upscaled. It serves as the primary input for the upscaling process.

inputs.name: segs
inputs.description: Segmentation maps corresponding to the original image. These maps guide the upscaling process to maintain fidelity to the segmented regions.

inputs.name: basic_pipe
inputs.description: A collection of models and configurations used in the upscaling process, including model, clip, vae, and settings for sampling and scheduling.

inputs.name: rescale_factor
inputs.description: The factor by which the image will be upscaled. It determines the increase in resolution.

inputs.name: resampling_method
inputs.description: The method used for resampling during the upscaling process, affecting the quality of the upscaled image.

inputs.name: supersample
inputs.description: A boolean indicating whether to apply supersampling, which can enhance the upscaling quality by reducing aliasing.

inputs.name: rounding_modulus
inputs.description: A value used to round the upscaled image dimensions, ensuring they are multiples of this modulus.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.description: The seed for random number generation, ensuring reproducibility of the upscaling process.

inputs.name: steps
inputs.description: The number of steps to perform in the upscaling process, affecting the detail and quality of the result.

inputs.name: cfg
inputs.description: Configuration settings for the upscaling process, including parameters for the model and sampling.

inputs.name: sampler_name
inputs.description: The name of the sampler to use during upscaling, influencing the texture and details of the upscaled image.

inputs.name: scheduler
inputs.description: The scheduler used to adjust the learning rate during the upscaling process, affecting the convergence and quality.

inputs.name: denoise
inputs.description: A boolean indicating whether to apply denoising, which can improve the visual quality of the upscaled image by reducing noise.

inputs.name: feather
inputs.description: The feathering amount applied to the edges of the segmentation maps, smoothing transitions between segments.
