inputs.name: inpaint_model
inputs.description: The model used for inpainting missing or uncertain areas in the upscaled image, enhancing overall quality.

inputs.name: noise_mask_feather
inputs.description: The amount of feathering applied to the noise mask, affecting the blending of noise-reduced areas.

inputs.name: upscale_model_opt
inputs.description: Optional configurations for the upscale model, allowing customization of the upscaling process.

inputs.name: upscaler_hook_opt
inputs.description: Optional hooks to modify the behavior of the upscaler, enabling advanced customization.

inputs.name: scheduler_func_opt
inputs.description: Optional scheduler functions to further customize the learning rate adjustment during upscaling.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The upscaled image, enhanced in resolution while preserving the details and regions defined by the segmentation maps.

SetDefaultImageForSEGS.description: This node is designed to set a default image for SEGS (segmentation structures) in scenarios where the original image might be missing or not applicable. It ensures that each segment within the SEGS structure has a consistent and predefined visual representation, facilitating further processing or visualization steps without dependency on the original image data.

inputs.name: segs
inputs.description: The 'segs' input represents the segmentation structures for which a default image is to be set. This input is crucial for identifying the segments that require a default image assignment.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The 'image' input specifies the default image to be applied across all segments within the SEGS structure. It plays a key role in ensuring visual consistency across segments.

inputs.name: override
inputs.description: The 'override' input indicates whether the default image should replace existing images within the SEGS structure, allowing for flexible control over image assignment.

outputs.name: segs
outputs.description: The output 'segs' consists of the updated segmentation structures with the default image applied, ready for further processing or visualization.

StepsScheduleHookProvider.description: The StepsScheduleHookProvider node is designed to generate hooks that adjust the number of steps in a generative process based on a simple schedule. This allows for dynamic modification of the iteration steps during the generation process, aiming to optimize or alter the progression of the generative task.

inputs.name: schedule_for_iteration
inputs.description: Specifies the scheduling strategy to be used for iteration adjustments. The choice of schedule affects how the number of steps is dynamically adjusted during the generation process.

inputs.name: target_steps
inputs.description: Defines the target number of steps to aim for at the end of the generation process. This parameter directly influences the adjustment of steps in the generative task, aiming to reach the specified target.

outputs.name: pk_hook
outputs.description: Returns a hook configured to adjust the number of steps in the generative process according to the specified schedule and target steps.

StringListToString.description: This node is designed to concatenate a list of strings into a single string, using a specified delimiter. It allows for flexible string manipulation, particularly useful for aggregating multiple pieces of text with custom spacing or formatting.

inputs.name: join_with
inputs.description: Specifies the delimiter to use for joining the list of strings. The default delimiter is a newline character, allowing for easy creation of multi-line strings from a list.

inputs.name: string_list
inputs.description: The list of strings to be concatenated. This input is marked as required, emphasizing its critical role in the node's operation.

outputs.name: string
outputs.description: The concatenated string, formed by joining the input list of strings with the specified delimiter.

SubtractMask.description: The SubtractMask node is designed for performing pixel-wise subtraction between two mask images, resulting in a new mask that highlights the differences. This operation is fundamental in image processing tasks where the goal is to isolate changes or differences between two images.

inputs.name: mask1
inputs.description: The first mask image to be subtracted from. It plays a crucial role in determining the base or reference for the subtraction operation.

inputs.name: mask2
inputs.description: The second mask image to be subtracted. This mask is subtracted from the first one to highlight differences.

outputs.name: mask
outputs.description: The resulting mask after subtracting mask2 from mask1, highlighting the differences between the two.

SubtractMaskForEach.description: The SubtractMaskForEach node is designed to perform a bitwise subtraction operation between segmentation masks (SEGS) and a base mask, producing a modified set of segmentation masks. This operation is useful in scenarios where it's necessary to remove specific features or areas from a set of segmentation masks based on another mask.

inputs.name: base_segs
inputs.description: The base segmentation masks (SEGS) from which features or areas will be subtracted.

inputs.name: mask_segs
inputs.description: The segmentation masks (SEGS) that will be used as the subtraction mask, indicating the features or areas to be removed from the base segmentation masks.

outputs.name: segs
outputs.description: The resulting set of segmentation masks (segs) after the subtraction operation, with specific features or areas removed.

TiledKSamplerProvider.description: The TiledKSamplerProvider node is designed to facilitate the use of tiled sampling techniques within the ComfyUI framework. It dynamically integrates with the 'TiledKSampler' custom node, ensuring compatibility and extending functionality for advanced image generation tasks. This node acts as a bridge, enabling users to leverage tiled sampling strategies for improved performance and quality in image synthesis.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.description: Determines the random seed used for generating CPU noise for sampling, ensuring reproducibility and consistency in the sampling process.

inputs.name: steps
inputs.description: Specifies the total number of sampling steps to be executed, directly influencing the depth and detail of the sampling process.

inputs.name: cfg
inputs.description: Sets the classifier free guidance value, adjusting the influence of conditioning on the sampling process for targeted image generation.

inputs.name: sampler_name
inputs.description: Selects the specific sampler algorithm to be used, affecting the sampling behavior and output characteristics.

inputs.name: scheduler
inputs.description: Specifies the scheduler for controlling the sampling process, impacting the progression and quality of image generation.

inputs.name: denoise
inputs.description: Adjusts the level of denoising applied during the sampling process, affecting the clarity and sharpness of the generated images.

inputs.name: tile_width
inputs.description: Sets the width of the tiles used in the sampling process, influencing the granularity and detail of the output.

inputs.name: tile_height
inputs.description: Sets the height of the tiles used in the sampling process, influencing the granularity and detail of the output.

inputs.name: tiling_strategy
inputs.description: Determines the strategy for tiling during the sampling process, affecting the overall composition and coherence of the generated images.

inputs.name: basic_pipe
inputs.description: A crucial input comprising the model and conditioning texts, which are essential for the sampling process. It determines the characteristics of the generated images by providing the necessary context and parameters for targeted image synthesis.

outputs.name: ksampler
outputs.description: Outputs a sampler wrapper, which can be utilized for generating regional prompts in advanced image generation tasks.

ToBasicPipe.description: The ToBasicPipe node is designed to aggregate essential components for a generative pipeline into a single, basic pipeline structure. It combines models, clips, VAEs, and conditioning information into a unified format, facilitating easier manipulation and use in subsequent processes.

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: The model parameter represents the core generative model to be included in the basic pipeline. It is crucial for the generation process.

inputs.name: clip
inputs.description: The clip parameter is included to provide additional context or constraints for the generation process, enhancing the output's relevance or quality.

inputs.name: vae
inputs.description: The vae parameter is a variational autoencoder used for processing or transforming the input data, playing a significant role in the pipeline's functionality.

inputs.name: positive
inputs.description: The positive conditioning information guides the generation towards desired attributes or characteristics.

inputs.name: negative
inputs.description: The negative conditioning information steers the generation away from undesired attributes or characteristics, refining the output.

outputs.name: basic_pipe
outputs.description: The basic_pipe output encapsulates the combined model, clip, VAE, and conditioning information into a single, manageable structure for further processing.

ToBinaryMask.description: The ToBinaryMask node is designed to convert a given mask into a binary mask based on a specified threshold. This operation is fundamental in image processing tasks where binary masks are required to distinguish between areas of interest and the background.

inputs.name: mask
inputs.description: The mask input represents the original mask that will be converted into a binary format. The conversion is based on the threshold value, making this input crucial for the operation's outcome.

inputs.name: threshold
inputs.description: The threshold input determines the cutoff value for converting the original mask into a binary mask. Pixels with values above this threshold will be considered as part of the mask, affecting the binary mask's final appearance.

outputs.name: mask
outputs.description: The output is a binary mask where each pixel is either 0 or 1, indicating whether it belongs to the mask or the background, respectively.

ToDetailerPipe.description: The ToDetailerPipe node is designed to transform various model components and configurations into a detailed pipeline format. It focuses on enhancing the specificity and impact of model outputs by incorporating additional conditioning and refinement processes.

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: The 'model' parameter represents the core model to be included in the detailer pipeline, serving as the foundation for further enhancements and conditioning.

inputs.name: clip
inputs.description: The 'clip' parameter specifies the CLIP model to be used in conjunction with the main model for enhanced content understanding and generation.

inputs.name: vae
inputs.description: The 'vae' parameter involves a Variational Autoencoder (VAE) model, which is used for generating or modifying content within the pipeline.

inputs.name: positive
inputs.description: The 'positive' parameter is used for positive conditioning, influencing the model to generate content that aligns with specified positive attributes.

inputs.name: negative
inputs.description: The 'negative' parameter is used for negative conditioning, guiding the model to avoid generating content with specified negative attributes.

inputs.name: bbox_detector
inputs.description: The 'bbox_detector' parameter specifies the bounding box detector model used for identifying specific areas within images for focused processing or analysis.

inputs.name: wildcard
inputs.description: The 'wildcard' parameter allows for the inclusion of dynamic, user-defined text inputs that can influence the pipeline's processing and output generation.

inputs.name: Select to add LoRA
inputs.description: This parameter enables the selection of LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation) techniques to be added to the text, enhancing the model's adaptability and performance on specific tasks.

inputs.name: Select to add Wildcard
inputs.description: This parameter allows for the selection of predefined wildcard options to be added to the text, introducing variability and customization into the pipeline's output.

inputs.name: sam_model_opt
inputs.description: The 'sam_model_opt' parameter specifies an optional SAM (Sharpness-Aware Minimization) model to enhance the detailer pipeline's ability to generate sharp and clear images.

inputs.name: segm_detector_opt
inputs.description: The 'segm_detector_opt' parameter specifies an optional segmentation detector model used for identifying and segmenting specific parts of images for detailed processing.

inputs.name: detailer_hook
inputs.description: The 'detailer_hook' parameter allows for the inclusion of custom processing hooks within the detailer pipeline, enabling tailored modifications or enhancements to the pipeline's operation.

outputs.name: detailer_pipe
outputs.description: The output 'detailer_pipe' represents the comprehensive pipeline configuration, including all model components and settings specified through the input parameters.

ToDetailerPipeSDXL.description: The ToDetailerPipeSDXL node is designed to transform and refine input data through a series of conditioning and detection processes, preparing it for detailed image generation or enhancement. It leverages multiple models and techniques, including CLIP, VAE, and bounding box detection, to achieve precise and context-aware results.

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: Specifies the primary model used for generating or refining images, playing a central role in the overall processing pipeline.

inputs.name: clip
inputs.description: Defines the CLIP model used for understanding and interpreting the content of images or text, aiding in the alignment of generated content with specified conditions.

inputs.name: vae
inputs.description: Indicates the VAE (Variational Autoencoder) model employed for encoding and decoding images, facilitating the manipulation of image features in latent space.

inputs.name: positive
inputs.description: A set of positive conditioning factors that guide the generation or refinement process towards desired attributes or features.

inputs.name: negative
inputs.description: A set of negative conditioning factors used to steer the generation or refinement process away from certain attributes or features.

inputs.name: refiner_model
inputs.description: Specifies an additional model used for refining the generated or processed images, enhancing their quality or detail.

inputs.name: refiner_clip
inputs.description: Defines an additional CLIP model used for refining the alignment of generated content with specified conditions, enhancing the relevance and accuracy of the output.

inputs.name: refiner_positive
inputs.description: Additional positive conditioning factors for the refinement process, aimed at enhancing specific attributes or features in the refined output.

inputs.name: refiner_negative
inputs.description: Additional negative conditioning factors for the refinement process, aimed at reducing or eliminating certain attributes or features in the refined output.

inputs.name: bbox_detector
inputs.description: Specifies the bounding box detector model used for identifying and localizing objects within images, facilitating targeted processing or enhancement.

inputs.name: wildcard
inputs.description: A dynamic input that allows for the inclusion of custom text or conditions, providing flexibility in the generation or refinement process.

inputs.name: Select to add LoRA
inputs.description: Enables the selection of LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation) techniques to be applied, enhancing the model's adaptability and performance on specific tasks or conditions.

inputs.name: Select to add Wildcard
inputs.description: Allows for the selection of custom conditions or modifiers to be added, offering additional customization in the processing pipeline.

inputs.name: sam_model_opt
inputs.description: Specifies an optional SAM model used for semantic segmentation, contributing to the refinement and detail enhancement processes.

inputs.name: segm_detector_opt
inputs.description: Defines an optional segmentation detector model used for identifying specific regions or features within images, aiding in targeted processing.

inputs.name: detailer_hook
inputs.description: An optional hook for integrating custom processing or refinement steps, offering further customization of the pipeline.

outputs.name: detailer_pipe
outputs.description: The output is a detailer pipe, which encapsulates the refined and processed data, ready for further stages of image generation or enhancement.

TwoAdvancedSamplersForMask.description: This node provides advanced sampling functionalities for image manipulation, specifically designed to work with masks. It enables the application of different sampling strategies to distinct regions of an image, as defined by a mask, allowing for precise control over the sampling process in areas of interest.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.description: The seed for random number generation, ensuring reproducibility of the sampling process.

inputs.name: steps
inputs.description: The total number of steps to perform in the advanced sampling process, affecting the granularity of the operation.

inputs.name: denoise
inputs.description: A factor that influences the denoising process during sampling, impacting the clarity and quality of the sampled image.

inputs.name: samples
inputs.description: The initial latent images to be processed, serving as the starting point for the sampling operation.

inputs.name: base_sampler
inputs.description: The sampler to apply to the region outside the mask, dictating the sampling behavior in non-masked areas.

inputs.name: mask_sampler
inputs.description: The sampler to apply to the masked region, enabling specialized sampling within the mask boundaries.

inputs.name: mask
inputs.description: The mask defining areas of interest for different sampling strategies, guiding the application of the base and mask samplers.

inputs.name: overlap_factor
inputs.description: A parameter controlling the extent of mask overlap, affecting the transition between sampled regions.

outputs.name: latent
outputs.description: The modified latent image after applying advanced sampling techniques, reflecting changes in both masked and non-masked regions.

TwoSamplersForMask.description: This node is designed to apply different sampling strategies to distinct regions of a latent image, based on a specified mask. It enables the selective enhancement or alteration of image areas by utilizing separate samplers for the masked and unmasked regions, thereby facilitating targeted image manipulation within a unified framework.

inputs.name: latent_image
inputs.description: Represents the input latent image to be processed. It serves as the canvas on which different sampling strategies are applied based on the mask.

inputs.name: base_sampler
inputs.description: Specifies the sampler to be applied to the region outside the mask, influencing the overall appearance of the unmasked areas.

inputs.name: mask_sampler
inputs.description: Determines the sampler to be applied to the masked region, allowing for targeted manipulation or enhancement of specific areas.

inputs.name: mask
inputs.description: Defines the region to be selectively sampled or altered, guiding the application of the mask_sampler.

outputs.name: latent
outputs.description: The resulting latent image after applying the specified sampling strategies to the masked and unmasked regions.

TwoSamplersForMaskUpscalerProvider.description: This node provides a mechanism to upscale images using two distinct samplers, each responsible for different regions of the image, based on a mask. It enables the selective application of upscaling techniques to enhance image quality or add details in a controlled manner.

inputs.name: scale_method
inputs.description: Specifies the method used for scaling during the upscaling process.

inputs.name: full_sample_schedule
inputs.description: Defines the sampling schedule for the full image upscaling.

inputs.name: use_tiled_vae
inputs.description: Indicates whether a tiled VAE approach is used for upscaling.

inputs.name: base_sampler
inputs.description: The primary sampler used for upscaling the image, applied to the regions not covered by the mask.

inputs.name: mask_sampler
inputs.description: A specialized sampler used for upscaling the regions of the image specified by the mask.

inputs.name: mask
inputs.description: A binary mask indicating the regions of the image to be specifically upscaled by the mask_sampler.

inputs.name: vae
inputs.description: The variational autoencoder used in the upscaling process.

inputs.name: tile_size
inputs.description: Specifies the size of the tiles when using a tiled VAE approach.

inputs.name: full_sampler_opt
inputs.description: Options for the full sampler used in the upscaling process.

inputs.name: upscale_model_opt
inputs.description: Options for the upscale model used in the upscaling process.

inputs.name: pk_hook_base_opt
inputs.description: Options for the base hook in the upscaling process.

inputs.name: pk_hook_mask_opt
inputs.description: Options for the mask hook in the upscaling process.

inputs.name: pk_hook_full_opt
inputs.description: Options for the full hook in the upscaling process.

outputs.name: upscaler
outputs.description: The upscaled latent image after applying both the base and mask samplers.

TwoSamplersForMaskUpscalerProviderPipe.description: This node is designed to provide a pipeline that integrates two distinct samplers specifically for the purpose of upscaling masks. It facilitates the enhancement of image quality by applying specialized sampling techniques to areas designated by masks, thereby improving the overall visual impact of the images.

inputs.name: scale_method
inputs.description: Specifies the method used for scaling during the upscaling process. It influences how the image is enlarged and the quality of the upscaling.

inputs.name: full_sample_schedule
inputs.description: Defines the schedule for sampling throughout the upscaling process. It determines the sequence and parameters for sampling operations.

inputs.name: use_tiled_vae
inputs.description: Indicates whether a tiled VAE approach is used for upscaling. This affects the handling of large images by breaking them into tiles for processing.

inputs.name: base_sampler
inputs.description: Specifies the base sampler used in the upscaling process, which is crucial for the initial sampling phase.

inputs.name: mask_sampler
inputs.description: Defines the sampler used specifically for the mask areas during upscaling, enhancing the details in these regions.

inputs.name: mask
inputs.description: The mask that designates areas for specialized upscaling, playing a key role in the targeted enhancement of image quality.

inputs.name: basic_pipe
inputs.description: The basic processing pipeline that provides essential functionalities like VAE operations. It serves as the foundation for the upscaling process.

inputs.name: tile_size
inputs.description: The size of the tiles used when a tiled VAE approach is employed. It specifies the dimensions for breaking down large images.

inputs.name: full_sampler_opt
inputs.description: Optional configurations for the full sampler used in the upscaling process. It allows customization of the sampling behavior.

inputs.name: upscale_model_opt
inputs.description: Optional configurations for the upscale model. It enables fine-tuning of the model's parameters for better upscaling results.

inputs.name: pk_hook_base_opt
inputs.description: Optional configurations for the base hook in the pipeline. It affects the initial phase of the upscaling process.

inputs.name: pk_hook_mask_opt
inputs.description: Optional configurations for the mask hook. It influences how the mask is applied and processed during upscaling.

inputs.name: pk_hook_full_opt
inputs.description: Optional configurations for the full hook, affecting the entire upscaling process. It allows for comprehensive customization of the upscaling behavior.

outputs.name: upscaler
outputs.description: The result of the upscaling process, providing an enhanced version of the image with improved quality in masked areas.

UltralyticsDetectorProvider.description: This node is designed to load and provide access to detection models, facilitating object detection tasks by leveraging models trained with the Ultralytics framework.

inputs.name: model_name
inputs.description: Specifies the name of the model to be loaded, which is crucial for identifying and accessing the correct model file for object detection tasks.

outputs.name: bbox_detector
outputs.description: Provides an object detector that identifies bounding boxes around detected objects in images.

outputs.name: segm_detector
outputs.description: Offers a segmentation model capable of delineating the precise shape of objects by classifying each pixel of the image.

UnsamplerDetailerHookProvider.description: The UnsamplerDetailerHookProvider node is designed to provide hooks that modify the sampling process in image generation tasks. It focuses on adjusting the unsampling behavior, which is a critical step in refining the details and quality of generated images.

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: Specifies the model used in the unsampling process, serving as the foundation for generating images.

inputs.name: steps
inputs.description: Determines the number of steps in the unsampling process, affecting the level of detail and refinement in the generated images.

inputs.name: start_end_at_step
inputs.description: Defines the starting point for the end step in the unsampling process, influencing the progression of image refinement.

inputs.name: end_end_at_step
inputs.description: Specifies the ending point for the end step in the unsampling process, further refining the progression of image detail enhancement.

inputs.name: cfg
inputs.description: Sets the configuration for the unsampling process, impacting the overall quality and characteristics of the generated images.

inputs.name: sampler_name
inputs.description: Indicates the sampler used in the unsampling process, affecting the method of image generation.

inputs.name: scheduler
inputs.description: Determines the scheduling strategy for the unsampling process, influencing the timing and sequence of image refinement steps.

inputs.name: normalize
inputs.description: Specifies whether to normalize the output of the unsampling process, affecting the consistency and quality of the generated images.

inputs.name: positive
inputs.description: Defines positive conditioning factors for the unsampling process, guiding the generation towards desired attributes.

inputs.name: negative
inputs.description: Sets negative conditioning factors for the unsampling process, steering the generation away from undesired attributes.

inputs.name: schedule_for_cycle
inputs.description: unknown

outputs.name: detailer_hook
outputs.description: Produces a detailer hook configured according to the specified unsampling parameters, ready to be integrated into the image generation pipeline.

UnsamplerHookProvider.description: The UnsamplerHookProvider node is designed to create and manage UnsamplerHook instances, which are specialized hooks for adjusting the sampling process based on dynamic step calculations. This node plays a crucial role in customizing the sampling behavior, particularly in modifying the end step of the sampling process dynamically, to achieve desired effects or optimizations in image generation tasks.

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: The model parameter represents the generative model to be used for sampling. It is crucial for defining the behavior and capabilities of the UnsamplerHook, as the hook will operate based on the characteristics and functionalities of this model.

inputs.name: steps
inputs.description: Specifies the total number of steps to be used in the sampling process. This parameter is essential for determining the duration and granularity of the sampling operation.

inputs.name: start_end_at_step
inputs.description: Defines the initial step at which the end step adjustment begins. This parameter is key to controlling when the dynamic modification of the sampling process starts.

inputs.name: end_end_at_step
inputs.description: Indicates the final step at which the end step adjustment concludes. This parameter helps in fine-tuning the end of the dynamic sampling modification period.

inputs.name: cfg
inputs.description: The configuration setting for the sampling process. It influences the behavior of the UnsamplerHook by providing specific configuration values.

inputs.name: sampler_name
inputs.description: The name of the sampler to be used. This parameter identifies which sampling algorithm the UnsamplerHook will apply during the sampling process.

inputs.name: scheduler
inputs.description: Specifies the scheduler to be used in conjunction with the sampler. The scheduler manages the progression of steps during the sampling process.

inputs.name: normalize
inputs.description: A boolean flag indicating whether to normalize the samples during the sampling process. Normalization can affect the quality and characteristics of the generated images.

inputs.name: positive
inputs.description: A parameter that influences the sampling process by adjusting the positive aspects of the generated samples. It's part of the customization options provided by the UnsamplerHook.

inputs.name: negative
inputs.description: A parameter that influences the sampling process by adjusting the negative aspects of the generated samples. It's part of the customization options provided by the UnsamplerHook.

inputs.name: schedule_for_iteration
inputs.description: Specifies the scheduling strategy for iteration within the sampling process. This parameter determines how the UnsamplerHook dynamically adjusts the sampling process.

outputs.name: pk_hook
outputs.description: Returns an instance of UnsamplerHook, which is a specialized hook for dynamically adjusting the sampling process based on the provided parameters.

VariationNoiseDetailerHookProvider.description: This node provides a mechanism to introduce variation into the noise used in detail enhancement processes, leveraging a specified seed and strength to generate a modified noise pattern. It aims to enrich the textural details and variability in generated images or segments by blending original noise with a variation-induced noise.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.description: The seed parameter is crucial for generating the variation-induced noise, ensuring reproducibility and consistency in the noise pattern across different executions.

inputs.name: strength
inputs.description: The strength parameter determines the degree to which the variation-induced noise influences the final noise output, allowing for fine-tuned control over the textural changes introduced.

outputs.name: detailer_hook
outputs.description: Outputs a detailer hook configured with variation-induced noise, ready to be used in enhancing the details of generated images or segments.

WildcardPromptFromString.description: This node is designed to generate and process text prompts with wildcards, enabling dynamic content creation by replacing specified wildcard patterns with appropriate values. It facilitates the customization and variation of text inputs for further processing or output generation, emphasizing flexibility and adaptability in text manipulation.

inputs.name: string
inputs.description: The primary text input that may contain wildcards or placeholders for dynamic content generation.

inputs.name: delimiter
inputs.description: Specifies the delimiter used to identify or separate wildcards within the text, enabling precise pattern recognition and processing.

inputs.name: prefix_all
inputs.description: A prefix applied to all wildcards before processing, aiding in their identification and manipulation within the text.

inputs.name: postfix_all
inputs.description: A postfix applied to all wildcards after processing, ensuring that replaced content is correctly formatted or distinguished.

inputs.name: restrict_to_tags
inputs.description: Limits wildcard processing to only those tags specified, allowing for targeted content generation and customization.

inputs.name: exclude_tags
inputs.description: Excludes specific tags from wildcard processing, providing control over which content remains static.

outputs.name: wildcard
outputs.description: The processed text with wildcards replaced by their corresponding values, ready for use in various applications.

outputs.name: segs_labels
outputs.description: Labels or segments generated during the wildcard processing, offering insights into the structure and content of the processed text.

Inference_Core_AIO_Preprocessor.description: The Inference_Core_AIO_Preprocessor node is designed to streamline the preprocessing phase for a variety of input data types, specifically targeting the enhancement and preparation of data for subsequent processing or analysis within an AI-driven pipeline. It integrates auxiliary preprocessing functionalities and excludes certain preprocessing operations not suitable for image-to-image mapping, ensuring a versatile and optimized preprocessing workflow.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The 'image' parameter is the primary input for the node, representing the visual data that will undergo preprocessing. This input is essential for tailoring the preprocessing steps to the specific characteristics and requirements of the image, ensuring optimal preparation for further processing.

inputs.name: preprocessor
inputs.description: The 'preprocessor' parameter specifies the particular preprocessing technique to be applied to the input image. This selection allows for a customizable preprocessing workflow, adapting to various needs and enhancing the effectiveness of the data preparation.

inputs.name: resolution
inputs.description: The 'resolution' parameter defines the desired resolution for the output image after preprocessing. Adjusting this parameter allows for control over the output quality and size, catering to the specific requirements of subsequent processing stages.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The 'image' output represents the preprocessed image, now optimized and ready for further analysis or processing. This output is crucial for ensuring that the visual data is in the correct format and state for efficient and effective subsequent processing.

Inference_Core_AnimalPosePreprocessor.description: This node is designed to preprocess images for animal pose estimation, utilizing different model formats (TorchScript, ONNX) to detect and analyze animal poses within images. It supports dynamic selection of detection classes and handles both detection and pose estimation processes, adapting to the model's input requirements and optimizing for performance.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The original image to be processed for animal pose estimation. It serves as the primary input for model inference, crucial for both detection and pose estimation phases.

inputs.name: bbox_detector
inputs.description: The detection model used to identify animal bounding boxes in the image. This model can be either a TorchScript or ONNX model, depending on the implementation.

inputs.name: pose_estimator
inputs.description: The pose estimation model used to analyze the detected animal poses within the bounding boxes. This model also varies in format, supporting both TorchScript and ONNX.

inputs.name: resolution
inputs.description: The resolution to which the input image is resized before processing. This affects the detection and pose estimation accuracy and performance.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The image annotated with detected animal poses, highlighting the key points and poses of animals detected within the original image.

outputs.name: pose_keypoint
outputs.description: A structured representation of detected animal poses, including keypoints and their scores, formatted for further processing or visualization.

Inference_Core_AnimeFace_SemSegPreproces.description: This node specializes in preprocessing images for semantic segmentation, particularly focusing on anime faces. It leverages a deep learning model to segment anime faces from the background, optionally removing the background based on the user's preference. The node is designed to enhance the performance of downstream tasks by providing cleaner, more focused inputs.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The input image to be processed for anime face segmentation. This image is the primary subject for semantic segmentation, aiming to isolate anime faces from their backgrounds.

inputs.name: remove_background_using_abg
inputs.description: A boolean flag that determines whether the background should be removed from the input image, enhancing focus on the anime face.

inputs.name: resolution
inputs.description: Specifies the resolution to which the input image should be processed, affecting the quality and size of the output segmentation.

outputs.name: IMAGE
outputs.description: The processed image with the anime face segmented, optionally with the background removed based on the input flag.

outputs.name: ABG_CHARACTER_MASK (MASK)
outputs.description: A mask indicating the segmented areas of the anime face within the image, useful for further processing or analysis.

Inference_Core_AnimeLineArtPreprocessor.description: This node specializes in preprocessing images to extract anime-style line art, utilizing a dedicated model for detecting and enhancing line art features in anime images. It's designed to work within a ControlNet preprocessing pipeline, focusing on the transformation of input images into a format optimized for further anime-related image processing tasks.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The input image to be processed for anime line art extraction. This image serves as the primary data for the line art detection model, determining the quality and characteristics of the output.

inputs.name: resolution
inputs.description: Specifies the resolution for the output line art image, affecting the level of detail and clarity in the extracted line art.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The processed image with anime-style line art extracted, ready for use in subsequent processing stages.

Inference_Core_BAE-NormalMapPreprocessor.description: This node is designed to preprocess images for normal map estimation using the BAE (Boundary Aware Estimator) model. It adjusts images to the required resolution and format before passing them through the BAE model to generate normal maps.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The input image to be processed for normal map estimation. It is the primary data that the node operates on, affecting the quality and accuracy of the output normal map.

inputs.name: resolution
inputs.description: Specifies the resolution to which the input image should be resized before processing. This parameter influences the detail level of the output normal map.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The output normal map generated from the input image, providing a detailed representation of surface normals.

Inference_Core_BinaryPreprocessor.description: The Binary Preprocessor node is designed for image preprocessing within the ControlNet Preprocessors/Line Extractors category, specifically focusing on converting images to binary format based on a threshold value. This node applies a binary thresholding technique to extract significant lines or edges from images, facilitating further processing or analysis.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The input image to be processed. It serves as the primary data for the binary thresholding operation, aiming to extract significant lines or edges.

inputs.name: bin_threshold
inputs.description: Specifies the threshold value for the binary conversion of images. It determines the cutoff point for classifying pixel values as either black or white, playing a crucial role in the extraction of lines or edges from the image.

inputs.name: resolution
inputs.description: The resolution to which the input image is resized before applying the binary thresholding. This parameter can influence the detail level of the extracted lines or edges.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The processed image in binary format, where significant lines or edges are highlighted by converting the image based on the specified binary threshold.

Inference_Core_CannyEdgePreprocessor.description: The Canny Edge Preprocessor node is designed for edge detection in images, utilizing the Canny edge detection algorithm to highlight the contours and edges within an image. This preprocessing step is crucial for tasks that require clear delineation of object boundaries, such as in image segmentation or feature extraction processes.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The input image to be processed for edge detection.

inputs.name: low_threshold
inputs.description: Specifies the lower bound for the hysteresis thresholding step in the Canny edge detection algorithm, controlling the detection of weak edges.

inputs.name: high_threshold
inputs.description: Defines the upper bound for the hysteresis thresholding step, determining the detection of strong edges in the image.

inputs.name: resolution
inputs.description: The resolution to which the input image is resized before applying the Canny edge detection algorithm, affecting the detail level of detected edges.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The processed image with edges highlighted using the Canny edge detection technique.

Inference_Core_ColorPreprocessor.description: The Color Preprocessor node is designed to analyze and process images to detect and adjust their color palette. It utilizes a color detection algorithm to enhance or modify the image's color properties based on the specified resolution.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The input image to be processed for color detection and adjustment.

inputs.name: resolution
inputs.description: Specifies the resolution at which the color detection and adjustment should be performed, affecting the precision and quality of the output.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The processed image with adjusted color properties, based on the color detection algorithm.

Inference_Core_DensePosePreprocessor.description: The DensePose Preprocessor node is designed to estimate human body poses and overlay them on images using DensePose models. It supports different models and color maps for visualization, providing a flexible approach to pose estimation and visualization.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The input image on which body poses will be estimated and visualized.

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: Specifies the DensePose model to be used for pose estimation. The choice of model can affect the accuracy and performance of pose estimation.

inputs.name: cmap
inputs.description: Determines the color map used for visualizing the pose estimation results. Different color maps can be used to enhance the visual distinction of pose estimations.

inputs.name: resolution
inputs.description: The resolution to which the input image is resized before pose estimation. Affects the detail level of the pose estimation.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The output is an image with human body poses estimated and visualized on it.

Inference_Core_DepthAnythingPreprocessor.description: The Inference_Core_DepthAnythingPreprocessor node is designed to preprocess images for depth estimation tasks, utilizing different models based on the context (e.g., indoor vs. outdoor environments or specific model checkpoints). It abstracts the complexity of model selection and preprocessing steps, providing a streamlined interface for depth estimation.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The input image to be processed for depth estimation. This image is the primary input on which the depth estimation model operates.

inputs.name: ckpt_name
inputs.description: The name of the checkpoint file for the depth estimation model. This parameter allows for the selection of different pretrained models to tailor the depth estimation process to specific requirements.

inputs.name: resolution
inputs.description: Specifies the resolution at which the depth estimation should be performed, affecting the quality and detail of the output depth map.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The output is an image representing the estimated depth map of the input image, providing a visual representation of depth information.

Inference_Core_DiffusionEdge_Preprocesso.description: This node is designed to preprocess images for further processing by applying a diffusion edge detection algorithm. It enhances the edges in images based on the specified environment and patch batch size, making it suitable for tasks that require detailed edge information, such as line extraction in control networks.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The input image to be processed by the diffusion edge detection algorithm.

inputs.name: environment
inputs.description: Specifies the environment setting for the edge detection model, affecting the model's behavior and the resulting edge enhancements.

inputs.name: patch_batch_size
inputs.description: Determines the number of image patches processed simultaneously, influencing the execution speed and memory usage.

inputs.name: resolution
inputs.description: The resolution to which the input image is resized before processing, affecting the detail level of the detected edges.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The processed image with enhanced edges, ready for further processing or visualization.

Inference_Core_DWPreprocessor.description: The Inference_Core_DWPreprocessor node is designed for preprocessing input data specifically for the DWPose estimation model. It adapts input data to the required format and optimizes it for efficient pose estimation, ensuring compatibility and maximizing the performance of the DWPose model.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The 'image' parameter is the primary input for the pose estimation process, serving as the visual data that the model will analyze to estimate poses.

inputs.name: detect_hand
inputs.description: The 'detect_hand' parameter controls whether hand detection is enabled or disabled, influencing the comprehensiveness of the pose estimation.

inputs.name: detect_body
inputs.description: The 'detect_body' parameter toggles the inclusion of body pose estimation, affecting the scope of the pose analysis performed by the model.

inputs.name: detect_face
inputs.description: The 'detect_face' parameter determines whether face detection is included in the pose estimation, impacting the detail level of the pose analysis.

inputs.name: resolution
inputs.description: The 'resolution' parameter specifies the resolution of the output image, affecting the clarity and detail of the pose estimation results.

inputs.name: bbox_detector
inputs.description: The 'bbox_detector' parameter specifies the model or method used for bounding box detection, crucial for identifying regions of interest within the image for pose estimation.

inputs.name: pose_estimator
inputs.description: The 'pose_estimator' parameter defines the specific pose estimation model or technique to be applied, directly influencing the accuracy and performance of the pose estimation.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The 'image' output provides the visual representation of the pose estimation, including annotated poses on the input image.

outputs.name: pose_keypoint
outputs.description: The 'pose_keypoint' output delivers the estimated poses as a set of keypoints, offering detailed information about the detected poses.

Inference_Core_FacialPartColoringFromPos.description: This node is designed to colorize specific facial parts in pose keypoint data, utilizing customizable colors for each facial part. It processes pose keypoint frames to visually enhance and distinguish different facial regions based on the provided keypoint data and color specifications.

inputs.name: pose_kps
inputs.description: The pose keypoint data containing information about the positions of various facial parts. It serves as the primary input for generating colorized facial keypoints.

inputs.name: mode
inputs.description: Specifies the drawing mode for keypoints, allowing for either point-based or polygon-based rendering of facial parts.

inputs.name: skin
inputs.description: Specifies the color for the skin facial part, affecting the visual representation of the skin area in the output.

inputs.name: left_eye
inputs.description: Specifies the color for the left eye, affecting how the left eye is visualized in the output.

inputs.name: right_eye
inputs.description: Specifies the color for the right eye, affecting how the right eye is visualized in the output.

inputs.name: nose
inputs.description: Specifies the color for the nose, affecting how the nose is visualized in the output.

inputs.name: upper_lip
inputs.description: Specifies the color for the upper lip, affecting how the upper lip is visualized in the output.

inputs.name: inner_mouth
inputs.description: Specifies the color for the inner mouth, affecting how the inner mouth is visualized in the output.

inputs.name: lower_lip
inputs.description: Specifies the color for the lower lip, affecting how the lower lip is visualized in the output.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The output is a tensor representation of the pose frames with facial parts colorized according to the specified colors.

Inference_Core_FakeScribblePreprocessor.description: The Inference_Core_FakeScribblePreprocessor node is designed for preprocessing images to generate fake scribble lines, simulating the appearance of hand-drawn scribbles. It utilizes a modified HED edge detection model to create stylized line drawings that mimic the scribble effect, offering an alternative to traditional edge detection methods for artistic and creative applications.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The input image to be processed for fake scribble line generation. It serves as the primary data for the node's execution, determining the visual output.

inputs.name: safe
inputs.description: A mode selector that enables or disables safety features during the image processing, affecting the final appearance of the scribble lines.

inputs.name: resolution
inputs.description: Specifies the resolution at which the image processing should be performed, impacting the detail level of the generated scribble lines.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The processed image with fake scribble lines, representing a stylized version of the original input.

Inference_Core_HEDPreprocessor.description: The HEDPreprocessor node is designed for extracting soft-edge lines from images using the HED (Holistically-Nested Edge Detection) model. It preprocesses images to enhance edge features, facilitating downstream tasks that require detailed edge or line information.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The input image to be processed for edge detection. The resolution parameter allows specifying the desired output resolution, affecting the level of detail in the detected edges.

inputs.name: safe
inputs.description: A mode toggle that enables or disables safety checks during edge detection, potentially affecting performance and output quality.

inputs.name: resolution
inputs.description: Specifies the resolution of the output image, influencing the granularity of detected edges. Higher resolutions yield more detailed edge information.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The processed image with enhanced edge details, suitable for use in various image analysis and manipulation tasks.

Inference_Core_HintImageEnchance.description: The `Inference_Core_HintImageEnchance` node is designed to preprocess hint images for image generation tasks, enhancing and resizing them according to specified dimensions and modes. It supports operations such as resizing to fit within given dimensions, outer and inner fitting, and applying enhancements like binary thresholding, edge detection, and inpainting based on the image's alpha channel.

inputs.name: hint_image
inputs.description: The hint image to be processed, which can be enhanced and resized for better suitability in image generation tasks.

inputs.name: image_gen_width
inputs.description: The target width for the generated image, guiding the resizing process.

inputs.name: image_gen_height
inputs.description: The target height for the generated image, guiding the resizing process.

inputs.name: resize_mode
inputs.description: The mode of resizing to be applied, determining how the hint image is adjusted to fit the target dimensions.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The processed hint images, enhanced and resized according to the specified parameters, ready for use in image generation.

Inference_Core_ImageGenResolutionFromIma.description: This node is designed to calculate the generation resolution directly from an input image. It extracts the width and height of the input image and returns these dimensions as the intended resolution for image generation, facilitating the adjustment of output image size based on the input image's dimensions.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The input image for which the generation resolution is to be calculated. This image's dimensions are used to determine the output resolution, directly influencing the size of the generated image.

outputs.name: IMAGE_GEN_WIDTH (INT)
outputs.description: unknown

outputs.name: IMAGE_GEN_HEIGHT (INT)
outputs.description: unknown

Inference_Core_ImageGenResolutionFromLat.description: This node is designed to calculate the generation resolution for images based on the latent space representation. It extracts the height and width from the latent samples and scales them to determine the optimal resolution for image generation.

inputs.name: latent
inputs.description: The latent representation from which the image's generation resolution is derived. It affects the output by determining the base dimensions that are scaled to compute the final image resolution.

outputs.name: IMAGE_GEN_WIDTH (INT)
outputs.description: unknown

outputs.name: IMAGE_GEN_HEIGHT (INT)
outputs.description: unknown

Inference_Core_ImageIntensityDetector.description: The ImageIntensityDetector node is designed for preprocessing images by adjusting their intensity levels. It utilizes gamma correction to modify the intensity, aiming to enhance image quality or achieve specific visual effects.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The input image to be processed. It is the primary subject for intensity adjustment through gamma correction.

inputs.name: gamma_correction
inputs.description: Specifies the gamma correction factor to adjust the intensity levels of the image. It plays a crucial role in the preprocessing step by influencing the brightness and contrast of the output image.

inputs.name: resolution
inputs.description: Defines the resolution for the output image. This parameter determines the dimensions to which the image will be adjusted during processing.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The output is an image that has undergone intensity adjustment based on the specified gamma correction. This processed image is suitable for further analysis or visualization.

Inference_Core_ImageLuminanceDetector.description: This node is designed to adjust the luminance of an image based on ControlNet preprocessing techniques. It utilizes gamma correction to modify the image's luminance, aiming to enhance image quality or adjust it for further processing steps.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The input image to be processed for luminance adjustment.

inputs.name: gamma_correction
inputs.description: Specifies the gamma correction factor to adjust the image's luminance. A higher value brightens the image, while a lower value darkens it, affecting the overall image processing outcome.

inputs.name: resolution
inputs.description: Specifies the resolution for the output image, affecting the level of detail and size of the processed image.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The output is an image with adjusted luminance, processed through gamma correction to either increase or decrease its brightness.

Inference_Core_InpaintPreprocessor.description: The Inpaint Preprocessor node is designed for image preprocessing in inpainting tasks, where it prepares images by applying masks to indicate areas for inpainting, effectively setting masked pixels to a specific value for further processing.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The 'image' parameter represents the input image to be preprocessed for inpainting, serving as the primary data for mask application.

inputs.name: mask
inputs.description: The 'mask' parameter specifies the areas of the input image to be inpainted, indicating which pixels should be considered for modification.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The output is a preprocessed image with specified areas masked for inpainting, ready for further processing steps.

Inference_Core_LayeredDiffusionApply.description: This node is designed to apply a layered diffusion process to an input model, leveraging specific configurations and conditions to modify the model's behavior for enhanced image generation or transformation. It abstracts complex diffusion and conditioning logic into a more accessible interface for users, aiming to facilitate the creation of nuanced and high-quality visual content.

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: Represents the model to which the layered diffusion process will be applied, playing a crucial role in determining the outcome of the diffusion process by influencing the model's behavior and the quality of generated images.

inputs.name: config
inputs.description: The configuration string that specifies the particular settings or parameters for the layered diffusion process, directly impacting how the model is modified and behaves during image generation.

inputs.name: weight
inputs.description: A float value that influences the intensity or degree of the applied diffusion process, affecting the final visual output by adjusting how the model's parameters are modified.

outputs.name: model
outputs.description: The modified model after the application of the layered diffusion process, showcasing the effects of the diffusion and conditioning on the model's ability to generate or transform images.

Inference_Core_LayeredDiffusionCondApply.description: This node specializes in applying conditional layered diffusion processes to input data, leveraging specific configurations and weights to modulate the diffusion effect. It integrates conditional inputs to guide the diffusion process, enhancing the generation or transformation of data with nuanced control.

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: The model to which the layered diffusion process will be applied, serving as the foundation for the diffusion modifications.

inputs.name: cond
inputs.description: The conditional inputs for the foreground, guiding the diffusion process to achieve specific visual effects or characteristics.

inputs.name: uncond
inputs.description: The unconditional inputs for the background, providing a baseline for the diffusion process and influencing the overall output.

inputs.name: latent
inputs.description: Latent representations used in the diffusion process, contributing to the generation or transformation of the output.

inputs.name: config
inputs.description: Configuration string specifying the diffusion model and settings, crucial for determining the behavior of the diffusion process.

inputs.name: weight
inputs.description: A weight factor that influences the strength and characteristics of the diffusion effect applied to the model.

outputs.name: model
outputs.description: Outputs a modified model that has undergone the conditional layered diffusion process, reflecting the applied conditions and adjustments.

outputs.name: conditioning
outputs.description: The conditioning information used during the diffusion process, indicating how the conditional inputs have influenced the output.

Inference_Core_LayeredDiffusionCondJoint.description: This node specializes in applying conditional and joint layered diffusion processes to generate or manipulate images based on a set of conditions and joint configurations. It integrates multiple diffusion models to achieve complex image synthesis or transformation tasks, leveraging conditional inputs and joint model dynamics.

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: The model patcher used to apply layered diffusion techniques, essential for integrating with the diffusion process.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The target image for the diffusion process, serving as a basis for transformations or synthesis.

inputs.name: config
inputs.description: A configuration string that determines the specific layered diffusion model and settings to use.

inputs.name: cond
inputs.description: Optional conditional inputs for the diffusion process, allowing for targeted image manipulation or generation.

inputs.name: blended_cond
inputs.description: Optional blended conditional inputs, enabling more complex image synthesis by combining conditions.

outputs.name: model
outputs.description: Outputs the model after applying the layered diffusion process, equipped with modifications for image synthesis or transformation.

Inference_Core_LayeredDiffusionDecode.description: This node specializes in decoding layered diffusion processes, enabling the transformation of sampled data into images through a series of diffusion steps. It leverages advanced techniques to efficiently handle and decode multiple layers of diffusion, optimizing the generation of high-quality images.

inputs.name: samples
inputs.description: The sampled data to be decoded into images, representing the initial input for the diffusion process.

inputs.name: images
inputs.description: A tensor of images to be processed through the diffusion steps, serving as the basis for the decoding operation.

inputs.name: sd_version
inputs.description: Specifies the version of the diffusion model to be used, affecting the decoding behavior and output quality.

inputs.name: sub_batch_size
inputs.description: The size of sub-batches for processing, optimizing computational efficiency and resource usage.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The images generated from the decoded diffusion process, representing the primary output.

outputs.name: mask
outputs.description: The alpha mask associated with the decoded images, providing transparency information.

Inference_Core_LayeredDiffusionDecodeRGB.description: This node is designed to decode the alpha channel from pixel values in images, effectively converting RGB images to RGBA format. It leverages a layered diffusion process to enhance image quality by adding transparency information, thereby facilitating more nuanced image manipulation and generation tasks.

inputs.name: samples
inputs.description: Represents the input samples to be decoded, playing a crucial role in determining the final image output by providing the necessary data for the alpha channel decoding process.

inputs.name: images
inputs.description: The input images in tensor format, which are to be processed to decode the alpha channel and convert from RGB to RGBA format.

inputs.name: sd_version
inputs.description: Specifies the version of the stable diffusion model to be used for decoding, impacting the decoding process and the quality of the output images.

inputs.name: sub_batch_size
inputs.description: Determines the size of sub-batches for processing, affecting the efficiency and speed of the decoding operation.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The output RGBA images, where the alpha channel has been decoded and added to the original RGB images, enhancing their representation with transparency information.

Inference_Core_LayeredDiffusionDecodeSpl.description: This node specializes in decoding images through a layered diffusion process, specifically tailored for handling split image data. It leverages a modified diffusion decode method to process images in segments, optimizing for scenarios where images are divided into frames or layers for enhanced inference performance.

inputs.name: samples
inputs.description: A collection of sample data that the node will process. This data is crucial for the decoding operation, as it directly influences the segmentation, processing, and final quality of the decoded images.

inputs.name: images
inputs.description: The tensor of images to be decoded. This input is central to the node's functionality, as it directly manipulates these images based on the provided samples and frames.

inputs.name: frames
inputs.description: Specifies the number of frames or segments into which the images are divided. This parameter is key to determining how the images are processed and decoded.

inputs.name: sd_version
inputs.description: The version of the Stable Diffusion model to use for decoding. This affects the decoding behavior and the quality of the output images.

inputs.name: sub_batch_size
inputs.description: The size of sub-batches for processing, allowing for optimized resource utilization during the decoding process.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The decoded images, processed through the layered diffusion method. This output is crucial for understanding the effectiveness and quality of the decoding process.

Inference_Core_LayeredDiffusionDiffApply.description: This node specializes in applying a layered diffusion process to a given model, leveraging specific configurations and weights to modify the model's behavior. It is designed to enhance or alter the model's output by integrating diffusion techniques, which can include attention sharing mechanisms if supported by the model configuration.

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: The model to which the layered diffusion process will be applied. This parameter is crucial as it determines the base model that will undergo the diffusion process, affecting the final output.

inputs.name: cond
inputs.description: The conditional input for the diffusion process, which guides the diffusion direction and outcome.

inputs.name: uncond
inputs.description: The unconditional input for the diffusion process, providing a baseline for the diffusion effect.

inputs.name: blended_latent
inputs.description: A latent representation that combines aspects of both conditional and unconditional inputs, used to influence the diffusion process.

inputs.name: latent
inputs.description: The original latent representation of the model before the diffusion process is applied.

inputs.name: config
inputs.description: A string specifying the configuration to use for the layered diffusion process. This configuration determines how the diffusion is applied, including any model-specific adjustments or optimizations.

inputs.name: weight
inputs.description: A float value that influences the intensity of the diffusion process applied to the model. It adjusts how significantly the diffusion alters the model's behavior or output.

outputs.name: model
outputs.description: The modified model after the layered diffusion process has been applied, reflecting changes in behavior or output.

outputs.name: conditioning
outputs.description: The conditioning information used or generated during the diffusion process, which can influence the model's output.

Inference_Core_LayeredDiffusionJointAppl.description: This node is designed to apply a layered diffusion process to joint models, integrating multiple diffusion models or layers to generate or manipulate images in a cohesive manner. It leverages the strengths of each individual model layer to produce enhanced, high-quality outputs.

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: The model parameter represents the diffusion model to be applied. It is crucial for defining the specific diffusion process and its configuration, directly influencing the quality and characteristics of the output.

inputs.name: config
inputs.description: Config defines the configuration settings for the layered diffusion process, including model specifics and operational parameters, crucial for tailoring the diffusion to desired outcomes.

inputs.name: fg_cond
inputs.description: Foreground conditions specify the conditional inputs for the foreground of the diffusion process, guiding the generation or transformation of the output in the foreground areas.

inputs.name: bg_cond
inputs.description: Background conditions specify the conditional inputs for the background of the diffusion process, influencing the generation or transformation of the output in the background areas.

inputs.name: blended_cond
inputs.description: Blended conditions combine foreground and background conditions, providing a unified conditional input for the diffusion process across both areas.

outputs.name: model
outputs.description: The output is a modified version of the input model, enhanced through the layered diffusion process to produce or transform images based on the provided conditions and configurations.

Inference_Core_LeReS-DepthMapPreprocesso.description: The Inference_Core_LeReS-DepthMapPreprocessor node is designed for preprocessing images to generate depth maps using the LeReS algorithm. It enhances image depth perception by optionally boosting the depth estimation process and applying specific adjustments to remove nearest objects or background, aiming to improve the depth quality for further processing or visualization.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The input image to be processed for depth map generation.

inputs.name: rm_nearest
inputs.description: Specifies the threshold for removing the nearest objects in the depth map, enhancing the focus on more distant elements.

inputs.name: rm_background
inputs.description: Defines the threshold for background removal in the depth map, helping to isolate the main subjects from their surroundings.

inputs.name: boost
inputs.description: Enables or disables the boost mode for depth estimation, where 'enable' significantly enhances the depth map details.

inputs.name: resolution
inputs.description: The resolution at which the depth map should be generated, affecting the detail level of the output.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The processed depth map image, optimized for further computational tasks or visualization.

Inference_Core_LineArtPreprocessor.description: The Inference_Core_LineArtPreprocessor node is designed to preprocess images by extracting line art with a realistic style. It utilizes a specialized model to transform input images into line drawings, aiming to enhance or prepare the images for further processing or artistic applications.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The input image to be processed for line art extraction.

inputs.name: coarse
inputs.description: Determines whether the line art extraction should be performed in a coarse manner. Enabling this option modifies the extraction process to potentially alter the level of detail in the resulting line art.

inputs.name: resolution
inputs.description: Specifies the resolution at which the line art extraction should be performed, affecting the detail and quality of the output.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The output is an image that has been processed to extract line art, reflecting a realistic style.

Inference_Core_LineartStandardPreprocess.description: The Inference_Core_LineartStandardPreprocessor node is designed to preprocess images for line extraction, applying Gaussian blurring and intensity thresholding to enhance lineart features before further processing.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The input image to be processed for line extraction, serving as the primary data for the node's operations.

inputs.name: guassian_sigma
inputs.description: unknown

inputs.name: intensity_threshold
inputs.description: Determines the threshold for intensity differentiation, aiding in the distinction of lineart from the background by setting a cutoff intensity value.

inputs.name: resolution
inputs.description: Specifies the resolution at which the image processing should be executed, affecting the detail level of the output lineart.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: Produces an image with enhanced lineart features, ready for further processing or analysis.

Inference_Core_M-LSDPreprocessor.description: The M-LSD Preprocessor node is designed for extracting line segments from images using the M-LSD (Multi-Level Line Segment Detector) model. It processes images to detect and delineate line structures, facilitating tasks that require understanding of geometric shapes and structures within the visual data.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The input image to be processed for line segment detection. It serves as the primary data on which the M-LSD model operates.

inputs.name: score_threshold
inputs.description: Defines the confidence threshold for line segment detection. Lines with scores below this threshold are discarded, influencing the sensitivity of the detection process.

inputs.name: dist_threshold
inputs.description: Sets the distance threshold for separating line segments. This parameter helps in distinguishing between closely spaced lines, affecting the granularity of the detected lines.

inputs.name: resolution
inputs.description: Specifies the resolution at which the image is processed. This affects the scale of detection and can influence the detection of line segments.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The output is an image annotated with detected line segments, visually representing the geometric structures identified by the M-LSD model.

Inference_Core_Manga2Anime_LineArt_Prepr.description: This node specializes in preprocessing manga images to extract line art, transforming them into a format suitable for anime-style visual enhancements. It leverages a dedicated model to detect and refine manga line art, ensuring the output is optimized for subsequent anime-style rendering processes.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The input image to be processed for manga line art extraction. This image is transformed to highlight the essential line art, preparing it for anime-style rendering.

inputs.name: resolution
inputs.description: Specifies the resolution for the output line art image, allowing control over the detail level of the extracted lines.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The processed image with manga line art extracted, ready for further anime-style rendering.

Inference_Core_MaskOptFlow.description: The node 'Inference_Core_MaskOptFlow' is designed to process optical flow data by applying a mask to it, effectively filtering the optical flow based on the provided mask. This preprocessing step is crucial for tasks that require focused analysis on specific regions of the optical flow, enhancing the accuracy and relevance of the flow data for subsequent processing stages.

inputs.name: optical_flow
inputs.description: The 'optical_flow' parameter represents the optical flow data to be processed. It is essential for determining the motion between two images or frames.

inputs.name: mask
inputs.description: The 'mask' parameter is used to specify the regions of interest within the optical flow data. It plays a critical role in filtering and refining the flow data for targeted analysis.

outputs.name: OPTICAL_FLOW
outputs.description: The modified optical flow data, filtered through the applied mask, ready for further analysis or processing.

outputs.name: PREVIEW_IMAGE
outputs.description: A visual representation of the masked optical flow, providing a preview of the effect of the mask on the flow data.

Inference_Core_MediaPipe-FaceMeshPreproc.description: This node is designed to preprocess images for face mesh detection tasks by leveraging MediaPipe's Face Mesh technology. It dynamically installs dependencies, configures MediaPipe Face Mesh settings based on input parameters, and processes images to detect facial landmarks with configurable accuracy and face count limits.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The input image to be processed for face mesh detection.

inputs.name: max_faces
inputs.description: Specifies the maximum number of faces to detect in an image, allowing for control over the face detection scope and performance.

inputs.name: min_confidence
inputs.description: Determines the minimum confidence threshold for detecting faces, enabling fine-tuning of the detection sensitivity to balance between accuracy and detection rate.

inputs.name: resolution
inputs.description: The resolution to which the input image is resized before processing, affecting the precision of face mesh detection.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The processed image with detected face meshes, ready for further analysis or visualization.

Inference_Core_MeshGraphormer-DepthMapPr.description: This node is designed to preprocess images for depth map generation and hand pose estimation using the MeshGraphormer model. It handles the conversion of input images to a format suitable for the model, performs inference to generate depth maps and masks, and processes these outputs for further use in hand refinement tasks.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The input image or batch of images to be processed for depth map and mask generation. It plays a crucial role in the node's execution as it directly influences the quality and accuracy of the generated depth maps and masks.

inputs.name: mask_bbox_padding
inputs.description: Determines the padding around detected bounding boxes for masks, influencing the size and coverage of the generated masks.

inputs.name: resolution
inputs.description: Specifies the resolution at which the depth map and mask detection should be performed, affecting the detail level of the output.

inputs.name: mask_type
inputs.description: Defines the strategy for mask generation, either based on depth values or tight bounding boxes, affecting the mask's shape and coverage.

inputs.name: mask_expand
inputs.description: Controls the expansion of masks beyond their original boundaries, useful for ensuring complete coverage of hand areas in depth maps.

inputs.name: rand_seed
inputs.description: A seed value for random number generation, ensuring reproducibility of the mask generation process.

outputs.name: IMAGE
outputs.description: The processed images after depth map and mask generation, ready for further analysis or visualization.

outputs.name: INPAINTING_MASK
outputs.description: The masks indicating areas to be inpainted or further processed, typically highlighting regions of interest such as hands.

Inference_Core_MiDaS-DepthMapPreprocesso.description: The MiDaS Depth Map Preprocessor node is designed to transform input images into depth maps using the MiDaS model. This process enhances the perception of depth in images, facilitating various applications in 3D modeling, augmented reality, and beyond by providing a detailed depth estimation.

inputs.name: image
