inputs.description: Determines the contribution ratio of the CLIP model associated with the first model in the merged output.

inputs.name: switch_2
inputs.description: Activates or deactivates the inclusion of the second model in the merging process.

inputs.name: ckpt_name2
inputs.description: The name of the checkpoint file for the second model. This is used to identify and load the specific model to be merged.

inputs.name: model_ratio2
inputs.description: Specifies the contribution ratio of the second model in the merged output. This affects how prominently the model's features are represented.

inputs.name: clip_ratio2
inputs.description: Determines the contribution ratio of the CLIP model associated with the second model in the merged output.

inputs.name: switch_3
inputs.description: Activates or deactivates the inclusion of the third model in the merging process.

inputs.name: ckpt_name3
inputs.description: The name of the checkpoint file for the third model. This is used to identify and load the specific model to be merged.

inputs.name: model_ratio3
inputs.description: Specifies the contribution ratio of the third model in the merged output. This affects how prominently the model's features are represented.

inputs.name: clip_ratio3
inputs.description: Determines the contribution ratio of the CLIP model associated with the third model in the merged output.

inputs.name: model_stack
inputs.description: An optional stack of models that can be included in the merge process. This allows for the integration of additional models beyond the primary three specified.

outputs.name: MODEL_STACK
outputs.description: The resulting merged model stack, which combines the features of the input models according to the specified merge method, normalization, and weighting.

outputs.name: show_help
outputs.description: A URL providing additional help and documentation on how to use the node effectively.

CR Module Input.description: The CR_ModuleInput node is designed to facilitate the flow of data through a pipeline by accepting a variety of inputs and flushing them through the system. It serves as a critical junction point in the pipeline, ensuring that data is correctly routed and transformed for subsequent processing stages.

inputs.name: pipe
inputs.description: The 'pipe' parameter is the primary conduit for data flowing through the node. It encapsulates a variety of data types and structures, acting as a central hub for the input data that will be processed and routed within the pipeline.

outputs.name: pipe
outputs.description: Represents the aggregated and processed data, ready to be forwarded to the next stage in the pipeline.

outputs.name: model
outputs.description: The model data extracted from the input pipe.

outputs.name: pos
outputs.description: Positive conditioning data extracted from the input pipe.

outputs.name: neg
outputs.description: Negative conditioning data extracted from the input pipe.

outputs.name: latent
outputs.description: Latent representation data extracted from the input pipe.

outputs.name: vae
outputs.description: VAE model data extracted from the input pipe.

outputs.name: clip
outputs.description: CLIP model data extracted from the input pipe.

outputs.name: controlnet
outputs.description: ControlNet data extracted from the input pipe.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: Image data extracted from the input pipe.

outputs.name: seed
outputs.description: Seed value extracted from the input pipe.

outputs.name: show_help
outputs.description: A URL providing additional help and documentation for the node.

CR Module Output.description: The CR Module Output node is designed to serve as the endpoint for a module within a pipeline, facilitating the organized output of data processed through the module. It abstracts the complexity of data handling at the end of a module, ensuring a streamlined and efficient data flow out of the module.

inputs.name: pipe
inputs.description: Accepts a pipeline object that encapsulates all the data processed within the module. This object is the primary input for the node, enabling the organized output of processed data.

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: unknown

inputs.name: pos
inputs.description: unknown

inputs.name: neg
inputs.description: unknown

inputs.name: latent
inputs.description: unknown

inputs.name: vae
inputs.description: unknown

inputs.name: clip
inputs.description: unknown

inputs.name: controlnet
inputs.description: unknown

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: unknown

inputs.name: seed
inputs.description: unknown

outputs.name: pipe
outputs.description: Outputs the same pipeline object that was input, potentially with modifications or additions made during the module's processing.

outputs.name: show_help
outputs.description: Provides a URL to the documentation or help page related to this node, offering users guidance on its usage and functionalities.

CR Module Pipe Loader.description: The CR Module Pipe Loader node is designed to aggregate various types of inputs, such as models, conditioning data, latent vectors, and images, into a unified pipeline format. It facilitates the modular assembly of components for generative AI applications, allowing for flexible and dynamic construction of processing pipelines.

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: Represents a model component to be included in the pipeline. It's crucial for defining the generative model that will be used in the pipeline.

inputs.name: pos
inputs.description: Specifies positive conditioning data to guide the generative process. It affects the direction and characteristics of the generation.

inputs.name: neg
inputs.description: Specifies negative conditioning data to counterbalance or steer away from certain aspects during generation.

inputs.name: latent
inputs.description: Provides a latent vector to seed or influence the generative process, offering a way to introduce variability or specific directions.

inputs.name: vae
inputs.description: Represents a VAE (Variational Autoencoder) component, which can be used for encoding or decoding in the pipeline.

inputs.name: clip
inputs.description: Incorporates a CLIP model for semantic understanding or alignment, enhancing the generative process with textual or visual guidance.

inputs.name: controlnet
inputs.description: Includes a ControlNet component for additional control over the generation process, allowing for more precise manipulations.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: Includes an image to be processed or used as part of the generative process, adding visual data to the pipeline.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.description: Provides a seed value for random number generation, ensuring reproducibility or variability in the generative process.

outputs.name: pipe
outputs.description: The assembled pipeline, encapsulating all the provided components in a unified format for further processing.

outputs.name: show_help
outputs.description: A URL to the documentation or help page for the node, offering guidance on its usage and capabilities.

CR Multi Upscale Stack.description: This node is designed to create a stack of upscale operations based on specified models and rescale factors. It allows for the dynamic addition of upscale models to a list, enabling a sequence of image upscale transformations to be defined and applied in a modular fashion.

inputs.name: switch_1
inputs.description: Determines whether the first upscale operation should be included in the stack. It acts as a conditional flag for the inclusion of the first upscale model and its corresponding rescale factor.

inputs.name: upscale_model_1
inputs.description: Specifies the first upscale model to be potentially included in the stack, contingent on the state of switch_1.

inputs.name: rescale_factor_1
inputs.description: Defines the rescale factor associated with the first upscale model, determining the magnitude of the upscale transformation.

inputs.name: switch_2
inputs.description: Acts as a conditional flag for the inclusion of the second upscale model and its corresponding rescale factor in the stack.

inputs.name: upscale_model_2
inputs.description: Specifies the second upscale model to be potentially included in the stack, contingent on the state of switch_2.

inputs.name: rescale_factor_2
inputs.description: Defines the rescale factor associated with the second upscale model, determining the magnitude of the upscale transformation.

inputs.name: switch_3
inputs.description: Determines whether the third upscale operation should be included in the stack. It acts as a conditional flag for the inclusion of the third upscale model and its corresponding rescale factor.

inputs.name: upscale_model_3
inputs.description: Specifies the third upscale model to be potentially included in the stack, contingent on the state of switch_3.

inputs.name: rescale_factor_3
inputs.description: Defines the rescale factor associated with the third upscale model, determining the magnitude of the upscale transformation.

inputs.name: upscale_stack
inputs.description: An optional initial list of upscale operations to be extended with additional models and rescale factors based on the switches. It allows for the accumulation and modular configuration of upscale transformations.

outputs.name: UPSCALE_STACK
outputs.description: The compiled list of upscale operations, each represented as a tuple of an upscale model and its corresponding rescale factor. This list is dynamically constructed based on the input switches and parameters.

outputs.name: show_help
outputs.description: A URL providing access to additional documentation and help related to the CR Multi Upscale Stack node.

CR Multi-ControlNet Stack.description: This node is designed to create a stack of ControlNet configurations, each with its own switch, allowing for the dynamic application of multiple ControlNet effects based on specified conditions. It facilitates the layering and conditional application of various ControlNet adjustments to images, enhancing flexibility and control in image manipulation workflows.

inputs.name: switch_1
inputs.description: Determines whether the first ControlNet configuration in the stack is active ('On') or inactive ('Off').

inputs.name: controlnet_1
inputs.description: The first ControlNet configuration to be applied, if 'switch_1' is 'On'.

inputs.name: controlnet_strength_1
inputs.description: The strength of the first ControlNet effect.

inputs.name: start_percent_1
inputs.description: The starting percentage of the image where the first ControlNet effect begins to apply.

inputs.name: end_percent_1
inputs.description: The ending percentage of the image where the first ControlNet effect stops applying.

inputs.name: switch_2
inputs.description: Determines whether the second ControlNet configuration in the stack is active ('On') or inactive ('Off').

inputs.name: controlnet_2
inputs.description: The second ControlNet configuration to be applied, if 'switch_2' is 'On'.

inputs.name: controlnet_strength_2
inputs.description: The strength of the second ControlNet effect.

inputs.name: start_percent_2
inputs.description: The starting percentage of the image where the second ControlNet effect begins to apply.

inputs.name: end_percent_2
inputs.description: The ending percentage of the image where the second ControlNet effect stops applying.

inputs.name: switch_3
inputs.description: Determines whether the third ControlNet configuration in the stack is active ('On') or inactive ('Off').

inputs.name: controlnet_3
inputs.description: The third ControlNet configuration to be applied, if 'switch_3' is 'On'.

inputs.name: controlnet_strength_3
inputs.description: The strength of the third ControlNet effect.

inputs.name: start_percent_3
inputs.description: The starting percentage of the image where the third ControlNet effect begins to apply.

inputs.name: end_percent_3
inputs.description: The ending percentage of the image where the third ControlNet effect stops applying.

inputs.name: image_1
inputs.description: The image to which the first ControlNet configuration is applied.

inputs.name: image_2
inputs.description: The image to which the second ControlNet configuration is applied.

inputs.name: image_3
inputs.description: The image to which the third ControlNet configuration is applied.

inputs.name: controlnet_stack
inputs.description: A list of additional ControlNet configurations to be applied, each including the ControlNet's name, the image to apply it to, the strength of the effect, and the start and end percentages for the effect's application.

outputs.name: CONTROLNET_STACK
outputs.description: The compiled list of ControlNet configurations to be applied, including those specified individually and those included in the 'controlnet_stack'.

outputs.name: show_help
outputs.description: A URL to the documentation for further assistance on using the CR Multi-ControlNet Stack node.

CR Multiline Text.description: This node is designed to process and manipulate multiline text, allowing for operations such as removing specific characters, splitting strings, and converting from CSV format. It aims to provide versatile text processing capabilities tailored to multiline inputs.

inputs.name: text
inputs.description: The primary text input that will be processed. This is the multiline text that operations such as character removal, string splitting, and CSV conversion will be applied to.

inputs.name: convert_from_csv
inputs.description: A boolean flag that, when set to True, treats the input text as CSV data and processes it accordingly.

inputs.name: csv_quote_char
inputs.description: Specifies the quote character used in the CSV data. This is relevant only when the convert_from_csv option is enabled.

inputs.name: remove_chars
inputs.description: A boolean flag that, when set to True, triggers the removal of specified characters from the input text.

inputs.name: chars_to_remove
inputs.description: Specifies the characters to be removed from the input text. This parameter is used when the remove_chars option is enabled.

inputs.name: split_string
inputs.description: A boolean flag that, when set to True, splits the input text into a list of strings.

outputs.name: multiline_text
outputs.description: The processed text after applying the specified operations.

outputs.name: show_help
outputs.description: A URL to a help page providing more information about the node's functionality.

CR Output Flow Frames.description: This node is designed for saving sequences of animation frames, facilitating the output process in animation workflows by streamlining the saving of image sequences.

inputs.name: output_folder
inputs.description: Specifies the directory where the output animation frames will be saved. It is essential for defining the destination of the saved frames.

inputs.name: current_image
inputs.description: Represents the current image frame to be saved. It is crucial for determining the specific frame that will be output at any given iteration.

inputs.name: filename_prefix
inputs.description: A prefix added to the filename of each saved frame, aiding in the organization and identification of the output files.

inputs.name: current_frame
inputs.description: Indicates the index of the current frame being processed. This is vital for tracking the progress of the frame saving operation and for naming the output files appropriately.

inputs.name: interpolated_img
inputs.description: An optional parameter for providing an interpolated image frame that can be saved alongside the current frame, offering flexibility in outputting enhanced or modified frames.

inputs.name: output_path
inputs.description: The path where the final image will be saved. This parameter is crucial for directing the output to the correct location.

CR Output Schedule To File.description: This node is designed to output animation schedules to a file, supporting both CSV and text formats. It ensures unique file naming to avoid overwriting existing files and provides flexibility in specifying the output file path, name, and extension.

inputs.name: output_file_path
inputs.description: Specifies the directory path where the output file will be saved. It plays a crucial role in determining the location of the generated file.

inputs.name: file_name
inputs.description: The base name of the output file. This name is essential for identifying the file and can be modified to ensure uniqueness if a file with the same name already exists.

inputs.name: file_extension
inputs.description: Determines the format of the output file (e.g., 'csv' or 'txt'). This affects how the schedule data is formatted and saved.

inputs.name: schedule
inputs.description: The animation schedule data to be written to the file. This data is central to the node's purpose, as it represents the content that will be saved in the specified format.

CR Overlay Text.description: This node is designed to overlay text onto images, allowing for customization of text alignment, font properties, and positioning. It provides a versatile tool for adding textual annotations or labels directly onto visual content.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The image onto which the text will be overlaid. It serves as the base layer for the text overlay operation.

inputs.name: text
inputs.description: The text content to be overlaid on the image. This parameter allows for dynamic text annotations on visual content.

inputs.name: font_name
inputs.description: The name of the font to be used for the text overlay. This determines the visual style of the text.

inputs.name: font_size
inputs.description: The size of the font for the text overlay. It influences the readability and visual impact of the text.

inputs.name: font_color
inputs.description: The color of the font in RGB format. It affects the visibility and aesthetic of the text overlay.

inputs.name: align
inputs.description: Specifies the alignment of the text within the given margins. It affects the positioning and appearance of the text overlay.

inputs.name: justify
inputs.description: Determines the justification of the text, affecting its alignment relative to the specified margins.

inputs.name: margins
inputs.description: The margin size around the text, influencing its positioning within the image.

inputs.name: line_spacing
inputs.description: The spacing between lines of text, affecting the layout and readability of the text overlay.

inputs.name: position_x
inputs.description: The horizontal position of the text within the image, determining its exact placement.

inputs.name: position_y
inputs.description: The vertical position of the text within the image, determining its exact placement.

inputs.name: rotation_angle
inputs.description: The angle at which the text is rotated, allowing for dynamic text orientation.

inputs.name: rotation_options
inputs.description: Options for rotating the text, providing flexibility in text presentation.

inputs.name: font_color_hex
inputs.description: The hexadecimal color code for the font. Provides an alternative way to specify the font color.

outputs.name: IMAGE
outputs.description: The resulting image after the text overlay operation, with the text visually integrated onto the original image.

outputs.name: show_help
outputs.description: A string output that provides help or additional information related to the text overlay operation.

CR Overlay Transparent Image.description: This node is designed to overlay a transparent image onto a background image, allowing for adjustments in transparency, position, rotation, and scale of the overlay image. It facilitates the creation of composite images by blending two images together in a visually appealing manner.

inputs.name: back_image
inputs.description: The background image onto which the overlay image will be placed. It serves as the base layer for the composite image.

inputs.name: overlay_image
inputs.description: The image to be overlaid on the background image. This image can be manipulated in terms of transparency, rotation, and scale to achieve the desired visual effect.

inputs.name: transparency
inputs.description: Controls the opacity of the overlay image, allowing it to be more or less visible against the background image.

inputs.name: offset_x
inputs.description: The horizontal offset from the center of the background image where the overlay image will be placed.

inputs.name: offset_y
inputs.description: The vertical offset from the center of the background image where the overlay image will be placed.

inputs.name: rotation_angle
inputs.description: The angle in degrees to rotate the overlay image, enabling dynamic positioning and orientation.

inputs.name: overlay_scale_factor
inputs.description: A factor by which the overlay image is scaled, allowing for adjustments in size relative to the background image.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The resulting image after overlaying the transparent image onto the background, incorporating all specified transformations.

CR Page Layout.description: The CR Page Layout node is designed for arranging visual elements within a specified page layout. It enables the creation of structured and aesthetically pleasing page designs by allowing users to define the layout parameters, including dimensions, template, and color scheme, as well as to place images and panels according to custom or predefined layouts.

inputs.name: layout_options
inputs.description: Specifies the layout options for the page, such as including headers, footers, or neither, allowing for further customization of the page structure.

inputs.name: image_panel
inputs.description: The primary image or panel to be used as the base for the layout, serving as the central visual element around which other components are arranged.

inputs.name: header_height
inputs.description: Defines the height of the header area, allowing for customization of the space allocated for header content.

inputs.name: header_text
inputs.description: Specifies the text to be included in the header, enabling the addition of titles or other header information.

inputs.name: header_align
inputs.description: Determines the alignment of the header text, influencing the text's positioning within the header area.

inputs.name: footer_height
inputs.description: Sets the height of the footer area, providing control over the space allocated for footer content.

inputs.name: footer_text
inputs.description: Specifies the text to be included in the footer, enabling the addition of descriptive or supplementary information at the bottom of the page.

inputs.name: footer_align
inputs.description: Determines the alignment of the footer text, affecting its positioning within the footer area.

inputs.name: font_name
inputs.description: Selects the font to be used for text elements within the layout, allowing for stylistic consistency or variation.

inputs.name: font_color
inputs.description: Defines the color of the text, enabling customization to match the overall design theme or to highlight specific text elements.

inputs.name: header_font_size
inputs.description: Specifies the font size for the header text, allowing for visual emphasis or subtlety depending on the design needs.

inputs.name: footer_font_size
inputs.description: Sets the font size for the footer text, enabling customization to ensure readability and design coherence.

inputs.name: border_thickness
inputs.description: Defines the thickness of the border surrounding the layout, offering an additional layer of design customization.

inputs.name: border_color
inputs.description: Determines the color of the border surrounding the layout, providing a visual frame for the page content.

inputs.name: background_color
inputs.description: Specifies the background color of the layout, setting the overall tone and atmosphere of the design.

inputs.name: font_color_hex
inputs.description: Provides an alternative method to specify the text color using hexadecimal color codes, offering precise color customization.

inputs.name: border_color_hex
inputs.description: Allows for the specification of border color using hexadecimal color codes, enabling precise color matching and customization.

inputs.name: bg_color_hex
inputs.description: Offers an alternative method to specify the background color using hexadecimal color codes, allowing for precise color customization.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The final image resulting from the applied layout, showcasing the arranged visual elements according to the specified parameters.

outputs.name: show_help
outputs.description: A string output that provides help or guidance related to the use of the node, including parameter explanations or layout tips.

CR Pipe Switch.description: The CR Pipe Switch node is designed to dynamically select between two pipeline paths based on a specified input. It facilitates conditional execution within a pipeline, allowing for more flexible and customizable data processing flows.

inputs.name: Input
inputs.description: Determines which pipeline path to select for execution. A value of 1 selects the first pipeline, while any other value selects the second pipeline.

inputs.name: pipe1
inputs.description: The first pipeline path to be potentially executed. It is selected if the 'Input' parameter is set to 1.

inputs.name: pipe2
inputs.description: The second pipeline path to be potentially executed. It is selected if the 'Input' parameter is not set to 1.

outputs.name: PIPE_LINE
outputs.description: The selected pipeline path based on the 'Input' parameter.

outputs.name: show_help
outputs.description: A URL providing additional information and documentation about the CR Pipe Switch node.

CR Polygons.description: The CR Polygons node is designed for creating and manipulating polygon shapes within a graphical environment, leveraging the capabilities of matplotlib for visualization. This node facilitates the generation, customization, and rendering of polygonal figures, supporting a wide range of graphical applications.

inputs.name: mode
inputs.description: Specifies the mode of polygon generation, affecting the shape and arrangement of polygons.

inputs.name: width
inputs.description: Specifies the width of the canvas on which polygons will be drawn. This parameter influences the overall size of the graphical output.

inputs.name: height
inputs.description: Determines the height of the canvas, affecting the vertical dimension of the generated polygonal graphics.

inputs.name: rows
inputs.description: Sets the number of rows in the grid layout for placing polygons. This affects the distribution and organization of polygons on the canvas.

inputs.name: columns
inputs.description: Defines the number of columns in the grid layout, impacting how polygons are arranged horizontally.

inputs.name: face_color
inputs.description: Primary color used for filling polygons, contributing to the visual style of the output.

inputs.name: background_color
inputs.description: Color used for the canvas background, setting the visual context for the polygons.

inputs.name: line_color
inputs.description: Color used for the polygon outlines, enhancing the definition and contrast of shapes.

inputs.name: line_width
inputs.description: Specifies the thickness of the polygon outlines, affecting the visual prominence of the shapes.

inputs.name: face_color_hex
inputs.description: Hexadecimal representation of the primary color, offering an alternative method for specifying color.

inputs.name: bg_color_hex
inputs.description: Hexadecimal code for the background color, providing precision in color selection.

inputs.name: line_color_hex
inputs.description: Hexadecimal code for the outline color, allowing for exact color matching.

outputs.name: IMAGE
outputs.description: Generates an image file containing the rendered polygons, serving as the visual output of the node.

outputs.name: show_help
outputs.description: Provides textual help or guidance related to the node's functionality and usage.

CR Prompt List Keyframes.description: This node is designed to generate a list of keyframes based on a given list of prompts, each associated with specific animation parameters such as transition type, speed, and profile. It aims to facilitate the creation of detailed animation sequences by converting textual prompts into structured keyframe data.

inputs.name: prompt_list
inputs.description: A list of tuples, each containing a prompt and its associated animation parameters. This list is essential for generating the keyframe list, as it dictates the content and timing of each keyframe in the animation sequence.

inputs.name: keyframe_format
inputs.description: Specifies the format in which the keyframes are to be generated, influencing the structure and compatibility of the output with different animation tools.

outputs.name: keyframe_list
outputs.description: The generated list of keyframes, structured according to the specified format, ready for use in animation sequences.

outputs.name: show_help
outputs.description: A URL providing additional information and guidance on how to use the node effectively.

CR Prompt List.description: The CR Prompt List node is designed to aggregate and manage a collection of prompts for generative tasks, facilitating the organization and sequential processing of textual inputs for creative or analytical applications.

inputs.name: prepend_text
inputs.description: This parameter allows for the addition of text before the main content of each prompt, enabling customization and contextualization of the input sequence.

inputs.name: multiline_text
inputs.description: Accepts multiple lines of text as input, providing a flexible space for entering extensive or detailed prompts that require more than a single line.

inputs.name: append_text
inputs.description: Enables the appending of text to the end of each prompt, allowing for further customization or the addition of closing remarks or signatures.

inputs.name: start_index
inputs.description: Determines the starting index for processing the list of prompts, offering control over the sequence's beginning point.

inputs.name: max_rows
inputs.description: Limits the number of prompts to be processed, facilitating the management of large collections by setting a maximum threshold.

outputs.name: prompt
outputs.description: Represents the aggregated and potentially transformed collection of prompts, ready for downstream generative tasks.

outputs.name: body_text
outputs.description: Provides the main content of the processed prompts, central to the node's output.

outputs.name: show_help
outputs.description: Offers a link to additional information or guidance related to the node's functionality, supporting user understanding and application.

CR Prompt Scheduler.description: The CR Prompt Scheduler node is designed to manage and schedule animation prompts based on predefined rules and formats. It dynamically adjusts prompts and their attributes according to the current frame and specified scheduling mode, facilitating the creation of complex animations.

inputs.name: mode
inputs.description: Specifies the scheduling mode, which determines how prompts are selected and managed throughout the animation.

inputs.name: current_frame
inputs.description: Indicates the current frame of the animation, used to determine the appropriate prompt and its attributes based on the schedule.

inputs.name: default_prompt
inputs.description: The default prompt to use when the scheduler is disabled or no other prompts are applicable.

inputs.name: schedule_format
inputs.description: Defines the format of the schedule, allowing for compatibility with different scheduling syntaxes.

inputs.name: interpolate_prompt
inputs.description: Determines whether to interpolate between prompts when transitioning from one keyframe to another.

inputs.name: schedule
inputs.description: The actual schedule data, containing the prompts and their corresponding frames.

inputs.name: schedule_alias
inputs.description: A unique identifier for the schedule, used to manage and reference different scheduling configurations.

inputs.name: keyframe_list
inputs.description: A list of keyframes specifying the frames and associated prompts for animation.

inputs.name: prepend_text
inputs.description: Text to prepend to the current and next prompts, enhancing the prompt's context or detail.

inputs.name: append_text
inputs.description: Text to append to the current and next prompts, adding additional context or detail.

outputs.name: current_prompt
outputs.description: The prompt to be used for the current frame.

outputs.name: next_prompt
outputs.description: The prompt to be used for the next frame.

outputs.name: weight
outputs.description: A weight value indicating the blend ratio between the current and next prompts.

outputs.name: show_help
outputs.description: A link to further documentation or help regarding the scheduler.

CR Prompt Text.description: This node is designed to process and return a user-defined text prompt, along with a help URL for further guidance. It primarily serves as a utility for text input handling within a broader system, facilitating user interaction by accepting and returning text prompts.

inputs.name: prompt
inputs.description: The 'prompt' parameter is the user-defined text input that the node processes. It plays a crucial role in the node's operation by being the main piece of information that gets returned along with a help URL.

outputs.name: prompt
outputs.description: The 'prompt' output is the user-defined text input that was processed by the node.

outputs.name: show_help
outputs.description: The 'show_help' output provides a URL to a help page, offering users additional information and guidance on using the node.

CR Radial Gradient.description: The CR Radial Gradient node is designed to create visually appealing radial gradient patterns. It leverages mathematical models to blend colors or intensities from a central point outward, allowing for the creation of dynamic and customizable radial gradients that can enhance the visual aesthetics of graphics or UI elements.

inputs.name: width
inputs.description: Sets the width of the canvas, influencing the radial gradient's spread and how it occupies the visual space.

inputs.name: height
inputs.description: Determines the height of the canvas on which the radial gradient is applied, affecting the scale and distribution of the gradient pattern.

inputs.name: start_color
inputs.description: Specifies the starting color of the radial gradient. It sets the tone for the center of the gradient, influencing the overall appearance and mood of the generated pattern.

inputs.name: end_color
inputs.description: Defines the ending color of the radial gradient. This color gradually blends with the starting color towards the edges, creating a smooth transition and adding depth to the visual effect.

inputs.name: gradient_distance
inputs.description: Specifies the extent of the gradient's transition area, affecting how gradually the colors blend from the center to the edges.

inputs.name: radial_center_x
inputs.description: Determines the x-coordinate of the radial gradient's center point on the canvas, allowing for precise positioning of the gradient's origin.

inputs.name: radial_center_y
inputs.description: Sets the y-coordinate of the radial gradient's center point on the canvas, enabling accurate placement of the gradient's starting point.

inputs.name: start_color_hex
inputs.description: Provides a hexadecimal representation of the custom starting color, offering precise control over the gradient's initial color scheme.

inputs.name: end_color_hex
inputs.description: Gives a hexadecimal code for the custom ending color, allowing for exact specification of the gradient's final color in the transition.

outputs.name: IMAGE
outputs.description: The resulting image featuring the applied radial gradient, showcasing the blend of specified colors in a radial pattern.

outputs.name: show_Help
outputs.description: Provides a link or guidance for further assistance or information about the radial gradient node.

CR Random Hex Color.description: This node generates a set of random hexadecimal color values based on a given seed. It aims to provide a simple way to generate consistent color schemes for design and visualization purposes.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.description: The seed parameter initializes the random number generator, ensuring that the same set of colors is generated each time for a given seed value. This allows for reproducibility in color generation.

outputs.name: hex_color1
outputs.description: A randomly generated hexadecimal color value.

outputs.name: hex_color2
outputs.description: A randomly generated hexadecimal color value.

outputs.name: hex_color3
outputs.description: A randomly generated hexadecimal color value.

outputs.name: hex_color4
outputs.description: A randomly generated hexadecimal color value.

outputs.name: show_help
outputs.description: A URL to the help documentation for this node.

CR Random LoRA Stack.description: The CR_RandomLoRAStack node is designed to manage and manipulate stacks of LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation) instances, specifically focusing on randomizing and applying LoRA modifications to models. It enables the dynamic adjustment of model weights through LoRA techniques, supporting exclusive modes, stride-based re-randomization, and the integration of multiple LoRA instances into a single stack.

inputs.name: exclusive_mode
inputs.description: Determines whether only one LoRA instance should be applied at a time, enabling a mode where the instance with the highest chance is selected exclusively.

inputs.name: stride
inputs.description: Sets the minimum number of cycles before a re-randomization of the LoRA weights is performed, controlling the frequency of weight adjustments.

inputs.name: force_randomize_after_stride
inputs.description: Forces a re-randomization of the LoRA weights after a specified number of cycles, ensuring dynamic adjustments over time.

inputs.name: lora_name_1
inputs.description: Specifies the first LoRA instance's name, part of the trio of LoRA instances that can be applied.

inputs.name: switch_1
inputs.description: Controls whether the first LoRA instance is active or not, allowing for selective application.

inputs.name: chance_1
inputs.description: Determines the chance of the first LoRA instance being applied, used in exclusive mode to select the most likely instance.

inputs.name: model_weight_1
inputs.description: Defines the model weight for the first LoRA instance, influencing how it modifies the model.

inputs.name: clip_weight_1
inputs.description: Sets the clipping weight for the first LoRA instance, affecting its impact on the model.

inputs.name: lora_name_2
inputs.description: Specifies the second LoRA instance's name, part of the trio of LoRA instances that can be applied.

inputs.name: switch_2
inputs.description: Controls whether the second LoRA instance is active or not, allowing for selective application.

inputs.name: chance_2
inputs.description: Determines the chance of the second LoRA instance being applied, used in exclusive mode to select the most likely instance.

inputs.name: model_weight_2
inputs.description: Defines the model weight for the second LoRA instance, influencing how it modifies the model.

inputs.name: clip_weight_2
inputs.description: Sets the clipping weight for the second LoRA instance, affecting its impact on the model.

inputs.name: lora_name_3
inputs.description: Specifies the third LoRA instance's name, part of the trio of LoRA instances that can be applied.

inputs.name: switch_3
inputs.description: Controls whether the third LoRA instance is active or not, allowing for selective application.

inputs.name: chance_3
inputs.description: Determines the chance of the third LoRA instance being applied, used in exclusive mode to select the most likely instance.

inputs.name: model_weight_3
inputs.description: Defines the model weight for the third LoRA instance, influencing how it modifies the model.

inputs.name: clip_weight_3
inputs.description: Sets the clipping weight for the third LoRA instance, affecting its impact on the model.

inputs.name: lora_stack
inputs.description: An optional stack of existing LoRA instances to be extended or modified by the current operation.

outputs.name: lora_stack
outputs.description: Returns a modified stack of LoRA instances, incorporating the adjustments and randomizations specified in the input parameters.

CR Random Multiline Colors.description: This node generates a multiline string of colors based on the specified type (hex color, RGB, or matplotlib xkcd color names), number of rows, and seed. It's designed to provide a simple way to create a diverse set of color values for various applications, ensuring repeatability with the use of a seed.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.description: A seed value to ensure the repeatability of the color values generated. Using the same seed will produce the same set of color values.

inputs.name: value_type
inputs.description: Specifies the format of the color values to be generated: hex color, RGB, or matplotlib xkcd color names. This choice determines the structure of the output color values.

inputs.name: rows
inputs.description: Determines the number of color values to be generated, corresponding to the number of lines in the output string.

outputs.name: multiline_text
outputs.description: A string containing multiple lines, each representing a color value in the specified format.

outputs.name: show_help
outputs.description: A URL providing additional help and information about the node.

CR Random Multiline Values.description: This node generates a multiline string composed of randomly selected characters or digits based on a specified value type. It allows for the creation of diverse patterns such as binary, decimal, natural numbers, hexadecimal, alphabetic, alphanumeric, or custom-defined sequences. The randomness can be controlled with a seed value, and the node supports customization of the output through parameters like row count, string length, and optional prepended text.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.description: A value used to initialize the random number generator, ensuring reproducibility of the random patterns generated by the node.

inputs.name: value_type
inputs.description: Specifies the type of characters or digits to be used in generating the multiline string. It determines the character set from which random selections are made, influencing the pattern and appearance of the output.

inputs.name: rows
inputs.description: Determines the number of lines in the generated multiline string. Each line is composed of randomly selected characters or digits based on the specified value type.

inputs.name: string_length
inputs.description: Specifies the length of each line in the multiline string, controlling how many characters or digits are randomly selected and concatenated per line.

inputs.name: custom_values
inputs.description: Allows for the specification of a custom set of characters or digits from which the random selections are made, enabling highly customized and unique patterns.

inputs.name: prepend_text
inputs.description: An optional text to be prepended to each line of the generated multiline string, allowing for additional customization of the output.

outputs.name: multiline_text
outputs.description: The generated multiline string composed of randomly selected characters or digits, arranged according to the specified parameters.

outputs.name: show_help
outputs.description: A URL providing access to further documentation and help related to the node's functionality.

CR Random Panel Codes.description: This node generates a series of unique codes based on specified parameters, including the number of rows, string length, and a set of values to include in the codes. It utilizes a seed for randomization to ensure reproducibility of results. The node is designed to create randomized, yet structured, text strings that can serve various purposes, such as unique identifiers or access codes.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.description: The seed parameter is used to initialize the random number generator, ensuring that the sequence of generated codes is reproducible when the same seed is used. This is crucial for scenarios where consistent output is necessary across different runs.

inputs.name: rows
inputs.description: Specifies the number of codes to generate. This parameter directly influences the output's length, allowing for customization based on the required number of unique codes.

inputs.name: string_length
inputs.description: Determines the length of the numeric part of each code, thereby controlling the granularity and potential uniqueness of each generated code.

inputs.name: values
inputs.description: A string containing characters that can be used in the generation of the codes. This parameter allows for customization of the code format by specifying the allowable characters.

outputs.name: multiline_text
outputs.description: A string containing the generated codes, each on a new line. This output is useful for applications requiring a list of unique identifiers or access codes.

outputs.name: show_help
outputs.description: A URL providing access to additional documentation and help for using the node effectively.

CR Random RGB Gradient.description: This node generates a multiline text string representing a random RGB gradient, based on a given seed and the number of rows specified. It aims to provide a simple way to create diverse and random color gradients for various applications.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.description: The seed parameter initializes the random number generator, ensuring the reproducibility of the gradient pattern. It plays a crucial role in generating consistent results across different executions.

inputs.name: rows
inputs.description: The rows parameter determines the number of color steps in the gradient, affecting the gradient's smoothness and complexity. It directly influences the length and variation of the generated multiline text.

outputs.name: multiline_text
outputs.description: A string containing multiple lines, each representing a step in the RGB gradient with random colors.

outputs.name: show_help
outputs.description: A URL string providing access to additional help and documentation related to the node.

CR Random RGB.description: This node generates a set of four random RGB color values and provides a link to further help or documentation. It's designed to introduce variability and customization in visual elements by leveraging randomness.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.description: The seed parameter initializes the random number generator, ensuring reproducibility of the random RGB colors generated. It plays a crucial role in enabling consistent results across different executions.

outputs.name: rgb_1
outputs.description: A randomly generated RGB color value.

outputs.name: rgb_2
outputs.description: A randomly generated RGB color value.

outputs.name: rgb_3
outputs.description: A randomly generated RGB color value.

outputs.name: rgb_4
outputs.description: A randomly generated RGB color value.

outputs.name: show_help
outputs.description: A URL link to the node's documentation or help page.

CR Random Shape Pattern.description: This node generates a pattern of random shapes, allowing for the creation of visually diverse and customizable graphical patterns. It leverages randomness in shape selection, size, aspect ratio, and color to produce unique designs.

inputs.name: width
inputs.description: Defines the width of the canvas on which the shapes are drawn.

inputs.name: height
inputs.description: Defines the height of the canvas on which the shapes are drawn.

inputs.name: num_rows
inputs.description: Specifies the number of rows in the pattern, affecting the vertical distribution of shapes.

inputs.name: num_cols
inputs.description: Specifies the number of columns in the pattern, affecting the horizontal distribution of shapes.

inputs.name: color1
inputs.description: The primary color used in the pattern, providing a base for visual variety.

inputs.name: color2
inputs.description: The secondary color used in the pattern, adding to the visual diversity.

inputs.name: color1_hex
inputs.description: Hexadecimal representation of the primary color, offering an alternative color specification.

inputs.name: color2_hex
inputs.description: Hexadecimal representation of the secondary color, offering an alternative color specification.

outputs.name: IMAGE
outputs.description: The generated image containing the random shape pattern.

outputs.name: show_help
outputs.description: A URL to the help documentation for this node.

CR Random Weight LoRA.description: The CR_RandomWeightLoRA node is designed to manage and manipulate LoRA (Locally Reweighted Approximations) weights within a specified range, incorporating randomness and conditional logic based on the provided parameters. It facilitates the dynamic adjustment of LoRA weights, enabling more flexible and adaptive model behavior.

inputs.name: stride
inputs.description: Defines the interval at which the LoRA weights are potentially randomized, affecting the frequency of weight adjustments.

inputs.name: force_randomize_after_stride
inputs.description: Determines whether to force a re-randomization of weights after a specified number of strides, enhancing the variability of model behavior.

inputs.name: lora_name
inputs.description: Identifies the specific LoRA instance to be manipulated, serving as a key for tracking and adjusting its weight.

inputs.name: switch
inputs.description: Controls whether the LoRA weight adjustment is active ('On') or bypassed ('Off'), allowing for conditional execution.

inputs.name: weight_min
inputs.description: Sets the minimum boundary for the random weight selection, constraining the range of possible weights.

inputs.name: weight_max
inputs.description: Defines the maximum limit for the random weight selection, establishing the upper boundary of the weight range.

inputs.name: clip_weight
inputs.description: Specifies a clipping value for the LoRA weight, ensuring that the weight does not exceed this threshold.

inputs.name: lora_stack
inputs.description: Optionally provides a stack of existing LoRA instances for integration or modification, allowing for cumulative adjustments.

outputs.name: lora_stack
outputs.description: Returns a stack of LoRA instances with their adjusted weights, ready for further processing or application.

CR Repeater.description: The CR Repeater node is designed to replicate items within a list or a single item multiple times based on a specified repeat count. It aims to facilitate the generation of extended datasets or the amplification of existing data elements for further processing.

inputs.name: input_data
inputs.description: Represents the data to be repeated. It can be a single item or a list of items, determining the scope of repetition within the node's operation.

inputs.name: repeats
inputs.description: Specifies the number of times the input data should be repeated. This parameter directly influences the size of the output list, allowing for controlled data expansion.

outputs.name: list
outputs.description: A list containing the repeated instances of the input data, expanded according to the specified repeat count.

outputs.name: show_help
outputs.description: Provides a URL to the documentation or help page for the CR Repeater node, offering additional information and usage guidelines.

CR Save Text To File.description: The CR_SaveTextToFile node is designed for saving text data to a file, supporting both plain text and CSV formats. It intelligently handles file naming to avoid overwriting existing files and provides flexibility in specifying the output file's location, name, and extension.

inputs.name: multiline_text
inputs.description: The text content to be saved, which can be in multiline format. This content is either saved as plain text or parsed into a CSV format based on the file extension provided.

inputs.name: output_file_path
inputs.description: The directory path where the output file will be saved. It is part of the final filepath construction.

inputs.name: file_name
inputs.description: The base name of the output file. If a file with the same name already exists, the node will append a numerical suffix to ensure uniqueness.

inputs.name: file_extension
inputs.description: The extension of the output file, determining whether the content is saved as plain text or CSV format.

outputs.name: show_help
outputs.description: A URL to the node's documentation, providing additional help and examples.

CR Schedule Input Switch.description: This node allows for the dynamic selection between two input schedules based on a given integer input. It facilitates conditional scheduling within animations, enabling the switch from one schedule to another based on the specified condition.

inputs.name: Input
inputs.description: Determines which schedule to output based on its value. A value of 1 selects the first schedule, while any other value selects the second schedule.

inputs.name: schedule1
inputs.description: The first schedule option that can be selected.

inputs.name: schedule2
inputs.description: The second schedule option that can be selected.

outputs.name: SCHEDULE
outputs.description: Outputs the selected schedule based on the input condition.

outputs.name: show_help
outputs.description: Provides a URL to the help documentation for this node.

CR SD1.5 Aspect Ratio.description: This node is designed to adjust the aspect ratio of images for Stable Diffusion 1.5, allowing users to select from a variety of predefined aspect ratios, swap dimensions, and manage upscale factors. It's particularly useful for tailoring image dimensions to specific requirements or preferences.

inputs.name: width
inputs.description: The initial width of the image. This value is adjusted based on the selected aspect ratio.

inputs.name: height
inputs.description: The initial height of the image. This value is adjusted based on the selected aspect ratio.

inputs.name: aspect_ratio
inputs.description: A predefined aspect ratio selection that determines the new dimensions of the image.

inputs.name: swap_dimensions
inputs.description: A toggle to swap the width and height of the image, allowing for easy orientation changes.

inputs.name: upscale_factor
inputs.description: A factor by which the image is upscaled, affecting the final image size.

inputs.name: batch_size
inputs.description: The number of images to process in a batch, affecting performance and memory usage.

outputs.name: width
outputs.description: The adjusted width of the image after applying the selected aspect ratio.

outputs.name: height
outputs.description: The adjusted height of the image after applying the selected aspect ratio.

outputs.name: upscale_factor
outputs.description: The factor by which the image has been upscaled.

outputs.name: batch_size
outputs.description: The number of images processed in the batch.

outputs.name: empty_latent
outputs.description: The latent representation of the image with adjusted dimensions, ready for further processing or generation.

outputs.name: show_help
outputs.description: A URL to the help documentation for this node.

CR SDXL Aspect Ratio.description: This node is designed to adjust the aspect ratio of images specifically for the SDXL model, accommodating a variety of predefined aspect ratios to fit different use cases, such as portraits, landscapes, and cinema formats. It allows for customization of image dimensions based on the selected aspect ratio, ensuring that the output images are optimally sized for the SDXL model's requirements.

inputs.name: width
inputs.description: Specifies the initial width of the image before aspect ratio adjustment. It serves as a base dimension that might be altered based on the selected aspect ratio.

inputs.name: height
inputs.description: Specifies the initial height of the image before aspect ratio adjustment. It acts as a base dimension that might be modified according to the chosen aspect ratio.

inputs.name: aspect_ratio
inputs.description: Determines the target aspect ratio for the image, offering a selection of predefined ratios tailored for the SDXL model. This choice dictates the final dimensions of the output image.

inputs.name: swap_dimensions
inputs.description: Allows for the swapping of width and height dimensions of the image, accommodating orientation adjustments as needed.

inputs.name: upscale_factor
inputs.description: Defines the factor by which the image's dimensions are scaled up, enhancing the resolution of the output image.

inputs.name: batch_size
inputs.description: Specifies the number of images to process in a single batch, facilitating efficient batch processing of images.

outputs.name: width
outputs.description: The adjusted width of the image after applying the selected aspect ratio and any scaling.

outputs.name: height
outputs.description: The adjusted height of the image after applying the selected aspect ratio and any scaling.

outputs.name: upscale_factor
outputs.description: The factor by which the image's dimensions have been scaled up.

outputs.name: batch_size
outputs.description: The number of images processed in the batch.

outputs.name: empty_latent
outputs.description: unknown

outputs.name: show_help
outputs.description: A URL to a help page providing additional information and guidance on using the aspect ratio node.

CR SDXL Base Prompt Encoder.description: The CR SDXL Base Prompt Encoder node is designed to encode base prompts for the SDXL model, providing foundational text inputs that can be further customized or mixed with other prompts. It plays a crucial role in establishing the initial context or theme for text-to-image generation tasks within the SDXL framework.

inputs.name: base_clip
inputs.description: Represents the foundational CLIP model used for encoding the base prompts, setting the initial visual-textual context for the SDXL model.

inputs.name: pos_g
inputs.description: Positive guidance text for enhancing specific attributes or themes in the generated images.

inputs.name: pos_l
inputs.description: Localized positive guidance text for fine-tuning specific areas or aspects within the generated images.

inputs.name: neg_g
inputs.description: Negative guidance text for suppressing undesired attributes or themes in the generated images.

inputs.name: neg_l
inputs.description: Localized negative guidance text for reducing specific undesired areas or aspects within the generated images.

inputs.name: preset
inputs.description: A predefined set of parameters or settings that influence the encoding process and the resulting image generation.

inputs.name: base_width
inputs.description: The width of the base image or context area for the encoding process.

inputs.name: base_height
inputs.description: The height of the base image or context area for the encoding process.

inputs.name: crop_w
inputs.description: Width of the cropping area applied to the base context, allowing for focus on specific regions during encoding.

inputs.name: crop_h
inputs.description: Height of the cropping area applied to the base context, enabling emphasis on particular regions during encoding.

inputs.name: target_width
inputs.description: The target width for the output image, guiding the scaling and aspect ratio of the generated content.

inputs.name: target_height
inputs.description: The target height for the output image, directing the scaling and aspect ratio of the generated content.

outputs.name: base_positive
outputs.description: The encoded positive base prompt, ready for further processing or combination with other prompts for image generation.

outputs.name: base_negative
outputs.description: The encoded negative base prompt, prepared for additional processing or merging with other prompts for image generation.

outputs.name: show_help
outputs.description: A helper output providing guidance or suggestions for optimizing the use of encoded prompts in the SDXL model.

CR SDXL Prompt Mix Presets.description: This node is designed to blend and manipulate text prompts and styles according to predefined presets, enabling the creation of nuanced and varied input prompts for generative models. It allows for the customization of positive and negative prompts and styles, offering a versatile tool for creative and targeted prompt engineering.

inputs.name: prompt_positive
inputs.description: The positive prompt text to be mixed or manipulated. It serves as the base for generating positive aspects of the final prompt, influencing the generative model's output towards desired characteristics.

inputs.name: prompt_negative
inputs.description: The negative prompt text to be mixed or manipulated. It acts as the base for generating negative aspects of the final prompt, guiding the generative model away from undesired characteristics.

inputs.name: style_positive
inputs.description: The positive style text to be mixed with the prompt. It enhances the positive aspects of the final prompt by adding stylistic elements, further directing the model's output.

inputs.name: style_negative
inputs.description: The negative style text to be mixed with the prompt. It enhances the negative aspects of the final prompt by adding stylistic elements, further preventing undesired outcomes in the model's output.

inputs.name: preset
inputs.description: The preset configuration for mixing the prompts and styles. It determines the specific way in which the positive and negative prompts and styles are combined, offering various creative possibilities.

outputs.name: pos_g
outputs.description: The generated positive prompt for global context.

outputs.name: pos_l
outputs.description: The generated positive prompt for local context.

outputs.name: pos_r
outputs.description: The generated positive prompt for right-aligned context.

outputs.name: neg_g
outputs.description: The generated negative prompt for global context.

outputs.name: neg_l
outputs.description: The generated negative prompt for local context.

outputs.name: neg_r
outputs.description: The generated negative prompt for right-aligned context.

outputs.name: show_help
outputs.description: A URL providing additional help and documentation for using the node.

CR SDXL Prompt Mixer.description: The CR SDXL Prompt Mixer node is designed to blend and manipulate text prompts and styles for generative models, allowing for the creation of customized prompt combinations based on user-defined positive and negative prompts and styles, as well as preset configurations. This node facilitates the exploration of creative prompt variations to influence the generative process.

inputs.name: prompt_positive
inputs.description: The positive prompt text that contributes to the desired attributes or themes in the generated content.

inputs.name: prompt_negative
inputs.description: The negative prompt text that specifies undesired attributes or themes to be minimized or avoided in the generated content.

inputs.name: style_positive
inputs.description: The positive style text that defines the desired stylistic attributes to be emphasized in the generated content.

inputs.name: style_negative
inputs.description: The negative style text that specifies undesired stylistic attributes to be minimized or avoided in the generated content.

inputs.name: preset
inputs.description: A predefined configuration that determines how the positive and negative prompts and styles are mixed and applied.

outputs.name: pos_g
outputs.description: The global positive prompt text after mixing based on the selected preset.

outputs.name: pos_l
outputs.description: The local positive prompt text after mixing based on the selected preset.

outputs.name: pos_r
outputs.description: The right-aligned positive prompt text after mixing based on the selected preset.

outputs.name: neg_g
outputs.description: The global negative prompt text after mixing based on the selected preset.

outputs.name: neg_l
outputs.description: The local negative prompt text after mixing based on the selected preset.

outputs.name: neg_r
outputs.description: The right-aligned negative prompt text after mixing based on the selected preset.

CR SDXL Style Text.description: The CR SDXL Style Text node is designed to generate stylized text prompts for creative applications, allowing users to specify positive and negative styles to influence the generated text. It provides a straightforward way to craft text prompts that align with specific stylistic preferences, enhancing the creative process.

inputs.name: positive_style
inputs.description: Defines the desired style attributes to emphasize in the generated text, influencing the text generation towards positive stylistic elements.

inputs.name: negative_style
inputs.description: Specifies the style attributes to de-emphasize or avoid in the generated text, guiding the text generation away from these stylistic elements.

outputs.name: positive_prompt_text_l
outputs.description: The generated text prompt that emphasizes the positive style attributes.

outputs.name: negative_prompt_text_l
outputs.description: The generated text prompt that de-emphasizes the negative style attributes.

outputs.name: show_help
outputs.description: A URL to a help page providing additional information and guidance on using the CR SDXL Style Text node.

CR Seamless Checker.description: The CR Seamless Checker node is designed to evaluate and ensure the seamless integration of various components within a system, focusing on compatibility and smooth operation across different modules or elements. It aims to identify and address potential discrepancies or conflicts that might disrupt the seamless functionality of the system.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The 'image' input represents the visual content to be checked for seamless integration, playing a crucial role in the evaluation process.

inputs.name: rescale_factor
inputs.description: The 'rescale_factor' input determines the scaling factor to be applied to the image, affecting the node's execution and results.

inputs.name: grid_options
inputs.description: The 'grid_options' input specifies the configuration for grid generation, influencing the seamless checker's operation.

outputs.name: show_help
outputs.description: The 'show_help' output provides guidance or suggestions based on the seamless integration evaluation of the image.

CR Seed to Int.description: The CR Seed to Int node is designed to convert a seed value into an integer, providing a straightforward mechanism for seed manipulation and conversion within custom node workflows. It also offers a link to further documentation, aiding users in understanding its application.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.description: The seed parameter is crucial for the conversion process, serving as the input that is directly transformed into an integer. Its value dictates the outcome of the conversion.

outputs.name: INT
outputs.description: Represents the integer value obtained from the conversion of the seed input.

outputs.name: show_help
outputs.description: Provides a URL to detailed documentation about the CR Seed to Int node, assisting users in understanding its usage and functionalities.

CR Seed.description: The CR Seed node is designed to provide a consistent starting point for random number generation processes by supplying a seed value. It also offers a link to further documentation on its usage.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.description: The seed parameter is crucial for initializing the random number generator to ensure reproducibility of results across different runs.

outputs.name: seed
outputs.description: Returns the same seed value that was input, allowing it to be used in subsequent operations.

outputs.name: show_help
outputs.description: Provides a URL to the documentation for further assistance and detailed information about the CR Seed node.

CR Select Font.description: This node allows users to select a font from a list of available TrueType fonts (.ttf) based on the operating system's font directory. It is designed to facilitate the customization of text appearance in graphics by providing access to system fonts.

inputs.name: font_name
inputs.description: Specifies the name of the font to be selected. This parameter enables the customization of text appearance by allowing users to choose from available TrueType fonts.

outputs.name: font_name
outputs.description: Returns the selected font name, facilitating further text customization operations.

outputs.name: show_help
outputs.description: Provides a URL to the help documentation for the CR Select Font node, offering users guidance on its usage.

CR Select ISO Size.description: This node allows users to select an ISO paper size from a predefined list of sizes, and returns the dimensions (width and height) of the selected size along with a URL to a help page.

inputs.name: iso_size
inputs.description: Specifies the ISO paper size to be selected. The choice of size directly determines the dimensions (width and height) that will be returned.

outputs.name: width
outputs.description: The width of the selected ISO paper size.

outputs.name: height
outputs.description: The height of the selected ISO paper size.

outputs.name: show_help
outputs.description: A URL to a help page providing additional information about selecting ISO sizes.

CR Select Model.description: The CR Select Model node is designed to select and load a specific model based on user input. It facilitates the dynamic selection of models from a predefined list, enabling users to switch between different models for their generative tasks.

inputs.name: ckpt_name1
inputs.description: Represents the first checkpoint name option for model selection.

inputs.name: ckpt_name2
inputs.description: Represents the second checkpoint name option for model selection.

inputs.name: ckpt_name3
inputs.description: Represents the third checkpoint name option for model selection.

inputs.name: ckpt_name4
inputs.description: Represents the fourth checkpoint name option for model selection.

inputs.name: ckpt_name5
inputs.description: Represents the fifth checkpoint name option for model selection.

inputs.name: select_model
inputs.description: An integer input that determines which model checkpoint to load from the given options.

outputs.name: MODEL
outputs.description: unknown

outputs.name: CLIP
outputs.description: unknown

outputs.name: VAE
outputs.description: unknown

outputs.name: ckpt_name
outputs.description: The name of the selected model.

outputs.name: show_help
outputs.description: A URL to the help documentation for this node.

CR Select Resize Method.description: This node allows users to select a method for resizing images, providing options between fitting and cropping to achieve the desired dimensions. It's designed to facilitate the customization of image processing workflows by offering a straightforward choice that influences how images are resized.

inputs.name: method
inputs.description: Specifies the resizing method to be used, either 'Fit' or 'Crop', affecting how the image will be resized to meet the desired dimensions.

outputs.name: method
outputs.description: Returns the selected method for resizing the image.

outputs.name: show_help
outputs.description: Provides a URL to the documentation or help page related to the selected resize method.

CR Set Switch From String.description: This node dynamically sets a switch based on a string input, allowing for conditional logic flows within a node network. It supports up to four predefined string conditions to determine the switch's state.

inputs.name: text
inputs.description: The primary string input used to determine the switch's state. It's essential for executing the node's logic and determining the output.

inputs.name: switch_1
inputs.description: A predefined condition string. If it matches the 'text' input, the switch is set to 1.

inputs.name: switch_2
inputs.description: A predefined condition string. If it matches the 'text' input, the switch is set to 2.

inputs.name: switch_3
inputs.description: A predefined condition string. If it matches the 'text' input, the switch is set to 3.

inputs.name: switch_4
inputs.description: A predefined condition string. If it matches the 'text' input, the switch is set to 4.

outputs.name: switch
outputs.description: The output switch state determined by the input string, indicating which condition was met.

outputs.name: show_help
outputs.description: A URL providing additional help and documentation for using this node.

CR Set Value On Binary.description: The CR_SetValueOnBinary node is designed to conditionally assign a value based on a binary input. It facilitates decision-making processes within a workflow by allowing users to specify different outcomes (values) depending on whether the binary input is 1 or 0.

inputs.name: binary
inputs.description: The binary input determines the branch of execution: if the input is 1, one value is returned; if 0, another value is chosen. This binary decision-making forms the core functionality of the node.

inputs.name: value_if_1
inputs.description: Specifies the value to return if the binary input is 1, enabling conditional logic based on binary input.

inputs.name: value_if_0
inputs.description: Specifies the value to return if the binary input is 0, enabling conditional logic based on binary input.

outputs.name: INT
outputs.description: The integer representation of the selected value based on the binary input.

outputs.name: FLOAT
outputs.description: The floating-point representation of the selected value based on the binary input.

outputs.name: show_help
outputs.description: A URL to the help documentation for this node.

CR Set Value On Boolean.description: This node dynamically assigns a value based on a boolean input, allowing for conditional logic within node flows. It provides a straightforward mechanism to output different values depending on whether a given boolean condition is true or false.

inputs.name: boolean
inputs.description: Determines the branch of conditional logic to follow. If true, the node outputs the value specified for 'true' conditions; otherwise, it outputs the value for 'false' conditions.

inputs.name: value_if_true
inputs.description: The value to output if the 'boolean' input is true. This allows for dynamic responses based on conditional checks.

inputs.name: value_if_false
inputs.description: The value to output if the 'boolean' input is false. This enables the node to adapt its output based on the evaluated condition.

outputs.name: INT
outputs.description: The integer representation of the output value, providing a numeric outcome based on the boolean condition.

outputs.name: FLOAT
outputs.description: The floating-point representation of the output value, offering a more precise numeric outcome.

outputs.name: show_help
outputs.description: A URL to the node's documentation, offering additional help and examples.

CR Set Value on String.description: This node is designed to conditionally set a string value based on the presence of a specified substring within another string. It facilitates conditional logic in text processing, allowing users to dynamically alter text outputs based on specific criteria.

inputs.name: text
inputs.description: The primary string to be evaluated for the presence of the 'test_string'. Its presence or absence determines which value ('value_if_true' or 'value_if_false') is returned.

inputs.name: test_string
inputs.description: The substring to be searched for within 'text'. If found, 'value_if_true' is returned; otherwise, 'value_if_false' is returned.

inputs.name: value_if_true
inputs.description: The string value to return if 'test_string' is found within 'text'.

inputs.name: value_if_false
inputs.description: The string value to return if 'test_string' is not found within 'text'.

outputs.name: STRING
outputs.description: The output string, determined by whether 'test_string' was found within 'text'.

outputs.name: BOOLEAN
outputs.description: A boolean value indicating whether 'test_string' was found within 'text'.

outputs.name: show_help
outputs.description: A URL to the help documentation for this node.

CR Simple Banner.description: The CR Simple Banner node is designed to create visually appealing banners by combining images with customizable text, fonts, and colors. It allows for the creation of banners with specific aesthetic requirements, such as font size, color, and outline, as well as the inclusion of margin sizes for layout adjustments.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The image parameter is the base image over which the banner text will be overlaid. It serves as the foundational visual element of the banner.

inputs.name: banner_text
inputs.description: The banner_text parameter specifies the text to be displayed on the banner. This text is customizable and is a key element in conveying the banner's message or theme.

inputs.name: font_name
inputs.description: The font_name parameter determines the typeface used for the banner text, allowing for stylistic customization to match the banner's design theme.

inputs.name: max_font_size
inputs.description: The max_font_size parameter sets the maximum size of the font for the banner text, enabling control over the text's visual impact and readability.

inputs.name: font_color
inputs.description: The font_color parameter specifies the color of the banner text, contributing to the banner's overall aesthetic and theme.

inputs.name: outline_thickness
inputs.description: The outline_thickness parameter controls the thickness of the outline around the banner text, enhancing text visibility and adding a distinct visual effect.

inputs.name: outline_color
inputs.description: The outline_color parameter defines the color of the text outline, which can be used to create contrast or complement the banner's color scheme.

inputs.name: margin_size
inputs.description: The margin_size parameter adjusts the spacing around the banner text, affecting the layout and overall composition of the banner.

inputs.name: font_color_hex
inputs.description: The font_color_hex parameter allows specifying the font color in hexadecimal format, offering precise control over the text color.

inputs.name: outline_color_hex
inputs.description: The outline_color_hex parameter allows specifying the outline color in hexadecimal format, providing additional customization for the text outline.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The image output represents the final banner image with the applied text and styling, ready for use in various media formats.

outputs.name: show_help
outputs.description: The show_help output provides guidance or additional information related to the banner creation process.

CR Simple Binary Pattern.description: This node generates simple binary patterns, offering a straightforward approach to creating binary (two-color) designs. It abstracts the complexity of pattern generation, enabling users to easily produce visually appealing binary patterns for various applications.

inputs.name: binary_pattern
inputs.description: Specifies the binary pattern as a multiline string, where each line represents a row in the pattern. This pattern dictates the visual structure of the generated image.

inputs.name: width
