It focuses on enhancing or modifying images through a series of transformations, with an emphasis on batch processing for efficiency and scalability.

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: Specifies the model to which the image processing adaptations will be applied. It is central to the node's operation, determining the transformations that will be performed on the input images.

inputs.name: ipadapter
inputs.description: Defines the specific IPAdapter to be used for the image processing adaptations. This parameter is crucial for determining the nature of the transformations applied to the images.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The input image to be processed. This parameter is essential for the node's functionality, serving as the primary data on which the adaptations are applied.

inputs.name: weight
inputs.description: Affects the intensity of the applied adaptations, allowing for fine-tuning of the transformation's impact on the image.

inputs.name: weight_type
inputs.description: Determines the method of weighting the adaptations, influencing how the transformations are applied based on the specified type.

inputs.name: start_at
inputs.description: Defines the starting point of the adaptation process, enabling control over when the transformations begin to take effect.

inputs.name: end_at
inputs.description: Specifies the endpoint of the adaptation process, allowing for precise control over the duration and extent of the transformations.

inputs.name: sharpening
inputs.description: Controls the level of image sharpening applied during the adaptation process, enhancing the clarity and detail of the transformed images.

inputs.name: embeds_scaling
inputs.description: Determines how the embeddings are scaled during the adaptation process, affecting the overall impact of the transformations on the image.

inputs.name: encode_batch_size
inputs.description: Specifies the batch size for encoding operations, optimizing the efficiency of the adaptation process by adjusting the volume of data processed at once.

inputs.name: image_negative
inputs.description: An optional negative image input that can be used for contrastive adaptations, enhancing the effectiveness of certain transformations.

inputs.name: attn_mask
inputs.description: An optional attention mask that can be applied to focus or restrict the adaptations to specific areas of the image.

inputs.name: clip_vision
inputs.description: An optional parameter that, when provided, integrates CLIP vision features into the adaptation process, enriching the transformations with additional visual context.

outputs.name: MODEL
outputs.description: The model after the image processing adaptations have been applied, reflecting the changes made to the input images.

outputs.name: tiles
outputs.description: The processed tiles of the image, showcasing the results of the applied adaptations.

outputs.name: masks
outputs.description: The masks used or generated during the adaptation process, indicating areas of focus or alteration.

IPAdapterUnifiedLoader.description: The IPAdapterUnifiedLoader node serves as a foundational component for loading various IPAdapter configurations, facilitating the dynamic integration of different model presets and computational backends. It abstracts the complexity of handling diverse input parameters, offering a streamlined approach to adapt image processing algorithms to specific needs.

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: Specifies the model to be used, serving as a key parameter in determining the processing capabilities and the output quality of the node.

inputs.name: preset
inputs.description: Defines the preset configuration to apply, allowing for customization of the processing based on predefined settings.

inputs.name: ipadapter
inputs.description: Optional parameter for specifying an IPAdapter instance, enabling further customization and flexibility in processing.

outputs.name: model
outputs.description: The configured model ready for use, encapsulating the selected presets and adjustments.

outputs.name: ipadapter
outputs.description: An optional IPAdapter instance that can be used for additional processing or customization.

IPAdapterUnifiedLoaderCommunity.description: The IPAdapterUnifiedLoaderCommunity node is designed to facilitate the loading of community-specific models into the IPAdapter framework. It allows for the customization and extension of model capabilities by incorporating community-driven presets and configurations.

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: Specifies the model to be loaded, serving as a key identifier within the IPAdapter framework.

inputs.name: preset
inputs.description: Defines the preset configuration to be applied to the model, focusing on community-specific enhancements or modifications.

inputs.name: ipadapter
inputs.description: Optional parameter to specify an existing IPAdapter instance for further customization or modification.

outputs.name: model
outputs.description: Returns the loaded model, ready for integration and use within the IPAdapter framework.

outputs.name: ipadapter
outputs.description: Returns an IPAdapter instance, potentially modified or customized based on the input parameters.

IPAdapterUnifiedLoaderFaceID.description: This node is designed to unify the loading process for FaceID models, accommodating various presets and configurations to ensure compatibility and optimal performance across different model types and computational environments.

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: Specifies the model to be loaded, serving as a key identifier for selecting the appropriate FaceID model configuration.

inputs.name: preset
inputs.description: Defines the specific FaceID preset to be used, allowing for customization and optimization based on the model's intended use case.

inputs.name: lora_strength
inputs.description: Adjusts the strength of the LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation) adjustments, providing fine-tuning capabilities for the model's performance.

inputs.name: provider
inputs.description: Determines the computational backend for model execution, supporting a range of environments from CPU to various GPU architectures.

inputs.name: ipadapter
inputs.description: Optionally specifies an IPAdapter model to be used in conjunction with the FaceID model, enhancing its capabilities.

outputs.name: MODEL
outputs.description: The loaded model, ready for use with the specified configurations and enhancements.

outputs.name: ipadapter
outputs.description: The optionally specified IPAdapter model, loaded and configured for use.

IPAdapterWeights.description: The IPAdapterWeights node is designed to manage and manipulate weights within the IPAdapter framework, focusing on the application of weight strategies for image processing. It enables the customization of weight distribution across frames, supports various timing methods, and facilitates the integration of images with weight-based adjustments.

inputs.name: weights
inputs.description: A string of comma or newline-separated weight values to be converted into a list of floats. It forms the basis for weight distribution and manipulation.

inputs.name: timing
inputs.description: Specifies the timing strategy for applying weights across frames, influencing the animation or transition effect.

inputs.name: frames
inputs.description: The total number of frames to which the weights will be applied, defining the scope of the animation or transition.

inputs.name: start_frame
inputs.description: The starting frame number from which weight application begins, allowing for precise control over the animation's commencement.

inputs.name: end_frame
inputs.description: The ending frame number at which weight application concludes, marking the animation's termination point.

inputs.name: add_starting_frames
inputs.description: The number of additional frames to be added at the beginning of the animation, extending its start.

inputs.name: add_ending_frames
inputs.description: The number of additional frames to be added at the end of the animation, extending its duration.

inputs.name: method
inputs.description: The method used for applying weights across frames, affecting the pattern and distribution of weight adjustments.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: An optional image input that, if provided, can be used in conjunction with weights for enhanced image processing effects.

outputs.name: weights
outputs.description: The processed list of weight values after applying the specified strategy and adjustments.

outputs.name: weights_invert
outputs.description: The inverted list of weight values, providing an alternative distribution for certain processing effects.

outputs.name: total_frames
outputs.description: The total number of frames resulting from the applied weight strategy, including any added starting or ending frames.

outputs.name: image_1
outputs.description: The first image output, modified according to the weight strategy and method applied.

outputs.name: image_2
outputs.description: The second image output, modified in relation to the first image and the applied weight strategy.

outputs.name: weights_strategy
outputs.description: The weight strategy applied, encapsulating all weight-related parameters and their effects on the output.

IPAdapterWeightsFromStrategy.description: The IPAdapterWeightsFromStrategy node is designed to generate weights for image processing based on a specified strategy. It allows for the dynamic adjustment of image processing parameters, facilitating tailored image manipulation according to the strategy chosen.

inputs.name: weights_strategy
inputs.description: Specifies the strategy to be used for generating weights, influencing how images are processed and manipulated.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: An optional image input that can be used in conjunction with the weights strategy to further customize the image processing.

outputs.name: weights
outputs.description: The generated weights based on the specified strategy.

outputs.name: weights_invert
outputs.description: The inverted weights derived from the original weights, used for alternative processing effects.

outputs.name: total_frames
outputs.description: The total number of frames calculated based on the weights strategy, affecting the duration of the image processing.

outputs.name: image_1
outputs.description: The first image output, modified according to the weights and strategy applied.

outputs.name: image_2
outputs.description: The second image output, modified in a different manner based on the weights and strategy for varied effects.

outputs.name: weights_strategy
outputs.description: The weights strategy used for processing, including all parameters and settings involved.

PrepImageForClipVision.description: The node PrepImageForClipVision is designed to prepare images for processing by CLIP vision models, adapting them to the specific input requirements of these models for enhanced image understanding and analysis.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The initial image to be processed, serving as the raw input for feature extraction and encoding.

inputs.name: interpolation
inputs.description: The method used for resizing the image, affecting the quality and the way pixels are interpolated.

inputs.name: crop_position
inputs.description: Specifies the position from which the image is cropped, influencing the focus area of the processed image.

inputs.name: sharpening
inputs.description: Determines the level of sharpness applied to the image, enhancing edge definition and detail visibility.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The processed image, optimized for compatibility with CLIP vision models, ready for further analysis or encoding.

CLIPTextEncode SDXL Plus (JPS).description: This node is designed to encode text inputs using the CLIP model tailored for the SDXL architecture, enhancing text-based inputs for further processing or generation tasks. It focuses on refining and conditioning the input text to align with aesthetic or specific dimensional requirements, leveraging the advanced capabilities of the CLIP model to interpret and encode textual information in a way that's optimized for high-resolution image synthesis and manipulation.

inputs.name: width
inputs.description: Specifies the width of the output image, influencing the spatial dimensions of the conditioned output.

inputs.name: height
inputs.description: Specifies the height of the output image, influencing the spatial dimensions of the conditioned output.

inputs.name: res_factor
inputs.description: Specifies the factor by which the resolution of the output is adjusted, influencing the overall quality and detail of the conditioned output.

inputs.name: text_pos
inputs.description: The positive text input to be encoded, serving as a key component of the conditioning process to promote certain qualities or themes.

inputs.name: text_neg
inputs.description: The negative text input to be encoded, used to demote or reduce the presence of certain qualities or themes in the conditioning process.

inputs.name: clip
inputs.description: The CLIP model instance used for text tokenization and encoding, central to the node's functionality.

outputs.name: cond_pos
outputs.description: The conditioned positive output, including encoded text information tailored to promote specified qualities or themes.

outputs.name: cond_neg
outputs.description: The conditioned negative output, including encoded text information tailored to reduce or demote specified qualities or themes.

Conditioning Switch (JPS).description: The Conditioning Switch node is designed to select and output one of several conditioning inputs based on a specified selection index. It facilitates dynamic control over which conditioning data is passed forward in a processing pipeline, allowing for flexible manipulation of conditioning contexts within generative models or other computational frameworks.

inputs.name: select
inputs.description: The 'select' parameter determines which conditioning input to output, based on its numerical index. It is essential for controlling the flow of different conditioning contexts through the node.

inputs.name: con_i
inputs.description: Represents a series of optional conditioning inputs (con_1 to con_5), where 'i' can range from 1 to 5. These inputs allow for dynamic selection of conditioning data based on the 'select' parameter, enabling varied contextual inputs for processing.

outputs.name: con_out
outputs.description: The output conditioning data selected based on the 'select' parameter. It enables dynamic switching between different conditioning contexts.

ControlNet Switch (JPS).description: The ControlNet Switch node is designed to dynamically select between multiple control network configurations based on a given selection input. It facilitates the flexible manipulation of control networks within a processing pipeline, allowing for the conditional application of different control network settings.

inputs.name: select
inputs.description: Specifies the index of the control network to be selected for output. This input determines which control network configuration is applied, enabling dynamic switching between configurations.

inputs.name: ctrlnet_i
inputs.description: Represents a generic control network configuration option, where 'i' can range from 1 to 5, indicating the selectable control network configurations based on the 'select' input.

outputs.name: ctrlnet_out
outputs.description: Outputs the selected control network configuration, facilitating its application in subsequent processing steps.

Crop Image Pipe (JPS).description: The Crop Image Pipe node is designed to process image cropping settings, applying specified cropping positions, offsets, and interpolation methods to images. It abstracts the complexity of image cropping operations, enabling users to define how images should be cropped and resized for further processing or visualization.

inputs.name: cropimage_settings
inputs.description: Specifies the settings for cropping an image, including the positions, offsets, and interpolation method to be used. This parameter is crucial for determining how the image will be cropped and resized, affecting the final output.

outputs.name: source_crop_pos
outputs.description: The position from which the source image should be cropped.

outputs.name: source_crop_offset
outputs.description: The offset applied to the source image cropping position.

outputs.name: support_crop_pos
outputs.description: The position from which the support image should be cropped.

outputs.name: support_crop_offset
outputs.description: The offset applied to the support image cropping position.

outputs.name: crop_intpol
outputs.description: The interpolation method used for cropping the image.

Crop Image Settings (JPS).description: The Crop Image Settings node is designed to configure the parameters for cropping images, including the position, offset, and interpolation method. It abstracts the complexity of image cropping settings, allowing for flexible and precise control over how images are cropped and prepared for further processing.

inputs.name: source_crop_pos
inputs.description: Specifies the initial position for cropping the source image. This affects the starting point of the crop and influences the final composition of the cropped image.

inputs.name: source_crop_offset
inputs.description: Determines the offset from the specified position for the source image crop, providing fine-tuned control over the crop's placement.

inputs.name: support_crop_pos
inputs.description: Specifies the initial position for cropping the support image, similar to 'source_crop_pos' but for an additional image or context.

inputs.name: support_crop_offset
inputs.description: Determines the offset from the specified position for the support image crop, allowing for precise alignment with the source image.

inputs.name: crop_intpol
inputs.description: Defines the interpolation method to be used for cropping, affecting the quality and appearance of the cropped image.

outputs.name: cropimage_settings
outputs.description: The configuration settings for cropping an image, encapsulating position, offset, and interpolation method details.

Crop Image Square (JPS).description: This node is designed to crop an image into a square shape based on specified parameters such as crop position, offsets, zoom level, interpolation method, target resolution, and sharpening intensity. It allows for precise control over the cropping process to achieve the desired square crop of an image.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The image to be cropped into a square shape. This parameter is crucial as it defines the source image that will undergo the cropping process.

inputs.name: crop_position
inputs.description: Specifies the position from which the crop should start, allowing for targeted cropping based on the image's composition.

inputs.name: offset_x
inputs.description: The horizontal offset from the specified crop position, enabling fine-tuning of the crop's starting point on the x-axis.

inputs.name: offset_y
inputs.description: The vertical offset from the specified crop position, enabling fine-tuning of the crop's starting point on the y-axis.

inputs.name: zoom
inputs.description: Determines the zoom level applied to the image before cropping, allowing for closer focus on specific areas of the image.

inputs.name: interpolation
inputs.description: The method used for resizing the image during the cropping process, affecting the quality of the cropped image.

inputs.name: target_rez
inputs.description: The target resolution for the cropped image, specifying the desired dimensions of the output square image.

inputs.name: sharpening
inputs.description: The intensity of sharpening applied to the cropped image, enhancing its details and edges.

outputs.name: IMAGE
outputs.description: The resulting image after the cropping process, which has been adjusted to meet the specified square shape, resolution, and quality enhancements.

Crop Image TargetSize (JPS).description: The Crop Image TargetSize node is designed for adjusting images to specific target dimensions with options for cropping, zooming, and applying various interpolation and sharpening techniques. It provides flexibility in image processing by allowing for precise control over the dimensions and quality of the output image, catering to different requirements for image manipulation.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The input image to be processed. It serves as the base for cropping, resizing, and applying other transformations to meet the target dimensions and quality specifications.

inputs.name: target_w
inputs.description: The target width for the output image. This parameter dictates the desired width that the image should be adjusted to, either by cropping or resizing.

inputs.name: target_h
inputs.description: The target height for the output image. Similar to target_w, it specifies the desired height for the image adjustment.

inputs.name: crop_position
inputs.description: Specifies the position from which the image should be cropped. This affects how the image is aligned before cropping to the target dimensions.

inputs.name: offset
inputs.description: A general offset value used when adjusting the image's position before cropping. It allows for fine-tuning the crop alignment.

inputs.name: interpolation
inputs.description: The method used for resizing the image. Different interpolation techniques can affect the image's quality and appearance.

inputs.name: sharpening
inputs.description: Determines whether and how much the output image should be sharpened, enhancing its details and overall clarity.

outputs.name: IMAGE
outputs.description: The processed image after applying the specified cropping, zooming, interpolation, and sharpening transformations. It represents the final output that meets the target dimensions and quality criteria.

CtrlNet CannyEdge Pipe (JPS).description: The CtrlNet CannyEdge Pipe node is designed to process settings for Canny Edge detection, returning various parameters such as source, strength, start, end, and threshold values. This node is part of the JPS Nodes/Pipes category, focusing on image processing and manipulation by applying the Canny Edge detection algorithm.

inputs.name: cannyedge_settings
inputs.description: Specifies the configuration for Canny Edge detection, including source, strength, start and end positions, and low and high threshold values. This input is crucial for determining how the edge detection is performed and its sensitivity.

outputs.name: cannyedge_source
outputs.description: The source of the image for Canny Edge detection.

outputs.name: cannyedge_strength
outputs.description: The strength of the Canny Edge detection effect.

outputs.name: cannyedge_start
outputs.description: The start position for applying the Canny Edge detection.

outputs.name: cannyedge_end
outputs.description: The end position for applying the Canny Edge detection.

outputs.name: cannyedge_low
outputs.description: The low threshold value for the Canny Edge detection.

outputs.name: cannyedge_high
outputs.description: The high threshold value for the Canny Edge detection.

CtrlNet CannyEdge Settings (JPS).description: This node is designed to configure settings for the Canny Edge detection process within a pipeline, allowing users to specify parameters such as edge detection strength, start and end thresholds, and high and low threshold values.

inputs.name: cannyedge_from
inputs.description: Specifies the source of the image for Canny Edge detection, allowing selection from predefined sources such as 'Source Image', 'Support Image', or 'Support Direct'.

inputs.name: cannyedge_strength
inputs.description: Determines the intensity of the edge detection process, with a range allowing for fine-tuning of the edge detection's sensitivity.

inputs.name: cannyedge_start
inputs.description: Sets the starting threshold for edge detection, enabling control over the minimum edge strength that will be considered.

inputs.name: cannyedge_end
inputs.description: Defines the ending threshold for edge detection, allowing users to limit the maximum edge strength that will be detected.

inputs.name: cannyedge_low
inputs.description: Specifies the low threshold value for the hysteresis procedure in Canny Edge detection, influencing the detection of weaker edges.

inputs.name: cannyedge_high
inputs.description: Sets the high threshold value for the hysteresis procedure in Canny Edge detection, affecting the detection of stronger edges.

outputs.name: cannyedge_settings
outputs.description: Outputs the configured settings for Canny Edge detection as a tuple, ready to be used in the detection process.

CtrlNet MiDaS Pipe (JPS).description: The CtrlNet MiDaS Pipe node is designed to process settings for depth estimation using the MiDaS model, encapsulating the configuration into a format suitable for further processing or application within a pipeline. It primarily serves to adjust depth-related parameters based on input settings.

inputs.name: midas_settings
inputs.description: Specifies the configuration for depth estimation, including source, strength, start, end, and additional parameters, which collectively determine how depth estimation is performed.

outputs.name: midas_source
outputs.description: Identifies the source image for depth estimation.

outputs.name: midas_strength
outputs.description: Specifies the strength of the depth effect.

outputs.name: midas_start
outputs.description: Defines the starting point of depth effect application.

outputs.name: midas_end
outputs.description: Marks the end point of depth effect application.

outputs.name: midas_a
outputs.description: Adjusts a specific depth parameter, influencing the overall depth effect.

outputs.name: midas_bg
outputs.description: Controls the background depth parameter, affecting how background depth is rendered.

CtrlNet MiDaS Settings (JPS).description: This node is designed to configure settings for the MiDaS depth estimation model within a control network, allowing users to specify the source of depth information, its strength, and the range over which the depth effect should be applied.

inputs.name: midas_from
inputs.description: Specifies the source of depth information, offering options such as 'Source Image', 'Support Image', or 'Support Direct'. This choice determines the origin of depth data for processing.

inputs.name: midas_strength
inputs.description: Controls the intensity of the depth effect applied by the MiDaS model, with a range allowing for fine-tuned adjustments to the depth perception.

inputs.name: midas_start
inputs.description: Defines the starting point of the depth effect's application, enabling precise control over where the depth begins to take effect.

inputs.name: midas_end
inputs.description: Sets the endpoint for the depth effect, allowing users to limit the depth's influence to a specific range within the image.

inputs.name: midas_a
inputs.description: Adjusts a specific parameter within the MiDaS model, offering additional customization of the depth effect.

inputs.name: midas_bg
inputs.description: Modifies the background depth value, enabling users to fine-tune the depth effect's background intensity.

outputs.name: midas_settings
outputs.description: Outputs the configured settings for the MiDaS model as a tuple, ready for use in depth estimation processes.

CtrlNet OpenPose Pipe (JPS).description: The CtrlNet OpenPose Pipe node is designed to process and apply OpenPose settings to input data, facilitating the configuration and application of OpenPose parameters for pose estimation tasks. It abstracts the complexity of setting up OpenPose configurations, making it easier to integrate pose estimation into broader workflows.

inputs.name: openpose_settings
inputs.description: Specifies the configuration settings for OpenPose, including source, strength, start, end, and options for body, face, and hand detection. Each setting plays a critical role in tailoring the OpenPose algorithm's behavior, affecting the accuracy and focus of pose estimation. For instance, the source determines where the OpenPose algorithm will be applied (e.g., main or support images), strength adjusts the intensity of pose detection, and the options for body, face, and hand detection enable specific aspects of the pose to be emphasized or ignored, depending on the requirements of the task.

outputs.name: openpose_source
outputs.description: Identifies the source of the input for OpenPose processing.

outputs.name: openpose_strength
outputs.description: Defines the strength of the OpenPose effect.

outputs.name: openpose_start
outputs.description: Specifies the start point of the OpenPose effect.

outputs.name: openpose_end
outputs.description: Specifies the end point of the OpenPose effect.

outputs.name: openpose_body
outputs.description: Enables or disables body detection in OpenPose.

outputs.name: openpose_face
outputs.description: Enables or disables face detection in OpenPose.

outputs.name: openpose_hand
outputs.description: Enables or disables hand detection in OpenPose.

CtrlNet OpenPose Settings (JPS).description: This node is designed to configure settings for the OpenPose algorithm within a control network, allowing users to specify parameters such as the source of the pose estimation, the strength of the pose estimation, and whether to enable or disable body, face, and hand estimations. It abstracts the complexity of OpenPose configuration into a simple, user-friendly interface.

inputs.name: openpose_from
inputs.description: Specifies the source image for OpenPose estimation, allowing selection between 'Source Image', 'Support Image', or 'Support Direct'. This choice determines the input image on which the OpenPose algorithm will be applied.

inputs.name: openpose_strength
inputs.description: Controls the intensity of the OpenPose estimation, with a range from 0.00 to 10.00. This parameter allows for fine-tuning the impact of pose estimation on the final output.

inputs.name: openpose_start
inputs.description: Defines the starting point of the OpenPose effect within the processing pipeline, allowing for precise control over when the pose estimation begins.

inputs.name: openpose_end
inputs.description: Sets the endpoint for the OpenPose effect, enabling users to define the duration and finality of the pose estimation within the workflow.

inputs.name: openpose_body
inputs.description: Enables or disables body estimation in the OpenPose algorithm, offering control over the inclusion of body pose data in the output.

inputs.name: openpose_face
inputs.description: Allows the user to enable or disable face estimation, providing flexibility in whether facial pose data is included in the OpenPose analysis.

inputs.name: openpose_hand
inputs.description: Determines whether hand estimation is enabled or disabled, enabling users to decide if hand pose data should be factored into the OpenPose results.

outputs.name: openpose_settings
outputs.description: Outputs the configured settings for OpenPose as a tuple, ready to be used in the control network's pose estimation pipeline.

CtrlNet ZoeDepth Pipe (JPS).description: This node is designed to process ZoeDepth settings, translating them into specific values that can be utilized in further image processing or rendering tasks. It abstracts the complexity of handling depth-related parameters by providing a straightforward interface to specify depth effects.

inputs.name: zoedepth_settings
inputs.description: Specifies the settings for ZoeDepth, including source, strength, start, and end points of depth effect. This input is crucial for determining how depth will be applied in the image processing pipeline.

outputs.name: zoe_source
outputs.description: The source of depth information, determined by the ZoeDepth settings.

outputs.name: zoe_strength
outputs.description: The strength of the depth effect.

outputs.name: zoe_start
outputs.description: The starting point of the depth effect.

outputs.name: zoe_end
outputs.description: The ending point of the depth effect.

CtrlNet ZoeDepth Settings (JPS).description: This node is designed to configure depth settings for a control network, specifically focusing on the ZoeDepth aspect. It allows users to select the depth source, adjust depth strength, and define the start and end points of depth application, providing a customizable depth effect for images.

inputs.name: zoe_from
inputs.description: Specifies the source of depth information, allowing selection from predefined options such as Source Image, Support Image, or Support Direct. This choice determines the origin of depth data for processing.

inputs.name: zoe_strength
inputs.description: Controls the intensity of the depth effect, with a range allowing for subtle to pronounced depth enhancements.

inputs.name: zoe_start
inputs.description: Defines the starting point of depth application, enabling fine-tuning of where the depth effect begins in the image.

inputs.name: zoe_end
inputs.description: Sets the endpoint for depth application, allowing users to specify where the depth effect concludes within the image.

outputs.name: zoedepth_settings
outputs.description: Outputs the configured settings for ZoeDepth as a tuple, ready for use in subsequent processing stages.

Disable Enable Switch (JPS).description: This node toggles between disabling and enabling a feature based on the comparison of two integer values and a match condition.

inputs.name: select
inputs.description: Specifies the first integer value to be compared, influencing the switch's outcome.

inputs.name: compare
inputs.description: Specifies the second integer value to be compared against the first, affecting the switch's result.

inputs.name: match
inputs.description: Determines the condition ('Set to Disable' or 'Set to Enable') that controls the switch's behavior.

outputs.name: disable_enable
outputs.description: Outputs either 'disable' or 'enable' based on the comparison of input values and the match condition.

Enable Disable Switch (JPS).description: This node is designed to toggle between enabling and disabling states based on specific conditions. It evaluates the equality of two integer inputs against a predefined match condition to determine the output state, facilitating dynamic control flows within a system.

inputs.name: select
inputs.description: An integer input that is compared against another input to determine the switch state. Its value influences the node's decision to enable or disable.

inputs.name: compare
inputs.description: An integer input that is compared with the 'select' input to determine the switch state. This comparison is crucial for the node's functionality.

inputs.name: match
inputs.description: A predefined condition that dictates whether the switch should be set to enable or disable based on the comparison of 'select' and 'compare' inputs.

outputs.name: enable_disable
outputs.description: The output state of the switch, which can be either 'enable' or 'disable', determined by the input conditions.

Generation TXT IMG Settings (JPS).description: This node is designed to configure and determine the generation mode and image strength based on the selected mode and image percentage. It supports switching between text-to-image and image-to-image modes, adjusting the output based on the mode's specific requirements.

inputs.name: mode
inputs.description: Specifies the generation mode, either 'Txt2Img' or 'Img2Img', influencing the generation process and output characteristics.

inputs.name: img_percentage
inputs.description: Determines the strength or intensity of the image processing, affecting the final image output in 'Img2Img' mode.

outputs.name: gen_mode
outputs.description: Indicates the generation mode as an integer value, distinguishing between text-to-image and image-to-image modes.

outputs.name: img_strength
outputs.description: Represents the calculated strength or intensity of the image processing, based on the provided image percentage.

Get Date Time String (JPS).description: This node generates a string representing the current date and time, formatted according to a specified style from a predefined list of formats. It's designed to provide a flexible way to capture the exact moment in a format that suits various application needs, such as logging, file naming, or timestamping data.

inputs.name: style
inputs.description: Specifies the format for the date and time string. The choice of format affects how the current timestamp is represented, catering to different formatting needs.

outputs.name: time_format
outputs.description: The formatted date and time string as per the specified style.

Get Image Size (JPS).description: This node is designed to determine the dimensions of an image, specifically its width and height. It abstracts the process of analyzing an image's size, providing a straightforward way to obtain these fundamental attributes.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The image for which the size needs to be determined. This input is crucial as it directly influences the output by providing the necessary data to calculate the image's dimensions.

outputs.name: width

outputs.name: height
outputs.description: The height of the input image, measured in pixels.

This includes setting parameters for resizing, cropping, padding, interpolation, and sharpening to prepare images for optimal processing in subsequent stages.

outputs.name: crop_bottom

outputs.name: padding_left

outputs.name: padding_right

outputs.name: padding_bottom

outputs.name: interpolation

outputs.name: sharpening

Image Switch (JPS).description: The Image Switch node is designed to select and output one of several input images based on a given selection index. It facilitates dynamic image routing within a pipeline, allowing for conditional image processing paths.

inputs.name: select
inputs.description: The 'select' parameter determines which of the input images to output, based on its numerical index. It is essential for controlling the flow of images through the node.

inputs.name: img_i
inputs.description: Represents a series of optional input images (img_1 to img_5) that can be selected for output. The specific image selected is determined by the 'select' parameter.

outputs.name: img_out
outputs.description: The output image selected based on the 'select' parameter. It enables conditional image processing by dynamically routing one of the input images.

Images Masks MultiPipe (JPS).description: The Images Masks MultiPipe node is designed to facilitate the processing and manipulation of images and masks within a pipeline, enabling operations such as generation, revision, and inpainting with the support of a model. It serves as a versatile component in workflows that require the handling of visual data and its associated masks, streamlining tasks that involve image generation, modification, and enhancement.

inputs.name: generation_img
inputs.description: Specifies the initial image for generation processes, setting the stage for subsequent image manipulations or enhancements.

inputs.name: generation_mask
inputs.description: Defines the mask associated with the generation image, used for guiding or restricting certain operations within the image processing pipeline.

inputs.name: ipa1_img
inputs.description: Represents the first image processed through an intermediate pipeline action, contributing to the multi-step image manipulation workflow.

inputs.name: ipa2_img
inputs.description: Denotes the second image resulting from an intermediate pipeline action, furthering the progression of image processing tasks.

inputs.name: ipa1_mask
inputs.description: Serves as the mask for the first intermediate pipeline action image, aiding in targeted image modifications or enhancements.

inputs.name: ipa2_mask
inputs.description: Acts as the mask for the second intermediate pipeline action image, facilitating precise control over image alterations.

inputs.name: revision1_img
inputs.description: Indicates the first revised image, showcasing the application of modifications or improvements post initial generation or processing.

inputs.name: revision2_img
inputs.description: Signifies the second revised image, illustrating further adjustments or refinements made after the initial set of revisions.

inputs.name: inpaint_model
inputs.description: Incorporates a model to support inpainting tasks, enabling the restoration or completion of images based on the provided masks.

outputs.name: generation_img
outputs.description: Outputs the generated image after processing through the pipeline.

outputs.name: generation_mask
outputs.description: Outputs the mask associated with the generated image, reflecting any modifications or enhancements made.

outputs.name: ipa1_img

outputs.name: ipa2_img

outputs.name: ipa1_mask

outputs.name: ipa2_mask

outputs.description: Outputs the first revised image, after applying modifications or enhancements.

outputs.name: revision2_img
outputs.description: Outputs the second revised image, reflecting additional adjustments or refinements.

outputs.name: inpaint_model
outputs.description: Provides the model used for inpainting tasks, facilitating the restoration or completion of images.

ImageToImage Pipe (JPS).description: The ImageToImage Pipe node is designed to process image-to-image settings, extracting and returning various parameters related to image transformation processes. It abstracts the complexity of configuring settings for image-to-image operations, providing a streamlined interface for specifying and retrieving transformation parameters.

inputs.description: Specifies the settings for image-to-image transformation, including strengths and configurations for inpainting, unsampling, and other related processes. It is crucial for defining how the image will be processed and transformed.

outputs.name: img2img_strength
outputs.description: The strength of the image-to-image transformation.

outputs.name: inpaint_strength
outputs.description: The strength of the inpainting process in the transformation.

outputs.name: inpaint_grow_mask
outputs.description: Specifies how much the inpaint mask should grow.

outputs.name: unsampler_strength
outputs.description: The strength of the unsampling process.

outputs.name: unsampler_cfg
outputs.description: Configuration for the unsampler process.

outputs.name: unsampler_sampler

ImageToImage Settings (JPS).description: The ImageToImage Settings node is designed to configure and apply specific settings for image-to-image transformation tasks within the JPS Nodes framework. It focuses on adjusting parameters that influence how an input image is processed and transformed into an output image, catering to various customization needs for image manipulation.

inputs.description: Specifies the strength of the image-to-image transformation, affecting the intensity of the applied changes.

inputs.name: inpaint_strength
inputs.description: Determines the strength of the inpainting effect, influencing how missing or unwanted parts of the image are filled in.

inputs.name: inpaint_grow_mask
inputs.description: Sets the amount by which the inpainting mask is expanded, affecting the area of the image that is subject to inpainting.

inputs.name: unsampler_strength
inputs.description: Defines the strength of the unsampling process, affecting the level of detail enhancement in the output image.

inputs.name: unsampler_cfg
inputs.description: Specifies the configuration for the unsampler, influencing the algorithm's behavior and output quality.

inputs.name: unsampler_sampler
inputs.description: Selects the sampling method used by the unsampler, affecting the texture and quality of the output image.

inputs.name: unsampler_scheduler

InstantID Pipe (JPS).description: The InstantID Pipe node is designed to process settings for instant identification features, encapsulating the logic to handle various parameters such as weight, strength, noise, and range, and returning these processed settings for further use in identification tasks.

inputs.description: Adjusts the horizontal offset for the image processing, shifting the image generation focus horizontally.

inputs.name: offset_h
inputs.description: Adjusts the vertical offset for the image processing, shifting the image generation focus vertically.

inputs.name: prepare_type
inputs.description: Defines the preparation type for the image processing, setting the approach for how images are prepared before processing.

inputs.name: prepare_intpol
inputs.description: Specifies the interpolation method used in the image processing, affecting the smoothness and quality of the generated image.

inputs.name: prepare_sharpening
inputs.description: Sets the level of sharpening applied during the image processing, enhancing the clarity and detail of the generated image.

outputs.name: ip_adapter_tiled_settings
outputs.description: Returns a comprehensive set of settings tailored for tiled image processing, encapsulating model details, weight adjustments, noise levels, and more, to optimize the image generation pipeline.

IP Adapter Tiled Settings Pipe (JPS).description: The IP Adapter Tiled Settings Pipe node is designed to configure and apply image processing adapter settings for tiled images. It allows for the customization of various image processing parameters to enhance or modify the tiled images according to the specified settings.

inputs.name: ip_adapter_settings
inputs.description: Defines the comprehensive configuration for image processing adapter settings tailored for tiled images, impacting the processing and enhancement outcomes by adjusting parameters such as model, weight types, noise levels, and more.

outputs.name: ipa_model
outputs.description: The model used for image processing.

outputs.name: ipa_wtype
outputs.description: The weight type applied during image processing.

outputs.name: ipa_weight
outputs.description: The weight applied to the image processing.

outputs.name: ipa_noise
outputs.description: The noise level applied to the image.

outputs.name: ipa_start
outputs.description: The start point for image processing.

outputs.name: ipa_end
outputs.description: The end point for image processing.

outputs.name: tile_short
outputs.description: The short side length of the tile.

outputs.name: tile_weight
outputs.description: The weight applied to the tile.

outputs.name: zoom
outputs.description: The zoom level applied to the image.

outputs.name: offset_w
outputs.description: The width offset applied to the image.

outputs.name: offset_h
outputs.description: The height offset applied to the image.

outputs.name: prepare_type
outputs.description: The preparation type used for the image.

outputs.name: prepare_intpol
outputs.description: The interpolation method used for image preparation.

outputs.name: prepare_sharpening
outputs.description: The sharpening level applied to the image.

IPA Switch (JPS).description: The IPA Switch node is designed to select and output one of several IP Adapter configurations based on a given selection input. It facilitates dynamic switching between different IP Adapter settings, allowing for flexible adaptation to various processing needs within a pipeline.

inputs.name: select
inputs.description: Determines which IP Adapter configuration to output, based on the numerical selection.

inputs.name: ipa_i
inputs.description: Represents a series of optional IP Adapter configurations (ipa_1 to ipa_5) that can be selected for output. 'i' ranges from 1 to 5, where ipa_1 is mandatory and the rest are optional, allowing for dynamic selection based on 'select'.

outputs.name: IPA_out
outputs.description: The selected IP Adapter configuration.

Largest Int (JPS).description: The node determines the largest and smallest integers between two given values, and also indicates if the first integer is larger than the second. It abstracts the comparison logic into a simple interface for users.

inputs.name: int_a
inputs.description: Represents the first integer to be compared. Its value influences the determination of the larger and smaller integers, as well as the flag indicating if it is larger than the second integer.

inputs.name: int_b
inputs.description: Represents the second integer to be compared. It is used alongside the first integer to determine the larger and smaller values, and to set the flag indicating if the first integer is larger.

outputs.name: larger_int
outputs.description: The larger integer between the two inputs.

outputs.name: smaller_int
outputs.description: The smaller integer between the two inputs.

outputs.name: is_a_larger
outputs.description: A flag indicating if the first input integer is larger than the second.

Latent Switch (JPS).description: The Latent Switch node is designed to select and output one of several provided latent representations based on a given selection index. It facilitates dynamic switching between different latent inputs, enabling flexible manipulation of latent spaces in generative models.

inputs.name: select
inputs.description: Determines which latent representation to output, based on its numerical index. This selection drives the node's core functionality by choosing among the available latent inputs.

inputs.name: latent_i
inputs.description: One of the latent representation options that can be selected for output. The specific latent input to be used is determined by the 'select' parameter.

outputs.name: latent_out
outputs.description: The selected latent representation based on the input selection index.

Lora Loader (JPS).description: The Lora Loader (JPS) node is designed to dynamically load and apply LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation) adjustments to models and/or CLIP components based on specified parameters. It facilitates the customization of model behavior and performance without altering the original model architecture, enabling fine-tuned control over model outputs.

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: The model parameter represents the base model to which the LoRA adjustments will be applied. It is crucial for defining the starting point of the adaptation process.

inputs.name: clip
inputs.description: The clip parameter signifies the CLIP model component that may also undergo LoRA adjustments, allowing for enhanced or modified functionality in tasks involving text and image processing.

inputs.name: switch
inputs.description: This parameter controls whether LoRA adjustments are applied or not, offering a straightforward mechanism to enable or disable the adaptation process.

inputs.name: lora_name
inputs.description: Specifies the name of the LoRA file to be loaded and applied, serving as a key identifier for retrieving the appropriate adaptation parameters.

inputs.name: strength_model
inputs.description: Determines the intensity of the LoRA adjustments applied to the model, enabling precise control over the adaptation's impact.

inputs.name: strength_clip
inputs.description: Sets the intensity of the LoRA adjustments for the CLIP component, allowing for tailored modifications to its behavior.

outputs.name: model
outputs.description: The modified model with LoRA adjustments applied, reflecting changes in behavior or performance as specified by the input parameters.

outputs.name: clip
outputs.description: The CLIP component with LoRA adjustments applied, if applicable, showcasing the adaptability of the node to various model components.

Mask Switch (JPS).description: The Mask Switch node is designed to select and output one of several input masks based on a given selection index. It facilitates dynamic mask switching within a pipeline, allowing for flexible mask manipulation and application.

inputs.name: select
inputs.description: Specifies the index of the mask to be selected and outputted. This selection determines which mask input (among potentially multiple provided) is passed through as the output.

inputs.name: mask_i
inputs.description: Represents any of the optional mask inputs (mask_1 to mask_5) that can be selected for output. The specific mask chosen is determined by the 'select' index.

outputs.name: mask_out
outputs.description: The selected mask output based on the input selection index.

Model Switch (JPS).description: The Model Switch node is designed to dynamically select between multiple model inputs based on a specified selection criterion. It facilitates the flexible integration and switching of different models within a workflow, allowing for varied model outputs to be generated based on the selection.

inputs.name: select
inputs.description: Determines which model to select for output. The selection is based on an integer value, directing the switch to output the corresponding model.

inputs.name: model_i
inputs.description: Represents a generic model input option. Depending on the 'select' parameter's value, one of the available model inputs (model_1 to model_5) is selected for output. This abstraction simplifies the input specification by treating all model inputs uniformly.

outputs.name: model_out
outputs.description: The selected model output based on the 'select' parameter. This output facilitates the dynamic integration of different models within a workflow.

Multiply Float Float (JPS).description: Performs multiplication of two floating-point numbers, returning both integer and floating-point representations of the result. This node is designed to facilitate mathematical operations within a broader computational workflow, emphasizing flexibility in handling numerical data.

inputs.name: float_a
inputs.description: Represents the first floating-point number to be multiplied. Its value influences the multiplication operation and the resulting output.

inputs.name: float_b
inputs.description: Represents the second floating-point number to be multiplied. Together with float_a, it determines the outcome of the multiplication process.

outputs.name: int_multiply
outputs.description: The result of the multiplication operation cast to an integer, providing a whole number representation of the product.

outputs.name: float_multiply
outputs.description: The result of the multiplication operation as a floating-point number, offering a precise representation of the product.

Multiply Int Float (JPS).description: The `Math_Multiply_INT_FLOAT` node is designed to perform multiplication between an integer and a floating-point number, producing both integer and floating-point results. This node facilitates mathematical operations within a flow, allowing for the combination of different numerical types to achieve precise calculations.

inputs.name: int_a
inputs.description: Represents the integer value to be multiplied. Its role is crucial as it determines the scale of the multiplication operation.

inputs.name: float_b
inputs.description: Represents the floating-point number to be multiplied with the integer. It allows for fractional scaling in the multiplication process.

outputs.name: int_multiply
outputs.description: The integer result of multiplying the input integer and floating-point number.

outputs.name: float_multiply
outputs.description: The floating-point result of the multiplication, providing a precise outcome.

Multiply Int Int (JPS).description: Performs multiplication of two integer inputs and provides the result in both integer and floating-point formats.

inputs.name: int_a
inputs.description: Represents the first integer input for multiplication. Its value influences the multiplication result directly.

inputs.name: int_b
inputs.description: Represents the second integer input for multiplication. Its value influences the multiplication result directly.

outputs.name: int_multiply
outputs.description: The result of multiplying the two integer inputs, returned as an integer.

outputs.name: float_multiply
outputs.description: The result of multiplying the two integer inputs, returned as a floating-point number.

Prepare Image (JPS).description: The Prepare Image node is designed to process and adjust images according to specified parameters such as resizing, cropping, padding, and applying various transformations like interpolation and sharpening. This node aims to prepare images for further processing or analysis, ensuring they meet the required dimensions and quality standards.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The input image to be processed. This parameter is crucial as it serves as the base for all subsequent adjustments and transformations.

inputs.name: target_w
inputs.description: The target width for the image after processing. It determines the final width that the image will be resized or adjusted to.

inputs.name: target_h
inputs.description: The target height for the image after processing. It determines the final height that the image will be resized or adjusted to.

inputs.name: crop_w_percent
inputs.description: The percentage of the image's width to be retained after cropping. This parameter allows for precise control over the width of the cropped area.

inputs.name: crop_h_percent
inputs.description: The percentage of the image's height to be retained after cropping. This parameter allows for precise control over the height of the cropped area.

inputs.name: offset_w
inputs.description: The horizontal offset applied to the image. This parameter can be used to shift the image horizontally before other transformations are applied.

inputs.name: offset_h
inputs.description: The vertical offset applied to the image. This parameter can be used to shift the image vertically before other transformations are applied.

inputs.name: interpolation
inputs.description: The interpolation method to be used during image resizing. This parameter affects the quality of the resized image.

inputs.name: sharpening
inputs.description: The level of sharpening to apply to the image. This parameter enhances the image's details and clarity.

outputs.name: IMAGE
outputs.description: The processed image after applying the specified adjustments and transformations.

Prepare Image Plus (JPS).description: The Prepare Image Plus node is designed to configure and apply a set of image preparation settings, including resizing, cropping, padding, interpolation, sharpening, and flipping. It allows for detailed customization of how an image is processed before being used in further operations, ensuring that images are optimally prepared for tasks such as machine learning model input or visual presentation.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The primary image input for processing. This parameter is essential as it specifies the image to which all preparation settings will be applied.

inputs.name: target_w
inputs.description: Specifies the target width for the image after resizing, affecting the final dimensions of the processed image.

inputs.name: target_h
inputs.description: Specifies the target height for the image after resizing, impacting the final dimensions of the processed image.

inputs.name: offset_w
inputs.description: Determines the horizontal offset applied to the image, which can adjust the image's position or alignment.

inputs.name: offset_h
inputs.description: Determines the vertical offset applied to the image, impacting the image's position or alignment vertically.

inputs.name: crop_left
inputs.description: Specifies the amount of cropping from the left side of the image, useful for removing unwanted edges or framing the subject.

inputs.name: crop_right
inputs.description: Specifies the amount of cropping from the right side of the image, aiding in framing the subject or removing extraneous parts.

inputs.name: crop_top
inputs.description: Determines the amount of cropping from the top of the image, which can help in adjusting the framing or focusing on specific parts of the image.

inputs.name: crop_bottom
inputs.description: Determines the amount of cropping from the bottom of the image, useful for framing or removing unnecessary parts.

inputs.name: padding_left
inputs.description: Specifies the amount of padding added to the left side of the image, which can be used for alignment or aesthetic purposes.

inputs.name: padding_right
inputs.description: Specifies the amount of padding added to the right side of the image, aiding in alignment or visual design.

inputs.name: padding_top
inputs.description: Determines the amount of padding added to the top of the image, which can be used for alignment or to achieve a specific visual effect.

inputs.name: padding_bottom
inputs.description: Determines the amount of padding added to the bottom of the image, useful for alignment or achieving a desired visual layout.

inputs.name: interpolation
inputs.description: Defines the method used for resizing the image, impacting the quality and appearance of the resized image.

inputs.name: sharpening
inputs.description: Specifies the level of sharpening applied to the image, enhancing edge definition and detail.

inputs.name: resize_type
inputs.description: Determines the method of resizing applied to the image, such as stretching or cropping to fit the specified dimensions.

inputs.name: flip
inputs.description: Indicates whether the image should be flipped horizontally, vertically, or not at all, affecting the image's orientation.

outputs.name: IMAGE
outputs.description: The output is the image after applying the specified preparation settings, including resizing, cropping, padding, interpolation, sharpening, and flipping.

Prepare Image Tiled IPA (JPS).description: The Prepare Image Tiled IPA node is designed to configure and apply image preparation settings for tiled image processing. It adjusts parameters such as model type, weight type, noise level, and image tiling options based on the input specifications, facilitating the tailored preprocessing of images for enhanced image synthesis or manipulation tasks.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: Specifies the image to be processed, serving as the base for all subsequent image preparation operations.

inputs.name: target_w
inputs.description: Sets the target width for the image processing, influencing the dimensions of the output image.

inputs.name: target_h
inputs.description: Defines the target height for the image processing, influencing the dimensions of the output image.

inputs.name: zoom
inputs.description: Determines the zoom level applied to the image, affecting the scale of the image details.

inputs.name: offset_w
inputs.description: Specifies the horizontal offset for the image, adjusting its position along the width.

inputs.name: offset_h
inputs.description: Specifies the vertical offset for the image, adjusting its position along the height.

inputs.name: interpolation
inputs.description: Chooses the interpolation method for image resizing, affecting the smoothness and quality of the resized image.

inputs.name: sharpening
inputs.description: Sets the level of sharpening to be applied to the image, enhancing edge definition and detail.

inputs.name: tile_short
inputs.description: Defines the base length of the shortest side of the tile, influencing the tiling pattern and size.

inputs.name: prepare_type
inputs.description: Selects the preparation type for the image, determining the specific processing approach to be applied.

outputs.name: IMAGE
outputs.description: Returns the processed image with applied tiling, interpolation, and sharpening settings, ready for further use or analysis.

Resolution Multiply (JPS).description: The Resolution Multiply node is designed to scale the dimensions of an image by a specified factor, effectively multiplying the width and height of the image by this factor to produce new dimensions. This node is useful in scenarios where image resolution adjustments are required, such as preparing images for processing or display at different sizes.

inputs.name: width
inputs.description: Specifies the original width of the image. The width is scaled by the factor to calculate the new width.

inputs.name: height
inputs.description: Specifies the original height of the image. The height is scaled by the factor to calculate the new height.

inputs.name: factor
inputs.description: The multiplier used to scale the width and height of the image. A factor greater than 1 increases the image size, while a factor less than 1 would decrease it (though the node's constraints do not allow for reduction).

outputs.name: width_resized
outputs.description: The new width of the image after scaling by the specified factor.

outputs.name: height_resized
outputs.description: The new height of the image after scaling by the specified factor.

Revision Settings (JPS).description: The Revision Settings (JPS) node is designed to configure and apply various revision settings for image processing tasks. It allows for the adjustment of parameters such as strength and noise augmentation for revisions, as well as crop and offset settings, providing a flexible tool for fine-tuning image revisions.

inputs.name: rev1_strength
inputs.description: Defines the strength of the first revision. It influences the intensity of the applied adjustments, affecting the overall impact on the image.

inputs.name: rev2_strength
inputs.description: Specifies the strength of the second revision. This parameter controls the intensity of adjustments for the second revision, impacting the final image outcome.

inputs.name: rev1_noiseaug
inputs.description: Determines the level of noise augmentation for the first revision. It adds noise to the image, simulating various effects or enhancing realism.

inputs.name: rev2_noiseaug
inputs.description: Sets the noise augmentation level for the second revision, adding noise to simulate effects or enhance the image's realism.

inputs.name: rev1_crop
inputs.description: Specifies the cropping area for the first revision. It defines how the image is cropped, affecting the composition and focus area.

inputs.name: rev1_offset
inputs.description: Defines the offset for the first revision's crop. It adjusts the crop's position, allowing for precise control over the image's framing.

inputs.name: rev2_crop
inputs.description: Indicates the cropping area for the second revision. This parameter determines the cropping strategy, influencing the image's composition and focus.

inputs.name: rev2_offset
inputs.description: Sets the offset for the second revision's crop, adjusting its position for targeted framing and composition adjustments.

inputs.name: crop_intpol
inputs.description: Specifies the interpolation method for cropping. It affects the quality and appearance of the cropped area, offering various options for different effects.

inputs.name: crop_res
inputs.description: Defines the resolution for cropping. It determines the size of the cropped area, impacting the detail and scale of the final image.

outputs.name: revision_settings
outputs.description: Outputs the configured revision settings as a tuple, ready for application in image processing tasks.

Revision Settings Pipe (JPS).description: The Revision Settings Pipe node is designed to process and adjust image revision settings, facilitating the customization of image processing parameters such as cropping, interpolation, and noise augmentation. It serves as a configurable pipeline component within image processing workflows, enabling precise control over the revision effects applied to images.

inputs.name: revision_settings
inputs.description: Specifies the settings for image revision, including resolution, interpolation method, cropping preferences, offsets, strengths, and noise augmentation levels. This input is crucial for determining how the image will be modified during the revision process.

outputs.name: crop_res
outputs.description: The resolution to which the image will be cropped.

outputs.name: crop_intpol
outputs.description: The interpolation method used for cropping the image.

outputs.name: rev1_crop
outputs.description: Specifies the first revision cropping preference.

outputs.name: rev1_offset
outputs.description: The offset applied during the first revision.

outputs.name: rev2_crop
outputs.description: Specifies the second revision cropping preference.

outputs.name: rev2_offset
outputs.description: The offset applied during the second revision.

outputs.name: rev1_strength
outputs.description: The strength of the first revision effect.

outputs.name: rev2_strength
outputs.description: The strength of the second revision effect.

outputs.name: rev1_noiseaug
outputs.description: The level of noise augmentation applied during the first revision.

outputs.name: rev2_noiseaug
outputs.description: The level of noise augmentation applied during the second revision.

Sampler Scheduler Settings (JPS).description: This node is designed to facilitate the selection and configuration of samplers and schedulers within a generative pipeline, allowing users to specify and retrieve the settings for various sampling strategies and their corresponding scheduling algorithms.

inputs.name: sampler_name
inputs.description: Specifies the name of the sampler to be used, playing a crucial role in determining the sampling strategy for the generative process.

inputs.name: scheduler
inputs.description: Determines the scheduling algorithm to be applied, directly affecting the execution and efficiency of the sampling process.

outputs.name: sampler_name
outputs.description: Returns the name of the selected sampler.

outputs.name: scheduler
outputs.description: Returns the selected scheduling algorithm.

Save Images Plus (JPS).description: This node specializes in efficiently storing images on disk, offering capabilities for metadata customization and compression preferences. It facilitates organized file management and supports dynamic adaptation to image attributes, enhancing the storage process with optional metadata embedding for enriched file context.

inputs.name: images
inputs.description: A batch of images to be saved. This parameter is crucial for determining the output file names and paths, as well as for the actual image saving process.

inputs.name: filename_prefix
inputs.description: An optional prefix for the output filenames, allowing for organized storage and easy identification of saved images.

outputs.name: dummy_out
outputs.description: unknown

SDXL Basic Settings (JPS).description: This node is designed to configure the basic settings for SDXL image generation, including resolution, sampler, scheduler, and various parameters related to image refinement and generation steps. It abstracts the complexity of setting up these parameters, providing a streamlined interface for users to easily adjust the core settings that influence the quality and characteristics of the generated images.

inputs.name: resolution
inputs.description: Specifies the desired resolution for the image generation, chosen from a predefined list of resolutions. This setting directly impacts the dimensions of the output image.

inputs.name: sampler_name
inputs.description: Determines the sampler to be used for image generation, affecting the sampling process and the quality of the generated image.

inputs.name: scheduler
inputs.description: Specifies the scheduler for managing the sampling process, influencing how the generation steps are executed.

inputs.name: steps_total
inputs.description: The total number of steps to be used in the image generation process, impacting the detail and quality of the output.

inputs.name: base_percentage
inputs.description: Defines the base percentage of the image to be generated in the initial steps, influencing the progression of image detail.

inputs.name: cfg
inputs.description: Configuration parameter for controlling the generation process, affecting the coherence and quality of the generated image.

inputs.name: cfg_rescale
inputs.description: Parameter for rescaling the configuration value, allowing for fine-tuning of the generation process.

inputs.name: cfg_refiner
inputs.description: Adjusts the configuration for refining the generation process, enhancing the quality of the final image.

inputs.name: ascore_refiner
inputs.description: Refines the ascore to adjust the quality of the generated image, impacting the final image aesthetics.

inputs.name: res_factor
inputs.description: Factor for adjusting the resolution of the generated image, influencing the overall image quality.

inputs.name: clip_skip
inputs.description: Determines the number of clipping steps to skip in the generation process, affecting the final image output.

inputs.name: filename
inputs.description: The filename for the generated image, used for saving and identifying the output file.

outputs.name: sdxl_basic_settings
outputs.description: Encapsulates the configured basic settings for SDXL image generation, including resolution, sampler, scheduler, and various parameters for image refinement and generation steps.

SDXL Basic Settings Pipe (JPS).description: This node processes basic settings for SDXL, translating a structured input of settings into specific output values that are essential for image generation processes. It encapsulates the functionality to parse and convert settings related to resolution, sampling, and image refinement parameters into a format that can be utilized by downstream processes or components.

inputs.name: sdxl_basic_settings
inputs.description: Represents the basic settings for SDXL, including resolution, sampling, and image refinement parameters. It is crucial for determining the output values that configure the image generation process.

outputs.name: image_res
outputs.description: The resolution of the generated image.

outputs.name: width
outputs.description: The width of the generated image in pixels.

outputs.name: height
outputs.description: The height of the generated image in pixels.

outputs.name: sampler_name
outputs.description: The name of the sampler used for image generation.

outputs.name: scheduler
outputs.description: The scheduler used alongside the sampler for image generation.

outputs.name: steps_total
outputs.description: The total number of steps for the image generation process.

outputs.name: step_split
outputs.description: The step split value used in the image generation process.

outputs.name: cfg
outputs.description: The CFG scale used in the image generation process.

outputs.name: cfg_rescale
outputs.description: The CFG rescale value, adjusting the influence of CFG on the process.

outputs.name: cfg_refiner
outputs.description: The CFG refiner scale, refining the CFG's effect.

outputs.name: ascore_refiner
outputs.description: The ascore refiner value, refining the ascore's effect.

outputs.name: res_factor
outputs.description: The resolution factor, influencing the overall image resolution.

outputs.name: clip_skip
outputs.description: The number of CLIP model skips during the generation process.

outputs.name: filename
outputs.description: The filename for the generated image.

SDXL Fundamentals MultiPipe (JPS).description: The SDXL Fundamentals MultiPipe node is designed to aggregate and streamline the process of configuring fundamental components for image synthesis, including models, clips, and conditioning settings. It simplifies the setup by allowing optional inputs for various components and returns a comprehensive set of configurations, making it a central node for initializing and refining image generation pipelines.

inputs.name: vae
inputs.description: Optional VAE component for the image synthesis process, affecting the initial stages of image generation.

inputs.name: model_base
inputs.description: Optional base model for the initial image generation process, influencing the core synthesis mechanism.

inputs.name: model_refiner
inputs.description: Optional refiner model to enhance the details of the generated images, improving the final output quality.

inputs.name: clip_base
inputs.description: Optional CLIP model for the base setup, used for guiding the image synthesis towards the desired outcome based on textual descriptions.

inputs.name: clip_refiner
inputs.description: Optional CLIP model for refining the generated images, ensuring closer alignment with the intended visual concepts.

inputs.name: pos_base
inputs.description: Optional base positive conditioning to steer the image generation towards specific attributes or themes.

inputs.name: neg_base
inputs.description: Optional base negative conditioning to avoid certain attributes or themes in the generated images.

inputs.name: pos_refiner
inputs.description: Optional refiner positive conditioning to further refine the generated images towards more specific attributes or themes.

inputs.name: neg_refiner
inputs.description: Optional refiner negative conditioning to further avoid certain attributes or themes in the refined images.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.description: Optional seed for deterministic image generation, ensuring reproducibility of the results.

outputs.name: vae
outputs.description: The VAE component used in the image synthesis process.

outputs.name: model_base
outputs.description: The base model used for the initial image generation.

outputs.name: model_refiner
outputs.description: The refiner model used to enhance the details of the generated images.

outputs.name: clip_base
outputs.description: The CLIP model used for guiding the image synthesis in the base setup.

outputs.name: clip_refiner
outputs.description: The CLIP model used for refining the generated images.

outputs.name: pos_base
outputs.description: The base positive conditioning applied to steer the image generation.

outputs.name: neg_base
outputs.description: The base negative conditioning applied to avoid certain themes in the generated images.

outputs.name: pos_refiner
outputs.description: The refiner positive conditioning applied to further refine the generated images.

outputs.name: neg_refiner
outputs.description: The refiner negative conditioning applied to further avoid certain themes in the refined images.

outputs.name: seed
outputs.description: The seed used for deterministic image generation.

SDXL Prompt Handling (JPS).description: This node is designed to process and handle text prompts for image generation tasks, optimizing them for use with the SDXL model. It focuses on refining and structuring input prompts to enhance the clarity and effectiveness of the generated images.

inputs.name: handling
inputs.description: Specifies the method for handling the combination or selection of positive prompts, offering various strategies to optimize prompt effectiveness.

inputs.name: pos_g
inputs.description: Represents the global positive prompt, providing a broad thematic or subject matter direction for the image generation.

inputs.name: pos_l
inputs.description: Denotes the local positive prompt, offering more specific details or elements to be included in the generated image.

outputs.name: pos_g
outputs.description: The processed global positive prompt, reflecting the chosen handling strategy and ready for use with the SDXL model.

outputs.name: pos_l
outputs.description: The processed local positive prompt, adjusted according to the handling method and tailored for the image generation task.

SDXL Prompt Handling Plus (JPS).description: This node is designed to enhance the process of handling and refining text prompts for generative models, incorporating advanced techniques to manipulate and optimize prompts for improved clarity, creativity, or specificity in generated outputs.
