outputs.description: The mask corresponding to the cropped area of the image. It indicates the parts of the image that were retained after the cropping process.

LayerUtility_ ImageAutoCrop.description: The ImageAutoCrop node is designed to automatically crop images based on certain criteria, such as the presence of a mask or specific image features. It aims to streamline the process of refining image layers by removing unnecessary or undesired parts, enhancing the focus and composition of the image.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: Represents the input image to be auto-cropped. It is crucial for determining the area of interest and executing the crop operation.

inputs.name: background_color
inputs.description: Specifies the background color to be used in the cropping process, particularly when adjusting the image to a new aspect ratio or filling in areas after cropping.

inputs.name: aspect_ratio
inputs.description: Defines the desired aspect ratio for the cropped image, which can be set to custom values, original, or based on the detection of a mask.

inputs.name: proportional_width
inputs.description: When using a custom aspect ratio, this value specifies the width proportion to calculate the new aspect ratio.

inputs.name: proportional_height
inputs.description: When using a custom aspect ratio, this value specifies the height proportion to calculate the new aspect ratio.

inputs.name: scale_to_longest_side
inputs.description: A boolean indicating whether to scale the image based on the longest side, maintaining the aspect ratio.

inputs.name: longest_side
inputs.description: Specifies the target length of the longest side of the image when scaling is applied.

inputs.name: detect
inputs.description: Determines the method used to detect the cropping area, such as minimum bounding rectangle, maximum inscribed rectangle, or mask area detection.

inputs.name: border_reserve
inputs.description: The amount of border to reserve around the detected cropping area, adding space around the crop.

inputs.name: ultra_detail_range
inputs.description: Specifies the range for enhancing detail around the edges of the mask, used in conjunction with certain matting methods.

inputs.name: matting_method
inputs.description: The method used for generating a mask around the subject of the image, such as 'SegmentAnything' or a simple background removal.

inputs.name: sam_model
inputs.description: Specifies the model used for the 'SegmentAnything' matting method, affecting the quality and accuracy of the generated mask.

inputs.name: grounding_dino_model
inputs.description: Specifies the DINO model used for grounding the segmentation, enhancing the mask's accuracy around the subject.

inputs.name: sam_threshold
inputs.description: The threshold value for the SAM model, determining the sensitivity of the segmentation process.

inputs.name: sam_prompt
inputs.description: The prompt used with the SAM model to guide the segmentation process, influencing the areas of focus.

outputs.name: cropped_image
outputs.description: The result of the auto-cropping process, which is a refined version of the original image with unnecessary parts removed.

outputs.name: box_preview
outputs.description: A visual representation of the cropping box applied to the original image, useful for previewing the crop area before finalization.

outputs.name: cropped_mask
outputs.description: The corresponding mask of the cropped image, adjusted to match the new dimensions and area of the cropped image.

LayerUtility_ ImageBlend V2.description: This node facilitates the blending of two images, offering a range of blending modes and control over the blend's opacity and mask inversion. It's designed to enhance creative workflows in image processing by allowing for complex visual effects through layer blending.

inputs.name: background_image
inputs.description: Serves as the base layer for blending, providing the foundational imagery over which the layer image is blended.

inputs.name: layer_image
inputs.description: Acts as the top layer in the blend, overlaying the background image according to the specified blending mode and opacity.

inputs.name: invert_mask
inputs.description: Determines whether the mask applied to the layer image should be inverted, affecting how the blend is masked out.

inputs.name: blend_mode
inputs.description: Specifies the method of blending the layer image with the background, such as multiply or overlay, influencing the visual outcome.

inputs.name: opacity
inputs.description: Controls the transparency level of the layer image over the background, allowing for fine-tuning of the blend intensity.

inputs.name: layer_mask
inputs.description: Optional mask that can be applied to the layer image, defining areas of transparency for intricate blending effects.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The result of blending the layer image with the background image, reflecting the chosen blend mode, opacity, and mask settings.

LayerUtility_ ImageBlend.description: This node is designed to blend two images together using a variety of blending modes. It leverages predefined functions to apply different mathematical operations for combining the pixel values of the background and layer images, resulting in a composite image that can be used for various visual effects or image processing tasks.

inputs.name: background_image
inputs.description: The background image over which the layer image will be blended. This forms the base of the composite image.

inputs.name: layer_image
inputs.description: The layer image to be blended onto the background image. This image is combined with the background based on the specified blend mode and opacity.

inputs.name: invert_mask
inputs.description: A boolean parameter that determines whether the mask applied to the layer image should be inverted, affecting how the blend is applied.

inputs.name: blend_mode
inputs.description: Specifies the method of blending the layer image with the background. Different modes can produce various visual effects.

inputs.name: opacity
inputs.description: Controls the transparency of the layer image, allowing for finer control over the blend intensity.

inputs.name: layer_mask
inputs.description: An optional mask that can be applied to the layer image, defining which parts of the layer should be visible in the final blend.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The result of blending the layer image with the background image according to the specified parameters.

LayerUtility_ ImageBlendAdvance V2.description: This node specializes in advanced blending techniques for layer-based image editing. It leverages sophisticated algorithms to merge images, allowing for more complex and nuanced image compositions than its predecessor.

inputs.name: background_image
inputs.description: The primary image over which the layer image will be blended, serving as the backdrop for the composition.

inputs.name: layer_image
inputs.description: The secondary image to be blended onto the background image, acting as the overlay in the composition.

inputs.name: invert_mask
inputs.description: A boolean value that determines whether the mask applied to the layer image should be inverted, affecting the blending areas.

inputs.name: blend_mode
inputs.description: Specifies the method of blending used to combine the background and layer images, influencing the visual outcome of the blend.

inputs.name: opacity
inputs.description: An integer defining the opacity level of the layer image, dictating its transparency when blended with the background image.

inputs.name: x_percent
inputs.description: A float value indicating the horizontal positioning of the layer image relative to the background image, as a percentage.

inputs.name: y_percent
inputs.description: A float value indicating the vertical positioning of the layer image relative to the background image, as a percentage.

inputs.name: mirror
inputs.description: Specifies the mirror mode applied to the layer image, such as horizontal or vertical flipping, before blending.

inputs.name: scale
inputs.description: A float value that determines the scaling factor of the layer image, affecting its size relative to the background image.

inputs.name: aspect_ratio
inputs.description: A float value that adjusts the aspect ratio of the layer image, influencing its proportions when scaled.

inputs.name: rotate
inputs.description: A float value specifying the rotation angle of the layer image, in degrees, applied before blending.

inputs.name: transform_method
inputs.description: Defines the interpolation method used for scaling and rotating the layer image, affecting the quality of the transformation.

inputs.name: anti_aliasing
inputs.description: An integer indicating the level of anti-aliasing applied to the layer image, enhancing the smoothness of its edges.

inputs.name: layer_mask
inputs.description: An optional mask that can be applied to the layer image, allowing for more precise control over which parts of the layer are visible or blended.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The resulting image after blending the layer image with the background, incorporating all specified adjustments and effects.

outputs.name: mask
outputs.description: The mask applied to the layer image, determining the areas of the layer that are visible or blended in the final composition.

LayerUtility_ ImageBlendAdvance.description: The ImageBlendAdvance node is designed for advanced blending of images within a layer-based editing context. It leverages sophisticated algorithms to merge images seamlessly, offering users enhanced control over the blending process for creating complex visual compositions.

inputs.name: background_image
inputs.description: The base image over which the layer image will be blended. It serves as the canvas for the blending operation.

inputs.name: layer_image
inputs.description: The image to be blended onto the background image. This layer can be manipulated through various parameters to achieve the desired blending effect.

inputs.name: invert_mask
inputs.description: A boolean flag that, when set, inverts the blending mask, affecting how the layer image merges with the background.

inputs.name: blend_mode
inputs.description: Defines the algorithm used for blending the layer image with the background, influencing the visual outcome of the blend.

inputs.name: opacity
inputs.description: Determines the transparency level of the layer image, allowing for finer control over its visibility against the background.

inputs.name: x_percent
inputs.description: Specifies the horizontal positioning of the layer image relative to the background, enabling precise alignment.

inputs.name: y_percent
inputs.description: Specifies the vertical positioning of the layer image relative to the background, enabling precise alignment.

inputs.name: mirror
inputs.description: Allows for the mirroring of the layer image either horizontally or vertically, adding to the creative possibilities.

inputs.name: scale
inputs.description: Controls the size of the layer image, enabling scaling up or down as needed for the composition.

inputs.name: aspect_ratio
inputs.description: Adjusts the aspect ratio of the layer image, maintaining its proportions while scaling.

inputs.name: rotate
inputs.description: Rotates the layer image around its center, offering additional compositional flexibility.

inputs.name: transform_method
inputs.description: Specifies the interpolation method used during transformations such as scaling or rotating, affecting image quality.

inputs.name: anti_aliasing
inputs.description: Sets the level of anti-aliasing applied to the layer image, enhancing the visual quality of edges and transitions.

inputs.name: layer_mask
inputs.description: unknown

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The final blended image resulting from the application of the specified parameters and blending operations.

outputs.name: mask
outputs.description: An optional output that provides the mask used in the blending process, useful for further editing or analysis.

LayerUtility_ ImageChannelMerge.description: The ImageChannelMerge node is designed to merge separate image channels into a single image, supporting various color modes. It allows for the flexible combination of up to four image channels, accommodating optional fourth channel input for extended color space manipulation.

inputs.name: channel_i
inputs.description: Represents one of the image channels to be merged. Each channel contributes to the composite image by adding its unique layer of detail, color, or depth. The index 'i' can range from 1 to 4, where channels 1 through 3 are required and channel 4 is optional, allowing for more complex color space manipulations when included.

inputs.name: mode
inputs.description: Specifies the color mode for the merged image, such as RGBA, YCbCr, LAB, or HSV. This determines how the channels are combined and interpreted, affecting the overall appearance of the final composite image.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The resulting image after merging the specified channels. It represents a composite image in the specified color mode.

LayerUtility_ ImageChannelSplit.description: The ImageChannelSplit node is designed to split an input image into its constituent channels based on a specified color mode. It facilitates the manipulation of individual color channels for advanced image processing tasks, enabling users to work with each channel separately for detailed analysis or modification.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The input image to be split into its constituent channels. This parameter is crucial for the operation as it determines the source image for channel separation.

inputs.name: mode
inputs.description: Specifies the color mode for channel splitting. This parameter affects how the input image is processed and determines the output channel format.

outputs.name: channel_1
outputs.description: The first channel of the split image, which varies depending on the specified mode.

outputs.name: channel_2
outputs.description: The second channel of the split image, which varies depending on the specified mode.

outputs.name: channel_3
outputs.description: The third channel of the split image, which varies depending on the specified mode.

outputs.name: channel_4
outputs.description: The fourth channel of the split image, applicable in modes that support four channels.

LayerUtility_ ImageCombineAlpha.description: The ImageCombineAlpha node is designed to combine RGB images with masks to produce images with an alpha channel, effectively integrating transparency information from the mask into the RGB image. This process allows for the creation of RGBA images where the transparency level is controlled by the mask, enabling more complex image compositing tasks.

inputs.name: RGB_image
inputs.description: The RGB_image parameter represents the input RGB images that are to be combined with masks to generate RGBA images. This parameter is crucial for defining the visual content of the output images.

inputs.name: mask
inputs.description: The mask parameter represents the input masks that define the transparency levels for the corresponding RGB images. These masks are essential for integrating transparency into the RGB images to create RGBA outputs.

outputs.name: RGBA_image
outputs.description: The RGBA_image output represents the resulting images with an alpha channel added, combining the input RGB images with the transparency information from the masks.

LayerUtility_ ImageHub.description: The ImageHub node serves as a dynamic selector and router for image and mask inputs, allowing for the selection of specific image-mask pairs based on a specified output channel. It facilitates the flexible manipulation and routing of image data within a node network, enabling the creation of complex image processing pipelines.

inputs.name: output
inputs.description: Specifies the output channel to select the corresponding image and mask inputs. It determines which set of inputs (image and mask) will be used for the output.

inputs.name: random_output
inputs.description: A boolean flag that, if set, could potentially alter the selection logic for choosing the output image and mask, adding an element of randomness to the output selection process.

inputs.name: input1_image
inputs.description: The first image input option for the node, which can be selected as the output based on the 'output' parameter value.

inputs.name: input1_mask
inputs.description: The mask associated with the first image input, providing an option for output selection alongside the corresponding image.

inputs.name: input2_image
inputs.description: The second image input option, selectable based on the output parameter.

inputs.name: input2_mask
inputs.description: The mask associated with the second image input, used in conjunction with the corresponding image for output selection.

inputs.name: input3_image
inputs.description: The third image input option, which can be chosen based on the specified output channel.

inputs.name: input3_mask
inputs.description: The mask for the third image input, available for selection with its corresponding image based on the output parameter.

inputs.name: input4_image
inputs.description: The fourth image input option, selectable for output based on the specified channel.

inputs.name: input4_mask
inputs.description: The mask associated with the fourth image input, selectable alongside the corresponding image.

inputs.name: input5_image
inputs.description: The fifth image input option, which can be selected for output based on the specified channel.

inputs.name: input5_mask
inputs.description: The mask for the fifth image input, available for selection with its corresponding image.

inputs.name: input6_image
inputs.description: The sixth image input option, selectable for output based on the output parameter.

inputs.name: input6_mask
inputs.description: The mask associated with the sixth image input, used in output selection alongside the corresponding image.

inputs.name: input7_image
inputs.description: The seventh image input option, which can be chosen for output based on the specified channel.

inputs.name: input7_mask
inputs.description: The mask for the seventh image input, available for selection with its corresponding image.

inputs.name: input8_image
inputs.description: The eighth image input option, selectable for output based on the output parameter.

inputs.name: input8_mask
inputs.description: The mask associated with the eighth image input, used in output selection alongside the corresponding image.

inputs.name: input9_image
inputs.description: The ninth and final image input option, which can be selected for output based on the specified channel.

inputs.name: input9_mask
inputs.description: The mask for the ninth image input, available for selection with its corresponding image.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The selected image output based on the specified output channel and input parameters.

outputs.name: mask
outputs.description: The selected mask output corresponding to the chosen image, based on the specified output channel and input parameters.

LayerUtility_ ImageMaskScaleAs.description: This node is designed to scale images and masks to match the dimensions of a target image or mask, applying various resizing methods and fitting options to ensure the output aligns with the specified dimensions. It supports different interpolation methods for resizing, offering flexibility in how the scaling is performed to meet the needs of different use cases.

inputs.name: scale_as
inputs.description: Specifies the target tensor to scale the image or mask as, determining the dimensions to which the inputs should be resized.

inputs.name: fit
inputs.description: Defines how the image or mask should be fitted to the target dimensions, affecting the scaling and cropping behavior.

inputs.name: method
inputs.description: Determines the interpolation method used for resizing, such as 'bicubic', 'nearest', etc., influencing the quality and characteristics of the output.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The image tensor to be scaled. It is optional and when provided, it will be resized to match the target dimensions.

inputs.name: mask
inputs.description: The mask tensor to be scaled. It is optional and when provided, it will be resized alongside the image to match the target dimensions.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The scaled image tensor, resized to match the target dimensions specified by 'scale_as'.

outputs.name: mask
outputs.description: The scaled mask tensor, resized alongside the image to match the target dimensions specified by 'scale_as'.

outputs.name: original_size
outputs.description: A list containing the original width and height of the input image or mask before scaling.

outputs.name: widht
outputs.description: unknown

outputs.name: height
outputs.description: The target height to which the image or mask has been scaled.

LayerUtility_ ImageOpacity.description: The ImageOpacity node is designed to adjust the opacity of an image, optionally applying an inversion mask to selectively modify the transparency across the image. It provides a way to dynamically control the visual appearance of images by altering their transparency levels.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The 'image' parameter represents the input image to which the opacity adjustment will be applied. It is essential for defining the base visual content that will undergo transparency modification.

inputs.name: opacity
inputs.description: The 'opacity' parameter specifies the degree of transparency to apply to the image, with a range from 0 (completely transparent) to 100 (fully opaque). It allows for fine-tuning the visibility of the image.

inputs.name: invert_mask
inputs.description: The 'invert_mask' parameter determines whether to invert the mask applied to the image, enabling selective opacity adjustments across different regions of the image.

inputs.name: mask
inputs.description: The 'mask' parameter, when provided, specifies a mask to apply to the image for targeted opacity adjustments. It is optional and used for more complex transparency effects.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The modified image with adjusted opacity.

outputs.name: mask
outputs.description: The mask used for opacity adjustment, if any was applied.

LayerUtility_ ImageRemoveAlpha.description: The ImageRemoveAlpha node is designed to process images by removing the alpha channel. It can either fill the background with a specified color or convert images directly to RGB, depending on whether the background filling option is enabled. This functionality is essential for image processing tasks where transparency needs to be handled or eliminated, such as preparing images for environments that do not support alpha channels.

inputs.name: RGBA_image
inputs.description: The RGBA_image parameter represents the input images with an alpha channel that needs processing. It is crucial for specifying the images on which the alpha removal or background filling operations will be performed.

inputs.name: fill_background
inputs.description: The fill_background parameter determines whether the background of the image should be filled with a specified color when the alpha channel is removed. This affects whether the image will simply have its alpha channel discarded or if it will have a new background color applied.

inputs.name: background_color
inputs.description: The background_color parameter specifies the color to use when filling the background after removing the alpha channel. It is essential for customizing the appearance of the output images when the fill_background option is enabled.

inputs.name: mask
inputs.description: The mask parameter allows for the specification of a custom mask to define how the alpha channel should be removed or how the background should be filled. It provides additional flexibility in processing images with complex transparency or background requirements.

outputs.name: RGB_image
outputs.description: The RGB_image output represents the processed images with the alpha channel removed. These images are either directly converted to RGB or have their backgrounds filled with a specified color, depending on the node's configuration.

LayerUtility_ ImageRewardFilter.description: The ImageRewardFilter node filters and ranks images based on their relevance to a given prompt using a reward model. It selects the top images as per the specified output number, effectively curating a subset of images that best match the prompt criteria.

inputs.name: images
inputs.description: A collection of images to be evaluated and filtered based on their relevance to the prompt. This input is crucial for determining which images are retained and which are discarded, based on their scores from the reward model.

inputs.name: prompt
inputs.description: The text prompt against which the images are evaluated. This prompt guides the reward model in scoring the images, influencing which images are considered most relevant.

inputs.name: output_num
inputs.description: Specifies the number of top-scoring images to retain. This parameter controls the size of the output image set, ensuring only the most relevant images are selected.

outputs.name: images
outputs.description: The subset of input images that were ranked highest by the reward model, deemed most relevant to the prompt.

outputs.name: obsolete_images
outputs.description: Images that were scored lower by the reward model and not included in the top selections based on the output number.

LayerUtility_ ImageScaleByAspectRatio V2.description: This node is designed to adjust the scale of images based on their aspect ratio, offering various scaling options to fit specific dimensions or pixel counts. It provides flexibility in resizing images while maintaining their aspect ratio, catering to different requirements such as scaling to a particular side's length, width, height, or even total pixel count.

inputs.name: aspect_ratio
inputs.description: Defines the aspect ratio for scaling the image. It can be an original, custom, or predefined ratio like '1:1', '3:2', etc., which determines the proportional relationship between the image's width and height.

inputs.name: proportional_width
inputs.description: Specifies the width part of the custom aspect ratio, used in conjunction with proportional_height to define a custom aspect ratio.

inputs.name: proportional_height
inputs.description: Specifies the height part of the custom aspect ratio, used in conjunction with proportional_width to define a custom aspect ratio.

inputs.name: fit
inputs.description: Determines how the image should be fitted into the target dimensions, with options like 'letterbox', 'crop', or 'fill'.

inputs.name: method
inputs.description: Specifies the resizing method to be used, such as 'lanczos', 'bicubic', 'hamming', etc., affecting the quality of the scaled image.

inputs.name: round_to_multiple
inputs.description: Rounds the dimensions of the scaled image to the nearest multiple of a specified number, enhancing compatibility with certain processing or display requirements.

inputs.name: scale_to_side
inputs.description: Specifies the side to which the image should be scaled. It can be the longest or shortest side, width, height, or total pixel count, influencing the final dimensions of the scaled image.

inputs.name: scale_to_length
inputs.description: Determines the target length for the specified side to scale to, directly affecting the image's final dimensions.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The input image to be scaled. This parameter is optional and allows for the scaling of an image based on the specified aspect ratio and other parameters.

inputs.name: mask
inputs.description: An optional mask that can be scaled alongside the image, maintaining the same transformations and aspect ratio adjustments.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The scaled image, adjusted according to the specified aspect ratio and scaling parameters.

outputs.name: mask
outputs.description: The scaled mask, adjusted in accordance with the image's scaling and aspect ratio modifications.

outputs.name: original_size
outputs.description: The original dimensions of the input image before scaling.

outputs.name: width
outputs.description: The width of the scaled image, reflecting the result of the applied scaling parameters.

outputs.name: height
outputs.description: The height of the scaled image, reflecting the result of the applied scaling parameters.

LayerUtility_ ImageScaleByAspectRatio.description: This node is designed to adjust the scale of an image based on its aspect ratio, offering various scaling options to fit, fill, or match specific dimensions while maintaining the original or a custom aspect ratio. It supports different resizing methods to optimize the visual quality of the scaled image.

inputs.name: aspect_ratio
inputs.description: Specifies the aspect ratio to use for scaling the image. It can be set to 'original' to use the image's current aspect ratio, 'custom' to use a specified ratio, or a predefined ratio in the format 'width:height'.

inputs.name: proportional_width
inputs.description: The width part of the custom aspect ratio, used when 'aspect_ratio' is set to 'custom'.

inputs.name: proportional_height
inputs.description: The height part of the custom aspect ratio, used when 'aspect_ratio' is set to 'custom'.

inputs.name: fit
inputs.description: Determines how the image should be fitted to the target dimensions, affecting how the image is scaled and cropped.

inputs.name: method
inputs.description: The method used for resizing the image, such as 'bicubic', 'hamming', 'bilinear', 'box', or 'nearest', each offering different quality and performance characteristics.

inputs.name: round_to_multiple
inputs.description: If specified, rounds the scaled dimensions to the nearest multiple of this value, which can be useful for aligning images to certain size constraints.

inputs.name: scale_to_longest_side
inputs.description: Determines if the image should be scaled based on the longest side, providing a boolean option to enable or disable this feature.

inputs.name: longest_side
inputs.description: Specifies the target length for the longest side of the image when 'scale_to_longest_side' is enabled, determining the final dimensions of the scaled image.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The original image to be scaled. This can be a tensor representation of an image.

inputs.name: mask
inputs.description: An optional mask to be scaled alongside the image, typically used for segmentation tasks.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The scaled image tensor, adjusted according to the specified aspect ratio, dimensions, and scaling method.

outputs.name: mask
outputs.description: The scaled mask tensor, corresponding to the 'mask' input, adjusted to match the dimensions of the scaled image.

outputs.name: original_size
outputs.description: The original dimensions of the image before scaling.

outputs.name: width
outputs.description: The width of the scaled image.

outputs.name: height
outputs.description: The height of the scaled image.

LayerUtility_ ImageScaleRestore V2.description: This node is designed to adjust the scale of images and optionally their masks to a specified size or scale, using various interpolation methods. It can handle multiple images in a batch, ensuring that each image is resized according to the given parameters, including the option to scale by the longest side for uniformity across varying image dimensions. The node emphasizes flexibility in image processing tasks, allowing for detailed control over the resizing process.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The input image or images to be scaled. This parameter is crucial for defining the source images that will undergo resizing operations.

inputs.name: scale
inputs.description: The scale factor to apply to the image dimensions. It determines how much the image size should be increased or decreased.

inputs.name: method
inputs.description: Specifies the interpolation method to use for resizing the images. This affects the quality and characteristics of the output image.

inputs.name: scale_by
inputs.description: Determines the criterion for scaling the image, such as by its longest side, shortest side, width, height, or total pixel count.

inputs.name: scale_by_length
inputs.description: Specifies the target length for the chosen scaling criterion, applicable when scaling by dimensions or total pixel count.

inputs.name: mask
inputs.description: An optional mask or masks associated with the image(s), which will be resized in tandem with the image.

inputs.name: original_size
inputs.description: An optional parameter specifying the target dimensions to resize the image to, overriding the scale factor.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The resized images, adjusted according to the specified scale, dimensions, or method.

outputs.name: mask
outputs.description: The resized masks corresponding to the input images, if masks were provided.

outputs.name: original_size
outputs.description: The original dimensions of the input images before resizing.

outputs.name: width
outputs.description: The target width of the resized images.

outputs.name: height
outputs.description: The target height of the resized images.

LayerUtility_ ImageScaleRestore.description: This node is designed to adjust the scale of images to a specified size or restore them to their original dimensions. It supports various resizing methods and can handle images with or without associated masks, making it versatile for different image processing tasks.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The image to be scaled or restored. It is central to the node's operation as it directly influences the output image's dimensions and quality.

inputs.name: scale
inputs.description: Determines the scaling factor or the target size for the image resizing. It plays a crucial role in defining the new dimensions of the image.

inputs.name: method
inputs.description: Specifies the algorithm used for resizing the image, affecting the quality and characteristics of the output.

inputs.name: scale_by_longest_side
inputs.description: A flag indicating whether to scale the image by its longest side, ensuring aspect ratio preservation.

inputs.name: longest_side
inputs.description: Specifies the target length of the longest side of the image when scaled, relevant only if 'scale_by_longest_side' is True.

inputs.name: mask
inputs.description: An optional mask that will be resized in tandem with the image, useful for maintaining consistency between the image and its mask.

inputs.name: original_size
inputs.description: The original dimensions of the image, used when restoring the image to its initial size or to scale the image to a specific size.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The scaled or restored image, reflecting the specified dimensions and resizing method.

outputs.name: mask
outputs.description: The resized mask corresponding to the output image, if an input mask was provided.

outputs.name: original_size
outputs.description: The original dimensions of the image, useful for reference or further processing.

outputs.name: width
outputs.description: The width of the output image after scaling, providing specific detail on the image's dimensions.

outputs.name: height
outputs.description: The height of the output image after scaling, offering precise information on the image's size.

LayerUtility_ ImageShift.description: The ImageShift node is designed to manipulate images by shifting them horizontally and/or vertically. It supports cyclic shifting, allowing images to wrap around edges, and can apply a border mask to the shifted images for enhanced visual effects. This node is useful for creating dynamic visual transformations and adjusting image compositions.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The primary image to be shifted. This input is essential for determining the base visual content that will undergo the shifting process.

inputs.name: shift_x
inputs.description: Specifies the horizontal shift distance for the image. Positive values shift the image to the right, while negative values shift it to the left.

inputs.name: shift_y
inputs.description: Specifies the vertical shift distance for the image. Positive values shift the image downwards, while negative values shift it upwards.

inputs.name: cyclic
inputs.description: Determines whether the image shift should be cyclic, allowing the shifted parts of the image to wrap around to the opposite edge.

inputs.name: background_color
inputs.description: Defines the background color to use for areas of the image that become unfilled due to the shift.

inputs.name: border_mask_width
inputs.description: Sets the width of the border mask applied to the edges of the shifted image, enhancing visual separation.

inputs.name: border_mask_blur
inputs.description: Determines the blur intensity of the border mask, providing a smoother transition at the image edges.

inputs.name: mask
inputs.description: An optional mask that can be applied to the image, specifying areas to be excluded or differently treated during the shift.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The shifted image, transformed according to the specified parameters.

outputs.name: mask
outputs.description: A mask generated during the shifting process, potentially useful for further image processing steps.

outputs.name: border_mask
outputs.description: A border mask applied to the shifted image, enhancing its visual appearance with a defined edge.

LayerUtility_ Integer.description: The Integer node is designed to process and manipulate integer values. It allows for the conversion of an integer input into both its integer and string representations, facilitating operations that require numerical manipulation or the integration of integer values into text-based formats.

inputs.name: int_value
inputs.description: Specifies the integer value to be processed. This parameter enables the node to perform operations on the provided integer, converting it to both its integer and string representations.

outputs.name: int
outputs.description: The integer representation of the input value.

outputs.name: string
outputs.description: The string representation of the input integer value.

LayerUtility_ LaMa.description: The LaMa node utilizes the LaMa (Large Mask inpainting) model for sophisticated image inpainting tasks. It excels in removing unwanted elements from images or filling in missing areas, offering high-quality restoration and manipulation capabilities.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The input image to be processed for inpainting, serving as the primary subject for object removal or area filling.

inputs.name: mask
inputs.description: A binary mask indicating the areas to inpaint within the image, guiding the model on where to apply its restoration efforts.

inputs.name: lama_model
inputs.description: Specifies the LaMa model to be used for the inpainting task, allowing for customization of the inpainting process.

inputs.name: device
inputs.description: The computing device (CPU/GPU) on which the inpainting operation is performed, affecting performance and efficiency.

inputs.name: invert_mask
inputs.description: A boolean indicating whether to invert the inpainting mask, altering the areas targeted for inpainting.

inputs.name: mask_grow
inputs.description: An integer specifying how much to expand the inpainting mask, enabling broader area coverage.

inputs.name: mask_blur
inputs.description: An integer defining the level of blur applied to the mask edges, smoothing the transition between inpainted and original areas.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The output image after inpainting, showcasing the areas where unwanted elements have been removed or missing parts filled in.

LayerUtility_ LayerImageTransform.description: The LayerImageTransform node is designed to perform various image transformations on a given layer, including scaling, rotating, mirroring, and applying anti-aliasing. It allows for precise adjustments to an image's appearance, enabling the creation of customized visual effects and adjustments.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The input image to be transformed. It serves as the base for all subsequent transformations, including scaling, rotating, and mirroring.

inputs.name: x
inputs.description: The horizontal offset to apply after transformations, allowing for precise positioning of the transformed image.

inputs.name: y
inputs.description: The vertical offset to apply after transformations, enabling precise vertical positioning of the transformed image.

inputs.name: mirror
inputs.description: Specifies the mirroring mode to apply to the image, such as horizontal or vertical flipping, enhancing the image's symmetry or creating reflections.

inputs.name: scale
inputs.description: The scaling factor to apply to the image, adjusting its size while preserving its aspect ratio.

inputs.name: aspect_ratio
inputs.description: The aspect ratio to maintain during scaling, allowing for proportional adjustments to the image's dimensions.

inputs.name: rotate
inputs.description: The rotation angle in degrees to apply to the image, enabling orientation adjustments.

inputs.name: transform_method
inputs.description: The method used for image transformation, such as resizing or rotating, affecting the image's quality and appearance.

inputs.name: anti_aliasing
inputs.description: The level of anti-aliasing to apply, reducing the appearance of jagged edges in the transformed image.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The transformed image after applying scaling, rotating, mirroring, and anti-aliasing effects.

LayerUtility_ LayerMaskTransform.description: The LayerMaskTransform node is designed to apply various transformations to image masks, including scaling, mirroring, rotating, and adjusting aspect ratios. It enables the customization of image masks for further processing or visualization, supporting a range of transformation methods to fit different requirements.

inputs.name: mask
inputs.description: The input mask to be transformed. It serves as the primary subject for all subsequent transformations, determining the base image mask that will undergo scaling, mirroring, rotating, and aspect ratio adjustments.

inputs.name: x
inputs.description: The horizontal offset to apply when positioning the transformed mask onto the original canvas. It affects the final placement of the mask, allowing for precise control over its location.

inputs.name: y
inputs.description: The vertical offset to apply when positioning the transformed mask onto the original canvas. Similar to the 'x' parameter, it enables fine-tuning of the mask's placement on the canvas.

inputs.name: mirror
inputs.description: Specifies the mirroring mode to apply to the mask, which can be horizontal, vertical, or none. This transformation flips the mask along the specified axis, altering its orientation.

inputs.name: scale
inputs.description: The scaling factor to apply to the mask, allowing for size adjustments. This parameter directly influences the overall dimensions of the transformed mask.

inputs.name: aspect_ratio
inputs.description: The aspect ratio to maintain during the scaling process. Adjusting this parameter alters the shape of the mask, enabling custom aspect ratio transformations.

inputs.name: rotate
inputs.description: The degree of rotation to apply to the mask. This parameter controls the angular adjustment of the mask, enabling it to be rotated to a specific orientation.

inputs.name: transform_method
inputs.description: The method used for transforming the mask, including scaling and rotating. It determines the algorithm applied for the transformation, affecting the quality and appearance of the output.

inputs.name: anti_aliasing
inputs.description: The level of anti-aliasing to apply during the transformation process. Higher values result in smoother edges but may increase processing time.

outputs.name: mask
outputs.description: The transformed mask, resulting from the applied transformations such as scaling, mirroring, rotating, and aspect ratio adjustments. It represents the final output of the node, ready for further use or visualization.

LayerUtility_ LoadPSD.description: This node is designed to load and process Photoshop (PSD) files, extracting individual layers, including hidden ones if specified, and converting them into a format suitable for further image processing or analysis. It supports selective layer extraction based on layer visibility, name, or index, and provides functionality to handle cases where the specified layer is not found by either defaulting to the top layer or generating a placeholder image.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: Specifies the PSD file to be loaded. This is the primary input for the node, determining which PSD file's layers are to be processed and extracted.

inputs.name: file_path
inputs.description: The path to the PSD file to be loaded. If provided, this path is used to locate the PSD file; otherwise, a default path is used.

inputs.name: include_hidden_layer
inputs.description: A boolean flag that determines whether hidden layers within the PSD file should be included in the processing and output.

inputs.name: find_layer_by
inputs.description: Determines the method of layer selection, either by the layer's name or its index within the PSD file.

inputs.name: layer_index
inputs.description: An integer specifying the index of the layer to be extracted. Used when 'find_layer_by' is set to 'layer_index'.

inputs.name: layer_name
inputs.description: The name of the layer to be extracted. Used when 'find_layer_by' is set to 'layer_name'.

outputs.name: flat_image
outputs.description: The flattened version of the PSD file, converted to a standard image format.

outputs.name: layer_image
outputs.description: The extracted layer specified by the user, converted into a tensor format suitable for image processing tasks.

outputs.name: all_layers
outputs.description: A collection of all processed layers from the PSD file, each converted into a tensor format.

LayerUtility_ NumberCalculator.description: The NumberCalculator node performs basic arithmetic operations between two input values based on a specified operator. It supports a variety of operations including addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, exponentiation, integer division, and modulo. This node is designed to facilitate mathematical calculations within data processing pipelines, allowing for dynamic computation based on input parameters.

inputs.name: a
inputs.description: The first operand in the arithmetic operation. It plays a crucial role in determining the outcome of the computation.

inputs.name: b
inputs.description: The second operand in the arithmetic operation. It is used in conjunction with the first operand to perform the specified mathematical function.

inputs.name: operator
inputs.description: Specifies the arithmetic operation to be performed on the operands. The operator can be one of the following: '+', '-', '*', '/', '**', '//', '%'. This choice dictates the nature of the calculation.

outputs.name: int
outputs.description: The integer part of the result from the arithmetic operation.

outputs.name: float
outputs.description: The floating-point representation of the result from the arithmetic operation.

LayerUtility_ NumberCalculatorV2.description: The NumberCalculatorV2 node is designed to perform a variety of arithmetic operations between two numbers, including basic arithmetic, exponentiation, and nth root calculations. It extends the functionality of basic arithmetic by allowing inputs as strings and parsing them for numerical values, providing a flexible interface for dynamic calculation scenarios.

inputs.name: a_value
inputs.description: A string representing the first number or a numeric expression. If 'a' is not provided, 'a_value' is parsed to extract the first number for the operation, enhancing flexibility in handling numeric inputs.

inputs.name: b_value
inputs.description: A string representing the second number or a numeric expression. Similar to 'a_value', if 'b' is not provided, 'b_value' is parsed to extract the first number, allowing for dynamic numeric operations based on string inputs.

inputs.name: operator
inputs.description: Specifies the arithmetic operation to perform on the numbers. It supports a range of operators including basic arithmetic and nth root, enabling complex mathematical calculations.

inputs.name: a
inputs.description: An optional numeric input that directly specifies the first operand. If provided, it overrides the number extracted from 'a_value', offering direct control over the calculation.

inputs.name: b
inputs.description: An optional numeric input that directly specifies the second operand. If provided, it overrides the number extracted from 'b_value', giving direct input capability for the operation.

outputs.name: int
outputs.description: The integer part of the calculation result, providing a discrete numerical outcome.

outputs.name: float
outputs.description: The floating-point part of the calculation result, offering a precise numerical outcome.

outputs.name: string
outputs.description: The string representation of the calculation result, enabling easy integration and display in various contexts.

LayerUtility_ PrintInfo.description: The 'LayerUtility: PrintInfo' node is designed to log and return information about the input it receives, including the type of the input, dimensions and shape if it's a tensor, and serialization of the input if possible. It's a utility node aimed at providing insights into the data flowing through a node pipeline, facilitating debugging and data inspection.

inputs.name: anything
inputs.description: Accepts any type of input, aiming to provide detailed information about it, including its type, dimensions if applicable, and a serialized form. This flexibility allows for a wide range of data types to be inspected, making it a versatile tool for debugging and data analysis.

outputs.name: text
outputs.description: Outputs a string containing detailed information about the input, including its type, dimensions if applicable, and serialized form, aiding in debugging and data inspection.

LayerUtility_ PromptEmbellish.description: The PromptEmbellish node is designed to enhance and refine text prompts for image generation tasks, specifically targeting the Stable Diffusion model. It employs a multi-step process to modify, polish, and enrich the initial prompt based on provided descriptions or image content, aiming to produce more detailed and effective prompts for generating high-quality images.

inputs.name: api
inputs.description: The API parameter specifies the interface used for generating content, indicating the external service or model to be utilized for prompt embellishment.

inputs.name: token_limit
inputs.description: This parameter sets the maximum number of tokens (words) for the generated prompt, defining the length and detail level of the output text.

inputs.name: describe
inputs.description: A description or keyword that must be included in the embellished prompt, guiding the content generation process to ensure relevance to the desired theme or subject.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: An optional image input that can be used as a reference for the prompt embellishment process, allowing for more context-specific text generation.

outputs.name: text
outputs.description: The output is an enhanced text prompt, specifically tailored for use with the Stable Diffusion model to generate images that closely match the input description or image content.

LayerUtility_ PromptTagger.description: The PromptTagger node is designed to enhance and modify text prompts based on specific criteria such as token limits and exclusion or replacement of words. It primarily serves to prepare and optimize prompts for further processing or generation tasks, ensuring they meet the required specifications for use with certain APIs or models.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The image input is used as a reference for generating or modifying the text prompt, providing visual context that influences the output.

inputs.name: api
inputs.description: Specifies the API to be used, with 'gemini-pro-vision' being a supported option. This determines the processing or generation capabilities available for the prompt.

inputs.name: token_limit
inputs.description: Defines the maximum number of tokens allowed in the prompt, ensuring it adheres to specific API or model constraints.

inputs.name: exclude_word
inputs.description: A word to be excluded from the prompt, allowing for customization and refinement of the generated text.

inputs.name: replace_with_word
inputs.description: Specifies a word to replace within the prompt, enabling targeted modifications to the text.

outputs.name: text
outputs.description: The modified or enhanced text prompt, ready for further processing or use.

LayerUtility_ PurgeVRAM.description: The PurgeVRAM node is designed to free up GPU memory resources by optionally clearing PyTorch's cache and unloading all models from memory. It's a system utility node aimed at optimizing memory usage during runtime, especially useful in environments with limited GPU memory or when running multiple model inference tasks sequentially.

inputs.name: anything
inputs.description: A placeholder input that does not affect the operation of the node, allowing for flexible integration into workflows.

inputs.name: purge_cache
inputs.description: Determines whether the PyTorch cache should be cleared, helping to free up GPU memory.

inputs.name: purge_models
inputs.description: Controls whether all models should be unloaded from memory, further aiding in the optimization of GPU memory usage.

LayerUtility_ QueueStop.description: This node is designed to control the execution flow within a queue by providing the functionality to either stop or continue the queue based on specified conditions. It plays a crucial role in managing the execution order and conditions within complex workflows, allowing for dynamic control over the process flow.

inputs.name: any
inputs.description: A generic input parameter that can be of any type, serving as a placeholder for data that might be passed through the node without alteration.

inputs.name: mode
inputs.description: Specifies the operation mode of the node, which can either be 'stop' to halt the queue or 'continue' to proceed without interruption. This allows for conditional control over the queue's execution.

inputs.name: stop
inputs.description: A boolean parameter that, when true and the mode is set to 'stop', triggers the stopping of the queue. This provides a direct mechanism to halt the queue's execution based on logical conditions.

outputs.name: any
outputs.description: Returns the input data unmodified, allowing for the data to be passed through or halted based on the node's execution logic.

LayerUtility_ QWenImage2Prompt.description: This node integrates a chat model to generate text prompts based on an input image and a question. It utilizes an image-to-text conversion process to facilitate interactions with the chat model, aiming to produce descriptive or query-responsive text outputs.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The input image for which the text prompt will be generated. It serves as the visual context for the chat model to interpret and describe.

inputs.name: question
inputs.description: An optional question to guide the generation of the text prompt, allowing for more specific or directed outputs from the chat model.

outputs.name: text
outputs.description: The generated text prompt that describes or answers the question about the input image.

LayerUtility_ RestoreCropBox.description: The RestoreCropBox node is designed to reintegrate a previously cropped image back into its original background, optionally utilizing an inversion mask and a specific crop box to accurately place the cropped image. This functionality is crucial for image editing tasks where maintaining the original context of the image is necessary after modifications.

inputs.name: background_image
inputs.description: The original image from which a portion was cropped. This image serves as the canvas where the cropped image will be placed back.

inputs.name: croped_image
inputs.description: The cropped portion of the image that needs to be restored onto the original background.

inputs.name: invert_mask
inputs.description: A boolean flag indicating whether the mask used for cropping should be inverted during the restoration process.

inputs.name: crop_box
inputs.description: Defines the specific area (box) on the background image where the cropped image will be placed.

inputs.name: croped_mask
inputs.description: An optional mask that was used during the cropping process. It can be utilized for more precise restoration.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The resulting image after the cropped image has been restored onto the original background.

outputs.name: mask
outputs.description: The mask used during the restoration process, which can be useful for further image processing steps.

LayerUtility_ RGB Value.description: This node converts a given color value, either in hexadecimal string format or as an RGB tuple, into its constituent red, green, and blue (RGB) integer components. It's designed to facilitate color manipulation and analysis within image processing tasks by providing a direct way to extract and work with individual color channels.

inputs.name: color_value
inputs.description: The color value input can be a hexadecimal string or an RGB tuple, representing the color to be converted into its RGB components. This input is crucial for determining the specific RGB values to be extracted, directly affecting the node's output.

outputs.name: R
outputs.description: The red component of the color, extracted as an integer value.

outputs.name: G
outputs.description: The green component of the color, extracted as an integer value.

outputs.name: B
outputs.description: The blue component of the color, extracted as an integer value.

LayerUtility_ SaveImagePlus.description: The SaveImagePlus node is designed to enhance image saving capabilities within a workflow, offering advanced options such as custom file paths, filename prefixes, timestamping, image formatting, quality adjustments, metadata inclusion, and the option to add a blind watermark. It also supports saving workflow configurations as JSON and provides a preview feature, making it a versatile tool for managing output images and related data.

inputs.name: images
inputs.description: The images to be saved. This parameter is essential for defining the content that will be processed and saved by the node.

inputs.name: custom_path
inputs.description: Specifies a custom directory path where the images will be saved. This allows for flexible file management and organization.

inputs.name: filename_prefix
inputs.description: A prefix added to the filename of the saved images, enabling easy identification and sorting.

inputs.name: timestamp
inputs.description: Determines whether and how a timestamp is added to the filename, offering options for none, second, or millisecond precision. This helps in versioning and organizing saved images.

inputs.name: format
inputs.description: The file format for the saved images, with options including PNG and JPG. This choice affects the image's compatibility and quality.

inputs.name: quality
inputs.description: Adjusts the quality of the saved images, applicable for formats that support compression. It allows for balancing between image quality and file size.

inputs.name: meta_data
inputs.description: A boolean indicating whether to include metadata in the saved images, enhancing the information content of the image files.

inputs.name: blind_watermark
inputs.description: An optional string to be used as a blind watermark, adding a layer of security or branding to the images without altering their appearance.

inputs.name: save_workflow_as_json
inputs.description: When enabled, saves the current workflow configuration as a JSON file alongside the images, useful for documentation or replication purposes.

inputs.name: preview
inputs.description: A boolean flag that, when enabled, saves a preview image to a temporary directory, useful for quick checks or as a thumbnail.

LayerUtility_ SD3NegativeConditioning.description: This node applies negative conditioning to the input conditioning data for SD3 models, aiming to modify and control the generation process by zeroing out specific parts of the conditioning and adjusting the range of effect. It's designed to enhance or suppress certain aspects of the generated content based on the negative conditioning applied.

inputs.name: conditioning
inputs.description: The input conditioning data to be modified. It's crucial for defining the aspects of the generated content that need enhancement or suppression.

inputs.name: zero_out_start
inputs.description: Defines the starting point (as a percentage of the total length) from which the negative conditioning effect begins, allowing for precise control over the area of impact.

outputs.name: conditioning
outputs.description: The modified conditioning data after applying negative conditioning, ready to be used in the generation process.

LayerUtility_ Seed.description: The Seed node is designed to initialize or set a seed value for processes that require deterministic outcomes. It ensures that operations which involve randomness can be replicated exactly by providing a consistent starting point.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.description: The seed parameter is used to set the initial value for the seed, influencing the deterministic nature of subsequent operations. It ensures that results can be consistently replicated when the same seed is used.

outputs.name: seed
outputs.description: Outputs the same seed value that was input, allowing it to be used in subsequent operations that require a deterministic starting point.

LayerUtility_ ShowBlindWaterMark.description: This node is designed to decode and reveal blind watermarks embedded within images. It processes each image to extract the watermark, demonstrating the capability to reverse the watermarking process and retrieve hidden information.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The input image from which the blind watermark is to be decoded. This image is expected to have a watermark embedded in it, which this node aims to extract and reveal.

outputs.name: watermark_image
outputs.description: The output image that contains the decoded watermark, extracted from the input image. This image represents the hidden information that was embedded within the original image.

LayerUtility_ SimpleTextImage.description: This node is designed to generate images with text overlay, allowing for the creation of simple text-based images. It utilizes text wrapping and font customization to place text onto images, making it suitable for creating labels, annotations, or decorative text elements within a graphical context.

inputs.name: text
inputs.description: Specifies the text to be overlaid on the image. It plays a crucial role in determining the content of the generated image.

inputs.name: font_file
inputs.description: Determines the font used for the text, affecting the visual appearance of the text in the image.

inputs.name: align
inputs.description: Specifies the alignment of the text within the image, such as 'center', 'left', or 'right'.

inputs.name: char_per_line
inputs.description: Controls the number of characters per line, influencing text wrapping and layout.

inputs.name: leading
inputs.description: Adjusts the space between lines of text, impacting the readability and aesthetic of the text.

inputs.name: font_size
inputs.description: Sets the size of the font, directly affecting how the text appears on the image.

inputs.name: text_color
inputs.description: Specifies the color of the text, allowing for customization of the text's visual style.

inputs.name: stroke_width
inputs.description: Defines the width of the text's stroke, enhancing text legibility or stylistic appearance.

inputs.name: stroke_color
inputs.description: Determines the color of the text's stroke, used to add contrast or decorative effects to the text.

inputs.name: x_offset
inputs.description: Adjusts the horizontal position of the text within the image, enabling precise placement.

inputs.name: y_offset
inputs.description: Adjusts the vertical position of the text within the image, enabling precise placement.

inputs.name: width
inputs.description: Sets the width of the generated image.

inputs.name: height
inputs.description: Sets the height of the generated image.

inputs.name: size_as
inputs.description: unknown

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The generated image with the specified text overlaid.

outputs.name: mask
outputs.description: A mask image indicating areas affected by the text overlay, useful for further image processing steps.

LayerUtility_ String.description: This node is designed to handle string operations within a layer, providing functionality to manipulate and process text data as part of a larger workflow. It abstracts the complexities of text handling, offering a streamlined interface for operations such as formatting, concatenation, or conversion, within the context of layer-based utilities.

inputs.name: string
inputs.description: Represents the text input that the node will process, emphasizing its role in the manipulation or analysis of string data. This input is crucial for operations that require textual content to work with.

outputs.name: string
outputs.description: Outputs the processed text, reflecting the successful application of the specified string operations.

LayerUtility_ StringCondition.description: The StringCondition node is designed to evaluate text against specified conditions, such as inclusion or exclusion of a substring, and return a boolean result along with the result in string format. This functionality allows for conditional logic to be applied based on text content, enabling dynamic flow control and content filtering within a data processing pipeline.

inputs.name: text
inputs.description: The 'text' parameter is the primary string to be evaluated against the given condition. Its role is crucial as it determines the context in which the condition is applied, directly influencing the outcome of the node's execution.

inputs.name: condition
inputs.description: The 'condition' parameter specifies the type of string evaluation to perform, such as 'include' or 'exclude', dictating whether the substring should be present or absent in the text for the condition to be considered true.

inputs.name: sub_string
inputs.description: The 'sub_string' parameter is the string fragment to be searched within the 'text' parameter. Its presence or absence, based on the 'condition', determines the boolean outcome of the node's operation.

outputs.name: output
outputs.description: Indicates whether the specified condition (inclusion or exclusion of a substring) was met in the text.

outputs.name: string
outputs.description: A string representation of the boolean result, providing a textual indication of whether the condition was met.

LayerUtility_ SwitchCase.description: The SwitchCase node provides a mechanism to execute different branches of logic based on the value of a given condition. It compares a switch condition against multiple cases and executes the branch where the condition matches, allowing for more dynamic and conditional data flow within a node network.

inputs.name: switch_condition
inputs.description: The condition value to be compared against the defined cases. It determines which branch of logic will be executed based on its match with the case values.

inputs.name: case_i
inputs.description: A case value to compare against the switch condition. If matched, the corresponding input for this case is selected for output. The index 'i' can range to accommodate multiple cases.

inputs.name: input_default
inputs.description: The default input to use if none of the case values match the switch condition.

inputs.name: input_i
inputs.description: The input associated with a case. It is selected for output if the switch condition matches the corresponding case value. The index 'i' can range to accommodate multiple inputs.

outputs.description: unknown

LayerUtility_ TextBox.description: The TextBox node is designed to encapsulate and return the input text as is, supporting multiline text inputs. It serves as a basic utility for handling and passing through text data within a node-based processing pipeline.

inputs.name: text
inputs.description: The 'text' parameter accepts a string input, potentially spanning multiple lines, and passes it through without modification. It's essential for operations where the exact input text needs to be preserved or displayed.

outputs.name: text
outputs.description: The output is the same as the input text, allowing for the direct passage of text data through the node.

LayerUtility_ TextImage.description: This node is designed to generate images from text by applying specific font styles, sizes, and colors. It allows for the customization of text appearance on images, including the layout and spacing, to create visually appealing graphics or text overlays on images. The node leverages image processing techniques to convert text into a graphical representation, suitable for a variety of applications such as dynamic image generation, graphic design, and content creation.

inputs.name: text
inputs.description: The text to be converted into an image. This parameter is crucial as it defines the content that will be visually represented in the generated image.

inputs.name: font_file
inputs.description: Specifies the font file to use for the text rendering. This affects the style and appearance of the text in the image, allowing for a wide range of typographic designs.

inputs.name: spacing
inputs.description: Controls the spacing between characters in the text. Adjusting this parameter can enhance readability or achieve a desired stylistic effect.

inputs.name: leading
inputs.description: Determines the leading (line spacing) of the text, which is the distance between the baselines of successive lines of type. This parameter helps in adjusting the layout of text blocks for better visual composition.

inputs.name: horizontal_border
inputs.description: The horizontal border padding for the text within the image. This parameter ensures that the text does not touch the edges of the image, providing a cleaner look.

inputs.name: vertical_border
inputs.description: The vertical border padding for the text within the image. Similar to the horizontal border, it prevents the text from touching the top and bottom edges of the image.

inputs.name: scale
inputs.description: Affects the overall size of the text in the image. Scaling the text up or down can help it fit better within the image or achieve a specific visual impact.

inputs.name: variation_range
inputs.description: Defines the range of variation for random adjustments to the text appearance, such as size or position, to add uniqueness or dynamism to the generated image.

inputs.name: variation_seed
inputs.description: The seed for generating random variations in text appearance, ensuring reproducibility of the text styling when needed.

inputs.name: layout
inputs.description: Specifies the layout orientation of the text within the image, such as horizontal or vertical alignment, influencing the overall composition and readability.

inputs.name: width
inputs.description: The width of the image canvas on which the text is rendered. This parameter defines the horizontal boundary for the text layout and appearance.

inputs.name: height
inputs.description: The height of the image canvas on which the text is rendered. This parameter defines the vertical boundary for the text layout and appearance.

inputs.name: text_color
inputs.description: The color of the text. This parameter allows for customization of the text's visual impact against the image background.

inputs.name: background_color
inputs.description: The background color of the image. It sets the overall tone of the image and can affect the contrast and visibility of the text.

inputs.name: size_as
inputs.description: An optional parameter that allows the image size to be defined relative to another element or parameter, providing flexibility in image scaling and layout.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The generated image with the text rendered according to the specified parameters. This output is the primary result of the node's processing, showcasing the text as a visual element within an image.

outputs.name: mask
outputs.description: A mask that represents the area of the text within the generated image. This can be useful for further image processing tasks, such as compositing or applying effects specifically to the text area.

LayerUtility_ TextJoin.description: The TextJoin node is designed to concatenate multiple text inputs into a single string, separated by commas. It allows for the dynamic combination of up to four text strings, facilitating the aggregation of textual data for further processing or display.

inputs.name: text_i
inputs.description: unknown

outputs.name: text
outputs.description: The output is a single string that represents the concatenated result of the input texts, separated by commas.

LayerUtility_ XY to Percent.description: This node converts the X and Y coordinates of a layer image relative to a background image into percentage values, facilitating the positioning of the layer image on the background image in a scalable manner.

inputs.name: background_image
inputs.description: The background image against which the layer image's position is calculated. It serves as the reference frame for determining the percentage-based position.

inputs.name: layer_image
inputs.description: The layer image whose position is to be calculated relative to the background image. This image's dimensions are used in the calculation of its center's position in percentage terms.

inputs.name: x
inputs.description: The X coordinate of the layer image's position, which is used along with the background image's dimensions to calculate the horizontal position in percentage.

inputs.name: y
inputs.description: The Y coordinate of the layer image's position, which is used along with the background image's dimensions to calculate the vertical position in percentage.

outputs.name: x_percent
outputs.description: The calculated horizontal position of the layer image's center as a percentage of the background image's width.

AdjectiveStyler.description: The AdjectiveStyler node dynamically customizes text prompts based on a selection of stylistic adjectives, allowing users to enhance or modify the tone and characteristics of their text inputs through a menu-driven interface.

inputs.name: text_positive
inputs.description: Defines the initial positive text prompt to be styled. It serves as the base content that will be modified according to the selected stylistic adjectives.

inputs.name: text_negative
inputs.description: Defines the initial negative text prompt to be styled. It serves as the base content that will be modified according to the selected stylistic adjectives.

inputs.name: adjective
inputs.description: unknown

inputs.name: log_prompt
inputs.description: Controls whether the styling process and selections are logged, aiding in debugging or review of the styling choices made.

outputs.name: text_positive
outputs.description: The modified positive text prompt, styled according to the selected adjectives.

outputs.name: text_negative
outputs.description: The modified negative text prompt, styled according to the selected adjectives.

AdjectiveStylerAdvanced.description: The AdjectiveStylerAdvanced node dynamically applies stylistic transformations to text inputs based on a selection of adjectives, enhancing or altering the tone, mood, or descriptive quality of the text. It leverages a collection of predefined templates to modify text inputs according to user-selected stylistic preferences, aiming to achieve a specific aesthetic or thematic effect.

inputs.name: text_positive_g
inputs.description: The global positive text to be styled, affecting the overall positive tone or content of the input.

inputs.name: text_positive_l
inputs.description: The local positive text to be styled, targeting specific positive aspects or details within the input.

inputs.name: text_negative
inputs.description: The negative text to be styled, focusing on altering or enhancing negative elements or tones within the input.

inputs.name: adjective
inputs.description: unknown

inputs.name: negative_prompt_to
inputs.description: Determines the scope of negative text transformation, allowing customization of which parts of the text (global, local, or both) are to be styled.

inputs.name: log_prompt
inputs.description: A boolean flag to enable or disable logging of the prompt styling process, providing insights into the selections and transformations applied.

outputs.name: text_positive_g
outputs.description: The styled global positive text, reflecting the applied stylistic transformations.

outputs.name: text_positive_l
outputs.description: The styled local positive text, showcasing the specific stylistic enhancements made.

outputs.name: text_positive
outputs.description: A composite of styled positive text, combining global and local transformations for a cohesive effect.

outputs.name: text_negative_g
outputs.description: The styled global negative text, indicating the stylistic changes applied to the overall negative tone or content.

outputs.name: text_negative_l
outputs.description: The styled local negative text, highlighting the stylistic alterations made to specific negative details or aspects.

outputs.name: text_negative
outputs.description: The fully styled negative text, incorporating both global and local stylistic transformations.

ArtistStyler.description: The ArtistStyler node dynamically applies artistic styling to text prompts based on a selection of styles defined in a dataset. It allows users to enhance their text inputs with predefined artistic styles, enabling a more creative and tailored text generation process.

inputs.name: text_positive
inputs.description: A positive text input that the user wishes to apply artistic styling to. This input is crucial for defining the base content that will be enhanced with the selected artistic style.

inputs.name: text_negative
inputs.description: A negative text input that the user wishes to apply artistic styling to. This input complements the positive text, offering a nuanced approach to text styling by also considering elements to be stylistically negated or downplayed.

inputs.name: artist
inputs.description: Specifies the artistic style to apply to the text inputs. This selection is central to the customization of the text, enabling the application of a specific artistic flair.

inputs.name: log_prompt
