inputs.name: prompt_l
inputs.description: A secondary prompt, also supporting multiline input, that complements the primary prompt to refine and direct the generation towards positive conditioning.

inputs.name: opt_model
inputs.description: An optional model parameter that allows for further customization and control over the text generation process.

inputs.name: opt_clip
inputs.description: An optional CLIP parameter that can be used to enhance the semantic understanding of the prompts.

inputs.name: opt_clip_width
inputs.description: Specifies the width for the CLIP encoding process, enhancing the conditioning's focus.

inputs.name: opt_clip_height
inputs.description: Specifies the height for the CLIP encoding process, refining the conditioning's scope.

inputs.name: insert_lora
inputs.description: Allows the insertion of Lora tags for advanced customization and control over the generated content.

inputs.name: insert_embedding
inputs.description: Enables the inclusion of specific embeddings to influence the generation process.

inputs.name: insert_saved
inputs.description: Permits the use of saved prompts to guide the generation, offering a way to reuse successful configurations.

inputs.name: target_width
inputs.description: The target width for the generated content, affecting the output's dimensions.

inputs.name: target_height
inputs.description: The target height for the generated content, impacting the output's scale.

inputs.name: crop_width
inputs.description: Defines the width of the crop area for the CLIP encoding, focusing the analysis.

inputs.name: crop_height
inputs.description: Defines the height of the crop area for the CLIP encoding, concentrating the examination.

outputs.name: CONDITIONING
outputs.description: The output conditioning data used for text generation.

outputs.name: MODEL
outputs.description: The model used in the generation process, if any.

outputs.name: CLIP
outputs.description: The CLIP data used for enhancing the prompts, if any.

outputs.name: TEXT_G
outputs.description: The primary generated text output.

outputs.name: TEXT_L
outputs.description: The secondary generated text output.

SDXL Power Prompt - Simple _ Negative (r.description: This node provides a simplified version of the SDXL Power Prompt specifically designed for negative conditioning scenarios. It streamlines the process by not loading Loras, making it more efficient for cases where negative prompts are required.

inputs.name: prompt_g
inputs.description: The global prompt used for generating or conditioning the output. It plays a crucial role in guiding the overall direction and theme of the generation.

inputs.name: prompt_l
inputs.description: The local prompt that specifies more detailed or localized conditions for the generation. It complements the global prompt by adding specificity to certain areas or aspects.

inputs.name: opt_clip
inputs.description: Optional CLIP model settings to adjust the conditioning based on visual concepts.

inputs.name: opt_clip_width
inputs.description: Specifies the width of the CLIP model's input. It's crucial for defining the dimensions of the visual concepts to be considered.

inputs.name: opt_clip_height
inputs.description: Specifies the height of the CLIP model's input. It's essential for determining the dimensions of the visual concepts to be analyzed.

inputs.name: insert_embedding
inputs.description: Allows the insertion of pre-defined embeddings into the prompt, enhancing the conditioning with additional context or information.

inputs.name: insert_saved
inputs.description: Enables the inclusion of saved prompts, providing a way to reuse previously successful or preferred prompt configurations.

inputs.name: target_width
inputs.description: Defines the target width for the output, allowing for specific dimension requirements to be set.

inputs.name: target_height
inputs.description: Defines the target height for the output, enabling precise dimension specifications for the generated content.

inputs.name: crop_width
inputs.description: Determines the width of the crop area, which can be used to focus the generation on a specific part of the visual concept.

inputs.name: crop_height
inputs.description: Specifies the height of the crop area, allowing for targeted focus within the visual concept for the generation.

outputs.name: CONDITIONING
outputs.description: The conditioning output that combines global and local prompts with optional parameters to guide the generation process.

outputs.name: TEXT_G
outputs.description: The global prompt used for the generation, returned as part of the output for reference.

outputs.name: TEXT_L
outputs.description: The local prompt used for the generation, returned as part of the output for reference.

Seed (rgthree).description: The Seed node is designed to manage and generate random seeds for operations, ensuring reproducibility and uniqueness in processes that require randomization. It can return a predefined seed, generate a new random seed, or modify the seed based on specific conditions, while also handling metadata updates related to seed information.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.description: The 'seed' parameter is crucial for determining the starting point of randomness. It can either use a predefined seed or trigger the generation of a new random seed, affecting the node's output and ensuring reproducibility of results.

outputs.name: SEED
outputs.description: Outputs the seed used or generated during the node's execution, which is essential for ensuring the reproducibility of the randomness in processes.

SAIColorTransfer.description: The SAIColorTransfer node is designed for applying color transfer techniques between images. It enables the modification of the color scheme of target images to match the color characteristics of source images, supporting various modes of color transfer.

inputs.name: target_images
inputs.description: Target images are the images whose color schemes are to be modified. They serve as the canvas for the color transfer process.

inputs.name: source_images
inputs.description: Source images provide the color scheme to be transferred to the target images. They act as the reference for the desired color characteristics.

inputs.name: mode
inputs.description: Specifies the color transfer mode to be used, such as 'pdf_regrain', 'mean_transfer', or 'lab_transfer', each offering a different approach to color adaptation.

outputs.name: images
outputs.description: The modified images with the color scheme of the source images applied to the target images.

SAIPrimitiveConverter.description: The SAIPrimitiveConverter node is designed to facilitate the conversion of input values between different primitive data types, such as strings, lists, and dictionaries. It dynamically processes input based on specified output types and conditions, offering flexibility in handling various data structures and formats.

inputs.name: input_value
inputs.description: The raw input value to be converted. Its role is pivotal in determining the final output, as the conversion process adapts based on this value's type and content.

inputs.name: output_type
inputs.description: Specifies the desired type of the conversion output, such as 'LIST', 'DICT', or 'STRING', guiding the conversion process and determining the structure of the result.

inputs.name: sub_data_type
inputs.description: An optional parameter that further specifies the type of the elements within the input value, enhancing the conversion accuracy for complex data structures.

inputs.name: index_or_key
inputs.description: An optional parameter used to extract a specific element from the input value when converting to a 'STRING' type, based on either an index in a list or a key in a dictionary.

outputs.name: output
outputs.description: The result of the conversion process, which can vary in type (e.g., list, dictionary, string) based on the specified output type and conditions of the input.

SAIStringRegexSearchMatch.description: This node performs a search operation within a given text using a specified regular expression pattern, returning all matches found. It's designed to facilitate complex text analysis and extraction tasks by leveraging the power of regex patterns.

inputs.name: text_input
inputs.description: The text in which to search for matches. This input allows for multiline text, enabling searches across complex documents or blocks of text.

inputs.name: regex_pattern
inputs.description: The regular expression pattern used to identify matches within the text input. This pattern defines the criteria for what constitutes a match, allowing for precise and flexible text analysis.

outputs.name: matches
outputs.description: A list of all text segments within the input text that match the specified regular expression pattern.

SAIStringRegexSearchReplace.description: This node provides functionality for searching and replacing text in a given input string based on a specified regular expression pattern. It allows for the dynamic alteration of text content by identifying patterns and substituting them with a desired replacement string.

inputs.name: text_input
inputs.description: The input text where the search and replacement operation will be performed. It serves as the primary content for regex operations.

inputs.name: regex_pattern
inputs.description: The regular expression pattern used to identify the text segments within the input text that need to be replaced.

inputs.name: replacement_text
inputs.description: The text that will replace the segments identified by the regex pattern in the input text.

outputs.name: replaced_text
outputs.description: The resulting text after the search and replace operations have been performed on the input text.

SaltAIStableVideoDiffusion.description: The SaltAIStableVideoDiffusion node is designed to interface with the Stability AI API for generating videos based on input images. It encapsulates the process of sending an image to the API, managing the request, and processing the returned video data into a sequence of frames. This node leverages advanced video diffusion techniques to create high-quality, stable videos from static images, providing a seamless integration for applications requiring video generation capabilities.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The input image tensor that serves as the basis for video generation. It is crucial for defining the visual content from which the video will be generated, affecting the overall theme and appearance of the output video.

inputs.name: api_key
inputs.description: A required parameter for authenticating with the Stability AI API. It ensures authorized access to the video generation service, impacting the node's ability to generate videos.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.description: An optional parameter to control the randomness of video generation, enhancing the reproducibility of results by allowing for the generation of consistent videos across multiple runs.

inputs.name: cfg
inputs.description: The CFG scale parameter influences the creativity and coherence of the generated video, balancing between fidelity to the input image and the novelty of the generated content.

inputs.name: mbi
inputs.description: The motion bucket ID parameter guides the motion dynamics in the generated video, affecting how elements within the video move and interact.

outputs.name: frames
outputs.description: A sequence of video frames represented as tensors, providing the generated video content in a format suitable for further processing or visualization.

SaltBatchCropDataExtractor.description: The SaltBatchCropDataExtractor node is designed for extracting specific crop data from a batch based on an index. It processes a collection of crop data, identifying and extracting detailed information about a particular crop region, including its dimensions and position within the original image.

inputs.name: crop_data_batch
inputs.description: A batch of crop data from which specific crop information is to be extracted. It plays a crucial role in determining the output by specifying which crop region's details are to be retrieved.

inputs.name: index
inputs.description: The index within the crop data batch that specifies the particular crop region to extract information from. It is essential for pinpointing the exact crop data to be processed.

outputs.name: crop_data_batch
outputs.description: The extracted crop data for the specified index, including the crop's size and coordinates.

outputs.name: width
outputs.description: The width of the extracted crop region.

outputs.name: height
outputs.description: The height of the extracted crop region.

outputs.name: top
outputs.description: The top coordinate of the extracted crop region.

outputs.name: left
outputs.description: The left coordinate of the extracted crop region.

outputs.name: right
outputs.description: The right coordinate of the extracted crop region.

outputs.name: bottom
outputs.description: The bottom coordinate of the extracted crop region.

SaltCLIPSegLoader.description: The SaltCLIPSegLoader node is designed to load and initialize the CLIPSeg model for image segmentation tasks. It facilitates the process of fetching the model and its processor from a specified source, caching them locally for efficient reuse.

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: Specifies the model identifier for the CLIPSeg model to be loaded. This allows for flexibility in choosing different CLIPSeg model versions or configurations.

outputs.name: clipseg_model
outputs.description: Returns a tuple containing the CLIPSeg processor and the CLIPSeg model, ready for image segmentation tasks.

SaltCLIPSegMasking.description: This node is designed for batch processing of images to generate segmentation masks based on textual descriptions using the CLIPSeg model. It leverages a combination of image and text inputs to produce detailed segmentation masks that align with the given text descriptions, facilitating advanced image manipulation and analysis tasks.

inputs.name: images
inputs.description: A batch of images to be processed for segmentation. These images are transformed and resized to match the master image size for consistent mask generation.

inputs.name: text
inputs.description: An optional textual description that guides the segmentation process, allowing for targeted mask generation based on textual cues.

inputs.name: clipseg_model
inputs.description: An optional pre-loaded CLIPSeg model and processor to be used for segmentation. If not provided, the node will load a default model.

outputs.name: masks
outputs.description: Segmentation masks corresponding to the input images, adjusted to the master image size.

outputs.name: mask_images
outputs.description: RGB representations of the segmentation masks for visualization purposes.

SaltCropImageLocation.description: This node specializes in identifying and extracting specific image locations for cropping within a batch processing environment. It facilitates precise, location-based cropping operations on multiple images, enhancing the efficiency and accuracy of batch image manipulation tasks.

inputs.name: images
inputs.description: The collection of images to be processed for location-based cropping. This parameter is crucial for determining the specific areas within each image that need to be cropped, based on the provided location data.

inputs.name: top
inputs.description: Specifies the top boundary for the cropping operation. It defines the starting vertical point from which the image will be cropped.

inputs.name: left
inputs.description: Specifies the left boundary for the cropping operation. It defines the starting horizontal point from which the image will be cropped.

inputs.name: right
inputs.description: Specifies the right boundary for the cropping operation, determining the end horizontal point for the crop.

inputs.name: bottom
inputs.description: Specifies the bottom boundary for the cropping operation, determining the end vertical point for the crop.

inputs.name: crop_data_batch
inputs.description: Optional parameter that includes pre-defined cropping data for batch processing. When provided, it can override manual boundary settings for more automated cropping.

outputs.name: images
outputs.description: The resulting images after the cropping operation has been applied, reflecting the specified location-based adjustments.

outputs.name: crop_data_batch
outputs.description: A batch of crop data corresponding to each processed image, detailing the specific crop locations and dimensions applied.

SaltImageBlendingModes.description: This node is designed for blending two sets of images together using a variety of blending modes. It allows for the adjustment of blend percentages and the application of masks to control the blending process, offering a flexible approach to creating composite images.

inputs.name: images_a
inputs.description: The first set of images to be blended. These serve as the base layer in the blending process.

inputs.name: images_b
inputs.description: The second set of images to be blended with the first set. These images act as the overlay layer.

inputs.name: mode
inputs.description: Specifies the blending mode to be used. Each mode applies a different algorithm for combining the images, affecting the visual outcome of the blend.

inputs.name: blend_percentage
inputs.description: Determines the intensity of the blend between the two image sets. A higher percentage results in a stronger presence of the overlay images.

inputs.name: masks
inputs.description: Optional masks that can be applied to the images to control where the blending occurs. Useful for creating more precise or complex composite images.

outputs.name: images
outputs.description: The resulting set of blended images.

SaltImagePasteCrop.description: The SaltImagePasteCrop node specializes in blending and sharpening operations for image processing within a batch context. It seamlessly integrates crop images into target images, applying specified blending and sharpening parameters to achieve a visually cohesive result.

inputs.name: images
inputs.description: A batch of target images to which crop images will be applied. This parameter is crucial for defining the base images that will undergo the paste and crop operations.

inputs.name: crop_images
inputs.description: A batch of crop images that will be pasted onto the target images. This parameter is essential for supplying the images that will be integrated into the target images using blending and sharpening techniques.

inputs.name: crop_data_batch
inputs.description: Optional batch of crop data providing specific instructions for each pasting operation, including position and size. When provided, it enables precise control over the pasting process.

inputs.name: crop_blending
inputs.description: The blending factor to be used when integrating crop images into the target images, controlling the blend's intensity.

inputs.name: crop_sharpening
inputs.description: The amount of sharpening to apply to the crop images before pasting, enhancing image details.

outputs.name: images
outputs.description: A batch of images resulting from the pasting and cropping operations, with applied blending and sharpening effects.

outputs.name: masks
outputs.description: A batch of mask images corresponding to the areas affected by the pasting and cropping operations in the target images.

SaltInfo.description: The SaltInfo node is designed to log and return basic information about a workflow, including its title and description. It serves as a means to encapsulate and convey workflow metadata, facilitating easier identification and understanding of the workflow's purpose.

inputs.name: workflow_title
inputs.description: The title of the workflow, serving as a concise identifier and summary of the workflow's objective.

inputs.name: workflow_description
inputs.description: A detailed description of the workflow, outlining its purpose, functionality, and any other relevant information.

outputs.name: title
outputs.description: The title of the workflow, as provided in the input.

outputs.name: description
outputs.description: The detailed description of the workflow, as provided in the input.

SaltInput.description: The SaltInput node is designed to facilitate the creation and management of inputs for workflows within the Salt AI platform. It allows for the specification of various input types, including strings, numbers, booleans, and files, and supports additional features such as image and mask inputs, setting allowed values, and specifying whether user overrides are required. This node plays a crucial role in customizing and controlling the flow of data into Salt AI workflows, ensuring that inputs are correctly defined and processed according to the workflow's requirements.

inputs.name: input_name
inputs.description: Specifies the name of the input. This name is used to identify the input within the workflow, making it easier to reference and manage.

inputs.name: input_desc
inputs.description: Provides a description for the input. This description helps to clarify the purpose and expected content of the input, aiding in the workflow's documentation and usability.

inputs.name: input_type
inputs.description: Defines the type of the input. This can range from basic types like strings and numbers to more complex types like images and files, allowing for versatile input handling in the workflow.

inputs.name: input_value
inputs.description: The actual value for the input. Depending on the input type, this could be text, a numerical value, an image path, etc., serving as the primary data that the workflow will process.

inputs.name: input_image
inputs.description: An optional image input. When provided, this allows the workflow to directly process an image, adding a visual data processing capability.

inputs.name: input_mask
inputs.description: An optional mask input. This is used in conjunction with image inputs to apply specific processing or transformations based on the mask.

inputs.name: input_allowed_values
inputs.description: Specifies allowed values for the input. This is useful for inputs that should only accept a predefined set of values, ensuring data validity.

inputs.name: user_override_required
inputs.description: Indicates whether a user override is required for the input. This can be used to enforce user interaction for certain inputs, ensuring that specific conditions are met before proceeding.

inputs.name: relative_path
inputs.description: Determines whether the input value should be treated as a relative path. This is relevant for file inputs, affecting how the file path is interpreted and handled within the workflow.

outputs.name: value
outputs.description: unknown

SaltLoadImageZip.description: This node is designed to load images from a ZIP file, optionally resizing them to match the dimensions of the first image encountered. It supports a variety of image formats and is capable of handling multiple images within a single ZIP archive, making it suitable for batch processing of images for further analysis or manipulation.

inputs.name: path
inputs.description: Specifies the file path to the ZIP archive containing the images to be loaded. It is crucial for locating and accessing the desired ZIP file.

inputs.name: resize_images_to_first
inputs.description: Determines whether all loaded images should be resized to match the dimensions of the first image found in the ZIP file. This is useful for ensuring uniformity in image sizes for batch processing.

outputs.name: images
outputs.description: Returns a tensor containing the loaded (and possibly resized) images from the ZIP file, ready for further processing or analysis.

SaltMaskAdaptiveThresholdingRegion.description: This node applies adaptive thresholding to a set of mask images, converting them into binary images based on local pixel value variations. It is designed to enhance the visibility of features in regions with varying illumination by adjusting the threshold value dynamically across the image.

inputs.name: masks
inputs.description: The input masks to be processed for adaptive thresholding. These masks are transformed into binary images using a locally adaptive threshold.

inputs.name: block_size
inputs.description: The size of the local region around each pixel to calculate its threshold value. It determines the adaptability of the thresholding process to local changes in illumination.

inputs.name: constant
inputs.description: A constant subtracted from the mean or weighted mean calculated over the block size. This fine-tunes the thresholding process.

outputs.name: MASKS
outputs.description: The output tensor containing the regions after applying adaptive thresholding, enhancing local features in the masks.

SaltMaskAdd.description: The SaltMaskAdd node is designed to perform element-wise addition of two mask tensors, applying a clamp operation to ensure the resulting values fall within a specified range. This node is essential for combining mask regions to create composite masks or to enhance certain features within the mask by adding another mask's values.

inputs.name: masks_a
inputs.description: The first set of mask tensors to be added. These masks are one of the primary inputs for the addition operation, contributing to the resultant composite mask.

inputs.name: masks_b
inputs.description: The second set of mask tensors to be added. These masks are combined with the first set to produce the final composite mask, influencing the outcome of the addition operation.

outputs.name: MASKS
outputs.description: The output of the node, representing the composite mask created by adding the input masks together, with values clamped to ensure they remain within a valid range.

SaltMaskArbitaryRegion.description: This node applies a filter to mask arbitrary regions within given masks based on specified size and threshold parameters. It enables the customization of mask regions for various applications, such as image segmentation or object isolation.

inputs.name: masks
inputs.description: The input masks on which the arbitrary region filtering is applied. This parameter is crucial for defining the areas to be processed.

inputs.name: size
inputs.description: Specifies the size parameter for the arbitrary region filter, affecting the scale of the regions to be filtered within the masks.

inputs.name: threshold
inputs.description: Determines the threshold for the arbitrary region filtering, influencing which parts of the mask are considered for processing.

outputs.name: MASKS
outputs.description: The output is a modified mask where arbitrary regions have been filtered according to the specified size and threshold.

SaltMaskBilateralFilter.description: The SaltMaskBilateralFilter node applies a bilateral filter to mask regions to smooth them while preserving edges, enhancing the quality of mask regions by reducing noise and maintaining structural integrity.

inputs.name: masks
inputs.description: The input masks to be processed with the bilateral filter, aiming to smooth the mask regions while preserving their edges.

inputs.name: diameter
inputs.description: Specifies the diameter of each pixel neighborhood that is used during filtering.

inputs.name: sigmaColor
inputs.description: Represents the filter sigma in the color space, controlling how much colors in the neighborhood will be mixed together.

inputs.name: sigmaSpace
inputs.description: Determines the filter sigma in the coordinate space, affecting the spatial closeness of pixels to be considered during filtering.

outputs.name: MASKS
outputs.description: The output tensor of regions after applying the bilateral filter, where each region has been smoothed while preserving edges.

SaltMaskCeilingRegion.description: This node is designed to identify and isolate the ceiling regions within a given set of masks. It processes each mask to highlight the ceiling areas, facilitating focused analysis or modifications on these specific regions.

inputs.name: masks
inputs.description: The input masks to be processed for ceiling region identification. This parameter is crucial for determining the areas within each mask that correspond to ceiling regions.

outputs.name: MASKS
outputs.description: The output masks with the ceiling regions identified and isolated from the original input masks.

SaltMaskClipHardeningFilter.description: This node applies a clip hardening filter to mask regions, enhancing their edges and details through a sharpening process. It allows for adjustable strength to control the intensity of the effect.

inputs.name: masks
inputs.description: The masks to be processed, enhancing their clarity and definition.

inputs.name: strength
inputs.description: Controls the intensity of the sharpening effect applied to the masks. A higher value results in a more pronounced effect.

outputs.name: MASKS
outputs.description: The processed masks with enhanced edges and details after applying the clip hardening filter.

SaltMaskContourExtraction.description: This node is designed for extracting contours from mask regions using multiple threshold values. It applies a series of thresholds to identify and draw contours around regions of interest within the masks, effectively highlighting their boundaries.

inputs.name: masks
inputs.description: The input masks for which contours are to be extracted. These masks serve as the primary data on which the contour extraction process is applied.

inputs.name: thresholds
inputs.description: A list of threshold values used to identify contours within the masks. Each threshold value defines a specific level of intensity for which contours are detected and drawn, allowing for a multi-faceted analysis of the mask regions.

outputs.name: MASKS
outputs.description: The output consists of tensors representing the extracted contours from the input masks. These tensors highlight the boundaries of regions within the masks, based on the specified threshold values.

SaltMaskCropRegion.description: This node focuses on cropping regions from a batch of masks based on a specified region type and padding. It dynamically adjusts the crop to focus on areas of interest within each mask, resizing the cropped regions to a uniform size for batch processing. The node is designed to enhance or isolate specific features within masks, facilitating further analysis or processing.

inputs.name: masks
inputs.description: A batch of masks to be processed for cropping. This parameter is crucial for determining the areas within each mask that will be cropped based on the specified region type and padding.

inputs.name: padding
inputs.description: The padding value adds a specified number of pixels around the crop region. This parameter allows for flexibility in the size of the cropped area, ensuring that important features are not clipped.

inputs.name: region_type
inputs.description: Specifies the type of region to focus on for cropping, such as 'dominant'. This parameter influences how the cropping algorithm identifies and isolates areas of interest within each mask.

outputs.name: cropped_masks
outputs.description: The batch of masks after cropping, resized to a uniform size for consistency across the batch.

outputs.name: crop_data_batch
outputs.description: A list of crop data for each mask, detailing the specific crop dimensions and locations.

outputs.name: top_int
outputs.description: The top coordinate of the crop region for the first mask in the batch.

outputs.name: left_int
outputs.description: The left coordinate of the crop region for the first mask in the batch.

outputs.name: right_int
outputs.description: The right coordinate of the crop region for the first mask in the batch.

outputs.name: bottom_int
outputs.description: The bottom coordinate of the crop region for the first mask in the batch.

outputs.name: width_int
outputs.description: The width of the cropped region for the first mask in the batch, providing insight into the size of the cropped area.

outputs.name: height_int
outputs.description: The height of the cropped region for the first mask in the batch, offering a measure of the cropped area's size.

SaltMaskDilateRegion.description: This node applies a dilation filter to mask regions, effectively expanding the areas of interest within the masks based on the specified number of iterations. It's designed to process and modify mask regions to highlight or enlarge specific features within the masks.

inputs.name: masks
inputs.description: The input masks to be dilated. This parameter is crucial for defining the areas within the image that will undergo dilation, directly impacting the node's output.

inputs.name: iterations
inputs.description: Specifies the number of times the dilation operation is applied to the masks. This parameter controls the extent of dilation, affecting the size and visibility of features within the masks.

outputs.name: MASKS
outputs.description: The output masks after dilation. These masks represent the modified regions with expanded areas of interest, showcasing the effect of the dilation process.

SaltMaskDominantRegion.description: This node focuses on identifying and isolating the dominant region within a given set of masks based on a specified threshold. It effectively highlights the most prominent area in an image mask, making it useful for tasks that require focus on significant mask regions.

inputs.name: masks
inputs.description: The input masks on which the dominant region detection is to be performed. These masks are crucial for determining the area of interest within the images.

inputs.name: threshold
inputs.description: A threshold value to distinguish the dominant region within the masks. It plays a pivotal role in defining what constitutes the 'dominant' area by setting a cutoff intensity value.

outputs.name: MASKS
outputs.description: The output is a tensor of masks with the dominant region highlighted. This is significant for applications needing to focus on or manipulate the primary area within the masks.

SaltMaskEdgeDetection.description: This node applies edge detection algorithms to mask regions, enhancing the edges within the masks using methods like Canny or Sobel. It's designed to highlight the contours and boundaries of objects within the mask regions, making them more distinct for further processing or analysis.

inputs.name: masks
inputs.description: The input masks on which edge detection will be performed. These masks are processed to highlight their edges, significantly impacting the node's output by delineating object boundaries more clearly.

inputs.name: method
inputs.description: Specifies the edge detection method to use ('canny' or 'sobel'). The choice of method affects the edge enhancement technique applied to the masks, influencing the clarity and style of the resulting edges.

inputs.name: low_threshold
inputs.description: The lower bound for the edge detection algorithm's thresholding. It helps in filtering out noise and less prominent edges, focusing on more significant boundaries.

inputs.name: high_threshold
inputs.description: The upper bound for the edge detection algorithm's thresholding. It defines the intensity above which edges are considered significant, ensuring that only the most prominent edges are enhanced.

inputs.name: sobel_ksize
inputs.description: The kernel size for the Sobel operator, applicable only when the Sobel method is used. It affects the smoothness and precision of the edge detection.

outputs.name: MASKS
outputs.description: The output tensor containing the enhanced edges of the input masks. This tensor represents the detected edges, making the boundaries within the masks more pronounced and ready for further analysis.

SaltMaskErodeRegion.description: This node applies an erosion filter to mask regions, effectively shrinking the masked areas based on the specified number of iterations. It's designed to refine mask boundaries by eroding away the edges of masked regions.

inputs.name: masks
inputs.description: The input masks to be eroded. This parameter is crucial for defining the areas to be processed and refined by the erosion operation.

inputs.name: iterations
inputs.description: Specifies the number of times the erosion operation is applied to each mask, allowing for adjustable intensity of the effect.

outputs.name: MASKS
outputs.description: The output masks after applying the erosion filter, showcasing the refined and reduced masked regions.

SaltMaskFillRegion.description: This node is designed to fill regions within masks, transforming the input masks by identifying and filling specified regions to produce modified masks.

inputs.name: masks
inputs.description: The input masks to be processed for region filling. This parameter is crucial for determining the areas within each mask that will undergo the filling operation.

outputs.name: MASKS
outputs.description: The output consists of masks with specified regions filled, resulting from the processing of the input masks.

SaltMaskFloorRegion.description: The SaltMaskFloorRegion node is designed to identify and isolate floor regions within given masks. It processes each mask to extract the floor area, converting it into a tensor that represents the floor region.

inputs.name: masks
inputs.description: The input masks for which floor regions need to be identified. These masks are processed to extract floor areas, significantly impacting the node's output.

outputs.name: MASKS
outputs.description: The output tensor representing the isolated floor regions within the input masks.

SaltMaskGaussianRegion.description: Applies a Gaussian filter to specified regions within masks, allowing for the softening of edges and blending of regions for a smoother appearance. This node is particularly useful for image processing tasks where the focus is on enhancing or modifying the visual characteristics of masked areas.

inputs.name: masks
inputs.description: The masks to which the Gaussian filter will be applied. These masks define the regions that will be processed to achieve a smoother appearance.

inputs.name: radius
inputs.description: Specifies the radius of the Gaussian filter. A larger radius results in a more pronounced smoothing effect, allowing for greater control over the degree of blending and softening of the masked regions.

outputs.name: MASKS
outputs.description: The modified masks after the application of the Gaussian filter, showcasing smoother and more blended regions.

SaltMaskGradientRegion.description: This node applies a gradient filter to mask regions, enhancing edges and transitions within the mask to highlight areas of change. It's designed to process mask inputs and apply morphological gradient operations to emphasize the contours and transitions in the mask regions.

inputs.name: masks
inputs.description: The masks input represents the mask regions to which the gradient filter will be applied. This input is crucial for defining the areas of interest where edge enhancement and transition highlighting are desired.

inputs.name: kernel_size
inputs.description: The kernel_size parameter specifies the size of the kernel used in the morphological gradient operation. It affects the extent of edge enhancement and transition highlighting in the mask regions.

outputs.name: MASKS
outputs.description: The output masks are the result of applying the gradient filter to the input mask regions, featuring enhanced edges and transitions.

SaltMaskHistogramEqualizationRegion.description: This node applies histogram equalization to each mask in a collection of masks, enhancing the contrast of regions within the masks. It is designed to improve the visibility and differentiation of features within each mask by adjusting the distribution of intensities.

inputs.name: masks
inputs.description: The collection of masks to be processed. Each mask is enhanced individually to improve its contrast through histogram equalization.

outputs.name: MASKS
outputs.description: The enhanced masks with improved contrast, resulting from the application of histogram equalization to each original mask.

SaltMaskInvert.description: The SaltMaskInvert node is designed to invert the pixel values of mask regions, effectively flipping the mask's foreground and background. This operation is fundamental in image processing tasks where the focus is on the inverse of the given regions.

inputs.name: masks
inputs.description: The input masks to be inverted. This parameter is crucial as it directly influences the inversion process, determining which areas of the mask will be flipped.

outputs.name: MASKS
outputs.description: The inverted masks, with pixel values flipped from the original input. This output is significant for subsequent image processing or analysis tasks that require the inverted mask regions.

SaltMaskMinorityRegion.description: This node is designed to identify and isolate minority regions within a given set of masks, applying a threshold to distinguish these areas. It focuses on highlighting less prevalent features in the mask data, potentially for further analysis or processing.

inputs.name: masks
inputs.description: The masks input represents the collection of mask images to be processed, aiming to identify minority regions within each mask.

inputs.name: threshold
inputs.description: The threshold parameter determines the sensitivity of the minority region detection, influencing which areas are considered minority based on their pixel intensity.

outputs.name: MASKS
outputs.description: The output is a tensor of masks, each corresponding to the isolated minority region within the original input masks.

SaltMaskNoiseAddition.description: The SaltMaskNoiseAddition node is designed to introduce noise into mask regions, simulating variations and imperfections that might occur in real-world scenarios. It allows for the customization of the noise characteristics through parameters such as mean and standard deviation, enabling a wide range of noise effects.

inputs.name: masks
inputs.description: The 'masks' input is a collection of mask regions to which noise will be added. This parameter is essential for defining the areas where the noise effect will be applied, impacting the node's execution and the visual outcome of the noise addition.

inputs.name: mean
inputs.description: The 'mean' parameter specifies the average value of the noise distribution. Adjusting this value allows for controlling the overall brightness or darkness of the added noise, influencing the visual appearance of the masks.

inputs.name: stddev
inputs.description: The 'stddev' parameter determines the standard deviation of the noise distribution. This affects the variability and intensity of the noise added to the masks, enabling fine-tuning of the noise effect to achieve desired outcomes.

outputs.name: MASKS
outputs.description: The output 'MASKS' consists of the original mask regions with added noise, reflecting the specified mean and standard deviation parameters. This modified set of masks can be used for further processing or visualization.

SaltMaskRegionLabeling.description: This node is designed to label distinct regions within a mask, converting them into visually distinct areas based on connectivity, and outputting these labeled regions as a tensor. It utilizes thresholding and connected component analysis to segment and label different regions, enhancing the interpretability of mask regions by assigning unique colors to each.

inputs.name: masks
inputs.description: The input masks to be labeled, where each mask is processed to identify and label connected regions based on the specified threshold(s).

inputs.name: threshold
inputs.description: A list of threshold values to apply binary thresholding on the masks, which is crucial for separating the regions to be labeled. If a single value is provided, it is applied to all masks.

outputs.name: images
outputs.description: The output tensor containing the labeled regions, where each region is assigned a unique color to distinguish it from others. This correction addresses the feedback by correctly identifying the output as a tensor of labeled images, not just 'regions_tensor'.

SaltMaskRegionSplit.description: The SaltMaskRegionSplit node is designed to isolate and split different regions within a given set of masks, effectively segmenting them into distinct areas based on connectivity.

inputs.name: masks
inputs.description: The input masks to be segmented into distinct regions. This parameter is crucial for determining the segmentation outcome, as it directly influences the isolation of different areas within the masks.

outputs.name: region1
outputs.description: Represents the first isolated region from the input masks.

outputs.name: region2
outputs.description: Represents the second isolated region from the input masks.

outputs.name: region3
outputs.description: Represents the third isolated region from the input masks.

outputs.name: region4
outputs.description: Represents the fourth isolated region from the input masks.

outputs.name: region5
outputs.description: Represents the fifth isolated region from the input masks.

outputs.name: region6
outputs.description: Represents the sixth isolated region from the input masks.

SaltMaskSharpeningFilter.description: This node applies a sharpening filter to a collection of masks, enhancing their edges and details according to a specified strength. It's designed to refine mask visuals by iteratively applying a sharpening effect, making the features within the masks more pronounced.

inputs.name: masks
inputs.description: The collection of masks to be sharpened. This input is crucial for determining the regions within which the sharpening filter will be applied.

inputs.name: strength
inputs.description: Defines the intensity of the sharpening effect. A higher value results in a more pronounced sharpening effect on the masks.

outputs.name: MASKS
outputs.description: The output is a tensor of sharpened masks, where each mask has undergone the specified number of sharpening iterations to enhance its details.

SaltMaskSkeletonization.description: The SaltMaskSkeletonization node is designed to transform input mask images into their skeletonized versions, effectively reducing the masks to their simplest form while preserving their overall geometry. This process is useful for applications requiring a minimal representation of shapes within the masks.

inputs.name: masks
inputs.description: The input masks to be skeletonized, where each mask represents a distinct region to be processed into its skeletal form.

inputs.name: iterations
inputs.description: Specifies the number of times the erosion operation is applied to each mask, influencing the thinness of the resulting skeleton.

inputs.name: strength
inputs.description: Determines the intensity of the skeletonization process, affecting the final skeletal structure's prominence.

outputs.name: MASKS
outputs.description: The output tensor containing the skeletonized versions of the input masks, with each skeleton representing the minimal structure of the original mask.

SaltMaskSmoothRegion.description: The SaltMaskSmoothRegion node applies a smoothing filter to regions within masks, utilizing a specified sigma value to control the smoothness level. This process enhances the visual quality of mask regions by reducing noise and irregularities.

inputs.name: masks
inputs.description: The 'masks' parameter represents the input masks on which the smoothing operation is to be performed, serving as the primary data for the node's processing.

inputs.name: sigma
inputs.description: The 'sigma' parameter controls the smoothness level of the smoothing filter applied to the mask regions, directly influencing the degree of smoothing and noise reduction.

outputs.name: MASKS
outputs.description: The output is a tensor of masks that have been smoothed according to the specified sigma value, offering enhanced visual quality by reducing noise and irregularities.

SaltMasksToImages.description: This node is designed to convert a collection of mask images into a tensor representation, facilitating the transition from image processing to tensor operations for further computational tasks.

inputs.name: masks
inputs.description: The masks input represents a collection of mask images that are to be converted into tensor format. This conversion is crucial for enabling subsequent tensor-based operations and analyses.

outputs.name: images
outputs.description: The output is a tensor comprising the converted images from the input masks, ready for further processing or analysis.

SaltMaskSubtract.description: This node is designed to perform subtraction between two sets of masks, effectively computing the difference to highlight or remove specific regions within the masks.

inputs.name: masks_a
inputs.description: The first set of masks to be subtracted from. This input plays a crucial role in determining the base for the subtraction operation.

inputs.name: masks_b
inputs.description: The second set of masks to subtract from the first set. This input is essential for identifying the regions to be removed or highlighted in the resulting masks.

outputs.name: MASKS
outputs.description: The result of subtracting the second set of masks from the first, producing a new set of masks that highlight differences.

SaltMaskThresholdRegion.description: This node applies a threshold filter to mask regions, segmenting them based on specified black and white threshold values. It's designed to isolate and enhance areas within the masks, making it easier to distinguish between different regions based on their intensity levels.

inputs.name: masks
inputs.description: The input masks to be processed. These masks are segmented based on the provided threshold values, which determine the intensity levels that define the boundaries of the regions.

inputs.name: black_threshold
inputs.description: The lower bound for pixel intensity. Pixels with intensity below this value are set to black, aiding in the segmentation of darker regions within the masks.

inputs.name: white_threshold
inputs.description: The upper bound for pixel intensity. Pixels with intensity above this value are set to white, aiding in the segmentation of lighter regions within the masks.

outputs.name: MASKS
outputs.description: The output masks after applying the threshold filter, with regions segmented based on the specified black and white thresholds.

SaltOutput.description: The SaltOutput node is designed to handle the final output processing within the SaltAI framework, focusing on formatting and logging the output data according to specified parameters. It encapsulates the functionality to dynamically generate output metadata, manage file paths, and support a variety of output types including images, audio, and zip files, ensuring the output is correctly structured and accessible.

inputs.name: output_name
inputs.description: Specifies the name of the output, which is used to label and identify the output data. It plays a crucial role in organizing and accessing the output effectively.

inputs.name: output_desc
inputs.description: Provides a description for the output, offering context or additional details about the nature or content of the output data.

inputs.name: output_type
inputs.description: Determines the format of the output data, supporting a wide range of types including images, audio, video, and various file formats. This parameter is key to ensuring the output is correctly processed and rendered.

inputs.name: output_data
inputs.description: Contains the actual data to be outputted, which can vary widely in type depending on the output_type parameter.

inputs.name: video_audio
inputs.description: Optional audio track for video outputs, allowing for the inclusion of sound in video files.

inputs.name: animation_fps
inputs.description: Specifies the frames per second for animated outputs, controlling the playback speed of animations.

inputs.name: animation_quality
inputs.description: Defines the quality level of animations, offering options to balance between performance and visual fidelity.

SaltRGBAFromMask.description: This node is designed to convert masks into RGBA images, incorporating transparency into the resulting image. It focuses on processing image masks to generate images with an alpha channel, enabling the creation of images where certain regions are transparent, based on the input mask.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The source image that will be combined with the mask to produce an RGBA image. The image's non-masked areas will remain visible, while the masked areas can be made transparent or semi-transparent.

inputs.name: mask
inputs.description: The input mask for which the RGBA image will be generated. This mask determines the regions that will be transparent or opaque in the resulting image.

inputs.name: threshold
inputs.description: A value used to determine the cutoff point for what is considered transparent in the mask. Pixels in the mask above this value will be more opaque.

inputs.name: invert_mask
inputs.description: A boolean indicating whether the mask should be inverted before applying it to the image. Inverting the mask swaps which areas are considered transparent and which are opaque.

outputs.name: rgba_image
outputs.description: The resulting RGBA image where the input mask has been applied to define transparent regions.

SaltAdvancedAudioCompressor.description: This node provides advanced audio compression capabilities, allowing for detailed control over the compression process through parameters such as threshold, ratio, attack, release, and makeup gain. It is designed to modify the dynamic range of audio signals for enhanced sound quality or specific audio effects.

inputs.name: audio
inputs.description: The raw audio data to be compressed. This input is crucial for the compression process as it directly influences the output quality and effectiveness of the compression.

inputs.name: threshold_dB
inputs.description: Sets the threshold level in decibels for the compressor. Audio signals above this level will be compressed, affecting the loudness and dynamic range of the output.

inputs.name: ratio
inputs.description: Determines the compression ratio, which affects how much the audio signal is reduced once it crosses the threshold level.

inputs.name: attack_ms
inputs.description: The time in milliseconds it takes for the compressor to apply compression after the audio signal exceeds the threshold. This parameter influences the responsiveness of the compression effect.

inputs.name: release_ms
inputs.description: The time in milliseconds for the compressor to cease the compression effect after the audio signal falls below the threshold level. It affects the smoothness of the audio output.

inputs.name: makeup_gain
inputs.description: The gain in decibels to be applied after compression, compensating for any loss in volume due to the compression process.

outputs.name: audio
outputs.description: The compressed audio data, resulting from the application of the specified compression settings.

SaltAudio2VHS.description: The SaltAudio2VHS node is designed to transform audio inputs into a format reminiscent of VHS audio quality, providing a unique auditory experience that emulates the characteristics of vintage video cassette sound.

inputs.name: audio
inputs.description: The 'audio' input accepts audio data to be processed and converted into VHS audio format, playing a crucial role in determining the final output's quality and authenticity.

outputs.name: vhs_audio
outputs.description: The output 'vhs_audio' delivers the transformed audio in VHS format, offering a nostalgic audio experience with the distinct sound quality of a bygone era.

SaltAudioBandpassFilter.description: The SaltAudioBandpassFilter node applies a bandpass filter to an audio input, allowing frequencies within a specified range to pass through while attenuating frequencies outside this range. This process is useful for isolating specific frequency bands or reducing noise.

inputs.name: audio
inputs.description: The raw audio data to be processed. This input is crucial for defining the audio content that will undergo bandpass filtering.

inputs.name: low_cutoff_frequency
inputs.description: The lower frequency limit of the bandpass filter. Frequencies below this threshold will be attenuated, helping to isolate the desired frequency band.

inputs.name: high_cutoff_frequency
inputs.description: The upper frequency limit of the bandpass filter. Frequencies above this threshold will be attenuated, further refining the isolation of the desired frequency band.

outputs.name: audio
outputs.description: The processed audio data after the bandpass filter has been applied, with specified frequencies allowed to pass and others attenuated.

SaltAudioBassBoost.description: The SaltAudioBassBoost node enhances the bass frequencies of an audio input, allowing for a richer and deeper sound experience. It applies a low-pass filter and gain adjustment to boost the bass frequencies up to a specified cutoff frequency.

inputs.name: audio
inputs.description: The raw audio data to be processed. This input is crucial for determining the audio content that will undergo bass enhancement.

inputs.name: cutoff_freq
inputs.description: The frequency (in Hz) below which the audio's bass will be boosted. It defines the threshold for the low-pass filter, affecting the range of bass frequencies enhanced.

inputs.name: boost_dB
inputs.description: The amount of gain (in decibels) to apply to the bass frequencies. This determines the intensity of the bass boost effect.

outputs.name: audio
outputs.description: The processed audio data with enhanced bass frequencies.

SaltAudioCompressor.description: The SaltAudioCompressor node is designed to compress audio signals, reducing the dynamic range of the audio to ensure a more consistent volume level across the track. It utilizes parameters such as threshold, ratio, attack, and release times to control the compression effect, making it suitable for audio post-production and enhancement tasks.

inputs.name: audio
inputs.description: The raw audio data to be compressed. This input is crucial as it represents the audio signal that will undergo compression, directly influencing the output quality and characteristics.

inputs.name: threshold_dB
inputs.description: The threshold level in decibels (dB) above which compression is applied. This parameter determines the loudness level at which the compressor starts to reduce the gain, playing a key role in the dynamics control of the audio.

inputs.name: ratio
inputs.description: The compression ratio, indicating how much the audio signal is reduced once it crosses the threshold. It's essential for defining the intensity of the compression effect.

inputs.name: attack_ms
inputs.description: The attack time in milliseconds, specifying how quickly the compressor reacts to audio exceeding the threshold. It affects the compressor's responsiveness to sudden loudness changes.

inputs.name: release_ms
inputs.description: The release time in milliseconds, defining how quickly the compressor stops affecting the audio after it falls below the threshold. This parameter influences the smoothness of the volume level transitions.

outputs.name: audio
outputs.description: The compressed audio data, resulting from the application of dynamic range compression to the input audio. This output showcases the effect of the compression settings on the original audio signal.

SaltAudioDeesser.description: The SaltAudioDeesser node is designed to process audio files by applying a de-esser effect, which reduces or eliminates sibilance (harsh 's' or 'sh' sounds) from the audio. This is achieved through the use of command-line tools to dynamically adjust the intensity, amount, and frequency of the de-essing effect based on user inputs.

inputs.name: audio
inputs.description: The raw audio data to be processed. This input is crucial as it is the target for the de-esser effect, aiming to reduce sibilance without affecting the overall quality of the audio.

inputs.name: intensity
inputs.description: Defines the intensity of the de-esser effect. Higher values result in more aggressive sibilance reduction.

inputs.name: amount
inputs.description: Specifies the amount of sibilance reduction to apply. This controls how much of the detected sibilance is reduced.

inputs.name: frequency_keep
inputs.description: The frequency above which sibilance is reduced. This helps in preserving the desired frequencies while reducing unwanted sibilance.

outputs.name: audio
outputs.description: The audio data after the de-esser effect has been applied, with reduced sibilance.

SaltAudioFade.description: The SaltAudioFade node applies a fade-in or fade-out effect to an audio clip, based on specified parameters such as fade type, duration, and start time. This node is designed to manipulate the dynamics of an audio segment, enhancing its auditory transitions.

inputs.name: audio
inputs.description: The raw audio data to which the fade effect will be applied. This is the primary input for the fade operation.

inputs.name: fade_type
inputs.description: Specifies the type of fade effect to apply: 'in' for a fade-in effect, or 'out' for a fade-out effect. This determines the direction of the volume transition.

inputs.name: fade_duration
inputs.description: The duration of the fade effect in seconds. This defines how long the fade transition will last.

inputs.name: fade_start
inputs.description: The start time in seconds for the fade effect. This optional parameter allows for specifying when the fade effect should begin within the audio clip.

outputs.name: audio
outputs.description: The modified audio data with the applied fade effect. This output is suitable for further processing or playback.

SaltAudioFramesyncSchedule.description: This node is designed to synchronize audio with frame-based visual content, ensuring that audio events align precisely with specific frames in a video or animation sequence. It calculates and schedules audio keyframes based on various parameters such as amplitude control and frame rate, facilitating the creation of dynamic and responsive audiovisual experiences.

inputs.name: audio
inputs.description: The raw audio data to be processed. It is crucial for determining the synchronization points and dynamics of the audio in relation to the visual content.

inputs.name: amp_control
inputs.description: A parameter that influences the amplitude adjustments of the audio, affecting the overall loudness and dynamics of the synchronized output.

inputs.name: amp_offset
inputs.description: An offset value for the amplitude control, allowing for fine-tuning of the audio's loudness in relation to the visual content.

inputs.name: frame_rate
inputs.description: The frame rate of the visual content, essential for aligning audio events with the corresponding video frames.

inputs.name: start_frame
inputs.description: The starting frame from which the audio synchronization begins, enabling selective synchronization over specific segments.

inputs.name: end_frame
inputs.description: The ending frame at which the audio synchronization ends, allowing for precise control over the duration of the audiovisual alignment.

inputs.name: curves_mode
inputs.description: Specifies the mode of curve interpolation for easing the transitions between audio keyframes, enhancing the fluidity and naturalness of the audiovisual experience.

outputs.name: average_sum
outputs.description: A list of calculated loudness values for each frame, representing the synchronized audio dynamics over time.

outputs.name: frame_count
outputs.description: The total number of frames processed for synchronization, indicating the scope of the audiovisual alignment.

outputs.name: frame_rate
outputs.description: The frame rate used for the synchronization, reaffirming the temporal resolution of the audiovisual content.

SaltAudioFrequencyBoost.description: This node applies a frequency-specific boost to an audio file using an equalization filter. It enhances or attenuates a specified frequency range of the audio signal, allowing for precise audio frequency manipulation.

inputs.name: audio
inputs.description: The raw audio data to be processed. This input is crucial for applying the frequency boost effect to the audio content.

inputs.name: frequency
inputs.description: The center frequency to boost, around which the equalization filter is applied. This parameter determines the specific frequency range that will be enhanced or attenuated.

inputs.name: bandwidth
inputs.description: Defines the width of the frequency range around the center frequency that will be affected by the boost. It allows for control over how broad or narrow the boosted frequency range is.

inputs.name: gain_dB
inputs.description: The amount of gain (in decibels) to apply to the specified frequency range. This determines the intensity of the boost effect.

outputs.name: audio
outputs.description: The modified audio data after the frequency boost has been applied. It reflects the changes made to the audio's frequency spectrum.

SaltAudioFrequencyCutoff.description: This node applies a frequency cutoff to an audio file, using a specified filter type and cutoff frequency. It leverages FFmpeg to modify the audio signal, either attenuating or completely removing frequencies beyond the specified cutoff point, depending on the filter type used.

inputs.name: audio
inputs.description: The raw audio data to be processed. This input is crucial as it represents the audio signal that will undergo the frequency cutoff operation.

inputs.name: filter_type
inputs.description: Specifies the type of filter to apply for the frequency cutoff, such as low-pass or high-pass, which determines how frequencies above or below the cutoff point are affected.

inputs.name: cutoff_frequency
inputs.description: The frequency threshold at which the audio signal will be cut off. Frequencies beyond this point will be attenuated or removed, depending on the filter type.

outputs.name: audio
outputs.description: The modified audio data after the frequency cutoff has been applied, with certain frequencies attenuated or removed based on the filter type and cutoff frequency.

SaltAudioInversion.description: The node is designed to invert the waveform of an audio file, effectively flipping its phase. This process can be used to create unique sound effects or to cancel out specific audio components when mixed with the original.

inputs.name: audio
inputs.description: The audio input is the raw audio data that will be inverted. This process alters the audio's waveform by reversing its phase, which can be useful for sound design or audio correction purposes.

outputs.name: audio
outputs.description: The output is the inverted audio data, with its waveform phase reversed from the original input. This can be used for creative audio effects or technical audio manipulation.

SaltAudioLDM2LoadModel.description: This node is designed to load a specific audio latent diffusion model (AudioLDM2) into memory, making it ready for audio processing tasks. It supports loading different versions of the model and allows specifying the computational device (CPU or GPU) for the model's operations.

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: Specifies the version of the AudioLDM2 model to load. The choice of model can significantly impact the quality and characteristics of the generated audio.

inputs.name: device
inputs.description: Determines the computational device ('cuda' for GPU or 'cpu' for CPU) on which the model will be loaded and executed, affecting performance and efficiency.

outputs.name: audioldm2_model
outputs.description: The loaded AudioLDM2 model, ready for audio processing tasks.

SaltAudioLDM2Sampler.description: This node is designed for sampling audio using the LDM2 model, providing a specialized approach to generating or processing audio data with advanced machine learning techniques. It focuses on leveraging the capabilities of the LDM2 architecture to offer high-quality audio sampling functionalities.

inputs.name: audioldm2_model
inputs.description: Specifies the LDM2 model to be used for audio sampling, influencing the quality and characteristics of the generated audio.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.description: Determines the random seed for generating audio, ensuring reproducibility of results.

inputs.name: steps
inputs.description: Defines the number of steps to be used in the sampling process, affecting the detail and quality of the output audio.

inputs.name: guidance_scale
inputs.description: Controls the strength of the conditioning on the input prompts, influencing the adherence to the specified prompts.

inputs.name: audio_length_seconds
inputs.description: Sets the length of the generated audio in seconds.

inputs.name: num_waveforms
inputs.description: Determines the number of audio waveforms to generate.

inputs.name: positive_prompt
inputs.description: The text prompt that encourages certain elements or themes in the generated audio.

inputs.name: negative_prompt
inputs.description: The text prompt that discourages certain elements or themes in the generated audio.

outputs.name: audio
outputs.description: The sampled audio output, generated based on the specified inputs and model.

SaltAudioMixer.description: The SaltAudioMixer node is designed for blending two audio streams into a single output by overlaying one audio stream onto another at a specified mix time. This functionality is essential for creating composite audio tracks or for audio editing purposes where multiple sounds need to be combined.

inputs.name: audio_a
inputs.description: The first audio stream to be mixed. It serves as the base layer onto which the second audio stream will be overlaid.

inputs.name: audio_b
inputs.description: The second audio stream to be mixed. It is overlaid onto the first audio stream at the specified mix time.

inputs.name: mix_time_seconds
inputs.description: The time, in seconds, at which the second audio stream is to be overlaid onto the first. This determines the starting point of the overlay in the resulting mixed audio.

outputs.name: mixed_audio
outputs.description: The resulting audio stream after mixing the two input streams. It represents the composite audio track created by overlaying the second audio stream onto the first at the specified mix time.

SaltAudioNoiseReductionSpectralSubtracti.description: This node is designed to reduce noise in audio files using spectral subtraction. It aims to enhance audio clarity by removing unwanted noise, making it suitable for improving the quality of recordings or audio tracks.

inputs.name: audio
inputs.description: The raw audio data to be processed. It serves as the primary input for noise reduction.

inputs.name: noise_floor
inputs.description: A parameter to adjust the intensity of noise reduction. Lower values mean less noise reduction, while higher values increase the noise reduction effect.

outputs.name: audio
outputs.description: The processed audio data with reduced noise.

SaltAudioNormalize.description: The SaltAudioNormalize node is designed to normalize audio files, adjusting their volume levels to a consistent amplitude. This process enhances the audio quality by ensuring that the sound is neither too loud nor too soft, making it ideal for preparing audio for further processing or playback.

inputs.name: audio
inputs.description: The 'audio' input is the raw audio data that needs normalization. It is crucial for the node's operation as it directly influences the outcome of the normalization process.

outputs.name: audio
outputs.description: The 'audio' output is the normalized version of the input audio. It represents the result of the normalization process, with adjusted volume levels for consistent amplitude.

SaltAudioPitchShift.description: This node applies a pitch shift to an audio input by a specified number of semitones, allowing for audio manipulation that can adjust the pitch without altering the playback speed.

inputs.name: audio
inputs.description: The raw audio data to be pitch-shifted. This input is crucial for determining the source audio material on which the pitch shift effect will be applied.

inputs.name: semitones
inputs.description: The number of semitones by which the audio's pitch is to be shifted. This parameter directly influences the pitch alteration, with positive values raising the pitch and negative values lowering it.

outputs.name: audio
outputs.description: The pitch-shifted audio data, resulting from the application of the specified semitone shift to the input audio.

SaltAudioPitchShiftScheduled.description: This node is designed for applying a scheduled pitch shift to audio data. It allows for dynamic adjustments to the pitch over time, based on a predefined schedule, enabling more complex and nuanced audio transformations than a static pitch shift.

inputs.name: audio
inputs.description: The audio data to be processed. It is the primary input for pitch shifting operations, determining the raw sound material to be modified.

inputs.name: schedule
inputs.description: A list or array defining the pitch shift values over time. This schedule dictates how the pitch is altered throughout the audio, allowing for dynamic and varied pitch changes.

inputs.name: interpolate
inputs.description: A boolean flag indicating whether to interpolate between scheduled pitch values for smoother transitions or to apply them directly as discrete steps.

outputs.name: audio
outputs.description: The resulting audio data after applying the scheduled pitch shifts. It reflects the dynamic pitch adjustments made according to the input schedule.

SaltAudioPlaybackRate.description: This node is designed to adjust the playback speed of an audio file. It allows users to increase or decrease the speed of audio playback without altering the pitch, providing a versatile tool for audio editing and manipulation.

inputs.name: audio
inputs.description: The audio input is the raw audio data that the node will process to adjust its playback speed. It serves as the primary content for speed adjustment.

inputs.name: speed_factor
inputs.description: The speed factor determines the rate at which the audio playback speed is adjusted. A value greater than 1 speeds up the playback, while a value less than 1 slows it down, offering precise control over the audio's tempo.

outputs.name: audio
outputs.description: The output is the modified audio data with the adjusted playback speed. It retains the original audio's pitch while altering its tempo.

SaltAudioRepeat.description: The SaltAudioRepeat node is designed for repeating an audio segment a specified number of times. It enables the creation of looped audio effects by duplicating the input audio according to the user-defined repetition count.

inputs.name: audio
inputs.description: The 'audio' parameter is the raw audio data to be looped. It is essential for determining the base audio content that will be repeated.

inputs.name: repeat_times
inputs.description: The 'repeat_times' parameter specifies how many times the audio should be looped. It directly influences the length and content of the output audio.

outputs.name: audio
outputs.description: The output is the looped audio, which is the result of repeating the input audio segment for the specified number of times.

SaltAudioSimpleEcho.description: The SaltAudioSimpleEcho node applies an echo effect to audio inputs, allowing for the creation of layered audio experiences by repeating the audio signal multiple times with a specified delay and decay factor.

inputs.name: audio
inputs.description: The raw audio data to which the echo effect will be applied. This is the primary input for the echo processing.

inputs.name: times
inputs.description: Specifies the number of times the audio will be echoed, affecting the density of the echo effect.

inputs.name: delay_ms
inputs.description: The delay in milliseconds between each echo, determining the temporal spacing of the echoes.

inputs.name: decay_factor
inputs.description: The factor by which the volume of each successive echo decreases, controlling the fade-out effect of the echoes.

outputs.name: audio
outputs.description: The processed audio data with the echo effect applied.

SaltAudioSimpleReverb.description: This node applies a simple reverb effect to an audio input, simulating the sound reflection and decay characteristics of a physical space. It allows for the adjustment of the reverb level and decay time to tailor the effect.

inputs.name: audio
inputs.description: The raw audio data to which the reverb effect will be applied. This input is crucial for defining the base sound that will be processed.

inputs.name: reverb_level
inputs.description: Specifies the intensity of the reverb effect. A higher value results in a more pronounced reverb, simulating a larger or more reflective space.

inputs.name: decay
inputs.description: Determines the rate at which the reverb effect fades away. A higher decay value simulates a longer echo, as if the sound is reflecting off distant surfaces.

outputs.name: audio
outputs.description: The processed audio data with the reverb effect applied, reflecting the adjustments made through the input parameters.

SaltAudioStereoMerge.description: This node merges two mono audio inputs into a single stereo audio output, ensuring that each input occupies one channel of the stereo output. It is designed to work with audio files in WAV format, automatically adjusting the channels of the inputs to mono if necessary and aligning their lengths before merging.

inputs.name: audio_a
inputs.description: The first mono audio input to be merged into the stereo output. It occupies the left channel of the resulting stereo audio.

inputs.name: audio_b
inputs.description: The second mono audio input to be merged into the stereo output. It occupies the right channel of the resulting stereo audio.

outputs.name: audio
outputs.description: The resulting stereo audio output, with the first input occupying the left channel and the second input occupying the right channel.

SaltAudioStereoSplitter.description: This node is designed to split a stereo audio file into two separate mono audio files, one for each channel. It ensures that audio input is in stereo format and divides it into left and right channels, providing a straightforward way to work with audio channels individually.

inputs.name: audio
inputs.description: The stereo audio input that will be split into two mono channels. It is essential for processing and must be in stereo format to ensure proper splitting.

outputs.name: left_channel_mono
outputs.description: The left channel of the input stereo audio, processed and returned as a mono audio file.

outputs.name: right_channel_mono
outputs.description: The right channel of the input stereo audio, processed and returned as a mono audio file.

SaltAudioStitcher.description: The SaltAudioStitcher node is designed to seamlessly combine two audio files into a single audio track. It allows for the insertion of a silent transition between the two audio segments, providing flexibility in creating continuous audio experiences from separate sources.

inputs.name: audio_a
inputs.description: The first audio file to be stitched. It serves as the starting point of the combined audio track.

inputs.name: audio_b
