GenerateCategoryName.description: This node is designed to generate a marketable and specific name for a product category based on provided product descriptions and an existing product category tree. It analyzes common themes, attributes, or characteristics from the descriptions to ideate and select a category name that is clear, specific, and appealing to customers.

inputs.name: captions
inputs.description: Captions are textual descriptions of products that serve as the basis for identifying common themes and characteristics to generate a category name. They play a crucial role in the ideation process by providing the content for analysis.

inputs.name: llm
inputs.description: The language model used to assist in generating category names by analyzing the provided captions and existing category tree for insights and suggestions.

inputs.name: existing_tree
inputs.description: The current structure of product categories, which is considered during the generation process to ensure the new category name fits within the existing hierarchy and does not duplicate or conflict with current categories.

outputs.name: category_name
outputs.description: The generated name for the product category, selected for its clarity, specificity, and marketability based on the analysis of product descriptions and the existing category tree.

GetCategoryByIndex.description: The GetCategoryByIndex node is designed to filter and retrieve specific categories of data based on a given index. It operates by selecting subsets of features and captions that match the specified index, effectively isolating a particular category from a larger dataset.

inputs.name: id
inputs.description: The 'id' parameter specifies the index of the category to be retrieved. It determines which category's features and captions are selected, playing a crucial role in the node's operation by filtering the dataset according to this index.

inputs.name: features
inputs.description: The 'features' parameter represents the numerical data or attributes associated with each item in the dataset. It is essential for identifying and isolating the category corresponding to the given index.

inputs.name: captions
inputs.description: The 'captions' parameter consists of textual descriptions or titles associated with each item in the dataset. It is used alongside 'id' and 'features' to select and return the relevant captions for the specified category.

inputs.name: labels
inputs.description: The 'labels' parameter contains the indices or identifiers for each category within the dataset. It is used to match the 'id' parameter and filter the dataset to retrieve the specified category's data.

outputs.name: features
outputs.description: Returns the filtered features corresponding to the specified category index, isolating a subset of the dataset's numerical attributes.

outputs.name: captions
outputs.description: Returns the filtered captions corresponding to the specified category index, providing textual descriptions for the isolated subset of items.

ReadCaptions.description: The ReadCaptions node is designed to extract captions from a specified JSON file, focusing on parsing and aggregating caption data related to various categories within the file. This node plays a crucial role in processing and preparing textual data for further analysis or processing steps, such as clustering or generating new content based on the extracted captions.

inputs.name: file_path
inputs.description: Specifies the path to the JSON file containing captions. This input is essential for locating and reading the file to extract captions, directly influencing the node's ability to perform its primary function.

outputs.name: captions
outputs.description: A list of captions extracted and aggregated from the specified JSON file. This output is crucial for downstream tasks that require textual data for analysis, processing, or generation.

ReadPreprocessedFeatures.description: This node is designed to read preprocessed feature data from a specified file path, loading it into a numpy array format for further processing or analysis.

inputs.name: file_path
inputs.description: Specifies the path to the file containing the preprocessed features. This path is essential for locating and loading the data correctly.

outputs.name: features
outputs.description: Outputs the preprocessed features loaded from the file as a numpy array, ready for use in subsequent processing steps.

SaltAppendStringList.description: The SaltAppendStringList node is designed to extend a list of strings by appending a new string to it. This functionality is essential for dynamically growing lists in applications that require concatenation or accumulation of string data.

inputs.name: string_list
inputs.description: The list of strings to which a new string will be appended. It serves as the base list that will be modified by adding another string to its end.

inputs.name: string_input
inputs.description: The string to be appended to the list. This parameter represents the new data being added to the existing list of strings.

outputs.name: updated_list
outputs.description: The list of strings after the specified string has been appended to it. This reflects the updated state of the list, showcasing the addition of new string data.

SaltBase64EncodeImages.description: The `SaltBase64EncodeImages` node is designed to convert a collection of images, either passed directly as tensors or specified via file paths or URLs, into their Base64-encoded string representations. This process involves resizing the images to specified dimensions and encoding them, facilitating their use in environments where binary image data needs to be embedded or transmitted in text form.

inputs.name: width
inputs.description: Specifies the desired width to which the images should be resized. This parameter plays a crucial role in determining the final dimensions of the encoded images, affecting their appearance and size.

inputs.name: height
inputs.description: Determines the desired height for the image resizing process. Similar to width, it significantly influences the encoded images' dimensions and visual quality.

inputs.name: images
inputs.description: An optional tensor containing images to be encoded. When provided, it bypasses the need for loading images from paths or URLs, directly converting the tensor images to Base64 strings.

inputs.name: paths_or_urls
inputs.description: A string containing either file paths or URLs, separated by newlines, from which images will be loaded, resized, and encoded. This allows for flexible sourcing of images from local storage or the web.

outputs.name: base64_images
outputs.description: A list of strings, each representing a Base64-encoded image. This output facilitates the embedding or transmission of images in environments where binary data is not supported.

SaltCreateStringList.description: This node is designed to create a list containing a single string element. It serves as a utility for initializing a list structure with a specified string, facilitating operations that require list input formats.

inputs.name: string_input
inputs.description: The string to be initialized into a list. This parameter is crucial for defining the sole element of the newly created list, setting the foundation for further list-based manipulations.

outputs.name: string_list
outputs.description: The output is a list containing the initial string input as its only element. This list is ready for further processing or manipulation in subsequent operations.

SaltFilterJSON.description: The SaltFilterJSON node is designed to filter elements from a JSON array based on a specified condition. It evaluates each element against a given key-value pair and returns a new JSON array containing only those elements that match the condition.

inputs.name: json_input
inputs.description: The JSON string input that represents an array of objects. It is the primary data source for the filtering operation.

inputs.name: condition_key
inputs.description: The key to be checked within each object of the JSON array. It determines the field against which the condition is applied.

inputs.name: condition_value
inputs.description: The value that the specified key's value must match for an object to be included in the filtered output.

outputs.name: json_output
outputs.description: The output is a JSON string representing an array of objects that meet the specified condition.

SaltFlattenJSON.description: The SaltFlattenJSON node is designed to transform nested JSON structures into a flat dictionary format, where nested keys are combined into single keys separated by underscores. This simplification process aids in the easier handling and processing of complex JSON data by reducing its hierarchical depth.

inputs.name: json_input
inputs.description: The JSON input that needs to be flattened. This parameter is crucial as it directly influences the node's ability to simplify complex JSON structures into a more manageable form.

outputs.name: json_output
outputs.description: The output of the node is a JSON string that represents the original JSON input in a flattened format. This makes the data easier to work with in environments that may not support deeply nested structures.

SaltGeneralJSONAPI.description: The SaltGeneralJSONAPI node is designed to facilitate the creation and handling of JSON-based requests for general APIs. It abstracts the complexities involved in preparing requests, including sanitization, handling files, and setting headers, thereby streamlining the process of interacting with various web services through a unified interface.

inputs.name: preset
inputs.description: A preset configuration for the API request, allowing for predefined settings to be applied automatically.

inputs.name: api_base
inputs.description: The base URL for the API request, serving as the foundation to which endpoint paths and parameters are appended.

inputs.name: optional_user_agent
inputs.description: An optional user agent string to be included in the request headers, identifying the client to the server.

inputs.name: optional_api_key
inputs.description: An optional API key for authentication, included in the request headers to access restricted endpoints or features.

inputs.name: request
inputs.description: The JSON-formatted string representing the request to be sent. It is sanitized and placeholders are replaced with actual values before sending, ensuring that the request is properly formatted and contains all necessary information.

inputs.name: a
inputs.description: A wildcard placeholder for dynamic content that can be included in the request, offering flexibility in the request composition.

inputs.name: b
inputs.description: A wildcard placeholder for dynamic content, potentially representing images or other binary data, to be included in the request.

inputs.name: c
inputs.description: A wildcard placeholder for additional dynamic content, enhancing the request's flexibility and customization.

inputs.name: d
inputs.description: A wildcard placeholder for further dynamic content, allowing for a wide range of data to be included in the request.

inputs.name: e
inputs.description: A wildcard placeholder for extra dynamic content, ensuring maximum flexibility in the request's composition.

outputs.name: response
outputs.description: The raw response from the API, encapsulating the outcome of the request.

outputs.name: json
outputs.description: The JSON-parsed response, providing structured access to the data returned by the API.

SaltJSONFormat.description: The SaltJSONFormat node is designed to reformat JSON data according to specified formatting options such as indentation, width, depth, compactness, and dictionary sorting. This node aims to enhance readability or compactness of JSON data for better handling and visualization.

inputs.name: json_input
inputs.description: The raw JSON string that needs to be reformatted. It is essential for defining the structure and content of the data to be processed.

inputs.name: indent
inputs.description: Specifies the number of spaces to use for indentation in the formatted JSON, allowing customization of the visual structure.

inputs.name: width
inputs.description: Sets the maximum width of each line in the formatted JSON, controlling line breaks for readability.

inputs.name: depth
inputs.description: Determines the maximum depth to which the JSON will be formatted, affecting the visibility of nested structures.

inputs.name: compact
inputs.description: A boolean flag that, when true, minimizes the use of whitespace in the formatted JSON to produce a more compact output.

inputs.name: sort_dicts
inputs.description: Controls whether dictionaries within the JSON are sorted by key, aiding in consistent and organized output.

outputs.name: json_output
outputs.description: The reformatted JSON string, which has been adjusted according to the input parameters for improved structure and readability.

SaltJSONKeysToList.description: This node is designed to extract the keys from a JSON object and provide them as both a list and a concatenated string. It serves the purpose of enabling users to easily access and manipulate the structure of JSON data by focusing on its keys.

inputs.name: json_input
inputs.description: The JSON input as a string. It is required to be a valid JSON object (dictionary) for the operation to proceed. This input is crucial as it determines the keys that will be extracted and returned in the output.

outputs.name: keys
outputs.description: A list of keys extracted from the input JSON object.

outputs.name: keys_list
outputs.description: A string representation of the keys extracted from the input JSON object, concatenated and separated by newlines.

SaltJSONListToStringList.description: This node is designed to convert a JSON list into a list of strings, ensuring that the input JSON is properly formatted and is indeed a list before proceeding with the conversion.

inputs.name: json_input
inputs.description: The JSON input that needs to be converted into a list of strings. It must be a valid JSON string representing a list.

outputs.name: strings
outputs.description: The output list of strings converted from the input JSON list.

SaltJSONPop.description: The SaltJSONPop node is designed to selectively remove specified keys from a JSON structure. It can operate recursively, allowing for the deletion of keys not only at the root level but also deeply nested within the JSON object. This functionality is particularly useful for cleaning or modifying JSON data by removing unnecessary, sensitive, or redundant information.

inputs.name: json_input
inputs.description: The JSON string from which keys will be removed. This input is crucial as it defines the structure and content that will be manipulated.

inputs.name: key
inputs.description: The name of the key(s) to be removed from the JSON input. This parameter determines which parts of the JSON structure will be targeted for deletion.

inputs.name: max_occurrences
inputs.description: Defines the maximum number of occurrences of the specified key to remove. If set to -1, there is no limit, allowing for the removal of all instances of the key.

outputs.name: json_output
outputs.description: The modified JSON string after the specified keys have been removed. This output reflects the changes made to the original JSON structure.

SaltJSONSelectNthItems.description: This node is designed to select a specified number of items starting from a given index within a JSON object. It aims to facilitate the extraction of specific portions of JSON data based on positional selection, making it easier to work with subsets of JSON structures.

inputs.name: json_input
inputs.description: The JSON string from which items will be selected. It is crucial as it provides the data that the node operates on, determining the scope of selection.

inputs.name: start_index
inputs.description: The starting index from which items will be selected. It defines the beginning of the selection range within the JSON object.

inputs.name: count
inputs.description: The number of items to be selected starting from the start_index. It specifies the size of the subset to be extracted from the JSON object.

outputs.name: selection
outputs.description: The JSON string representing the selected items. It is the result of extracting a subset of items from the input JSON based on the specified start index and count.

SaltJSONToList.description: Converts a JSON string into a list of its innermost values, providing both a string representation and the actual list of these values. This node is designed to extract and present the deepest nested values found within a JSON structure, making them accessible for further processing or analysis.

inputs.name: json_input
inputs.description: The JSON string to be processed. This input is crucial as it provides the raw data from which innermost values are extracted, directly influencing the output list and its string representation.

outputs.name: values
outputs.description: A string representation of the list containing the innermost values extracted from the JSON input.

outputs.name: values_list
outputs.description: The actual list of innermost values extracted from the JSON input.

SaltJSONValuesToList.description: This node is designed to extract the values from a JSON object and provide them in two formats: as a list and as a string with each value separated by a newline. It ensures that the input JSON is properly formatted and is a dictionary before proceeding with the extraction.

inputs.name: json_input
inputs.description: The JSON string input from which values are to be extracted. It must be a well-formed JSON dictionary. This input is crucial for the node's operation as it determines the source of the values to be processed.

outputs.name: values
outputs.description: A list of values extracted from the input JSON dictionary.

outputs.name: values_list
outputs.description: A string representation of the values extracted from the input JSON, separated by newlines.

SaltLoadDirectoryAsJSON.description: This node is designed to compile files from a specified directory into a single JSON object. It reads each file within the directory, assuming they are in JSON format, and combines them into a unified JSON structure. The method of combination can vary based on the mode specified, such as using filenames as keys, which allows for a structured and accessible way to handle multiple JSON files collectively.

inputs.name: path
inputs.description: Specifies the path to the directory containing the JSON files to be compiled. This path is crucial as it determines the source of the JSON files that will be processed and combined.

inputs.name: mode
inputs.description: Determines the method used to compile the JSON files into a single JSON object. For example, using filenames as keys to associate each file's content with its name in the resulting JSON structure.

inputs.name: reverse_order
inputs.description: A boolean flag indicating whether the files should be processed in reverse order. This can affect the final structure of the compiled JSON, especially if the order of files is significant.

outputs.name: json_output
outputs.description: The resulting JSON object after compiling the files from the specified directory. It represents a unified structure containing the contents of all processed files.

SaltLoadFileByIndexOrName.description: This node is designed to load a file's content based on either its index within a directory or its name. It streamlines the process of retrieving file data, making it accessible for further processing or analysis.

inputs.name: path
inputs.description: Specifies the path to the directory containing the file to be loaded. It is crucial for locating the target file within the filesystem.

inputs.name: file_identifier
inputs.description: Acts as a unique identifier for the file to be loaded, which can be either the file's name or its index within the specified directory. This flexibility allows for easy reference to files without needing to know their exact names.

outputs.name: file_content
outputs.description: The content of the loaded file, returned as a string. This output makes the file's data readily available for use in subsequent operations.

SaltLoadTextFile.description: This node is designed to load the contents of a text file into the system. It focuses on reading and importing text data from a specified file path, making it accessible for further processing or analysis within the application.

inputs.name: file_path
inputs.description: Specifies the file path of the text file to be loaded. This path is essential for locating and accessing the file for reading.

outputs.name: file_content
outputs.description: The content of the loaded text file. This output makes the text data available for use within the application.

outputs.name: file_log
outputs.description: Provides a log message related to the file loading process, including information on mime type determination or errors encountered.

SaltMergeJSON.description: The SaltMergeJSON node is designed to merge two JSON strings into a single JSON string, effectively combining their contents. This node is particularly useful in scenarios where integrating data from multiple JSON sources is required.

inputs.name: json_input1
inputs.description: The first JSON string to be merged. It plays a crucial role in the merging process as it forms the base onto which the second JSON string's contents are added.

inputs.name: json_input2
inputs.description: The second JSON string to be merged with the first. Its contents are added to those of the first JSON string, contributing to the creation of the merged JSON output.

outputs.name: json_output
outputs.description: The resulting JSON string after merging the contents of the two input JSON strings. It represents the combined data structure.

SaltSaveTextFile.description: This node is designed to save textual content to a file or multiple files within a newly created directory. It supports specifying file names, extensions, and content, handling both single and multiple content inputs. The node ensures the creation of a unique directory for file storage, validating file extensions against supported types, and provides error handling for file creation and saving processes.

inputs.name: filename_prefix
inputs.description: Specifies the prefix for the file name(s) to be saved. This prefix is used as the base name for the file or files, with indexes appended for multiple contents.

inputs.name: file_extension
inputs.description: Defines the file extension for the saved file(s). This extension indicates the file type and is validated against a list of supported types to ensure compatibility.

inputs.name: file_content
inputs.description: The content to be saved into a single file. This parameter allows for saving a specific piece of text content directly to a file.

inputs.name: file_contents_input
inputs.description: A list of text contents to be saved into multiple files. Each content in the list is saved to a separate file, with filenames generated based on the filename prefix and index.

outputs.name: file_paths
outputs.description: A list of paths to the saved files. This includes the complete path for each file created during the node's execution.

outputs.name: directory_path
outputs.description: The path to the directory where all files are saved. This directory is uniquely generated for each execution of the node.

SaltSelectFromJSON.description: This node is designed to select a specific item from a JSON structure based on a given JSON path and match index. It allows for precise extraction of data from complex JSON inputs, facilitating targeted data retrieval and manipulation.

inputs.name: json_input
inputs.description: The JSON string from which data will be selected. It serves as the primary data source for the selection process.

inputs.name: json_path
inputs.description: The JSONPath expression used to specify the item to be selected from the JSON input. It defines the path to the target data within the JSON structure.

inputs.name: match_index
inputs.description: The index of the match to be selected when multiple items match the JSONPath expression. It determines which item is chosen if the path yields more than one result.

outputs.name: selection
outputs.description: The selected item from the JSON input, returned as a JSON string. It represents the outcome of the selection process based on the provided path and index.

SaltSelectFromStringList.description: The `SaltSelectFromStringList` node enables the selection of an element from a list of strings based on a specified index. It abstracts the process of indexing into lists, providing a straightforward way to retrieve specific elements, and includes handling for out-of-range indices.

inputs.name: list_input
inputs.description: Represents the list of strings from which an element will be selected. It is crucial for determining the scope of selection.

inputs.name: index
inputs.description: Specifies the position in the list from which to select the element. It determines the exact element to be retrieved from the list.

outputs.name: selection
outputs.description: The selected string from the input list, based on the provided index.

SaltSortJSON.description: This node sorts a list of dictionaries contained within a JSON string based on a specified key and order. It is designed to organize JSON data in a more readable or structured format, facilitating easier data manipulation and analysis.

inputs.name: json_input
inputs.description: The JSON string input that contains a list of dictionaries to be sorted. It is essential for specifying the data to be organized.

inputs.name: sort_key
inputs.description: The key within the dictionaries to sort the list by. This key determines the order of the sorted data.

inputs.name: reverse
inputs.description: A boolean flag that specifies the sorting order. When true, the list is sorted in descending order; otherwise, it's sorted in ascending order.

outputs.name: json_output
outputs.description: The sorted JSON string output, providing a structured representation of the input data after sorting.

SaltSplitByNewline.description: The node splits a given text into a list of strings based on newline characters, optionally stripping whitespace and ignoring lines that start with common comment symbols (#, //).

inputs.name: text
inputs.description: The text to be split into lines. This input allows for the processing of multiline text, enabling the node to operate on extensive or compact text data.

inputs.name: strip_text
inputs.description: A boolean flag that determines whether whitespace should be stripped from the beginning and end of each line, as well as ignoring lines that start with comment symbols.

outputs.name: list
outputs.description: A list of strings derived from the input text, split based on newline characters and optionally processed according to the strip_text parameter.

outputs.name: strings
outputs.description: A duplicate of the list output, provided for compatibility or further processing needs.

SaltStringPathBasename.description: This node extracts the basename (the final component of a file path) from a given file path string. It simplifies file path manipulation by isolating the most specific part of the path, such as the file name and extension, from a complete path.

inputs.name: file_path
inputs.description: The complete file path from which the basename is to be extracted. This input is crucial for determining the specific file or directory name at the end of the path.

outputs.name: path_basename
outputs.description: The basename of the provided file path, which is the file name and extension or the final directory name in the path.

SaltStringPathDirname.description: This node extracts the directory path from a given file path, effectively isolating the portion of the path that specifies the directory containing the file. It serves to simplify file path manipulation by providing a straightforward method to obtain the directory component.

inputs.name: file_path
inputs.description: The file path from which the directory name is to be extracted. This input is crucial for determining the specific directory location within a filesystem.

outputs.name: path_directory
outputs.description: The directory portion of the provided file path, which specifies the location of the file within the filesystem.

SaltUpdateJSON.description: The SaltUpdateJSON node is designed to update specific values within a JSON structure based on a given key. It recursively searches through the JSON, updating all instances of the key with a new value, thereby allowing for comprehensive modifications of nested JSON objects.

inputs.name: json_input
inputs.description: The JSON string to be updated. It serves as the base structure for modifications, where specific values associated with a given key are targeted for updates.

inputs.name: key
inputs.description: The key whose associated values are to be updated across the JSON structure. It acts as the identifier for locating and modifying specific data points within the JSON.

inputs.name: new_value
inputs.description: The new value to replace existing values associated with the specified key within the JSON structure. This allows for dynamic updates to the JSON's content.

outputs.name: json_output
outputs.description: The updated JSON string, reflecting the changes made to values associated with the specified key. It represents the final state of the JSON after applying the updates.

SaltValidateJSON.description: The SaltValidateJSON node is designed to validate JSON input against a specified JSON schema. It checks if the given JSON data adheres to the structure and data types defined in the schema, providing a boolean validity status and an error message if applicable.

inputs.name: json_input
inputs.description: The JSON string to be validated. It is essential for determining if the input JSON matches the specified schema.

inputs.name: json_schema
inputs.description: The JSON schema string against which the input JSON will be validated. This schema defines the expected structure, constraints, and types of the input JSON.

outputs.name: is_valid
outputs.description: A boolean indicating whether the input JSON is valid according to the specified schema.

outputs.name: error_message
outputs.description: A string containing the error message if the validation fails, otherwise an empty string.

AddAgentToList.description: The `AddAgentToList` node is designed to add a specified agent to an existing list of agents, facilitating dynamic management of agent collections within a chat or agent-based system.

inputs.name: agent
inputs.description: The `agent` parameter represents the individual agent to be added to the list. It is crucial for expanding the agent list dynamically.

inputs.name: agents
inputs.description: The `agents` parameter is the current list of agents to which the new agent will be added. It serves as the foundation for dynamically managing agent collections.

outputs.name: agents
outputs.description: Returns the updated list of agents after adding the specified agent, reflecting the new state of the agent collection.

AddTool.description: Facilitates the dynamic addition of tools to conversational agents by cloning and registering functions within these agents. This process enhances the agents' capabilities, allowing them to perform additional tasks as specified by the tool being added.

inputs.name: tool
inputs.description: Represents the tool to be added, including its function, name, and description. This parameter is crucial for defining the new capabilities to be integrated into the agent.

inputs.name: assistant
inputs.description: The conversational agent to which the tool will be added. This agent is cloned to ensure modifications do not affect the original instance.

inputs.name: executor
inputs.description: An optional agent responsible for executing the tool's function. If not provided, the assistant itself is used as the executor.

outputs.name: assistant
outputs.description: The modified conversational agent with the new tool added.

outputs.name: executor
outputs.description: The agent designated to execute the added tool's function, which may be the same as the assistant if no executor is specified.

ChangeSystemMessage.description: This node is designed to modify the system message within an agent, allowing for dynamic updates to the agent's instructions or behavior based on new system messages.

inputs.name: agent
inputs.description: Represents the agent whose system message is to be updated, serving as the primary entity for modification.

inputs.name: system_message
inputs.description: The new system message to be set for the agent, enabling customization of the agent's instructions or behavior.

outputs.name: agent
outputs.description: The updated agent with the new system message applied, reflecting the changes in instructions or behavior.

ClearMemory.description: The ClearMemory node is designed to reset or clear the memory of a specified agent, potentially targeting a specific recipient within its memory scope. This functionality is crucial for managing and refreshing the state of conversational agents, ensuring they can operate without the burden of outdated or irrelevant conversational history.

inputs.name: agent
inputs.description: The 'agent' parameter represents the conversational agent whose memory is to be cleared. This is essential for resetting the agent's state or context to ensure it can handle new interactions effectively.

outputs.name: agent
outputs.description: Returns the agent with its memory cleared or reset, ready for new interactions. This ensures the agent can operate with a fresh state, free from the constraints of its prior conversational history.

ConversableAgentCreator.description: This node is designed to facilitate the creation of conversable agents, which are AI entities capable of engaging in dialogue based on a predefined system message. It abstracts the complexities of configuring such agents, allowing users to specify basic parameters like the agent's name and its operational message, optionally integrating a language model for enhanced interaction capabilities.

inputs.name: name
inputs.description: Specifies the name of the conversable agent to be created, serving as a unique identifier and a way to reference the agent in interactions.

inputs.name: system_message
inputs.description: Defines the initial message or instruction that the agent will use to guide its interactions, setting the tone and scope of its conversational abilities.

inputs.name: llm_model
inputs.description: An optional parameter that allows for the integration of a language learning model to enhance the agent's conversational capabilities, providing a more dynamic and responsive interaction experience.

outputs.name: agent
outputs.description: The created conversable agent, ready to be utilized for engaging in dialogues and performing tasks as defined by its configuration.

ConversableAgentCreatorAdvanced.description: This node facilitates the advanced creation of conversable agents, allowing for the customization of agent attributes such as name, system message, and optional parameters like LLM model, default auto-reply, and a description. It's designed to enable the creation of sophisticated conversational AI agents that can interact with users, process document QA tasks, and provide automated responses.

inputs.name: name
inputs.description: The name of the conversable agent being created. It serves as a unique identifier and a way to reference the agent in interactions.

inputs.name: system_message
inputs.description: A system message that defines the agent's initial instructions or guidelines, setting the context for its operation.

inputs.name: llm_model
inputs.description: An optional parameter specifying the language learning model to be used by the agent, enhancing its conversational capabilities.

inputs.name: default_auto_reply
inputs.description: The default message the agent will use when it cannot generate a response based on the LLM model or code execution.

inputs.name: description
inputs.description: A brief description of the agent, which can be used for identification or informational purposes by other agents.

outputs.name: agent
outputs.description: The conversable agent created by this node, ready for interaction and capable of processing document QA tasks.

ConvertAgentAsTool.description: This node is designed to transform an agent into a tool that can be utilized within a broader system. It encapsulates the functionality of an agent, allowing it to be invoked as a callable tool for processing messages.

inputs.name: agent
inputs.description: The agent parameter represents the conversational agent to be converted into a tool. This conversion enables the agent's capabilities to be accessed in a tool-like manner, facilitating its integration into larger workflows or systems.

outputs.name: tool
outputs.description: The output is a tool encapsulating the agent's functionality, enabling it to be called with messages and return responses. This allows the agent's conversational capabilities to be utilized in a broader context.

ConvertAgentToLlamaindex.description: This node is designed to transform an existing agent into a format compatible with LlamaIndex, enabling its integration and utilization within the LlamaIndex ecosystem. It allows for the extension of an agent's capabilities by optionally incorporating a pre-defined embedding model.

inputs.name: agent
inputs.description: The agent to be converted. This is the primary input that specifies the agent whose functionalities are to be made compatible with the LlamaIndex format.

inputs.name: optional_embed_model
inputs.description: An optional embedding model that can be included to enhance the agent's capabilities within the LlamaIndex ecosystem.

outputs.name: model
outputs.description: The transformed agent, now in a format that is compatible with LlamaIndex, ready for integration and utilization.

CreateScaleSERPSearchTool.description: This node facilitates the creation of a search tool powered by ScaleSERP, designed to perform search engine queries optimized for comprehensive, accurate, and trusted results. It is particularly useful for answering questions related to current events, leveraging a variety of parameters such as search type, location, and device preferences to tailor the search results.

inputs.name: api_key
inputs.description: The API key required to authenticate requests with the ScaleSERP service. It is crucial for enabling the search functionality of the tool.

inputs.name: function_name
inputs.description: The name assigned to the created search tool. It serves as an identifier and is used to reference the tool within the system.

inputs.name: search_type
inputs.description: Specifies the type of search to be performed, influencing the nature of the results returned. It allows for customization of the search to fit specific needs or contexts.

inputs.name: location
inputs.description: An optional parameter that specifies the geographical location for the search, enabling localized search results.

inputs.name: device
inputs.description: Defines the type of device the search is optimized for, such as desktop, mobile, or tablet, affecting the format and relevance of the search results.

inputs.name: mobile_type
inputs.description: Specifies the type of mobile device for the search when the device is set to mobile, further customizing the search experience.

inputs.name: tablet_type
inputs.description: Specifies the type of tablet device for the search when the device is set to tablet, further customizing the search experience.

outputs.name: tool
outputs.description: The search tool created, encapsulating the functionality to perform searches using ScaleSERP with the specified parameters.

CreateTavilySearchTool.description: This node encapsulates the functionality to create a customizable search tool powered by the Tavily search engine. It allows for the dynamic creation of search tools with specific configurations, such as search depth, maximum results, and domain inclusions or exclusions, tailored to enhance search accuracy and relevance for various applications.

inputs.name: api_key
inputs.description: The API key required to authenticate requests with the Tavily search engine, enabling access to its search capabilities.

inputs.name: function_name
inputs.description: The name assigned to the created search tool, which identifies it within the system for future reference and usage.

inputs.name: search_depth
inputs.description: Determines the depth of the search performed by the Tavily search engine, affecting how extensively the engine searches through content to find relevant results.

inputs.name: max_results
inputs.description: The maximum number of search results to return, controlling the breadth of information retrieved from a search query.

inputs.name: include_answer
inputs.description: A flag indicating whether to include a direct answer to the search query in the results, providing a concise response alongside traditional search results.

inputs.name: include_raw_content
inputs.description: A flag indicating whether to include the raw content of search results, offering detailed insights into the content matched by the search query.

inputs.name: include_domains
inputs.description: A list of domains to specifically include in the search results, focusing the search on preferred sources of information.

inputs.name: exclude_domains
inputs.description: A list of domains to exclude from the search results, filtering out unwanted or irrelevant sources.

outputs.name: tool
outputs.description: The search tool created, encapsulating the configured search functionality and parameters for use in search operations.

EmptyAgentsList.description: The EmptyAgentsList node is designed to initialize an empty list of agents. This functionality is essential for scenarios where a fresh start is needed or when beginning to populate a list of agents from scratch.

outputs.name: agents
outputs.description: Returns an empty list, signifying the initialization of an agent list without any pre-existing agents.

GenerateReply.description: This node facilitates the generation of replies in a chat context by processing messages sent to and from agents. It leverages conversational agents to simulate interactive dialogues, dynamically generating responses based on the input message and the context of the conversation.

inputs.name: recipient
inputs.description: Specifies the agent intended to receive the message, playing a crucial role in determining the context and content of the generated reply.

inputs.name: message
inputs.description: The message content sent to the recipient, which is used as the basis for generating a reply. Its content directly influences the reply's relevance and coherence.

inputs.name: sender
inputs.description: Identifies the sender of the message, providing additional context for the reply generation process. It's optional and defaults to None if not provided.

outputs.name: reply
outputs.description: The generated reply from the recipient agent, based on the input message and the conversation context.

GroupChat.description: The GroupChat node facilitates the creation and management of a group chat session among multiple agents. It orchestrates the interaction, ensuring that messages are exchanged according to specified rules and configurations, thereby enabling a simulated group conversation environment.

inputs.name: group_manager
inputs.description: Represents the configuration and management settings for the group chat, acting as the central control unit.

inputs.name: init_message
inputs.description: The initial message to start the group chat session, setting the context for the conversation.

inputs.name: send_introductions
inputs.description: Controls whether introductory messages are sent at the beginning of the chat, setting the tone for the conversation.

inputs.name: summary_method
inputs.description: Determines the method used to summarize the chat session, affecting how the conversation's content is condensed.

inputs.name: max_turns
inputs.description: Specifies the maximum number of turns the chat session can have, controlling the length of the conversation.

inputs.name: clear_history
inputs.description: Specifies whether the chat history should be cleared before starting a new session, influencing the continuity of the conversation.

inputs.name: agents
inputs.description: A list of agents participating in the group chat. It's crucial for defining the participants of the conversation.

outputs.name: chat_history
outputs.description: The compiled history of messages exchanged during the group chat session.

outputs.name: summary
outputs.description: A summary of the group chat session, providing an overview of the conversation's content.

GroupChatAdvanced.description: The GroupChatAdvanced node facilitates advanced group chat simulations among multiple agents, incorporating features like message filtering, speaker selection, and customizable chat introductions. It enables the creation and management of dynamic, multi-agent conversations for various simulation and interaction scenarios.

inputs.name: group_manager
inputs.description: Specifies the manager of the group chat, orchestrating the flow and rules of the conversation.

inputs.name: init_message
inputs.description: The initial message to start the chat, setting the context for the conversation.

inputs.name: select_speaker_message_template
inputs.description: Template for customizing the message that introduces the speaker selection process, guiding the narrative flow.

inputs.name: select_speaker_prompt_template
inputs.description: Customizes the select speaker prompt, guiding the LLM in selecting the next agent to speak.

inputs.name: summary_method
inputs.description: Determines the method for generating a chat summary, affecting the analysis and insights derived from the conversation.

inputs.name: max_turns
inputs.description: Specifies the maximum number of message exchanges allowed in the chat, controlling the conversation's length.

inputs.name: func_call_filter
inputs.description: Determines if the next speaker is chosen based on function call suggestions, influencing the flow of conversation.

inputs.name: speaker_selection_method
inputs.description: Specifies the method used to select the next speaker, affecting the dynamics of the conversation.

inputs.name: allow_repeat_speaker
inputs.description: Allows or disallows the same speaker to be chosen consecutively, impacting the variety of conversation.

inputs.name: send_introductions
inputs.description: Controls whether introductory messages are sent at the beginning of the chat, setting the stage for the conversation.

inputs.name: role_for_select_speaker_messages
inputs.description: Defines the role used in select speaker messages, guiding the context for speaker selection.

inputs.name: clear_history
inputs.description: Indicates whether the chat history should be cleared before starting a new session, impacting the continuity of conversations.

inputs.name: agents
inputs.description: A list of agents participating in the chat. It's crucial for simulating the group chat dynamics and interactions among different entities.

outputs.name: chat_history
outputs.description: The compiled history of messages exchanged during the chat, providing a complete record of the conversation.

outputs.name: summary
outputs.description: A summary of the chat, offering insights or an overview of the conversation's content and outcomes.

GroupChatManagerCreator.description: The GroupChatManagerCreator node specializes in creating a group chat manager agent designed to oversee and manage group chat interactions among multiple agents. It is tailored for scenarios where group chat functionality is essential, providing tools to configure and control the chat environment effectively.

inputs.name: name
inputs.description: The 'name' parameter specifies the name of the group chat manager. It is a key identifier for the chat manager within the group chat environment.

inputs.name: system_message
inputs.description: The 'system_message' parameter is a customizable message that the group chat manager can use to communicate system-level information within the group chat.

inputs.name: llm_model
inputs.description: The 'llm_model' parameter allows for the specification of a language model to be used by the group chat manager, enabling advanced language understanding and response generation capabilities.

inputs.name: max_consecutive_auto_reply
inputs.description: This parameter sets the maximum number of consecutive automatic replies the group chat manager can send, helping to prevent spam and maintain conversation quality.

outputs.name: group_manager
outputs.description: The output is a configured group manager agent, ready to be deployed in managing group chat interactions.

LLMAgentExecutor.description: The LLMAgentExecutor node is designed to orchestrate the execution of language model agents within a given environment, leveraging a combination of user queries, document contexts, and model configurations to generate responses or actions. It integrates various components such as file creation, user simulation, and context management to facilitate complex interactions and generate outputs based on the specified parameters.

inputs.name: llm_model
inputs.description: Specifies the language model to be used for execution, including model details and API keys, enabling the node to configure and utilize the model appropriately.

inputs.name: query
inputs.description: The user's input or question that initiates the execution process, serving as the starting point for the interaction with the agent.

inputs.name: documents_or_string
inputs.description: Optional context provided as either a list of documents or a single string, which is used to enrich the agent's understanding and response generation.

inputs.name: summary_method
inputs.description: Defines the method used to summarize the interaction or content, influencing how the agent processes and presents information.

inputs.name: max_turns
inputs.description: Limits the number of interaction turns between the user and the agent, controlling the depth of the conversation.

inputs.name: clear_history
inputs.description: Determines whether to reset the agent's memory before starting the execution, affecting the continuity of context.

outputs.name: file_path
outputs.description: The path to the generated file as a result of the execution process.

outputs.name: chat_history
outputs.description: A record of the chat history between the user and the agent throughout the execution.

outputs.name: summary
outputs.description: A summary of the interaction or content generated by the agent, based on the specified summarization method.

LLMAgentResponseImageScrape.description: This node is designed to extract and process images from a given text response, identifying and converting any embedded image paths into a tensor representation suitable for further image processing or analysis.

inputs.name: response_string
inputs.description: The response string is the primary input for this node, containing the text from which images will be scraped. It plays a crucial role in determining which images are extracted and processed, directly affecting the node's output.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The output is a tensor representation of all the images found and processed from the input text. This tensor can be used for further image processing or analysis tasks.

LLMAnthropic.description: The LLMAnthropic node integrates Anthropic's conversational AI models into the SaltAI Language Toolkit, enabling users to leverage advanced natural language processing capabilities for generating human-like text responses. This node is designed to facilitate seamless interaction with Anthropic's AI, providing a bridge for developers to incorporate sophisticated conversational AI features into their applications.

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: Specifies the Anthropic model to be used for generating responses. This selection determines the conversational capabilities and nuances of the AI's output.

inputs.name: anthropic_api_key
inputs.description: The API key required for accessing Anthropic's models. This key is essential for authenticating and enabling the interaction with Anthropic's AI services.

inputs.name: embedding_model
inputs.description: Defines the embedding model to be used in conjunction with the main model. This affects the quality and relevance of the AI's responses by enhancing its understanding of the input context.

inputs.name: openai_api_key
inputs.description: The API key for OpenAI, used when the embedding model requires access to OpenAI's services. This key facilitates the integration with OpenAI's ecosystem, broadening the AI's capabilities.

outputs.name: llm_model
outputs.description: The loaded Anthropic model, ready for generating responses. This output signifies the successful initialization and readiness of the AI model for interaction.

LLMChat.description: The LLMChat node facilitates interactive chat sessions with a language model, allowing users to submit queries and receive responses. It dynamically initializes or resets the chat engine based on the session requirements, ensuring tailored interactions.

inputs.name: llm_model
inputs.description: Specifies the language model configuration for the chat session, including any necessary model details for initialization.

inputs.name: llm_context
inputs.description: Provides context or additional settings for the language model, potentially influencing the chat session's behavior.

inputs.name: llm_message
inputs.description: A list of messages that have been part of the chat session, used to maintain context or continuity in the conversation.

inputs.name: llm_documents
inputs.description: A list of documents that can be referenced by the language model during the chat session, enriching the responses.

inputs.name: prompt
inputs.description: The user's input or question to the language model, serving as the basis for generating a response.

outputs.name: response
outputs.description: The language model's response to the user's query, encapsulating the interaction's outcome.

LLMChatBot.description: The LLMChatBot node is designed to facilitate interactive chat sessions using large language models (LLMs). It dynamically generates responses based on user inputs, context, and optionally, a set of documents to enrich the conversation. This node leverages advanced natural language processing techniques to understand and engage in human-like dialogue, making it suitable for applications requiring conversational AI capabilities.

inputs.name: llm_model
inputs.description: A dictionary specifying the large language model to be used for the chat session. It includes configurations such as the embedding model and the main language model itself, which are crucial for generating responses.

inputs.name: llm_context
inputs.description: An optional context that can be provided to tailor the chat session's environment, influencing how responses are generated by the model.

inputs.name: prompt
inputs.description: The user's input message to which the chatbot will respond. This is a key component in initiating the dialogue flow.

inputs.name: reset_engine
inputs.description: A flag to reset the chat engine, clearing any existing context or history to start a fresh conversation.

inputs.name: user_nickname
inputs.description: An optional nickname for the user, used to personalize the chat session.

inputs.name: system_nickname
inputs.description: An optional nickname for the system or chatbot, enhancing the conversational experience.

inputs.name: char_per_token
inputs.description: Defines the average number of characters per token, used for tokenization purposes in the chat session.

inputs.name: documents
inputs.description: An optional list of documents that can be used to provide additional context or information for generating responses. Each document is structured to include text and potentially additional metadata.

outputs.name: chat_history
outputs.description: A record of the chat session, including both user and system messages, maintained to provide context for the conversation.

outputs.name: response
outputs.description: The generated response from the chatbot to the user's input, showcasing the chatbot's ability to engage in meaningful dialogue.

outputs.name: chat_token_count
outputs.description: The cumulative count of tokens used in the chat session, helping to monitor and manage the session's complexity.

LLMChatEngine.description: The LLMChatEngine node facilitates interactive chat sessions by initializing and managing a chat engine based on a specified language model index. It supports dynamic conversation flow by allowing the reset of the chat engine and processing user queries to generate responses.

inputs.name: llm_index
inputs.description: The index of the language model to be used for the chat session. It determines which chat engine instance is initialized for handling queries.

inputs.name: query
inputs.description: The user's query as a string. It is the input for the chat engine to process and generate a response.

inputs.name: reset_engine
inputs.description: A boolean flag indicating whether to reset the chat engine before processing the current query. This allows for starting a new conversation context.

outputs.name: string
outputs.description: The generated response from the chat engine as a string, based on the user's query.

LLMChatMessageConcat.description: The node is designed to concatenate two lists of chat messages, effectively merging conversations or message sequences into a single, continuous stream.

inputs.name: message_a
inputs.description: Represents the first list of chat messages to be concatenated. It is crucial for combining multiple message sequences into a unified list.

inputs.name: message_b
inputs.description: Represents the second list of chat messages to be concatenated with the first. This parameter is essential for merging conversations or extending message sequences.

outputs.name: llm_message
outputs.description: The concatenated list of chat messages, providing a unified sequence of conversations or message exchanges.

LLMChatMessages.description: The LLMChatMessagesAdv node is designed to prepare and structure chat messages for interaction between a system and a user. It encapsulates the process of converting raw text inputs into a formatted list of chat messages, facilitating a structured dialogue flow.

inputs.name: prompt
inputs.description: unknown

inputs.name: role
inputs.description: unknown

outputs.name: llm_message
outputs.description: A list of structured chat messages, representing the dialogue between the system and the user. This output facilitates further processing or interaction within a chat-based application.

LLMChatMessagesAdv.description: The LLMChatMessagesAdv node is designed to prepare chat messages by encapsulating system and user prompts into a structured format. This node plays a crucial role in initializing and structuring conversation data for further processing or interaction within a chat-based application.

inputs.name: system_prompt
inputs.description: The system prompt represents the initial message or context provided by the system, setting the stage for the user's response. It is crucial for defining the scenario or environment in which the user interaction takes place.

inputs.name: user_prompt
inputs.description: The user prompt captures the user's input or response to the system's initial message. It is essential for driving the conversation forward and determining the direction of the interaction.

outputs.name: llm_message
outputs.description: A list of structured chat messages that include both the system's and the user's inputs, ready for further processing or analysis.

LLMComplete.description: The LLMComplete node is designed to generate text completions based on a given prompt, utilizing a specified large language model (LLM). It abstracts the complexity of interacting with different LLMs, providing a unified interface for text generation tasks.

inputs.name: llm_model
inputs.description: Specifies the large language model to be used for generating text completions. It is crucial for determining the source and capabilities of the generated text.

inputs.name: prompt
inputs.description: The input text prompt based on which the text completion is generated. It sets the context or question for the LLM to respond to, influencing the nature of the generated text.

outputs.name: completion
outputs.description: The generated text completion from the LLM based on the provided prompt. It represents the LLM's response or continuation of the input prompt.

LLMCSVReader.description: The LLMCSVReader node specializes in reading CSV files and converting them into a format suitable for llama_index Document processing. It allows for the customization of the reading process through various parameters, enabling the handling of different CSV structures and the inclusion of additional information.

inputs.name: path
inputs.description: Specifies the file path of the CSV file to be read. It is crucial for locating the file that needs to be processed.

inputs.name: concat_rows
inputs.description: Determines whether rows from the CSV file should be concatenated. This affects how the data is structured in the resulting Document.

inputs.name: extra_info
inputs.description: Allows for the inclusion of extra information in a JSON string format, which can be used to provide additional context or configuration for the reading process.

outputs.name: documents
outputs.description: The output is a Document or a list of Documents, depending on the reading configuration, representing the structured data extracted from the CSV file.

LLMCustomNodeComposer.description: This node is designed to draft simple ComfyUI nodes by generating the necessary code structure based on provided specifications. It abstracts the complexities of node creation, allowing users to focus on defining the functionality and inputs of their custom nodes.

inputs.name: llm_model
inputs.description: Specifies the language model to be used for generating the code structure. It is crucial for interpreting the input specifications and composing the appropriate code.

inputs.name: class_prefix
inputs.description: Defines the prefix for the class name of the generated node, allowing for customization and easy identification.

inputs.name: node_explanation
inputs.description: A brief description or explanation of the node's intended functionality, providing context for the code generation.

inputs.name: example_documents
inputs.description: An optional list of example documents that can be used as references or templates in the node drafting process.

inputs.name: example_code
inputs.description: Optional example code that can serve as a guideline or inspiration for the generated node's functionality.

outputs.name: response
outputs.description: The output is the generated code for the ComfyUI node, encapsulating the structure and logic as specified by the input parameters.

LLMDirectoryReader.description: The LLMDirectoryReader node specializes in reading and processing directory structures, enabling the extraction and organization of document data from various file types contained within. It serves as a versatile tool for handling bulk document processing tasks, streamlining the workflow for data ingestion from directories.

inputs.name: input_directory
inputs.description: Specifies the root directory from which documents will be read. This is the starting point for the directory traversal.

inputs.name: optional_path_list
inputs.description: A list of specific paths within the directory to include or exclude, providing finer control over which files are processed.

inputs.name: recursive
inputs.description: Determines whether the directory reading should be recursive, allowing for the inclusion of files in subdirectories.

inputs.name: required_ext_list
inputs.description: A comma-separated list of file extensions to include in the reading process, enabling filtering of files by type.

inputs.name: exclude_glob_list
inputs.description: A comma-separated list of patterns to exclude from the reading process, offering a way to skip over unwanted files or directories.

outputs.name: documents
outputs.description: The output is a collection of documents extracted from the specified directory, organized and ready for further processing.

LLMDocumentListAppend.description: This node is designed to append a list of documents to an existing list of documents, optionally updating their metadata with additional information. It facilitates the dynamic expansion of document collections, allowing for the aggregation of data from multiple sources.

inputs.name: llm_documents
inputs.description: Represents the initial list of documents to which new documents will be appended. It plays a crucial role in the node's operation by serving as the base collection for aggregation.

inputs.name: append_llm_documents
inputs.description: The list of new documents to be appended to the existing list. This parameter is essential for expanding the document collection with new entries.

inputs.name: extra_info
inputs.description: A JSON string containing additional metadata to be merged into the metadata of the documents being appended. This allows for the enrichment of document data.

outputs.name: documents
outputs.description: The updated list of documents after appending the new documents and optionally updating their metadata.

LLMDocxReader.description: The LLMDocxReader node specializes in reading Microsoft Word (.docx) files and converting them into a format suitable for further processing or analysis within the llama_index ecosystem. It leverages the capabilities of the DocxReader class to parse and extract document content, facilitating the integration of Word documents into data pipelines.

inputs.name: path
inputs.description: Specifies the file system path to the .docx file to be read. This path is essential for locating and accessing the file for content extraction.

inputs.name: extra_info
inputs.description: Provides additional, optional information in a string format that can be used to influence the reading process or to append extra metadata to the resulting document.

outputs.name: documents
outputs.description: The output is a document object that encapsulates the content and structure of the read .docx file, ready for further processing within the llama_index ecosystem.

LLMEpubReader.description: The LLMEpubReader node specializes in reading and converting Epub book files into a structured document format, facilitating the processing and analysis of digital book content.

inputs.name: path
inputs.description: Specifies the file system path to the Epub book file to be read. This path is essential for locating and accessing the file for processing.

inputs.name: extra_info
inputs.description: Provides additional, optional information that can be used to influence the reading process or to pass extra parameters specific to the Epub file being processed.

outputs.name: documents
outputs.description: Returns the content of the Epub book file as a structured document, making it accessible for further processing and analysis.

LLMExtractZIP.description: The LLMExtractZIP node is designed to extract files from a ZIP archive, with the option to filter the extracted files based on their extensions. It ensures that only desired files are extracted and handles the creation of necessary directories, providing detailed logging of the extraction process.

inputs.name: path
inputs.description: Defines the destination path where the extracted files will be saved. This parameter is essential for directing the output of the extraction process, ensuring that files are organized and stored in the intended location.

inputs.name: filter_extensions
inputs.description: Specifies the file extensions to include in the extraction process, allowing for selective extraction of files. This parameter plays a crucial role in filtering out unwanted files, enhancing the node's efficiency and relevance to the user's needs.

outputs.name: extraction_path
outputs.description: The path to the directory where the files have been extracted. This output is crucial for users to locate and access the extracted files easily.

LLMFlatReader.description: The LLMFlatReader node is designed to read and process 'flat' files, converting them into a format suitable for indexing and further analysis by the llama_index Document system. It leverages the foundational capabilities of the FlatReader class to facilitate the ingestion of simple text files into more structured document representations.

inputs.name: path
inputs.description: Specifies the filesystem path to the 'flat' file that needs to be read. This path is essential for locating and accessing the file for processing.

inputs.name: extra_info
inputs.description: Provides additional, optional information in a string format that can be used to influence the reading process or to pass extra parameters that might be needed for specific use cases.

outputs.name: documents
outputs.description: The processed data from the 'flat' file, structured as a document suitable for indexing and further analysis.

LLMGetPromptJSON.description: The LLMGetPromptJSON node is designed to transform a given prompt into a structured JSON format, optionally parsing and including various input types such as integers, floats, and booleans. This functionality facilitates the dynamic generation of prompts tailored to specific requirements, enhancing the flexibility and precision of language model interactions.

inputs.name: optional_order_input
inputs.description: An optional parameter that allows for the specification of the order in which inputs are processed. This can affect the final structure and content of the generated JSON prompt.

inputs.name: parse_to_inputs
inputs.description: A boolean flag that, when set to true, triggers the parsing of the prompt into distinct inputs based on specified inclusion criteria (integers, floats, booleans).

inputs.name: include_int
inputs.description: Determines whether integers found within the prompt should be included in the parsed inputs, contributing to the structured JSON output.

inputs.name: include_float
inputs.description: Specifies whether floating-point numbers within the prompt are included in the parsed inputs, affecting the composition of the JSON structure.

inputs.name: include_boolean
inputs.description: Indicates whether boolean values within the prompt should be parsed and included in the JSON output, influencing the prompt's final structure.

outputs.name: prompt_json
outputs.description: The resulting JSON-formatted prompt, structured according to the specified input parameters and parsing options.

LLMGroqModel.description: The LLMGroqModel node integrates Groq's large language models (LLMs) with embedding models, such as those provided by OpenAI, to facilitate advanced text processing and analysis tasks. It enables the loading of specific LLMs and embedding models, configuring them for use in various applications that require understanding, generating, or transforming text.

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: Specifies the Groq model to be loaded for text processing tasks, indicating the specific LLM to be utilized.

inputs.name: groq_api_key
inputs.description: The API key required to authenticate and access Groq's large language models, ensuring secure and authorized use.

inputs.name: embedding_model
inputs.description: Defines the embedding model to be used in conjunction with the Groq LLM, typically for tasks involving text embedding or similarity analysis.

inputs.name: openai_api_key
inputs.description: Optional API key for accessing OpenAI's embedding models, providing flexibility in choosing the embedding model based on availability or preference.

outputs.name: llm_model
outputs.description: The loaded Groq large language model, ready for text processing tasks.

outputs.name: embed_model_only
outputs.description: The embedding model loaded alongside the Groq LLM, used for text embedding or similarity analysis.

LLMHtmlComposer.description: The LLMHtmlComposer node is designed to generate HTML content based on given text input, classifier list, and optional extra directions. It leverages a language model to compose either a full HTML page document or an HTML snippet, depending on the specified mode, ensuring the output is well-structured and valid.

inputs.name: llm_model
inputs.description: Represents the language model used for generating HTML content. It's crucial for interpreting the input text and classifiers to produce the desired HTML output.

inputs.name: text_input
inputs.description: The primary text input from which the HTML content will be generated. This text serves as the base for the composition process.

inputs.name: classifier_list
inputs.description: A list of classifiers provided as a comma-separated string. These classifiers guide the language model in generating HTML content that aligns with specific criteria or categories.

inputs.name: extra_directions
inputs.description: Optional additional instructions to further guide the HTML generation process, allowing for more customized outputs.

inputs.name: composer_mode
inputs.description: Specifies the mode of HTML composition, either as a full HTML page document or an HTML snippet, influencing the structure and inclusion of HTML elements in the output.

outputs.name: html_output
outputs.description: The generated HTML content, either as a full HTML page or an HTML snippet, based on the input text, classifiers, and optional directions.

LLMHtmlRepair.description: The LLMHtmlRepair node leverages a language model to analyze and correct malformed HTML content, ensuring the output is well-structured and valid HTML without data loss.

inputs.name: llm_model
inputs.description: Specifies the language model to use for repairing the HTML. It's crucial for interpreting the input and generating the corrected HTML.

inputs.name: text_input
inputs.description: The malformed HTML content that needs to be repaired. It serves as the primary input for the correction process.

inputs.name: extra_directions
inputs.description: Optional additional instructions for the language model, guiding the repair process with more specificity.

outputs.name: html_output
outputs.description: The repaired HTML content, which is well-structured and valid, ensuring no data is omitted.

LLMHTMLTagReader.description: The LLMHTMLTagReader node is designed to read and interpret HTML tags from specified files, transforming them into a structured document format. It leverages BeautifulSoup to parse HTML content, focusing on specific tags and attributes to extract relevant information, while also allowing for customization through optional parameters.

inputs.name: path
inputs.description: Specifies the file path to the HTML file to be read. This is a crucial parameter as it determines the source of the HTML content to be processed.

inputs.name: tag
inputs.description: Defines the specific HTML tag to focus on during the parsing process. This allows for targeted extraction of information from the HTML file.

inputs.name: ignore_no_id
inputs.description: A boolean flag that, when set, instructs the reader to ignore HTML elements without an ID attribute. This can be useful for filtering out unnecessary elements.

inputs.name: extra_info
inputs.description: Allows for the inclusion of additional, custom information in the form of a string, which can be used to further customize the parsing behavior.

outputs.name: documents
outputs.description: The structured document format output, which represents the parsed and interpreted HTML content.

LLMHWPReader.description: The LLMHWPReader node is designed to read and process HWP (Hangul Word Processor) files, a popular word processing file format in South Korea, converting them into a format suitable for further analysis or processing within the llama_index ecosystem.

inputs.name: path
inputs.description: Specifies the file path to the HWP document to be read. This path is essential for locating and accessing the file for processing.

inputs.name: extra_info
inputs.description: Provides additional information or parameters in JSON string format that may influence how the HWP file is processed, allowing for customizable handling of the file.

outputs.name: documents
outputs.description: Returns the processed HWP file content as a document object, ready for integration into the llama_index ecosystem for further analysis or processing.

LLMImageCaptionReader.description: The LLMImageCaptionReader node is designed to interpret and describe image files by generating captions, effectively converting visual content into descriptive text documents. This process facilitates the integration of image data into text-based indexing and search systems, such as the llama_index Document structure.

inputs.name: path
inputs.description: Specifies the file path of the image to be captioned. This is a crucial input as it determines the source image for caption generation.

inputs.name: prompt
inputs.description: An optional text input that can guide or influence the caption generation process, allowing for more tailored or context-specific descriptions.

inputs.name: extra_info
inputs.description: Optional additional information provided as a string, which can be used to pass extra parameters or context for the caption generation process.

outputs.name: documents
outputs.description: The output is a document object that contains the generated caption, encapsulating the image description in a structured text format.

LLMImageTabularChartReader.description: The LLMImageTabularChartReader node specializes in interpreting image-based charts as tabular data, converting visual information into a structured document format. This process enables the extraction and analysis of data from images that represent charts, facilitating their integration into data processing workflows.

inputs.name: path
inputs.description: Specifies the file path to the image chart that needs to be read. It is essential for locating and accessing the image for data extraction.

inputs.name: max_output_tokens
inputs.description: Determines the maximum number of tokens to be generated for the output, affecting the level of detail and length of the extracted data.

inputs.name: prompt
inputs.description: Provides an optional text prompt to guide the interpretation of the image chart, potentially influencing the focus or context of the extracted data.

inputs.name: extra_info
inputs.description: Allows for the inclusion of additional information in a string format, which can be used to pass extra parameters or context for the data extraction process.

outputs.name: documents
outputs.description: Returns the extracted tabular data from the image chart in a structured document format, enabling further analysis or processing.
