outputs.description: The compiled history of messages exchanged during the chat, presented in a readable format.

outputs.name: summary
outputs.description: A concise summary of the chat, reflecting the conversation's key points and outcomes.

outputs.name: initiator
outputs.description: Returns the initiating agent after the chat, potentially with updated state or information.

outputs.name: recipient
outputs.description: Returns the recipient agent after the chat, potentially with updated state or information.

SAIOpenAIAPIWhisper.description: The SAIOpenAIAPIWhisper node is designed to transcribe audio files using OpenAI's Whisper model through an API. It abstracts the complexity of audio processing and transcription, providing an easy-to-use interface for converting speech in audio files into text.

inputs.name: file_path
inputs.description: The path to the audio file to be transcribed. This is crucial for locating and processing the audio file for transcription.

inputs.name: openai_key
inputs.description: The API key for accessing OpenAI's Whisper model. This key is essential for authenticating and authorizing the transcription request.

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: Specifies the Whisper model version to use for transcription. This allows for flexibility in choosing the model that best fits the transcription needs.

inputs.name: mode
inputs.description: Defines the operation mode, such as transcribing. It determines how the audio file will be processed.

inputs.name: language
inputs.description: The language of the audio to be transcribed. This helps in optimizing the transcription accuracy by informing the model of the language context.

inputs.name: response_format
inputs.description: The format in which the transcription results are returned, e.g., text. It specifies the desired output format for the transcription.

inputs.name: temperature
inputs.description: Controls the creativity of the transcription. A higher temperature can result in more varied transcriptions.

inputs.name: timestamp_granularities
inputs.description: Specifies the granularity of timestamps in the transcription, such as by segment. This affects how detailed the timestamp information in the transcription will be.

inputs.name: max_frames
inputs.description: The maximum number of frames to process, which can limit the scope of transcription for longer audio files.

inputs.name: seek_seconds
inputs.description: The number of seconds to skip from the beginning of the audio file. This allows for starting the transcription at a specific point in the audio.

inputs.name: prompt
inputs.description: An optional prompt to guide the transcription process. This can influence the context or focus of the transcription.

outputs.name: transcription_result
outputs.description: The transcribed text of the audio file, providing a textual representation of the spoken content.

outputs.name: audio_path
outputs.description: The path to the processed audio file, useful for further analysis or processing.

outputs.name: frames_count
outputs.description: The total number of frames processed during the transcription, indicating the scope of the transcription.

SAIWhisperLoadModel.description: The SAIWhisperLoadModel node is designed to load and prepare Whisper models for speech-to-text operations. It supports loading various versions of OpenAI's Whisper models, ensuring they are ready for transcription tasks by initializing the model and its processor according to the specified model version and computational device.

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: Specifies the version of the Whisper model to be loaded. This parameter determines which pre-trained Whisper model is initialized for speech-to-text processing.

inputs.name: device
inputs.description: Defines the computational device ('cuda' or 'cpu') on which the Whisper model will be loaded. This affects the performance and efficiency of the model's operation.

outputs.name: model
outputs.description: Returns a tuple containing the loaded Whisper model, its processor, and the device it's loaded on, ready for speech-to-text transcription.

SAIWhisperTranscribe.description: This node is designed to transcribe audio and video files using the Whisper model. It processes media files to extract audio, then transcribes the audio into text, providing detailed transcription data including timestamps and potentially images, depending on the media type and transcription settings.

inputs.name: whisper_model
inputs.description: The Whisper model, processor, and device configuration used for transcription. This affects the accuracy and quality of the transcription.

inputs.name: file_path
inputs.description: The path to the media file to be transcribed. Supports both audio and video files, validating against supported formats.

inputs.name: frame_rate
inputs.description: Optional. Specifies the frame rate for audio extraction from video files, affecting the temporal resolution of the transcription.

inputs.name: chunk_type
inputs.description: Specifies whether the transcription should be segmented by sentences or words, affecting the granularity of the output timestamps.

inputs.name: max_new_tokens
inputs.description: Optional. Limits the number of new tokens generated during transcription, impacting the length and detail of the output.

outputs.name: transcription_text
outputs.description: The complete transcription text without timestamps or segmentation.

outputs.name: transcription_timestamp_dict
outputs.description: A structured representation of the transcription with detailed information, including timestamps.

outputs.name: transcription_frame_dict
outputs.description: Timestamped frames of the transcription, providing temporal context to the text.

outputs.name: prompt_schedule
outputs.description: A schedule of prompts used during transcription, if applicable.

outputs.name: images
outputs.description: A collection of images extracted from the video, if the media type is video.

outputs.name: transcription_count
outputs.description: The total number of transcription segments produced.

outputs.name: frame_rate
outputs.description: The frame rate derived from the audio extraction process.

outputs.name: frame_count
outputs.description: The total number of frames in the video, if the media type is video.

SaveImageExtended.description: The SaveImageExtended node extends the functionality of image saving in ComfyUI by allowing for enhanced customization and metadata handling. It supports saving images with custom filenames and paths, embedding metadata within the image files, and optionally saving job-related data alongside the images. This node caters to advanced use cases where detailed control over the image output process is desired, including the management of image metadata and the organization of saved images.

inputs.name: images
inputs.description: A collection of images to be saved. This parameter is crucial as it directly influences the node's primary function of saving images to disk.

inputs.name: filename_prefix
inputs.description: A prefix added to the filename for further customization, allowing for more descriptive or organized file naming.

inputs.name: filename_keys
inputs.description: Specifies the keys from the generation parameters to be included in the filename, enabling dynamic naming based on specific generation attributes.

inputs.name: foldername_prefix
inputs.description: A prefix for the folder name where images will be saved, allowing for organized grouping of images in the output directory.

inputs.name: foldername_keys
inputs.description: Defines the keys from the generation parameters to be included in the folder name, facilitating organized storage based on specific attributes.

inputs.name: delimiter
inputs.description: The character used to separate elements in the filename and folder name, allowing for customization of the file and folder naming scheme.

inputs.name: save_job_data
inputs.description: Controls the saving of job-related data alongside the images, enabling the association of creation parameters or results with the saved images.

inputs.name: job_data_per_image
inputs.description: Determines whether job-related data should be saved for each image individually or as a single file for all images, affecting how job data is organized.

inputs.name: job_custom_text
inputs.description: Custom text to be included in job-related data, offering a way to embed arbitrary information or notes alongside the saved images.

inputs.name: save_metadata
inputs.description: Controls whether to embed metadata within the saved images. This affects the node's ability to include additional information like prompts or custom data within the image files.

inputs.name: counter_digits
inputs.description: Determines the number of digits for the image counter, affecting the formatting of the sequence numbers in filenames.

inputs.name: counter_position
inputs.description: Specifies the position of the counter in the filename, affecting how the sequence numbers are formatted and displayed.

inputs.name: one_counter_per_folder
inputs.description: Specifies whether a single counter is used for all images in a folder or if each folder has its own counter, influencing file organization.

inputs.name: image_preview
inputs.description: Controls whether a preview of the saved image is displayed, enhancing the user's ability to visually verify the saved images.

inputs.name: positive_text_opt
inputs.description: Optional text associated with positive prompts, used in job data saving to provide context or details about the image generation.

inputs.name: negative_text_opt
inputs.description: Optional text associated with negative prompts, used in job data saving to provide additional context or details about the image generation.

PerturbedAttention.description: The PerturbedAttention node introduces a mechanism to modify the behavior of attention mechanisms within neural network models, specifically targeting the self-attention components of U-Net architectures. It achieves this by applying perturbations to the attention calculations, potentially enhancing the model's ability to focus on relevant features or introducing variability for generative tasks.

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: The neural network model to which perturbed attention will be applied. This parameter is crucial as it determines the base architecture that will be modified by the perturbation process.

inputs.name: scale
inputs.description: Specifies the scale of perturbation to be applied, directly influencing the intensity and impact of the perturbations on the attention mechanism.

inputs.name: adaptive_scale
inputs.description: Determines the adaptive scaling factor for perturbations, allowing for dynamic adjustment based on model performance or other criteria.

inputs.name: unet_block
inputs.description: Identifies the specific U-Net block (input, middle, or output) where the perturbed attention mechanism will be applied, enabling precise targeting within the model.

inputs.name: unet_block_id
inputs.description: The numerical identifier for the U-Net block, further specifying the exact location for perturbation application within the chosen block.

inputs.name: sigma_start
inputs.description: Defines the starting value of sigma for the perturbation process, controlling the intensity of perturbations applied to the attention mechanism. It plays a key role in adjusting the model's focus and variability.

inputs.name: sigma_end
inputs.description: Specifies the ending value of sigma, marking the point at which perturbation intensity ceases to increase, thereby defining the range of perturbation application.

inputs.name: rescale
inputs.description: A factor that adjusts the scale of perturbations, offering an additional layer of control over their intensity.

inputs.name: rescale_mode
inputs.description: Determines how the rescaling of perturbations is applied, with options including 'full' and 'partial', to influence the overall effect on the attention mechanism.

inputs.name: unet_block_list
inputs.description: A list specifying the U-Net blocks where the perturbed attention mechanism will be applied. This allows for targeted modifications within the model, enhancing flexibility and control over the perturbation effects.

outputs.name: model
outputs.description: The modified neural network model with perturbed attention mechanisms applied to specified U-Net blocks. This output reflects the enhanced or altered capabilities of the model due to the perturbations.

SeargeAdvancedParameters.description: The SeargeAdvancedParameters node is designed to handle and process advanced configuration parameters for the generation process. It allows for the customization and fine-tuning of generation settings, enabling users to adjust parameters that influence the output's quality, style, and other advanced aspects.

inputs.name: dynamic_cfg_method
inputs.description: unknown

inputs.name: dynamic_cfg_factor
inputs.description: unknown

inputs.name: refiner_detail_boost
inputs.description: unknown

inputs.name: contrast_factor
inputs.description: unknown

inputs.name: saturation_factor
inputs.description: unknown

inputs.name: latent_detailer
inputs.description: unknown

inputs.name: data
inputs.description: unknown

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: This output represents the processed data stream, encapsulating all the adjusted and fine-tuned parameters for the generation process.

SeargeCheckpointLoader.description: The SeargeCheckpointLoader node is designed for loading specific checkpoints from a predefined repository. It abstracts the complexity of checkpoint loading mechanisms, providing a simplified interface for retrieving model, CLIP, and VAE components based on checkpoint names.

inputs.name: ckpt_name
inputs.description: Specifies the name of the checkpoint to load. This parameter is crucial for identifying and retrieving the correct checkpoint data, impacting the model, CLIP, and VAE components that are loaded.

outputs.name: model
outputs.description: The loaded model component from the specified checkpoint.

outputs.name: clip
outputs.description: The loaded CLIP component from the specified checkpoint.

outputs.name: vae
outputs.description: The loaded VAE component from the specified checkpoint.

SeargeConditioningMuxer2.description: The SeargeConditioningMuxer2 node is designed for selecting one of two conditioning inputs based on a selector input. It facilitates dynamic control over which conditioning data is passed forward in a processing pipeline, allowing for flexible manipulation of conditioning contexts.

inputs.name: input0
inputs.description: The first conditioning input option. This input represents one of the potential conditioning contexts to be selected.

inputs.name: input1
inputs.description: The second conditioning input option. Similar to input0, this represents an alternative conditioning context that can be selected.

inputs.name: input_selector
inputs.description: An integer selector that determines which of the two conditioning inputs (input0 or input1) is passed forward. A value of 0 selects input0, while a value of 1 selects input1.

outputs.name: output
outputs.description: The selected conditioning input, determined by the value of the input_selector. This output carries forward the chosen conditioning context for further processing.

SeargeConditioningMuxer5.description: The SeargeConditioningMuxer5 node is designed for selecting one of five conditioning inputs based on a specified selector input. It facilitates dynamic control over which conditioning data is passed forward in a processing pipeline, allowing for flexible manipulation of input data streams.

inputs.name: input0
inputs.description: Represents the first conditioning input option. Its selection is dependent on the value of the input selector.

inputs.name: input1
inputs.description: Represents the second conditioning input option, selectable through the input selector.

inputs.name: input2
inputs.description: Denotes the third conditioning input option, which can be chosen based on the input selector's value.

inputs.name: input3
inputs.description: Indicates the fourth conditioning input option, selectable via the input selector.

inputs.name: input4
inputs.description: Signifies the fifth conditioning input option, chosen based on the input selector's value.

inputs.name: input_selector
inputs.description: An integer that selects which of the five conditioning inputs to pass forward. It determines the flow of data through the node.

outputs.name: output
outputs.description: The selected conditioning input, determined by the input selector. It enables dynamic data flow control within the pipeline.

SeargeConditioningParameters.description: The SeargeConditioningParameters node is designed to manage and configure the conditioning parameters for image generation processes. It focuses on adjusting various scales and scores that influence the conditioning of positive and negative prompts, as well as refining and targeting specific aspects of the generated images. This node plays a crucial role in fine-tuning the aesthetic and thematic direction of the output.

inputs.name: base_conditioning_scale
inputs.description: Specifies the scale for base conditioning, affecting the foundational aspects of image generation.

inputs.name: refiner_conditioning_scale
inputs.description: Determines the scale for refiner conditioning, influencing the refinement process of the generated images.

inputs.name: target_conditioning_scale
inputs.description: Sets the scale for target conditioning, targeting specific attributes or qualities in the image generation.

inputs.name: positive_conditioning_scale
inputs.description: Adjusts the scale for positive conditioning, enhancing desired features or themes in the generated images.

inputs.name: negative_conditioning_scale
inputs.description: Modifies the scale for negative conditioning, reducing or avoiding undesired aspects in the images.

inputs.name: positive_aesthetic_score
inputs.description: Defines the aesthetic score for positive prompts, influencing the visual appeal of the generated images.

inputs.name: negative_aesthetic_score
inputs.description: Sets the aesthetic score for negative prompts, impacting the avoidance of certain visual elements.

inputs.name: precondition_mode
inputs.description: Specifies the mode of preconditioning, determining how preconditions are applied to the image generation process.

inputs.name: precondition_strength
inputs.description: Determines the strength of the preconditioning, affecting the intensity of applied preconditions.

inputs.name: data
inputs.description: unknown

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: unknown

SeargeConditionMixing.description: This node is designed to integrate condition mixing functionality into the UI, allowing for the dynamic creation and manipulation of UI elements based on specified conditions. It primarily serves to enrich the user interface by enabling the customization of UI components through condition-based logic.

inputs.name: data
inputs.description: An optional data stream that can be provided to the node. If supplied, it is used to further customize the UI elements based on the existing conditions within the data stream.

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: Returns a data stream that includes the condition mixing settings, enhancing the UI's dynamic response to user interactions or predefined conditions.

SeargeControlnetAdapterV2.description: The SeargeControlnetAdapterV2 node serves as an interface for adapting and applying control network configurations and annotations to input data, facilitating the enhancement or modification of images through various controlnet modes and preprocessing options. It abstracts the complexity of controlnet operations, offering customizable parameters to fine-tune the application of these networks on the input data.

inputs.name: controlnet_mode
inputs.description: Specifies the mode of operation for the control network, allowing users to select different controlnet configurations for processing the input data.

inputs.name: controlnet_preprocessor
inputs.description: A boolean flag indicating whether preprocessing should be applied before the controlnet operation, affecting the input data's preparation.

inputs.name: strength
inputs.description: Determines the intensity of the controlnet effect, allowing for fine-tuning of the applied enhancements or modifications.

inputs.name: low_threshold
inputs.description: Sets the lower threshold for controlnet processing, influencing the sensitivity of the operation to input data features.

inputs.name: high_threshold
inputs.description: Defines the upper threshold for controlnet processing, adjusting the operation's responsiveness to prominent features in the input data.

inputs.name: start_percent
inputs.description: Specifies the starting percentage of the input data to be processed, enabling selective application of the controlnet operation.

inputs.name: end_percent
inputs.description: Indicates the ending percentage of the input data that will undergo controlnet processing, allowing for targeted modifications.

inputs.name: noise_augmentation
inputs.description: Controls the level of noise augmentation applied to the input data, enhancing the robustness of the controlnet operation.

inputs.name: revision_enhancer
inputs.description: A boolean parameter that activates an additional enhancement layer post-controlnet processing, refining the output quality.

inputs.name: data
inputs.description: An optional data stream input that can be processed alongside image inputs for integrated controlnet operations.

inputs.name: source_image
inputs.description: An optional image input that the controlnet operation can directly modify or enhance.

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: Outputs the processed data stream, incorporating the applied controlnet modifications.

outputs.name: preview
outputs.description: Provides a preview image showcasing the effects of the controlnet operation on the input data.

SeargeControlnetModels.description: The SeargeControlnetModels node is designed to facilitate the selection and application of various controlnet models within a generative AI pipeline. It abstracts the complexity of choosing and integrating different controlnet models, which are essential for modifying or enhancing generated content based on specific control parameters or conditions.

inputs.name: clip_vision
inputs.description: Specifies the CLIP vision model to be used, potentially including a 'none' option to indicate no specific CLIP vision model is required. This input is crucial for determining the visual understanding context for the controlnet model.

inputs.name: canny_checkpoint
inputs.description: Refers to the specific checkpoint for the Canny edge detection model within the controlnet framework, including a 'none' option. It's used to apply edge detection features to the generated content.

inputs.name: depth_checkpoint
inputs.description: Indicates the checkpoint for the depth estimation model, allowing for depth-aware modifications to the generated content. This parameter includes a 'none' option to skip depth processing.

inputs.name: recolor_checkpoint
inputs.description: Specifies the checkpoint for the recoloring model, enabling color adjustments or transformations in the generated content. Includes a 'none' option for cases where recoloring is not required.

inputs.name: sketch_checkpoint
inputs.description: Denotes the checkpoint for the sketch model, used to apply sketch-like effects or transformations to the generated content. A 'none' option is included for flexibility.

inputs.name: custom_checkpoint
inputs.description: Allows for the specification of a custom controlnet model checkpoint, providing additional flexibility in content modification. Includes a 'none' option.

inputs.name: data
inputs.description: Optional stream of data that can be used for additional processing or as part of the controlnet model's input. This parameter provides flexibility in handling complex workflows.

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: The output data stream resulting from the application of the controlnet models, encapsulating all modifications and enhancements made to the generated content.

SeargeCustomAfterUpscaling.description: This node is designed to process the output of an upscaling stage, specifically handling the transformation of upscaled images into a final image format. It encapsulates the functionality to decode and retrieve the final upscaled image from a given set of custom outputs.

inputs.name: custom_output
inputs.description: Represents the output from a previous upscaling stage, serving as the essential input for generating the final image. It is crucial for the node's operation as it contains the data needed to extract and construct the final image.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The final image produced after processing the upscaled output. It signifies the completion of the upscaling process, ready for further use or display.

SeargeCustomAfterVaeDecode.description: This node is designed to process the output of a VAE decoding stage, specifically handling custom outputs. It retrieves and optionally post-processes the decoded image, providing a flexible mechanism to integrate custom processing or adjustments post VAE decoding.

inputs.name: custom_output
inputs.description: The custom output from a previous stage, expected to contain VAE decoded data along with any additional custom parameters or results that need further processing.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The final processed image, which may be the original decoded image or a post-processed version, depending on the presence of post-processing steps.

SeargeCustomPromptMode.description: This node is designed to customize the prompting mode within a user interface, allowing for dynamic adjustments to how prompts are presented and interacted with by the user. It facilitates the integration of custom prompting strategies into the UI, enhancing user experience by tailoring prompt interactions.

inputs.name: data
inputs.description: An optional data stream that can be provided to customize the prompting mode further. It allows for the integration of additional data into the prompting process, enhancing its flexibility and adaptability.

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: Returns a data stream that includes the customized prompting settings, enabling dynamic adjustments to the UI's prompt interactions based on the provided input.

SeargeDebugPrinter.description: The SeargeDebugPrinter node is designed for debugging purposes within the ComfyUI SDXL environment, providing a mechanism to print and inspect the state of data streams. It allows for conditional output based on an enabled flag, and formats the data with optional prefixes for improved readability and organization.

inputs.name: enabled
inputs.description: Determines whether the debug output is enabled, allowing for conditional printing based on this flag.

inputs.name: data
inputs.description: The data stream to be printed. It supports various data types and structures, enabling detailed inspection of the content.

inputs.name: prefix
inputs.description: An optional prefix to prepend to each line of the debug output, enhancing the clarity and context of the printed information.

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: Returns the original data stream, allowing for further processing or inspection after debugging.

SeargeEnablerInputs.description: The SeargeEnablerInputs node is designed to process and validate the state of a given parameter, ensuring it aligns with predefined states within the system. It serves as a mechanism to enable or disable certain functionalities based on the state's value.

inputs.name: state
inputs.description: Specifies the current state of a parameter, which determines the activation status of certain functionalities within the system. The default state is the second item in the predefined states list.

outputs.name: state
outputs.description: Returns the validated state of the parameter, which is used to control the activation of specific functionalities.

SeargeFloatConstant.description: The SeargeFloatConstant node is designed to provide a constant floating-point value as specified by the user. It serves as a simple utility to inject fixed numerical values into a data flow or computation process.

inputs.name: value
inputs.description: Specifies the constant floating-point value to be returned by the node. This allows for the injection of a predetermined numerical value into the workflow.

outputs.name: value
outputs.description: The constant floating-point value specified by the user, serving as the node's output.

SeargeFloatMath.description: SeargeFloatMath provides mathematical operations on floating-point numbers, allowing for the execution of basic arithmetic operations with customizable operands and operation types.

inputs.name: op
inputs.description: Specifies the arithmetic operation to be performed, chosen from a predefined list of operations. This affects the calculation result by determining which mathematical operation is applied.

inputs.name: a
inputs.description: The first operand in the arithmetic operation, serving as a base value for calculations.

inputs.name: b
inputs.description: The second operand, used in multiplication and division operations with the first operand.

inputs.name: c
inputs.description: An additional operand used in operations involving addition or subtraction, enhancing the flexibility of calculations.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: The result of the specified arithmetic operation performed on the input operands.

SeargeFloatPair.description: The SeargeFloatPair node is designed to simply return a pair of float values as provided in its input. It serves as a basic utility within a larger system, allowing for the straightforward passing and manipulation of float values.

inputs.name: value1
inputs.description: Specifies the first float value to be returned. It is a fundamental input that directly determines the first element of the output pair.

inputs.name: value2
inputs.description: Defines the second float value to be returned. This input is crucial as it sets the second element of the output pair, complementing the first value.

outputs.name: value 1
outputs.description: unknown

outputs.name: value 2
outputs.description: unknown

SeargeFreeU.description: SeargeFreeU is a node designed to configure and apply specific settings for the FreeU mode in a generative model's processing pipeline. It allows for the dynamic adjustment of parameters based on the selected FreeU mode, enhancing the model's output through fine-tuned control.

inputs.name: freeu_mode
inputs.description: Specifies the mode of operation for FreeU, affecting how other parameters are set and ultimately influencing the generative model's output.

inputs.name: b1
inputs.description: A floating-point parameter influencing the behavior of the FreeU mode, contributing to the model's output customization.

inputs.name: b2
inputs.description: Another floating-point parameter for fine-tuning the FreeU mode's effect, further customizing the output.

inputs.name: s1
inputs.description: A parameter controlling a specific aspect of the FreeU mode, affecting the output's characteristics.

inputs.name: s2
inputs.description: Similar to s1, this floating-point parameter adjusts another aspect of the FreeU mode, impacting the final generative model's output.

inputs.name: freeu_version
inputs.description: Determines the version of FreeU to be applied, directly influencing the behavior of other parameters and the overall effect on the model's output.

inputs.name: data
inputs.description: Optional data stream for further processing or modification within the FreeU mode, allowing for extended customization and flexibility.

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: The modified data stream, enriched or altered by the FreeU settings applied, ready for subsequent stages in the processing pipeline.

SeargeGenerated1.description: SeargeGenerated1 is designed to manage and generate flow control parameters within the SeargeSDXL framework. It plays a crucial role in orchestrating the flow of data and operations across various stages of the image generation process, ensuring that the right parameters are available at the right time for optimal performance and output quality.

inputs.name: parameters
inputs.description: This input represents the parameters required for generating flow control outputs, serving as the foundation for orchestrating the data and operations within the SeargeSDXL framework.

outputs.name: parameters
outputs.description: Returns the original parameters provided as input, facilitating the flow of data through the system.

outputs.name: operation_selector
outputs.description: Generates an integer value to select the operation mode, influencing the flow and processing of image generation.

outputs.name: prompt_style_selector
outputs.description: Generates an integer value to select the prompt style, affecting the thematic direction of the generation process.

outputs.name: prompt_style_group
outputs.description: Generates an integer value to select the prompt style group, further refining the thematic direction of the generation process.

SeargeGenerationParameters.description: This node is designed to handle and process generation parameters for the SeargeSDXL system. It focuses on configuring and optimizing the generation settings to align with user inputs and preferences, ensuring that the output is tailored to the specific requirements of the task at hand.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.description: Specifies the initial seed for generation, ensuring reproducibility of results.

inputs.name: image_size_preset
inputs.description: Selects a predefined image size for the generation, simplifying the configuration process.

inputs.name: image_width
inputs.description: Defines the width of the generated image, allowing for custom dimensions.

inputs.name: image_height
inputs.description: Sets the height of the generated image, enabling customization of output size.

inputs.name: steps
inputs.description: Determines the number of steps in the generation process, affecting the detail and quality of the output.

inputs.name: cfg
inputs.description: Controls the CFG scale, adjusting the influence of the conditioning on the generation.

inputs.name: sampler_preset
inputs.description: Chooses a preset for the sampling method, affecting the generation's randomness and diversity.

inputs.name: sampler_name
inputs.description: Specifies the exact sampler to be used, offering fine control over the generation process.

inputs.name: scheduler
inputs.description: Selects the scheduler for controlling the sampling process, impacting the progression of generation steps.

inputs.name: base_vs_refiner_ratio
inputs.description: Adjusts the balance between base and refiner models, tailoring the output's refinement level.

inputs.name: data
inputs.description: Incorporates various generation parameters and settings, encapsulating all necessary information for the generation.

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: Outputs the comprehensive set of generation parameters, configured and ready for use in the generation process.

SeargeHighResolution.description: The SeargeHighResolution node is designed to enhance the resolution and detail of images through a series of upscale and detail enhancement processes. It leverages various scaling techniques, including bicubic and nearest neighbor interpolations, and integrates with model-based upscaling and detail enhancement to achieve high-resolution outputs. This node plays a crucial role in refining image quality, especially in scenarios where higher detail and clarity are desired.

inputs.name: hires_mode
inputs.description: Specifies the high-resolution mode to be used, influencing the overall approach and techniques applied for image enhancement.

inputs.name: hires_scale
inputs.description: Determines the scaling factor for upscaling the image, directly affecting the final image size and detail level.

inputs.name: hires_denoise
inputs.description: Controls the amount of denoising applied during the upscaling process, helping to reduce noise in the upscaled image.

inputs.name: hires_softness
inputs.description: A parameter controlling the blend between different upscaling methods (nearest and bicubic) to achieve a desired softness in the image texture.

inputs.name: hires_detail_boost
inputs.description: Adjusts the intensity of detail enhancement applied to the upscaled image, allowing for finer control over the clarity and sharpness of details.

inputs.name: hires_contrast_factor
inputs.description: Modifies the contrast of the upscaled image, enhancing visual depth and definition.

inputs.name: hires_saturation_factor
inputs.description: Alters the saturation level of the upscaled image, affecting color intensity and vibrance.

inputs.name: hires_latent_detailer
inputs.description: An optional model for enhancing the details of the upscaled image at a latent level, further refining image quality.

inputs.name: final_upscale_size
inputs.description: Specifies the target size for the final upscaled image, determining the overall dimensions of the output.

inputs.name: data
inputs.description: Optional data that can be passed through for additional processing or information tracking.

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: The final upscaled and detail-enhanced image data, representing the high-resolution output of the node's processing. This data includes the upscaled image along with any additional information processed through the node.

SeargeImage2ImageAndInpainting.description: This node is designed for image-to-image translation and inpainting tasks, allowing for the modification and enhancement of images by applying inpainting techniques and adjusting denoise levels.

inputs.name: denoise
inputs.description: Specifies the level of denoising to apply to the image, influencing the clarity and noise reduction in the output.

inputs.name: inpaint_mask_blur
inputs.description: Determines the blur intensity of the inpainting mask, affecting the smoothness of the inpainting boundaries.

inputs.name: inpaint_mask_mode
inputs.description: Defines the mode of inpainting mask application, dictating how the mask is used to guide the inpainting process.

inputs.name: data
inputs.description: Optional data stream for additional processing or information, providing flexibility in handling image data.

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: The modified image data stream, incorporating the applied inpainting and denoise adjustments.

SeargeImageAdapterV2.description: The SeargeImageAdapterV2 node is designed to adapt image inputs for further processing within the SDXL framework, enabling the integration and manipulation of source images, image masks, and uploaded masks. It facilitates the creation of a standardized data structure for image-related inputs, ensuring compatibility and ease of use across various image processing operations.

inputs.name: data
inputs.description: An optional data stream that can be provided to include additional information or parameters for image processing. It serves as a flexible input to accommodate various data needs.

inputs.name: source_image
inputs.description: An optional image input representing the primary source image for processing. It plays a crucial role in image adaptation tasks.

inputs.name: image_mask
inputs.description: An optional mask input for the source image, used to specify areas of interest or exclusion during image processing.

inputs.name: uploaded_mask
inputs.description: An optional mask input uploaded by the user, allowing for custom mask definitions in image processing tasks.

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: Returns the adapted data stream, enriched with image processing inputs.

outputs.name: image_inputs
outputs.description: unknown

SeargeImageSave.description: The SeargeImageSave node is designed to manage the saving of images generated within the SeargeSDXL framework. It incorporates logic to handle various states of image saving, including enabling or disabling the saving of upscaled images and applying fixes for high-resolution image saving. This node plays a crucial role in the image generation pipeline by ensuring that images are saved according to user preferences and settings, including the handling of special cases such as saving to specific directories.

inputs.name: images
inputs.description: Specifies the images to be saved, serving as the primary content for the node's saving functionalities.

inputs.name: filename_prefix
inputs.description: Defines the prefix for filenames under which images will be saved, influencing the naming convention used for saved images.

inputs.name: state
inputs.description: Determines the state of image saving (enabled or disabled), directly affecting whether images are saved or not.

inputs.name: save_to
inputs.description: Indicates the directory (output or input folder) where images should be saved, guiding the node's decision on where to store generated images.

SeargeImageSaving.description: This node is designed for the purpose of saving images during various stages of image generation and processing. It handles the intricacies of saving original, high-resolution, and upscaled images based on specific conditions and settings, ensuring that the images are stored correctly and efficiently.

inputs.name: save_parameters_file
inputs.description: Determines whether the parameters file should be saved, impacting the node's operation by enabling or disabling the saving of parameter configurations.

inputs.name: save_folder
inputs.description: Specifies the folder where images and related files should be saved, influencing the node's behavior in terms of organizing saved outputs.

inputs.name: save_generated_image
inputs.description: Controls the saving of generated images, playing a crucial role in the node's operation by dictating whether or not these images are persisted.

inputs.name: embed_workflow_in_generated
inputs.description: Determines whether the workflow information should be embedded in generated images, affecting the node's functionality by enabling or disabling the embedding of workflow metadata.

inputs.name: generated_image_name
inputs.description: Specifies the name for generated images, influencing how saved images are named and organized.

inputs.name: save_high_res_image
inputs.description: Determines the saving of high-resolution images, affecting the node's functionality by enabling or disabling the saving of these images.

inputs.name: embed_workflow_in_high_res
inputs.description: Decides if workflow information should be embedded in high-resolution images, impacting the node's behavior by enabling or disabling the embedding of workflow metadata in high-res images.

inputs.name: high_res_image_name
inputs.description: Specifies the name for high-resolution images, influencing how these images are named and organized upon saving.

inputs.name: save_upscaled_image
inputs.description: Controls the saving of upscaled images, impacting the node's behavior by dictating the saving process of upscaled images.

inputs.name: embed_workflow_in_upscaled
inputs.description: Determines whether workflow information should be embedded in upscaled images, affecting the node's functionality by enabling or disabling the embedding of workflow metadata in upscaled images.

inputs.name: upscaled_image_name
inputs.description: Specifies the name for upscaled images, influencing how these images are named and organized.

inputs.name: data
inputs.description: An optional parameter that allows passing additional data through the node, potentially affecting its operation based on the provided data.

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: Returns the modified data with image saving settings applied, facilitating further processing or utilization downstream.

SeargeInput1.description: SeargeInput1 is designed to aggregate and organize various textual prompts and styles into a unified parameter set for further processing. It serves as a multiplexer, combining inputs related to main and secondary prompts, style descriptions, and negative prompts and styles, along with optional image and mask inputs, into a single, structured output.

inputs.name: main_prompt
inputs.description: The primary text prompt for generating or influencing content. It serves as the main input for content creation or modification.

inputs.name: secondary_prompt
inputs.description: A supplementary text prompt that provides additional context or direction alongside the main prompt.

inputs.name: style_prompt
inputs.description: A text prompt that specifies the desired style or tone for the content being generated or modified.

inputs.name: negative_prompt
inputs.description: A text prompt that indicates what themes or elements should be avoided in the generated content.

inputs.name: negative_style
inputs.description: A text prompt that specifies styles or tones to be avoided in the content creation process.

inputs.name: inputs
inputs.description: An optional parameter for passing in previously defined inputs, allowing for dynamic input aggregation and modification.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: An optional image input that can be used to influence or guide the content generation process.

inputs.name: mask
inputs.description: An optional mask input for the image, used to specify areas of interest or exclusion in content generation.

outputs.name: inputs
outputs.description: The aggregated set of parameters, including prompts, styles, and optional image and mask inputs, structured for further processing.

SeargeInput2.description: The node is designed to facilitate the integration and manipulation of various input types for generating or modifying content, focusing on enhancing user interaction with the system by providing a structured way to input data.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.description: Specifies the initial value for random number generation, ensuring reproducibility and consistency in the generated content.

inputs.name: image_width
inputs.description: Determines the width of the generated image, allowing for customization of the output's dimensions.

inputs.name: image_height
inputs.description: Sets the height of the generated image, enabling control over the output's size.

inputs.name: steps
inputs.description: Defines the number of steps the generation process should take, affecting the detail and quality of the output.

inputs.name: cfg
inputs.description: Controls the configuration setting for the generation process, influencing the output's characteristics.

inputs.name: sampler_name
inputs.description: Selects the sampling algorithm used during generation, impacting the diversity and quality of results.

inputs.name: scheduler
inputs.description: Chooses the scheduling algorithm for the generation process, affecting the progression and quality of outputs.

inputs.name: save_image
inputs.description: Determines whether the generated image should be saved, facilitating content preservation.

inputs.name: save_directory
inputs.description: Specifies the directory where generated images will be saved, organizing output management.

inputs.name: inputs
inputs.description: Optional additional inputs that can be provided for the generation process, offering further customization.

outputs.name: inputs
outputs.description: Outputs the parameters used in the generation process, encapsulating the configured inputs for potential reuse or analysis.

SeargeInput3.description: SeargeInput3 is designed to process and integrate various input types for generating or modifying content, focusing on combining different forms of prompts and styles to tailor the output according to specific requirements or preferences.

inputs.name: base_ratio
inputs.description: Specifies the base ratio for high-resolution image processing, influencing the balance between base and refined details in the output.

inputs.name: refiner_strength
inputs.description: Determines the strength of the refinement process, affecting the intensity of details and textures in the final image.

inputs.name: refiner_intensity
inputs.description: Controls the intensity of the refiner's effect, allowing for finer adjustments to how much the refiner alters the image.

inputs.name: precondition_steps
inputs.description: Defines the number of steps to precondition the image, preparing it for further processing or refinement.

inputs.name: batch_size
inputs.description: Sets the batch size for processing, impacting performance and the amount of data processed simultaneously.

inputs.name: upscale_resolution_factor
inputs.description: Adjusts the factor by which the image resolution is increased, directly influencing the output image's clarity and detail.

inputs.name: save_upscaled_image
inputs.description: Determines whether the upscaled image is saved, providing control over the output management.

inputs.name: inputs
inputs.description: Optional inputs for additional parameters or configurations, offering flexibility in the processing workflow.

inputs.name: denoise
inputs.description: Applies a denoising filter to the image, reducing noise and potentially improving visual quality.

outputs.name: inputs
outputs.description: The processed inputs, potentially including modified or additional parameters for further stages of content generation or modification.

SeargeInput4.description: SeargeInput4 is designed to manage and process model names within the system, facilitating the selection and application of different AI models for various tasks. It abstracts the complexity of handling model identifiers, ensuring seamless integration and operation across different components.

inputs.name: base_model
inputs.description: Specifies the base model to be used, impacting the selection process and ultimately influencing the outcomes of the tasks performed by the node.

inputs.name: refiner_model
inputs.description: Specifies the refiner model to be used, impacting the selection process and ultimately influencing the outcomes of the tasks performed by the node.

inputs.name: vae_model
inputs.description: Specifies the VAE model to be used, impacting the selection process and ultimately influencing the outcomes of the tasks performed by the node.

inputs.name: main_upscale_model
inputs.description: Specifies the main upscale model to be used, impacting the selection process and ultimately influencing the outcomes of the tasks performed by the node.

inputs.name: support_upscale_model
inputs.description: Specifies the support upscale model to be used, impacting the selection process and ultimately influencing the outcomes of the tasks performed by the node.

inputs.name: lora_model
inputs.description: Specifies the LORA model to be used, impacting the selection process and ultimately influencing the outcomes of the tasks performed by the node.

inputs.name: model_settings
inputs.description: Optional settings for the models that can further customize the processing and application of the models.

outputs.name: model_names
outputs.description: Returns the processed model names, ready for use in subsequent operations, indicating successful handling and preparation of model identifiers.

SeargeInput5.description: SeargeInput5 is designed for prompt processing within the SeargeSDXL framework. It focuses on refining and adjusting input prompts to better suit the generation process, ensuring that the prompts are optimized for the specific requirements of the SeargeSDXL models.

inputs.name: base_conditioning_scale
inputs.description: Specifies the scale factor for base conditioning, influencing the impact of the base prompts on the generation process.

inputs.name: refiner_conditioning_scale
inputs.description: Determines the scale factor for refiner conditioning, affecting how much the refiner prompts contribute to the final generated content.

inputs.name: style_prompt_power
inputs.description: Controls the intensity of the style prompt's influence, allowing for fine-tuning of the stylistic elements in the generated content.

inputs.name: negative_style_power
inputs.description: Adjusts the degree to which negative style prompts are considered, helping to avoid undesired stylistic elements.

inputs.name: style_template
inputs.description: A template for styling the prompts, providing a structured approach to applying stylistic adjustments.

inputs.name: inputs
inputs.description: A collection of input parameters and prompts that are processed and refined for content generation.

outputs.name: inputs
outputs.description: The processed and refined collection of input parameters and prompts, ready for further processing or content generation.

SeargeInput6.description: SeargeInput6 is designed to handle high-resolution fix parameters, providing a specialized interface for adjusting and applying high-definition enhancements to generated content.

inputs.name: hires_fix
inputs.description: Specifies whether high-resolution fixes are enabled or disabled, allowing for toggling of high-definition enhancements.

inputs.name: hrf_steps
inputs.description: Determines the number of steps for the high-resolution fix process, affecting the detail and quality of enhancements.

inputs.name: hrf_denoise
inputs.description: Sets the denoise level for high-resolution fixes, impacting the clarity and noise reduction in the enhanced output.

inputs.name: hrf_upscale_factor
inputs.description: Defines the upscale factor, controlling the degree of size increase for high-resolution enhancements.

inputs.name: hrf_intensity
inputs.description: Adjusts the intensity of the refiner, influencing the strength of high-resolution enhancements.

inputs.name: hrf_seed_offset
inputs.description: Specifies the seed offset for noise generation, affecting the randomness and variation in the high-resolution enhancements.

inputs.name: hrf_smoothness
inputs.description: Controls the smoothness level of the high-resolution fix, impacting the softness or sharpness of the enhanced output.

inputs.name: inputs
inputs.description: Optional additional parameters that can be included for more granular control over the high-resolution fix process.

outputs.name: inputs
outputs.description: Returns a dictionary of parameters, including high-resolution fix settings, ready for further processing or application.

SeargeInput7.description: SeargeInput7 is designed to process miscellaneous parameters for a user interface, specifically handling inputs like 'lora_strength', 'operation_mode', and 'prompt_style'. It combines these inputs, optionally with additional parameters, to configure and customize the operation of a system or application.

inputs.name: lora_strength
inputs.description: Specifies the strength of the LoRA (Long Range) parameter, affecting the intensity or effect of an operation within the system.

inputs.name: operation_mode
inputs.description: Defines the mode of operation for the system, allowing users to select from predefined modes to tailor the system's behavior.

inputs.name: prompt_style
inputs.description: Determines the style of prompts used within the system, enabling customization of user interactions or outputs.

inputs.name: inputs
inputs.description: Optional additional parameters provided by the user, which are merged with the primary inputs to further customize the system's operation.

outputs.name: inputs
outputs.description: A comprehensive set of parameters, including 'lora_strength', 'operation_mode', and 'prompt_style', along with any additional inputs, configured for system operation.

SeargeIntegerConstant.description: The SeargeIntegerConstant node is designed to provide a constant integer value as output. It serves as a simple utility within a larger system to supply fixed numerical values, facilitating operations or calculations that require a specific, unchanging integer.

inputs.name: value
inputs.description: Specifies the constant integer value to be returned by the node. This parameter allows for the customization of the output based on the user's needs, ensuring flexibility in providing a specific integer constant.

outputs.name: value
outputs.description: The constant integer value specified by the input parameter. This output is used in subsequent operations or calculations that require a fixed integer.

SeargeIntegerMath.description: The SeargeIntegerMath node provides mathematical operations on integer values, supporting basic arithmetic functions such as addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division. It allows for the dynamic execution of predefined operations based on input parameters, facilitating various integer math computations.

inputs.name: op
inputs.description: Specifies the mathematical operation to be performed, chosen from a predefined set of operations. This determines how the input integers are processed and affects the outcome of the computation.

inputs.name: a
inputs.description: The first integer operand in the mathematical operation, serving as a primary input for the computation.

inputs.name: b
inputs.description: The second integer operand, used in operations involving two inputs, such as multiplication or division.

inputs.name: c
inputs.description: An optional third integer operand, used in operations that require an additional input, such as adding a constant after multiplication.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: The integer result of the specified mathematical operation.

SeargeIntegerPair.description: The SeargeIntegerPair node is designed to handle pairs of integer values, allowing for the retrieval and manipulation of these pairs within a deprecated integer-based context. It focuses on providing a straightforward interface for working with two integer values, emphasizing simplicity and directness in integer operations.

inputs.name: value1
inputs.description: Represents the first integer value in the pair. It is crucial for defining the pair's first component and influences the node's output by serving as one of the two primary integers to be processed.

inputs.name: value2
inputs.description: Denotes the second integer value in the pair. This parameter is essential for completing the integer pair and affects the node's functionality by being the second primary integer to be handled alongside 'value1'.

outputs.name: value 1
outputs.description: The first integer value of the pair, returned as is from the input without modification.

outputs.name: value 2
outputs.description: The second integer value of the pair, returned unchanged from the input, completing the integer pair output.

SeargeIntegerScaler.description: The SeargeIntegerScaler node is designed for scaling integer values by a specified factor and ensuring the result is a multiple of a given value. It abstracts the mathematical operation of scaling and rounding to meet specific numerical constraints, making it a utility for precise integer manipulation.

inputs.name: value
inputs.description: The base integer value to be scaled. It serves as the primary input for the scaling operation.

inputs.name: factor
inputs.description: A floating-point factor by which the base value is scaled. This allows for proportional scaling of the integer value.

inputs.name: multiple_of
inputs.description: Specifies that the resulting scaled value should be a multiple of this integer. It ensures the result adheres to specific alignment or divisibility requirements.

outputs.name: value
outputs.description: The scaled integer value, adjusted to be a multiple of the specified 'multiple_of' parameter.

SeargeLatentMuxer3.description: The SeargeLatentMuxer3 node is designed for selecting one of three provided latent inputs based on a specified selector input. It facilitates dynamic control over which latent input to proceed with in a computational graph, allowing for flexible manipulation of latent representations in generative models.

inputs.name: input0
inputs.description: The first latent input option for selection.

inputs.name: input1
inputs.description: The second latent input option for selection.

inputs.name: input2
inputs.description: The third latent input option for selection.

inputs.name: input_selector
inputs.description: An integer selector that determines which of the three latent inputs to use. The selector ranges from 0 to 2, with each number corresponding to one of the latent inputs.

outputs.name: output
outputs.description: The selected latent input, based on the value of the input selector.

SeargeLoraLoader.description: The SeargeLoraLoader node is designed to load and apply LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation) modifications to models and CLIPs. It facilitates the dynamic adjustment of model behaviors by applying specific LoRA modifications, which are identified by their names and strengths, to the base models and CLIPs. This process allows for fine-tuning and customization of model outputs based on the applied LoRAs.

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: The base model to which the LoRA modifications will be applied. It serves as the foundation for the LoRA adjustments.

inputs.name: clip
inputs.description: The CLIP model to which the LoRA modifications will be applied, allowing for adjustments in how the CLIP model processes or interprets data.

inputs.name: lora_name
inputs.description: The name of the LoRA modification to apply, which identifies the specific LoRA file or setting to be used for the adjustment.

inputs.name: strength_model
inputs.description: The strength of the LoRA modification applied to the model, determining the intensity of the adjustment.

inputs.name: strength_clip
inputs.description: The strength of the LoRA modification applied to the CLIP, determining the intensity of the adjustment.

outputs.name: model
outputs.description: The model after applying the specified LoRA modifications, reflecting the adjustments made.

outputs.name: clip
outputs.description: The CLIP model after applying the specified LoRA modifications, reflecting the adjustments made.

SeargeLoras.description: SeargeLoras is designed to manage and apply LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation) adjustments to models within a generative AI framework. It dynamically adjusts the LoRA stack based on input parameters, ensuring that the model's behavior is modified according to specified LoRA configurations for enhanced performance or specific outcomes.

inputs.name: lora_i
inputs.description: Specifies the LoRA's name, serving as a key identifier for applying specific LoRA adjustments. This is a generic placeholder for multiple LoRA inputs (lora_1 to lora_5).

inputs.name: lora_i_strength
inputs.description: Determines the strength of the LoRA's effect, influencing how significantly the LoRA adjustment alters the model. This applies to multiple LoRA inputs, each having its own strength parameter.

inputs.name: data
inputs.description: An optional data structure that can be provided to include additional context or parameters for the LoRA adjustments.

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: Returns the updated data structure including the modified LoRA stack, reflecting the applied LoRA adjustments.

SeargeMagicBox.description: SeargeMagicBox orchestrates a complex pipeline for image generation and manipulation, leveraging a series of specialized processing stages. It dynamically selects and executes various stages such as data preprocessing, checkpoint loading, image styling, and resolution enhancement, facilitating a customizable and modular approach to generating high-quality images.

inputs.name: stage
inputs.description: Specifies the current processing stage to be executed, determining the specific operation or transformation to be applied to the image data.

inputs.name: input_from
inputs.description: Indicates the source of input for the current stage, potentially allowing for custom input alongside standard pipeline data.

inputs.name: output_to
inputs.description: Specifies the destination for the stage's output, enabling custom handling or integration into the standard data stream.

inputs.name: data
inputs.description: The data object that carries the image and related information through the processing pipeline, serving as the input and output medium for each stage.

inputs.name: custom_input
inputs.description: Provides a mechanism for supplying custom input data to a stage, enabling specialized processing beyond the standard pipeline content.

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: The updated data object, reflecting the modifications and additions made by the current processing stage.

outputs.name: custom_output
outputs.description: Custom output generated by the current stage, available for use in subsequent stages or for external processing.

SeargeModelSelector.description: The SeargeModelSelector node facilitates the selection of models for various stages of image generation and refinement within the ComfyUI framework, specifically designed for the SDXL environment. It allows users to specify base, refiner, and VAE checkpoints, optionally incorporating additional data streams for enhanced customization.

inputs.name: base_checkpoint
inputs.description: Specifies the base model checkpoint for the initial stage of image generation, serving as the foundation for further processing.

inputs.name: refiner_checkpoint
inputs.description: Determines the refiner model checkpoint used to refine the initial image outputs, enhancing their quality or details.

inputs.name: vae_checkpoint
inputs.description: Indicates the VAE model checkpoint, which is used for variational autoencoder processes, potentially embedding additional information into the generation process.

inputs.name: data
inputs.description: An optional data stream that can be used for further customization or processing within the image generation pipeline.

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: Returns a data stream that includes the selected model checkpoints, ready for use in subsequent image generation stages.

SeargeOperatingMode.description: The SeargeOperatingMode node is designed to configure and manage the operating modes within the ComfyUI environment, specifically tailored for the SDXL suite. It allows for the dynamic adjustment of workflow and prompting modes, as well as batch processing sizes, thereby facilitating a flexible and customizable user interaction experience.

inputs.name: workflow_mode
inputs.description: Specifies the workflow mode, determining the overall process flow and operations available within the UI, such as text-to-image or image-to-image conversions.

inputs.name: prompting_mode
inputs.description: Defines the prompting mode, influencing how users are prompted for input and how that input is processed and utilized within the system.

inputs.name: batch_size
inputs.description: Determines the number of items to be processed in a single batch, allowing for efficient bulk processing of tasks.

inputs.name: data
inputs.description: Optional data stream for additional configurations or parameters that may be required by the operating mode.

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: The configured data stream, enriched with the selected operating mode settings.

SeargeOutput1.description: SeargeOutput1 is designed to demultiplex and output a variety of prompt-related parameters and media from a single input structure. It focuses on extracting and organizing textual prompts, styles, and associated images or masks for further processing or display, serving as a critical node in the pipeline for handling and refining user inputs into actionable data for generative models.

inputs.name: parameters
inputs.description: The 'parameters' input is the central data structure from which all output parameters are derived, containing all necessary information about prompts, styles, and media for the node to process.

outputs.name: parameters
outputs.description: Returns the original input parameters for reference or further use.

outputs.name: main_prompt
outputs.description: Extracts the main textual prompt for generation.

outputs.name: secondary_prompt
outputs.description: Extracts a secondary textual prompt, potentially for refinement or additional context.

outputs.name: style_prompt
outputs.description: Extracts a style-related textual prompt, indicating the desired artistic or thematic direction.

outputs.name: negative_prompt
outputs.description: Extracts a textual prompt meant to guide the generation away from certain themes or elements.

outputs.name: negative_style
outputs.description: Extracts a style-related prompt intended to negate or counterbalance certain stylistic directions.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: Outputs an image associated with the input parameters, potentially for use as a reference or starting point in generation.

outputs.name: mask
outputs.description: Outputs a mask associated with the input parameters, potentially for use in targeted image manipulation or generation.

SeargeOutput2.description: The SeargeOutput2 node is designed to demultiplex and output a set of generation parameters for image creation, including seed, dimensions, steps, and configuration settings. It plays a crucial role in configuring the generative process by providing detailed control over the generation parameters.

inputs.name: parameters
inputs.description: This parameter contains all the necessary settings for image generation, including seed, image dimensions, steps, CFG scale, sampler and scheduler names, and options for saving images. It's essential for defining the behavior and output of the generative process.

outputs.name: parameters
outputs.description: Returns the original set of parameters provided as input, facilitating further processing or utilization in the workflow.

outputs.name: seed
outputs.description: The seed value for random number generation, ensuring reproducibility of the generated images.

outputs.name: image_width
outputs.description: The width of the generated image in pixels.

outputs.name: image_height
outputs.description: The height of the generated image in pixels.

outputs.name: steps
outputs.description: The number of steps to run the generation process, affecting the detail and quality of the output.

outputs.name: cfg
outputs.description: The CFG scale used to control the trade-off between fidelity to the text prompt and the randomness of the generated images.

outputs.name: sampler_name
outputs.description: The name of the sampler algorithm used for image generation.

outputs.name: scheduler
outputs.description: The name of the scheduler algorithm used to manage the generation steps.

outputs.name: save_image
outputs.description: A boolean indicating whether the generated image should be saved.

outputs.name: save_directory
outputs.description: The directory path where the generated image will be saved, if applicable.

SeargeOutput3.description: SeargeOutput3 is designed to demultiplex and extract advanced parameters from a given input, facilitating the customization and fine-tuning of generative models or processes.

inputs.name: parameters
inputs.description: Represents the advanced parameters for generative processes, playing a crucial role in customizing and fine-tuning the output.

outputs.name: parameters
outputs.description: Returns the original set of advanced parameters provided as input.

outputs.name: denoise
outputs.description: Specifies the denoise level for the generative process, influencing the clarity and detail of the generated output.

outputs.name: base_ratio
outputs.description: Determines the base model's contribution ratio in the generative process, balancing between base and refiner models.

outputs.name: refiner_strength
outputs.description: Adjusts the strength of the refiner model, affecting the refinement level of the generated output.

outputs.name: noise_offset
outputs.description: Controls the offset of noise applied during the generation, impacting the variation and uniqueness of the output.

outputs.name: precondition_steps
outputs.description: Defines the number of preconditioning steps to prepare the model before generation, optimizing the output quality.

outputs.name: batch_size
outputs.description: Sets the batch size for the generation process, affecting the processing speed and resource utilization.

outputs.name: upscale_resolution_factor
outputs.description: Specifies the factor by which the output resolution is upscaled, enhancing the detail and quality of the final image.

outputs.name: save_upscaled_image
outputs.description: Indicates whether the upscaled image should be saved, providing an option to retain higher resolution outputs.

SeargeOutput4.description: SeargeOutput4 is designed to demultiplex model names and configurations for various components of a generative AI model, including base, refiner, VAE, and upscale models, as well as Lora models. It abstracts the complexity of handling multiple model configurations, streamlining the process of selecting and configuring the appropriate models for generation tasks.

inputs.name: model_names
inputs.description: Specifies the names and configurations of various models involved in the generation process, including base, refiner, VAE, main upscale, support upscale, and Lora models. It is crucial for determining the specific models to be used and their configurations.

outputs.name: model_names
outputs.description: Returns the original dictionary of model names and configurations, facilitating access to model identifiers.

outputs.name: base_model
outputs.description: Identifies the base model used for initial generation.

outputs.name: refiner_model
outputs.description: Specifies the refiner model for enhancing the initial generation.

outputs.name: vae_model
outputs.description: Denotes the VAE model used for variational autoencoding tasks.

outputs.name: main_upscale_model
outputs.description: Indicates the primary upscale model for image resolution enhancement.

outputs.name: support_upscale_model
outputs.description: Specifies the secondary upscale model, supporting the main upscale model.

outputs.name: lora_model
outputs.description: Identifies the Lora model used for specific model adjustments or enhancements.

SeargeOutput5.description: SeargeOutput5 is designed to demultiplex and output prompt processing parameters, including various scales and powers related to base and refiner conditioning, as well as style prompt power adjustments. This node plays a crucial role in fine-tuning the generation process by providing detailed control over the influence of different components on the final output.

inputs.name: parameters
inputs.description: The 'parameters' input contains key-value pairs specifying the scales and powers for base conditioning, refiner conditioning, style prompt, and negative style, which are essential for adjusting the generation process.

outputs.name: parameters
outputs.description: Returns the original set of parameters provided as input, allowing for further processing or utilization downstream.

outputs.name: base_conditioning_scale
outputs.description: Specifies the scale factor for base conditioning, influencing the initial stage of generation.

outputs.name: refiner_conditioning_scale
outputs.description: Determines the scale factor for refiner conditioning, affecting the refinement stage of generation.

outputs.name: style_prompt_power
outputs.description: Indicates the power applied to the style prompt, adjusting its influence on the generation.

outputs.name: negative_style_power
outputs.description: Specifies the power applied to negative styles, allowing for the reduction of unwanted stylistic elements.

SeargeOutput6.description: SeargeOutput6 is designed to output HiResFix parameters, facilitating the adjustment and optimization of high-resolution image generation processes within the SeargeSDXL framework.

inputs.name: parameters
inputs.description: This parameter contains HiResFix settings and configurations, playing a crucial role in determining the behavior of high-resolution image enhancements.

outputs.name: parameters
outputs.description: Returns the HiResFix parameters, enabling fine-tuning of high-resolution image processing.

outputs.name: hrf_steps
outputs.description: Specifies the number of steps for the HiResFix process, impacting the detail level of the output image.

outputs.name: hrf_denoise
outputs.description: Controls the denoising level applied during the HiResFix process, affecting image clarity.

outputs.name: hrf_upscale_factor
outputs.description: Determines the upscaling factor, influencing the final image size in the HiResFix process.

outputs.name: hrf_noise_offset
outputs.description: Adjusts the noise offset, modifying the texture and noise characteristics of the output image.

outputs.name: hrf_seed
outputs.description: The seed value for random number generation, ensuring reproducibility of the HiResFix process.

outputs.name: hires_fix
outputs.description: Indicates whether the high-resolution fix is enabled, toggling the application of HiResFix enhancements.

outputs.name: hrf_smoothness
outputs.description: Sets the smoothness level, affecting the softness or sharpness of the final image.

SeargeOutput7.description: SeargeOutput7 is designed to demultiplex and output specific parameters related to miscellaneous settings, including the strength of LoRA adjustments, from a given set of parameters. It focuses on extracting and providing access to detailed configuration options that may affect the generation process or model behavior.

inputs.name: parameters
inputs.description: The 'parameters' input contains miscellaneous settings that may include various configuration options and values, such as LoRA strength, which are crucial for adjusting the generation process or model behavior.

outputs.name: parameters
outputs.description: Returns the original set of miscellaneous parameters, allowing for further processing or utilization in subsequent steps.

outputs.name: lora_strength
outputs.description: Outputs the LoRA strength value extracted from the input parameters, indicating the level of LoRA adjustments applied.

SeargeParameterProcessor.description: The SeargeParameterProcessor node is designed to process and refine parameters for image generation tasks, incorporating advanced settings such as seed manipulation, style template adjustments, and high-resolution fix parameters. It acts as a central hub for configuring the generation process, ensuring that inputs like prompts, generation parameters, and model names are optimally adjusted for the desired output.

inputs.name: inputs
inputs.description: Accepts a variety of parameters for processing, including but not limited to prompts, generation parameters, model names, and advanced settings, allowing for a comprehensive customization of the image generation process.

outputs.name: parameters
outputs.description: Outputs a dictionary of processed parameters, ready for use in the image generation process, ensuring that all inputs have been optimally adjusted for the desired outcome.

SeargePipelineStart.description: This node initiates the pipeline for data processing, setting up the initial conditions and configurations necessary for the workflow to proceed.
