It prepares the data stream by merging any additional data provided, configures pipeline settings based on the workflow version, and updates the pipeline with hidden and version-specific information.

inputs.name: wf_version
inputs.description: Specifies the version of the workflow to be used, determining the configuration and behavior of the pipeline.

inputs.name: data
inputs.description: The primary data stream to be processed by the pipeline. This data can be augmented with additional data if provided.

inputs.name: additional_data
inputs.description: Optional data that can be merged with the primary data stream for enhanced processing capabilities.

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: The processed data stream, ready for further stages in the pipeline.

SeargePipelineTerminator.description: This node is designed to terminate an ongoing pipeline within the ComfyUI SDXL environment, effectively halting any further processing or data manipulation within that pipeline.

inputs.name: data
inputs.description: An optional data stream that may contain pipeline-specific information or states to be terminated. It's used to access and terminate the specific pipeline instance.

SeargePreviewImage.description: The SeargePreviewImage node is designed to provide a preview of images by optionally saving them to a temporary directory. It allows for the conditional processing and display of images based on the enabled state and the presence of images to preview, incorporating additional image metadata if provided.

inputs.name: enabled
inputs.description: Determines whether the image preview functionality is active. When false, the node will not process or display any images.

inputs.name: images
inputs.description: The images to be previewed. This parameter is optional and allows for the display of images if they are provided and the preview is enabled.

outputs.name: images
outputs.description: The images that have been processed for preview, potentially saved with additional metadata.

SeargePromptAdapterV2.description: The SeargePromptAdapterV2 node is designed to adapt input prompts for further processing or generation tasks, enabling customization and refinement of text inputs to fit specific requirements or formats.

inputs.name: data
inputs.description: This input represents a data stream that can include various types of information, serving as a flexible container for inputs that the node can process or transform.

inputs.name: main_prompt
inputs.description: Captures the primary text prompt intended for guiding the generation process, focusing on the main subject or theme.

inputs.name: secondary_prompt
inputs.description: This input captures additional text prompts that complement the main prompt, offering further context or detail.

inputs.name: style_prompt
inputs.description: Specifies a style or tone for the text generation, influencing the mood or character of the output.

inputs.name: negative_main_prompt
inputs.description: Captures negative text prompts to avoid certain topics or attributes in the generation process.

inputs.name: negative_secondary_prompt
inputs.description: Additional negative prompts that help refine the filtering process by excluding undesired elements.

inputs.name: negative_style_prompt
inputs.description: Defines a style or tone to be avoided in the text generation, ensuring the output does not carry undesired characteristics.

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: A data stream that includes the processed or transformed inputs, ready for further use or generation tasks.

outputs.name: prompts
outputs.description: A collection of prompts, both positive and negative, formatted and ready for use in generation tasks.

SeargePromptCombiner.description: The SeargePromptCombiner node is designed to merge two input prompts into a single output prompt, optionally separated by a specified delimiter. This functionality is useful in scenarios where dynamic prompt construction is needed, allowing for the combination of separate prompt elements into a cohesive whole.

inputs.name: prompt1
inputs.description: The first prompt to be combined. It serves as the initial part of the new, merged prompt.

inputs.name: separator
inputs.description: A string used to separate the two prompts when combined. This allows for customizable spacing or punctuation between prompt elements.

inputs.name: prompt2
inputs.description: The second prompt to be combined. It follows the separator and completes the merged prompt.

outputs.name: combined prompt
outputs.description: The result of merging prompt1 and prompt2, optionally separated by the separator. This is the final, combined prompt ready for use.

SeargePromptStyles.description: The SeargePromptStyles node is designed to enhance and customize the styling of prompts within the ComfyUI environment. It allows for the dynamic integration of styling options into the data stream, enabling a more tailored and visually coherent user interface experience.

inputs.name: data
inputs.description: An optional data stream that can be enhanced with prompt styling information. If provided, it is augmented with styling details; otherwise, a new styling data structure is initiated.

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: The enhanced or newly created data stream, now containing prompt styling information, ready for further processing or display within the UI.

SeargePromptText.description: The SeargePromptText node is designed for capturing and processing textual input for prompts in a deprecated Searge prompting system. It primarily serves to receive a user-defined text prompt, maintaining simplicity and directness in its approach.

inputs.name: prompt
inputs.description: The 'prompt' parameter is the primary text input from the user, serving as the basis for further processing or generation tasks within the node. It allows multiline input, enabling more detailed and complex prompts.

outputs.name: prompt
outputs.description: This output is the unaltered text received from the input, directly passed through for use in subsequent processing or generation stages.

SeargeSamplerInputs.description: The SeargeSamplerInputs node is designed to manage and provide sampler and scheduler configurations for sampling processes. It abstracts the complexity of selecting appropriate sampling strategies by offering predefined options and defaults, thereby facilitating the customization and optimization of sampling operations.

inputs.name: sampler_name
inputs.description: Specifies the name of the sampler to be used. This parameter allows for the selection among various predefined samplers, influencing the sampling behavior and results.

inputs.name: scheduler
inputs.description: Determines the scheduling strategy to be employed during sampling. This parameter influences how samples are generated over time, affecting the overall sampling process.

outputs.name: sampler_name
outputs.description: The name of the selected sampler, reflecting the choice made for the sampling process.

outputs.name: scheduler
outputs.description: The name of the chosen scheduler, indicating the scheduling strategy employed for sampling.

SeargeSaveFolderInputs.description: This node is designed to handle input related to saving files in a specific folder, allowing users to specify the destination for saved files within a deprecated Searge module.

inputs.name: save_to
inputs.description: Specifies the destination folder where files should be saved. This parameter plays a crucial role in determining the output path for saved files.

outputs.name: save_to
outputs.description: Returns the specified destination folder for saving files, reflecting the user's input.

SeargeSDXLBasePromptEncoder.description: The SeargeSDXLBasePromptEncoder node is designed to encode base prompts for the SDXL model, focusing on converting textual descriptions into a format suitable for further processing or generation tasks. It serves as a foundational component in the pipeline, preparing the input for more specialized encoding or refinement stages.

inputs.name: base_clip
inputs.description: Serves as the primary input for the encoding process, representing the base CLIP model used to encode the prompts.

inputs.name: pos_g
inputs.description: Represents the global positive textual content to be encoded, crucial for guiding the model's generation towards desired attributes or themes.

inputs.name: pos_l
inputs.description: Specifies local positive textual content, complementing the global positive content to refine the encoding process.

inputs.name: neg_g
inputs.description: Represents the global negative textual content, used to steer the model away from undesired attributes or themes.

inputs.name: neg_l
inputs.description: Specifies local negative textual content, complementing the global negative content to refine the encoding process.

inputs.name: base_width
inputs.description: Defines the width of the base image for encoding, affecting the spatial dimensions of the encoded output.

inputs.name: base_height
inputs.description: Defines the height of the base image for encoding, affecting the spatial dimensions of the encoded output.

inputs.name: crop_w
inputs.description: Specifies the width of the crop area, allowing for focused encoding on a specific region of the base image.

inputs.name: crop_h
inputs.description: Specifies the height of the crop area, allowing for focused encoding on a specific region of the base image.

inputs.name: target_width
inputs.description: Determines the target width for the encoded output, influencing the resolution of the generation task.

inputs.name: target_height
inputs.description: Determines the target height for the encoded output, influencing the resolution of the generation task.

outputs.name: base_positive
outputs.description: The encoded positive prompt, ready for further processing or direct use in generation tasks.

outputs.name: base_negative
outputs.description: The encoded negative prompt, prepared for use in guiding the model away from undesired outputs.

SeargeSDXLImage2ImageSampler.description: This node specializes in image-to-image sampling, incorporating a high-resolution fix to enhance the quality of the output images. It leverages advanced sampling techniques to refine and generate images based on input conditions, aiming to produce high-fidelity results that closely match the specified criteria.

inputs.name: base_model
inputs.description: Specifies the base model used for the initial phase of image generation, influencing the core structure and style of the output.

inputs.name: base_positive
inputs.description: Positive conditioning text or criteria to guide the base model towards desired image attributes.

inputs.name: base_negative
inputs.description: Negative conditioning text or criteria to instruct the base model on what attributes to avoid in the image generation process.

inputs.name: refiner_model
inputs.description: Defines the model used in the refinement phase, aimed at enhancing details and adjusting aspects of the initially generated image.

inputs.name: refiner_positive
inputs.description: Positive conditioning for the refinement phase, focusing on enhancing or adding desired details to the image.

inputs.name: refiner_negative
inputs.description: Negative conditioning for the refinement phase, aimed at removing or minimizing undesired details in the image.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The initial image or its latent representation to be refined, serving as the starting point for the refinement process.

inputs.name: vae
inputs.description: The variational autoencoder used for processing the image or its latent representation.

inputs.name: noise_seed
inputs.description: A seed value for noise generation, ensuring reproducibility in the sampling process.

inputs.name: steps
inputs.description: The number of steps to be taken in the sampling process, affecting the detail and quality of the final image.

inputs.name: cfg
inputs.description: Configuration parameter influencing the sampling process's complexity and detail level.

inputs.name: sampler_name
inputs.description: The name of the sampling algorithm to be used, determining the approach to image generation and refinement.

inputs.name: scheduler
inputs.description: Specifies the scheduling algorithm for controlling the sampling process, impacting the progression and quality of image refinement.

inputs.name: base_ratio
inputs.description: Determines the balance between the base and refiner models' contributions to the final image.

inputs.name: denoise
inputs.description: The degree of denoising applied during the refinement process, affecting the smoothness and clarity of the image.

inputs.name: upscale_model
inputs.description: unknown

inputs.name: scaled_width
inputs.description: The target width for scaling the image during the refinement process.

inputs.name: scaled_height
inputs.description: The target height for scaling the image during the refinement process.

inputs.name: noise_offset
inputs.description: An offset applied to the noise seed, allowing for variation in the noise pattern during the refinement process.

inputs.name: refiner_strength
inputs.description: Controls the intensity of the refinement process, affecting how much the refiner model alters the initial image.

inputs.name: softness
inputs.description: Adjusts the softness of the image, influencing the blending and transition effects during refinement.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The final refined image, showcasing the combined effects of base and refinement conditioning, along with the applied sampling techniques.

SeargeSDXLImage2ImageSampler2.description: This node specializes in image-to-image sampling, incorporating high-resolution fixes to enhance the quality and detail of the output images. It leverages advanced sampling techniques to transform input images into refined versions, maintaining the essence while improving visual fidelity.

inputs.name: base_model
inputs.description: Specifies the base model used for the initial phase of image sampling, setting the foundation for subsequent refinements.

inputs.name: base_positive
inputs.description: Positive conditioning for the base model, guiding the initial image transformation with desired attributes.

inputs.name: base_negative
inputs.description: Negative conditioning for the base model, instructing it to avoid certain attributes during the initial transformation.

inputs.name: refiner_model
inputs.description: The model used for refining the output of the base model, enhancing details and overall image quality.

inputs.name: refiner_positive
inputs.description: Positive conditioning for the refiner model, further guiding the enhancement of image details.

inputs.name: refiner_negative
inputs.description: Negative conditioning for the refiner model, ensuring undesired attributes are minimized in the final output.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The original image input for the sampling process, serving as the basis for both initial transformation and subsequent refinement.

inputs.name: vae
inputs.description: The variational autoencoder used to process the image, contributing to the generation of latent representations.

inputs.name: noise_seed
inputs.description: A seed value for noise generation, ensuring reproducibility in the sampling process.

inputs.name: steps
inputs.description: The number of steps to be used in the sampling process, affecting the detail and quality of the output.

inputs.name: cfg
inputs.description: Configuration parameter influencing the sampling process, allowing for fine-tuning of the output.

inputs.name: sampler_name
inputs.description: Specifies the sampling algorithm to be used, affecting the approach to image transformation.

inputs.name: scheduler
inputs.description: Determines the scheduling algorithm for sampling, impacting the progression of image refinement.

inputs.name: base_ratio
inputs.description: Defines the ratio of steps allocated to the base model versus the refiner model, balancing between initial transformation and refinement.

inputs.name: denoise
inputs.description: Controls the level of denoising applied during the refinement process, affecting the clarity of the final image.

inputs.name: upscale_model
inputs.description: Specifies the model used for upscaling the image, enhancing its resolution as part of the refinement process.

inputs.name: scaled_width
inputs.description: The target width for image upscaling, defining the dimensions of the output image.

inputs.name: scaled_height
inputs.description: The target height for image upscaling, defining the dimensions of the output image.

inputs.name: noise_offset
inputs.description: Adjusts the noise level added during the sampling process, allowing for finer control over the texture and details of the output image.

inputs.name: refiner_strength
inputs.description: Determines the intensity of the refinement process, directly influencing the detail and quality of the final image.

inputs.name: softness
inputs.description: Adjusts the softness of the image, affecting the smoothness and blending of details during the refinement process.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The final, refined image output, showcasing enhanced detail and quality following the sampling process.

SeargeSDXLPromptEncoder.description: The SeargeSDXLPromptEncoder node is designed to encode prompts for the SDXL model, facilitating the generation of text prompts that are optimized for image synthesis tasks. It supports the encoding of both base and refined prompts, enabling users to fine-tune the prompt details for more precise image generation outcomes.

SeargeSDXLRefinerPromptEncoder.description: This node specializes in refining the encoding of prompts for the SDXL model by applying specific aesthetic and dimensional adjustments to both positive and negative prompts. It leverages a refiner encoder to enhance the quality and relevance of the prompts based on given aesthetic scores and dimensions, aiming to optimize the generation process.

inputs.name: refiner_clip
inputs.description: The CLIP model used for refining the encoding of prompts, central to adjusting the prompt's quality and relevance.

inputs.name: pos_r
inputs.description: Positive text prompt for refinement, influencing the encoding process with a focus on enhancing positive aspects.

inputs.name: neg_r
inputs.description: Negative text prompt for refinement, influencing the encoding process with a focus on enhancing negative aspects.

inputs.name: pos_ascore
inputs.description: The aesthetic score assigned to the positive prompt, influencing its refinement.

inputs.name: neg_ascore
inputs.description: The aesthetic score assigned to the negative prompt, influencing its refinement.

inputs.name: refiner_width
inputs.description: The width dimension for the refined encoding, used to adjust the spatial characteristics of the prompt.

inputs.name: refiner_height
inputs.description: The height dimension for the refined encoding, used to adjust the spatial characteristics of the prompt.

outputs.name: refiner_positive
outputs.description: The refined encoding of the positive prompt, enhanced for better quality and relevance.

outputs.name: refiner_negative
outputs.description: The refined encoding of the negative prompt, enhanced for better quality and relevance.

SeargeSDXLSampler.description: The SeargeSDXLSampler node is designed to facilitate sampling operations within the SDXL framework, providing foundational support for generating or refining samples based on specific inputs. It serves as a core component in the process of creating or enhancing digital content, leveraging the capabilities of the SDXL architecture.

inputs.name: base_model
inputs.description: Required input specifying the model to be used as the base for sampling, essential for the initial generation phase.

inputs.name: base_positive
inputs.description: Required input specifying positive conditioning for the base model, guiding the initial generation towards desired attributes.

inputs.name: base_negative
inputs.description: Required input specifying negative conditioning for the base model, steering the initial generation away from undesired attributes.

inputs.name: refiner_model
inputs.description: Required input specifying the model to be used for refining the initial samples, enhancing their quality or altering their characteristics.

inputs.name: refiner_positive
inputs.description: Required input specifying positive conditioning for the refiner model, guiding the refinement process towards desired attributes.

inputs.name: refiner_negative
inputs.description: Required input specifying negative conditioning for the refiner model, steering the refinement process away from undesired attributes.

inputs.name: latent_image
inputs.description: Required input specifying the latent image to be used as a starting point for the sampling or refinement process.

inputs.name: noise_seed
inputs.description: Optional input specifying the seed for noise generation, influencing the randomness of the sampling process.

inputs.name: steps
inputs.description: Required input specifying the number of steps to perform in the sampling process, affecting the detail and quality of the output.

inputs.name: cfg
inputs.description: Required input specifying the CFG (classifier-free guidance) scale, adjusting the influence of conditioning on the generation process.

inputs.name: sampler_name
inputs.description: Required input specifying the name of the sampler to use, determining the algorithm for the sampling process.

inputs.name: scheduler
inputs.description: Required input specifying the scheduler to use, affecting the progression of steps in the sampling process.

inputs.name: base_ratio
inputs.description: Required input specifying the ratio of influence between the base and refiner models on the final output, balancing their contributions.

inputs.name: denoise
inputs.description: Optional input specifying the denoise level, affecting the clarity and sharpness of the output.

outputs.description: unknown

SeargeSDXLSampler2.description: The SeargeSDXLSampler2 node is designed to facilitate the sampling process within the SDXL framework, providing mechanisms to generate or refine samples based on given inputs. It integrates legacy functionalities, ensuring compatibility and extending the capabilities of the SDXL sampling process with additional features or optimizations.

inputs.name: base_model
inputs.description: The 'base_model' parameter specifies the foundational model used for sampling, playing a critical role in defining the initial state and characteristics of the sample.

inputs.name: base_positive
inputs.description: The 'base_positive' parameter influences the sampling process by providing positive conditioning, guiding the generation towards desired attributes.

inputs.name: base_negative
inputs.description: The 'base_negative' parameter offers negative conditioning, helping to steer away the sampling process from undesired attributes.

inputs.name: refiner_model
inputs.description: The 'refiner_model' parameter is used to refine the initial samples, enhancing details or correcting aspects based on the refinement model.

inputs.name: refiner_positive
inputs.description: Similar to 'base_positive', the 'refiner_positive' parameter provides positive conditioning for the refinement stage, further shaping the sample's attributes.

inputs.name: refiner_negative
inputs.description: The 'refiner_negative' parameter applies negative conditioning in the refinement stage, aiding in the removal or reduction of undesired features.

inputs.name: latent_image
inputs.description: The 'latent_image' parameter represents the initial latent space representation to be refined or manipulated during the sampling process.

inputs.name: noise_seed
inputs.description: The 'noise_seed' parameter allows for the reproducibility of the sampling process by setting a specific seed for noise generation.

inputs.name: steps
inputs.description: The 'steps' parameter determines the number of steps or iterations the sampling process will undergo, affecting the detail and quality of the final sample.

inputs.name: cfg
inputs.description: The 'cfg' parameter controls the configuration strength, influencing the adherence to the conditioning provided and impacting the sample's fidelity.

inputs.name: sampler_name
inputs.description: The 'sampler_name' parameter specifies the sampling algorithm to be used, affecting the approach and method of sample generation.

inputs.name: scheduler
inputs.description: The 'scheduler' parameter determines the scheduling algorithm for the sampling process, impacting the progression and dynamics of sample refinement.

inputs.name: base_ratio
inputs.description: The 'base_ratio' parameter adjusts the balance between the base model and refiner model contributions, fine-tuning the final sample's appearance.

inputs.name: denoise
inputs.description: The 'denoise' parameter applies a denoising effect to the sample, potentially enhancing clarity and reducing noise artifacts.

inputs.name: refiner_prep_steps
inputs.description: The 'refiner_prep_steps' parameter specifies the number of preparatory steps for the refiner model, setting the stage for refinement.

inputs.name: noise_offset
inputs.description: The 'noise_offset' parameter adjusts the starting point of noise application, influencing the randomness and variation in the sampling process.

inputs.name: refiner_strength
inputs.description: The 'refiner_strength' parameter determines the intensity of the refinement process, directly affecting the level of detail and fidelity in the refined sample.

outputs.name: latent
outputs.description: The 'latent' output represents the result of the sampling process, encapsulating the generated or refined sample in a latent space format. It is crucial for subsequent image generation or further refinement steps.

SeargeSDXLSamplerV3.description: The SeargeSDXLSamplerV3 node is designed for advanced sampling in generative models, offering enhanced capabilities for generating high-quality digital content. It incorporates sophisticated algorithms to refine and optimize the output, making it suitable for applications requiring precision and detail in the generated samples.

inputs.name: base_model
inputs.description: Specifies the base model used for initial sampling, setting the foundation for the generation process.

inputs.name: base_positive
inputs.description: Defines the positive conditioning to guide the base model towards desirable outcomes.

inputs.name: base_negative
inputs.description: Specifies the negative conditioning to steer the base model away from undesirable outcomes.

inputs.name: refiner_model
inputs.description: Indicates the refiner model used to enhance and refine the initial samples for improved quality.

inputs.name: refiner_positive
inputs.description: Defines the positive conditioning for the refiner model, further guiding the enhancement process.

inputs.name: refiner_negative
inputs.description: Specifies the negative conditioning for the refiner model, ensuring the refinement avoids undesirable aspects.

inputs.name: latent_image
inputs.description: Represents the latent image or state used as a starting point for the sampling process.

inputs.name: noise_seed
inputs.description: Provides a seed value for noise generation, ensuring reproducibility in the sampling process.

inputs.name: steps
inputs.description: Determines the number of steps in the sampling process, affecting the detail and quality of the output.

inputs.name: cfg
inputs.description: Configures the sampling strength or control factor, influencing the variance and fidelity of the generated content.

inputs.name: sampler_name
inputs.description: Specifies the name of the sampler algorithm used, affecting the sampling strategy and outcome.

inputs.name: scheduler
inputs.description: Indicates the scheduler used to manage the sampling steps, impacting the progression and refinement of the generation.

inputs.name: base_ratio
inputs.description: Sets the ratio of base to refiner model usage, balancing initial generation with refinement.

inputs.name: denoise
inputs.description: Controls the denoising factor in the sampling process, affecting the clarity and smoothness of the output.

inputs.name: refiner_prep_steps
inputs.description: Specifies the number of preparation steps for the refiner model, adjusting the initial conditions for refinement.

outputs.name: latent
outputs.description: Produces the final latent image or state after the sampling and refinement process, ready for further use or conversion to digital content.

SeargeSeparator.description: SeargeSeparator is designed to serve as a UI element within the ComfyUI framework, specifically tailored for SDXL custom nodes. Its primary function is to act as a visual and functional separator in the user interface, helping to organize and delineate different sections or functionalities without performing any processing or data manipulation.

SeargeStylePreprocessor.description: The SeargeStylePreprocessor node is designed to apply predefined styles to input parameters for further processing. It adjusts the inputs based on the active style name and style definitions, ensuring that the inputs are formatted and ready for the next stages of processing.

inputs.name: inputs
inputs.description: A collection of input parameters that may require styling before further processing. It plays a crucial role in determining how the inputs are modified based on the selected style.

inputs.name: active_style_name
inputs.description: Specifies the name of the style to be applied to the inputs. It influences the selection of styling rules that are applied, tailoring the inputs for specific processing needs.

inputs.name: style_definitions
inputs.description: Contains the definitions of available styles in a structured format. It is essential for determining how inputs are modified, providing a blueprint for the styling process.

outputs.name: inputs
outputs.description: The modified collection of input parameters, adjusted according to the selected style. It represents the inputs ready for subsequent processing stages.

SeargeTextInputV2.description: SeargeTextInputV2 is designed to capture and process textual input from the user, specifically for generating or modifying prompts in a user interface context. It allows for multiline text input, providing a straightforward mechanism for users to input or edit text for various applications.

inputs.name: prompt
inputs.description: The 'prompt' parameter is the primary text input from the user. It is essential for capturing user input, which can then be processed or passed on for further actions. The parameter supports multiline text, enabling more complex or detailed input from the user.

outputs.name: prompt_text
outputs.description: The 'prompt_text' output returns the user's input text without modification. It serves as a direct reflection of the user's input, facilitating further processing or use within the application.

SeargeUpscaleModelLoader.description: The SeargeUpscaleModelLoader node is designed to load upscale models by name, facilitating the dynamic selection and utilization of different upscaling algorithms or models within a system. It abstracts the complexities of model loading, ensuring that the appropriate upscale model is readily available for image enhancement tasks.

inputs.name: upscaler_name
inputs.description: Specifies the name of the upscaler model to be loaded. This parameter is crucial for identifying and retrieving the correct model from a predefined collection of upscale models.

outputs.name: upscale_model
outputs.description: Returns the loaded upscale model, ready for use in upscaling tasks. This output is essential for subsequent image processing stages that require a specific upscaling model.

SeargeUpscaleModels.description: This node is designed to configure and manage upscale models within a UI context, specifically for enhancing image resolution through various upscaling techniques. It allows for the selection and application of different upscaling models, including detail processing and high-resolution upscaling, to improve image quality.

inputs.name: detail_processor
inputs.description: Specifies the model used for detail enhancement in images, playing a crucial role in refining image textures and details without altering the overall resolution.

inputs.name: high_res_upscaler
inputs.description: Defines the model responsible for increasing the image resolution by a factor of 4x, essential for achieving high-resolution outputs.

inputs.name: primary_upscaler
inputs.description: Identifies the primary model used for the initial phase of image upscaling, crucial for the first step in enhancing image resolution.

inputs.name: secondary_upscaler
inputs.description: Specifies the secondary model applied after the primary upscaling, offering an additional layer of refinement and quality improvement.

inputs.name: data
inputs.description: Optional data stream for passing additional information or parameters relevant to the upscaling process.

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: Returns a data stream containing the configured upscale models and any additional parameters, ready for further processing or application.

SeargeVAELoader.description: The SeargeVAELoader node is designed for loading pre-trained VAE models by name, facilitating the integration of these models into the processing pipeline for various tasks such as image generation or manipulation.

inputs.name: vae_name
inputs.description: Specifies the name of the VAE model to be loaded, serving as a key to retrieve the corresponding pre-trained model.

outputs.name: vae
outputs.description: Returns the loaded VAE model, ready for use in downstream tasks such as encoding or decoding images.

ColorBlend.description: The ColorBlend node is designed to blend two images, specifically a black and white layer with a color layer, to produce a single image that combines the luminosity of the black and white layer with the color information of the color layer. This blending process is achieved through a sophisticated manipulation of color spaces and image processing techniques.

inputs.name: bw_layer
inputs.description: The black and white layer image to be blended. It serves as the base for the luminosity channel in the blending process, influencing the final image's light and dark areas.

inputs.name: color_layer
inputs.description: The color layer image to be blended. This layer provides the color information for the blending process, affecting the final image's coloration and vibrancy.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The result of blending the black and white layer with the color layer, producing an image that combines the luminosity of the former with the color information of the latter.

ControlLoraSave.description: The ControlLoraSave node is designed to save the modified state of a model and its control network to a file, incorporating LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation) adjustments. This process involves extracting and storing LoRA parameters from the model's and control network's state dictionaries, and saving them in a specified output directory.

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: The model parameter represents the neural network model whose state is to be saved with LoRA adjustments. It is crucial for capturing the model's current configuration and modifications.

inputs.name: control_net
inputs.description: The control_net parameter signifies the control network associated with the model, which is essential for extracting and applying LoRA adjustments to the model's parameters.

inputs.name: filename_prefix
inputs.description: The filename_prefix parameter specifies the prefix for the output file names, allowing for organized storage and easy identification of saved models.

inputs.name: rank
inputs.description: The rank parameter determines the rank of the LoRA adjustments, influencing the granularity and extent of modifications applied to the model's parameters.

GetImageSize.description: This node is designed to determine the dimensions of an image, specifically its width and height, by analyzing the image's shape.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The image whose size is to be determined. This input is crucial for calculating the image's dimensions.

outputs.name: width
outputs.description: The width of the input image, derived from its shape.

outputs.name: height
outputs.description: The height of the input image, derived from its shape.

BatchCreativeInterpolation.description: The Batch Creative Interpolation node is designed to facilitate the generation and manipulation of frame sequences in a batch processing manner. It leverages advanced interpolation techniques to creatively adjust and enhance video frames, enabling dynamic frame rate conversion, motion smoothing, and the introduction of novel visual effects. This node is particularly useful in applications requiring high-quality video processing, animation, and effects generation, where frame-by-frame control and precision are paramount.

inputs.name: positive
inputs.description: Specifies the positive conditioning input, used to guide the interpolation process towards desired outcomes.

inputs.name: negative
inputs.description: Specifies the negative conditioning input, used to steer the interpolation process away from undesired outcomes.

inputs.name: images
inputs.description: Specifies the images to be interpolated, serving as the basis for generating new frames within the sequence.

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: Defines the model to be used for the interpolation process, central to generating the interpolated frames.

inputs.name: ipadapter
inputs.description: Defines the IP adapter used for processing, crucial for integrating with different image processing pipelines.

inputs.name: clip_vision
inputs.description: Provides the CLIP vision model input, aiding in the contextual understanding and guidance of the interpolation process.

inputs.name: type_of_frame_distribution
inputs.description: Determines the method for distributing frames, whether linearly or dynamically, to control the pacing of frame generation.

inputs.name: linear_frame_distribution_value
inputs.description: Specifies the value for linear frame distribution, influencing the uniformity of frame spacing.

inputs.name: dynamic_frame_distribution_values
inputs.description: Defines dynamic values for frame distribution, allowing for variable pacing and timing across the sequence.

inputs.name: type_of_key_frame_influence
inputs.description: Selects the method for key frame influence, impacting how key frames affect the interpolation.

inputs.name: linear_key_frame_influence_value
inputs.description: Sets the linear influence value of key frames, determining their impact on the interpolation process.

inputs.name: dynamic_key_frame_influence_values
inputs.description: Specifies dynamic influence values for key frames, offering nuanced control over their effect.

inputs.name: type_of_strength_distribution
inputs.description: Chooses the method for distributing strength, affecting the intensity of interpolation effects.

inputs.name: linear_strength_value
inputs.description: Determines the linear strength value, controlling the overall intensity of the interpolation.

inputs.name: dynamic_strength_values
inputs.description: Provides dynamic strength values, allowing for varied intensity levels throughout the sequence.

inputs.name: buffer
inputs.description: Sets the buffer size for processing, optimizing performance and resource utilization.

inputs.name: high_detail_mode
inputs.description: Enables or disables high detail mode, affecting the quality and detail of the interpolated frames.

inputs.name: base_ipa_advanced_settings
inputs.description: unknown

inputs.name: detail_ipa_advanced_settings
inputs.description: unknown

outputs.name: GRAPH
outputs.description: Provides a graphical representation of the interpolation process, detailing key frame positions and interpolation paths.

outputs.name: POSITIVE
outputs.description: unknown

outputs.name: NEGATIVE
outputs.description: unknown

outputs.name: MODEL
outputs.description: unknown

outputs.name: KEYFRAME_POSITIONS
outputs.description: Lists the positions of key frames within the interpolated sequence, crucial for understanding frame distribution.

outputs.name: BATCH_SIZE
outputs.description: Indicates the number of frames processed in a single batch, relevant for performance optimization.

outputs.name: BUFFER
outputs.description: Specifies the buffer size used during processing, affecting memory usage and computational efficiency.

outputs.name: FRAMES_TO_DROP
outputs.description: Identifies frames that were dropped during the interpolation process, useful for quality control and adjustment.

IpaConfiguration.description: The IpaConfiguration node is designed to configure and apply advanced image processing adjustments (IPA) settings for steerable motion in image generation, focusing on parameters like start and end points, weight, scaling, and noise characteristics to enhance the visual output.

inputs.name: ipa_starts_at
inputs.description: Specifies the starting point of the IPA effect, influencing when the adjustments begin to take effect in the image generation process.

inputs.name: ipa_ends_at
inputs.description: Defines the ending point of the IPA effect, determining when the adjustments cease to have an impact, thus shaping the duration of the effect.

inputs.name: ipa_weight_type
inputs.description: Determines the type of weighting applied to the IPA effect, such as 'ease in-out', affecting the transition smoothness of the adjustments.

inputs.name: ipa_weight
inputs.description: Sets the overall weight of the IPA effect, controlling the intensity of the applied adjustments.

inputs.name: ipa_embeds_scaling
inputs.description: Specifies the scaling method for embeddings, like 'V only', impacting how the adjustments are applied in terms of visual representation.

inputs.name: ipa_noise_strength
inputs.description: Controls the strength of noise added to the image, influencing the texture and detail level.

inputs.name: use_image_for_noise
inputs.description: Indicates whether an image is used as the source for noise, affecting the noise pattern and realism in the output.

inputs.name: type_of_noise
inputs.description: Specifies the type of noise, such as 'fade', affecting the visual characteristics of the noise applied.

inputs.name: noise_blur
inputs.description: Determines the level of blur applied to the noise, influencing the softness and subtlety of the noise effect.

outputs.name: configuration
outputs.description: Returns the configured advanced IPA settings, encapsulating all specified adjustments for steerable motion in image generation.

RemoveAndInterpolateFrames.description: The RemoveAndInterpolateFrames node is designed to selectively remove specified frames from a sequence of images and interpolate new frames to fill the gaps, ensuring a smooth transition between frames. This process leverages frame interpolation techniques to enhance the fluidity of motion within the sequence, making it particularly useful for applications requiring high-quality video frame manipulation.

inputs.name: images
inputs.description: The tensor containing a sequence of images from which specific frames will be removed and between which new frames will be interpolated. It plays a crucial role in determining the input and output quality of the interpolation process.

inputs.name: frames_to_drop
inputs.description: A string representation of a list indicating the indices of frames to be removed from the sequence. This parameter directly influences which frames are interpolated and replaced, impacting the final video output.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: unknown

StyleAlignedBatchAlign.description: The StyleAlignedBatchAlign node is designed to modify a given model to incorporate style alignment techniques, specifically focusing on sharing normalization and attention mechanisms across different parts of the model. This node enables the adjustment of the model's behavior to better align with specific styles by patching the model's attention and normalization layers based on the provided parameters.

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: The model to be patched with style alignment techniques. It serves as the base model for modifications aimed at enhancing style alignment.

inputs.name: share_norm
inputs.description: Specifies how normalization layers should be shared within the model to achieve style alignment, influencing the model's internal processing for style consistency.

inputs.name: share_attn
inputs.description: Determines the sharing strategy for attention mechanisms within the model, affecting how the model focuses on different aspects of the input for style alignment.

inputs.name: scale
inputs.description: A scaling factor that adjusts the intensity of the style alignment effect, allowing for fine-tuning of the model's style-aligned behavior.

outputs.name: model
outputs.description: The modified model with enhanced style alignment capabilities, reflecting the applied patches for shared normalization and attention mechanisms.

StyleAlignedReferenceSampler.description: The StyleAlignedReferenceSampler node is designed to sample reference styles in a manner that aligns with specific style guidelines or constraints. It focuses on generating style references that adhere to predefined stylistic parameters, ensuring consistency and coherence in the style of the generated content.

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: Specifies the model to be used for sampling, ensuring that the generated styles align with the desired aesthetic or thematic guidelines.

inputs.name: share_norm
inputs.description: Determines how normalization layers are shared across the model, influencing the consistency of style application.

inputs.name: share_attn
inputs.description: Controls how attention layers are shared, affecting the focus and coherence of the generated styles.

inputs.name: scale
inputs.description: Adjusts the scale of the applied style, allowing for finer control over the intensity of style effects.

inputs.name: batch_size
inputs.description: Specifies the number of samples to be processed in parallel, affecting the efficiency of the sampling process.

inputs.name: noise_seed
inputs.description: Determines the seed for noise generation, allowing for reproducibility and consistency in the style sampling process.

inputs.name: cfg
inputs.description: Controls the conditioning factor, adjusting the influence of the conditioning on the style sampling.

inputs.name: positive
inputs.description: Defines positive conditioning to guide the style sampling towards desired attributes.

inputs.name: negative
inputs.description: Specifies negative conditioning to avoid certain attributes in the style sampling.

inputs.name: ref_positive
inputs.description: Provides additional positive conditioning specifically for reference style generation, enhancing the alignment with desired attributes.

inputs.name: sampler
inputs.description: Selects the sampling strategy to be used, affecting the diversity and quality of the generated styles.

inputs.name: sigmas
inputs.description: Sets the noise levels for the sampling process, influencing the exploration of the style space.

inputs.name: ref_latents
inputs.description: Inputs pre-existing latents to be used as a reference in the style sampling process, enabling more precise style alignment.

outputs.name: output
outputs.description: Outputs the sampled latents according to the specified style guidelines.

outputs.name: denoised_output
outputs.description: Provides a denoised version of the sampled latents, potentially enhancing the clarity and quality of the generated styles.

StyleAlignedSampleReferenceLatents.description: This node is designed to sample reference latents in a style-aligned manner, capturing the essence of a given style through the manipulation of latents. It focuses on generating a set of reference latents that are aligned with the desired style attributes, facilitating the creation of content that is stylistically coherent.

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: The model parameter represents the neural network model that will be used for sampling. It is crucial for defining the architecture and parameters that will be utilized in the generation process.

inputs.name: noise_seed
inputs.description: The noise_seed parameter is used to initialize the random noise generation, ensuring reproducibility and consistency in the sampling process.

inputs.name: cfg
inputs.description: This parameter specifies the configuration settings for the sampling process, dictating how the model should interpret and manipulate the input latents.

inputs.name: positive
inputs.description: The positive parameter indicates the positive guidance text or attributes that should be emphasized in the generated content, steering the style alignment towards these characteristics.

inputs.name: negative
inputs.description: The negative parameter specifies the negative guidance text or attributes that should be minimized or avoided in the generated content, helping to refine the style alignment by excluding undesired elements.

inputs.name: sampler
inputs.description: The sampler parameter determines the specific sampling strategy or algorithm to be used in generating the reference latents, affecting the diversity and quality of the output.

inputs.name: sigmas
inputs.description: The sigmas parameter controls the variance of the noise added during the sampling process, influencing the exploration of the latent space and the resulting style alignment.

inputs.name: latent_image
inputs.description: This parameter represents the initial latent image that serves as a starting point for the sampling process, providing a basis for the generation and alignment of reference latents.

outputs.name: ref_latents
outputs.description: The ref_latents output contains the generated reference latents that are aligned with the specified style, ready for further processing or utilization.

outputs.name: noised_output
outputs.description: The noised_output includes the noised version of the generated latents, offering an alternative representation of the style-aligned reference latents.

Asymmetric Tiled KSampler.description: This node specializes in generating samples through a tiling approach that allows for asymmetric adjustments to the tiling pattern. It modifies the convolutional layers of a model to use circular or constant padding based on the tiling configuration, enabling more flexible and potentially more aesthetically pleasing image generation.

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: The model parameter represents the generative model to be used for sampling. It is crucial as it defines the architecture and parameters that will be adjusted for asymmetric tiling during the sampling process.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.description: The seed parameter ensures reproducibility of the sampling process by initializing the random number generator to a specific state.

inputs.name: tileX
inputs.description: The tileX parameter controls the horizontal tiling behavior, allowing for circular or constant padding to be applied asymmetrically.

inputs.name: tileY
inputs.description: The tileY parameter controls the vertical tiling behavior, complementing tileX by enabling asymmetric padding adjustments in the vertical direction.

inputs.name: steps
inputs.description: The steps parameter determines the number of iterations the sampling process will undergo, affecting the detail and quality of the generated sample.

inputs.name: cfg
inputs.description: The cfg parameter adjusts the conditioning factor, influencing the strength of the conditioning signal during the sampling process.

inputs.name: sampler_name
inputs.description: The sampler_name parameter specifies the sampling algorithm to be used, impacting the characteristics of the generated sample.

inputs.name: scheduler
inputs.description: The scheduler parameter selects the scheduling algorithm for controlling the sampling process, affecting the progression of sampling steps.

inputs.name: positive
inputs.description: The positive parameter provides positive conditioning information, guiding the sampling process towards desired attributes.

inputs.name: negative
inputs.description: The negative parameter provides negative conditioning information, steering the sampling process away from undesired attributes.

inputs.name: latent_image
inputs.description: The latent_image parameter represents the initial state in the latent space from which the sampling process begins.

inputs.name: denoise
inputs.description: The denoise parameter controls the level of denoising applied during the sampling process, affecting the clarity and smoothness of the generated sample.

outputs.name: latent
outputs.description: The output is a modified latent representation, reflecting the asymmetric tiling adjustments and sampling process.

Circular VAEDecode.description: This node is designed for decoding latent representations into images, specifically by modifying the padding mode of convolutional layers in the VAE's first stage model to 'circular'. This adjustment aims to enhance the decoding process by leveraging circular padding, which can be particularly beneficial for generating or reconstructing images with seamless transitions.

inputs.name: samples
inputs.description: The latent representation to be decoded into an image. It is crucial for the decoding process as it contains the encoded information of the image to be reconstructed.

inputs.name: vae
inputs.description: The Variational Autoencoder (VAE) model used for the decoding process. It is essential as it contains the architecture and parameters necessary for transforming the latent representation back into an image.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The decoded image generated from the latent representation. It represents the output of the decoding process, showcasing the reconstructed or generated image.

Tiled KSampler.description: The Tiled KSampler node is designed for advanced sampling in generative models, specifically tailored for handling tiled inputs. It incorporates circular padding and customizable sampling strategies to generate high-quality latent representations.

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: The generative model used for sampling. It's crucial for defining the architecture and parameters that will be used during the sampling process.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.description: A seed value to ensure reproducibility of the sampling process. It influences the randomness of the generated samples.

inputs.name: tiling
inputs.description: A flag indicating whether circular padding should be applied, enhancing the quality of tiled samples.

inputs.name: steps
inputs.description: The number of steps to perform during the sampling process, affecting the detail and quality of the generated samples.

inputs.name: cfg
inputs.description: A configuration parameter influencing the sampling process, allowing for fine-tuning of the generative model's behavior.

inputs.name: sampler_name
inputs.description: The name of the sampler to use, determining the specific sampling strategy employed.

inputs.name: scheduler
inputs.description: The scheduler to use, controlling the progression of sampling steps and potentially improving sample quality.

inputs.name: positive
inputs.description: Positive conditioning information to guide the sampling towards desired characteristics.

inputs.name: negative
inputs.description: Negative conditioning information to steer the sampling away from undesired characteristics.

inputs.name: latent_image
inputs.description: An initial latent image to start the sampling from, allowing for modifications or enhancements of existing samples.

inputs.name: denoise
inputs.description: A parameter to control the denoising strength during sampling, affecting the clarity and sharpness of the generated samples.

outputs.name: latent
outputs.description: The generated latent representation, which can be further processed or converted into a final image.

Blend Latents.description: The Blend Latents node is designed to blend two sets of latent representations using a variety of blending modes such as add, multiply, divide, subtract, overlay, screen, difference, exclusion, hard light, linear dodge, soft light, and random noise. This blending process allows for the creation of new, hybrid latent representations by combining features from both input sets in a controlled manner, leveraging different mathematical operations to achieve diverse visual effects.

inputs.name: latent_a
inputs.description: The first set of latent representations to be blended. It plays a crucial role in determining the base characteristics of the blended output.

inputs.name: latent_b
inputs.description: The second set of latent representations to be blended with the first. It contributes additional characteristics to the blended output, influencing the final visual effect.

inputs.name: operation
inputs.description: Specifies the blending mode to be used, such as add, multiply, divide, etc. This choice significantly affects the visual outcome of the blending process.

inputs.name: blend
inputs.description: A float value representing the blending factor, which determines the proportion of influence each set of latents has on the final blended output.

outputs.name: latent
outputs.description: The resulting set of blended latent representations, which combines features from both input sets according to the specified blending mode and factor.

BLIP Analyze Image.description: The node provides functionality for analyzing images using the BLIP model, capable of generating captions or answering questions about the image content. It leverages pre-trained BLIP models for either caption generation or visual question answering, depending on the mode selected.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The image to be analyzed by the BLIP model. It is the primary input that determines the content of the generated caption or the context for the question answering.

inputs.name: mode
inputs.description: Specifies the operation mode of the BLIP model, either generating captions for the image or answering questions about it. This mode selection alters the model's behavior and output.

inputs.name: question
inputs.description: The question to be answered about the image, required when the mode is set to 'interrogate' for visual question answering.

inputs.name: blip_model
inputs.description: An optional parameter specifying a pre-loaded BLIP model to be used for analysis, allowing for customization and efficiency improvements.

outputs.name: string
outputs.description: The output from the BLIP model, which can be either a caption describing the image or an answer to a question posed about the image content.

BLIP Model Loader.description: The BLIP Model Loader node is designed to dynamically load and initialize BLIP models based on the specified configuration, such as model type (caption or interrogate). It ensures the models are ready for inference by setting them to evaluation mode and moving them to the appropriate device.

inputs.name: blip_model
inputs.description: Specifies the type of BLIP model to load, such as 'caption' or 'interrogate', determining the model's functionality and application.

outputs.name: blip_model
outputs.description: The type of BLIP model loaded, reflecting the input specification.

Boolean To Text.description: This node converts a boolean input into its textual representation, outputting 'True' or 'False' as a string based on the input value. It serves as a simple utility within the WAS Suite for logic operations, facilitating the interpretation or display of boolean values in a human-readable format.

inputs.name: boolean
inputs.description: The boolean input that will be converted to its textual representation. This parameter determines whether the output will be 'True' or 'False'.

outputs.name: string
outputs.description: The textual representation of the input boolean value, either 'True' or 'False'.

Bounded Image Blend with Mask.description: This node specializes in blending two images within specified boundaries using a mask, allowing for precise control over the blending process. It supports feathering and blend factor adjustments to fine-tune the blending effect, making it ideal for applications requiring seamless integration of images.

inputs.name: target
inputs.description: The target image onto which the source image will be blended. It serves as the backdrop for the blending operation.

inputs.name: target_mask
inputs.description: A mask image used to define the blending area on the target image. It determines where and how the source image will be blended onto the target.

inputs.name: target_bounds
inputs.description: Specifies the boundaries within the target image where the blending should occur, allowing for precise control over the location of the blend.

inputs.name: source
inputs.description: The source image to be blended onto the target image. This image will be manipulated according to the blend factor and feathering settings.

inputs.name: blend_factor
inputs.description: A value that controls the intensity of the blending effect, allowing for adjustments in how prominently the source image appears on the target.

inputs.name: feathering
inputs.description: The amount of feathering applied to the edges of the blend, creating a smoother transition between the blended images.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The result of the blending operation, featuring the source image seamlessly integrated into the target image within the specified boundaries.

Bounded Image Blend.description: This node is designed to blend two images within specified bounds, allowing for precise control over the blending process. It supports adjusting the blend factor and feathering to achieve smooth transitions between the images.

inputs.name: target
inputs.description: The target image onto which the source image will be blended. It serves as the base layer in the blending operation.

inputs.name: target_bounds
inputs.description: Specifies the bounds within which the source image will be blended onto the target. This allows for localized blending within the target image.

inputs.name: source
inputs.description: The source image to be blended onto the target. It overlays the target within the specified bounds.

inputs.name: blend_factor
inputs.description: Determines the intensity of the source image's influence in the blend. A higher value results in the source image being more prominent.

inputs.name: feathering
inputs.description: Applies a smoothing effect to the edges of the blended area, creating a more seamless transition between the source and target images.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The result of blending the source image onto the target within the specified bounds, incorporating the blend factor and feathering for smooth transitions.

Bounded Image Crop with Mask.description: This node is designed to crop images based on specified masks, adjusting the cropping boundaries with additional padding parameters. It ensures that the cropping operation is sensitive to the presence and shape of objects within the images as defined by the masks, allowing for dynamic and context-aware image processing.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The input image or batch of images to be cropped. This parameter is crucial as it defines the visual content that will be processed and cropped according to the mask and padding parameters.

inputs.name: mask
inputs.description: The mask or batch of masks used to determine the cropping boundaries around the objects of interest within the images. This parameter is essential for identifying the relevant areas to be retained after cropping.

inputs.name: padding_left
inputs.description: Specifies the amount of padding to add to the left boundary of the crop. This affects the horizontal positioning and width of the cropped area.

inputs.name: padding_right
inputs.description: Specifies the amount of padding to add to the right boundary of the crop. This affects the horizontal positioning and width of the cropped area.

inputs.name: padding_top
inputs.description: Specifies the amount of padding to add to the top boundary of the crop. This affects the vertical positioning and height of the cropped area.

inputs.name: padding_bottom
inputs.description: Specifies the amount of padding to add to the bottom boundary of the crop. This affects the vertical positioning and height of the cropped area.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The output consists of a batch of cropped images, each adjusted according to its corresponding mask and the specified padding parameters.

outputs.name: image_bounds
outputs.description: The boundaries used for each crop are returned, providing insight into the cropping process.

Bounded Image Crop.description: This node is designed to crop images based on specified bounding coordinates, ensuring that the cropping process is adapted to the dimensions of each image in a batch. It facilitates the precise extraction of image regions, allowing for focused analysis or manipulation of specific areas within images.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The 'image' parameter represents the input image or a batch of images to be cropped. It plays a crucial role in determining the regions to be extracted based on the provided bounding coordinates.

inputs.name: image_bounds
inputs.description: The 'image_bounds' parameter specifies the coordinates for cropping the image(s). It defines the rectangular region(s) within the image(s) to be extracted, ensuring targeted manipulation of the image content.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The output is a cropped version of the input image or images, adjusted according to the specified bounding coordinates. It enables focused analysis or manipulation of specific regions within the images.

Bus Node.description: The 'Bus Node' serves as a central hub for routing and overriding various components such as models, CLIP, VAE, and conditioning inputs within a generative AI pipeline. It facilitates the dynamic interchange and management of these components, ensuring that the most appropriate resources are utilized for each operation.

inputs.name: bus
inputs.description: A tuple containing references to a model, CLIP, VAE, positive conditioning, and negative conditioning. It acts as a conduit for passing these components through the pipeline, allowing for their dynamic interchange and management.

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: A specific model to be used in the operation. If provided, it overrides the model component of the bus.

inputs.name: clip
inputs.description: A specific CLIP model to be used in the operation. If provided, it overrides the CLIP component of the bus.

inputs.name: vae
inputs.description: A specific VAE model to be used in the operation. If provided, it overrides the VAE component of the bus.

inputs.name: positive
inputs.description: Positive conditioning to influence the generation towards desired attributes. If provided, it overrides the positive conditioning component of the bus.

inputs.name: negative
inputs.description: Negative conditioning to influence the generation away from undesired attributes. If provided, it overrides the negative conditioning component of the bus.

outputs.name: bus
outputs.description: A tuple representing the updated state of the bus, containing the current set of components (model, CLIP, VAE, positive conditioning, negative conditioning) after any overrides.

outputs.name: model
outputs.description: The model component currently in use, either passed directly or derived from the bus.

outputs.name: clip
outputs.description: The CLIP model component currently in use, either passed directly or derived from the bus.

outputs.name: vae
outputs.description: The VAE model component currently in use, either passed directly or derived from the bus.

outputs.name: positive
outputs.description: The positive conditioning component currently in use, either passed directly or derived from the bus.

outputs.name: negative
outputs.description: The negative conditioning component currently in use, either passed directly or derived from the bus.

Cache Node.description: The Cache Node is designed to manage the caching process within a workflow, specifically handling the loading and saving of various types of data such as latent representations, images, and conditioning information. It facilitates efficient data retrieval and storage, optimizing the workflow's performance by reducing redundant computations and data loading times.

inputs.name: latent_suffix
inputs.description: Specifies the suffix for the latent data cache file. It is crucial for identifying and retrieving precomputed latent representations, enhancing efficiency by avoiding redundant computations.

inputs.name: image_suffix
inputs.description: Indicates the suffix for the image data cache file. This parameter is essential for identifying and accessing pre-stored images, streamlining the workflow by eliminating the need for repeated image loading.

inputs.name: conditioning_suffix
inputs.description: Defines the suffix for the conditioning data cache file. It plays a key role in identifying and fetching precomputed conditioning information, thereby speeding up the data preparation process for model inputs.

inputs.name: output_path
inputs.description: Specifies the directory path where the cache files are stored or will be stored. This parameter is essential for directing where to save or load cache files.

inputs.name: latent
inputs.description: The latent representation data to be cached. This parameter is optional and is used when saving data to the cache.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The image data to be cached. This parameter is optional and is used when saving data to the cache.

inputs.name: conditioning
inputs.description: The conditioning information to be cached. This parameter is optional and is used when saving data to the cache.

outputs.name: latent_filename
outputs.description: The filename of the latent representation data cache file.

outputs.name: image_filename
outputs.description: The filename of the image data cache file.

outputs.name: conditioning_filename
outputs.description: The filename of the conditioning data cache file.

Checkpoint Loader (Simple).description: This node is designed to load checkpoints for models, specifically focusing on a simplified process that requires only the checkpoint name. It aims to streamline the loading of model states for further use or analysis, making it accessible even without specifying configuration details.

inputs.name: ckpt_name
inputs.description: The name of the checkpoint to be loaded. This parameter is crucial as it identifies the specific checkpoint file from which the model's state will be restored.

outputs.name: MODEL
outputs.description: The loaded model state.

outputs.name: CLIP
outputs.description: The loaded CLIP model component, if applicable.

outputs.name: VAE
outputs.description: The loaded VAE model component, if applicable.

outputs.name: NAME_STRING
outputs.description: The name string derived from the checkpoint, providing an identifier for the loaded model.

Checkpoint Loader.description: The Checkpoint Loader node is designed for advanced loading operations, specifically to load various components such as models, CLIP, and VAE from specified checkpoints and configuration files. It facilitates the restoration of these components to their saved states, enabling the continuation of work or further manipulation.

inputs.name: config_name
inputs.description: Specifies the name of the configuration file to be used for loading. It plays a crucial role in determining the setup and parameters of the components to be loaded.

inputs.name: ckpt_name
inputs.description: Indicates the name of the checkpoint file from which the components are to be loaded. This file contains the saved state of the components.

outputs.name: MODEL
outputs.description: The loaded model component.

outputs.name: CLIP
outputs.description: The loaded CLIP component.

outputs.name: VAE
outputs.description: The loaded VAE component.

outputs.name: NAME_STRING
outputs.description: The name string derived from the checkpoint file, providing an identifier for the loaded components.

CLIP Input Switch.description: The WAS_CLIP_Input_Switch node is designed to toggle between two CLIP model inputs based on a boolean condition. It facilitates dynamic input selection within workflows that utilize CLIP models, enhancing flexibility in processing visual content.

inputs.name: clip_a
inputs.description: The first CLIP model input. Acts as the default selection when the boolean condition is true.

inputs.name: clip_b
inputs.description: The second CLIP model input. It is selected when the boolean condition is false.

inputs.name: boolean
inputs.description: A boolean condition that determines which CLIP model input (clip_a or clip_b) is selected for output.

outputs.name: clip
outputs.description: The selected CLIP model input based on the boolean condition.

CLIP Vision Input Switch.description: This node provides a mechanism to switch between two CLIP vision models based on a boolean condition. It enables dynamic selection of vision models within a workflow, facilitating conditional processing of visual data.

inputs.name: clip_vision_a
inputs.description: The first CLIP vision model to choose from. Acts as a potential input for the switch operation, contributing to conditional logic in processing visual data.

inputs.name: clip_vision_b
inputs.description: The second CLIP vision model to choose from. Serves as an alternative input for the switch operation, enabling a choice between two models based on a condition.

inputs.name: boolean
inputs.description: A boolean value determining which CLIP vision model (A or B) to pass through. True selects 'clip_vision_a', and False selects 'clip_vision_b'.

outputs.name: clip_vision
outputs.description: The selected CLIP vision model based on the boolean condition. Enables conditional routing of visual model processing.

CLIPSeg Batch Masking.description: This node applies the CLIPSeg model to a batch of images, generating corresponding segmentation masks based on the provided text descriptions. It leverages the CLIPSeg model's ability to understand the content of images in relation to textual descriptions, producing masks that highlight areas of interest specified by the text.

inputs.name: image_a
inputs.description: The first input image tensor to be segmented. It serves as the primary visual context for the segmentation process.

inputs.name: image_b
inputs.description: The second input image tensor to be segmented. It acts as an additional visual context for the segmentation process.

inputs.name: text_a
inputs.description: The first textual description that specifies the content to be segmented within the images. It guides the CLIPSeg model in focusing on relevant parts of the images for mask generation.

inputs.name: text_b
inputs.description: The second textual description that specifies the content to be segmented within the images. It provides additional guidance to the CLIPSeg model for mask generation.

inputs.name: image_c
inputs.description: An optional third input image tensor to be segmented, providing further visual context if available.

inputs.name: image_d
inputs.description: An optional fourth input image tensor to be segmented, providing further visual context if available.

inputs.name: image_e
inputs.description: An optional fifth input image tensor to be segmented, providing further visual context if available.

inputs.name: image_f
inputs.description: An optional sixth input image tensor to be segmented, providing further visual context if available.

inputs.name: text_c
inputs.description: An optional third textual description, offering additional content specification for segmentation.

inputs.name: text_d
inputs.description: An optional fourth textual description, offering additional content specification for segmentation.

inputs.name: text_e
inputs.description: An optional fifth textual description, offering additional content specification for segmentation.

inputs.name: text_f
inputs.description: An optional sixth textual description, offering additional content specification for segmentation.

outputs.name: IMAGES_BATCH
outputs.description: A batch of original images processed through the node.

outputs.name: MASKS_BATCH
outputs.description: A batch of segmentation masks corresponding to the input images and text descriptions.

outputs.name: MASK_IMAGES_BATCH
outputs.description: A batch of inverted mask images derived from the segmentation masks.

CLIPSeg Masking.description: This node leverages the CLIPSeg model for image segmentation, utilizing both textual and visual inputs to generate a segmentation mask. It's designed to understand and segment images based on textual descriptions, providing a flexible approach to image analysis that combines the capabilities of CLIP models with segmentation techniques.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The input image to be segmented. It serves as the visual context for the segmentation process, allowing the model to generate a mask that highlights areas of interest based on the accompanying text.

inputs.name: text
inputs.description: An optional textual description that guides the segmentation process, enabling the model to focus on specific elements within the image as described by the text.

inputs.name: clipseg_model
inputs.description: An optional pre-loaded CLIPSeg model and processor. If provided, it bypasses the default model loading process, allowing for customization and potentially faster processing.

outputs.name: MASK
outputs.description: The output is a segmentation mask that highlights areas of interest in the image as determined by the textual description and visual analysis.

outputs.name: MASK_IMAGE
outputs.description: An inverted version of the segmentation mask, represented as an image, which can be used for further image processing or visualization.

CLIPSeg Model Loader.description: This node is designed to load a CLIPSeg model, which is a specialized model for image segmentation using CLIP (Contrastive Language–Image Pretraining). It facilitates the integration of CLIPSeg's capabilities into workflows, enabling advanced image segmentation tasks that leverage both textual and visual information.

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: Specifies the model to be loaded. The default model is 'CIDAS/clipseg-rd64-refined'. This parameter allows for the selection of different CLIPSeg models based on the task requirements.

outputs.name: clipseg_model
outputs.description: Outputs a tuple containing the CLIPSeg model and its processor, ready for image segmentation tasks.

CLIPTextEncode (BlenderNeko Advanced + N.description: This node specializes in encoding text inputs using an advanced CLIP model, enhanced by BlenderNeko's modifications and optionally incorporating Noodle Soup Prompts (NSP) for dynamic text manipulation.
