It aims to provide a more nuanced and contextually aware text representation for downstream tasks, such as image generation or text-based conditioning.

inputs.name: mode
inputs.description: Determines the mode of text manipulation, such as using Noodle Soup Prompts for dynamic text changes.

inputs.name: noodle_key
inputs.description: A key used in Noodle Soup Prompts for identifying placeholders in the text to be dynamically replaced.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.description: A seed for random elements in text manipulation, ensuring reproducibility of the text encoding.

inputs.name: clip
inputs.description: The CLIP model used for encoding the text. It's crucial for understanding the context and semantics of the input text.

inputs.name: token_normalization
inputs.description: Determines how tokens are normalized during encoding, affecting the representation's sensitivity to token frequency.

inputs.name: weight_interpretation
inputs.description: Controls how the weights are interpreted in the encoding process, influencing the emphasis on certain aspects of the text.

inputs.name: text
inputs.description: The input text to be encoded. This text can be dynamically modified based on the mode selected, allowing for creative and context-sensitive text representations.

outputs.name: conditioning
outputs.description: The encoded text representation, suitable for use in downstream tasks like image generation.

outputs.name: parsed_text
outputs.description: The text after being processed and potentially modified by the node, reflecting dynamic changes or manipulations.

outputs.name: raw_text
outputs.description: The original input text before any processing or manipulation.

CLIPTextEncode (NSP).description: This node specializes in encoding text inputs using CLIP models, enhanced with Noodle Soup Prompts (NSP) or wildcard text transformations. It aims to provide a versatile text encoding capability that can adapt to different prompt styles and requirements, making it suitable for a wide range of text-to-image or text-based conditioning applications.

inputs.name: mode
inputs.description: Determines whether Noodle Soup Prompts or wildcards are used for text transformation. This choice affects how the text is parsed and encoded.

inputs.name: noodle_key
inputs.description: A key used in Noodle Soup Prompts for dynamic text replacement. It's essential for customizing the prompt transformation process.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.description: A seed for random number generation, used in text transformation to ensure reproducibility or variability.

inputs.name: text
inputs.description: The text input to be encoded. This can include Noodle Soup Prompts or wildcards, which are then transformed based on the mode selected.

inputs.name: clip
inputs.description: The CLIP model to be used for encoding the text. It plays a crucial role in determining the quality and relevance of the encoded output.

outputs.name: conditioning
outputs.description: The encoded text output, suitable for use in text-to-image generation or other conditioning contexts.

outputs.name: parsed_text
outputs.description: The text after being processed by NSP or wildcard transformation, providing insight into how the input text was interpreted.

outputs.name: raw_text
outputs.description: The original text input before any NSP or wildcard transformation, allowing for comparison with the parsed text.

Conditioning Input Switch.description: The Conditioning Input Switch node is designed to selectively switch between two conditioning inputs based on a boolean value, facilitating dynamic control over which conditioning data is passed forward in a processing pipeline.

inputs.name: conditioning_a
inputs.description: The first conditioning input option. It serves as one of the two possible conditioning data inputs to be selected based on the boolean value.

inputs.name: conditioning_b
inputs.description: The second conditioning input option. It acts as an alternative to the first conditioning input, offering a choice that can be selected based on the boolean value.

inputs.name: boolean
inputs.description: A boolean value that determines which conditioning input (either conditioning_a or conditioning_b) is passed forward. When true, conditioning_a is selected; otherwise, conditioning_b is chosen.

outputs.name: conditioning
outputs.description: The selected conditioning input, determined by the boolean value. It outputs the chosen conditioning data for further processing.

Constant Number.description: This node is designed to process numerical inputs and convert them based on specified types, such as integer, float, or boolean. It allows for the transformation of a number or textual representation of a number into a constant value of a specified type, supporting operations like type conversion and value adjustment.

inputs.name: number_type
inputs.description: Specifies the desired type for the output number, allowing for conversion between integer, float, and boolean types, which affects how the input number is processed and converted.

inputs.name: number
inputs.description: The numerical value to be processed or converted. This value serves as the base for any type conversion or adjustment operations performed by the node.

inputs.name: number_as_text
inputs.description: An optional textual representation of a number that, if provided, will be converted according to the specified 'number_type'. This allows for textual input to be dynamically interpreted and processed as a numerical value.

outputs.name: number
outputs.description: The processed or converted number in the specified 'number_type', demonstrating the node's ability to adjust and convert numerical values effectively.

outputs.name: float
outputs.description: The float representation of the processed or converted number.

outputs.name: int
outputs.description: The integer representation of the processed or converted number.

Control Net Model Input Switch.description: This node is designed to switch between two control net inputs based on a boolean condition. It facilitates dynamic control net selection within workflows, enabling conditional logic to dictate the control net used for further processing.

inputs.name: control_net_a
inputs.description: The first control net option for selection.

inputs.name: control_net_b
inputs.description: The second control net option for selection.

inputs.name: boolean
inputs.description: A boolean value determining which control net is selected. If true, `control_net_a` is selected; otherwise, `control_net_b` is chosen.

outputs.name: control_net
outputs.description: The selected control net based on the boolean condition.

Convert Masks to Images.description: This node is designed to convert mask data into image format, effectively transforming binary or grayscale mask representations into RGB images. It supports processing masks of various dimensions, including individual masks and batches of masks, by expanding their channels to match the RGB color space. This functionality is crucial for visualizing masks in a more interpretable form or preparing them for further image processing tasks.

inputs.name: masks
inputs.description: The input masks to be converted into images. This parameter accepts masks of different dimensions, including individual masks and batches of masks, and transforms them into RGB images for visualization or further processing.

outputs.name: IMAGES
outputs.description: The output images converted from the input masks. These images are in RGB format, suitable for visualization or further image processing tasks.

Create Grid Image from Batch.description: This node is designed to generate a grid image from a batch of images. It organizes multiple images into a grid layout based on specified parameters such as the number of columns, maximum cell size, and border properties. The node aims to facilitate the visualization of collections of images in a structured and aesthetically pleasing manner.

inputs.name: images
inputs.description: Specifies the directory path where the images are located. This path is essential for the node to locate and process the images for grid generation.

inputs.name: border_width
inputs.description: Specifies the width of the border around each image in the grid. This parameter adds a visual separation between images, enhancing the grid's clarity and aesthetics.

inputs.name: number_of_columns
inputs.description: Indicates the number of columns in the grid. This parameter directly influences the layout of the grid image by specifying how many images are placed in each row.

inputs.name: max_cell_size
inputs.description: Sets the maximum size for each cell in the grid. This parameter controls the scaling of images to fit within the specified cell dimensions, ensuring a uniform appearance.

inputs.name: border_red
inputs.description: Determines the red component of the border color. This parameter, along with the green and blue components, allows for customization of the border color.

inputs.name: border_green
inputs.description: Determines the green component of the border color. This parameter, along with the red and blue components, allows for customization of the border color.

inputs.name: border_blue
inputs.description: Determines the blue component of the border color. This parameter, along with the red and green components, allows for customization of the border color.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: Produces a tensor representation of the generated grid image. This output facilitates further processing or visualization within the pipeline.

Create Grid Image.description: This node is designed to create a grid image from a collection of image files. It allows for customization of the grid layout, including the number of columns, cell size, and border properties. The node supports filtering images by file extension and can include images from subfolders based on the user's choice.

inputs.name: images_path
inputs.description: The path to the directory containing the images to be included in the grid. The node checks for the existence of this path and filters images based on allowed extensions.

inputs.name: pattern_glob
inputs.description: A glob pattern to filter the images in the specified path. It allows for more granular control over which images are included based on their filenames.

inputs.name: include_subfolders
inputs.description: A flag indicating whether to include images from subdirectories of the specified path. This allows for recursive image inclusion based on the user's preference.

inputs.name: border_width
inputs.description: The width of the border around each image in the grid. A width of 0 or less means no border is added.

inputs.name: number_of_columns
inputs.description: Specifies the number of columns in the grid layout. This affects the overall arrangement and appearance of the grid image.

inputs.name: max_cell_size
inputs.description: The maximum size for each cell in the grid, controlling the dimensions of the images in the grid.

inputs.name: border_red
inputs.description: The red component of the border color, allowing for customization of the border's appearance.

inputs.name: border_green
inputs.description: The green component of the border color, contributing to the customization of the border's appearance.

inputs.name: border_blue
inputs.description: The blue component of the border color, further allowing for customization of the border's appearance.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The generated grid image as a tensor, suitable for further processing or visualization.

Create Morph Image from Path.description: This node is designed to generate a morphing animation between a sequence of images stored in a specified directory. It creates a GIF animation that smoothly transitions from one image to another over a given number of frames, allowing for customization of the transition speed, loop count, and output size. The node aims to facilitate the creation of dynamic visual content by automating the morphing process.

inputs.name: transition_frames
inputs.description: Specifies the number of frames to be used for transitioning between each pair of images, affecting the smoothness of the morphing animation.

inputs.name: still_image_delay_ms
inputs.description: Determines the delay in milliseconds for each still image before transitioning, allowing for a pause on each image in the sequence.

inputs.name: duration_ms
inputs.description: Sets the duration in milliseconds for each frame in the animation, controlling the speed of the morphing effect.

inputs.name: loops
inputs.description: Defines how many times the animation will loop, with 0 indicating an infinite loop.

inputs.name: max_size
inputs.description: Limits the maximum size of the images in the animation, ensuring the output file remains within a manageable size.

inputs.name: input_path
inputs.description: The directory path where the input images are stored, serving as the source for the morphing animation.

inputs.name: input_pattern
inputs.description: A pattern to match filenames within the input directory, allowing for selective inclusion of images in the animation.

inputs.name: output_path
inputs.description: The directory path where the generated GIF animation will be saved.

inputs.name: filename
inputs.description: The name of the output file, without the extension, allowing for customization of the output filename.

inputs.name: filetype
inputs.description: Specifies the file type of the output animation, typically set to 'GIF' for compatibility with most viewers.

outputs.name: filepath_text
outputs.description: The absolute path to the saved output file, providing a direct link to the generated animation.

outputs.name: filename_text
outputs.description: The name of the saved output file, including its extension, offering a clear identifier for the generated animation.

Create Morph Image.description: This node is designed to generate a morphing animation between two or more images, creating a smooth transition effect. It allows for customization of the transition duration, frame rate, and output settings, making it versatile for creating dynamic visual content.

inputs.name: image_a
inputs.description: The first image in the morphing sequence. It serves as the starting point for the morphing animation.

inputs.name: image_b
inputs.description: The second image in the morphing sequence. It serves as the ending point for the morphing animation.

inputs.name: transition_frames
inputs.description: Defines the number of frames to be generated between the starting and ending images, controlling the smoothness of the transition.

inputs.name: still_image_delay_ms
inputs.description: The duration in milliseconds for which each image remains still before transitioning to the next, enhancing the visual effect.

inputs.name: duration_ms
inputs.description: The duration in milliseconds of each transition step, affecting the speed of the morphing animation.

inputs.name: loops
inputs.description: Determines the number of times the animation loops, allowing for repeated playback.

inputs.name: max_size
inputs.description: Specifies the maximum size of the images, ensuring they are resized appropriately for consistent morphing.

inputs.name: output_path
inputs.description: The file path where the generated morphing animation will be saved.

inputs.name: filename
inputs.description: The name of the output file, allowing for easy identification and organization.

inputs.name: filetype
inputs.description: The format of the output file, typically GIF for animations.

outputs.name: image_a_pass
outputs.description: The first image after processing, confirming its successful inclusion in the morphing animation.

outputs.name: image_b_pass
outputs.description: The second image after processing, confirming its successful inclusion in the morphing animation.

outputs.name: filepath_text
outputs.description: The path to the generated morphing animation file, providing access to the final visual content.

outputs.name: filename_text
outputs.description: The name of the generated morphing animation file, facilitating easy identification and retrieval.

Create Video from Path.description: This node facilitates the creation of videos from a sequence of images, allowing for customizable transitions, frame delays, and video properties such as frame rate and resolution. It leverages computer vision techniques to generate smooth transitions between images, making it ideal for creating morphing effects or slideshows.

inputs.name: transition_frames
inputs.description: Specifies the number of frames to be used for transitions between images, enabling smooth morphing effects.

inputs.name: image_delay_sec
inputs.description: Determines the delay (in seconds) for each image before transitioning to the next, allowing for control over the viewing duration of each image in the video.

inputs.name: fps
inputs.description: Sets the frames per second (fps) for the output video, influencing the smoothness and playback speed.

inputs.name: max_size
inputs.description: Defines the maximum size (in pixels) for the width or height of the images, ensuring that the video maintains a consistent resolution.

inputs.name: input_path
inputs.description: The directory path where the input images are located.

inputs.name: output_path
inputs.description: The directory path where the output video will be saved.

inputs.name: filename
inputs.description: The name of the output video file.

inputs.name: codec
inputs.description: The codec used for encoding the video, affecting compatibility and quality.

outputs.name: filepath_text
outputs.description: The path to the created video file.

outputs.name: filename_text
outputs.description: The name of the created video file, confirming the output.

Debug Number to Console.description: This node is designed for debugging purposes, allowing the user to print a specified number along with an optional label to the console. It serves as a simple yet effective tool for monitoring and debugging numerical values during the execution of a workflow.

inputs.name: number
inputs.description: The numerical value to be printed to the console. It is the primary data of interest for debugging.

inputs.name: label
inputs.description: An optional label to accompany the number in the console output, providing context or identification for the debugged value.

outputs.name: number
outputs.description: The same numerical value that was input, passed through for further use or inspection in the workflow.

Dictionary to Console.description: This node is designed for debugging purposes, allowing the user to print a dictionary to the console with an optional label for easier identification. It emphasizes the utility of visually inspecting dictionary contents directly within the console, facilitating the debugging and development process.

inputs.name: dictionary
inputs.description: The dictionary to be printed to the console. It is essential for visual inspection and debugging purposes.

inputs.name: label
inputs.description: An optional label to precede the dictionary output in the console, enhancing readability and identification.

outputs.name: dict
outputs.description: Returns the same dictionary that was input, allowing for further use in the node chain without alteration.

Diffusers Hub Model Down-Loader.description: This node is designed to download and load models from the Hugging Face Hub, specifically tailored for diffusers models. It handles the retrieval of models by their repository ID and optional revision, facilitating the integration of these models into the workflow.

inputs.name: repo_id
inputs.description: The repository ID on Hugging Face Hub from which the model should be downloaded. It is crucial for identifying the specific model to be retrieved.

inputs.name: revision
inputs.description: An optional revision identifier for the model, allowing for the selection of specific versions of the model from the repository. If not specified, the latest version is retrieved.

outputs.name: MODEL
outputs.description: The loaded diffusers model.

outputs.name: CLIP
outputs.description: The CLIP model associated with the diffusers model, if available.

outputs.name: VAE
outputs.description: The VAE model associated with the diffusers model, if available.

outputs.name: NAME_STRING
outputs.description: The repository ID of the loaded model, serving as a unique identifier.

Diffusers Model Loader.description: This node is designed to load models related to the 'diffusers' library, specifically targeting the loading of diffusion models, CLIP models, and VAEs. It facilitates the integration of these models into the workflow by providing a streamlined mechanism for their retrieval and initialization based on specified model paths.

inputs.name: model_path
inputs.description: Specifies the path to the model that needs to be loaded. This path is critical as it determines which model will be retrieved and initialized for use in the workflow.

outputs.name: MODEL
outputs.description: The loaded diffusion model, ready for use in generating or manipulating images.

outputs.name: CLIP
outputs.description: The loaded CLIP model, which can be used for text-image matching and manipulation tasks.

outputs.name: VAE
outputs.description: The loaded VAE model, which can be utilized for various image generation and manipulation tasks.

outputs.name: NAME_STRING
outputs.description: The name of the loaded model, providing a simple identifier for reference.

Export API.description: The Export API node is designed to facilitate the exporting of API configurations, including prompts and their associated settings, to a specified output path. It supports customization of the filename, optional parsing of text tokens, and the choice to save prompt configurations for future use.

inputs.name: save_prompt_api
inputs.description: Indicates whether the prompt configuration should be saved for future API calls, enabling easy reuse of configurations.

inputs.name: output_path
inputs.description: Specifies the destination path where the API configurations will be exported. This path determines where the exported files will be saved.

inputs.name: filename_prefix
inputs.description: Defines the prefix for the filenames of the exported API configurations, allowing for easy identification and organization.

inputs.name: filename_delimiter
inputs.description: Specifies the delimiter to be used in the filenames, separating different parts of the filename for clarity.

inputs.name: filename_number_padding
inputs.description: Determines the padding for numerical parts of the filename, ensuring consistent filename lengths and sorting order.

inputs.name: parse_text_tokens
inputs.description: Determines whether text tokens within the prompt should be parsed, allowing for dynamic content generation based on the prompt.

Image Analyze.description: This node is designed to analyze images by applying specific filters based on the selected mode, such as 'Black White Levels' or 'RGB Levels'. It converts images into a format suitable for analysis, applies the chosen filter, and returns the analyzed image.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The image to be analyzed. It is the primary input for the analysis process.

inputs.name: mode
inputs.description: Determines the type of analysis to be performed on the image, with options including 'Black White Levels' and 'RGB Levels'.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The analyzed image after applying the selected filter.

Image Aspect Ratio.description: This node calculates the aspect ratio of an image, determining whether it is landscape, portrait, or square based on its width and height. It provides both numerical and common aspect ratio formats, and identifies the image orientation.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The image tensor for which the aspect ratio is to be calculated. If not provided, width and height must be specified.

inputs.name: width
inputs.description: The width of the image. Required if the image tensor is not provided.

inputs.name: height
inputs.description: The height of the image. Required if the image tensor is not provided.

outputs.name: aspect_number
outputs.description: The numerical aspect ratio of the image.

outputs.name: aspect_float
outputs.description: The floating-point representation of the image's aspect ratio.

outputs.name: is_landscape_bool
outputs.description: A boolean indicating if the image is in landscape orientation.

outputs.name: aspect_ratio_common
outputs.description: The aspect ratio in common format (e.g., '16:9').

outputs.name: aspect_type
outputs.description: A string indicating the type of aspect ratio ('landscape', 'portrait', 'square').

Image Batch.description: The Image Batch node is designed to combine multiple images into a single batch, allowing for operations that require batch processing or collective analysis of images. It ensures that images are compatible in dimensions before batching them together, making it suitable for workflows that involve image manipulation, augmentation, or processing in batches.

inputs.name: images_a
inputs.description: The first image to be included in the batch. It serves as a reference for resizing subsequent images if their dimensions do not match, ensuring uniformity in the batch.

inputs.name: images_b
inputs.description: The second image to be included in the batch. It is resized to match the dimensions of the first image if necessary, ensuring that all images in the batch have uniform dimensions.

inputs.name: images_c
inputs.description: The third image to be included in the batch, resized if necessary to ensure uniform dimensions across the batch.

inputs.name: images_d
inputs.description: The fourth image to be included in the batch, resized if necessary to ensure uniform dimensions across the batch.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The output is a single batched image, combined from the input images. This batch can be used for further processing or analysis as a collective group.

Image Blank.description: The WAS_Image_Blank node generates a blank image with specified dimensions and color. It allows for the creation of a simple, solid-colored image by defining its width, height, and RGB color values.

inputs.name: width
inputs.description: Specifies the width of the generated image.

inputs.name: height
inputs.description: Specifies the height of the generated image.

inputs.name: red
inputs.description: Determines the red component of the image's color, allowing for customization of the image's appearance.

inputs.name: green
inputs.description: Determines the green component of the image's color, contributing to the customization of the image's overall color.

inputs.name: blue
inputs.description: Determines the blue component of the image's color, finalizing the customization of the image's color.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The output is a blank image with the specified dimensions and color.

Image Blend by Mask.description: The Image Blend by Mask node is designed to blend two images together based on a mask and a specified blend percentage. It allows for the creation of composite images by selectively blending parts of two input images according to the mask's pattern, offering a high degree of control over the blending process.

inputs.name: image_a
inputs.description: The first image to be blended. It serves as the base layer in the blending operation.

inputs.name: image_b
inputs.description: The second image to be blended. It is combined with the first image according to the mask and blend percentage.

inputs.name: mask
inputs.description: A mask image that determines the blending pattern. Areas in white allow the second image to show through, while black areas retain the first image.

inputs.name: blend_percentage
inputs.description: A float value that specifies the percentage of blending between the two images. A higher value increases the visibility of the second image in the blended result.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The resulting image after blending the two input images based on the mask and blend percentage.

Image Blend.description: The Image Blend node is designed to seamlessly blend two images together based on a specified blend percentage. This node allows for the creation of composite images by adjusting the degree of visibility of each input image in the final output.

inputs.name: image_a
inputs.description: The first image to be blended. It serves as one of the primary components in the blending process.

inputs.name: image_b
inputs.description: The second image to be blended with the first. It contributes to the final composite image alongside 'image_a'.

inputs.name: blend_percentage
inputs.description: A float value that determines the blending ratio between 'image_a' and 'image_b'. A higher percentage increases the visibility of 'image_b' in the output.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The resulting image after blending 'image_a' and 'image_b' according to the specified blend percentage.

Image Blending Mode.description: This node is designed to blend two images together using a variety of blending modes. It allows for the creation of composite images by applying different mathematical operations to the pixel values of the input images based on the selected mode.

inputs.name: image_a
inputs.description: The first input image to be blended. It serves as the base layer in the blending operation.

inputs.name: image_b
inputs.description: The second input image to be blended. It is combined with the first image according to the specified blending mode.

inputs.name: mode
inputs.description: Specifies the blending mode to be used for combining the two images. Each mode applies a different mathematical operation, affecting the visual outcome of the blend.

inputs.name: blend_percentage
inputs.description: Determines the intensity of the blend between the two images. A higher percentage results in a stronger influence of the second image on the final output.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The result of blending the two input images according to the specified mode and blend percentage. It represents the composite image generated by the blending operation.

Image Bloom Filter.description: The node applies a bloom filter effect to an image, enhancing its visual appeal by simulating the way the human eye perceives extreme brightness. It blurs the bright areas and adds them back to the original image, creating a glowing effect around bright spots.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The image to which the bloom filter effect will be applied. It serves as the base for creating the bloom effect by undergoing a series of transformations including blurring and brightness adjustment.

inputs.name: radius
inputs.description: Defines the radius for the Gaussian blur applied during the bloom filter effect creation. It influences the spread and intensity of the bloom effect around bright areas of the image.

inputs.name: intensity
inputs.description: A multiplier for the bloom effect's intensity. It controls how much the bloom effect contributes to the final image, allowing for fine-tuning of the glow's strength around bright spots.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The final image after applying the bloom filter effect, showcasing enhanced brightness and a glowing effect around bright areas.

Image Bounds to Console.description: This node is designed for debugging purposes, specifically to output the bounds of an image to the console. It allows for a customizable label to accompany the bounds information, enhancing readability and traceability during debugging sessions.

inputs.name: image_bounds
inputs.description: Represents the boundaries of an image that are to be debugged. This input is crucial for determining the specific area of the image to focus on during the debugging process.

inputs.name: label
inputs.description: An optional label to accompany the bounds information in the console output. This label can provide context or a description for the bounds being debugged, making the output more informative.

outputs.name: image_bounds
outputs.description: Echoes back the input image bounds, allowing for further processing or analysis in subsequent nodes.

Image Bounds.description: The Image Bounds node is designed to calculate the bounding box of an image, effectively identifying the outermost edges where content exists. This functionality is crucial for tasks that require understanding of image dimensions and spatial content, such as cropping, resizing, or further image analysis.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The 'image' parameter represents the input image for which the bounding box is to be calculated. It plays a critical role in determining the spatial limits of the content within the image.

outputs.name: image_bounds
outputs.description: The 'image_bounds' output provides the calculated bounding box of the input image, represented as a list of tuples with the format (min_row, max_row, min_col, max_col) for each image in the batch.

Image Canny Filter.description: The Image Canny Filter node is designed to detect edges in an image using the Canny edge detection algorithm. It processes an input image to highlight its edges, making it useful for image analysis and preprocessing tasks where edge detection is crucial.

inputs.name: images
inputs.description: The input image tensor to be processed for edge detection. It is crucial for identifying and highlighting the edges within the image.

inputs.name: enable_threshold
inputs.description: A boolean flag to enable or disable the thresholding in edge detection. This affects how edges are detected based on the specified thresholds.

inputs.name: threshold_low
inputs.description: The lower threshold for the hysteresis procedure in edge detection. It determines the minimum intensity gradient of edges to be considered.

inputs.name: threshold_high
inputs.description: The upper threshold for the hysteresis procedure in edge detection. It sets the maximum intensity gradient of edges to be detected.

outputs.name: images
outputs.description: The output image tensor with detected edges highlighted. It is useful for further image analysis or preprocessing steps.

Image Chromatic Aberration.description: This node applies a chromatic aberration effect to an image by adjusting the RGB channels' offsets and intensity, simulating the way light disperses through a lens.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The input image to which the chromatic aberration effect will be applied.

inputs.name: red_offset
inputs.description: The offset value for the red channel, affecting the dispersion effect.

inputs.name: green_offset
inputs.description: The offset value for the green channel, affecting the dispersion effect.

inputs.name: blue_offset
inputs.description: The offset value for the blue channel, affecting the dispersion effect.

inputs.name: intensity
inputs.description: The intensity of the chromatic aberration effect.

inputs.name: fade_radius
inputs.description: The radius over which the chromatic aberration effect fades off.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The image with the applied chromatic aberration effect.

Image Color Palette.description: The Image Color Palette node is designed to generate color palettes from images. It utilizes various algorithms to analyze the colors within an image and produce a palette that represents the most significant or desired colors. This node can be used for tasks such as image analysis, enhancing visual content, or creating thematic color schemes based on images.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The input image from which the color palette will be generated. This image is analyzed to extract the dominant or specified colors to form the palette.

inputs.name: colors
inputs.description: Specifies the number of colors to include in the generated palette. This parameter allows for customization of the palette's complexity and detail.

inputs.name: mode
inputs.description: Determines the method used to generate the color palette, such as linear, brightness, tonal, or a combination of brightness and tonal. This affects how colors are selected and organized within the palette.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The visual representation of the generated color palette, typically displayed as an image. This output allows users to see the palette's colors in context.

outputs.name: color_palettes
outputs.description: The list of colors in the generated palette, usually provided in a specific format such as RGB or hexadecimal. This output is useful for applying the palette colors in various applications.

Image Crop Face.description: This node specializes in detecting and cropping faces within images, optionally applying a padding around the detected face area for better framing. It leverages facial detection algorithms to identify the most prominent face in an image and extracts it, adjusting the crop size based on specified padding parameters.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The input image where a face needs to be detected and cropped. This parameter is crucial as it provides the visual data from which the node will identify and extract the face.

inputs.name: crop_padding_factor
inputs.description: Specifies the amount of padding to add around the detected face area before cropping. This helps in ensuring that the face is well-framed within the cropped image, enhancing the visual appeal.

inputs.name: cascade_xml
inputs.description: An optional parameter specifying the name of the cascade classifier to be used for face detection. This allows for flexibility in choosing different detection algorithms based on the application's requirements.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The cropped image containing the detected face, potentially with added padding for better framing. This output is the primary result of the node's face detection and cropping operation.

outputs.name: crop_data
outputs.description: Provides data related to the cropping operation, including the dimensions and location of the cropped area.

Image Crop Location.description: This node is designed to crop a given image based on specified coordinates and dimensions, adjusting the crop area to fit within the original image's boundaries. It ensures the cropped area does not exceed the image's dimensions by dynamically adjusting the specified coordinates and size.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The input image to be cropped. This parameter is crucial as it defines the base image from which a specific region will be extracted based on the provided coordinates.

inputs.name: top
inputs.description: The top coordinate for the cropping area, influencing the vertical starting point of the crop within the original image.

inputs.name: left
inputs.description: The left coordinate for the cropping area, influencing the horizontal starting point of the crop within the original image.

inputs.name: right
inputs.description: The right coordinate for the cropping area, determining the horizontal end point of the crop within the original image.

inputs.name: bottom
inputs.description: The bottom coordinate for the cropping area, determining the vertical end point of the crop within the original image.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The cropped image.

outputs.name: crop_data
outputs.description: Crop data including the final crop dimensions and coordinates.

Image Crop Square Location.description: This node specializes in cropping a square region from an image based on specified coordinates and size. It adjusts the crop area to ensure it remains within the image's boundaries and optionally resizes the cropped region to maintain a dimension that is a multiple of 8, facilitating compatibility with certain image processing operations.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The input image to be cropped. This parameter is crucial as it defines the base from which the square region will be extracted.

inputs.name: x
inputs.description: The x-coordinate of the center point of the square crop. It influences the horizontal positioning of the crop area within the image.

inputs.name: y
inputs.description: The y-coordinate of the center point of the square crop. It affects the vertical positioning of the crop area within the image.

inputs.name: size
inputs.description: The size of the square to be cropped from the image. This parameter determines the dimensions of the resulting cropped area.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The cropped square region of the image, resized to ensure its dimensions are multiples of 8.

outputs.name: crop_data
outputs.description: The original crop data detailing the dimensions and coordinates of the crop.

Image Displacement Warp.description: This node applies a displacement warp effect to an image based on a provided displacement map and amplitude. It adjusts the positions of pixels in the original image according to the displacement values, creating a visually distorted version of the image that simulates physical displacement.

inputs.name: images
inputs.description: The original images to be warped. They serve as the base for applying the displacement effect.

inputs.name: displacement_maps
inputs.description: Grayscale images representing the displacement maps. Each pixel's intensity in these maps indicates the displacement amount for the corresponding pixel in the original images.

inputs.name: amplitude
inputs.description: A scalar value that scales the displacement effect. Higher values result in more pronounced displacement.

outputs.name: images
outputs.description: The resulting images after applying the displacement warp effect. They showcase the original images with the displacement effect applied.

Image Dragan Photography Filter.description: This node applies a Dragan effect to images, enhancing their visual appeal by adjusting saturation, contrast, sharpness, brightness, and colorization. It utilizes a high-pass filter to accentuate details and texture, creating a distinctive, dramatic look.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The input images to which the Dragan effect will be applied. This parameter is crucial for defining the visual content that will undergo transformation.

inputs.name: saturation
inputs.description: Controls the intensity of the image's colors, affecting the vibrancy of the output.

inputs.name: contrast
inputs.description: Adjusts the difference between the darkest and lightest tones in the image, enhancing the visual depth.

inputs.name: brightness
inputs.description: Modifies the overall lightness or darkness of the image, affecting its visibility and mood.

inputs.name: sharpness
inputs.description: Determines the clarity of detail in the image, making textures more pronounced.

inputs.name: highpass_radius
inputs.description: Specifies the radius for the high-pass filter, influencing the level of detail enhancement.

inputs.name: highpass_samples
inputs.description: Defines the number of samples for the high-pass filter, affecting the texture's granularity.

inputs.name: highpass_strength
inputs.description: Sets the strength of the high-pass filter, determining the intensity of detail accentuation.

inputs.name: colorize
inputs.description: Enables or disables colorization, adding a unique hue to the image or preserving its original colors.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The transformed images with the applied Dragan effect, showcasing enhanced textures and dramatic visual appeal.

Image Edge Detection Filter.description: This node applies edge detection filters to images, offering different modes such as normal edge detection and Laplacian edge detection. It transforms images by highlighting their edges, enhancing the visual distinction of shapes and boundaries within the image.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The input image to apply edge detection on. It is crucial for identifying and enhancing the edges within the image.

inputs.name: mode
inputs.description: Specifies the edge detection mode to use, either 'normal' or 'laplacian'. This choice affects how edges are detected and highlighted in the image.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The output image with edges detected and enhanced, represented as a tensor. This image visually emphasizes the edges and boundaries within the original image.

Image fDOF Filter.description: The node focuses on applying a field of depth effect to images, simulating the depth-of-field effect often seen in photography. This effect can make a subject stand out by blurring the background or foreground in relation to the subject's focus distance.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The input image to which the field of depth effect will be applied. This parameter is crucial for determining the areas of focus and blur within the image.

inputs.name: depth
inputs.description: Specifies the depth information for each part of the image, used to calculate the blur intensity in relation to the subject's focus distance.

inputs.name: mode
inputs.description: Determines the type of blur to be applied, offering options such as 'mock', 'gaussian', and 'box' to simulate different depth-of-field effects.

inputs.name: radius
inputs.description: Controls the radius of the blur effect, affecting the extent of the area that appears out of focus.

inputs.name: samples
inputs.description: Defines the number of samples to be used in the blur effect, influencing the quality and intensity of the depth-of-field simulation.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The output image with the field of depth effect applied, showcasing areas of focus and blur based on the specified parameters.

Image Film Grain.description: The node applies a film grain effect to images, simulating the appearance of traditional film photography. It allows customization of the grain's density, intensity, and highlights, offering a way to add texture and a vintage feel to digital images.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The input image to which the film grain effect will be applied. This parameter is crucial as it determines the base image that will be transformed.

inputs.name: density
inputs.description: Controls the density of the grain effect, affecting how many noise pixels are added to the image. Higher values result in a more pronounced grain effect.

inputs.name: intensity
inputs.description: Adjusts the intensity of the grain effect, influencing the visibility and impact of the grain on the final image.

inputs.name: highlights
inputs.description: Modifies the brightness of the highlights in the image, allowing for finer control over the appearance of the grain in lighter areas.

inputs.name: supersample_factor
inputs.description: A factor for supersampling the image before applying the grain, which can enhance the quality of the effect.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The output image with the film grain effect applied, including adjustments to density, intensity, and highlights.

Image Filter Adjustments.description: This node provides a comprehensive suite of image adjustment tools, allowing users to modify and enhance images through a variety of filters such as brightness, contrast, saturation, sharpness, and blur adjustments. It serves as a versatile tool for fine-tuning the visual aspects of images to meet specific aesthetic or technical requirements.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The input image to be adjusted. This parameter is crucial as it serves as the base for all subsequent adjustments, determining the visual output of the node.

inputs.name: brightness
inputs.description: Adjusts the brightness level of the input image, affecting its overall lightness or darkness.

inputs.name: contrast
inputs.description: Modifies the contrast of the input image, enhancing or reducing the difference between its light and dark areas.

inputs.name: saturation
inputs.description: Alters the saturation level of the input image, adjusting the intensity of its colors.

inputs.name: sharpness
inputs.description: Adjusts the sharpness of the input image, affecting the clarity and detail of its visual elements.

inputs.name: blur
inputs.description: Applies a blur effect to the input image, softening its appearance by reducing detail and texture.

inputs.name: gaussian_blur
inputs.description: Applies a Gaussian blur effect to the input image, creating a smooth, blurred appearance with a specific radius.

inputs.name: edge_enhance
inputs.description: Enhances the edges within the input image, making them more pronounced and defined.

inputs.name: detail_enhance
inputs.description: Enhances the details of the input image, improving its overall sharpness and clarity.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The adjusted image, reflecting the applied filters and enhancements.

Image Flip.description: The Image Flip node provides functionality to flip images either horizontally or vertically, allowing for simple yet effective transformations of image data.

inputs.name: images
inputs.description: A batch of images to be flipped. This parameter is crucial for determining which images undergo the flipping process.

inputs.name: mode
inputs.description: Specifies the direction of the flip, either 'horizontal' or 'vertical'. This affects how the images are transformed.

outputs.name: images
outputs.description: The batch of images after being flipped according to the specified mode.

Image Generate Gradient.description: This node is designed to generate images with gradient effects based on specified color stops, direction, and size. It allows for the creation of visually appealing backgrounds or elements by blending colors smoothly across the image in either a horizontal or vertical direction, with an option to adjust the tolerance for color transitions.

inputs.name: width
inputs.description: Specifies the width of the generated gradient image. It determines how wide the image will be.

inputs.name: height
inputs.description: Specifies the height of the generated gradient image. It determines how tall the image will be.

inputs.name: direction
inputs.description: Determines the direction of the gradient transition in the image, either horizontal or vertical.

inputs.name: tolerance
inputs.description: Adjusts the tolerance for color transitions in the gradient, affecting the smoothness of the gradient effect.

inputs.name: gradient_stops
inputs.description: Defines the color stops for the gradient, specifying the colors and their positions within the gradient transition.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The generated image with the specified gradient effect.

Image Gradient Map.description: The node applies a gradient map to an image, optionally flipping the gradient map horizontally. It transforms the input image by mapping its grayscale values to colors defined in the gradient map, creating a visually appealing effect that retains the original image's structure while altering its color scheme.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The original image to which the gradient map will be applied. It serves as the base for the transformation, dictating the structure of the output image.

inputs.name: gradient_image
inputs.description: The gradient map image that defines the color transformation. This image's colors are mapped to the grayscale values of the original image, determining the output image's color scheme.

inputs.name: flip_left_right
inputs.description: A boolean flag indicating whether the gradient map should be flipped horizontally before being applied. This can alter the visual effect of the gradient mapping on the original image.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The resulting image after applying the gradient map to the original image. This output retains the structure of the original image but features the colors defined by the gradient map.

Image High Pass Filter.description: This node applies a high-pass filter to an image, enhancing edges and details by subtracting a blurred version of the image from the original. It supports adjustments for the filter's radius and strength, and offers options for color output and a neutral background.

inputs.name: images
inputs.description: The input images to be processed with the high-pass filter. The filter enhances edges and details by emphasizing high-frequency components.

inputs.name: radius
inputs.description: Determines the radius of the Gaussian blur applied to create the high-pass filter, affecting the level of detail enhancement.

inputs.name: strength
inputs.description: Adjusts the intensity of the high-pass filter effect, controlling how much the edges and details are emphasized.

inputs.name: color_output
inputs.description: Specifies whether the output image should be in color or grayscale.

inputs.name: neutral_background
inputs.description: Determines if a neutral background should be applied to the image, potentially enhancing visibility of details.

outputs.name: images
outputs.description: The resulting images after applying the high-pass filter, with enhanced edges and details.

Image History Loader.description: The Image History Loader node is designed to retrieve and load historical image data from a specified database. It focuses on accessing and processing previously stored images, ensuring that users can easily retrieve and utilize historical image data for various purposes, such as analysis, comparison, or restoration.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The 'image' parameter specifies the name or identifier of the image to be retrieved from the history database. It plays a crucial role in locating and loading the specific historical image data for further processing or analysis.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: This output is a tensor representation of the loaded image, providing the image data for further processing.

outputs.name: filename_text
outputs.description: This output is the basename of the image file, providing the image name for reference or display purposes.

Image Input Switch.description: The Image Input Switch node is designed to selectively output one of two input images based on a boolean condition. This functionality allows for dynamic image processing flows where the path of execution can change based on conditional logic.

inputs.name: image_a
inputs.description: The first image input option for the switch. This image is selected if the boolean condition is true.

inputs.name: image_b
inputs.description: The second image input option for the switch. This image is selected if the boolean condition is false.

inputs.name: boolean
inputs.description: A boolean input that determines which of the two images (image_a or image_b) is output by the node.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The output image, which is either image_a or image_b depending on the boolean condition.

Image Levels Adjustment.description: The Image Levels Adjustment node is designed to modify the tonal range of an image by adjusting its black, mid, and white levels. This process enhances the visual quality of the image by altering its contrast and brightness, making it more visually appealing or suitable for further processing.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The input image to be adjusted. This parameter is crucial as it serves as the base for the levels adjustment process, directly influencing the outcome of the adjustment.

inputs.name: black_level
inputs.description: Specifies the minimum intensity value that pixels in the image should have. Adjusting this level affects the overall darkness of the image, enhancing details in darker regions.

inputs.name: mid_level
inputs.description: Defines the midpoint intensity value for the image's tonal range. Adjusting the mid level can significantly alter the image's contrast, affecting its overall visual appearance.

inputs.name: white_level
inputs.description: Sets the maximum intensity value that pixels in the image can reach. This level adjustment brightens the image and can bring out details in lighter areas.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The adjusted image with modified black, mid, and white levels. This output reflects the changes made to the image's tonal range, enhancing its visual quality.

Image Load.description: The Image Load node is designed to load images from a specified path, supporting both local and remote sources. It processes the images to convert them into a format suitable for further analysis or manipulation, optionally handling RGBA conversion and providing filename information. This node is essential for preparing image data for downstream tasks in image processing pipelines.

inputs.name: image_path
inputs.description: Specifies the path to the image to be loaded. This can be a local file path or a URL to an image online. The node handles different sources and formats, ensuring the image is accessible for processing.

inputs.name: RGBA
inputs.description: Determines whether the loaded image should be converted to RGBA format. This is useful for maintaining transparency information in images that support it.

inputs.name: filename_text_extension
inputs.description: Controls whether the returned filename includes the file extension. This can be useful for subsequent processing steps that may require the filename with or without its extension.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The processed image data, converted to a tensor format suitable for further analysis or manipulation.

outputs.name: mask
outputs.description: A mask tensor representing the alpha channel of the image, useful for operations that require knowledge of transparent areas.

outputs.name: filename_text
outputs.description: The filename of the loaded image, optionally including the file extension based on the input parameter.

Image Lucy Sharpen.description: The node applies a Lucy-Richardson deconvolution algorithm to sharpen images. It iteratively enhances the contrast of edges by deblurring the image through a series of convolutions with a specified kernel, improving the visual clarity and detail of the image.

inputs.name: images
inputs.description: The input images to be sharpened. This parameter is crucial as it determines the base images that will undergo the sharpening process.

inputs.name: iterations
inputs.description: Specifies the number of times the sharpening process is applied. Higher values result in a more pronounced sharpening effect.

inputs.name: kernel_size
inputs.description: Determines the size of the convolution kernel used for sharpening. A larger kernel size can lead to a smoother sharpening effect.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The output sharpened images, with enhanced edges and details.

Image Median Filter.description: The Image Median Filter node applies a median filter effect to images, enhancing their quality by reducing noise without significantly blurring the edges. It allows for customization of the filter's diameter and the sigma values for color and space, enabling fine-tuned adjustments to the filtering process.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The input image or images to which the median filter will be applied. This parameter is crucial for defining the target of the filtering operation.

inputs.name: diameter
inputs.description: Specifies the diameter of the pixel neighborhood used during filtering. A larger diameter increases the area considered for calculating the median, affecting the level of detail and noise reduction.

inputs.name: sigma_color
inputs.description: Controls the filter's sensitivity to color differences. A higher sigma value means that colors farther apart will influence each other more, leading to smoother color transitions.

inputs.name: sigma_space
inputs.description: Determines the spatial extent of the filter. A higher value allows pixels farther apart to influence each other, resulting in a smoother image but potentially blurring edges.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The output image or images after applying the median filter, showcasing reduced noise and potentially enhanced detail without significant edge blurring.

Image Mix RGB Channels.description: This node is designed to merge individual red, green, and blue image channels into a single RGB image. It abstracts the complexity of channel manipulation and blending, providing a straightforward way to combine these color components into a cohesive visual representation.

inputs.name: red_channel
inputs.description: The red channel of the image, representing the intensity of the red color component across the image. It plays a crucial role in determining the overall hue and saturation of the merged RGB image.

inputs.name: green_channel
inputs.description: The green channel of the image, representing the intensity of the green color component. It significantly influences the final color balance and appearance of the merged RGB image.

inputs.name: blue_channel
inputs.description: The blue channel of the image, indicating the intensity of the blue color component. This channel is essential for achieving the desired depth and tone in the final RGB image.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The resulting image after merging the red, green, and blue channels. It is a full-color RGB image that combines the input channels into a single, visually cohesive output.

Image Monitor Effects Filter.description: This node applies various monitor effect filters to an image, simulating digital, signal, and TV distortions. It allows for customization of the distortion intensity and offset, providing a versatile tool for creating visually unique images.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The input image to which the monitor effect filters will be applied. It serves as the base for the distortion effects.

inputs.name: mode
inputs.description: Specifies the type of distortion effect to apply: Digital Distortion, Signal Distortion, or TV Distortion. This choice determines the visual style of the output image.

inputs.name: amplitude
inputs.description: Controls the intensity of the distortion effect. A higher value results in more pronounced distortions.

inputs.name: offset
inputs.description: Adjusts the offset of the distortion effect, allowing for further customization of the visual outcome.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The output image after applying the selected monitor effect filter. It showcases the visual distortions as specified by the input parameters.

Image Nova Filter.description: The node applies a 'Nova' filter effect to images, enhancing them with a specific visual style that alters their appearance in a distinctive way. This process involves modifying various aspects of the image to achieve the desired aesthetic, contributing to a broad range of creative and artistic applications.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The 'image' parameter represents the input image(s) to which the Nova filter effect will be applied. It plays a crucial role in determining the final output, as the filter effect directly modifies the visual characteristics of these images.

inputs.name: amplitude
inputs.description: The 'amplitude' parameter adjusts the intensity of the Nova filter effect, influencing the degree of visual alteration applied to the image.

inputs.name: frequency
inputs.description: The 'frequency' parameter controls the frequency of the visual patterns introduced by the Nova filter effect, affecting the overall texture and appearance of the image.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The output is the transformed image(s) after the application of the Nova filter effect, showcasing the distinctive visual style imparted by the filter.

Image Padding.description: The Image Padding node is designed to modify the spatial dimensions of an image by adding padding around its edges. This process can include creating feathered edges for a smoother transition between the image and the padding, as well as applying additional transformations to ensure the padded image maintains its visual integrity. The node can handle various padding configurations and is capable of generating a mask to highlight the padded areas.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The original image to which padding will be applied. This is the primary input over which all padding and feathering operations are performed.

inputs.name: feathering
inputs.description: Determines the radius of the feathering effect applied at the edges of the padding, creating a smooth transition between the image and the padding.

inputs.name: feather_second_pass
inputs.description: A boolean flag indicating whether a second pass of padding adjustments should be applied, potentially refining the padding process for better visual results.

inputs.name: left_padding
inputs.description: Specifies the width of the padding to be added to the left side of the image. This parameter directly influences the horizontal dimension of the resulting image.

inputs.name: right_padding
inputs.description: Specifies the width of the padding to be added to the right side of the image. This parameter directly influences the horizontal dimension of the resulting image.

inputs.name: top_padding
inputs.description: Specifies the height of the padding to be added to the top of the image. This parameter directly influences the vertical dimension of the resulting image.

inputs.name: bottom_padding
inputs.description: Specifies the height of the padding to be added to the bottom of the image. This parameter directly influences the vertical dimension of the resulting image.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The resulting image after padding has been applied, potentially including a feathered edge for smoother transitions.

Image Paste Crop by Location.description: This node specializes in pasting a cropped image onto a specified location within another image, allowing for blending and sharpening adjustments. It provides the capability to seamlessly integrate a cropped image into a larger canvas, with options to fine-tune the integration through blending gradients and sharpening effects, enhancing the overall composition.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The base image onto which the cropped image will be pasted. It serves as the canvas for the operation, determining the final image's dimensions and serving as the background for the pasted crop.

inputs.name: crop_image
inputs.description: The cropped image to be pasted onto the base image. This image is the focal point of the operation, and its placement and appearance adjustments (blending and sharpening) significantly influence the outcome.

inputs.name: top
inputs.description: The top coordinate where the cropped image will be placed on the base image. It determines the vertical positioning of the crop.

inputs.name: left
inputs.description: The left coordinate where the cropped image will be placed on the base image. It determines the horizontal positioning of the crop.

inputs.name: right
inputs.description: The right boundary for the cropping operation, affecting how the image blends on the right side.

inputs.name: bottom
inputs.description: The bottom boundary for the cropping operation, affecting how the image blends on the bottom side.

inputs.name: crop_blending
inputs.description: The degree to which the cropped image blends with the base image at the edges, creating a gradient transition. This parameter allows for a smoother integration of the crop into the base image.

inputs.name: crop_sharpening
inputs.description: The intensity of the sharpening effect applied to the cropped image. This parameter can enhance the details of the crop, making it stand out more or blend better with the base image.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The resulting image after the cropped image has been pasted, blended, and optionally sharpened onto the base image. It represents the final composition, showcasing the integrated appearance of the crop within the larger canvas.

Image Paste Crop.description: This node specializes in blending a cropped image onto another image, applying optional sharpening and gradient blending based on specified parameters. It allows for precise control over the cropping, blending, and sharpening processes to achieve a seamlessly integrated final image.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The base image onto which the cropped image will be pasted. It serves as the background for the operation.

inputs.name: crop_image
inputs.description: The image to be cropped and pasted onto the base image. This image is manipulated according to the crop data and other parameters before being integrated.

inputs.name: crop_data
inputs.description: Specifies the dimensions and coordinates for cropping the 'crop_image'. It includes the crop size and the bounding box coordinates.

inputs.name: crop_blending
inputs.description: Determines the intensity of the gradient blending at the edges of the cropped image, affecting how seamlessly it integrates with the base image.

inputs.name: crop_sharpening
inputs.description: Specifies the level of sharpening to apply to the cropped image, enhancing its details before pasting.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The resulting image after the cropped image has been pasted and blended onto the base image.

Image Paste Face.description: This node specializes in seamlessly integrating a cropped image onto a target image, with options for blending and sharpening to ensure a natural and aesthetically pleasing result. It does not specifically focus on facial detection or adjustment but rather on the general process of pasting and adjusting an image segment within another image.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The base image onto which the cropped image will be pasted. It serves as the backdrop for the integration process.

inputs.name: crop_image
inputs.description: The cropped image that will be pasted onto the base image. This image is the focal point of the operation, being integrated into the base image.

inputs.name: crop_data
inputs.description: Data specifying how the cropped image should be adjusted and aligned on the base image. It includes positional adjustments and size modifications to ensure a proper fit.

inputs.name: crop_blending
inputs.description: Determines the degree of blending between the cropped image and the base image, affecting the smoothness of the integration.

inputs.name: crop_sharpening
inputs.description: Controls the sharpness of the pasted image, enhancing the clarity and detail of the image features after integration.

outputs.name: IMAGE
outputs.description: The resulting image after the cropped image has been pasted and integrated with the base image, potentially blended and sharpened for aesthetic enhancement.

outputs.name: MASK_IMAGE
outputs.description: The mask image representing the area affected by the pasting operation, useful for further processing or analysis.

Image Perlin Noise.description: The Image Perlin Noise node generates a Perlin noise pattern, a type of gradient noise often used for procedural texture generation. This node allows for the creation of complex, natural-looking textures by simulating the appearance of random variations in surfaces or materials.

inputs.name: width
inputs.description: Specifies the width of the generated noise image. It determines the horizontal dimension of the output texture.

inputs.name: height
inputs.description: Defines the height of the generated noise image, affecting its vertical dimension.

inputs.name: scale
inputs.description: Controls the scale of the noise pattern, influencing the granularity and overall appearance of the texture.

inputs.name: octaves
inputs.description: Determines the number of layers of noise to be combined, affecting the complexity and detail of the final texture.

inputs.name: persistence
inputs.description: Adjusts the amplitude of each octave, influencing the contrast between high and low values in the noise pattern.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.description: Sets the initial value for the noise generation algorithm, ensuring reproducibility of the noise pattern.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The generated Perlin noise image, which can be used as a texture or a basis for further graphical manipulations.

Image Perlin Power Fractal.description: This node generates a Perlin Power Fractal image, leveraging Perlin noise to create complex, visually appealing textures or landscapes. It allows for detailed customization of the fractal's appearance through various parameters, including scale, octaves, and persistence.

inputs.name: width
inputs.description: Specifies the width of the generated image. Affects the overall size and detail level of the fractal.

inputs.name: height
inputs.description: Determines the height of the generated image, influencing the fractal's size and detail.

inputs.name: scale
inputs.description: Controls the scale of the noise used in the fractal, impacting the zoom level and detail of the texture.

inputs.name: octaves
inputs.description: Adjusts the number of layers of noise to combine, affecting the complexity and detail of the fractal.

inputs.name: persistence
inputs.description: Modifies the amplitude of each octave, influencing the roughness and detail of the fractal's surface.

inputs.name: lacunarity
inputs.description: Changes the frequency of each octave, affecting the fractal's texture and detail.

inputs.name: exponent
inputs.description: Alters the power to which the scale is raised, impacting the fractal's appearance and detail.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.description: Sets the seed for the noise generation, ensuring reproducibility of the fractal patterns.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The generated Perlin Power Fractal image, represented as a tensor.

Image Pixelate.description: The node is designed to transform images into pixel art by applying pixelation, color reduction, and optionally dithering. It supports customization of pixelation size, number of colors, initial color selection mode, dithering options, and color palettes, allowing for a wide range of artistic effects.

inputs.name: images
inputs.description: The images to be transformed into pixel art. This input is crucial for defining the base content that will undergo pixelation and color reduction.

inputs.name: pixelation_size
inputs.description: Specifies the size of the pixels in the resulting pixel art, controlling the level of detail and abstraction.

inputs.name: num_colors
inputs.description: Determines the number of colors used in the pixel art, affecting the color complexity and style.

inputs.name: init_mode
inputs.description: Defines the initial color selection mode, influencing the starting point for color optimization.

inputs.name: max_iterations
inputs.description: Sets the maximum number of iterations for color optimization, impacting the refinement of the final pixel art.

inputs.name: dither
inputs.description: Enables or disables dithering, a technique to simulate additional colors and gradients through patterns.

inputs.name: dither_mode
inputs.description: Selects the dithering algorithm to be used, influencing the pattern and appearance of simulated colors.

inputs.name: color_palettes
inputs.description: A list of color palettes to be used for coloring the pixel art, offering additional customization for the final appearance.

inputs.name: color_palette_mode
inputs.description: Determines how the color palettes are applied, affecting the gradient and transition between colors.

inputs.name: reverse_palette
inputs.description: When enabled, reverses the order of colors in the palette, allowing for different visual effects.

outputs.name: images
outputs.description: The resulting pixel art images, transformed from the original inputs through pixelation, color reduction, and optional dithering.

Image Power Noise.description: This node generates a power noise image based on specified parameters such as width, height, frequency, attenuation, and noise type. It allows for the creation of various noise patterns by manipulating these parameters, providing a versatile tool for generating noise-based images.

inputs.name: width
inputs.description: Specifies the width of the generated noise image. It determines the horizontal dimension of the output image.

inputs.name: height
inputs.description: Specifies the height of the generated noise image. It determines the vertical dimension of the output image.

inputs.name: frequency
inputs.description: Controls the frequency of the noise pattern. Higher values result in more frequent changes in the noise pattern.

inputs.name: attenuation
inputs.description: Determines the attenuation of the noise pattern. It affects the amplitude of the noise, with higher values leading to more subdued noise patterns.

inputs.name: noise_type
inputs.description: Defines the type of noise to generate, such as 'grey', 'white', 'pink', 'blue', 'green', or 'mix'. This parameter allows for the creation of different noise characteristics.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.description: A seed value for the noise generation process, ensuring reproducibility of the noise pattern.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The generated power noise image.

Image Rembg (Remove Background).description: The Image Rembg (Remove Background) node is designed to process images by removing the background, enhancing the focus on the foreground elements. It utilizes various image processing techniques such as thresholding, blurring, and masking to achieve a transparent or solid-color background, thereby isolating the main subjects of the image.

inputs.name: images
inputs.description: The input images to be processed for background removal. These images undergo transformations to isolate the foreground from the background.

inputs.name: transparency
inputs.description: Controls the level of transparency applied to the background area of the images, allowing for fine-tuning of the background removal effect.

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: Specifies the model used for background removal, enabling the selection of different algorithms based on the desired outcome.

inputs.name: post_processing
inputs.description: Indicates whether post-processing steps such as smoothing and edge refinement are applied to the processed images.

inputs.name: only_mask
inputs.description: When set to true, the node outputs only the mask used for background removal instead of the processed images.

inputs.name: alpha_matting
inputs.description: Enables alpha matting, which helps in achieving more accurate and finer background removal, especially around the edges of the foreground elements.

inputs.name: alpha_matting_foreground_threshold
inputs.description: Sets the threshold for determining the foreground elements during the alpha matting process, affecting the precision of the background removal.

inputs.name: alpha_matting_background_threshold
inputs.description: Sets the threshold for determining the background elements during the alpha matting process, affecting the precision of the background removal.

inputs.name: alpha_matting_erode_size
inputs.description: Determines the size of the erosion applied to the mask during the alpha matting process, impacting the smoothness of the edges.

inputs.name: background_color
inputs.description: Specifies the color applied to the background of the images after removal, allowing for customization of the background appearance.

outputs.name: images
