Write to Video.description: The 'Write to Video' node is designed to facilitate the creation and manipulation of video files from images. It encompasses functionalities such as writing individual images to a video, generating transition frames between images, adding still image delays, and configuring video properties like frame rate and resolution. This node aims to provide a comprehensive set of tools for video editing and generation, making it easier to produce high-quality video content.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The image or sequence of images to be written into the video. This is the primary content that will be displayed in the video.

inputs.name: transition_frames
inputs.description: Specifies the number of frames used for creating smooth transitions between images in the video. It enhances the visual flow of the video content.

inputs.name: image_delay_sec
inputs.description: Determines the duration for which each image is displayed in the video, allowing for the creation of still image delays. This parameter helps in controlling the pacing of the video content.

inputs.name: fps
inputs.description: Sets the frame rate of the video, defining how many frames are displayed per second. This parameter is crucial for determining the smoothness and playback speed of the video.

inputs.name: max_size
inputs.description: Specifies the maximum size (in pixels) for the images in the video, ensuring that all images are uniformly scaled. This parameter helps in maintaining consistent video quality and aspect ratio.

inputs.name: output_path
inputs.description: The path to the directory where the video will be saved. It determines the location of the output video file.

inputs.name: filename
inputs.description: The name of the output video file. It allows for easy identification and organization of created videos.

inputs.name: codec
inputs.description: Defines the codec used for encoding the video. Different codecs can affect the video's compatibility, size, and quality.

outputs.name: IMAGE_PASS
outputs.description: Indicates whether the image processing and video writing operations were successful.

outputs.name: filepath_text
outputs.description: The full path to the created video file, including its name. It provides a direct link to access or share the video.

outputs.name: filename_text
outputs.description: The name of the created video file. It helps in identifying the video among other files.

BLVAEEncode.description: The BLVAEEncode node is designed for encoding images into a latent space representation using a Variational Autoencoder (VAE). It supports both standard and tiled encoding modes, and offers functionality for storing or loading the encoded latent representations. This node is essential for tasks that require manipulation or analysis of images in their latent form, such as image generation or modification.

inputs.name: vae
inputs.description: Specifies the Variational Autoencoder (VAE) model to be used for encoding the images into latent space. This parameter is crucial for determining the characteristics of the latent representation.

inputs.name: tiled
inputs.description: A boolean flag indicating whether the encoding should be performed in a tiled manner. Tiled encoding can be beneficial for handling large images by processing them in smaller, manageable tiles.

inputs.name: tile_size
inputs.description: Defines the size of the tiles (in pixels) to be used when tiled encoding is enabled. This parameter allows for flexibility in managing the granularity of the encoding process.

inputs.name: store_or_load_latent
inputs.description: A boolean flag that determines whether the encoded latent representation should be stored or loaded. This functionality is useful for workflows that require persistence of latent data.

inputs.name: remove_latent_on_load
inputs.description: A boolean flag that indicates whether the latent representation should be removed from storage upon loading. This can help manage storage space efficiently.

inputs.name: delete_workflow_latent
inputs.description: A boolean flag that specifies whether the latent representation associated with a workflow should be deleted. This parameter is useful for cleaning up data that is no longer needed.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: The image to be encoded into latent space. This parameter is optional and allows for direct encoding of provided images.

outputs.name: latent
outputs.description: The encoded latent representation of the input image. This output is essential for subsequent manipulation or analysis in the latent space.

CLIPTextEncodeList.description: This node is designed for encoding textual inputs using a CLIP model, transforming them into a structured format that can be utilized for further computational tasks or analyses. It focuses on processing multiple text inputs, applying tokenization and encoding to extract relevant features for downstream applications.

inputs.name: clip
inputs.description: The 'clip' parameter represents the CLIP model used for text encoding. It is crucial for the node's operation as it determines how text inputs are processed and encoded.

inputs.name: token_normalization
inputs.description: Specifies the method for normalizing tokens, affecting the encoding process's outcome. It plays a significant role in adjusting the encoding based on the chosen normalization strategy.

inputs.name: weight_interpretation
inputs.description: Defines how weights are interpreted during the encoding process, influencing the final encoded output. It's important for tailoring the encoding to specific weight interpretation preferences.

inputs.name: text
inputs.description: The textual input to be encoded. This parameter is essential as it provides the raw data for the encoding process.

outputs.name: conditioning_sequence
outputs.description: The output is a sequence of conditionings derived from the encoded text inputs. It's significant for subsequent computational tasks that rely on these encoded representations.

CLIPTextEncodeSequence2.description: This node is designed to encode text inputs into a sequence of conditionings suitable for guiding generative models. It processes each line of the input text, optionally using an advanced encoding method if available, and organizes the encoded data into a structured sequence that can be utilized for conditional generation tasks.

inputs.name: clip
inputs.description: The CLIP model used for encoding the text. It plays a crucial role in transforming textual descriptions into a format that can be understood by generative models.

inputs.name: token_normalization
inputs.description: Determines whether or not to normalize tokens during encoding, impacting the consistency and quality of the generated output.

inputs.name: weight_interpretation
inputs.description: Controls how the weights are interpreted during the encoding process, potentially altering the emphasis on different aspects of the input text.

inputs.name: cond_keyframes_type
inputs.description: Specifies the type of keyframe conditioning to apply, influencing how the encoded text is structured into a sequence for generation.

inputs.name: frame_count
inputs.description: The total number of frames to generate, affecting the distribution of conditionings across the sequence.

inputs.name: text
inputs.description: The input text to be encoded. It is processed line by line, with each line potentially representing a separate conditioning for the generative model.

outputs.name: conditioning_sequence
outputs.description: The sequence of encoded conditionings derived from the input text, ready for use in guiding generative models.

outputs.name: cond_keyframes
outputs.description: The calculated keyframe conditionings based on the input parameters, providing a structured approach to sequence generation.

outputs.name: frame_count
outputs.description: The total number of frames that will be generated, reflecting the input parameter.

ConditioningBlend.description: The ConditioningBlend node specializes in blending two conditioning inputs using specified blending modes and strengths. It allows for the dynamic combination of conditioning contexts, enabling more nuanced control over the generation process.

inputs.name: conditioning_a
inputs.description: The first conditioning input to be blended. It plays a crucial role in determining the base of the blend.

inputs.name: conditioning_b
inputs.description: The second conditioning input to be blended. It contributes to the blend by providing an additional layer of context.

inputs.name: blending_mode
inputs.description: Specifies the method used for blending the two conditioning inputs. The choice of mode affects the blending behavior and outcome.

inputs.name: blending_strength
inputs.description: Controls the strength of the blend between the two conditioning inputs, allowing for fine-tuning of the blend's intensity.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.description: A seed for random number generation, ensuring reproducibility of the blend when desired.

outputs.name: conditioning
outputs.description: The result of blending the two conditioning inputs, ready for use in further processing or generation tasks.

DebugInput.description: The DebugInput node is designed for debugging purposes, allowing users to print and inspect the properties and directory listing of any input object. It serves as a versatile tool for understanding and troubleshooting the data flowing through the node.

inputs.name: input
inputs.description: Accepts any type of input, facilitating the debugging process by printing the input's value and, if the input is an object, its directory listing.

KSamplerSeq.description: The KSamplerSeq node is designed for advanced sampling in generative models, specifically focusing on the iterative refinement of latent images through a sequence of steps. It incorporates mechanisms for unsampling latents, adjusting denoise levels dynamically, and optionally looping through the sequence to enhance the quality or diversity of the generated samples.

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: Specifies the generative model to be used for sampling.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.description: Determines the initial random seed for sampling, affecting the randomness and reproducibility of the generated samples.

inputs.name: seed_mode_seq
inputs.description: Defines the mode of seed progression throughout the sequence, allowing for incremental, decremental, random, or fixed seed values.

inputs.name: alternate_values
inputs.description: Enables or disables the alternation of certain parameters between iterations to introduce variability.

inputs.name: steps
inputs.description: The total number of steps to execute in the sampling process, impacting the refinement and detail of the output.

inputs.name: cfg
inputs.description: Controls the conditioning factor, influencing the adherence of the generated samples to the specified conditions.

inputs.name: sampler_name
inputs.description: Selects the specific sampling algorithm to be used, from a predefined set of samplers.

inputs.name: scheduler
inputs.description: Chooses the scheduling algorithm for controlling the sampling process, affecting the progression of denoising and refinement.

inputs.name: sequence_loop_count
inputs.description: Determines how many times the sampling sequence is looped, potentially enhancing the output through repeated refinement.

inputs.name: positive_seq
inputs.description: Specifies the positive conditioning sequence, guiding the generative model towards desired attributes in the output.

inputs.name: negative_seq
inputs.description: Specifies the negative conditioning sequence, steering the generative model away from undesired attributes in the output.

inputs.name: use_conditioning_slerp
inputs.description: Enables or disables spherical linear interpolation (slerp) for blending conditioning vectors, affecting the smoothness of transitions between conditions.

inputs.name: cond_slerp_strength
inputs.description: Controls the strength of the conditioning slerp, adjusting the influence of interpolated conditions on the output.

inputs.name: latent_image
inputs.description: Provides the initial latent image to be refined through the sampling process.

inputs.name: use_latent_interpolation
inputs.description: Enables or disables the interpolation of latent images, affecting the diversity and smoothness of transitions in the output.

inputs.name: latent_interpolation_mode
inputs.description: Selects the mode of latent image interpolation, allowing for blend, slerp, or cosine interpolation methods.

inputs.name: latent_interp_strength
inputs.description: Determines the strength of the latent image interpolation, influencing the degree of blending or transition between latent images.

inputs.name: denoise_start
inputs.description: Sets the initial denoise level, affecting the clarity and detail of the generated samples at the start of the sequence.

inputs.name: denoise_seq
inputs.description: Specifies the denoise level for subsequent iterations in the sequence, allowing for dynamic adjustment of clarity and detail.

inputs.name: unsample_latents
inputs.description: Determines whether to perform unsampling on the latents, potentially enhancing the quality or diversity of the output.

outputs.name: latent
outputs.description: The latent representation of the generated samples, indicating the underlying data structure that defines the output images.

KSamplerSeq2.description: KSamplerSeq2 is designed for advanced sequence-based sampling in generative models, allowing for complex conditioning, noise manipulation, and latent space operations. It supports iterative sampling with customizable denoising, latent interpolation, and conditioning strategies to generate high-quality samples.

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: Specifies the generative model to be used for sampling. It is crucial for defining the architecture and parameters that will generate the output.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.description: Determines the initial random seed for sampling, enabling reproducibility and variation in the generated sequences.

inputs.name: seed_mode_seq
inputs.description: Controls how the seed value changes across sequence iterations, affecting the diversity and coherence of the generated samples.

inputs.name: alternate_values
inputs.description: Enables or disables the alternation of certain parameters between sequence iterations, introducing variability in the sampling process.

inputs.name: steps
inputs.description: Defines the number of steps to be taken in the sampling process, impacting the detail and quality of the generated samples.

inputs.name: cfg
inputs.description: Sets the configuration for the sampling process, influencing the balance between fidelity to the input conditions and creativity.

inputs.name: sampler_name
inputs.description: Selects the specific sampling algorithm to be used, affecting the characteristics of the generated samples.

inputs.name: scheduler
inputs.description: Chooses the scheduling algorithm for controlling the sampling process, impacting the progression and quality of samples.

inputs.name: frame_count
inputs.description: Specifies the total number of frames to be generated in the sequence, affecting the overall length and complexity of the output.

inputs.name: cond_keyframes
inputs.description: Determines the number of keyframes for conditioning, influencing the variation and transitions in the generated sequence.

inputs.name: positive_seq
inputs.description: Specifies the positive conditioning sequence for the sampling, guiding the generative model towards desired attributes.

inputs.name: negative_seq
inputs.description: Specifies the negative conditioning sequence for the sampling, steering the generative model away from undesired attributes.

inputs.name: use_conditioning_slerp
inputs.description: Enables spherical linear interpolation for conditioning, allowing for smooth transitions between conditions in the sequence.

inputs.name: cond_slerp_strength
inputs.description: Controls the strength of the conditioning spherical linear interpolation, affecting the smoothness of condition transitions.

inputs.name: latent_image
inputs.description: Provides the initial latent image for the sampling process, serving as the starting point for generation.

inputs.name: use_latent_interpolation
inputs.description: Enables latent space interpolation between steps, introducing smooth transitions and variations in the generated sequence.

inputs.name: latent_interpolation_mode
inputs.description: Determines the method of latent space interpolation, affecting the nature of transitions between generated samples.

inputs.name: latent_interp_strength
inputs.description: Controls the strength of latent space interpolation, influencing the degree of variation between sequence steps.

inputs.name: denoise_start
inputs.description: Sets the initial denoising level for the sampling process, impacting the clarity and quality of the generated samples.

inputs.name: denoise_seq
inputs.description: Specifies the denoising level for subsequent steps in the sequence, allowing for dynamic adjustment of clarity.

inputs.name: unsample_latents
inputs.description: Determines whether to unsample latents during the sequence generation, affecting the detail and quality of the output.

inputs.name: inject_noise
inputs.description: Enables the injection of noise into the latent space, introducing variability and texture to the generated samples.

inputs.name: noise_strength
inputs.description: Specifies the strength of the noise to be injected, controlling the amount of variability introduced.

inputs.name: denoise_sine
inputs.description: Enables sine wave modulation of the denoise parameter, creating dynamic changes in clarity throughout the sequence.

inputs.name: denoise_max
inputs.description: Sets the maximum denoising level achievable through sine wave modulation, defining the upper limit of clarity.

inputs.name: seed_keying
inputs.description: Enables seed keying to vary the seed based on specific conditions or modes, introducing further variability.

inputs.name: seed_keying_mode
inputs.description: Specifies the mode of seed keying, affecting how the seed changes throughout the sequence.

inputs.name: seed_divisor
inputs.description: Determines the divisor used in modulo seed keying, influencing the frequency of seed changes.

outputs.name: latent
outputs.description: Represents the final generated sample or sequence of samples, encapsulating the result of the complex sampling process.

VAEEncodeForInpaint (WAS).description: This node is designed for encoding images for inpainting tasks using a Variational Autoencoder (VAE). It processes images, masks, and mask offsets to generate latent representations that are suitable for inpainting, adjusting the input mask based on the specified offset to prepare the image for encoding.

inputs.name: pixels
inputs.description: The input image to be encoded for inpainting. It plays a crucial role in determining the output latent representation.

inputs.name: vae
inputs.description: The Variational Autoencoder (VAE) model used for encoding the input image into a latent representation.

inputs.name: mask
inputs.description: A mask indicating the regions of the image to be inpainted. It is used to modify the input image before encoding.

inputs.name: mask_offset
inputs.description: An integer specifying how much to modify the mask by. This affects the area of the image to be inpainted by either expanding or contracting the masked region.

outputs.name: latent
outputs.description: The latent representation of the input image, suitable for use in inpainting tasks.

VividSharpen.description: The VividSharpen node enhances the sharpness and clarity of images by applying a vivid sharpening effect. It utilizes a combination of Gaussian blur inversion and blending techniques to accentuate details and edges, making the image appear more vivid and defined.

inputs.name: images
inputs.description: Specifies the images to be sharpened. This is the primary input for the sharpening process.

inputs.name: radius
inputs.description: Determines the radius of the Gaussian blur used in the sharpening process. A larger radius results in a more pronounced sharpening effect.

inputs.name: strength
inputs.description: Controls the intensity of the sharpening effect. A higher strength value leads to a more vivid and pronounced sharpening.

outputs.name: images
outputs.description: The sharpened images, enhanced with vivid sharpness and clarity.
